pairs.ne: Data भनेको अर्थ नजोडिएको काँचो तथ्य हो। ७८ एक्लैले केही बताउँदैन। बाँकी तीनलाई प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको छ, त्यसैले ती information हुन्।
pairs.en: Data is a raw fact with no meaning attached. 78 on its own tells you nothing. The other three have been processed and given meaning, which makes them information.

pairs.ne: MySQL एउटा DBMS हो — सफ्टवेयर। डाटाबेस भनेको त्यसले व्यवस्थापन गर्ने data को सङ्ग्रह हो। DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।
pairs.en: MySQL is a DBMS: the software. The database is the collection of data it manages. Calling the DBMS "the database" is the most common slip in this unit.

pairs.ne: उही तथ्य तीन पटक राख्नु redundancy हो; एउटा बदलेपछि प्रतिलिपिहरू बाझिनु inconsistency हो। प्रश्नले अद्यावधिकपछिको नतिजा सोधेकाले उत्तर inconsistency हो।
pairs.en: Storing the same fact three times is redundancy; the copies disagreeing after one is updated is inconsistency. The question asks about the result of the update, so the answer is inconsistency.

pairs.ne: External (view) तह चित्रको सबैभन्दा माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक। Conceptual तहले समग्रमा कुन data छ भन्छ; internal तहले डिस्कमा कसरी राखिएको छ भन्छ।
pairs.en: The external (or view) level is the top of the diagram, nearest the user. The conceptual level says what data exists overall; the internal level says how it is stored on disk.

pairs.ne: Instance भनेको अहिलेको data हो, त्यसैले पङ्क्ति थप्दा बदलिन्छ। Schema भनेको संरचना — तालिकाको नाम, स्तम्भ र कुञ्जी — र विद्यार्थी थप्दा ती बदलिँदैनन्।
pairs.en: The instance is the data in the database right now, so inserting a row changes it. The schema is the structure — the table name, columns and keys — and adding a student does not change any of those.

pairs.ne: DBA सँग डाटाबेसको पूर्ण नियन्त्रण हुन्छ: बनाउने, कसले प्रयोग गर्न पाउने नियन्त्रण गर्ने, backup लिने र कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने।
pairs.en: The DBA has complete control of the database: creating it, controlling who may use it, taking backups and tuning performance.

pairs.ne: Hierarchical model रूख हो, त्यसैले रेकर्डको एउटै parent हुन्छ। Network model ग्राफ हो र धेरै हुन दिन्छ — दुईबीचको परीक्षामा सोधिने फरक यही एउटा हो।
pairs.en: The hierarchical model is a tree, so a record has exactly one parent. The network model is a graph and allows several, which is the single examinable difference between the two.

pairs.ne: एकै ठाउँमा राख्नुले डाटाबेसलाई बलियो बनाउँछ र सँगै एउटै जोखिम बिन्दु पनि। बाँकी तीन फाइदा हुन्।
pairs.en: Centralisation is what makes a database powerful and also what makes it a single point of failure. The other three options are advantages. A question asking for both wants at least one of each.

pairs.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीको प्रयोग: बैंकिङ (खाता र कारोबार), हवाई तथा बस टिकट (सिट), विद्यालय र विश्वविद्यालय (विद्यार्थी, अंक, शुल्क), अस्पताल (बिरामीको रेकर्ड), टेलिकम (कल रेकर्ड), अनलाइन पसल (सामान, अर्डर), र सरकारी अभिलेख — नागरिकता, जग्गा, मतदाता नामावली।
pairs.en: 1.4 — Where database systems are used. Banking (accounts and transactions), airlines and bus booking (seats), schools and universities (students, marks, fees), hospitals (patient records), telecom (call records), online shops (products, orders), and government records — citizenship, land, voter rolls.

pairs.ne: DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। डाटाबेस भनेको data, DBMS भनेको प्रोग्राम।
pairs.en: Calling the DBMS "the database". The database is the data; the DBMS is the program. MySQL is a DBMS.

pairs.ne: तीन तह, र हरेकले के लुकाउँछ।
pairs.en: Three levels, and what each one hides.

pairs.ne: तलबाट सुरु। INTERNAL तह भनेको डिस्कमा डाटा भौतिक रूपमा कसरी बस्छ — फाइल, ब्लक, इन्डेक्स।
pairs.en: Start at the bottom. The INTERNAL level is how the data physically sits on the disk — files, blocks, indexes.

pairs.ne: माथि CONCEPTUAL तहले कुन डाटा छ र कसरी सम्बन्धित छ भन्छ — तालिका र कुञ्जी। डिस्कले कसरी राख्छ भन्ने वास्ता गर्दैन।
pairs.en: Above it, the CONCEPTUAL level says WHAT data exists and how it relates — the tables and keys. It does not care how the disk stores them.

pairs.ne: सबैभन्दा माथि EXTERNAL तह — हरेक प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने कुरा। शिक्षकले अंक, कर्मचारीले ठेगाना। कसैले पूरै डाटाबेस देख्दैन।
pairs.en: At the top, the EXTERNAL level is what each user sees. A teacher sees marks; a clerk sees addresses. Neither sees the whole database.

pairs.ne: तहबीचका खाली ठाउँ नै DATA INDEPENDENCE हुन्। डिस्क भण्डारण बदल्दा तालिका बदलिँदैन; तालिका बदल्दा प्रयोगकर्ताको view उही रहन सक्छ।
pairs.en: The gaps between the levels are DATA INDEPENDENCE. Change the disk storage and the tables do not change; change a table and a user's view can stay the same.

pairs.ne: Data, information, database कि DBMS?
pairs.en: Data, information, database or DBMS?

pairs.ne: १.१ का चार शब्द, वास्तविक उदाहरणमा। विद्यार्थीले अंक गुमाउने ठाउँ एउटै हो — सफ्टवेयरलाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। त्यसैले ती दुईमध्ये कुन हो ध्यान दिएर छान्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: The four words of 1.1, drilled on real cases. The one students lose a mark on is calling the software "the database" — so decide carefully which of those two you are looking at.

pairs.ne: MySQL सफ्टवेयर हो — यसले डाटाबेस बनाउँछ, व्यवस्थापन गर्छ र पहुँच नियन्त्रण गर्छ। डाटाबेस भनेको यसले हेर्ने data हो। युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती यही हो।
pairs.en: MySQL is software — it creates, manages and controls access to a database. The database is the data it looks after. This is the single most common slip in the unit.

pairs.ne: अर्थ नजोडिएको काँचो तथ्य। ७८ के को? कसको? यी उत्तर नआएसम्म यो data हो, information होइन।
pairs.en: A raw fact with no meaning attached. 78 what? Of whom? Until those are answered it is data, not information.

pairs.ne: उही तथ्य, प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको। Data मा काम गर्न सकिने भएपछि त्यो information बन्छ।
pairs.en: The same fact, processed and given meaning. Information is what data becomes once you can act on it.

pairs.ne: सम्बन्धित data को व्यवस्थित सङ्ग्रह। यसलाई व्यवस्थापन गर्ने सफ्टवेयर छुट्टै कुरा हो — यही छुट्याइ नै प्रश्नको सार हो।
pairs.en: An organised collection of related data. Note that the software managing it is a separate thing — that separation is the whole point of the question.

pairs.ne: MySQL र MS Access जस्तै अर्को DBMS। install गर्न मिल्ने भए सफ्टवेयर; तपाईंका पङ्क्ति राख्ने भए डाटाबेस।
pairs.en: Another DBMS, like MySQL and MS Access. If you can install it, it is software; if it holds your rows, it is the database.

pairs.ne: हरेक शब्द अघिल्लोमाथि बनेको छ। "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको प्रायः पूरै उत्तर यही क्रममा छ।
pairs.en: Each word is built on the one before it. Getting the order right is most of the answer to "differentiate between…".

pairs.ne: यिनलाई जोडीमा सम्झनुहोस्। फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा सोध्नु भनेको डाटाबेसले के सुधार्छ भनी सोध्नु हो।
pairs.en: Learn these as pairs. A question asking for the limitations of the file system is really asking what a database fixes.

pairs.ne: Hierarchical र network लाई एउटै प्रश्नले छुट्याउँछ: एउटा रेकर्डका कति parent हुन सक्छन्?
pairs.en: Hierarchical and network are separated by one question: how many parents may a record have?

pairs.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: data, information, database र DBMS को परिभाषा दिन र फरक छुट्याउन, फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा र डाटाबेसले तिनको के जवाफ दिन्छ भन्न, फाइदा–बेफाइदा सूचीबद्ध गर्न, वास्तविक प्रयोग बताउन, प्रयोगकर्ताका प्रकार नाम लिन, तीन तहको संरचना कोरेर व्याख्या गर्न, र चार डाटाबेस मोडेल तुलना गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: Compare the four database models, and define schema and instance.

pairs.ne: पाँचमध्ये दुई सफ्टवेयर हुन्, दुई सामग्री। उत्तर दिनुअघि एउटा प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: के यो install गर्न मिल्छ? मिल्छ भने DBMS; DBMS ले राख्ने वा दिने कुरा भए बाँकी तीनमध्ये एक। अनि आफैंमा अर्थ लाग्छ कि लाग्दैन सोधेर data र information छुट्याउनुहोस्।
pairs.en: Then separate data from information by asking whether it means anything on its own. 78 does not. "Ram scored 78" does.

pairs.ne: एक–एक वाक्यमा: Physical data independence — डिस्कमा data कसरी राखिन्छ त्यो बदल्दा तालिका बदल्नु पर्दैन। Logical data independence — तालिका बदल्दा प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने कुरा बदल्नु पर्दैन। पहिलो हासिल गर्न सजिलो, दोस्रो गाह्रो।
pairs.en: Data independence in one sentence each. Physical data independence — you can change how the data is stored on disk without changing the tables. Logical data independence — you can change the tables without changing what a user sees. Physical is the easier of the two to achieve; logical is harder, because a user's view is built directly on the tables.

pairs.ne: चार अंक, चार हरफ। यसरी दुई स्तम्भमा लेख्नुभयो भने जोडीको एउटा पक्ष मात्र लेख्ने गल्ती हुँदैन — यो प्रश्न प्रायः त्यसैगरी आधा उत्तर हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Four marks, four lines. Answer in a two-column layout like this and you cannot accidentally define only one side of the pair — which is how this question is usually half-answered.

pairs.ne: दुई परिवर्तन आउँदैछन्: डाटाबेस छिटो disk मा सार्नु, र email स्तम्भ थप्नु। खोल्नुअघि दुवैको level निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। independence को नाम level बाटै आउँछ — level ठिक भए दोस्रो आधा आफैँ आउँछ।
pairs.en: Two changes are coming: moving the database to a faster disk, and adding an email column. Decide the level for each before you open this. The name of the independence follows from the level — get the level right and the second half is free.

pairs.ne: तलबाट माथि सोच्नुहोस्: यो डिस्कको कुरा हो, कुन data छ भन्ने कुरा हो, कि कसले देख्छ भन्ने कुरा हो? यी तीन प्रश्न ठ्याक्कै तीन तहमा मिल्छन्, र independence को नाम सधैं आफूले जोगाउने सीमाको तल्लो तहबाट राखिन्छ।
pairs.en: Work from the bottom up: is this about the disk, about what data exists, or about who sees it? Those three questions map onto the three levels exactly, and the independence is always named after the level below the boundary it protects.

pairs.ne: फाइदा र बेफाइदा दुवै सोधिएको ठाउँमा फाइदा मात्र लेख्नु। आधा प्रश्न, आधा अंक।
pairs.en: Listing advantages when the question says advantages AND disadvantages. Half the question, half the marks.

pairs.ne: Schema र instance मिसाउनु। विद्यार्थी थप्दा instance बदलिन्छ, schema होइन।
pairs.en: Mixing up schema and instance. Adding a student changes the instance, not the schema.

pairs.ne: तीन तहको चित्र उल्टो कोर्नु। External माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक; internal तल — डिस्कनजिक।
pairs.en: Drawing the three-level architecture upside down. External is at the top, nearest the user; internal is at the bottom, nearest the disk.

pairs.ne: यो युनिट छोटो छ — ६ घण्टा — तर पूरै विषय यसैका परिभाषामाथि बनेको छ। यहाँका प्रायः सबै प्रश्न परिभाषा दिने, फरक छुट्याउने वा सूची बनाउने हुन्। तीनै सम्झेर लेख्ने भएकाले ठ्याक्कै शब्द याद गर्नु नै काम हो। यस युनिटबाट कोर्न सकिने चित्र तीन तहको संरचना हो।
pairs.en: This unit is short — 6 hours — but it supplies the definitions the whole subject is built on. Almost every question here is either define, differentiate or list. All three are answered from memory, so the work is learning the exact wording rather than reasoning it out in the hall. The three-level architecture is the one diagram from this unit you may be asked to draw.

pairs.ne: तीनै तह सही क्रममा भएको चित्रलाई एक अंक, हरेक तहको व्याख्यालाई एक–एक। तहबीचको data independence उल्लेख गर्दा तीन अंकको उत्तर चार अंकको बन्छ।
pairs.en: One mark for the diagram with all three levels in the right order, and one mark for explaining each level. Mentioning data independence between the levels is what turns a three-mark answer into a four-mark one.

pairs.ne: कुनै तीन — नाम दिएर एक–एक हरफमा व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Any three, each named and explained in one line.

pairs.ne: फाइल प्रणालीका चार समस्या: दोहोरोपन, असङ्गति, अलगाव, र समवर्ती नियन्त्रणको अभाव। डाटाबेसले हरेकको जवाफ दिन्छ।
pairs.en: The file system's four problems are redundancy, inconsistency, isolation and no concurrency control. A database answers each one.

pairs.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीका वास्तविक लागत पनि छन्: पैसा, हार्डवेयर, तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी, र एउटै ठाउँमा जोखिम।
pairs.en: A database system also has real costs: money, hardware, trained staff, and one point of failure.

pairs.ne: प्रयोगकर्ता: DBA, डिजाइनर, एप्लिकेसन प्रोग्रामर, end user।
pairs.en: Users: DBA, designer, application programmer, end user.

pairs.ne: तीन तह: external (प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने), conceptual (कुन data छ), internal (कसरी राखिएको)। बीचका खाली ठाउँ नै data independence हुन्।
pairs.en: Three levels: external (what a user sees), conceptual (what data exists), internal (how it is stored). The gaps between them are data independence.

pairs.ne: Schema संरचना हो, विरलै बदलिन्छ; instance आजको data हो, निरन्तर बदलिन्छ।
pairs.en: Schema is the structure and rarely changes; instance is today's data and changes constantly.

pairs.ne: Data → information → database → DBMS। हरेक अघिल्लोमाथि बनेको, र DBMS सफ्टवेयर हो, data होइन।
pairs.en: Data → information → database → DBMS. Each is built on the one before, and the DBMS is software, not data.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Data भनेको काँचो, प्रशोधन नगरिएको तथ्य हो। एक्लै यसको अर्थ हुँदैन: 78, Ram, 10। Information भनेको प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको data हो: "रामले कक्षा १० मा ७८ अंक ल्याए।" उही तथ्य, अब काम लाग्ने। Database भनेको सम्बन्धित data को सङ्ग्रह हो, जुन राख्न र झिक्न सजिलो हुने गरी व्यवस्थित गरिएको हुन्छ। DBMS (Database Management System) भनेको डाटाबेस बनाउने, व्यवस्थापन गर्ने र पहुँच नियन्त्रण गर्ने सफ्टवेयर हो — MySQL, Oracle, MS Access।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording Data is raw, unprocessed facts. On their own they carry no meaning: 78, Ram, 10. Information is data that has been processed and given meaning: "Ram scored 78 in class 10." The same facts, now useful. A database is a collection of related data, organised so it can be stored and retrieved efficiently. A DBMS (Database Management System) is the software that creates, manages and controls access to a database — MySQL, Oracle, MS Access.

pairs.ne: फाइदा र बेफाइदा फाइदा: दोहोरोपन नियन्त्रण हुन्छ; data एकरूप रहन्छ; प्रयोगकर्ताबीच साझेदारी हुन्छ; सुरक्षा र पहुँच नियन्त्रण सम्भव हुन्छ; backup र recovery भित्रै हुन्छ; मानक लागू गर्न सकिन्छ। बेफाइदा — र यी साँच्चिकै हुन्: DBMS किन्न र चलाउन महँगो हुन्छ; बलियो हार्डवेयर चाहिन्छ; तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी चाहिन्छन्; र सबै एकै ठाउँमा हुने भएकाले एउटै बिग्रँदा सबै प्रभावित हुन्छ। फाइदा मात्र लेखेको उत्तर अपूरो हुन्छ। परीक्षकले दुवै सोध्छन्।
pairs.en: Advantages and disadvantages Advantages: redundancy is controlled; data stays consistent; data is shared between users; security and access control are possible; backup and recovery are built in; standards can be enforced. Disadvantages — and they are real: a DBMS is expensive to buy and to run; it needs powerful hardware; it needs trained staff; and because everything is in one place, a failure affects everything at once. An answer that lists only advantages is an incomplete answer. Examiners ask for both.

pairs.ne: चार प्रयोगकर्ता, चार काम Database Administrator (DBA) — पूर्ण नियन्त्रण। डाटाबेस बनाउने, अधिकार दिने–खोस्ने, backup लिने, कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने। Database Designer — बन्नुअघि नै कुन इन्टिटी र सम्बन्ध चाहिन्छ भन्ने तय गर्ने। Application Programmer — SQL मार्फत डाटाबेस पढ्ने–लेख्ने प्रोग्राम लेख्ने। End User — ती प्रोग्राम चलाउने। naive प्रयोगकर्ताले फारम वा मेनुबाट काम गर्छ र SQL देख्दैन; sophisticated प्रयोगकर्ताले आफैं क्वेरी लेख्छ।
pairs.en: Four users, four jobs Database Administrator (DBA) — has complete control. Creates the database, grants and revokes permission, takes backups, tunes performance. One person, or a small team. Database Designer — decides what entities and relationships the database needs, before it is built. Application Programmer — writes the programs that read and write the database through SQL. End User — uses those programs. A naive end user works through a form or a menu and never sees SQL; a sophisticated end user writes their own queries.

pairs.ne: Schema र instance Schema भनेको डाटाबेसको संरचना हो — तालिकाका नाम, स्तम्भ र तिनका टाइप, कुञ्जी र बन्धन। एक पटक डिजाइन हुन्छ र विरलै बदलिन्छ। Instance भनेको कुनै क्षणमा डाटाबेसमा साँच्चै भएको data हो। पङ्क्ति थपिँदा, बदलिँदा वा हट्दा हरेक पटक फेरिन्छ। उही schema को instance हरेक दिन फरक हुन्छ। नयाँ विद्यार्थी भर्ना हुँदा Student तालिकाको schema बदलिँदैन — instance मात्र बदलिन्छ।
pairs.en: Schema and instance A schema is the structure of the database — the table names, the columns and their types, the keys and the constraints. It is designed once and changes rarely. An instance is the data actually in the database at a given moment. It changes every time a row is inserted, updated or deleted. The same schema has a different instance every day. The schema of the Student table does not change when a new student joins — only its instance does.

pairs.ne: डाटा नै database हो। प्रोग्राम चाहिँ DBMS हो। MySQL एउटा प्रोग्राम हो।

pairs.ne: MySQL DBMS हो — सफ्टवेयर। डाटाबेस भनेको त्यसले व्यवस्थापन गर्ने data को सङ्ग्रह हो। "MySQL एउटा डाटाबेस हो" भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।
pairs.en: MySQL is the DBMS — the software. The database is the collection of data it manages. Saying "MySQL is a database" is the single most common slip in this unit, and it loses the mark in a "differentiate" question.

pairs.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्
pairs.en: Predict first
englishVariants: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Every ER component, one at a time What you will learn: which shape belongs to which idea, and what each one becomes when the diagram is turned into tables. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: कुन आकार कुन विचारको हो, र चित्र तालिकामा बदलिँदा हरेक के बन्छ। How to use this Press each component in turn and watch which part of the diagram lights up. Read the shape name — that is what you have to draw in the exam — and then the sentence, which tells you what the component becomes in a real table. Pay attention to weak entity. "Weak" does not mean unimportant. It means the thing cannot be identified without its owner: a dependant is identified by which employee they belong to, plus their name. हरेक भाग क्रमैसँग थिच्नुहोस् र चित्रको कुन भाग बल्छ हेर्नुहोस्। आकारको नाम पढ्नुहोस् — परीक्षामा कोर्नुपर्ने त्यही हो — अनि वाक्य पढ्नुहोस्, जसले त्यो भाग वास्तविक तालिकामा के बन्छ बताउँछ। कमजोर इन्टिटी मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्। "कमजोर" को अर्थ महत्त्वहीन होइन; मालिकविना चिनिन नसक्ने भन्ने हो। Degree of a relationship is how many entities take part in it — not how many rows. Unary (one entity related to itself: an employee manages an employee), binary (two entities — almost every relationship you will meet), ternary (three). Degree and cardinality are different questions: degree counts entities, cardinality counts how many rows link to how many. सम्बन्धको degree भनेको त्यसमा कति इन्टिटी सहभागी छन् भन्ने हो — कति पङ्क्ति भन्ने होइन। Unary (एउटै इन्टिटी आफैंसँग), binary (दुई — प्रायः सबै), ternary (तीन)। Degree र cardinality फरक प्रश्न हुन्: degree ले इन्टिटी गन्छ, cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्ने। 2.5 Mapping cardinalities Predict first

· अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग The relational table visualiser What you will learn: which part of a table each term names, so the words attach to something you can see instead of to each other. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक शब्दले तालिकाको कुन भाग जनाउँछ — शब्दहरू एकआपसमा होइन, देखिने कुरामा टाँसिऊन् भनेर। What to notice Press Degree and then Cardinality one after the other, and watch the highlight turn from columns to rows. The two counts are printed under the table the whole time — 4 and 4 here, which is unhelpfully equal, so read the word, not the number. Now press Relational schema, then Relational instance. The schema highlights the heading; the instance highlights the body. That is the whole distinction: the heading is the design, the body is today's data. Press the same button twice to clear it. Degree र Cardinality एकपछि अर्को थिच्नुहोस् — उज्यालो स्तम्भबाट पङ्क्तिमा सर्छ। दुवै गणना तालिकामुनि सधैं देखिन्छ। अब Relational schema र Relational instance थिच्नुहोस्। Schema ले शीर्ष भाग, instance ले मुख्य भाग बाल्छ — शीर्ष भनेको डिजाइन, मुख्य भाग भनेको आजको data। उही बटन दोहोर्‍याएर थिच्दा हट्छ। 3.3 — The properties of a relation. Every cell holds a single, atomic value — never a list. No two rows are identical — the primary key guarantees it. The order of rows does not matter, and neither does the order of columns — a table is a set, not a list. Every value in a column comes from the same domain. रिलेसनका गुण: हरेक कक्षमा एउटै अविभाज्य मान हुन्छ — सूची कहिल्यै होइन। दुई पङ्क्ति उस्तै हुँदैनन् — primary key ले सुनिश्चित गर्छ। पङ्क्तिको क्रमले फरक पार्दैन, स्तम्भको क्रमले पनि — तालिका सेट हो, सूची होइन। एउटै स्तम्भका सबै मान उही domain बाट आउँछन्। Predict first

· अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Watch a withdrawal disappear What you will learn: how two people can each do everything correctly and still lose one of the two withdrawals — and what a lock changes. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुई जनाले सबै सही गर्दा पनि दुई निकासीमध्ये एक कसरी हराउँछ — र lock ले के फरक पार्छ। What to notice Step through Both at once and watch the three boxes. At step 2 both clerks hold 5000 — and that is already the bug, four steps before anything looks wrong. The arithmetic is never wrong. Clerk 2 computes 5000 − 2000 = 3000 correctly; the value they started from was simply out of date by then. Nobody makes a mistake and the money is still lost. That is what makes this hard to believe from a definition. Now switch to One at a time. The lock forces clerk 2 to read after clerk 1 has written, so they start from 4000 and the final balance is 2000. Same two transactions, same arithmetic, different order. दुवै एकैचोटि मा चरण–चरण जानुहोस् र तीन बाकस हेर्नुहोस्। चरण २ मै दुवै कर्मचारीसँग ५००० छ — केही बिग्रेको देखिनुभन्दा चार चरण अगाडि नै समस्या सुरु भइसक्यो। गणित कहिल्यै गलत हुँदैन; कर्मचारी २ ले सुरु गरेको मान मात्र पुरानो भइसकेको थियो। कसैले गल्ती गर्दैन, तैपनि पैसा हराउँछ। अब एक–एक गरी मा जानुहोस्: lock ले कर्मचारी २ लाई कर्मचारी १ ले लेखेपछि मात्र पढ्न दिन्छ। Example 1 Reading a concurrency problem from a schedule Question: two transactions run on a balance of 5000. State the final balance, the correct balance, and name the problem. Schedule T1: read balance (5000) T2: read balance (5000) T1: balance = 5000 − 1000 (4000) T2: balance = 5000 − 2000 (3000) T1: write balance (4000) T2: write balance (3000) The whole schedule is above. Work out the balance the database is left holding, and the balance it should have held — the gap between those two numbers is the name of the problem. पूरा schedule माथि छ। डाटाबेसमा अन्तमा बाँकी रहने रकम, र रहनुपर्ने रकम निकाल्नुहोस् — ती दुई सङ्ख्याको फरक नै समस्याको नाम हो। Step 1 — find where the two reads happen. Both read before either writes, so both are working from 5000. Step 2 — find the last write. T2 writes last, so T2's value survives and T1's is overwritten. Answer Final balance 3000 Correct balance 2000 (5000 − 1000 − 2000) Problem lost update Prevented by locking — T2 must wait until T1 has written and released The giveaway in any schedule is two reads before the first write. Look for that pattern and you can name the problem without tracing the arithmetic at all. कुनै पनि schedule मा सङ्केत यही हो: पहिलो write अघि दुई read। यो ढाँचा भेटे गणित नै नगरी समस्याको नाम भन्न सकिन्छ। 6.3 ACID properties {{dia:acidProps}} Learn each property by the disaster it prevents. A definition you can attach to a failure is a definition you can reproduce under pressure. हरेक गुणलाई त्यसले रोक्ने विपत्तिबाट सम्झनुहोस्। असफलतासँग जोडिएको परिभाषा परीक्षामा सजिलै सम्झिन्छ। Predict first

· अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ 1.4 & 1.5 1's complement and 2's complement Both definitions The 1's complement of a binary number is found by changing every 0 to 1 and every 1 to 0. Nothing else happens. The 2's complement is the 1's complement plus 1. They exist so that a computer can represent negative numbers and, more importantly, so that subtraction can be done by the addition circuit. दुवै परिभाषा कुनै binary संख्याको 1's complement निकाल्न हरेक 0 लाई 1 र हरेक 1 लाई 0 बनाइन्छ। अरू केही गरिँदैन। 2's complement भनेको 1's complement मा 1 जोडेको हो। यी ऋणात्मक संख्या देखाउन, र त्योभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण — घटाउलाई जोड्ने सर्किटले नै गर्न सकियोस् भनेर बनाइएका हुन्। Predict first

Simplifying always starts by finding a factor two terms share. Look at the four terms and name the pair that shares one — getting the first grouping right is most of the question. सरल बनाउने काम सधैँ दुई पदले साझा गरेको factor खोजेर सुरु हुन्छ। चारै पद हेरेर साझा भएको जोडी भन्नुहोस् — पहिलो grouping ठिक पार्नु नै आधा प्रश्न हो। Step 1 — group terms that share a factor. The last two both contain AB: F = A'BC + AB'C + AB(C' + C) Step 2 — apply the complement law C' + C = 1: F = A'BC + AB'C + AB Step 3 — take C out of the first two terms: F = C(A'B + AB') + AB Answer: F = C(A′B + AB′) + AB, and since A′B + AB′ is the definition of XOR this can also be written F = C(A ⊕ B) + AB. Marks come from the named steps, not the final line. Write "complement law" or "distributive law" beside each step and you keep the marks even if the last line slips. अंक अन्तिम लाइनले होइन, नाम दिइएका चरणले दिन्छ। हरेक चरणको छेउमा "complement law" वा "distributive law" लेख्नुहोस्। Karnaugh map — simplifying by picture Where this sits in the syllabus. The unit is titled "Boolean algebra and Karnaugh Map" and competency 3 names the K-map, but the numbered content list stops at algebraic simplification. It is taught here because the title and the competency both require it. यो युनिटको नाम नै "Boolean algebra and Karnaugh Map" हो र competency ३ ले पनि के–म्याप तोकेको छ, त्यसैले यहाँ सिकाइएको हो। What a K-map is A Karnaugh map is a truth table redrawn as a grid, arranged so that neighbouring cells differ in exactly one variable. That is why the headings run 00, 01, 11, 10 — not 00, 01, 10, 11. Because neighbours differ by one variable, a group of adjacent 1s lets that one variable cancel. Grouping is therefore the complement law applied by eye instead of on paper. The four rules of grouping: only 1s; size 1, 2, 4 or 8; a rectangle (edges wrap round); and always as large as possible. के–म्याप भनेको के Karnaugh map भनेको ट्रुथ टेबललाई ग्रिडमा फेरि कोरेको हो, तर यसरी मिलाइएको कि छिमेकी कक्षमा ठ्याक्कै एउटा चल मात्र फरक होस्। त्यसैले हेडिङ 00, 01, 11, 10 हुन्छ — 00, 01, 10, 11 होइन। छिमेकीमा एउटै चल फरक हुने भएकाले छेउछाउका 1 को समूहले त्यही चल काट्न दिन्छ। समूह बनाउनु भनेको complement नियमलाई कागजमा नभई आँखाले लागू गर्नु हो। समूहका चार नियम: 1 मात्र; आकार 1, 2, 4 वा 8; आयत (किनारा वरिपरि जोडिन्छन्); र सधैं सक्ने जति ठूलो। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् P-type or N-type? What you will learn: to read a description and decide which material it is, so the "differentiate P-type and N-type" question is answered from recognition rather than from a memorised pair of sentences. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: विवरण पढेर कुन पदार्थ हो छुट्याउन — ताकि "P-type र N-type फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न घोकेको वाक्यबाट होइन, चिनेरै उत्तर दिन सकियोस्। Why this matters: every diode, transistor and chip on a motherboard is built from these two materials joined together. If you cannot tell them apart, the PN junction in 1.4 has nothing to stand on.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: मदरबोर्डको हरेक diode, transistor र चिप यिनै दुई पदार्थ जोडेर बनेको हुन्छ। यी छुट्याउन नसके १.४ को PN junction अडिने ठाउँ नै रहँदैन। 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias Definition — learn this wording A PN junction is formed when a P-type and an N-type material are joined in a single crystal. It is the basis of the diode. At the join, free electrons from the N side cross and fill holes on the P side. That leaves a thin strip with no free carriers — the depletion region — and exposed ions that create a barrier potential of about 0.7 V in silicon (0.3 V in germanium). Forward bias: P to the positive terminal, N to the negative. The depletion region narrows, and once the supply exceeds the barrier, current flows. Reverse bias: the connections are swapped. Carriers are pulled away from the join, the depletion region widens, and current stops — apart from a tiny leakage current carried by the minority carriers. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् PN junction भनेको एउटै क्रिस्टलमा P-type र N-type पदार्थ जोडिँदा बन्ने जोड हो। Diode यसैमा आधारित छ। जोडमा N तर्फका स्वतन्त्र electron पारि गएर P तर्फका hole भर्छन्। त्यसले स्वतन्त्र वाहक नभएको पातलो पट्टी छोड्छ — depletion region — र खुला ion हरूले silicon मा करिब ०.७ V (germanium मा ०.३ V) को barrier potential बनाउँछन्। Forward bias: P धनात्मक टर्मिनलमा, N ऋणात्मकमा। Depletion region साँघुरो हुन्छ, र सप्लाईले barrier नाघेपछि current बग्छ। Reverse bias: जडान उल्टिन्छ। वाहकहरू जोडबाट टाढा तानिन्छन्, depletion region चौडा हुन्छ, र current रोकिन्छ — अल्पसंख्यक वाहकले बोक्ने अति सानो leakage current बाहेक। Predict first

· अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Find each unit, and see what it is responsible for What you will learn: where each unit sits in the flow and exactly what it is responsible for — so that when a question asks which unit does the comparing, you can see the answer rather than recall a sentence. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्रवाहमा हरेक एकाइ कहाँ पर्छ र ठ्याक्कै कसको के जिम्मेवारी हो — ताकि तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्ने प्रश्न आउँदा वाक्य सम्झनुभन्दा उत्तर देख्न सकियोस्। {{dia:hwSystemUnits}} Why this matters: "differentiate between the ALU and the control unit" is asked almost every year, and the marks are lost by students who know both words but attach the wrong job to each. Seeing them side by side in the flow fixes which is which.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "ALU र control unit फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" झन्डै हरेक वर्ष सोधिन्छ, र अंक ती विद्यार्थीले गुमाउँछन् जसलाई दुवै शब्द थाहा हुन्छ तर काम उल्टो जोडिन्छ। प्रवाहमा सँगै देखेपछि कुन कुन हो पक्का हुन्छ। 2.2 The input unit Definition — learn this wording The input unit accepts data and instructions from the outside world and converts them into the binary form the computer can process. Keyboard — each key press closes a switch; the keyboard controller turns that into a scan code, which becomes a character. Mouse — a pointing device. An optical mouse photographs the surface many times a second and works out which way it moved. Scanner — shines light across a document and measures the reflection, producing an image of the page. OCR software is what turns that image into editable text. Digital camera — a lens focuses light onto an image sensor, which converts the brightness at each point into a number and stores it in memory. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Input unit ले बाहिरी संसारबाट data र निर्देशन लिन्छ र कम्प्युटरले प्रशोधन गर्न सक्ने binary रूपमा बदल्छ। Keyboard — हरेक किथिचाइले एउटा स्विच बन्द गर्छ; keyboard controller ले त्यसलाई scan code बनाउँछ, जुन अक्षर बन्छ। Mouse — देखाउने उपकरण। Optical mouse ले सेकेन्डमा धेरै पटक सतहको फोटो खिच्छ र कता सर्‍यो पत्ता लगाउँछ। Scanner — कागजमा बत्ती पार गरेर परावर्तन नाप्छ, र पानाको चित्र बनाउँछ। त्यो चित्रलाई सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षरमा बदल्ने काम OCR सफ्टवेयरको हो। Digital camera — लेन्सले बत्ती image sensor मा केन्द्रित गर्छ, जसले हरेक बिन्दुको उज्यालोलाई सङ्ख्यामा बदलेर मेमोरीमा राख्छ। Predict first

Decide two things before reading on: how many sets, and what Wednesday's failure costs you.पढ्नुअघि दुई कुरा निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: कति सेट चाहिन्छ, र बुधबारको असफलताले के गुमाउँछ। Step 1 — what does an incremental hold? Only what changed since the previous backup of any kind — so Tuesday's holds Monday-to-Tuesday changes, Wednesday's holds Tuesday-to- Wednesday, and so on. Step 2 — rebuild the timeline. Start from Monday's full set, then apply Tuesday's, Wednesday's, Thursday's and Friday's increments in order. That is five sets. Step 3 — remove Wednesday. Thursday's increment holds only what changed after Wednesday's backup. Without Wednesday there is a gap in the chain that nothing else fills, so the restore can only be trusted up to Tuesday. Answer Five sets are needed. Losing Wednesday's breaks the chain: everything from Wednesday onwards is unrecoverable. Run the same failure against a differential scheme and only Friday's differential matters — Wednesday's loss would cost nothing. That is what "two sets" buys you. यही असफलता differential योजनामा लगाउनुहोस् — शुक्रबारको differential मात्र काम लाग्छ, बुधबार हराए केही बिग्रँदैन। "दुई सेट" ले किन्ने कुरा यही हो। 6.3 Devices, media, scheduling and rotation Definition — learn this wording Backup devices and media: external hard disks (large, fast, cheap per gigabyte); USB flash drives (portable, small capacity); optical discs — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (write once, cheap, slow); magnetic tape (very large capacity, low cost, still used for archives); network attached storage; and cloud storage, which is off-site by nature. Scheduling means deciding when backups run and automating them. Backups that depend on someone remembering do not happen. They are usually scheduled outside working hours, because a backup competes for the disk and the network. Media rotation means reusing a set of media in a planned cycle, so that several generations of backup exist at once. The standard scheme is grandfather–father–son: daily backups (son) are kept for a week, weekly backups (father) for a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for a year. Rotation is what protects you from a problem you did not notice immediately. If a file was corrupted three weeks ago and every backup has been overwritten since, the only copies you hold are all corrupted too. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ब्याकअप उपकरण र मिडिया: बाहिरी hard disk (ठूलो, छिटो, प्रति GB सस्तो); USB flash drive (बोक्न सजिलो, कम क्षमता); optical disc — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (एक पटक लेखिने, सस्तो, ढिलो); चुम्बकीय टेप (धेरै ठूलो क्षमता, कम लागत, अभिलेखका लागि अझै प्रयोगमा); network attached storage; र cloud storage, जुन स्वभावतः अर्को ठाउँमा हुन्छ। Scheduling भनेको ब्याकअप कहिले चल्ने तय गरेर स्वचालित बनाउनु हो। कसैले सम्झनुपर्ने ब्याकअप हुँदैन। प्रायः कार्यालय समयबाहिर राखिन्छ, किनकि ब्याकअपले डिस्क र नेटवर्क ओगट्छ। Media rotation भनेको मिडियाको समूहलाई योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग गर्नु, ताकि एकैचोटि ब्याकअपका धेरै पुस्ता रहून्। मानक योजना grandfather–father–son हो: दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) एक वर्ष राखिन्छ। तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाएको समस्याबाट जोगाउने कुरा rotation नै हो। तीन हप्ताअघि फाइल बिग्रेको थियो र त्यसपछि हरेक ब्याकअप ओभरराइट भइसक्यो भने तपाईंसँग भएका सबै प्रतिलिपि पनि बिग्रिएकै हुन्छन्। 6.4 RAID Definition — learn this wording RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so the operating system sees them as one drive, in order to gain speed, fault tolerance, or both. RAID 0 — striping. Data is split across the disks, so reads and writes are faster and the full capacity is usable. There is no redundancy: if any one disk fails, all the data is lost. Minimum two disks. RAID 1 — mirroring. The same data is written to both disks. One disk can fail and the system keeps running. Only half the total capacity is usable. Minimum two disks. RAID 5 — striping with parity. Data and parity information are spread across all the disks. Any one disk can fail and its contents are rebuilt from the parity. The capacity of one disk is given up to parity. Minimum three disks. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्कलाई जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता, वा दुवै पाउन। RAID 0 — striping. Data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, त्यसैले पढ्न–लेख्न छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता प्रयोग हुन्छ। कुनै redundancy छैन: एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै data जान्छ। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 — mirroring. उही data दुवै डिस्कमा लेखिन्छ। एउटा बिग्रिए पनि प्रणाली चलिरहन्छ। कुल क्षमताको आधा मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 — parity सहितको striping. Data र parity सबै डिस्कमा फैलाइन्छ। कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए त्यसको सामग्री parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ। एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमता parity मा जान्छ। न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क। {{dia:hwRaid}} The yellow band is the sentence that separates a full-mark answer from a half one. RAID survives a disk failing; it does not survive a mistake. पहेँलो पट्टी नै पूरा अंक र आधा अंकको उत्तर छुट्याउने वाक्य हो। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिँदा जोगाउँछ; गल्ती भएमा जोगाउँदैन। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which structure does the situation need? What you will learn: to choose a structure from a description instead of reciting the classification. "Which data structure would you use and why" is how this unit's heaviest marks are actually asked. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्गीकरण घोकेर भन्नुको साटो विवरण पढेर संरचना छान्न। "कुन डाटा स्ट्रक्चर प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ र किन" भनी यस युनिटका सबैभन्दा भारी अंक यसै रूपमा सोधिन्छन्। How to use this Answer the two questions in the lead before you press anything. Does the shape branch? If yes it is non-linear — a tree if every item has one parent and no path loops back, a graph if either of those fails. If it does not branch, ask which end things leave from: the same end they entered is a stack, the far end is a queue. The bus-route case is the one worth reading the reason for even when you get it right. It is a graph for one reason only — the routes close into a loop — and that single property is what separates every graph question from every tree question. कुनै बटन थिच्नुअघि लिडका दुई प्रश्नको उत्तर दिनुहोस्। आकार हाँगिन्छ? हाँगिए non-linear — हरेक वस्तुको एउटै अभिभावक र कुनै चक्र नभए tree, यीमध्ये एक पनि नमिले graph। नहाँगिए चीज कुन छेउबाट निस्कन्छ सोध्नुहोस्: भित्र गएकै छेउबाट भए stack, पर्तिरको छेउबाट भए queue। 1.6 Operations on Data Structures OperationWhat it does TraversingVisiting each element exactly once in order to read or process it. हरेक तत्त्वलाई ठीक एक पटक भेटेर पढ्ने वा प्रयोग गर्ने। SearchingFinding the location of an element that matches a given value. दिइएको मानसँग मिल्ने तत्त्व कहाँ छ भनेर पत्ता लगाउने। InsertionAdding a new element into the structure. संरचनामा नयाँ तत्त्व थप्ने। DeletionRemoving an existing element from the structure. भइरहेको तत्त्व हटाउने। SortingArranging elements in a particular order — ascending or descending. तत्त्वहरूलाई सानोदेखि ठूलो वा ठूलोदेखि सानो क्रममा मिलाउने। MergingJoining two sorted lists into one single sorted list. दुईवटा मिलेका लिस्टलाई जोडेर एउटै मिलेको लिस्ट बनाउने। Example 3 Searching — linear search on an array #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int a[6] = {12, 45, 7, 23, 56, 9}; int key = 23, pos = -1; for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) { if (a[i] == key) { // compare one by one pos = i; break; // stop as soon as it is found } } if (pos != -1) cout << "Found " << key << " at index " << pos; else cout << "Not found"; return 0; } Before you open the output: how many comparisons does this loop make before break stops it? That number, not the printed line, is what a question about searching is really asking for. output खोल्नुअघि: break ले रोक्नुअघि यो loop ले कति पटक तुलना गर्छ? छापिने लाइन होइन, त्यही सङ्ख्या नै searching को प्रश्नले साँच्चै सोधेको कुरा हो। Output Found 23 at index 3 Linear search checks elements one by one and works even on unsorted data. Binary search is far faster but the data must be sorted first. Linear search ले एक–एक गरी जाँच्छ र नमिलेको डाटामा पनि चल्छ। Binary search धेरै छिटो हुन्छ तर डाटा मिलेको हुनैपर्छ। ▶ Experiment — Stack (LIFO) vs Queue (FIFO) Commit to an answer first, then run the experiment and see whether you were right. Guessing and being corrected is what makes this stick. Predict first

A negative amount is passed to the setter. Decide what the balance is afterwards — and whether the program stopped, complained, or simply carried on. Which of those three it does is the point of the example. setter मा ऋणात्मक रकम पठाइएको छ। त्यसपछि balance कति हुन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस् — र प्रोग्राम रोकियो, गुनासो गर्‍यो, कि सामान्य रूपमा अघि बढ्यो? तीनमध्ये कुन गर्छ भन्ने नै यो उदाहरणको मुख्य कुरा हो। Output Invalid amount rejected Balance = 5000 This is the whole point of encapsulation. If balance were public, a.balance = -500; would have silently corrupted the account. The setter is a guard at the only door. encapsulation को मुख्य उद्देश्य यही हो। balance public भएको भए a.balance = -500; ले चुपचाप खाता बिगार्थ्यो। setter एउटै ढोकामा उभिएको पहरेदार हो। Advantages of encapsulation Data security — data cannot be changed accidentally or wrongly from outside. Full control — the setter can validate the value before storing it. Read-only or write-only access — provide only a getter, or only a setter, as needed. Easier maintenance and testing — the class can be changed inside without affecting other code. Achieves data hiding, which is one of the main goals of OOP. इनक्याप्सुलेसनका फाइदा डाटा सुरक्षा — बाहिरबाट गल्तीले डाटा बदलिन सक्दैन। पूर्ण नियन्त्रण — setter ले मान राख्नु अघि जाँच्न सक्छ। पढ्ने मात्र वा लेख्ने मात्र पहुँच दिन सकिन्छ। मर्मत र परीक्षण सजिलो — भित्र बदल्दा अरू कोडमा असर पर्दैन। Data hiding हासिल हुन्छ, जुन OOP कै मुख्य लक्ष्य हो। The difference students always get wrong Say it in one line each Abstraction hides the complexity — the "how". Encapsulation hides the data — the "what". Abstraction is a design idea: decide what to show. Encapsulation is an implementation idea: actually protect the data using private plus getters and setters. Abstraction ले जटिलता ("कसरी" गर्ने) लुकाउँछ। Encapsulation ले डाटा ("के" छ) लुकाउँछ। एउटा डिजाइन को कुरा, अर्को कार्यान्वयन/सुरक्षा को कुरा। BasisAbstractionEncapsulation What it hidesHides the complexity / implementation — the "how".Hides the data — the "what". LevelA design-level idea.An implementation-level idea. Achieved byAbstract classes and pure virtual functions; access specifiers.private data with public getter and setter functions. FocusFocuses on what an object does.Focuses on how the data is protected. PurposeTo reduce complexity for the user.To secure the data from misuse. Common mistake Writing "both hide something, so they are the same". They are not. In the Account example above, encapsulation is balance being private. Abstraction is the user being given only setBalance() and getBalance() and never needing to know what happens inside them. "दुवैले केही लुकाउँछन्, त्यसैले उस्तै हुन्" भन्नु गलत। माथिको Account उदाहरणमा — balance private हुनु encapsulation हो; प्रयोगकर्तालाई setBalance() र getBalance() मात्र दिनु र भित्र के हुन्छ थाहा नदिनु abstraction हो। Encapsulation is how it is hidden. Abstraction is what is shown. Encapsulation भनेको कसरी लुकाइएको। Abstraction भनेको के देखाइएको। Predict first

One child, two parents. Decide which line comes from which class before opening this — and whether the printing order is the order the bases were inherited in, or the order the calls were written in. एउटा child, दुई parent। खोल्नुअघि कुन लाइन कुन class बाट आउँछ निर्णय गर्नुहोस् — र छापिने क्रम base inherit गरेको क्रम हो कि call लेखिएको क्रम हो? Output Tall from father Fair from mother Smart on my own The diamond problem and virtual base class The problem In hybrid inheritance, suppose B and C both inherit from A, and D inherits from both B and C. D then receives two copies of everything in A — one through B and one through C. When you write d.show() the compiler cannot decide which copy to use, and reports an ambiguity error. Because the diagram is diamond-shaped, this is called the diamond problem. समस्या Hybrid inheritance मा मानौं B र C दुवैले A बाट इनहेरिट गर्छन्, र D ले B र C दुवैबाट। तब D ले A का सबै कुराको दुई प्रति पाउँछ — एउटा B बाट, अर्को C बाट। d.show() लेख्दा कम्पाइलरले कुन प्रति चलाउने भन्ने निर्णय गर्न सक्दैन र ambiguity error देखाउँछ। चित्र हीरा जस्तो देखिने भएकाले यसलाई diamond problem भनिन्छ। Example 3 Solving it with a virtual base class class A { public: void show() { cout << "From A"; } }; class B : virtual public A { }; // <-- virtual class C : virtual public A { }; // <-- virtual class D : public B, public C { }; int main() { D d; d.show(); // now unambiguous - only ONE copy of A exists return 0; } Output From A The keyword virtual tells C++ to keep only one shared copy of A, so the ambiguity disappears. A base class declared this way is called a virtual base class. virtual शब्दले C++ लाई A को एउटै साझा प्रति राख्न भन्छ, त्यसैले अलमल हट्छ। यसरी घोषित base क्लासलाई virtual base class भनिन्छ। Predict first

The comments tell you which version each call matches. They do not tell you the numbers. Work out all three results before opening this — the third one is a circle, not a square. कुन call ले कुन version मिलाउँछ भन्ने comment ले भन्छ। सङ्ख्या भन्दैन। खोल्नुअघि तीनै नतिजा निकाल्नुहोस् — तेस्रो चाहिँ वृत्त हो, वर्ग होइन। Output Square area = 25 Rectangle area = 24 Circle area = 12.56 One name, three jobs. Version 1 and 3 both take a single argument — they are still valid overloads because the types differ (int vs float). एउटै नाम, तीन काम। संस्करण १ र ३ दुवैले एउटै आर्गुमेन्ट लिन्छन् — तर प्रकार फरक (int vs float) भएकाले दुवै मान्य overload हुन्। Operator overloading Operator overloading Operator overloading means giving an additional meaning to an existing C++ operator so that it also works with objects of your own class. For example + normally adds numbers. By overloading it, you can make c1 + c2 add two Complex number objects. The syntax uses the keyword operator followed by the symbol. अपरेटर ओभरलोडिङ Operator overloading भनेको भइरहेको C++ अपरेटरलाई थप अर्थ दिनु हो, ताकि यो तपाईंकै क्लासका अब्जेक्टसँग पनि काम गरोस्। जस्तै + ले सामान्यतया संख्या जोड्छ। ओभरलोड गरेपछि c1 + c2 ले दुई Complex अब्जेक्ट जोड्न सक्छ। Syntax मा operator कीवर्ड पछि चिन्ह लेखिन्छ। Example 2 Overloading the + operator #include <iostream> using namespace std; class Complex { int real, imag; public: Complex(int r = 0, int i = 0) { real = r; imag = i; } Complex operator + (Complex c) { // overloading + Complex temp; temp.real = real + c.real; temp.imag = imag + c.imag; return temp; } void show() { cout << real << " + " << imag << "i" << endl; } }; int main() { Complex c1(3, 2), c2(1, 7); Complex c3 = c1 + c2; // + now works on objects c3.show(); return 0; } Output 4 + 9i Note that + still adds ordinary numbers exactly as before. Overloading adds a meaning; it never removes the original one. + ले सामान्य संख्या पहिले जस्तै जोड्छ। ओभरलोडिङले अर्थ थप्छ, पुरानो अर्थ हटाउँदैन। 6.5 Function Overriding — run-time Function overriding Function overriding means the derived class defines a function with exactly the same name, the same return type and the same parameters as a function already present in its base class. The derived version replaces the base version for objects of the derived class. Overriding requires inheritance — it is impossible without a base and a derived class. If the base function is marked virtual and you call it through a base class pointer, C++ calls the derived version at run time. That is run-time polymorphism. Without virtual, the base version is called instead. फङ्सन ओभरराइडिङ Function overriding भनेको derived क्लासमा base क्लासकै फङ्सन जस्तै उही नाम, उही return type र उही प्यारामिटर भएको फङ्सन लेख्नु हो। derived अब्जेक्टका लागि derived कै संस्करणले base को संस्करणलाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ। Overriding का लागि inheritance अनिवार्य छ। base फङ्सनमा virtual लेखिएको छ र base पोइन्टर बाट बोलाइयो भने C++ ले चल्दै गर्दा derived संस्करण बोलाउँछ — यही run-time polymorphism हो। virtual नलेखे base कै संस्करण चल्छ। {{dia:dispatch}} The same pointer and the same call give two different answers, because virtual makes C++ look at the real object. उही पोइन्टर, उही कल — तर दुई फरक जवाफ, किनकि virtual ले C++ लाई वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेर्न लगाउँछ। Example 3 With and without virtual — the exam's favourite trick class Base { public: void show() { cout << "Base show" << endl; } // NOT virtual }; class Derived : public Base { public: void show() { cout << "Derived show" << endl; } }; int main() { Base *p; Derived d; p = &d; p->show(); // a Base pointer, holding a Derived object return 0; } A Base pointer is holding a Derived object, and show() is not virtual. Commit to one line of output. Most people answer with the type of the object; without virtual, C++ answers with the type of the pointer. Base pointer ले Derived object समातेको छ, र show() virtual छैन। एउटै लाइन output भन्नुहोस्। धेरैले object को प्रकार भन्छन्; virtual नभए C++ ले pointer को प्रकार भन्छ। Output without virtual Base show Now add one word — virtual void show() in Base — and the very same program prints Derived show instead. One keyword changes the whole output. That is exactly what the examiner is testing. अब Base मा एउटा शब्द थप्नुहोस् — virtual void show() — र उही प्रोग्रामले Derived show छाप्छ। एउटा कीवर्डले पूरै आउटपुट फेर्छ। परीक्षकले जाँच्ने ठ्याक्कै यही हो। Common mistake Thinking overriding works through the object as well as the pointer. If you write Derived d; d.show(); the derived version runs whether or not the function is virtual — because the object's type is known exactly. virtual only matters when you call through a base class pointer or reference. Derived d; d.show(); लेख्दा virtual भए पनि नभए पनि derived कै संस्करण चल्छ — किनकि अब्जेक्टको प्रकार ठ्याक्कै थाहा हुन्छ। virtual को महत्त्व base पोइन्टर बाट बोलाउँदा मात्र देखिन्छ। virtual matters only through a pointer or reference. Through the object, the type is already known. virtual ले pointer वा reference मार्फत मात्र फरक पार्छ। वस्तु मार्फत त प्रकार पहिले नै थाहा हुन्छ। ▶ Experiment — Which function actually runs? Decide first, then check. This is the single most-tested idea in the unit, and the one students most often get backwards. Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which category of language is this? What you will learn: to classify a language from a sample rather than from its name. The deciding question is always who can read it unaided — the processor, a person with a manual, or anybody who learnt the language. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: नाम होइन, नमुना हेरेर भाषा छुट्याउन। निर्णय गर्ने प्रश्न सधैं यही हो — सहायताविना कसले पढ्न सक्छ: प्रोसेसरले, म्यानुअल भएको मान्छेले, कि भाषा सिकेको जोसुकैले? How to use this Read the sample before the options. If you can see register names, it is assembly; if you can see only digits, it is machine; if you can read it as a sentence, it is high level. विकल्पभन्दा पहिले नमुना पढ्नुहोस्। Register का नाम देखिए assembly; अङ्क मात्र देखिए machine; वाक्यजस्तै पढ्न सकिए high level। Predict first

· चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस् Integer division, and where the remainder goes What you will learn: why 7 / 2 is 3 in C even when the answer is stored in a float, and how % recovers the part that division discarded. This is the arithmetic trap of the whole unit. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: नतिजा float मा राखे पनि C मा 7 / 2 किन 3 हुन्छ, र भागले फालेको भाग % ले कसरी फिर्ता ल्याउँछ। पूरै युनिटको गणितीय पासो यही हो। How to use this Stop on the line that assigns to share and predict the value before stepping. Almost everybody says 3.5 the first time. share मा मान राख्ने लाइनमा रोकिएर अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। पहिलो पटक झन्डै सबैले ३.५ भन्छन्। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which loop fits this job best? What you will learn: to choose a loop from the problem rather than from habit. The deciding fact is always whether the number of repetitions is known before the loop starts. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: बानीले होइन, समस्या हेरेर loop छान्न। निर्णय गर्ने कुरा सधैं loop सुरु हुनुअघि दोहोरिने सङ्ख्या थाहा छ कि छैन भन्ने हो। How to use this Ask two questions in order. Do I know the count in advance? If yes, for. If no, must the body happen at least once? If yes, do-while; if no, while. क्रमैसँग दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्। गन्ती पहिल्यै थाहा छ? छ भने for। छैन भने — body कम्तीमा एक पटक हुनैपर्छ? पर्छ भने do-while; पर्दैन भने while। Predict first

· चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस् An array, an index, and a running total What you will learn: which element marks[i] is on each turn, and what happens at the end when i reaches 5. The last two steps are the ones worth the attention — they are the off-by-one error, shown rather than described. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक पटक marks[i] कुन element हो, र अन्त्यमा i ५ पुग्दा के हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई चरण नै ध्यान दिनुपर्ने ठाउँ हुन् — off-by-one त्रुटि वर्णन होइन, देखाइएको छ। How to use this Keep asking "which box is this?" rather than "what number is this?". The index row and the element row are deliberately separate, because confusing them is the error. "यो कुन बाकस हो?" सोध्नुहोस्, "यो कुन सङ्ख्या हो?" होइन। Index को पङ्क्ति र element को पङ्क्ति जानीजानी छुट्याइएका छन्, किनभने तिनलाई मिसाउनु नै गल्ती हो। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Structure or union? What you will learn: to choose between them from what the program needs, which is the form the examination question takes. The deciding question is whether more than one member must hold a value at the same time. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्रोग्रामलाई के चाहिन्छ हेरेर दुईमध्ये छान्न — परीक्षाको प्रश्न यही रूपमा आउँछ। निर्णय गर्ने प्रश्न यही हो: एकैचोटि एकभन्दा बढी member सँग मान हुनुपर्छ कि पर्दैन? How to use this Two clues give a union away every time: a size equal to the largest member rather than the total, and a member going strange after a different member was written. दुई सुराकले union सधैं चिनाउँछन्: आकार जोड नभई सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर हुनु, र अर्को member लेखेपछि एउटा member अनौठो हुनु। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which pointer operator is needed here? What you will learn: to decide between & and * from the direction the line is travelling — taking an address out, or taking a value out of an address. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: लाइन कुन दिशामा गइरहेको छ हेरेर & र * छुट्याउन — ठेगाना निकालेको, कि ठेगानाबाट मान निकालेको। How to use this One case needs neither operator. An array name is already an address, which is why scanf("%s", name) takes no ampersand while scanf("%d", &n) does. एउटा केसमा कुनै पनि operator चाहिँदैन। Array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो — त्यसैले scanf("%s", name) लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन र scanf("%d", &n) लाई चाहिन्छ। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which Internet service does this task need? What you will learn: to match a real task to the service designed for it. Two of the cases are the pair students most often swap. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक काम र त्यसैका लागि बनेको सेवा मिलाउन। दुई केस विद्यार्थीले सबैभन्दा धेरै साटिने जोडी हुन्। How to use this Ask who the message is for. One named person, everybody, a machine you are operating, or a shop you are paying? The service follows from the answer. सन्देश कसका लागि हो सोध्नुहोस्। एक जना तोकिएको व्यक्ति, सबै, तपाईंले चलाइरहेको मेसिन, कि तिर्न लागेको पसल? उत्तरबाटै सेवा निस्कन्छ। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which component of multimedia is this? What you will learn: to tell the five components apart from a description. Two cases both move, and the difference is where the pictures came from. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णनबाटै पाँच भाग छुट्याउन। दुई केसमा दुवै चल्छन्, र फरक तस्बिर कहाँबाट आयो भन्नेमा छ। How to use this Ask two questions: does it move, and was it recorded or created? Those two sort all five. दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: चल्छ? र रेकर्ड गरिएको हो कि बनाइएको? यी दुईले पाँचै छुट्याउँछन्। Predict first

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which emerging technology is this? What you will learn: to identify a technology from a situation, which is how this unit is examined. The pairs that get confused — cloud against distributed, big data against data mining, VR against AR — are all here. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: परिस्थितिबाटै प्रविधि चिन्न — यो युनिट यसरी नै जाँचिन्छ। अलमल पार्ने जोडी — cloud र distributed, big data र data mining, VR र AR — सबै यहीँ छन्। How to use this Three questions settle most of them: whose computer is it, is the user still able to see the room, and is this the data or the digging? तीन प्रश्नले धेरैजसो टुङ्ग्याउँछन्: कम्प्युटर कसको हो, प्रयोगकर्ताले कोठा अझै देख्छ कि देख्दैन, र यो data हो कि खोतल्ने काम? Predict first

pairs.ne: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्
pairs.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A school stores its student records in MySQL. Which of these is the DATABASE? एउटा विद्यालयले विद्यार्थीको रेकर्ड MySQL मा राख्छ। यीमध्ये कुन डाटाबेस हो? MySQL The stored student records The computer it runs on MySQL is the DBMS — the software. The database is the collection of data it manages. Saying "MySQL is a database" is the single most common slip in this unit, and it loses the mark in a "differentiate" question. MySQL DBMS हो — सफ्टवेयर। डाटाबेस भनेको त्यसले व्यवस्थापन गर्ने data को सङ्ग्रह हो। "MySQL एउटा डाटाबेस हो" भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो। Practise the judgement
englishVariants: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग The ER visualiser — what a cardinality actually means What you will learn: the difference between one-to-many and many-to-many, shown in rows rather than in notation — and why only one of them needs a third table. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: एक–धेरै र धेरै–धेरैको फरक, चिन्हमा होइन पङ्क्तिमा देखेर — र किन तीमध्ये एउटालाई मात्र तेस्रो तालिका चाहिन्छ। What to notice The notation at the top barely changes between the three buttons — one letter. The rows underneath change completely, and that is the real difference. On 1:M, read the note under the list: every course points back at exactly one student. Now press M:N. The same note changes — Maths is now reached from two students. Both directions are "many", and that is the whole definition. Only M:N produces a junction table. Watch it appear, and notice it holds nothing but two foreign keys — one row per link, which is exactly what the relationship is. माथिको चिन्ह तीन बटनबीच झन्डै बदलिँदैन — एउटा अक्षर मात्र। तलका पङ्क्ति भने पूरै बदलिन्छन्, र वास्तविक फरक त्यही हो। 1:M मा सूचीमुनिको टिप्पणी पढ्नुहोस्: हरेक विषयले ठ्याक्कै एउटा विद्यार्थी देखाउँछ। अब M:N थिच्नुहोस् — Maths अब दुई विद्यार्थीबाट जोडिन्छ। दुवैतर्फ "धेरै", र पूरा परिभाषा यही हो। M:N ले मात्र junction तालिका बनाउँछ; त्यसमा दुई foreign key बाहेक केही हुँदैन। Practise the judgement

· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A table has the composite key (student_id, subject) and also holds the student's name. What kind of dependency is student_id → name? एउटा तालिकाको composite कुञ्जी (student_id, subject) छ र विद्यार्थीको नाम पनि छ। student_id → name कस्तो निर्भरता हो? Full Partial Transitive Partial. The key is both columns together, but name depends on only student_id — half the key. That is the definition of a partial dependency, and it is exactly what 2NF removes. A partial dependency is only possible when the key is composite; with a single-column key there is no "part" of it to depend on. Partial। कुञ्जी दुवै स्तम्भ मिलेर हो, तर name student_id मा मात्र निर्भर छ — आधा कुञ्जीमा। partial dependency को परिभाषा यही हो, र 2NF ले हटाउने पनि यही। कुञ्जी composite भएमा मात्र partial dependency सम्भव हुन्छ। {{dia:dbDependencies}} All three kinds on one table, so they can be told apart rather than recited. Read where the arrow starts — the whole key, part of the key, or a column that is not the key at all. That single question decides which normal form a table has broken, and it is the same table the normalisation walkthrough below uses. तीनै किसिम एउटै तालिकामा, ताकि घोकेर होइन, छुट्याएर भन्न सकियोस्। तीर कहाँबाट सुरु हुन्छ हेर्नुहोस् — पूरै कुञ्जीबाट, कुञ्जीको एक भागबाट, कि कुञ्जी नै नभएको स्तम्भबाट। यही एउटा प्रश्नले तालिकाले कुन normal form भङ्ग गर्‍यो निर्णय गर्छ, र तल normalization हेर्दा पनि यही तालिका चल्छ। 5.2 & 5.3 Normalization to 3NF {{dia:normalForms}} The three rules, stated exactly First Normal Form (1NF). A relation is in 1NF if every attribute holds only atomic (single) values and there are no repeating groups. Second Normal Form (2NF). A relation is in 2NF if it is in 1NF and every non-key attribute is fully functionally dependent on the whole primary key — that is, no partial dependency. Third Normal Form (3NF). A relation is in 3NF if it is in 2NF and no non-key attribute depends on another non-key attribute — that is, no transitive dependency. Notice the shape: each form includes the one before it. A table cannot be in 3NF without already being in 2NF and 1NF, which is why they are always applied in order. तीन नियम, ठ्याक्कै First Normal Form (1NF). हरेक एट्रिब्युटले अविभाज्य (एउटै) मान मात्र राखेको र दोहोरिने समूह नभएको रिलेसन 1NF मा हुन्छ। Second Normal Form (2NF). 1NF मा भएको र हरेक कुञ्जी–बाहेकको एट्रिब्युट पूरै primary key मा पूर्ण रूपमा निर्भर भएको — अर्थात् partial dependency नभएको। Third Normal Form (3NF). 2NF मा भएको र कुनै पनि कुञ्जी–बाहेकको एट्रिब्युट अर्को कुञ्जी–बाहेकको एट्रिब्युटमा निर्भर नभएको — अर्थात् transitive dependency नभएको। बनावट हेर्नुहोस्: हरेक रूपले अघिल्लोलाई समेट्छ। 1NF र 2NF नभई 3NF हुन सक्दैन, त्यसैले क्रमैसँग लागू गरिन्छ। Example 1 Normalising a table to 3NF, step by step Question: normalise this table to 3NF, naming the problem removed at each step. Given Student( roll, name, class_id, class_room, subjects ) roll name class_id class_room subjects 1 Ram 10 A-1 Maths, Science 2 Sita 10 A-1 Maths 3 Hari 11 B-2 Science Step 1 — 1NF. The subjects cell holds two values. Split it so every cell holds one value; the key becomes (roll, subject): 1NF Student( roll, subject, name, class_id, class_room ) 1 Maths Ram 10 A-1 1 Science Ram 10 A-1 2 Maths Sita 10 A-1 3 Science Hari 11 B-2 Problem removed: repeating group Step 2 — 2NF. The key is (roll, subject), but name, class_id and class_room depend on roll alone — a partial dependency. Split the table: 2NF Student( roll, name, class_id, class_room ) Takes ( roll, subject ) Problem removed: partial dependency Step 3 — 3NF. In Student, class_room depends on class_id, which depends on roll — a transitive dependency through a non-key column. Move it out: 3NF — answer Student( roll, name, class_id ) FK → Class.class_id Class ( class_id, class_room ) Takes ( roll, subject ) Problem removed: transitive dependency Three tables, and now each fact is written once. Change room A-1 and you change one row, not forty. That is the anomaly gone, which is the whole point — write that sentence in your answer and you have shown you understand normalization rather than memorised it. तीन तालिका, र अब हरेक तथ्य एक पटक मात्र लेखिएको छ। कोठा A-1 बदल्दा एउटै पङ्क्ति बदलिन्छ, चालीस होइन। anomaly हट्यो — उत्तरमा यही वाक्य लेख्नुभयो भने घोकेको होइन, बुझेको देखिन्छ। Practise the judgement

· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A full backup is taken on Sunday. Differential backups run Monday to Friday. The disk fails on Friday evening. How many backup files are needed to restore? आइतबार full backup लिइयो। सोमबारदेखि शुक्रबारसम्म differential backup। शुक्रबार साँझ डिस्क बिग्रियो। फर्काउन कति backup फाइल चाहिन्छ? One — Friday's Two — Sunday's and Friday's Six — all of them Two. A differential backup holds everything that changed since the last full backup, so Friday's already contains Monday to Thursday's changes as well. You need the full backup plus the most recent differential. Had they been incremental, the answer would be six — each incremental holds only what changed since the previous backup, so every one is needed, in order. That is the trade: differential takes more space, incremental takes more restoring. दुई। Differential ले अघिल्लो full backup देखिका सबै परिवर्तन राख्छ, त्यसैले शुक्रबारकोमा सोम–बिहीका पनि छन्। Full र सबैभन्दा नयाँ differential चाहिन्छ। Incremental भएको भए उत्तर छ हुन्थ्यो। सन्तुलन यही हो: differential ले ठाउँ बढी लिन्छ, incremental ले फर्काउन समय। 7.5 Recovery — redo and undo {{dia:recoveryLog}} One log, two directions Recovery is the process of restoring the database to a correct, consistent state after a failure. The tool it uses is the log — a file in which the DBMS records every change before it is applied. After a crash the recovery manager reads the log and sorts every transaction into one of two piles, by a single test: is there a COMMIT record? REDO — the transaction committed, so its work must exist. The log is read forwards and the changes are applied again. This delivers durability. UNDO — the transaction did not commit, so its half-finished work must not survive. The log is read backwards and the changes are reversed. This delivers atomicity. एउटै लग, दुई दिशा Recovery भनेको असफलतापछि डाटाबेसलाई सही र सङ्गत अवस्थामा फर्काउने प्रक्रिया हो। यसले प्रयोग गर्ने साधन log हो — DBMS ले हरेक परिवर्तन लागू गर्नु अघि लेख्ने फाइल। Crash पछि recovery manager ले log पढेर हरेक ट्रान्ज्याक्सनलाई एउटै जाँचबाट दुई थुप्रोमा छुट्याउँछ: COMMIT रेकर्ड छ कि छैन? REDO — commit भएको थियो, त्यसैले काम रहनुपर्छ। Log अगाडिबाट पढेर परिवर्तन फेरि लागू गरिन्छ। यसले durability दिन्छ। UNDO — commit भएको थिएन, त्यसैले आधा काम बाँच्नु हुँदैन। Log पछाडिबाट पढेर परिवर्तन उल्टाइन्छ। यसले atomicity दिन्छ। Example 1 Deciding redo or undo from a log Question: the log below survives a crash. State what recovery does with T1, T2 and T3, and give the reason. Given T1 start T1 write A T1 COMMIT T2 start T2 write B T3 start T3 write C T3 COMMIT -- CRASH -- Answer T1 REDO it has a COMMIT record, so its work must exist T2 UNDO no COMMIT record — it was still running T3 REDO it has a COMMIT record Do not read the order or the amount of work done. The only question is whether a COMMIT record appears before the crash. T2 had written B — real work, on its way to the disk — and it is still discarded entirely, because atomicity does not allow half a transaction to survive. क्रम वा कति काम भयो भन्ने नहेर्नुहोस्। एउटै प्रश्न हो — crash अघि COMMIT रेकर्ड छ कि छैन। T2 ले B लेखिसकेको थियो — साँच्चिकै काम — तर पूरै हटाइन्छ, किनभने atomicity ले आधा ट्रान्ज्याक्सन बाँच्न दिँदैन। Practise the judgement

Work it out before you read on — the whole law is one sentence, and you already have it.पढ्नुअघि आफैँ निकाल्नुहोस् — पूरै नियम एउटै वाक्य हो, र त्यो तपाईंसँग छ। Step 1 — add everything going in. 5 + 3 = 8 A. Step 2 — add everything going out that you know. 6 A on the one named branch. Step 3 — KCL says the two totals must match. 8 = 6 + I, so I = 2 A. Answer I = 2 A, flowing OUT of the junction Say the direction, not just the number. A junction question with an unsigned answer is only half answered, because "2 A" is true of a current going either way. सङ्ख्या मात्र होइन, दिशा पनि लेख्नुहोस्। दिशा नलेखिएको उत्तर आधा मात्र हो — किनकि "२ A" दुवै दिशाको current लाई मिल्छ। Example 2 Finding a missing voltage drop with KVL Question: a 12 V supply feeds a loop with three resistors. R₁ drops 5 V and R₂ drops 4 V. What does R₃ drop? Step 1 — write the law for this loop. Supply = sum of drops, so 12 = 5 + 4 + R₃. Step 2 — collect the known drops. 5 + 4 = 9 V. Step 3 — subtract. R₃ = 12 − 9 = 3 V. Answer R₃ drops 3 V This is the check a technician makes on a suspect power rail: if the drops do not add up to the supply, either a reading is wrong or there is a fault in the loop. बिग्रिएको पावर रेल जाँच्दा टेक्निसियनले यही हेर्छ: ड्रपको योग सप्लाईसँग मिलेन भने या त कुनै रिडिङ गलत छ, या loop मै खराबी छ। 1.3 Semiconductors and doping Definition — learn this wording A semiconductor conducts better than an insulator but worse than a conductor. Silicon and germanium are the two used. Each has four valence electrons, so a pure crystal has none spare and barely conducts. Doping is deliberately adding a small amount of impurity to a pure semiconductor to increase its conductivity. N-type — add a pentavalent impurity (5 valence electrons: phosphorus, arsenic). Four electrons bond; the fifth is spare and free to move. P-type — add a trivalent impurity (3 valence electrons: boron, gallium). One bond is left unfilled, and that gap is a hole. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Semiconductor ले insulator भन्दा राम्रो तर conductor भन्दा कम बिजुली चलाउँछ। Silicon र germanium दुई प्रयोग हुन्छन्। दुवैमा चार valence electron हुन्छन्, त्यसैले शुद्ध क्रिस्टलमा फाल्तु electron हुँदैन र मुस्किलले चल्छ। Doping भनेको चालकता बढाउन शुद्ध semiconductor मा जानाजान थोरै अशुद्धि मिसाउनु हो। N-type — pentavalent अशुद्धि (५ valence electron: phosphorus, arsenic) मिसाउनुहोस्। चार वटाले बन्धन बनाउँछन्; पाँचौं फाल्तु रहन्छ र चल्न स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ। P-type — trivalent अशुद्धि (३ valence electron: boron, gallium) मिसाउनुहोस्। एउटा बन्धन खाली रहन्छ, र त्यही खाली ठाउँ hole हो। {{dia:hwDoping}} The yellow band at the bottom is the line that most often decides a mark: doping adds a carrier, not a charge. Both doped types are still electrically neutral. तलको पहेँलो पट्टी नै प्रायः अंक निर्धारण गर्ने वाक्य हो: doping ले वाहक थप्छ, चार्ज होइन। दुवै doped प्रकार अझै विद्युतीय रूपमा उदासीन छन्। Majority and minority carriers Both kinds of carrier exist in both materials. What changes is which one dominates. In N-type: electrons are the majority carrier, holes the minority. In P-type: holes are the majority carrier, electrons the minority. The minority carriers come from heat breaking bonds in the silicon itself, which is why a hot device leaks more current than a cold one. बहुसंख्यक र अल्पसंख्यक वाहक दुवै किसिमका वाहक दुवै पदार्थमा हुन्छन्। फरक यत्ति हो कि कुन हावी हुन्छ। N-type मा: electron बहुसंख्यक, hole अल्पसंख्यक वाहक हो। P-type मा: hole बहुसंख्यक, electron अल्पसंख्यक वाहक हो। अल्पसंख्यक वाहक silicon भित्रै तापले बन्धन टुट्दा बन्छन् — त्यसैले तातो उपकरणले चिसो भन्दा बढी current चुहाउँछ। Practise the judgement

· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् You scan a printed page. Straight afterwards, can you edit the words in a word processor? तपाईंले छापिएको पाना स्क्यान गर्नुभयो। लगत्तै word processor मा शब्दहरू सम्पादन गर्न सकिन्छ? Yes — a scanner produces text Yes, but only if the page was typed No — you get an image until OCR converts it A scanner is a light sensor, not a reader. What it produces is a picture of the page — the letters in it are just dark pixels. OCR (Optical Character Recognition) software has to examine that picture and work out which shapes are which characters before anything becomes editable text. Scanner बत्ती नाप्ने सेन्सर हो, पढ्ने यन्त्र होइन। यसले पानाको तस्बिर दिन्छ — त्यसका अक्षर केवल कालो पिक्सेल हुन्। OCR (Optical Character Recognition) सफ्टवेयरले त्यो तस्बिर हेरेर कुन आकार कुन अक्षर हो पत्ता लगाएपछि मात्र सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षर बन्छ। 2.3 The processing unit — ALU and control unit Definition — learn this wording The ALU (Arithmetic and Logic Unit) performs all arithmetic operations (+ − × ÷) and all logical operations (greater than, less than, equal to, AND, OR, NOT). Every calculation and every comparison in the machine happens here and nowhere else. The control unit (CU) directs the whole system. It fetches each instruction from memory, decodes it to work out what is required, and sends the signals that tell each unit what to do and when. It does not calculate anything itself. A useful picture: the ALU is the worker, the control unit is the supervisor. The supervisor decides what gets done next; the worker does it. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ALU (Arithmetic and Logic Unit) ले सबै अंकगणितीय काम (+ − × ÷) र सबै तार्किक काम (ठूलो, सानो, बराबर, AND, OR, NOT) गर्छ। मेसिनको हरेक गणना र हरेक तुलना यहीँ हुन्छ, अन्त कतै हुँदैन। Control unit (CU) ले पूरै प्रणाली निर्देशित गर्छ। मेमोरीबाट हरेक निर्देशन ल्याउँछ, के चाहिएको हो बुझ्छ, र कुन एकाइले कहिले के गर्ने भन्ने सङ्केत पठाउँछ। यसले आफैँ केही गणना गर्दैन। सम्झने तरिका: ALU कामदार हो, control unit सुपरभाइजर। सुपरभाइजरले अब के गर्ने भन्छ; कामदारले गर्छ। Example 1 Which unit does what, on one instruction Question: a program contains the instruction IF marks > 40 THEN print "PASS". Which unit does each part of the work? Before you read on, decide one thing: which unit performs the comparison?पढ्नुअघि एउटा कुरा निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: तुलना कुन एकाइले गर्छ? Step 1 — the instruction has to be brought in. The control unit fetches it from memory and decodes it. Step 2 — the value of marks has to be available. It is held in the memory unit. Step 3 — marks > 40 has to be evaluated. That is a comparison, which is a logical operation, so the ALU does it and reports true or false. Step 4 — the result decides what happens next. The control unit reads the ALU's answer and directs the machine to the printing instruction. Step 5 — "PASS" reaches the user. Through the output unit. Answer CU fetches and decodes · memory holds the value · ALU compares · CU acts on the result · output unit displays Notice the control unit appears twice and never calculates. That is the distinction the exam is testing. ध्यान दिनुहोस्, control unit दुई पटक आउँछ र कहिल्यै गणना गर्दैन। परीक्षाले जाँच्ने भिन्नता यही हो। 2.4 The display unit Definition — learn this wording Resolution is the number of pixels across by the number down — 1366 × 768. More pixels means a sharper picture and more detail in the same area. Colour depth is the number of bits used to describe one pixel's colour. 24-bit gives about 16.7 million colours; fewer bits produce visible banding in a gradient. Refresh rate is how many times per second the screen is redrawn, measured in hertz. 60 Hz means sixty times a second. Too low a rate is visible as flicker and causes eye strain. CRT fires an electron beam at a phosphor coating — bulky, heavy, hot, most power. LCD uses liquid crystals to block or pass light from a lamp behind them — flat and far cooler. LED is an LCD whose backlight is made of LEDs instead — thinner still, better contrast, least power. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Resolution भनेको चौडाइका पिक्सेल × उचाइका पिक्सेल — १३६६ × ७६८। बढी पिक्सेल भनेको उही ठाउँमा तीक्ष्ण तस्बिर र बढी विवरण। Colour depth भनेको एउटा पिक्सेलको रङ बताउन प्रयोग हुने bit सङ्ख्या। २४-bit ले करिब १ करोड ६७ लाख रङ दिन्छ; कम bit भए रङ बदलिँदा पट्टीहरू देखिन्छन्। Refresh rate भनेको स्क्रिन सेकेन्डमा कति पटक फेरि कोरिन्छ — hertz मा नापिन्छ। ६० Hz भनेको सेकेन्डमा साठी पटक। धेरै कम भए झिमझिम देखिन्छ र आँखा दुख्छ। CRT ले phosphor मा electron किरण हान्छ — ठूलो, गह्रौं, तातो, सबैभन्दा बढी बिजुली। LCD ले पछाडिको बत्तीलाई liquid crystal ले छेक्ने वा पास गर्ने गर्छ — पातलो र धेरै चिसो। LED भनेको त्यही LCD हो, तर पछाडिको बत्ती LED को — झन् पातलो, राम्रो contrast, सबैभन्दा कम बिजुली। {{dia:hwDisplayTech}} LED is not a different kind of screen from LCD — it is an LCD with a different backlight. Saying so earns the mark that "LED is newer" does not. LED, LCD भन्दा फरक किसिमको स्क्रिन होइन — फरक backlight भएको LCD हो। यही भन्दा अंक मिल्छ; "LED नयाँ हो" भन्दा मिल्दैन। Practise the judgement

· आफैँ निदान गर्नुहोस् The fault lab — it restarts by itself after a while What you will learn: to use the timing of a fault as evidence. This scenario cannot be solved by naming a part — it is solved by noticing when the failure happens and what that rules out. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: खराबीको समय लाई प्रमाणका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न। यो अवस्था पार्टको नाम भनेर समाधान हुँदैन — कहिले बिग्रिन्छ र त्यसले के हटाउँछ भनी ध्यान दिएर हुन्छ। Why this matters: a fault that appears only after the machine warms up is one of the few whose cause is written in its timing. Students who never learn to read that will replace a processor to fix a dusty heatsink.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: मेसिन तातेपछि मात्र देखिने खराबी ती थोरैमध्ये एक हो जसको कारण समयमै लेखिएको हुन्छ। यो पढ्न नसिकेका विद्यार्थीले धुलो भरिएको heatsink मिलाउन प्रोसेसरै साट्छन्। 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults Symptom Most likely cause What to do Screen blurry or stretchedस्क्रिन धमिलो वा तानिएको Resolution not set to the monitor's native valueMonitor को आफ्नै resolution मा सेट नभएको Set the recommended resolution in display settingsDisplay सेटिङमा सिफारिस गरिएको resolution राख्ने Wrong or missing coloursरङ गलत वा नआएको Loose or damaged video cable — a bent pinVideo केबल खुकुलो वा बिग्रेको — पिन बाङ्गिएको Reseat the cable; check the pins; try another cableकेबल फेरि कस्ने; पिन हेर्ने; अर्को केबल जोड्ने Flickering, tiring to look atझिमझिम, हेर्न थकाइ लाग्ने Refresh rate set too lowRefresh rate धेरै कम राखिएको Raise it to the highest the monitor supportsMonitor ले सक्ने सबैभन्दा माथि बढाउने Distorted patterns or artefacts on screenस्क्रिनमा बिग्रिएका आकार वा धब्बा Video card overheating or failingVideo card तात्दै वा बिग्रँदै Clean its fan and fins; reseat the card; test in another slotयसको पंखा र पत्र सफा गर्ने; कार्ड फेरि बसाल्ने; अर्को slot मा जाँच्ने Device not recognised at allउपकरण पत्तै नलागेको Loose connector, dead port, or a missing driverConnector खुकुलो, पोर्ट मरेको, वा driver नभएको Try another port, then another cable, then install the driverअर्को पोर्ट, अनि अर्को केबल, अनि driver इन्स्टल Practise the judgement

· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A server uses RAID 1. A user deletes an important folder by mistake. Is it recoverable from the RAID? एउटा सर्भरमा RAID 1 छ। प्रयोगकर्ताले भुलवश महत्त्वपूर्ण फोल्डर मेट्छ। के त्यो RAID बाट फर्काउन सकिन्छ? Yes — the second disk still has it No — the deletion was mirrored too Yes, but only within 24 hours Mirroring copies every change to both disks, and a deletion is a change. Both disks lose the folder at the same instant. RAID protects against a disk failing — a mechanical event affecting one disk. It gives no protection against deletion, overwriting, a virus or ransomware, because those are legitimate write operations as far as the array is concerned. Only a backup, held separately and not written to continuously, recovers this. Mirroring ले हरेक परिवर्तन दुवै डिस्कमा सार्छ, र मेटाइ पनि परिवर्तन हो। दुवै डिस्कले एकै क्षणमा फोल्डर गुमाउँछन्। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिनु — एउटा डिस्कमा हुने यान्त्रिक घटना — बाट जोगाउँछ। मेटाइ, ओभरराइट, भाइरस वा ransomware बाट जोगाउँदैन, किनकि array का लागि ती वैध लेखाइ हुन्। छुट्टै राखिएको र निरन्तर नलेखिने ब्याकअपले मात्र यो फर्काउँछ। 6.5 Recovery techniques Match the technique to the failure Restore from backup — the general answer, and the only one that works when data itself has been lost or corrupted. System restore point — rolls the operating system's settings and drivers back to an earlier state. Fixes a bad update or driver; does not recover deleted personal files. Recovery / repair console — repairs a damaged boot sector or system files so the machine can start again. Data recovery software — scans sectors directly to retrieve files whose index entries were deleted. This works precisely because a quick format and a delete do not remove the data itself. Professional recovery from a failed drive — for physical damage such as a head crash, done in a clean room. Expensive, and never guaranteed. Rebuilding a RAID array — replacing a failed disk and letting the array rebuild its contents from the mirror or the parity. खराबी अनुसार उपाय मिलाउनुहोस् ब्याकअपबाट फर्काउने — सामान्य उत्तर, र data नै हराएको वा बिग्रिएको बेला काम लाग्ने एक मात्र उपाय। System restore point — अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सेटिङ र driver लाई अघिल्लो अवस्थामा फर्काउँछ। खराब अपडेट वा driver मिलाउँछ; मेटिएका व्यक्तिगत फाइल फर्काउँदैन। Recovery / repair console — बिग्रिएको boot sector वा सिस्टम फाइल मर्मत गरेर मेसिन फेरि सुरु हुन दिन्छ। Data recovery सफ्टवेयर — सूची मेटिएका फाइल फर्काउन sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। यो चल्नुको कारण नै quick format र delete ले data आफैँ नहटाउनु हो। बिग्रेको ड्राइभबाट व्यावसायिक रिकभरी — head crash जस्तो भौतिक क्षतिका लागि, clean room मा गरिने। महँगो, र कहिल्यै ग्यारेन्टी नहुने। RAID array पुनर्निर्माण — बिग्रेको डिस्क साटेर array लाई mirror वा parity बाट सामग्री फेरि बनाउन दिने। Practise the judgement

— ग्राफ Graph A graph is a non-linear data structure made of a set of vertices (also called nodes) joined by a set of edges (lines). Any vertex may connect to any other vertex. There is no root, no parent–child rule, and cycles are allowed — this is the main difference from a tree. In a directed graph the edges have arrows (one-way). In an undirected graph the edges have no direction (two-way). A weighted graph puts a number on each edge, for example the distance between two cities. Applications: road maps and Google Maps routing, social networks, computer networks. ग्राफ ग्राफ भनेको vertex (बिन्दु) हरूको समूह र तिनलाई जोड्ने edge (रेखा) हरूको समूहबाट बनेको अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो। जुनसुकै vertex जुनसुकैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। root हुँदैन, parent–child नियम हुँदैन, र चक्र (cycle) हुन सक्छ — ट्रीसँगको मुख्य फरक यही हो। Directed graph मा edge मा तीर हुन्छ (एकतर्फी)। Undirected मा दिशा हुँदैन। Weighted graph मा हरेक edge मा संख्या हुन्छ, जस्तै दुई सहरबीचको दूरी। प्रयोग: सडक नक्सा र Google Maps, सामाजिक सञ्जाल, कम्प्युटर नेटवर्क। {{dia:graph}} The yellow path B → C → D → B is a cycle. A tree can never contain one. पहेँलो बाटो B → C → D → B एउटा चक्र हो। ट्रीमा यस्तो कहिल्यै हुँदैन। Practise the judgement

· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A driver uses a steering wheel without knowing how the engine works.
