Types: default constructor, parameterized constructor and copy constructor. परिभाषा + पाँच विशेषता + तीन प्रकार — पूरा अंकका लागि तीनै भाग चाहिन्छ। Q4 · Differentiate between a constructor and a destructor. [4 marks] Show the answer Write it as a table: when called (on creation vs on destruction); name (class name vs class name with ~); parameters (can take them vs cannot); overloading (can be overloaded vs cannot, only one per class); purpose (initialise / allocate memory vs clean up / free memory). तालिकाको रूपमा पाँच हरफ लेख्नुहोस्। Key points to revise

· परीक्षा जोड Abstraction versus encapsulation is the comparison examiners return to. Learn the one-line difference exactly. Abstraction र Encapsulation को भिन्नता परीक्षकले पटक–पटक सोध्छन्। एक वाक्यको फरक ठ्याक्कै सिक्नुहोस्। Q1 · Define abstraction. Write any three advantages. [4 marks] Show the answer Abstraction is the process of showing only the essential features of an object to the user while hiding the internal implementation details of how the work is done. Advantages: it reduces complexity for the user; it increases security because internal details cannot be misused; and the internal code can be changed later without affecting the programs that use the class. परिभाषा + कुनै तीन फाइदा। गाडीको उदाहरण दिए झन् राम्रो। Q2 · What is encapsulation? Write a C++ program to demonstrate it. [5 marks] Show the answer Encapsulation is the process of binding data members and member functions together into a single unit called a class, and hiding the data from direct outside access by declaring it private. It is also known as data hiding. For the program, write the Account class from Example 3 above: a private balance, a public setBalance() and a public getBalance(), with main() creating an object and using the two functions. परिभाषा + माथिको Example 3 कै प्रोग्राम लेख्नुहोस्। Q3 · Differentiate between abstraction and encapsulation. [4 marks] Show the answer Abstraction hides the complexity or implementation — the "how" — and is a design-level concept achieved through abstract classes and access specifiers; it focuses on what an object does. Encapsulation hides the data — the "what" — and is an implementation-level concept achieved by making data private and providing public getters and setters; it focuses on protecting the data. तालिकाको रूपमा चार हरफ लेख्नुहोस्: के लुकाउँछ, कुन तह, कसरी हासिल हुन्छ, केमा ध्यान। Q4 · What is an abstract class? [2 marks] Show the answer An abstract class is a class that contains at least one pure virtual function — a virtual function with no body, declared using = 0. An object of an abstract class cannot be created; it exists only to be inherited, and every derived class must provide a definition for the pure virtual function. pure virtual function भएको क्लास; यसको अब्जेक्ट बन्दैन। Key points to revise

· परीक्षा जोड Types of inheritance and constructor call order carry the marks here — the order question appears very often. Inheritance का प्रकार र constructor चल्ने क्रममा अंक छन् — क्रमको प्रश्न धेरै पटक आउँछ। Q1 · Define inheritance. Explain base class and derived class with syntax. [4 marks] Show the answer Inheritance is the process by which one class acquires the properties and member functions of another class. The class whose features are inherited is called the base class (parent), and the class that inherits them is called the derived class (child). The main purpose is reusability of code. Syntax: class Derived : access_mode Base { … }; for example class Dog : public Animal { }; परिभाषा + base/derived + syntax — तीनै लेख्नुहोस्। Q2 · Explain the types of inheritance with suitable diagrams. [6 marks] Show the answer Draw all five diagrams and give one line each: Single — one base, one derived (A → B). Multilevel — a chain where a derived class becomes a base (A → B → C). Multiple — two or more bases, one derived (A and B → C). Hierarchical — one base, many derived (A → B and A → C). Hybrid — a combination of two or more of the above; may cause the diamond problem, solved with a virtual base class. पाँचै चित्र कोर्नुहोस् र एक–एक लाइन व्याख्या दिनुहोस्। चित्र बिना पूरा अंक आउँदैन। Q3 · What is the output of the given program? (base and derived constructors) [3 marks] Show the answer Apply the rule: base class constructor first, then derived; destructors in exact reverse order. For a two-level program the answer is: A constructor, B constructor, B destructor, A destructor. For a three-level chain (Animal → Dog → Puppy) it is: Animal, Dog, Puppy going in and ~Puppy, ~Dog, ~Animal coming out. नियम लगाउनुहोस्: बन्दा माथिबाट तल, नष्ट हुँदा तलबाट माथि। Q4 · What is the diamond problem? How is it solved? [3 marks] Show the answer In hybrid inheritance, when two classes B and C both inherit from the same base A, and a fourth class D inherits from both B and C, class D receives two copies of A's members. The compiler cannot decide which copy to use, causing an ambiguity error. This is called the diamond problem. It is solved by declaring A as a virtual base class: class B : virtual public A { }; — then only one shared copy of A exists. समस्या + virtual कीवर्डको समाधान — दुवै लेख्नुहोस्। Key points to revise

· परीक्षा जोड Overloading versus overriding, and compile-time versus run-time, are the highest-frequency questions in the whole subject. Overloading र Overriding, अनि Compile-time र Run-time — यी पूरै विषयकै सबैभन्दा बढी सोधिने प्रश्न हुन्। Q1 · Define polymorphism. Explain its types with examples. [6 marks] Show the answer Polymorphism comes from the Greek words poly (many) and morph (forms), so it means many forms. In C++ it is the ability of the same function name or operator to behave differently in different situations. Compile-time (static) polymorphism — the compiler decides which function to call while compiling, by checking the arguments. It is achieved by function overloading and operator overloading. Example: three area() functions with different parameters. Run-time (dynamic) polymorphism — the decision is made while the program runs, based on the object the base pointer points to. It is achieved by function overriding with virtual functions. Example: Base *p = &derivedObj; p->show(); परिभाषा + दुवै प्रकार + एक–एक उदाहरण। चित्र (रूख) कोरे झन् राम्रो। Q2 · Differentiate between function overloading and function overriding. [5 marks] Show the answer Write a table with at least five rows: meaning (same class, different parameters vs derived class, same parameters); inheritance (not required vs required); parameters (must differ vs must be identical); binding (early/static vs late/dynamic); type (compile-time vs run-time); and the virtual keyword (not used vs used in the base class). कम्तीमा पाँच हरफको तालिका लेख्नुहोस्। Q3 · What is a virtual function? Why is it needed? [3 marks] Show the answer A virtual function is a member function declared in the base class using the keyword virtual and redefined (overridden) in a derived class. It is needed so that when the function is called through a base class pointer, C++ decides at run time which version to run by looking at the actual object being pointed to, instead of the pointer's type. Without virtual the base class version would always be called, and run-time polymorphism would be impossible. परिभाषा + किन चाहिन्छ (base पोइन्टरबाट derived संस्करण चलाउन) — दुवै लेख्नुहोस्। Q4 · Write a program to demonstrate run-time polymorphism. [5 marks] Show the answer Write a base class Shape with virtual void draw(), two derived classes Circle and Square that each override draw(), and a main() that declares Shape *p; then points it first at a Circle object and then at a Square object, calling p->draw(); each time. The output will be "Drawing a Circle" then "Drawing a Square" — the same call giving two different results. That is the full program traced step by step in the Trace a Program section. Trace a Program सेक्सनको Program 3 नै यसको पूरा उत्तर हो — त्यहीँ लाइन–लाइन हेर्नुहोस्। Key points to revise

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which basis of classification is being used? What you will learn: to tell the five bases apart on a real case rather than by reciting the list. Six cases, and two of them answer the same basis for different reasons. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: सूची घोकेर होइन, वास्तविक केसमा पाँच आधार छुट्याउन। छ केस छन्, र तीमध्ये दुईले फरक कारणले उही आधारको उत्तर दिन्छन्। How to use this Before pressing anything, say out loud what question the case is answering. How much work? size. What kind of signal? data handling. How many different jobs? purpose. What shape? model. Who made it? brand. Case 3 is the one worth reading the reason for even if you get it right. The washing machine is also micro and also digital — more than one answer is true of the machine, and only one answers the question asked. केही थिच्नुअघि यो केसले कुन प्रश्नको उत्तर दिँदै छ भन्नुहोस्। कति काम? आकार। कस्तो सङ्केत? डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ। कति फरक काम? प्रयोजन। कस्तो आकार? मोडेल। कसले बनायो? ब्रान्ड। केस ३ को कारण सही भए पनि पढ्नुहोस्: वासिङ मेसिन micro पनि हो, digital पनि — मेसिनका लागि एकभन्दा बढी उत्तर सही हुन्छन्, तर सोधिएको प्रश्नको उत्तर एउटै हुन्छ। Example 2 Classify one machine five ways Question: a student's laptop, made by Apple, used for homework, browsing and music. Place it in all five classifications. Work down the five bases in order and answer each one separately. Write your five answers before opening this. पाँच आधार क्रमैसँग लिनुहोस् र हरेकको छुट्टै उत्तर दिनुहोस्। खोल्नुअघि आफ्ना पाँच उत्तर लेख्नुहोस्। Working by size MICROCOMPUTER one person uses it at a time by data handling DIGITAL it works in 0s and 1s by purpose GENERAL PURPOSE homework, browsing and music are different jobs by model LAPTOP that is its physical form by brand APPLE who made it One machine, five answers, none of them competing. A question that gives you a machine and asks for "the classification" is asking for all five unless it names a basis. एउटै मेसिन, पाँच उत्तर, कुनै पनि एकअर्कासँग बाझिँदैनन्। मेसिन दिएर "वर्गीकरण" सोध्ने प्रश्नले आधार नतोकेसम्म पाँचै खोजेको हुन्छ। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying a computer is "not accurate" when the output is wrong. If the input was wrong, that is GIGO. Accuracy describes the machine's arithmetic, not your typing. आउटपुट गलत हुँदा कम्प्युटर "शुद्ध छैन" भन्नु। इनपुट गलत थियो भने त्यो GIGO हो। शुद्धताले मेसिनको गणना जनाउँछ, तपाईंको टाइपिङ होइन। Mixing the five bases into one list. "Supercomputer, digital, laptop" is not a classification — it is one answer from each of three different questions. पाँच आधारलाई एउटै सूचीमा मिसाउनु। "Supercomputer, digital, laptop" वर्गीकरण होइन — यी तीन फरक प्रश्नका एक–एक उत्तर हुन्। Calling a calculator a computer. It has no stored program; you press every key. क्यालकुलेटरलाई कम्प्युटर भन्नु। त्यसमा भण्डारण गरिएको प्रोग्राम छैन; हरेक बटन तपाईं थिच्नुहुन्छ। Using "data" and "information" as the same word. Data goes in, information comes out; the processing in between is the difference. "Data" र "information" लाई उही शब्द ठान्नु। Data भित्र जान्छ, information बाहिर आउँछ; बीचको प्रशोधन नै फरक हो। Data in, information out. Accuracy is the machine's; correctness is yours. Data भित्र, information बाहिर। शुद्धता मेसिनको, सहीपन तपाईंको। Practical work — this unit's other 10 hours Why this section exists This unit is 18 hours, not 8. The 8 hours above are theory; the curriculum gives this unit 10 more hours of practical work, and lists six activities for them. Those activities are worth real marks. Of the 50 internal marks for this subject, 18 are practical work (15 for doing it, 3 for keeping records) and 12 are project work (10 for doing it, 2 for records). A further 5 are a viva in which you explain your own practical and project work. This website cannot do any of them for you. They are chart paper, presentations and a speech to your class. What it can do is tell you exactly what is required, what you need, and what to keep so that the marks are there when they are counted. यो खण्ड किन छ यो युनिट ८ होइन, १८ घण्टाको हो। माथिका ८ घण्टा सैद्धान्तिक हुन्; पाठ्यक्रमले यस युनिटलाई १० घण्टा प्रयोगात्मक काम दिएको छ, र त्यसका लागि छ वटा क्रियाकलाप तोकेको छ। ती क्रियाकलापका साँच्चिकै अंक छन्। यस विषयका ५० आन्तरिक अंकमध्ये १८ अंक प्रयोगात्मक काम (गर्नेको १५, अभिलेखको ३) र १२ अंक प्रोजेक्ट काम (गर्नेको १०, अभिलेखको २) हुन्। थप ५ अंक भाइभाका, जहाँ तपाईंले आफ्नै प्रयोगात्मक र प्रोजेक्ट काम बुझाउनुपर्छ। यी काम यो वेबसाइटले तपाईंका लागि गरिदिन सक्दैन। यी चार्ट पेपर, प्रस्तुतीकरण र कक्षामा बोल्ने काम हुन्। यसले गर्न सक्ने कुरा — के चाहिन्छ, के गर्नुपर्छ र के राख्नुपर्छ ठ्याक्कै बताउने, ताकि अंक गणना हुँदा ती तपाईंसँग होऊन्। Guided practicalThe six activities the curriculum suggests These are the curriculum's own six for Unit 1, quoted from its practical list. The document calls them samples and says a teacher may set other work instead, as the student's need or the school's context requires — so treat this as what is expected of you unless your teacher says otherwise. The 10 hours are not a sample. They are the unit's practical allocation. यी युनिट १ का लागि पाठ्यक्रमकै छ वटा क्रियाकलाप हुन्, त्यसकै प्रयोगात्मक सूचीबाट लिइएका। पाठ्यक्रमले यिनलाई नमुना भनेको छ र विद्यार्थीको आवश्यकता वा विद्यालयको सन्दर्भअनुसार शिक्षकले अरू काम दिन सक्ने लेखेको छ — त्यसैले शिक्षकले अर्कै नभनेसम्म यही नै अपेक्षा हो भनी लिनुहोस्। १० घण्टा चाहिँ नमुना होइन — त्यो युनिटकै प्रयोगात्मक समय हो। 1.1 Draw "Computer and its parts" on chart paper and demonstrate it. You need: chart paper, markers, a ruler. Builds on: 1.1, the block diagram. Hand in: the chart, plus a photograph of it in your record file. Label input, process, output and storage — a chart that names the parts without naming the four stages is a picture, not a block diagram. चाहिन्छ: चार्ट पेपर, मार्कर, रुलर। आधार: १.१ को ब्लक चित्र। बुझाउने: चार्ट र त्यसको फोटो अभिलेख फाइलमा। input, process, output र storage नाम लेख्नुहोस् — चार चरण नलेखेको चार्ट ब्लक चित्र होइन, तस्बिर मात्र हो। 1.2 Make a presentation on (a) features of computer and (b) modern application areas of computer. You need: presentation software, or paper slides if no computer is free. Builds on: 1.2 and 1.3. Hand in: the file or the slides, and your speaking notes. For (b), use examples from Nepal — the ones in 1.3 are a starting list, not a limit. चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर, वा कम्प्युटर खाली नभए कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: १.२ र १.३। बुझाउने: फाइल वा स्लाइड, र बोल्ने नोट। (ख) का लागि नेपालकै उदाहरण लिनुहोस् — १.३ को सूची सुरुवात हो, सीमा होइन। 1.3 Take part in a speech competition on "Role of computer in education". You need: a prepared speech and a class audience — this one is organised by your teacher. Builds on: 1.3. Hand in: your written speech in your record file. Your own school is the strongest example you have. चाहिन्छ: तयार गरेको भाषण र कक्षाका श्रोता — यो शिक्षकले मिलाउनुहुन्छ। आधार: १.३। बुझाउने: लेखेको भाषण अभिलेख फाइलमा। सबैभन्दा बलियो उदाहरण तपाईंकै विद्यालय हो। 1.4 Draw "Types of computer on the basis of working principle" on chart paper and display it in your classroom. You need: chart paper and markers. Builds on: 1.4 — working principle is the data handling basis: analog, digital, hybrid. Hand in: the chart. Give each type one real example; the fuel pump in the drill above is a hybrid one. चाहिन्छ: चार्ट पेपर, मार्कर। आधार: १.४ — working principle भनेको डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ को आधार हो: analog, digital, hybrid। बुझाउने: चार्ट। हरेक किसिमको एउटा वास्तविक उदाहरण दिनुहोस्। 1.5 Prepare a presentation on the use and purpose of hybrid and super computers in different sectors, and demonstrate it. You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 1.4. Hand in: the file and your notes. Weather forecasting at a Nepali met office is a supercomputer use worth naming; hospital and fuel-pump equipment are hybrid ones. चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: १.४। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। नेपालको मौसम विभागको पूर्वानुमान supercomputer को उल्लेखनीय प्रयोग हो; अस्पताल र पेट्रोल पम्पका उपकरण hybrid। 1.6 Present on (a) types by purpose, (b) types by size and data handling, and (c) types by mode and brand. You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 1.4 — this covers all five bases between its three parts. Hand in: the file and your notes. Keep the three parts separate: merging the bases is the mistake the lesson warns about. The practical list writes mode in part (c) where the topic list for 1.4 writes model — the same basis, spelled two ways in the one document. Use model, and ask your teacher if an answer sheet says otherwise. चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: १.४ — तीन भागले पाँचै आधार समेट्छन्। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। तीन भाग छुट्टै राख्नुहोस्; आधार मिसाउनु नै पाठले चेतावनी दिएको गल्ती हो। प्रयोगात्मक सूचीमा (ग) मा mode लेखिएको छ, तर १.४ को विषयसूचीमा model — एउटै आधार, एउटै कागजमा दुई हिज्जे। model नै प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Record keepingThe 3 marks most often thrown away Three of the 18 practical marks are for records, not for the work. A record is kept per activity and should contain: the activity number and title, the date, what you did, what you used, what you produced (with a photograph if it is a chart), and one or two sentences on what you learned or what went wrong. Keep them in one file, in order. The curriculum adds two things worth knowing in advance. The practical examination is conducted in the presence of internal and external supervisors, and it assesses both the product and your skill in using equipment — so being able to explain your chart matters as much as the chart. And project work is assessed on the report and the presentation of it; when a project is presented by a group, every member submits their own short reflection on the report, so a group project is still individual work at the end. १८ प्रयोगात्मक अंकमध्ये ३ अंक अभिलेख का हुन्, काम गरेकै होइन। हरेक क्रियाकलापको अभिलेखमा हुनुपर्छ: क्रियाकलापको नम्बर र शीर्षक, मिति, के गर्नुभयो, के प्रयोग गर्नुभयो, के बनाउनुभयो (चार्ट भए फोटोसहित), र के सिक्नुभयो वा के बिग्रियो भन्ने एक–दुई वाक्य। सबै एउटै फाइलमा क्रम मिलाएर राख्नुहोस्। पाठ्यक्रमले थप्छ: प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षा आन्तरिक र बाह्य दुवै सुपरिवेक्षकको उपस्थितिमा हुन्छ, र त्यसले उत्पादनसँगै उपकरण चलाउने सीप पनि जाँच्छ — त्यसैले चार्ट बुझाउन सक्नु चार्ट बनाउनुजत्तिकै महत्त्वको छ। प्रोजेक्ट कामको मूल्याङ्कन रिपोर्ट र त्यसको प्रस्तुतीकरण मा हुन्छ; समूहमा प्रस्तुत गरेमा हरेक सदस्यले आफ्नै छोटो मनन् बुझाउनुपर्छ, त्यसैले समूहको प्रोजेक्ट पनि अन्ततः व्यक्तिगत काम हो। Independent practiceTwo you can do on your own, today Not from the curriculum's list — these are short exercises to test whether the theory above actually holds in your hands. No marks, no teacher needed. One. Pick any five machines you can see from where you are sitting — a phone, a calculator, a TV, a fridge with a display, a laptop. For each, decide whether it contains a computer by the definition in 1.1, and if it does, place it on all five bases from 1.4. Write the five answers down. Where you hesitate is where to re-read. Two. Find one wrong output you have actually seen — a bill, a result sheet, a mistyped name on a document. Decide whether the machine or the data was at fault, and write one sentence saying which and why. If it was the data, you have found a real GIGO example, and it will serve you better in the exam than the one in this lesson. पाठ्यक्रमको सूचीबाट होइन — माथिको सिद्धान्त हातमा टिक्छ कि टिक्दैन जाँच्ने छोटा अभ्यास। अंक छैन, शिक्षक चाहिँदैन। एक। बसेकै ठाउँबाट देखिने पाँच यन्त्र छान्नुहोस् — फोन, क्यालकुलेटर, टिभी, डिस्प्ले भएको फ्रिज, ल्यापटप। हरेकका लागि १.१ को परिभाषाअनुसार त्यसमा कम्प्युटर छ कि छैन भन्नुहोस्, र भए १.४ का पाँचै आधारमा राख्नुहोस्। जहाँ अलमल हुन्छ, त्यही फेरि पढ्ने ठाउँ हो। दुई। आफूले देखेको एउटा गलत आउटपुट सम्झनुहोस् — बिल, नतिजा, कागजमा बिग्रेको नाम। मेसिनको गल्ती थियो कि data को, एक वाक्यमा कारणसहित लेख्नुहोस्। Data को भए तपाईंले साँचो GIGO उदाहरण भेट्नुभयो। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit This unit carries 6 of the 50 external marks and 8 of the 64 theory hours. It is almost always asked as short definition questions and one classification question. The practical half of the unit — 10 hours of chart work and presentations — is assessed inside your school's internal 50 marks, not in the written paper. यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ६ अंक र ६४ सैद्धान्तिक घण्टामध्ये ८ घण्टा ओगट्छ। प्रायः छोटो परिभाषा प्रश्न र एउटा वर्गीकरण प्रश्नका रूपमा सोधिन्छ। युनिटको प्रयोगात्मक आधा भाग — चार्ट र प्रस्तुतीकरणका १० घण्टा — लिखित परीक्षामा होइन, विद्यालयभित्रको आन्तरिक ५० अंकमा मूल्याङ्कन हुन्छ। 2 marks Practice question Define a computer. कम्प्युटरको परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। Show the answer A computer is an electronic device that accepts data, processes it according to a set of stored instructions, gives information as output, and stores data and instructions for later use. Name all four stages — input, process, output, storage — and the stored program. An answer that says only "a machine that calculates" does not reach full marks. चारै चरण — input, process, output, storage — र भण्डारण गरिएको प्रोग्रामको नाम लिनुहोस्। "गणना गर्ने मेसिन" मात्र लेखेको उत्तरले पूरा अंक पाउँदैन। 2 marks Practice question Differentiate between data and information with one example of each. Data र information बीचको फरक, हरेकको एक–एक उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer Data is raw, unprocessed facts that mean little on their own — for example the marks 72, 65, 88. Information is data that has been processed into a usable form — for example "the class average is 75". The difference is the processing in between, which is what the computer does. Data कच्चा तथ्य, जस्तै अंक ७२, ६५, ८८। Information प्रशोधन भएर काम लाग्ने रूपमा आएको, जस्तै "कक्षाको औसत ७५ छ"। बीचको प्रशोधन नै फरक हो। 4 marks Practice question On what five bases are computers classified? Give the categories under any two of them. कम्प्युटरको वर्गीकरण कुन पाँच आधारमा हुन्छ? तीमध्ये कुनै दुईका वर्ग लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer size supercomputer, mainframe, mini, micro data handling analog, digital, hybrid purpose general purpose, special purpose model desktop, laptop, palmtop brand IBM PC, IBM compatible, Apple Name all five bases for the first marks; then give the categories under the two you know best. Do not merge the lists. पहिले पाँचै आधारको नाम लिनुहोस्; अनि राम्ररी थाहा भएका दुईका वर्ग लेख्नुहोस्। सूचीहरू मिसाउनुहोस् नहोस्। 4 marks Practice question A computer produced a wrong salary report. The company says the computer is unreliable. Explain whether you agree, using a characteristic of computers. कम्प्युटरले गलत तलब प्रतिवेदन निकाल्यो। कम्पनी भन्छ कम्प्युटर भरपर्दो छैन। कम्प्युटरको एउटा विशेषता प्रयोग गरी तपाईं सहमत हुनुहुन्छ कि छैन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Show the answer Usually disagree. A computer is accurate and reliable: it processes exactly what it is given, and gives the same answer every time. A wrong report almost always means wrong input or a wrong program — Garbage In, Garbage Out. Say which it is: wrong data entered, or a mistake in the instructions. Both are human errors, not machine ones. प्रायः असहमत। कम्प्युटर शुद्ध र भरपर्दो हुन्छ: दिइएकै कुरा ठ्याक्कै प्रशोधन गर्छ र हरेक पटक उही उत्तर दिन्छ। गलत प्रतिवेदन भनेको प्रायः गलत इनपुट वा गलत प्रोग्राम — Garbage In, Garbage Out। कुन हो भन्नुहोस्: गलत data भरियो, कि निर्देशनमै गल्ती। दुवै मानवीय गल्ती हुन्, मेसिनको होइन। Key points to revise

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक उदाहरणमा चारै शब्द छुट्याउन — ताकि "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न घोकेको वाक्यबाट होइन, चिनेरै उत्तर दिन सकियोस्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to separate the four words on real examples, so the "differentiate between…" question is answered from recognition rather than from a memorised sentence.

pairs.ne: चतुर्भुजभित्र सम्बन्ध हुन्छ, क्रियापदमा लेखिएको — ENROLS, TEACHES। इन्टिटी आयत हुन् र एट्रिब्युट दीर्घवृत्त।
pairs.en: A diamond holds the relationship, written as a verb — ENROLS, TEACHES. Entities are rectangles and attributes are ellipses.

pairs.ne: व्युत्पन्न (derived) एट्रिब्युट धर्के दीर्घवृत्तले कोरिन्छ। दोहोरो दीर्घवृत्त = बहुमान, मुनि रेखा = कुञ्जी, दोहोरो आयत = कमजोर इन्टिटी।
pairs.en: A derived attribute is drawn with a dashed ellipse. A double ellipse means multivalued, an underline marks the key, and a double rectangle is a weak entity.

pairs.ne: "कमजोर" भनेको चिनारीको कुरा हो, महत्त्वको होइन। कमजोर इन्टिटी आफैंले चिनिँदैन र मालिकको कुञ्जी लिनुपर्छ। दोहोरो आयतले कोरिन्छ।
pairs.en: "Weak" is about identification, not importance. A weak entity cannot be identified on its own and must borrow its owner's key. It is drawn with a double rectangle.

pairs.ne: दुवै दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्। कक्षा → विद्यार्थी "धेरै" हो, तर विद्यार्थी → कक्षा "एक"। एकातिर धेरै र अर्कोतिर एक भए 1:M। विद्यार्थी धेरै कक्षामा हुन सक्ने भए मात्र M:N हुन्थ्यो।
pairs.en: Test both directions. Class → students is "many", but student → class is "one". Many one way and one the other way is 1:M. It would only be M:N if a student could also be in several classes.

pairs.ne: धेरै–धेरै सम्बन्धलाई foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन, किनभने स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्छ र दुवैतर्फ धेरै जोडी छन्। यो तेस्रो तालिका बन्छ, हरेक जोडका लागि एक पङ्क्ति।
pairs.en: A many-to-many relationship cannot be recorded by a foreign key, because a column holds one value and each side has many partners. It becomes a third table holding one row per link.

pairs.ne: अद्वितीय र NOT NULL — primary key ले पालना गर्नुपर्ने दुई नियम यिनै हुन्। अर्को तालिका देखाउने काम foreign key को हो, जुन NULL हुन र दोहोरिन सक्छ।
pairs.en: Unique and NOT NULL are the two rules a primary key must obey — together they are what let a row be found reliably. Pointing at another table is a foreign key, which may be NULL and may repeat.

pairs.ne: पङ्क्ति चिनाउने जुनसुकै समूह super key हो। अनावश्यक कुरा हटाएपछि candidate key बन्छ। तीमध्ये एउटा primary key छानिन्छ; बाँकी alternate key हुन्।
pairs.en: Any identifying set is a super key. Strip out everything unnecessary and it becomes a candidate key. One candidate key is then chosen as the primary key; the rest are alternate keys.

pairs.ne: सम्बन्धको degree ले त्यसमा सहभागी इन्टिटी गन्छ, पङ्क्ति होइन। यहाँ EMPLOYEE मात्र छ, आफैंसँग सम्बन्धित, त्यसैले degree unary हो। Degree लाई cardinality सँग नमिसाउनुहोस्।
pairs.en: The degree of a relationship counts the entities in it, not the rows. Only EMPLOYEE takes part here, related to itself, so the degree is unary. Do not confuse degree with cardinality.

pairs.ne: कमजोर इन्टिटीलाई "महत्त्वहीन" भन्नु। यसको अर्थ आफ्नो कुञ्जी नभएको र मालिकको कुञ्जी लिनुपर्ने भन्ने हो। दोहोरो आयतले कोर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Calling a weak entity "unimportant". It means the entity has no key of its own and must borrow its owner's. Draw it with a double rectangle.

pairs.ne: कुन mapping cardinality?
pairs.en: Which mapping cardinality?

pairs.ne: उत्तर दिनुअघि दुवै दिशा पढ्नुहोस्। एउटा दिशा मात्र बताउने वाक्यले cardinality बताएकै हुँदैन।
pairs.en: Read both directions before you answer. A sentence that only tells you one direction has not told you the cardinality.

pairs.ne: एकातिर धेरै, अर्कोतिर एक। दोस्रो वाक्यले नै तय गर्छ — त्यो नभए यो धेरै–धेरै पनि हुन सक्थ्यो।
pairs.en: Many one way, one the other. The second sentence is what settles it — without it this could equally have been many-to-many.

pairs.ne: दुवै दिशामा धेरै, त्यसैले एउटै foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन। तेस्रो तालिका बाध्य पार्ने यही हो।
pairs.en: Many in both directions, so no single foreign key can record it. This is the one that forces a third table.

pairs.ne: दुवै दिशामा एक। तालिका दुई नै हुन्छन्, र foreign key जुनसुकैमा राख्न सकिन्छ।
pairs.en: One in both directions. Two tables still, and the foreign key may sit in either one.

pairs.ne: "धेरै डाक्टरले उपचार गर्न सक्छन्" भन्नु नै दोस्रो "धेरै" हो। शब्द नरम छ, तर cardinality उही।
pairs.en: "May be treated by several" is the second "many". Read carefully — the wording is softer than in the course example, but the cardinality is the same.

pairs.ne: दुवै दिशा "बढीमा एक"। शिक्षक विभागमा अरूसँगै काम गर्छन्, तर नेतृत्व एउटैको गर्छन् — इन्टिटी होइन, नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध हेर्ने हो।
pairs.en: Both directions are "at most one". A teacher works in a department alongside others, but HEADS only one — the relationship named is what you judge, not the entities.

pairs.ne: कोर्ने प्रश्नमा आकार नै जाँचिन्छ। दीर्घवृत्त हुनुपर्ने ठाउँमा आयत कोर्दा भित्रको शब्द सही भए पनि अंक जान्छ।
pairs.en: A drawing question is marked on the shapes. A rectangle where an ellipse belongs loses the mark even when the word inside it is right.

pairs.ne: हरेक कुञ्जी माथिकोभन्दा साँघुरो हुँदै जान्छ। हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो, र हरेक candidate key एउटा super key — तर उल्टो होइन।
pairs.en: Each key is a narrowing of the one above it. Every primary key is a candidate key, and every candidate key is a super key — but not the reverse.

pairs.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: ER मोडेल किन चाहिन्छ भन्न, इन्टिटी–कमजोर इन्टिटी चिन्न र चिन्ह कोर्न, एट्रिब्युटका प्रकार नाम लिन, सम्बन्ध र यसको degree भन्न, 1:1–1:M–M:N को अर्थ र तालिकामा पर्ने असर भन्न, कुञ्जीका प्रकार परिभाषित गर्न, र सानो परिदृश्यको पूरा ER चित्र कोर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: Draw a complete ER diagram for a small scenario.

pairs.ne: हरेक भाग क्रमैसँग थिच्नुहोस् र चित्रको कुन भाग बल्छ हेर्नुहोस्। आकारको नाम पढ्नुहोस् — परीक्षामा कोर्नुपर्ने त्यही हो — अनि वाक्य पढ्नुहोस्, जसले त्यो भाग वास्तविक तालिकामा के बन्छ बताउँछ। कमजोर इन्टिटी मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्। "कमजोर" को अर्थ महत्त्वहीन होइन; मालिकविना चिनिन नसक्ने भन्ने हो।
pairs.en: Pay attention to weak entity. "Weak" does not mean unimportant. It means the thing cannot be identified without its owner: a dependant is identified by which employee they belong to, plus their name.

pairs.ne: सम्बन्धको degree भनेको त्यसमा कति इन्टिटी सहभागी छन् भन्ने हो — कति पङ्क्ति भन्ने होइन। Unary (एउटै इन्टिटी आफैंसँग), binary (दुई — प्रायः सबै), ternary (तीन)। Degree र cardinality फरक प्रश्न हुन्: degree ले इन्टिटी गन्छ, cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्ने।
pairs.en: Degree of a relationship is how many entities take part in it — not how many rows. Unary (one entity related to itself: an employee manages an employee), binary (two entities — almost every relationship you will meet), ternary (three). Degree and cardinality are different questions: degree counts entities, cardinality counts how many rows link to how many.

pairs.ne: माथिको चिन्ह तीन बटनबीच झन्डै बदलिँदैन — एउटा अक्षर मात्र। तलका पङ्क्ति भने पूरै बदलिन्छन्, र वास्तविक फरक त्यही हो। 1:M मा सूचीमुनिको टिप्पणी पढ्नुहोस्: हरेक विषयले ठ्याक्कै एउटा विद्यार्थी देखाउँछ। अब M:N थिच्नुहोस् — Maths अब दुई विद्यार्थीबाट जोडिन्छ। दुवैतर्फ "धेरै", र पूरा परिभाषा यही हो। M:N ले मात्र junction तालिका बनाउँछ; त्यसमा दुई foreign key बाहेक केही हुँदैन।
pairs.en: Only M:N produces a junction table. Watch it appear, and notice it holds nothing but two foreign keys — one row per link, which is exactly what the relationship is.

pairs.ne: हरेक केसमा दुई वाक्यलाई दुई छुट्टै प्रश्न मानेर पढ्नुहोस्: बायाँको एउटालाई दायाँ कति? अनि दायाँको एउटालाई बायाँ कति? दुवैपछि मात्र cardinality थाहा हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई केसमा बिस्तारै जानुहोस् — एउटामा शब्द नरम छ, अर्कोमा नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध हेर्नुपर्छ, इन्टिटी होइन।
pairs.en: The last two cases are the ones worth slowing down for. One uses softer wording — "may be treated by several" is still "many". The other describes a relationship between entities that also relate in other ways: judge the relationship that is named, not the entities.

pairs.ne: सधैं दुवै दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्। एउटा दिशा मात्र बताउने वाक्यले cardinality बताएकै हुँदैन। "एउटा कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी" भन्ने मात्रले 1:M कि M:N भन्न मिल्दैन — एउटा विद्यार्थी दुई कक्षामा हुन सक्छ कि भनी सोध्नुपर्छ।
pairs.en: Always test both directions. A sentence that only tells you one direction has not told you the cardinality. "A class has many students" alone could be 1:M or M:N — you have to ask whether a student can be in two classes.

pairs.ne: चार किसिमका key सोधिएका छन्। खोल्नुअघि एउटा सङ्ख्या भन्नुहोस्: यो तालिकामा कति वटा candidate key छन्? जवाफ १ आयो भने प्रश्न फेरि हेर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Four kinds of key are being asked for. Before you open this, commit to one number: how many candidate keys does this table have? If your answer is 1, look at the question again.

pairs.ne: परीक्षकले यी पाँच असम्बन्धित कुरा होइनन्, एकभित्र अर्को हुन् भन्ने जान्नुभएको छ कि छैन हेर्छन्। हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो, र हरेक candidate key एउटा super key। यही एक हरफले प्रायः एक अंक दिन्छ।
pairs.en: The examiner is checking that you know these are nested, not five unrelated things. Every primary key is a candidate key, and every candidate key is a super key. Saying so in one line is often worth a mark by itself.

pairs.ne: "एउटा कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी" लाई M:N भन्नु। अर्को दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्: विद्यार्थी एउटै कक्षामा हुन्छ, त्यसैले 1:M।
pairs.en: Answering "many students in a class" as M:N. Check the other direction: a student is in one class, so it is 1:M.

pairs.ne: Degree र cardinality मिसाउनु। Degree ले सम्बन्धका इन्टिटी गन्छ; cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्छ।
pairs.en: Confusing degree with cardinality. Degree counts the entities in a relationship; cardinality counts how many rows link to how many.

pairs.ne: ER चित्रमा कुनै पनि नाममुनि रेखा नकोर्नु। कुञ्जी एट्रिब्युटमुनि रेखा हुनैपर्छ — primary key को चिन्ह त्यही हो।
pairs.en: Underlining nothing in an ER diagram. The key attribute must be underlined — that is the notation for a primary key, and a marker looks for it.

pairs.ne: सम्बन्धलाई नामपदमा लेख्नु। चतुर्भुजभित्र क्रियापद हुन्छ: ENROLS, TEACHES, CONTAINS — "enrolment" होइन।
pairs.en: Writing a relationship as a noun. A diamond holds a verb: ENROLS, TEACHES, CONTAINS — not "enrolment".

pairs.ne: यो युनिट प्रायः कोरेर जाँचिन्छ। सामान्य प्रश्नले दुई–तीन वाक्यमा सानो प्रणाली वर्णन गरेर ER चित्र माग्छ — इन्टिटी, कुञ्जीमुनि रेखासहितका एट्रिब्युट, क्रियापदमा नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध, र दुवै रेखामा cardinality। यी चार कुरालाई छुट्टाछुट्टै अंक हुन्छ, त्यसैले cardinality छुटे पनि धेरैजसो अंक आउँछ। ठूलो कोर्नुहोस् र सबैमा नाम लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: This unit is examined mostly by drawing. The commonest question gives you two or three sentences describing a small system and asks for an ER diagram — entities, attributes with the key underlined, a relationship named as a verb, and the cardinality marked on both lines. Marks are given for each of those four things separately, so a diagram missing its cardinalities still earns most of them. Draw it big, and label everything.

pairs.ne: दुवैको परिभाषा, एक–एक उदाहरण, र चाहेमा कुन आकारले कोरिन्छ भन्ने पनि।
pairs.en: An attribute is a property or characteristic of an entity. Example: the student's name. It is drawn as an ellipse and becomes a column.

pairs.ne: हरेक cardinality र उदाहरणलाई एक–एक अंक, र M:N लाई थप तालिका चाहिन्छ भनेकोमा चौथो अंक।
pairs.en: One mark per cardinality with its example, and the fourth for stating that M:N requires an extra table.

pairs.ne: आयतमा दुई इन्टिटीलाई एक अंक, कुञ्जीमुनि रेखासहित दीर्घवृत्तका एट्रिब्युटलाई एक, चतुर्भुजमा क्रियापद रूपको सम्बन्धलाई एक, र दुवै रेखामा M:N लेखेकोमा एक।
pairs.en: One mark for the two entities as rectangles, one for the attributes as ellipses with the keys underlined, one for the relationship in a diamond named as a verb, and one for the M:N cardinality marked on both lines.

pairs.ne: Degree ले सम्बन्धका इन्टिटी गन्छ; cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ। दुई फरक प्रश्न हुन्।
pairs.en: Degree counts the entities in a relationship; cardinality counts how many rows link to how many. They are different questions.

pairs.ne: Cardinality सधैं दुवै दिशामा जाँच्नुहोस्। एकातिर धेरै र अर्कोतिर एक भए 1:M; दुवैतिर धेरै भए M:N।
pairs.en: Always test cardinality in BOTH directions. Many one way and one the other is 1:M; many both ways is M:N.

pairs.ne: M:N लाई सधैं तेस्रो तालिका चाहिन्छ। 1:1 र 1:M लाई चाहिँदैन।
pairs.en: M:N always needs a third table. 1:1 and 1:M do not.

pairs.ne: Primary key अद्वितीय हुन्छ र कहिल्यै NULL हुँदैन। Foreign key NULL हुन र दोहोरिन सक्छ, तर यसको मान देखाइएको तालिकामा पहिले नै हुनुपर्छ।
pairs.en: A primary key is unique and never NULL. A foreign key may be NULL and may repeat, but its value must already exist in the table it points at.

pairs.ne: हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो; हरेक candidate key एउटा super key। उल्टो होइन।
pairs.en: Every primary key is a candidate key; every candidate key is a super key. The reverse is not true.

pairs.ne: आयत = इन्टिटी, दीर्घवृत्त = एट्रिब्युट, चतुर्भुज = सम्बन्ध। दोहोरो आयत = कमजोर इन्टिटी, दोहोरो दीर्घवृत्त = बहुमान, धर्के = व्युत्पन्न, मुनि रेखा = कुञ्जी।
pairs.en: Rectangle = entity, ellipse = attribute, diamond = relationship. Double rectangle = weak entity, double ellipse = multivalued, dashed ellipse = derived, underlined = key.

pairs.ne: बनाउनुअघि मोडेल किन वास्तविक data भरिसकेपछि डाटाबेस बदल्न महँगो पर्छ। ER मोडेल भनेको कुनै तालिका बन्नुभन्दा अघि कोरिने डाटाबेसको चित्र हो, ताकि गल्ती वर्ष दिनको रेकर्डपछि होइन, कागजमै भेटियोस्। यो जानाजान SQL पनि होइन, तालिका पनि होइन। यो वस्तु र तिनका सम्बन्ध को चित्र हो — विद्यालयको कर्मचारीले पनि जाँच्न सक्ने भाषामा। चित्र मिलेपछि मात्र तालिकामा बदलिन्छ, र त्यो अनुवाद युनिट ३ मा छ। ER चित्रमा ठ्याक्कै तीन किसिमका आकार हुन्छन्: वस्तुका लागि आयत, तिनका गुणका लागि दीर्घवृत्त, र जोडाइका लागि चतुर्भुज।
pairs.en: Why model before you build A database is expensive to change once it holds real data. The ER model is a picture of the database drawn before any table exists, so that mistakes are found on paper instead of after a year of records. It is deliberately not SQL and not tables. It is a diagram of things and how they are connected, in language a school clerk could check. Only once the picture is agreed is it turned into tables — and that translation is Unit 3. An ER diagram has exactly three kinds of shape: rectangles for things, ellipses for their properties, and diamonds for the connections between them.

pairs.ne: इन्टिटी, इन्टिटी सेट, कमजोर इन्टिटी — तीन शब्द, एउटै आकार इन्टिटी भनेको डाटाबेसले राख्ने एउटै वस्तु: राम, एक विद्यार्थी। औंला ठड्याएर देखाउन सकिन्छ। इन्टिटी सेट भनेको उही किसिमका सबै इन्टिटी सँगै: सबै विद्यार्थी। ER चित्रमा कोरिने आयतले सेट को नाम लेख्छ — STUDENT लेख्छ, Ram लेख्दैन। "इन्टिटी र इन्टिटी सेट परिभाषित गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने एक अंकको प्रश्नले जाँच्ने यही फरक हो, र दुई उत्तर साटासाट मिल्दैनन्। छुट्याउने सजिलो उपाय युनिट ३ तर्फ एक पाइला अघि हेर्नु हो। चित्र तालिकामा बदलिँदा इन्टिटी सेट तालिका बन्छ र हरेक इन्टिटी एक पङ्क्ति बन्छ। तालिका भनेको पङ्क्तिहरूको सेट हो — उही वाक्य दुई पटक भनिएको। कमजोर इन्टिटी तेस्रो किसिमको वस्तु होइन, कुञ्जी नभएको इन्टिटी हो: मालिकविना चिनिन सक्दैन। दोहोरो आयतले कोरिन्छ।
pairs.en: Entity, entity set, weak entity — three words, one shape An entity is one single thing the database stores: Ram, one student. You can point at it. An entity set is every entity of the same kind, taken together: all the students. The rectangle you draw in an ER diagram names the set — it says STUDENT, not Ram. This is the distinction a one-mark question is testing when it asks you to "define entity and entity set", and the two answers are not interchangeable. The easiest way to keep them apart is to look one step ahead, at Unit 3. When the diagram becomes tables, the entity set becomes the table and each entity becomes one row. A table is a set of rows; that is the same sentence said twice. A weak entity is not a third kind of thing but an entity with a missing key: it cannot be identified without its owner. Drawn as a double rectangle.

pairs.ne: Primary key ले पालना गर्नुपर्ने दुई नियम Primary key अद्वितीय हुनुपर्छ — दुई पङ्क्तिको मान उही हुन नहुने — र NOT NULL हुनुपर्छ — कहिल्यै खाली छाड्न नहुने। यी दुई नियमले नै पङ्क्ति भरपर्दो रूपमा खोज्न दिन्छन्। Foreign key फरक किसिमको हो। यसले आफ्नै तालिकाको पङ्क्ति चिनाउँदैन; यो त्यस्तो स्तम्भ हो जसको मान अर्को तालिकाको primary key मा पहिले नै हुनैपर्छ। यही नियमले दुई तालिका जोड्छ, र यसलाई referential integrity भनिन्छ। Foreign key NULL हुन सक्छ — गीताको कक्षा अझै छैन — र दोहोरिन पनि सक्छ, किनभने धेरै विद्यार्थीको कक्षा एउटै हुन्छ। Primary key ले यी दुवै गर्न पाउँदैन।
pairs.en: The two rules a primary key must obey A primary key must be unique — no two rows may share its value — and it must be NOT NULL — it can never be left empty. Those two rules are what allow a row to be found reliably. A foreign key is different in kind. It is not about identifying a row in its own table; it is a column whose value must already exist as a primary key in another table. That rule is what links two tables together, and it is called referential integrity. A foreign key may be NULL — Gita has no class yet — and it may repeat, since many students share one class. A primary key may do neither.

pairs.ne: Weak भनेको आफ्नो कुञ्जी नभएको, महत्त्वहीन होइन। दोहोरो आयत, दोहोरो हीरा।
pairs.en: Weak means no key of its own, not unimportant. Double rectangle, double diamond.

pairs.ne: इन्टिटी र एट्रिब्युटको परिभाषा एक–एक उदाहरणसहित दिनुहोस्।
pairs.en: Define entity and attribute with one example of each.

pairs.ne: तीनै mapping cardinality लाई उपयुक्त उदाहरणसहित व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Explain the three mapping cardinalities with a suitable example of each.

pairs.ne: एउटा पुस्तकालयले पुस्तक र सदस्यको अभिलेख राख्छ। एक सदस्यले धेरै पुस्तक लिन सक्छन्, र एउटै पुस्तक समयक्रममा धेरै सदस्यले लिन सक्छन्। यसको ER चित्र कोर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: A library keeps books and members. A member may borrow many books, and a book may be borrowed by many members over time. Draw an ER diagram for this.

pairs.ne: तीन। Student, Course, र हरेक भर्नाका लागि एक पङ्क्ति राख्ने तेस्रो तालिका। "दुवैतर्फ धेरै" लाई एउटै foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन — स्तम्भले एउटा मान राख्छ, त्यसैले एउटै पङ्क्ति देखाउँछ। सम्बन्ध धेरै–धेरै भएकै क्षण junction तालिका अनिवार्य हुन्छ। तलको औजारमा M:N छान्नुहोस्, तेस्रो तालिका देखिन्छ।
pairs.en: Three. Student, Course, and a third table holding one row for every enrolment. No single foreign key can record "many on both sides" — a column holds one value, so it can point at one row. The moment a relationship is many-to-many, a junction table is forced. Switch the tool below to M:N and the third table appears.

pairs.ne: एउटा विद्यार्थीले धेरै विषय लिन सक्छ, र एउटा विषय धेरै विद्यार्थीले लिन सक्छन्। यो सम्बन्धलाई कति तालिका चाहिन्छ?
pairs.en: A student may take many courses, and a course may be taken by many students. How many TABLES will this relationship need?
