pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Backup भनेको छुट्टै राखिएको data को प्रतिलिपि हो, ताकि मूल हराए, बिग्रिए वा भुलवश बदलिए फर्काउन सकियोस्। Recovery भनेको खराबीपछि त्यो data फर्काउने र प्रणालीलाई चल्ने अवस्थामा ल्याउने प्रक्रिया हो। Data हार्डवेयर बिग्रेर मात्र हराउँदैन: भुलले मेटिनु, फाइल ओभरराइट हुनु, भाइरस, चोरी, आगलागी वा बाढी, र असफल अपडेट। ब्याकअप योजनाले यी सबै झेल्नुपर्छ — त्यसैले प्रतिलिपि मूलकै भवनमा राख्नु कमजोर योजना हो र अर्को ठाउँको प्रतिलिपि गम्भीर योजनाको हिस्सा हो। ब्याकअपको जाँच "चल्यो कि चलेन" होइन। फर्काउन सकिन्छ कि सकिँदैन हो — कहिल्यै फर्काएर नहेरिएको ब्याकअप अनुमान हो, सुरक्षा होइन।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording A backup is a copy of data kept separately, so that it can be restored if the original is lost, damaged or changed by mistake. Recovery is the process of restoring that data, and returning the system to working order, after a failure. Data is lost in more ways than hardware failure: accidental deletion, overwriting a file, a virus, theft, fire or flood, and a failed update. A backup plan has to survive all of them, which is why keeping the copy in the same building as the original is a weak plan and an off-site copy is part of a serious one. The test of a backup is not whether it ran. It is whether a restore works — a backup that has never been restored from is an assumption, not a safeguard.

pairs.ne: तीन विधिको तुलना Full backup — हरेक पटक सबै कपी गर्छ। लिन सबैभन्दा ढिलो र मिडिया धेरै लाग्छ, तर फर्काउन एउटै सेट चाहिन्छ — त्यसैले recovery सबैभन्दा छिटो र सुरक्षित। Incremental backup — जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअप पछि बदलिएको मात्र कपी गर्छ। लिन सबैभन्दा छिटो र सानो, तर फर्काउन अन्तिम full ब्याकअप र त्यसपछिका सबै increment चाहिन्छन्। शृंखलाको एउटा increment हराए वा बिग्रिए त्यसपछिको सबै जान्छ। Differential backup — अन्तिम full ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको सबै कपी गर्छ। हरेक दिनको अघिल्लो भन्दा ठूलो हुन्छ, तर फर्काउन ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट चाहिन्छ: full र सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो differential। सौदा सधैं उही हो: ब्याकअप लिँदाको समय र मिडिया, बनाम फर्काउँदाको समय र जोखिम।
pairs.en: The three methods compared Full backup — copies everything every time. Slowest to take and uses the most media, but a restore needs only one set, so it is the fastest and safest to recover from. Incremental backup — copies only what has changed since the last backup of any kind. Fastest to take and smallest, but a restore needs the last full backup plus every increment since. If one increment in the chain is missing or damaged, everything after it is lost. Differential backup — copies everything changed since the last full backup. Each day is larger than the last, but a restore needs exactly two sets: the full backup and the most recent differential. The trade is always the same: time and media when you back up, against time and risk when you restore.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ब्याकअप उपकरण र मिडिया: बाहिरी hard disk (ठूलो, छिटो, प्रति GB सस्तो); USB flash drive (बोक्न सजिलो, कम क्षमता); optical disc — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (एक पटक लेखिने, सस्तो, ढिलो); चुम्बकीय टेप (धेरै ठूलो क्षमता, कम लागत, अभिलेखका लागि अझै प्रयोगमा); network attached storage; र cloud storage, जुन स्वभावतः अर्को ठाउँमा हुन्छ। Scheduling भनेको ब्याकअप कहिले चल्ने तय गरेर स्वचालित बनाउनु हो। कसैले सम्झनुपर्ने ब्याकअप हुँदैन। प्रायः कार्यालय समयबाहिर राखिन्छ, किनकि ब्याकअपले डिस्क र नेटवर्क ओगट्छ। Media rotation भनेको मिडियाको समूहलाई योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग गर्नु, ताकि एकैचोटि ब्याकअपका धेरै पुस्ता रहून्। मानक योजना grandfather–father–son हो: दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) एक वर्ष राखिन्छ। तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाएको समस्याबाट जोगाउने कुरा rotation नै हो। तीन हप्ताअघि फाइल बिग्रेको थियो र त्यसपछि हरेक ब्याकअप ओभरराइट भइसक्यो भने तपाईंसँग भएका सबै प्रतिलिपि पनि बिग्रिएकै हुन्छन्।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording Backup devices and media: external hard disks (large, fast, cheap per gigabyte); USB flash drives (portable, small capacity); optical discs — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (write once, cheap, slow); magnetic tape (very large capacity, low cost, still used for archives); network attached storage; and cloud storage, which is off-site by nature. Scheduling means deciding when backups run and automating them. Backups that depend on someone remembering do not happen. They are usually scheduled outside working hours, because a backup competes for the disk and the network. Media rotation means reusing a set of media in a planned cycle, so that several generations of backup exist at once. The standard scheme is grandfather–father–son: daily backups (son) are kept for a week, weekly backups (father) for a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for a year. Rotation is what protects you from a problem you did not notice immediately. If a file was corrupted three weeks ago and every backup has been overwritten since, the only copies you hold are all corrupted too.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्कलाई जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता, वा दुवै पाउन। RAID 0 — striping. Data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, त्यसैले पढ्न–लेख्न छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता प्रयोग हुन्छ। कुनै redundancy छैन: एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै data जान्छ। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 — mirroring. उही data दुवै डिस्कमा लेखिन्छ। एउटा बिग्रिए पनि प्रणाली चलिरहन्छ। कुल क्षमताको आधा मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 — parity सहितको striping. Data र parity सबै डिस्कमा फैलाइन्छ। कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए त्यसको सामग्री parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ। एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमता parity मा जान्छ। न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so the operating system sees them as one drive, in order to gain speed, fault tolerance, or both. RAID 0 — striping. Data is split across the disks, so reads and writes are faster and the full capacity is usable. There is no redundancy: if any one disk fails, all the data is lost. Minimum two disks. RAID 1 — mirroring. The same data is written to both disks. One disk can fail and the system keeps running. Only half the total capacity is usable. Minimum two disks. RAID 5 — striping with parity. Data and parity information are spread across all the disks. Any one disk can fail and its contents are rebuilt from the parity. The capacity of one disk is given up to parity. Minimum three disks.

pairs.ne: खराबी अनुसार उपाय मिलाउनुहोस् ब्याकअपबाट फर्काउने — सामान्य उत्तर, र data नै हराएको वा बिग्रिएको बेला काम लाग्ने एक मात्र उपाय। System restore point — अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सेटिङ र driver लाई अघिल्लो अवस्थामा फर्काउँछ। खराब अपडेट वा driver मिलाउँछ; मेटिएका व्यक्तिगत फाइल फर्काउँदैन। Recovery / repair console — बिग्रिएको boot sector वा सिस्टम फाइल मर्मत गरेर मेसिन फेरि सुरु हुन दिन्छ। Data recovery सफ्टवेयर — सूची मेटिएका फाइल फर्काउन sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। यो चल्नुको कारण नै quick format र delete ले data आफैँ नहटाउनु हो। बिग्रेको ड्राइभबाट व्यावसायिक रिकभरी — head crash जस्तो भौतिक क्षतिका लागि, clean room मा गरिने। महँगो, र कहिल्यै ग्यारेन्टी नहुने। RAID array पुनर्निर्माण — बिग्रेको डिस्क साटेर array लाई mirror वा parity बाट सामग्री फेरि बनाउन दिने।
pairs.en: Match the technique to the failure Restore from backup — the general answer, and the only one that works when data itself has been lost or corrupted. System restore point — rolls the operating system's settings and drivers back to an earlier state. Fixes a bad update or driver; does not recover deleted personal files. Recovery / repair console — repairs a damaged boot sector or system files so the machine can start again. Data recovery software — scans sectors directly to retrieve files whose index entries were deleted. This works precisely because a quick format and a delete do not remove the data itself. Professional recovery from a failed drive — for physical damage such as a head crash, done in a clean room. Expensive, and never guaranteed. Rebuilding a RAID array — replacing a failed disk and letting the array rebuild its contents from the mirror or the parity.

pairs.ne: RAID ले डिस्क जोगाउँछ; ब्याकअपले गल्ती जोगाउँछ। Incremental = अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि, differential = अन्तिम full पछि।
pairs.en: RAID survives a disk; backup survives a mistake. Incremental = since last backup, differential = since last full.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: तालिका हेरेरै पुनर्स्थापनालाई कति सेट चाहिन्छ निकाल्न। पहिलो समस्या तपाईंका लागि गरिदिइन्छ, अर्कोमा कम चरण देखिन्छन्, र अन्तिम दुईमा केही दिइँदैन — तीमध्ये एउटाले उही गन्ती नियमलाई RAID पुनर्निर्माणमा सार्छ।

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम सुरु भयो। सधैं main() बाटै चल्न थाल्छ।
pairs.en: The program starts. Execution always begins at main().

pairs.ne: "Ram" र 15 सहित अब्जेक्ट s1 बन्दैछ। अब्जेक्ट बन्ने बित्तिकै कन्स्ट्रक्टर आफैं बोलिन्छ।
pairs.en: Object s1 is being created with "Ram" and 15. Creating an object automatically calls the constructor.

pairs.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर भित्र पस्यो। यहाँ n = "Ram" र r = 15 छ।
pairs.en: Jump into the constructor. Here n = "Ram" and r = 15.

pairs.ne: डाटा मेम्बर name ले "Ram" मान पायो।
pairs.en: The data member name gets the value "Ram".

pairs.ne: डाटा मेम्बर roll ले 15 मान पायो।
pairs.en: The data member roll gets the value 15.

pairs.ne: यो cout चल्यो, त्यसैले पहिलो आउटपुट अहिले देखियो।
pairs.en: This cout runs, so the first line of output appears now.

pairs.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर सकियो। अब्जेक्ट s1 मेमोरीमा तयार भयो। नियन्त्रण main() मा फर्कियो।
pairs.en: The constructor is finished. Object s1 is now ready in memory. Control returns to main().

pairs.ne: "Sita" र 16 सहित अब्जेक्ट s2 बन्दैछ। कन्स्ट्रक्टर फेरि बोलियो।
pairs.en: Object s2 is being created with "Sita" and 16. The constructor is called again.

pairs.ne: फेरि कन्स्ट्रक्टर भित्र। यस पटक n = "Sita" र r = 16।
pairs.en: Inside the constructor again. This time n = "Sita" and r = 16.

pairs.ne: s2 सँग आफ्नै छुट्टै name छ। यो "Sita" भयो। s1 मा कुनै असर पर्दैन।
pairs.en: s2 has its OWN separate copy of name. It becomes "Sita". s1 is not affected.

pairs.ne: s2 को roll 16 भयो।
pairs.en: roll of s2 becomes 16.

pairs.ne: दोस्रो आउटपुट लाइन छापियो।
pairs.en: The second line of output is printed.

pairs.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर सकियो। अब दुवै अब्जेक्ट अस्तित्वमा छन्।
pairs.en: Constructor finished. Both objects now exist.

pairs.ne: s1.display() बोलाइयो। डट अपरेटरले s1 अब्जेक्ट छान्यो।
pairs.en: s1.display() is called. The dot operator picks the object s1.

pairs.ne: display() ले s1 कै डाटा प्रयोग गर्‍यो, त्यसैले Ram र 15 छाप्यो।
pairs.en: display() runs using s1 data, so it prints Ram and 15.

pairs.ne: display() सकियो। फेरि main() मा।
pairs.en: display() ends. Back in main().

pairs.ne: s2.display() बोलाइयो। उही फङ्सन, तर फरक अब्जेक्ट।
pairs.en: s2.display() is called. The SAME function, but a different object.

pairs.ne: अब display() ले s2 को डाटा प्रयोग गर्‍यो, त्यसैले Sita र 16 छाप्यो।
pairs.en: Now display() uses s2 data, so it prints Sita and 16.

pairs.ne: display() फेरि सकियो।
pairs.en: display() ends again.

pairs.ne: return 0; main() सकिँदैछ, त्यसैले सबै लोकल अब्जेक्ट अब नष्ट हुनुपर्छ।
pairs.en: return 0; main() is ending, so every local object must now be destroyed.

pairs.ne: महत्त्वपूर्ण: अब्जेक्ट बनेको उल्टो क्रममा नष्ट हुन्छन्। s2 पछि बनेको थियो, त्यसैले s2 नै पहिले नष्ट हुन्छ।
pairs.en: IMPORTANT: objects are destroyed in REVERSE order of creation. s2 was made last, so s2 is destroyed FIRST.

pairs.ne: s2 को डिस्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो सन्देश छाप्यो।
pairs.en: The destructor of s2 prints its message.

pairs.ne: अब s1 को डिस्ट्रक्टर चल्यो — पहिले बनेको अब्जेक्ट अन्तिममा नष्ट हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Now the destructor of s1 runs — the object created first is destroyed last.

pairs.ne: s1 को डिस्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो सन्देश छाप्यो।
pairs.en: The destructor of s1 prints its message.

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम सकियो। हेर्नुहोस्: तपाईंले कन्स्ट्रक्टर वा डिस्ट्रक्टर हातले बोलाउनु परेन — C++ ले आफैं बोलायो।
pairs.en: The program ends. Notice: you never called the constructor or destructor yourself — C++ called both automatically.

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम main() बाट सुरु भयो।
pairs.en: The program starts at main().

pairs.ne: Puppy क्लासको एउटा अब्जेक्ट p बन्यो। तर Puppy, Dog माथि बनेको छ र Dog, Animal माथि बनेको छ।
pairs.en: ONE object p of class Puppy is created. But Puppy is built on top of Dog, and Dog is built on top of Animal.

pairs.ne: नियम: सबैभन्दा माथिको base क्लासको कन्स्ट्रक्टर पहिले चल्छ। त्यसैले Animal() पहिले चल्यो।
pairs.en: RULE: the constructor of the TOP-MOST base class runs first. So Animal() runs first.

pairs.ne: Animal कन्स्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो।
pairs.en: Animal constructor prints its line.

pairs.ne: त्यसपछि बीचको क्लास Dog() को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्यो।
pairs.en: Next the middle class constructor Dog() runs.

pairs.ne: Dog कन्स्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो।
pairs.en: Dog constructor prints its line.

pairs.ne: सबैभन्दा अन्त्यमा, हामीले साँच्चै बनाएको क्लास Puppy() को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्यो।
pairs.en: Last of all, the constructor of the class we actually created — Puppy() — runs.

pairs.ne: Puppy कन्स्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो। अब अब्जेक्ट p पूरै तयार भयो।
pairs.en: Puppy constructor prints its line. The object p is now fully built.

pairs.ne: p.eat() बोलाइयो। Puppy सँग आफ्नै eat() छैन, त्यसैले C++ माथि Dog मा, अनि Animal मा खोज्छ।
pairs.en: p.eat() is called. Puppy has no eat() of its own, so C++ looks up to Dog, then up to Animal.

pairs.ne: eat() Animal मा भेटियो र चल्यो। यही इनहेरिटेन्सको काम हो — नलेखीकनै कोड पुनः प्रयोग।
pairs.en: eat() is found in Animal and runs. This is inheritance working — code reused without rewriting.

pairs.ne: p.bark() बोलाइयो। Puppy मा छैन, त्यसैले C++ माथि Dog मा हेर्छ।
pairs.en: p.bark() is called. It is not in Puppy, so C++ looks up to Dog.

pairs.ne: bark() Dog मा भेटियो र चल्यो।
pairs.en: bark() is found in Dog and runs.

pairs.ne: p.weep() बोलाइयो। यो चाहिँ Puppy कै आफ्नो हो।
pairs.en: p.weep() is called. This one belongs to Puppy itself.

pairs.ne: Puppy बाट weep() चल्यो।
pairs.en: weep() runs from Puppy.

pairs.ne: return 0; प्रोग्राम सकिँदैछ। (डिस्ट्रक्टर लेखिएको भए उल्टो क्रममा चल्थ्यो: Puppy, अनि Dog, अनि Animal।)
pairs.en: return 0; the program is ending. (Destructors, if written, would run in the reverse order: Puppy, then Dog, then Animal.)

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम सकियो। एउटा अब्जेक्ट, तीन कन्स्ट्रक्टर, र तीन फरक क्लासबाट आएका तीन फङ्सन।
pairs.en: Program ends. One object, three constructors, and three functions coming from three different classes.

pairs.ne: p लाई Shape को पोइन्टरका रूपमा घोषणा गरियो। अहिले यो खाली छ — कतै देखाउँदैन।
pairs.en: p is declared as a pointer to Shape. It is empty right now — it points to nothing.

pairs.ne: मेमोरीमा Circle अब्जेक्ट c बन्यो।
pairs.en: A Circle object c is created in memory.

pairs.ne: मेमोरीमा Square अब्जेक्ट s बन्यो।
pairs.en: A Square object s is created in memory.

pairs.ne: p = &c;  अब Shape पोइन्टरसँग Circle अब्जेक्टको ठेगाना छ। Circle पनि एक प्रकारको Shape भएकाले यो मिल्छ।
pairs.en: p = &c;  The Shape pointer now stores the ADDRESS of the Circle object. This is allowed because Circle IS-A Shape.

pairs.ne: p->draw() बोलाइयो। p पोइन्टर भएकाले एरो अपरेटर प्रयोग गरियो।
pairs.en: p->draw() is called. The arrow operator is used because p is a pointer.

pairs.ne: base क्लासमा draw() लाई VIRTUAL लेखिएको छ। त्यसैले C++ ले अहिले निर्णय गर्दैन — चल्दै गर्दा वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेर्छ।
pairs.en: draw() is marked VIRTUAL in the base class. So C++ does NOT decide now — it waits and checks the real object at run time.

pairs.ne: वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट Circle हो, त्यसैले override गरिएको Circle::draw() छानियो — base को होइन।
pairs.en: The real object is a Circle, so the OVERRIDDEN Circle::draw() is chosen — not the base one.

pairs.ne: Circle::draw() चल्यो र आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो।
pairs.en: Circle::draw() runs and prints its line.

pairs.ne: p = &s;  उही पोइन्टर p सँग अब Square अब्जेक्टको ठेगाना छ।
pairs.en: p = &s;  The SAME pointer p now stores the address of the Square object instead.

pairs.ne: p->draw() फेरि बोलाइयो — ठ्याक्कै पहिलेकै लाइन।
pairs.en: p->draw() is called again — exactly the same line of code as before.

pairs.ne: फेरि C++ ले चल्दै गर्दा p ले वास्तवमा कुन अब्जेक्ट देखाएको छ भनेर जाँच्यो।
pairs.en: Again C++ checks at run time which object p is really pointing to.

pairs.ne: यस पटक अब्जेक्ट Square हो, त्यसैले Square::draw() छानियो।
pairs.en: This time the object is a Square, so Square::draw() is chosen.

pairs.ne: Square::draw() चल्यो र उही कलबाट फरक लाइन छाप्यो।
pairs.en: Square::draw() runs and prints a DIFFERENT line — from the same call.

pairs.ne: return 0; प्रोग्राम सकिँदैछ।
pairs.en: return 0; the program is ending.

pairs.ne: परीक्षा बुँदा: यो लाइनबाट "virtual" शब्द हटाए दुवै कलले "Drawing a Shape" छाप्थ्यो, किनकि तब C++ ले पोइन्टरको प्रकार हेरेर कम्पाइल गर्दै निर्णय गर्थ्यो।
pairs.en: EXAM POINT: if you delete the word "virtual" on this line, BOTH calls would print "Drawing a Shape", because C++ would then decide by the POINTER TYPE at compile time instead.

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम सकियो। एउटै कल, दुई आउटपुट — यही run-time polymorphism हो।
pairs.en: Program ends. One call, two outputs — that is run-time polymorphism.

pairs.ne: स्ट्याकले एउटै छेउ (top) बाट राख्छ र झिक्छ, त्यसैले अन्तिममा हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ।
pairs.en: A stack inserts and deletes at only one end called the top, so the last value pushed is the first one popped.

pairs.ne: ट्री अरेखीय हो किनकि यो तह–तह मिलेको हुन्छ — एउटा नोड धेरै सन्तानसँग जोडिन सक्छ।
pairs.en: A tree is non-linear because it is hierarchical — one node can connect to many child nodes.

pairs.ne: फिल्डहरू मिलेर रेकर्ड बन्छ, र धेरै रेकर्ड मिलेर फाइल बन्छ।
pairs.en: Fields make a record, and many related records together make a file.

pairs.ne: Queue ले FIFO मान्छ: नयाँ तत्त्व rear मा थपिन्छ र front बाट निस्कन्छ — काउन्टरको लाइन जस्तै।
pairs.en: A queue follows FIFO: new elements join at the rear and elements leave from the front, like a line at a counter.

pairs.ne: Linked list गतिशील हुन्छ: आवश्यकता अनुसार node बन्छन्, त्यसैले चल्दाचल्दै बढ्छ–घट्छ। Array घोषणा गरेपछि स्थिर हुन्छ। बाँकी तीन विकल्पले array लाई वर्णन गर्छन् — array मा index बाट पहुँच O(1) हो भने linked list मा हिँड्नुपर्छ, र linked list ले हरेक node मा pointer पनि राख्ने भएकाले प्रति तत्त्व बढी मेमोरी खान्छ।
pairs.en: A linked list is dynamic: nodes are allocated as needed, so it grows and shrinks at run time. An array is fixed once declared. The other three options describe an ARRAY — index access is O(1) in an array and requires walking the list in a linked list, and a linked list uses MORE memory per element because every node also stores a pointer.

pairs.ne: Traversing भनेको हरेक तत्त्वलाई एक पटक हेर्नु — प्रायः प्रशोधन गर्न वा देखाउन। Searching ले कुनै एउटा तत्त्व खोज्छ र बीचैमा रोकिन सक्छ; sorting ले क्रममा मिलाउँछ। तीनै पाठ्यक्रममा डाटा स्ट्रक्चरका operation का रूपमा सूचीबद्ध छन्।
pairs.en: Traversing means visiting each element once, usually to process or display it. Searching looks for one particular element and may stop early; sorting rearranges elements into order. All three are listed in the syllabus as operations on data structures.

pairs.ne: पाठ्यक्रमले ठ्याक्कै दुई non-linear संरचना नाम लिन्छ: tree र graph। Linear संरचनामा हरेक तत्त्वको एक अघिल्लो र एक पछिल्लो हुन्छ; non-linear मा एउटै तत्त्व धेरैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। चौथो विकल्प पासो हो — tree non-linear हो तर queue linear, त्यसैले "मात्र" भन्ने शर्त पूरा हुँदैन।
pairs.en: The syllabus names exactly two non-linear structures: trees and graphs. In a linear structure every element has one predecessor and one successor; in a non-linear one an element may connect to many. Option 4 is the trap — a tree is non-linear but a queue is linear, so the pair fails the word ONLY.

pairs.ne: क्रमैसँग हेर्नुहोस्: तीन push पछि stack मा 10, 20, 30 हुन्छ र टुप्पोमा 30। Pop ले टुप्पोको हटाउँछ, त्यसैले 30 गयो र 20 टुप्पोमा आयो। 40 push गर्दा त्यो 20 माथि बस्छ। टुप्पोमा 40 छ। सामान्य गल्ती 10 हटाउनु हो — तर LIFO ले पहिलो होइन, अन्तिम छिरेको हटाउँछ।
pairs.en: Work it through: after the three pushes the stack is 10, 20, 30 with 30 on top. A pop removes the TOP, so 30 goes and 20 is on top. Pushing 40 puts it above 20. The top is 40. The common slip is popping 10 — but LIFO removes the last one in, not the first.

pairs.ne: डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनेको मेमोरीमा data मिलाएर राख्ने तरिका हो, जसले प्रोग्रामलाई छिटो काम गर्न दिन्छ। उही data नमिलाई राखे प्रोग्राम ढिलो हुन्छ; मिलाएर राखे छिटो। Source लाई मेसिन कोडमा बदल्ने काम compiler को हो, डाटा स्ट्रक्चरको होइन।
pairs.en: A data structure is a way of organising data in memory so a program can use it efficiently. The same data stored badly makes a program slow; stored well it makes it fast. Converting source to machine code is the compiler's job, not a data structure's.

pairs.ne: Field — जसलाई attribute पनि भनिन्छ — entity को एउटा गुण हो। Record भनेको एउटै entity (एक विद्यार्थी) लाई वर्णन गर्ने सबै field को समूह। File भनेको record हरूको समूह। तीन एक–अर्काभित्र पर्छन्: field record भित्र, record file भित्र।
pairs.en: A field, also called an attribute, is one property of an entity. A record is the whole collection of fields describing one entity (one student). A file is a collection of records. The three sit inside one another: field in record, record in file.

pairs.ne: Print queue FIFO हो — पहिले पठाइएको कागजात पहिले छापिन्छ, र न्यायसंगत हुन त्यही चाहिन्छ। बाँकी तीनै LIFO हुन् र stack ले देखाउँछ: undo ले सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो काम उल्ट्याउँछ, थाल माथिबाट उठ्छ, र function सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो बोलाउनेकहाँ फर्कन्छ।
pairs.en: A print queue is FIFO — the document sent first is printed first, which is exactly what fairness requires. The other three are all LIFO and are modelled by a stack: undo reverses the most recent action, plates come off the top, and a function returns to the most recent caller.

pairs.ne: ठीक डाटा स्ट्रक्चर छान्दा प्रोग्राम छिटो र सफा हुन्छ; तपाईंको तर्क सही छ कि छैन भन्नेमा यसले केही गर्दैन। उत्कृष्ट डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भए पनि शर्त गलत भए प्रोग्राम गलत नै हुन्छ। पहिला तीन पाठ्यक्रमले लेखेका फाइदा हुन्।
pairs.en: Choosing the right data structure makes a program faster and tidier; it does nothing about the correctness of your logic. A program with a perfect data structure and a wrong condition is still wrong. The first three are the advantages the syllabus lists.

pairs.ne: एक पटक क्रममा मिलाएपछि हरेक पछिल्लो खोजी binary search हुन सक्छ, जसले हरेक चरणमा बाँकी सूची आधा गर्छ — हजार नामका लागि हजारसम्म होइन, करिब १० तुलना। Stack ले झन् बिगार्छ, किनकि टुप्पो मात्र छुन पाइन्छ। छोटो नाम र टिप्पणीले पढ्न सजिलो बनाउँछ, गति होइन।
pairs.en: Sorting once lets every later search be a binary search, which halves the remaining list at each step — about 10 comparisons for 1000 names instead of up to 1000. A stack would make it worse, since you can only reach the top. Shorter names and comments change readability, not running speed.

pairs.ne: फिल्ड → रेकर्ड → फाइल। इन्टिटी चाहिँ जुन वास्तविक वस्तुको वर्णन गरिँदैछ त्यो हो। विद्यार्थीहरूले प्रायः entity (वस्तु) र attribute (त्यसको गुण) लाई अलमल्याउँछन्।
pairs.en: Exam tip — remember the ladder Field → Record → File. One field is one value; many fields make one record; many records make one file. The entity is the real thing all of it describes. Students most often mix up entity (the thing) with attribute (a property of the thing).

pairs.ne: अन्तिम तत्त्वका लागि marks[5]
pairs.en: marks[5] is outside the array and gives a garbage value or crashes the program. C++ does not warn you.

pairs.ne: यसलाई कुन डाटा स्ट्रक्चर चाहिन्छ?
pairs.en: Which data structure does this need?

pairs.ne: दुई प्रश्नले हरेक केस मिलाउँछ। आकार रेखा हो कि हाँगा फैलिन्छ? रेखा भए चीज कुन छेउबाट निस्कन्छ — भित्र गएकै छेउबाट कि अर्कोबाट? जाँच्नुअघि छान्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Two questions settle every case. Is the shape a LINE or does it BRANCH? If it is a line, which end do things leave from — the end they went in at, or the other one? Commit before you check.

pairs.ne: Back ले सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो पृष्ठ B मा फर्काउँछ — पछि आएको पहिले जाने। पृष्ठहरू उही छेउबाट भित्र–बाहिर हुन्छन्, र यस्तो व्यवहार stack ले मात्र गर्छ।
pairs.en: Back returns to B, the page visited most recently — last in, first out. Pages go in and come out at the same end, and a stack is the only structure that behaves that way.

pairs.ne: report पहिले आयो र पहिले छापिन्छ — पहिले आएको पहिले जाने। चीज पछाडिबाट भित्र र अगाडिबाट बाहिर जान्छ — दुई फरक छेउ, र यही फरकले यसलाई stack होइन queue बनाउँछ।
pairs.en: The report arrived first and prints first — first in, first out. Things enter at the rear and leave from the front, which is two different ends, and that is what makes it a queue rather than a stack.

pairs.ne: हरेक फोल्डर ठ्याक्कै एउटै अभिभावक फोल्डरभित्र हुन्छ र धेरै छोरा राख्न सक्छ, र कुनै बाटो सुरुको ठाउँमा फर्किंदैन। एउटै अभिभावक, धेरै छोरा, चक्र छैन — यही tree हो, र यो non-linear हो।
pairs.en: Every folder sits inside exactly one parent folder and may hold many children, and no path ever leads back to where it started. One parent, many children, no cycle — that is a tree, and it is non-linear.

pairs.ne: तीन मार्ग मिलेर चक्र बन्छ, त्यसैले काठमाडौंबाट निस्केर काठमाडौं फर्कन सकिन्छ। Tree ले यो कहिल्यै गर्न सक्दैन, र कुनै सहर अर्कोको अभिभावक होइन — कुनै पनि बिन्दु कुनै पनि बिन्दुसँग जोडिन सक्छ, यही graph हो।
pairs.en: The three routes close into a loop, so you can leave Kathmandu and arrive back at it. A tree can never do that, and no city is the parent of another — any node may connect to any node, which is a graph.

pairs.ne: Undo ले सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो परिवर्तन "!" हटाउँछ, र दोस्रो undo ले "setu"। क्रम काम गरेको क्रमको ठ्याक्कै उल्टो हुन्छ, त्यसैले यिनलाई राख्ने संरचना stack हो।
pairs.en: Undo removes the exclamation mark, the most recent change, and a second undo removes "setu". The order is the reverse of the order things were done in, so the structure holding them is a stack.

pairs.ne: नयाँ मान्छे पछाडि उभिन्छ र छैटौं पालो पाउँछ, अगाडिकोले भर्खरको पालो पाउँछ। एक छेउबाट राख्ने र अर्को छेउबाट हटाउने — queue को परिभाषा यही हो।
pairs.en: The new person joins at the back and is served sixth, while the person at the front is served next. Insertion at one end and deletion at the other is the definition of a queue.

pairs.ne: एउटा मान → फिल्ड, फिल्डहरू → रेकर्ड, रेकर्डहरू → फाइल कसरी बन्छ।
pairs.en: How one value becomes a field, fields become a record, and records become a file.

pairs.ne: वर्गीकरणको रूख। तह वा हाँगा भएको संरचना non-linear हो।
pairs.en: The classification tree. If a structure has levels or branches, it is non-linear.

pairs.ne: पाँच पूर्णांक एउटै लगातार ब्लकमा। index ० देखि ४ सम्म — १ देखि ५ होइन।
pairs.en: Five integers in one continuous block. Index 0 to 4 — never 1 to 5.

pairs.ne: छरिएका ठेगानामा रहेका तीन नोड, पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडिएका।
pairs.en: Three nodes at scattered addresses, held together only by pointers.

pairs.ne: बीचमा थप्दा: एरेले तत्त्वहरू सार्नुपर्छ, लिंक्ड लिस्टले दुई लिंक मात्र फेर्छ। यही एउटा चित्रले array-vs-list का धेरै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिन्छ।
pairs.en: Inserting into the middle: the array must shift elements, the linked list only re-points two links. This single picture answers most array-vs-list questions.

pairs.ne: push र pop दुवै उही छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्। top
pairs.en: top moves.

pairs.ne: दुई फरक छेउ: पछाडिबाट लाइनमा बस्ने, अगाडिबाट निस्कने।
pairs.en: Two different ends: join at the rear, leave from the front.

pairs.ne: A root हो। D, E, F leaf हुन्। D र E siblings हुन्।
pairs.en: A is the root. D, E and F are leaves. D and E are siblings.

pairs.ne: पहेँलो बाटो B → C → D → B एउटा चक्र हो। ट्रीमा यस्तो कहिल्यै हुँदैन।
pairs.en: The yellow path B → C → D → B is a cycle. A tree can never contain one.

pairs.ne: व्यवहारिक उदाहरण — पुस्तकालय। ५,००० किताब भएको पुस्तकालय सम्झनुहोस्। किताबहरू नै डाटा हुन्। भुइँमा थुपारेको छ भने एउटा किताब खोज्न घण्टौं लाग्न सक्छ। तर विषय अनुसार नम्बर हालेको र्‍याकमा राखिएको छ भने एक मिनेटमै भेटिन्छ। किताब उही, कोठा उही — तर मिलाउने तरिका फेरियो, र गति पूरै फेरियो। त्यही मिलान नै डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो।
pairs.en: Same books. Same room. Same librarian. Only the arrangement changed — and the speed changed completely. That arrangement is the data structure.

pairs.ne: कच्चा तथ्य र अंक। मिलाएर नराखेसम्म यसको अर्थ हुँदैन।
pairs.en: The raw facts and figures that a computer stores or processes. On its own, data carries no meaning until it is organised.

pairs.ne: फेरि साना टुक्रामा भाग गर्न मिल्ने डाटा आइटम।
pairs.en: A data item that can be divided into smaller sub-items.

pairs.ne: अब भाग गर्न नमिल्ने डाटा आइटम।
pairs.en: A data item that cannot be divided any further. Also called an atomic item.

pairs.ne: एउटै वस्तुलाई जनाउने सम्बन्धित फिल्डहरूको समूह — तालिकाको एउटा हरफ।
pairs.en: A collection of related data items (fields) that together describe one thing. One row of a table.

pairs.ne: जुन वास्तविक वस्तु/व्यक्तिको बारेमा डाटा राखिन्छ।
pairs.en: Any real-world thing, person or object about which we store data.

pairs.ne: इन्टिटीको एउटा गुण वा विशेषता — तालिकाको एउटा स्तम्भ।
pairs.en: One property or characteristic of an entity. One column of a table.

pairs.ne: एउटै इन्टिटीका धेरै रेकर्डहरूको संग्रह।
pairs.en: A collection of related records of the same entity, stored together.

pairs.ne: लुप i < 5
pairs.en: i < 5, so i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — exactly the five valid indexes.

pairs.ne: उदाहरण — थाकिएका प्लेट। धोएर एक–अर्कामाथि थुपारेका प्लेटमध्ये अन्तिममा राखेको सबैभन्दा माथि हुन्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यही उठाइन्छ। पहिलो प्लेट सबैभन्दा तल हुन्छ र अन्तिममा निस्कन्छ।
pairs.en: Analogy — a pile of plates You wash plates and stack them one on top of another. The plate you put down last sits on top, so it is the plate you pick up first. The very first plate is at the bottom and leaves last. You cannot pull a plate from the middle without lifting the ones above it.

pairs.ne: कुनै बटन थिच्नुअघि लिडका दुई प्रश्नको उत्तर दिनुहोस्। आकार हाँगिन्छ? हाँगिए non-linear — हरेक वस्तुको एउटै अभिभावक र कुनै चक्र नभए tree, यीमध्ये एक पनि नमिले graph। नहाँगिए चीज कुन छेउबाट निस्कन्छ सोध्नुहोस्: भित्र गएकै छेउबाट भए stack, पर्तिरको छेउबाट भए queue। 1.6 Operations on Data Structures OperationWhat it does TraversingVisiting each element exactly once in order to read or process it. हरेक तत्त्वलाई ठीक एक पटक भेटेर पढ्ने वा प्रयोग गर्ने।
pairs.en: The bus-route case is the one worth reading the reason for even when you get it right. It is a graph for one reason only — the routes close into a loop — and that single property is what separates every graph question from every tree question.

pairs.ne: दिइएको मानसँग मिल्ने तत्त्व कहाँ छ भनेर पत्ता लगाउने।
pairs.en: Finding the location of an element that matches a given value.

pairs.ne: संरचनामा नयाँ तत्त्व थप्ने।
pairs.en: Adding a new element into the structure.

pairs.ne: भइरहेको तत्त्व हटाउने।
pairs.en: Removing an existing element from the structure.

pairs.ne: तत्त्वहरूलाई सानोदेखि ठूलो वा ठूलोदेखि सानो क्रममा मिलाउने।
pairs.en: Arranging elements in a particular order — ascending or descending.

pairs.ne: दुईवटा मिलेका लिस्टलाई जोडेर एउटै मिलेको लिस्ट बनाउने।
pairs.en: Joining two sorted lists into one single sorted list.

pairs.ne: output खोल्नुअघि: break ले रोक्नुअघि यो loop ले कति पटक तुलना गर्छ? छापिने लाइन होइन, त्यही सङ्ख्या नै searching को प्रश्नले साँच्चै सोधेको कुरा हो।
pairs.en: Before you open the output: how many comparisons does this loop make before break stops it? That number, not the printed line, is what a question about searching is really asking for.

pairs.ne: Linear search ले एक–एक गरी जाँच्छ र नमिलेको डाटामा पनि चल्छ। Binary search धेरै छिटो हुन्छ तर डाटा मिलेको हुनैपर्छ।
pairs.en: Linear search checks elements one by one and works even on unsorted data. Binary search is far faster but the data must be sorted first.

pairs.ne: Stack मा अन्तिममा हालेको मान पहिले निस्कियो — top
pairs.en: front moved on delete. That is FIFO.

pairs.ne: डाटा स्ट्रक्चरका शब्द, वर्गीकरण र अपरेसन पक्का अंक हुन् — परिभाषा लगभग हरेक वर्ष सोधिन्छ।
pairs.en: Data structure terms, classification and operations are guaranteed marks — the definitions are asked almost every year.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा र कुनै चार फाइदा लेख्नुहोस्। माथिकै अंग्रेजी वाक्य जस्ताको तस्तै लेख्दा पूरा अंक आउँछ।
pairs.en: Advantages: (i) efficiency — searching and sorting become faster; (ii) reusability — one structure can be used in many programs; (iii) abstraction — the user need not know the internal working; (iv) better memory utilisation.

pairs.ne: दुवैको परिभाषा + कम्तीमा दुई–दुई उदाहरण लेख्नुहोस्। तालिकाको रूपमा लेखे झन् राम्रो।
pairs.en: In a non-linear data structure the elements are not in a sequence; one element may connect to many, the structure has multiple levels, and it cannot be traversed in one straight run. Examples: tree, graph.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा + LIFO + प्लेटको उदाहरण + अपरेसनका नाम — चारै कुरा लेखे पूरा अंक।
pairs.en: Operations: push() to insert, pop() to remove, peek()/top() to read the top element, isEmpty() and isFull() to check the state. Pushing into a full stack causes overflow; popping from an empty stack causes underflow.

pairs.ne: चारै शब्दको एक–एक लाइन परिभाषा र एक–एक उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।
pairs.en: Entity — a real-world thing about which data is stored, e.g. Student. Attribute (field) — one property of that entity, e.g. Name, Roll, Marks. Record — a collection of related fields describing one entity, e.g. Ram | 15 | 78. File — a collection of related records, e.g. the records of all 40 students.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनेको कम्प्युटरको मेमोरीमा डाटालाई मिलाएर, राखेर र व्यवस्थापन गर्ने एउटा खास तरिका हो, ताकि त्यो डाटा छिटो र सजिलै प्रयोग र परिवर्तन गर्न सकियोस्। ध्यान दिनुहोस् — डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनेको डाटा आफैं होइन। यो डाटा कसरी मिलाइएको छ भन्ने कुरा र डाटा राख्ने–झिक्ने नियम हो।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording A data structure is a particular way of organising, storing and managing data in a computer's memory so that it can be accessed and modified efficiently. Notice what the definition does not say. A data structure is not the data itself. It is the arrangement of the data, together with the rules for putting data in and taking data out.

pairs.ne: छ वटा फाइदा Efficiency (दक्षता) — सही स्ट्रक्चरले खोज्ने र क्रम मिलाउने काम धेरै छिटो बनाउँछ। १० लाख डाटामा binary search ले करिब २० चरणमै भेट्छ; एक–एक गरी हेर्दा १० लाख चरणसम्म लाग्न सक्छ। Reusability — एक पटक लेखेको स्ट्याक धेरै प्रोग्राममा प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ। Abstraction — भित्र कसरी चल्छ थाहा नपाई पनि push() प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ। मेमोरीको राम्रो प्रयोग — linked list ले चाहिएको बेला मात्र मेमोरी लिन्छ। सजिलो मर्मत — मिलेको डाटाले कोड छोटो र स्पष्ट बनाउँछ। ठूलो डाटा — लाखौं रेकर्ड पनि व्यवस्थित रहन्छ।
pairs.en: Six advantages Efficiency — the right structure makes searching and sorting far faster. Searching a sorted array by binary search takes about 20 steps for 10,00,000 items; checking one by one takes up to 10,00,000 steps. Reusability — one structure such as a stack can be written once and used in many different programs. Abstraction — the user calls push() without knowing how it works inside. Better memory use — structures like the linked list take memory only when it is actually needed. Easy maintenance — organised data means shorter, clearer code that is easier to correct later. Handles large data — millions of records stay manageable.

pairs.ne: किन आवश्यक छ डाटा बढ्दै छ — प्रोग्रामले धेरै ठूलो डाटा सम्हाल्नुपर्छ। प्रोसेसरको गति सीमित छ — छिटो CPU ले पनि बिग्रेको मिलानलाई सुधार्न सक्दैन। खोजी छिटो हुनुपर्छ — नमिलेको १ लाख नाम एक–एक गरी खोज्न धेरै ढिलो हुन्छ। एकैचोटि धेरै प्रयोगकर्ता — डाटा छिटो पुग्नुपर्छ। मेमोरी सीमित छ — खेर नफाली राख्नुपर्छ।
pairs.en: Why they are needed Data keeps growing — programs must handle huge amounts of data. Processor speed is limited — a faster CPU cannot rescue a badly arranged pile of data. Search must be fast — searching 1,00,000 unsorted names one by one is far too slow. Many users at once — many requests must reach the data quickly. Memory is limited — data must be stored without waste.

pairs.ne: दुई मुख्य समूह Linear (रेखीय): तत्त्वहरू एउटा पछि अर्को गरी क्रमैसँग राखिन्छन्। प्रत्येकको एउटा अघिल्लो र एउटा पछिल्लो हुन्छ। एकै पटकमा सबै घुम्न सकिन्छ। Non-linear (अरेखीय): तत्त्वहरू क्रममा हुँदैनन्। एउटा तत्त्व धेरैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। सिधा एकै पटकमा सबै घुम्न सकिँदैन। केही किताबले पहिले primitive (int, float, char, pointer — भाषाले नै दिएको) र non-primitive (प्रोग्रामरले बनाएको) भनेर छुट्याउँछन्। Linear र non-linear चाहिँ non-primitive कै दुई प्रकार हुन्।
pairs.en: The two main groups Linear data structure: the elements are arranged in a sequence, one after another. Each element has exactly one element before it and one after it. The whole structure can be traversed completely in a single run. Non-linear data structure: the elements are not in a sequence. One element may be connected to many elements. It cannot be traversed in one straight run. Some books first split data structures into primitive (int, float, char, pointer — supplied by the language) and non-primitive (built by the programmer). Linear and non-linear are the two kinds of non-primitive structures.

pairs.ne: एरे एरे भनेको एउटै प्रकारका तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी मा राखिन्छ र सधैं ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। मेमोरी लगातार भएकाले र हरेक तत्त्वको साइज उही भएकाले कम्प्युटरले जुनसुकै तत्त्वको ठेगाना तुरुन्तै गणना गर्न सक्छ: ठेगाना = base + index × size। त्यसैले एरेको पहुँचलाई direct/random access भनिन्छ — a[900] मा पुग्न पनि a[0] जत्तिकै समय लाग्छ।
pairs.en: Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0].

pairs.ne: लिंक्ड लिस्ट लिंक्ड लिस्ट भनेको नोड भनिने तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो। हरेक नोडका दुई भाग हुन्छन्: डाटा, र अर्को नोडको ठेगाना राख्ने pointer। नोडहरू लगातार मेमोरीमा हुँदैनन् — जहाँसुकै हुन सक्छन्। लिस्टलाई पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडेर राख्छ। head नामक पोइन्टरले पहिलो नोड देखाउँछ, र अन्तिम नोडको पोइन्टरमा NULL हुन्छ जसले अन्त्य जनाउँछ। एक–एक नोड गरी मेमोरी लिने भएकाले लिस्ट प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा घटबढ हुन सक्छ। यसैलाई dynamic डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनिन्छ। प्रकार: singly (एउटा पोइन्टर), doubly (अघि र पछि दुवैको पोइन्टर), circular (अन्तिम नोडले पहिलो नोड देखाउने)।
pairs.en: Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first).

pairs.ne: स्ट्याक स्ट्याक त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ राख्ने र झिक्ने काम एउटै छेउ (top) बाट मात्र हुन्छ। यसले LIFO — Last In, First Out नियम मान्छ। अन्तिममा हालेको तत्त्व सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: push() हाल्ने, pop() झिक्ने, peek() नझिकी हेर्ने, isEmpty() र isFull() अवस्था जाँच्ने। Overflow = भरिएको स्ट्याकमा push। Underflow = खाली स्ट्याकबाट pop। खाली स्ट्याकमा top = -1 हुन्छ। प्रयोग: ब्राउजरको Back बटन, एडिटरको Undo, फङ्सन कलको call stack, स्ट्रिङ उल्टाउने, ब्राकेट मिलेको छ कि छैन जाँच्ने, infix लाई postfix मा बदल्ने।
pairs.en: Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix.

pairs.ne: क्यु क्यु त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ एउटा छेउ (rear) बाट राखिन्छ र अर्को छेउ (front) बाट झिकिन्छ। यसले FIFO — First In, First Out नियम मान्छ। पहिले हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: enqueue() पछाडि हाल्ने, dequeue() अगाडिबाट झिक्ने, front() पहिलो तत्त्व नझिकी हेर्ने। front > rear हुँदा क्यु खाली हुन्छ। प्रकार: simple queue, circular queue (rear घुमेर सुरुमै फर्कने), priority queue (महत्त्वपूर्ण तत्त्व पहिले निस्कने), deque (दुवै छेउबाट राख्न–झिक्न मिल्ने)। प्रयोग: प्रिन्टरको job queue, CPU scheduling, कल–सेन्टरको लाइन, डाटा बफर।
pairs.en: Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers.

pairs.ne: ट्री ट्री त्यस्तो अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जसले डाटालाई नोडहरूको तह (hierarchy) मा मिलाउँछ। माथि एउटा मात्र root हुन्छ, र अरू हरेक नोडको एउटा मात्र parent हुन्छ। ट्रीमा चक्र (cycle) हुँदैन। जान्नैपर्ने शब्दहरू: Root — सबैभन्दा माथिको नोड; parent नभएको एक मात्र नोड। Parent — तल नोड भएको नोड। Child — कुनै नोडको ठीक तलको नोड। Siblings — एउटै parent भएका नोडहरू। Leaf — सन्तान नभएको नोड। Level — root level ०, त्यसका सन्तान level १, यसरी नै। Height — root देखि सबैभन्दा तलको leaf सम्मको तह संख्या। Binary tree भनेको हरेक नोडका बढीमा दुई सन्तान हुने ट्री हो।
pairs.en: Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children.

pairs.ne: ग्राफ ग्राफ भनेको vertex (बिन्दु) हरूको समूह र तिनलाई जोड्ने edge (रेखा) हरूको समूहबाट बनेको अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो। जुनसुकै vertex जुनसुकैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। root हुँदैन, parent–child नियम हुँदैन, र चक्र (cycle) हुन सक्छ — ट्रीसँगको मुख्य फरक यही हो। Directed graph मा edge मा तीर हुन्छ (एकतर्फी)। Undirected मा दिशा हुँदैन। Weighted graph मा हरेक edge मा संख्या हुन्छ, जस्तै दुई सहरबीचको दूरी। प्रयोग: सडक नक्सा र Google Maps, सामाजिक सञ्जाल, कम्प्युटर नेटवर्क।
pairs.en: Graph A graph is a non-linear data structure made of a set of vertices (also called nodes) joined by a set of edges (lines). Any vertex may connect to any other vertex. There is no root, no parent–child rule, and cycles are allowed — this is the main difference from a tree. In a directed graph the edges have arrows (one-way). In an undirected graph the edges have no direction (two-way). A weighted graph puts a number on each edge, for example the distance between two cities. Applications: road maps and Google Maps routing, social networks, computer networks.

pairs.ne: — लिंक्ड लिस्ट
pairs.en: — एरे Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0]. एरे एरे भनेको एउटै प्रकारका तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी मा राखिन्छ र सधैं ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। मेमोरी लगातार भएकाले र हरेक तत्त्वको साइज उही भएकाले कम्प्युटरले जुनसुकै तत्त्वको ठेगाना तुरुन्तै गणना गर्न सक्छ: ठेगाना = base + index × size। त्यसैले एरेको पहुँचलाई direct/random access भनिन्छ — a[900] मा पुग्न पनि a[0] जत्तिकै समय लाग्छ। {{dia:arrayMemory}} Five integers in one continuous block. Index 0 to 4 — never 1 to 5. पाँच पूर्णांक एउटै लगातार ब्लकमा। index ० देखि ४ सम्म — १ देखि ५ होइन। Example 1 Declaring an array and printing it #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int marks[5] = {75, 82, 60, 91, 48}; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { cout << "marks[" << i << "] = " << marks[i] << endl; } return 0; } Output marks[0] = 75 marks[1] = 82 marks[2] = 60 marks[3] = 91 marks[4] = 48 The loop runs while i < 5, so i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — exactly the five valid indexes. लुप i < 5 सम्म चल्छ, त्यसैले i ले ०,१,२,३,४ मान लिन्छ — यीनै पाँच वटा मान्य index हुन्। Common mistake Writing marks[5] to reach the last element. In an array of size 5 the last index is 4. marks[5] is outside the array and gives a garbage value or crashes the program. C++ does not warn you. अन्तिम तत्त्वका लागि marks[5] लेख्नु गलत हो। साइज ५ को एरेमा अन्तिम index ४ हो। marks[5] एरे बाहिर पर्छ र फोहोर मान दिन्छ वा प्रोग्राम क्र्यास हुन्छ। C++ ले चेतावनी दिँदैन। Size 5 means last index 4. The last valid index is always size − 1. साइज ५ भए अन्तिम index ४। अन्तिम मान्य index सधैं साइज − १ हुन्छ। 1.5.1 (b) Linked List

pairs.ne: — स्ट्याक
pairs.en: — लिंक्ड लिस्ट Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first). लिंक्ड लिस्ट लिंक्ड लिस्ट भनेको नोड भनिने तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो। हरेक नोडका दुई भाग हुन्छन्: डाटा, र अर्को नोडको ठेगाना राख्ने pointer। नोडहरू लगातार मेमोरीमा हुँदैनन् — जहाँसुकै हुन सक्छन्। लिस्टलाई पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडेर राख्छ। head नामक पोइन्टरले पहिलो नोड देखाउँछ, र अन्तिम नोडको पोइन्टरमा NULL हुन्छ जसले अन्त्य जनाउँछ। एक–एक नोड गरी मेमोरी लिने भएकाले लिस्ट प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा घटबढ हुन सक्छ। यसैलाई dynamic डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनिन्छ। प्रकार: singly (एउटा पोइन्टर), doubly (अघि र पछि दुवैको पोइन्टर), circular (अन्तिम नोडले पहिलो नोड देखाउने)। {{dia:linkedList}} Three nodes at scattered addresses, held together only by pointers. छरिएका ठेगानामा रहेका तीन नोड, पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडिएका। Example 2 What one node looks like in C++ struct Node { int data; // part 1 — the value Node *next; // part 2 — address of the next node }; int main() { Node *head = new Node; // create the first node head->data = 75; head->next = NULL; // NULL means "the list ends here" return 0; } Notice Node *next; — a Node that stores the address of another Node. That single line is what makes the chain possible. Node *next; हेर्नुहोस् — एउटा Node ले अर्को Node को ठेगाना राख्छ। यही एउटा लाइनले शृंखला सम्भव बनाउँछ। Why this difference matters — array vs linked list in action {{dia:arrayVsList}} Inserting into the middle: the array must shift elements, the linked list only re-points two links. This single picture answers most array-vs-list questions. बीचमा थप्दा: एरेले तत्त्वहरू सार्नुपर्छ, लिंक्ड लिस्टले दुई लिंक मात्र फेर्छ। यही एउटा चित्रले array-vs-list का धेरै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिन्छ। 1.5.1 (c) Stack

pairs.ne: — क्यु
pairs.en: — स्ट्याक Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix. स्ट्याक स्ट्याक त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ राख्ने र झिक्ने काम एउटै छेउ (top) बाट मात्र हुन्छ। यसले LIFO — Last In, First Out नियम मान्छ। अन्तिममा हालेको तत्त्व सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: push() हाल्ने, pop() झिक्ने, peek() नझिकी हेर्ने, isEmpty() र isFull() अवस्था जाँच्ने। Overflow = भरिएको स्ट्याकमा push। Underflow = खाली स्ट्याकबाट pop। खाली स्ट्याकमा top = -1 हुन्छ। प्रयोग: ब्राउजरको Back बटन, एडिटरको Undo, फङ्सन कलको call stack, स्ट्रिङ उल्टाउने, ब्राकेट मिलेको छ कि छैन जाँच्ने, infix लाई postfix मा बदल्ने। {{dia:stackOps}} Both push and pop use the same end. Only top moves. push र pop दुवै उही छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्। top मात्र सर्छ। Analogy — a pile of plates You wash plates and stack them one on top of another. The plate you put down last sits on top, so it is the plate you pick up first. The very first plate is at the bottom and leaves last. You cannot pull a plate from the middle without lifting the ones above it. उदाहरण — थाकिएका प्लेट। धोएर एक–अर्कामाथि थुपारेका प्लेटमध्ये अन्तिममा राखेको सबैभन्दा माथि हुन्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यही उठाइन्छ। पहिलो प्लेट सबैभन्दा तल हुन्छ र अन्तिममा निस्कन्छ। 1.5.1 (d) Queue

pairs.ne: — ट्री
pairs.en: — क्यु Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers. क्यु क्यु त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ एउटा छेउ (rear) बाट राखिन्छ र अर्को छेउ (front) बाट झिकिन्छ। यसले FIFO — First In, First Out नियम मान्छ। पहिले हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: enqueue() पछाडि हाल्ने, dequeue() अगाडिबाट झिक्ने, front() पहिलो तत्त्व नझिकी हेर्ने। front > rear हुँदा क्यु खाली हुन्छ। प्रकार: simple queue, circular queue (rear घुमेर सुरुमै फर्कने), priority queue (महत्त्वपूर्ण तत्त्व पहिले निस्कने), deque (दुवै छेउबाट राख्न–झिक्न मिल्ने)। प्रयोग: प्रिन्टरको job queue, CPU scheduling, कल–सेन्टरको लाइन, डाटा बफर। {{dia:queueOps}} Two different ends: join at the rear, leave from the front. दुई फरक छेउ: पछाडिबाट लाइनमा बस्ने, अगाडिबाट निस्कने। 1.5.2 (a) Tree

pairs.ne: — ग्राफ
pairs.en: — ट्री Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children. ट्री ट्री त्यस्तो अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जसले डाटालाई नोडहरूको तह (hierarchy) मा मिलाउँछ। माथि एउटा मात्र root हुन्छ, र अरू हरेक नोडको एउटा मात्र parent हुन्छ। ट्रीमा चक्र (cycle) हुँदैन। जान्नैपर्ने शब्दहरू: Root — सबैभन्दा माथिको नोड; parent नभएको एक मात्र नोड। Parent — तल नोड भएको नोड। Child — कुनै नोडको ठीक तलको नोड। Siblings — एउटै parent भएका नोडहरू। Leaf — सन्तान नभएको नोड। Level — root level ०, त्यसका सन्तान level १, यसरी नै। Height — root देखि सबैभन्दा तलको leaf सम्मको तह संख्या। Binary tree भनेको हरेक नोडका बढीमा दुई सन्तान हुने ट्री हो। {{dia:tree}} A is the root. D, E and F are leaves. D and E are siblings. A root हो। D, E, F leaf हुन्। D र E siblings हुन्। 1.5.2 (b) Graph

pairs.en: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Stack and Queue, side by side What you will learn: which end each structure uses, and why that one difference decides the order values come out. The running code line lights up and the console explains every step in both languages. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुवैले कुन छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्, र त्यही एउटा फरकले मान निस्कने क्रम कसरी निर्धारण गर्छ। Stack — LIFO Try it push() pop() peek() Reset top = -1 (empty) Queue — FIFO Try it enqueue() dequeue() front() Reset front = 0 · rear = -1 (empty) Why did this happen? In the stack, the value pushed last came out first — only top moved. That is LIFO. In the queue, the value inserted first came out first — rear moved on insert, front moved on delete. That is FIFO. Stack मा अन्तिममा हालेको मान पहिले निस्कियो — top मात्र सर्‍यो। यही LIFO हो। Queue मा पहिले हालेको मान पहिले निस्कियो — हाल्दा rear, झिक्दा front सर्‍यो। यही FIFO हो। Exam focus — questions asked from this unit SEE exam connection
englishVariants: · अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ Common mistakes in program structure Forgetting using namespace std; — then cout is undefined and you must write std::cout. Writing cin << a; instead of cin >> a; — the arrows are the wrong way round. Missing the semicolon ; at the end of a statement. Writing Main() or MAIN() — C++ is case sensitive, it must be main(). यी चार गल्ती सबैभन्दा बढी हुन्छन्: namespace बिर्सने, cin मा तीर उल्टो लेख्ने, सेमीकोलन छुटाउने, र main लाई ठूलो अक्षरमा लेख्ने। C++ मा सानो–ठूलो अक्षरले फरक पार्छ। cin >> takes in, cout << puts out. The arrows point where the data goes. cin >> ले भित्र लिन्छ, cout << ले बाहिर पठाउँछ। तीरले डाटा जाने दिशा देखाउँछ। 2.9 Control Statements StatementWhat it doesSyntax ifRuns a block only when the condition is true.सर्त सही भएमा मात्र चल्छ।if(cond){ ... } if…elseOne block if true, another block if false.सही भए एउटा, गलत भए अर्को ब्लक।if(cond){}else{} if…else ladderChecks many conditions one by one from the top down.माथिबाट धेरै सर्त क्रमशः जाँच्छ।if(){}else if(){}else{} Nested ifAn if inside another if.एउटा if भित्र अर्को if।if(a){ if(b){} } switchChooses one case out of many by matching a value. Each case needs break.मान मिलाएर धेरैमध्ये एउटा case छान्छ।switch(x){ case 1: ... } forRepeats a block a known number of times.कति पटक दोहोरिने थाहा हुँदा।for(i=0;i<n;i++){} whileRepeats while a condition is true. The condition is checked first — entry controlled. May run zero times.सर्त पहिले जाँच्छ, त्यसैले ० पटक पनि चल्न सक्छ।while(cond){} do…whileRuns the block at least once, then checks the condition — exit controlled.कम्तीमा एक पटक चल्छ, अनि मात्र सर्त जाँच्छ।do{ }while(cond); breakExits the loop or switch immediately.तुरुन्तै लुप वा switch बाट बाहिर निस्कन्छ।break; continueSkips the rest of this round and jumps to the next round.यो चक्र छोडेर अर्को चक्रमा जान्छ।continue; Example 3 if…else ladder — printing a grade #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int marks = 78; if (marks >= 90) cout << "Grade A+"; else if (marks >= 75) cout << "Grade A"; else if (marks >= 60) cout << "Grade B"; else cout << "Grade C"; return 0; } marks is 78. Name the grade that prints, and say how many of the four tests are actually evaluated before the program stops testing. A ladder is not four separate ifs, and that is the marks difference. marks = ७८ छ। कुन grade छापिन्छ भन्नुहोस्, र प्रोग्रामले परीक्षण रोक्नुअघि चारमध्ये कति परीक्षण साँच्चै गर्छ पनि भन्नुहोस्। ladder भनेको छुट्टाछुट्टै चार वटा if होइन, र अङ्कको फरक त्यहीँ छ। Output Grade A The ladder is checked from the top. 78 fails the first test (78 >= 90 is false) but passes the second (78 >= 75 is true), so it prints Grade A and stops — the remaining conditions are never checked. माथिबाट क्रमशः जाँचिन्छ। ७८ पहिलो सर्तमा असफल भयो तर दोस्रोमा सफल भयो, त्यसैले "Grade A" छापेर रोकियो — बाँकी सर्त जाँचिँदैनन्। Example 4 while vs do…while — the difference that gets tested int i = 10; while (i < 5) { // condition is FALSE at the start cout << "while runs"; } // body runs ZERO times int j = 10; do { cout << "do-while runs"; // body runs ONCE first } while (j < 5); // then the condition fails Output do-while runs Same condition, same starting value — but while printed nothing and do…while printed once. That is the whole difference: while checks first, do…while acts first. उही सर्त, उही सुरुको मान — तर while ले केही छापेन र do…while ले एक पटक छाप्यो। फरक यही हो: while ले पहिले जाँच्छ, do…while ले पहिले काम गर्छ। Exam focus — questions asked from this unit SEE exam connection

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Does this line compile? What you will learn: to apply the access table instead of reciting it — especially inside a derived class, where private and protected stop behaving the same. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पहुँच तालिका घोक्नुभन्दा लागू गर्न — विशेष गरी derived क्लासभित्र, जहाँ private र protected फरक हुन्छन्। What to notice Cases 2 and 3 are the same code with one word changed — protected becomes private — and the answer flips. That single word is the entire difference between the two specifiers, and it only shows up inside a derived class. Case 4 is the one that catches people who learned "protected is less strict". From outside the class, protected behaves exactly like private. केस २ र ३ मा एउटै कोड छ, एउटै शब्द फरक — protected बाट private — र उत्तर उल्टिन्छ। दुई specifier बीचको पूरा फरक त्यही शब्द हो, र त्यो derived क्लासभित्र मात्र देखिन्छ। केस ४ ले "protected कम कडा हो" भन्ने भ्रम भत्काउँछ: क्लासबाहिरबाट protected ठ्याक्कै private जस्तै हुन्छ। 3.3 Declaring a Class and its Objects Example 1 A complete class with data members and member functions #include <iostream> #include <string> using namespace std; class Student { // class = blueprint private: // hidden from outside string name; // data member int roll; // data member public: // usable from outside void setData(string n, int r) { // member function name = n; roll = r; } void display() { // member function cout << name << " - " << roll << endl; } }; // <-- this semicolon is compulsory int main() { Student s1, s2; // s1 and s2 are OBJECTS s1.setData("Ram", 15); // dot operator s2.setData("Sita", 16); s1.display(); s2.display(); return 0; } Output Ram - 15 Sita - 16 Notice that s1 and s2 used the same display() function but printed different values — because each object carries its own copy of name and roll. s1 र s2 ले उही display() प्रयोग गरे तर फरक मान छापे — किनकि हरेक अब्जेक्टसँग आफ्नै name र roll छ। The single most common error in this unit Forgetting the semicolon after the closing brace of a class: }; not }. A class declaration is a statement, so it must end with a semicolon. Leaving it out produces a long, confusing list of compiler errors. क्लासको बन्द ब्रेस पछि सेमीकोलन बिर्सनु — यो युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो। }; लेख्नुपर्छ, } मात्र होइन। Defining a member function outside the class Example 2 Using the scope resolution operator :: class Student { private: string name; int roll; public: void setData(string n, int r); // only DECLARED here void display(); // only DECLARED here }; // DEFINED outside, using ClassName::functionName void Student::setData(string n, int r) { name = n; roll = r; } void Student::display() { cout << name << " - " << roll << endl; } The scope resolution operator :: tells the compiler which class the function belongs to. Without Student:: the compiler would treat display() as an ordinary global function that knows nothing about name or roll. Scope resolution operator :: ले फङ्सन कुन क्लासको हो भनेर कम्पाइलरलाई बताउँछ। Student:: नलेखे कम्पाइलरले यसलाई सामान्य global फङ्सन ठान्छ, जसलाई name र roll को केही थाहा हुँदैन। 3.5 Constructor and Destructor Constructor A constructor is a special member function that is called automatically when an object is created. Its job is to initialise the object's data. Its name is exactly the same as the class name. It has no return type — not even void. It can take parameters and can be overloaded. Three types: Default constructor — takes no arguments. Parameterized constructor — takes arguments to set the starting values. Copy constructor — creates a new object as a copy of an existing one, written Student(Student &s). कन्स्ट्रक्टर कन्स्ट्रक्टर एउटा विशेष मेम्बर फङ्सन हो, जुन अब्जेक्ट बन्ने बित्तिकै आफैं बोलिन्छ। यसको काम डाटालाई सुरुवाती मान दिनु हो। नाम क्लासकै नामसँग ठ्याक्कै मिल्नुपर्छ। return type हुँदैन — void पनि होइन। प्यारामिटर लिन सक्छ र overload पनि हुन सक्छ। तीन प्रकार: Default — कुनै आर्गुमेन्ट नलिने। Parameterized — सुरुको मान तोक्न आर्गुमेन्ट लिने। Copy — भइरहेको अब्जेक्टको प्रतिलिपि बनाउने। Destructor A destructor is a special member function that is called automatically when an object is destroyed — that is, when it goes out of scope. Its job is to free the memory the object was using. Its name is the class name with a tilde ~ in front. It has no return type and takes no parameters. It cannot be overloaded — a class has exactly one destructor. Objects are destroyed in the reverse order of their creation. डिस्ट्रक्टर डिस्ट्रक्टर एउटा विशेष मेम्बर फङ्सन हो, जुन अब्जेक्ट नष्ट हुँदा आफैं बोलिन्छ। यसको काम अब्जेक्टले लिएको मेमोरी खाली गर्नु हो। नाम अगाडि टिल्ड ~ राखेर क्लासकै नाम। return type हुँदैन र प्यारामिटर पनि लिँदैन। overload गर्न मिल्दैन — क्लासमा एउटा मात्र डिस्ट्रक्टर हुन्छ। अब्जेक्टहरू बनेको उल्टो क्रममा नष्ट हुन्छन्। {{dia:ctorDtor}} Constructors run in creation order; destructors run in the exact reverse order. कन्स्ट्रक्टर बनेको क्रममा, डिस्ट्रक्टर ठ्याक्कै उल्टो क्रममा चल्छ। Example 3 Constructor overloading — three constructors in one class #include <iostream> using namespace std; class Box { int len, wid; public: Box() { // 1. default constructor len = 1; wid = 1; cout << "Default called" << endl; } Box(int l, int w) { // 2. parameterized constructor len = l; wid = w; cout << "Parameterized called" << endl; } Box(Box &b) { // 3. copy constructor len = b.len; wid = b.wid; cout << "Copy called" << endl; } void area() { cout << "Area = " << len * wid << endl; } }; int main() { Box b1; // calls the default Box b2(4, 6); // calls the parameterized Box b3 = b2; // calls the copy constructor b1.area(); b2.area(); b3.area(); return 0; } Six lines are printed. Write all six down, in order, before opening this. The order is the answer: each constructor announces itself when it runs, so the first three lines tell you which one was chosen and when. छ वटा लाइन छापिन्छन्। खोल्नुअघि क्रम मिलाएर छैटै लेख्नुहोस्। क्रम नै उत्तर हो: हरेक constructor चल्दा आफ्नो नाम भन्छ, त्यसैले पहिलो तीन लाइनले कुन कहिले रोजियो भन्छ। Output Default called Parameterized called Copy called Area = 1 Area = 24 Area = 24 All three constructors have the same name — the compiler picks the right one by counting and checking the arguments. That is constructor overloading, and it is an example of compile-time polymorphism. तीनै कन्स्ट्रक्टरको नाम उही छ — कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट हेरेर सही एउटा छान्छ। यसैलाई constructor overloading भनिन्छ, र यो compile-time polymorphism कै उदाहरण हो। Exam favourite — the automatic call Constructors and destructors are called automatically. You never write s1.Student(); or s1.~Student(); yourself. And the destruction order is always the reverse of the creation order — like plates on a stack. दुवै आफैं बोलिन्छन् — हातले बोलाउनु पर्दैन। नष्ट हुने क्रम सधैं बनेको उल्टो हुन्छ, स्ट्याकमा थुपारेको प्लेट जस्तै। Exam focus — questions asked from this unit SEE exam connection

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Abstraction or encapsulation? Decide, then check What you will learn: to settle the pair with one question instead of two remembered definitions — which is what you will have time for in the hall. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुई घोकेका परिभाषाको सट्टा एउटै प्रश्नले यो जोडी छुट्याउन — परीक्षा हलमा त्यति नै समय हुन्छ। The one question that settles it Is complexity being hidden, or is data being protected? Complexity → abstraction. Data → encapsulation. Every case in this drill answers to that one test, and so does every version of this question the paper asks. Watch case 5 in particular. The situation barely changes — a dashboard showing speed — but the reason given changes the answer. The examiner is testing the reason, not the scenario. जटिलता लुकाइँदै छ, कि डाटा जोगाइँदै छ? जटिलता → abstraction। डाटा → encapsulation। यस अभ्यासका सबै केस यही एउटै जाँचले मिल्छन्। केस ५ विशेष हेर्नुहोस्: परिस्थिति उस्तै छ तर दिइएको कारणले उत्तर बदल्छ — परीक्षकले कारण जाँच्छन्। Exam focus — questions asked from this unit SEE exam connection

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Read the code and name it: overloading, overriding, or neither? What you will learn: to apply the table above to code you have not seen. The paper prints a class and asks which kind of polymorphism it is — and two of these six cases are neither, which is where the mark goes. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: माथिको तालिकालाई नदेखेको कोडमा लागू गर्न। परीक्षामा क्लास छापेर कुन किसिमको polymorphism हो सोधिन्छ — र यी छ केसमध्ये दुई "दुवै होइन" हुन्, अंक त्यहीँ जान्छ। How to use this Work the three checks in the order the lead gives them. One class or two? One class means it can only be overloading. Same parameters or different? Different means overloading; the same means you are looking at a redefinition. Only then look for virtual. Cases 3 and 4 are the two that are neither, and they fail for completely different reasons: case 3 compiles and quietly runs the wrong function, case 4 does not compile at all. Read both reasons — a question that shows you code without virtual is testing case 3 on purpose. लिडमा दिइएका तीन जाँच क्रमैसँग गर्नुहोस्। एक क्लास कि दुई? एउटै क्लास भए overloading मात्र हुन सक्छ। प्यारामिटर उही कि फरक? फरक भए overloading; उही भए पुनर्परिभाषा हेर्दै छ। त्यसपछि मात्र virtual खोज्नुहोस्। केस ३ र ४ दुवै होइन, तर कारण बेग्लै छ: केस ३ compile हुन्छ र चुपचाप गलत फङ्सन चलाउँछ, केस ४ compile नै हुँदैन। Advantages of polymorphism One interface, many implementations — easier to read, write and remember. Code reusability and shorter programs. Flexibility — new derived classes can be added without changing existing code. Supports dynamic binding and cleaner program design. Reduces the number of different function names a programmer must remember. पोलिमर्फिज्मका फाइदा एउटै इन्टरफेस, धेरै काम — पढ्न, लेख्न र सम्झन सजिलो। कोड पुनः प्रयोग र छोटो प्रोग्राम। लचकता — पुरानो कोड नछोई नयाँ derived क्लास थप्न सकिन्छ। Dynamic binding सम्भव बनाउँछ। फरक–फरक नाम सम्झिरहनु पर्दैन। Exam focus — questions asked from this unit SEE exam connection
