pairs.en: A constructor in C++ has:

pairs.ne: Destructor को नाम अगाडि कुन चिन्ह लेखिन्छ?
pairs.en: Which symbol is written before a destructor name?

pairs.ne: क्लास बाहिर member function परिभाषित गर्न कुन अपरेटर प्रयोग हुन्छ?
pairs.en: Which operator is used to define a member function outside its class?

pairs.ne: क्लास र अब्जेक्टबारे कुन भनाइ सही हो?
pairs.en: Which statement about a class and an object is TRUE?

pairs.ne: यो प्रोग्रामको आउटपुट के हुन्छ?
pairs.en: What is the output of this program? class A { public: A(){cout<<"A";} ~A(){cout<<"X";} }; int main(){ A a1; A a2; return 0; }

pairs.ne: यो लाइन compile हुन्छ?
pairs.en: Does this line compile?

pairs.ne: Class बाहिर member function परिभाषित गर्ने
pairs.en: Defining a member function outside the class

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पहुँच तालिका घोक्नुभन्दा लागू गर्न — विशेष गरी derived क्लासभित्र, जहाँ private र protected फरक हुन्छन्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to apply the access table instead of reciting it — especially inside a derived class, where private and protected stop behaving the same.

pairs.ne: यो encapsulation (data hiding) हो। Abstraction ले चाहिँ काम "कसरी" हुन्छ भन्ने जटिलता लुकाउँछ।
pairs.en: That is encapsulation (data hiding). Abstraction instead hides the complexity of HOW the work is done.

pairs.ne: Abstraction डिजाइन को कुरा हो — के देखाउने भन्ने निर्णय। Encapsulation कार्यान्वयन को — data लाई छुन पाउने function सँगै बेर्ने काम। गाडीको पेडल abstraction हो: इन्जिन नजानी थिच्नुहुन्छ। बन्द इन्जिन बाकस encapsulation हो। सँगै काम गर्छन् तर एउटै होइनन्, र परीक्षाले छुट्याउन भन्छ।
pairs.en: Abstraction is about DESIGN — deciding what to show. Encapsulation is about IMPLEMENTATION — wrapping the data with the functions that may touch it. A car pedal is abstraction: you press it without knowing the engine. The sealed engine casing is encapsulation. They work together but are not the same, and the exam asks you to tell them apart.

pairs.ne: Private data र public function मानक ढाँचा हो: बाहिरको कोड function हुँदै आउनुपर्छ, र त्यो function ले राख्नुअघि मान जाँच्न सक्छ। Data public बनाउँदा उद्देश्य नै सकिन्छ — जसले पनि विद्यार्थीको अंक −5 बनाइदिन सक्छ। Global variable त encapsulation को ठीक उल्टो हो।
pairs.en: Private data with public functions is the standard shape: outside code must go through a function, which can check the value before storing it. Making data public defeats the purpose entirely — anything could set a student's marks to −5. Global variables are the opposite of encapsulation.

pairs.ne: तपाईंलाई सरल इन्टरफेस दिइएको छ — cout << x — र मुनिको सबै लुकाइएको छ। यही abstraction हो: प्रयोग गर्न चाहिने मात्र देखाउनु। C++ library आफैँ यही विचारमा बनेको छ, त्यसैले पहिलो दिनै प्रोग्राम लेख्न सकिन्छ।
pairs.en: You are given a simple interface — cout << x — and everything underneath it is hidden. That is abstraction: showing only what is needed to use the thing. The C++ library is itself built on this idea, which is why you can write a program on day one.

pairs.ne: Setter एउटा ढोका हो। यसले ऋणात्मक उमेर अस्वीकार गर्न, असम्भव मान सीमित गर्न, वा परिवर्तन भएको अभिलेख राख्न सक्छ — बाहिरको कोडले सीधै variable लेख्दा यीमध्ये केही पनि सम्भव हुँदैन। गति र मेमोरी उस्तै रहन्छ, र inheritance access specifier मा भर पर्दैन।
pairs.en: The setter is a gate. It can reject a negative age, clamp an impossible one, or record that a change happened — none of which is possible when outside code writes the variable directly. Speed and memory are unchanged, and inheritance does not depend on access specifiers at all.

pairs.ne: Abstraction कि encapsulation?
pairs.en: Abstraction or encapsulation?

pairs.ne: परीक्षामा झन्डै हरेक वर्ष फरक छुट्याउन भनिने जोडी। एउटै जाँचले सबै केस मिलाउँछ: जटिलता लुकाइँदै छ, कि डाटा जोगाइँदै छ?
pairs.en: The pair the paper asks you to differentiate almost every year. One test settles every case: is complexity being hidden, or is data being protected?

pairs.ne: जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र आवश्यक अन्तरमुख मात्र देखाइएको छ। Abstraction ले "के गर्छ?" भन्छ र "कसरी" लुकाउँछ।
pairs.en: Complexity is hidden and only the necessary interface is shown. Abstraction answers "what does it do?" and hides "how".

pairs.ne: डाटा आफ्ना फङ्सनसँग बाँधिएको र सिधै पहुँचबाट जोगिएको छ। Encapsulation ले "यसलाई कसले छुन पाउँछ?" भन्छ। private शब्द यसको सङ्केत हो।
pairs.en: Data is bound with its functions and protected from direct access. Encapsulation answers "who may touch this?" The private keyword is its usual sign.

pairs.ne: क्लासले के हुनुपर्छ भन्छ, कसरी भन्दैन। Pure virtual फङ्सन abstraction को सबैभन्दा बलियो रूप हो।
pairs.en: The class states WHAT must exist without saying HOW. A pure virtual function is abstraction in its strongest form.

pairs.ne: डाटा र फङ्सनलाई एउटै इकाइमा बाँध्नु नै encapsulation को परिभाषा हो — लुकाउनुभन्दा अघि, बाँध्ने काम आफैंमा।
pairs.en: Binding data and functions into a single unit IS the definition of encapsulation — the wrapping itself, before any hiding.

pairs.ne: आवश्यक जानकारी देखाइएको, संयन्त्र लुकाइएको। बरु "गति बाहिरबाट बदल्न मिल्दैन" भनेको भए त्यो encapsulation हुन्थ्यो।
pairs.en: Necessary information shown, mechanism hidden. If instead the question said the speed value could not be changed from outside, that would be encapsulation.

pairs.ne: तपाईंलाई सजिलो र सुरक्षित बटन मात्र दिइन्छ। जटिल भाग नदेखिने पर्खाल पछाडि रहन्छ — बटन नफेरिने भएकाले भित्रको कोड जहिले पनि बदल्न सकिन्छ।
pairs.en: You get simple, safe buttons. The complicated part stays behind a wall you cannot see past — and because the buttons never change, the hidden part can be rewritten freely.

pairs.ne: private डाटा क्याप्सुल भित्र हुन्छ। भित्र पस्ने एक मात्र बाटो public फङ्सन हो, जसले गलत मान अस्वीकार गर्न सक्छ।
pairs.en: The private data sits in a capsule. The only way in is through a public function that can refuse a bad value.

pairs.ne: उदाहरण — गाडी चलाउनु। तपाईंलाई स्टेरिङ, एक्सिलेटर र ब्रेक मात्र चाहिन्छ; इन्जिन भित्र के हुन्छ थाहा पाउनु पर्दैन। भोलि कम्पनीले पूरै इन्जिन फेरे पनि तपाईंले उसैगरी चलाउनुहुन्छ — किनकि नियन्त्रण (interface) फेरिएन। प्रोग्रामिङमा पनि abstraction को साँचो फाइदा यही हो।
pairs.en: The car abstracts all of that away. If the manufacturer redesigns the entire engine next year, you still drive it the same way — because the interface (the controls) did not change. That is the real benefit of abstraction in programming too.

pairs.ne: प्रयोगकर्ताले एउटा सजिलो फङ्सन बोलाएर जवाफ पाउँछ। कसरी गणना भयो — private square()
pairs.en: square() helper — is completely hidden. That is abstraction.

pairs.ne: setter मा ऋणात्मक रकम पठाइएको छ। त्यसपछि balance कति हुन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस् — र प्रोग्राम रोकियो, गुनासो गर्‍यो, कि सामान्य रूपमा अघि बढ्यो? तीनमध्ये कुन गर्छ भन्ने नै यो उदाहरणको मुख्य कुरा हो।
pairs.en: A negative amount is passed to the setter. Decide what the balance is afterwards — and whether the program stopped, complained, or simply carried on. Which of those three it does is the point of the example.

pairs.ne: encapsulation को मुख्य उद्देश्य यही हो। balance
pairs.en: a.balance = -500; would have silently corrupted the account. The setter is a guard at the only door.

pairs.ne: Abstraction ले जटिलता ("कसरी" गर्ने) लुकाउँछ। Encapsulation ले डाटा ("के" छ) लुकाउँछ। एउटा डिजाइन को कुरा, अर्को कार्यान्वयन/सुरक्षा को कुरा।
pairs.en: private plus getters and setters.

pairs.ne: "दुवैले केही लुकाउँछन्, त्यसैले उस्तै हुन्" भन्नु गलत। माथिको Account
pairs.en: getBalance() and never needing to know what happens inside them.

pairs.ne: Compile नै हुँदैन। प्रोग्राम चल्नुअघि नै compiler ले अस्वीकार गर्छ — मुख्य कुरा यही हो। Encapsulation चेतावनी वा परम्परा होइन; private शब्दले गलत परिवर्तन लेख्नै नसकिने बनाउँछ। "Getter–setter किन चाहियो?" को उत्तर यही हो: हरेक परिवर्तन withdraw() हुँदै जान्छ, जहाँ ऋणात्मक मौज्दात एकै ठाउँमा रोक्न सकिन्छ।
pairs.en: That is the answer to "why bother with getters and setters?". Every change now goes through withdraw(), which is a single place to refuse a negative balance. Say this in an exam answer and you have shown the purpose, not just the definition.

pairs.ne: जटिलता लुकाइँदै छ, कि डाटा जोगाइँदै छ? जटिलता → abstraction। डाटा → encapsulation। यस अभ्यासका सबै केस यही एउटै जाँचले मिल्छन्। केस ५ विशेष हेर्नुहोस्: परिस्थिति उस्तै छ तर दिइएको कारणले उत्तर बदल्छ — परीक्षकले कारण जाँच्छन्।
pairs.en: Watch case 5 in particular. The situation barely changes — a dashboard showing speed — but the reason given changes the answer. The examiner is testing the reason, not the scenario.

pairs.ne: Abstraction र Encapsulation को भिन्नता परीक्षकले पटक–पटक सोध्छन्। एक वाक्यको फरक ठ्याक्कै सिक्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Abstraction versus encapsulation is the comparison examiners return to. Learn the one-line difference exactly.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा + कुनै तीन फाइदा। गाडीको उदाहरण दिए झन् राम्रो।
pairs.en: Advantages: it reduces complexity for the user; it increases security because internal details cannot be misused; and the internal code can be changed later without affecting the programs that use the class.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा + माथिको Example 3 कै प्रोग्राम लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: main() creating an object and using the two functions.

pairs.ne: तालिकाको रूपमा चार हरफ लेख्नुहोस्: के लुकाउँछ, कुन तह, कसरी हासिल हुन्छ, केमा ध्यान।
pairs.en: Abstraction hides the complexity or implementation — the "how" — and is a design-level concept achieved through abstract classes and access specifiers; it focuses on what an object does. Encapsulation hides the data — the "what" — and is an implementation-level concept achieved by making data private and providing public getters and setters; it focuses on protecting the data.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् एब्स्ट्र्याक्सन भनेको प्रयोगकर्तालाई आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाउने र भित्री काम कसरी हुन्छ भन्ने लुकाउने हो। C++ मा यो दुई तरिकाले हासिल गरिन्छ: access specifier सहितको क्लास (डाटा र सहायक फङ्सन private, काम लाग्ने फङ्सन मात्र public), र माथिल्लो तहमा abstract class मार्फत।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording Abstraction means showing only the essential features of an object to the user and hiding the internal implementation details — that is, hiding how the work is actually done. In C++ abstraction is achieved in two ways: using classes with access specifiers (data and helper functions kept private, only the useful functions made public), and at a higher level using abstract classes.

pairs.ne: एब्स्ट्र्याक्सनका फाइदा जटिलता घटाउँछ — हजारौं लाइनको सट्टा सानो, सजिलो interface मात्र देखिन्छ। सुरक्षा बढाउँछ — भित्री डाटा र सहायक फङ्सनको दुरुपयोग हुँदैन। पछि बदल्न सजिलो — लुकेको कोड बदल्दा प्रयोग गर्ने प्रोग्राम बिग्रँदैन। पुनः प्रयोग — उही क्लास धेरै प्रोग्राममा चल्छ। दोहोरो कोड हट्छ र मर्मत सजिलो हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Advantages of abstraction Reduces complexity — the user sees a small, simple interface instead of thousands of lines. Increases security — internal data and helper functions cannot be misused. Easy to change later — the hidden code can be rewritten without breaking any program that uses it. Improves reusability — the same class can be used in many programs. Avoids code duplication and makes maintenance easier.

pairs.ne: माथिल्लो तहको abstraction Pure virtual function भनेको शरीर नभएको virtual फङ्सन हो, जसमा पछाडि = 0 लेखिन्छ। यसले "हरेक सन्तान क्लासले यो फङ्सन दिनैपर्छ" भन्ने वाचा गर्छ। कम्तीमा एउटा pure virtual function भएको क्लासलाई abstract class भनिन्छ। यसको अब्जेक्ट बनाउन मिल्दैन — यो इनहेरिट गर्नकै लागि मात्र हुन्छ।
pairs.en: The higher level of abstraction A pure virtual function is a virtual function with no body, written by putting = 0 after it. It is a promise that says "every child class must provide this function". A class that contains at least one pure virtual function is called an abstract class. You cannot create an object of an abstract class — it exists only to be inherited.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् इनक्याप्सुलेसन भनेको डाटा मेम्बर र मेम्बर फङ्सनलाई एउटै एकाइ (क्लास) मा बाँध्ने र डाटालाई private बनाएर बाहिरबाट सिधै छुन नदिने हो। त्यसपछि बाहिरको कोडले डाटा बदल्न वा पढ्न public फङ्सन (setter/getter) प्रयोग गर्नै पर्छ। त्यसैले यसलाई data hiding पनि भनिन्छ।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording Encapsulation means binding data members and member functions together into a single unit (the class), and hiding the data from direct outside access by declaring it private. Outside code must then go through public functions — usually called setter and getter functions — to change or read that data. For this reason encapsulation is also called data hiding.

pairs.ne: इनक्याप्सुलेसनका फाइदा डाटा सुरक्षा — बाहिरबाट गल्तीले डाटा बदलिन सक्दैन। पूर्ण नियन्त्रण — setter ले मान राख्नु अघि जाँच्न सक्छ। पढ्ने मात्र वा लेख्ने मात्र पहुँच दिन सकिन्छ। मर्मत र परीक्षण सजिलो — भित्र बदल्दा अरू कोडमा असर पर्दैन। Data hiding हासिल हुन्छ, जुन OOP कै मुख्य लक्ष्य हो।
pairs.en: Advantages of encapsulation Data security — data cannot be changed accidentally or wrongly from outside. Full control — the setter can validate the value before storing it. Read-only or write-only access — provide only a getter, or only a setter, as needed. Easier maintenance and testing — the class can be changed inside without affecting other code. Achieves data hiding, which is one of the main goals of OOP.

pairs.ne: Encapsulation भनेको कसरी लुकाइएको। Abstraction भनेको के देखाइएको।
pairs.en: Encapsulation is how it is hidden. Abstraction is what is shown.

pairs.ne: pure virtual function भएको क्लास; यसको अब्जेक्ट बन्दैन।
pairs.en: = 0. An object of an abstract class cannot be created; it exists only to be inherited, and every derived class must provide a definition for the pure virtual function.

pairs.ne: बैंक क्लासले balance private राखेको छ र deposit() तथा withdraw() दिन्छ। कसैले account.balance = -5000; लेख्यो। के हुन्छ?
pairs.en: A bank class keeps balance private and offers deposit() and withdraw(). Someone writes account.balance = -5000;. What happens?

pairs.ne: Encapsulation भनेकै private data र public function हो, र abstraction भनेको त्यो public पक्षले देखाउने कुरा। दुवै युनिट ३ का access specifier बाट पढिन्छन्; ती नभई यी दुई शब्द साट्न मिल्ने जस्तै रहन्छन्।
pairs.en: Encapsulation IS private data with public functions, and abstraction is what the public half shows. Both are read off the access specifiers from Unit 3; without them the two words stay interchangeable.

pairs.ne: Abstraction (एब्स्ट्र्याक्सन)
pairs.en: Abstraction

pairs.ne: Inheritance (इनहेरिटेन्स)
pairs.en: Inheritance

pairs.ne: Encapsulation (इनक्याप्सुलेसन)
pairs.en: Encapsulation

pairs.ne: Polymorphism (पोलिमर्फिज्म)
pairs.en: Polymorphism

pairs.ne: Abstraction ले जटिलता लुकाएर चाहिने मात्र देखाउँछ; encapsulation ले data लाई यसका function सँग बाँधेर सुरक्षित राख्छ
pairs.en: Abstraction hides complexity and shows only what is needed; encapsulation binds data with its functions and keeps it protected

pairs.ne: Abstraction class मा मात्र लाग्छ; encapsulation function मा मात्र
pairs.en: Abstraction applies only to classes; encapsulation applies only to functions

pairs.ne: दुवै एउटै कुराका दुई नाम हुन्
pairs.en: They are two names for the same thing

pairs.ne: Encapsulation compile बेला हुन्छ; abstraction चल्ने बेला
pairs.en: Encapsulation happens at compile time; abstraction at run time

pairs.ne: private, र तिनलाई प्रयोग गर्न public member function
pairs.en: private, with public member functions to use them

pairs.ne: public, ताकि प्रोग्रामको जुनसुकै भागले बदल्न सकोस्
pairs.en: public, so any part of the program can change them

pairs.ne: class बाहिर global variable का रूपमा
pairs.en: as global variables outside the class

pairs.ne: main function भित्र
pairs.en: inside the main function

pairs.ne: राख्नुअघि मान जाँच्न सकिन्छ
pairs.en: The value can be checked before it is stored

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम छिटो चल्छ
pairs.en: The program runs faster

pairs.ne: Class लाई कम मेमोरी चाहिन्छ
pairs.en: The class needs less memory

pairs.ne: Inheritance सम्भव हुन्छ
pairs.en: Inheritance becomes possible

pairs.ne: डाटा मेम्बर र मेम्बर फङ्सनलाई एउटै एकाइमा बाँधेर बाहिरबाट डाटा लुकाउने कामलाई के भनिन्छ?
pairs.en: Binding data members and member functions together in one unit and hiding the data from outside is called:

pairs.ne: Abstraction र encapsulation लाई सबैभन्दा राम्ररी छुट्याउने कथन कुन हो?
pairs.en: Which statement best separates abstraction from encapsulation?

pairs.ne: C++ मा encapsulation ल्याउन data member प्रायः कसरी घोषणा गरिन्छ?
pairs.en: To achieve encapsulation in C++, data members are usually declared:

pairs.ne: अक्षर स्क्रिनसम्म कसरी पुग्छ नजानी cout प्रयोग गर्नु कसको दैनिक उदाहरण हो?
pairs.en: Using cout without knowing how characters reach the screen is an everyday example of:

pairs.ne: कुनै class ले age लाई private राख्छ र setAge(int) दिन्छ। Public age ले नदिने कुन कुरा यसले सम्भव बनाउँछ?
pairs.en: A class stores age privately and provides setAge(int). What does this arrangement make possible that a public age does not?

pairs.ne: Abstraction र Encapsulation
pairs.en: Abstraction and Encapsulation

pairs.ne: Abstract class र pure virtual function
pairs.en: Abstract class and pure virtual function

pairs.ne: विद्यार्थीले सधैं गल्ती गर्ने फरक
pairs.en: The difference students always get wrong

pairs.ne: Abstraction कि encapsulation? निर्णय गरेर जाँच्नुहोस्
pairs.en: Abstraction or encapsulation? Decide, then check

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुई घोकेका परिभाषाको सट्टा एउटै प्रश्नले यो जोडी छुट्याउन — परीक्षा हलमा त्यति नै समय हुन्छ।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to settle the pair with one question instead of two remembered definitions — which is what you will have time for in the hall.

pairs.ne: Base क्लासको कन्स्ट्रक्टर सधैं derived भन्दा पहिले चल्छ, सबैभन्दा माथिबाट सुरु हुँदै। क्रम: Animal → Dog → Puppy।
pairs.en: Base class constructors always run before derived ones, starting from the top-most base. So the order is Animal, then Dog, then Puppy.

pairs.ne: Hierarchical inheritance भनेको एउटा बाबु, धेरै छोरा — चित्र तलतिर फैलिन्छ। Multiple यसको उल्टो हो: एउटा छोरा, धेरै बाबु। Multilevel शृंखला हो, A देखि B देखि C। चित्रको आकार पढ्नु यस्ता प्रश्नको सबैभन्दा छिटो उत्तर हो।
pairs.en: Hierarchical inheritance is one parent with many children — the picture branches downward. Multiple inheritance is the reverse: one child with many parents. Multilevel is a chain, A to B to C. Reading the SHAPE of the diagram is the fastest way to answer this kind of question.

pairs.ne: Derived class ले private member पाउँछ — ती object मा हुन्छन् र ठाउँ ओगट्छन् — तर नाम लिएर छुन सक्दैन। Base कै public वा protected function हुँदै जानुपर्छ। protected हुनुको कारण ठ्याक्कै यही हो: "बाहिरका लागि private, मेरा छोराछोरीका लागि देखिने"।
pairs.en: A derived class inherits the private members — they exist in the object and take up space — but it cannot name them. It must go through a public or protected function of the base. This is exactly why protected exists: it means "private to the outside world, visible to my children".

pairs.ne: C++ मा कोलन, अनि access specifier, अनि base class को नाम लेखिन्छ। extends Java को हो र inherits C++ को keyword नै होइन। चौथो विकल्पको वाक्य-संरचना ठीक छ तर दिशा उल्टो — यसले Person लाई Student बाट inherit गराउँछ, जुन उल्टो हो।
pairs.en: C++ uses a colon, then the access specifier, then the base class name. extends is Java and inherits is not a C++ keyword at all. Option 4 has the syntax right but the direction backwards — it would make Person inherit from Student, which is the wrong way round.

pairs.ne: पुनः प्रयोग नै मुख्य कुरा हो: साझा व्यवहार एउटै परीक्षित ठाउँमा रहन्छ र हरेक छोराले पाउँछ। यसले विस्तार पनि सजिलो बनाउँछ — नयाँ derived class लाई फरक भएको कुरा मात्र चाहिन्छ। Inheritance ले पहुँचका नियम बदल्दैन, र derived object सामान्यतया ठूलो हुन्छ, सानो होइन — किनकि base को भाग पनि बोक्छ।
pairs.en: Reusability is the point: common behaviour lives in one tested place and every child gets it. That also makes a program easier to extend — a new derived class needs only what is different. Inheritance does not change access rules, and a derived object is normally LARGER, not smaller, since it carries the base part too.

pairs.ne: यो हीरा आकारले hierarchical र multiple inheritance मिसाउँछ, त्यसैले hybrid हो। D ले A लाई B हुँदै र फेरि C हुँदै पाउँछ, त्यसैले A का member दुई पटक आउँछन् र कुनै एउटालाई बोलाउँदा अन्योल हुन्छ। C++ ले virtual base class ले समाधान गर्छ, जसले compiler लाई A को एउटै प्रति राख्न लगाउँछ।
pairs.en: This diamond shape mixes hierarchical and multiple inheritance, so it is hybrid. D inherits A through B and again through C, so A's members arrive twice and a reference to one becomes ambiguous. C++ solves it with a virtual base class, which makes the compiler keep only one copy of A.

pairs.ne: private को अर्थ "यही class मात्र" हो, र inheritance ले यो खुकुलो बनाउँदैन — x B मा सर्छ तर B ले छुन पाउँदैन। यस्तै अवस्थाका लागि बनेको specifier protected हो: derived class ले देख्छ, बाहिरी संसारले देख्दैन। Inheritance mode (यहाँ public) ले base का public र protected मेम्बरको हैसियत बदल्छ; private मेम्बरमा पहुँच कहिल्यै दिँदैन।
pairs.en: private means "this class only", and inheriting does not loosen it — x is inherited by B but B is not allowed to touch it. protected is the specifier that exists for exactly this situation: visible to derived classes, still hidden from the outside world. Note that the inheritance mode (public here) changes what happens to the base's public and protected members; it never grants access to its private ones.

pairs.ne: derived अब्जेक्ट बन्दा पहिले base को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्छ, अनि derived को। डिस्ट्रक्टर ठ्याक्कै उल्टो — पहिले derived, अनि base।
pairs.en: The rule in one line When a derived object is created, the base class constructor runs FIRST, then the derived constructor. Destructors run in the exact reverse: derived destructor first, then base destructor.

pairs.ne: एउटा Puppy अब्जेक्ट बन्न लागेको छ। Next थिच्नुहोस् र क्रम हेर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: One Puppy object is about to be created. Press Next and watch the ORDER.

pairs.ne: पहिले Animal() चल्छ — सबैभन्दा माथिको base क्लास सधैं पहिले बन्छ।
pairs.en: Animal() runs first — the top-most base class is always constructed first.

pairs.ne: आफ्नो base तयार भएपछि दोस्रोमा Dog() चल्छ।
pairs.en: Dog() runs second, once its own base is ready.

pairs.ne: अन्तिममा Puppy() चल्छ। अब अब्जेक्ट पूरै तयार भयो।
pairs.en: Puppy() runs last. The object is now completely built.

pairs.ne: अब नष्ट हुँदैछ। पहिले ~Puppy() चल्छ — सबैभन्दा तलको derived क्लास पहिले जान्छ।
pairs.en: Now it is destroyed. ~Puppy() runs FIRST — the most derived class goes first.

pairs.ne: दोस्रोमा ~Dog() चल्छ।
pairs.en: ~Dog() runs second.

pairs.ne: अन्तिममा ~Animal() चल्छ। नष्ट हुने क्रम बन्ने क्रमको ठ्याक्कै उल्टो हो — परीक्षाको उत्तर यही हो।
pairs.en: ~Animal() runs last. Destruction is the exact reverse of construction — this is the exam answer.

pairs.ne: यो कुन प्रकारको inheritance हो?
pairs.en: Which type of inheritance?

pairs.ne: क्लास गन्नुहोस् र तीर गन्नुहोस्। एउटा base का धेरै छोरा र एउटा छोराका धेरै बाबु फरक कुरा हुन्, र multilevel भनेको multiple होइन।
pairs.en: Count the classes and count the arrows. One base with many children is not the same as one child with many parents, and multilevel is not multiple.

pairs.ne: एउटा शृंखला: C, B बाट र B, A बाट आउँछ। हरेक क्लासको एउटै बाबु छ, तर शृंखलामा एकभन्दा बढी तह छन्। विद्यार्थीले यसलाई "multiple" भन्छन् — होइन, किनभने कुनै क्लासका दुई बाबु छैनन्।
pairs.en: A chain: C derives from B, and B derives from A. Each class has ONE parent, but the chain has more than one level. Students call this "multiple" — it is not, because no class here has two parents.

pairs.ne: एउटै क्लासका दुई base क्लास। एउटै क्लासका एकभन्दा बढी बाबु हुने प्रकार यही मात्र हो, र C++ ले दिने तर Java ले नदिने पनि यही हो।
pairs.en: ONE class with TWO base classes. This is the only type where a single class has more than one parent, and it is the one C++ allows while Java does not.

pairs.ne: एउटै base बाट धेरै derived क्लास — हाँगा एउटै बाबुबाट तल जान्छन्। Multiple सँग तुलना गर्नुहोस्, जहाँ तीर माथितिर एउटै छोरामा मिल्छन्।
pairs.en: ONE base with MANY derived classes — the branches go downwards from a single parent. Compare with multiple, where the arrows converge upwards into one child.

pairs.ne: एउटा base, एउटा derived, एउटा तीर। बाँकी सबै प्रकार यसैबाट बन्छन्, त्यसैले छिटो नाम दिन सक्नु काम लाग्छ।
pairs.en: One base, one derived, one arrow. Every other type is built from this one, which is why it is worth being able to name it quickly.

pairs.ne: पहिले सबैभन्दा फराकिलो आकार हेर्नुहोस्। A का दुई छोरा (B र C) छन्, त्यसैले चित्र hierarchical हो; B मुनिको D ले तह थप्छ तर पूरै चित्रको नाम बदल्दैन। एउटै नाम मागिएमा प्रमुख आकार भन्नुहोस् — प्रश्नले दिए hybrid पनि भन्न सकिन्छ।
pairs.en: Read the widest shape first. A has two children (B and C), which makes the diagram hierarchical; D hanging under B adds a level but does not change what the whole picture is called. A paper asking for ONE name wants the dominant shape — and a hybrid is what you call it if the question allows.

pairs.ne: दुई तीर पुग्छन्, एउटा पुग्दैन। Derived क्लासले public र protected मेम्बर पुनः प्रयोग गर्छ; private मेम्बर हरेक अब्जेक्टभित्र हुन्छ तर छोराले छुन पाउँदैन।
pairs.en: The two arrows that get through and the one that does not. A derived class reuses public and protected members; a private member still exists inside every object but the child cannot reach it.

pairs.ne: कहिल्यै नफेरिने नियम: private मेम्बर कुनै पनि मोडमा इनहेरिट हुँदैन।
pairs.en: The one rule that never changes: private members are never inherited, in any mode.

pairs.ne: पाँचै प्रकार, र hybrid inheritance ले ल्याउन सक्ने diamond problem।
pairs.en: All five types, plus the diamond problem that hybrid inheritance can create.

pairs.ne: एउटा अब्जेक्ट, तीन कन्स्ट्रक्टर। बन्दा base पहिले, नष्ट हुँदा derived पहिले।
pairs.en: One object, three constructors. Base first going down, derived first coming back up.

pairs.ne: उदाहरण — परिवार। छोराले बाबुबाट आँखाको रङ, थर र रगतको समूह पाउँछ, र आफ्नै छुट्टै गुण पनि राख्छ। तर सबै कुरा पाउँदैन — बाबुको private मेम्बर व्यक्तिगत डायरी जस्तै हो: छ त, तर छोराले सिधै खोल्न पाउँदैन।
pairs.en: private behaves in inheritance.

pairs.ne: अब्जेक्ट d
pairs.en: Derived. That is inheritance doing its job.

pairs.ne: कुनै पनि मोडमा derived क्लासले base को private मेम्बर सिधै प्रयोग गर्न पाउँदैन।
pairs.en: Never inherited / not accessible in the derived class, in any mode.

pairs.ne: base को private
pairs.en: private.

pairs.ne: एउटा base बाट एउटा derived क्लास।
pairs.en: One base class → one derived class. The simplest form.

pairs.ne: शृंखला — derived क्लास आफैं अर्कोको base बन्छ।
pairs.en: A chain — a derived class itself becomes the base of another class. Grandparent → parent → child.

pairs.ne: दुई वा बढी base बाट एउटा derived क्लास।
pairs.en: Two or more base classes → one derived class. The bases are separated by commas.

pairs.ne: एउटा base बाट धेरै derived क्लास।
pairs.en: One base class → many derived classes. Several children share one parent.

pairs.ne: माथिका दुई वा बढी प्रकारको मिश्रण।
pairs.en: A combination of two or more of the above types — for example hierarchical plus multiple. This can create the diamond problem.

pairs.ne: एउटा child, दुई parent। खोल्नुअघि कुन लाइन कुन class बाट आउँछ निर्णय गर्नुहोस् — र छापिने क्रम base inherit गरेको क्रम हो कि call लेखिएको क्रम हो?
pairs.en: One child, two parents. Decide which line comes from which class before opening this — and whether the printing order is the order the bases were inherited in, or the order the calls were written in.

pairs.ne: दुई गणनाले प्रायः सबै केस मिलाउँछन्। कुनै एउटा क्लासका कति बाबु छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → multiple। एउटा base का कति छोरा छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → hierarchical। हरेकको एउटै बाबु तर धेरै तह भएको शृंखला → multilevel। केस ५ मा जानाजान दुई आकार मिसिएका छन्।
pairs.en: Case 5 mixes two shapes on purpose, because a real question sometimes does. Read the reason for how to answer when a diagram is not purely one type.

pairs.ne: शीर्षकमा गरिएको वाचा यही हो — त्यसैले पूरा गर्नुहोस्। एउटै object, चार लाइन output। खोल्नुअघि चारै लाइन क्रम मिलाएर लेख्नुहोस्। destructor को क्रम constructor को क्रम होइन, र परीक्षाको प्रश्न त्यही हो।
pairs.en: This is the promise in the title — so keep it. One object, four lines of output. Write all four down in order before opening this. The destructor order is not the constructor order, and that is the exam question.

pairs.ne: एउटै अब्जेक्टबाट चार लाइन। base पहिले बन्छ (भुइँतला नबनाई पहिलो तला बन्दैन) र अन्तिममा भत्किन्छ।
pairs.en: Four lines from one object. The base is built first (you cannot build the first floor before the ground floor) and destroyed last.

pairs.ne: Inheritance का प्रकार र constructor चल्ने क्रममा अंक छन् — क्रमको प्रश्न धेरै पटक आउँछ।
pairs.en: Types of inheritance and constructor call order carry the marks here — the order question appears very often.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा + base/derived + syntax — तीनै लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: class Dog : public Animal { };

pairs.ne: पाँचै चित्र कोर्नुहोस् र एक–एक लाइन व्याख्या दिनुहोस्। चित्र बिना पूरा अंक आउँदैन।
pairs.en: Single — one base, one derived (A → B). Multilevel — a chain where a derived class becomes a base (A → B → C). Multiple — two or more bases, one derived (A and B → C). Hierarchical — one base, many derived (A → B and A → C). Hybrid — a combination of two or more of the above; may cause the diamond problem, solved with a virtual base class.

pairs.ne: समस्या + virtual
pairs.en: class B : virtual public A { }; — then only one shared copy of A exists.

pairs.ne: constructor र destructor कुन क्रममा चल्छन् भन्ने पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्
pairs.en: Work out the order constructors and destructors run in

pairs.ne: निर्माण BASE बाट सुरु भई सबैभन्दा derived कक्षासम्म जान्छ। विनाश ठ्याक्कै उल्टो: सबैभन्दा derived कक्षा पहिले नष्ट हुन्छ। multiple inheritance मा base हरू colon पछि जुन क्रममा लेखिएका छन् त्यही क्रममा चल्छन्।
pairs.en: Construction goes BASE FIRST, down to the most derived class. Destruction is the exact reverse: the most derived class is destroyed first. For multiple inheritance, bases run in the order they are LISTED after the colon.

pairs.ne: class Animal { }; class Dog : public Animal { }; तपाईं लेख्नुहुन्छ: Dog d; — कुन constructor पहिले चल्छ?
pairs.en: class Animal { }; class Dog : public Animal { }; You write: Dog d; — which constructor runs first?

pairs.ne: कुन constructor पहिले चल्छ?
pairs.en: Which constructor runs first?

pairs.ne: base पहिले बन्छ। derived वस्तु त्यतिन्जेल हुनै सक्दैन जब सम्म आफूले पाएको भाग बनेको हुँदैन।
pairs.en: The base is built first. A derived object cannot exist until the part it inherits already does.

pairs.ne: कुन constructor दोस्रोमा चल्छ?
pairs.en: Which constructor runs second?

pairs.ne: Dog सबैभन्दा derived हो, त्यसैले अन्तिममा — तयार भइसकेको Animal माथि बन्छ।
pairs.en: Dog is the most derived class, so it is built last — on top of a finished Animal.

pairs.ne: d को scope सकिँदा कुन destructor पहिले चल्छ?
pairs.en: When d goes out of scope, which destructor runs FIRST?

pairs.ne: विनाश निर्माणको ठ्याक्कै उल्टो हो, त्यसैले सबैभन्दा derived पहिले जान्छ।
pairs.en: Destruction is the exact reverse of construction, so the most derived class goes first.

pairs.ne: पूरा क्रम लेख्नुहोस्, खाली ठाउँले छुट्याएर
pairs.en: Write the whole order, separated by spaces

pairs.ne: बनाउन तल, नष्ट गर्न माथि। यही एउटा वाक्यले यस्तै आकारका सबै प्रश्नको उत्तर दिन्छ।
pairs.en: Down the chain to build, back up the chain to destroy. That one sentence answers every question of this shape.

pairs.ne: class A { }; class B : public A { }; class C : public B { }; तपाईं लेख्नुहुन्छ: C obj; — multilevel inheritance। निर्माणको क्रम दिनुहोस्।
pairs.en: class A { }; class B : public A { }; class C : public B { }; You write: C obj; — multilevel inheritance. Give the construction order.

pairs.ne: पहिलो constructor
pairs.en: First constructor

pairs.ne: A शृङ्खलाको सबैभन्दा माथि छ, त्यसैले पहिले बन्छ — तपाईंले घोषणा गरेको वस्तु C भए पनि।
pairs.en: A is at the top of the chain, so it is built first — even though the object you declared is a C.

pairs.ne: दोस्रो constructor
pairs.en: Second constructor

pairs.ne: B, A र C को बीचमा छ, त्यसैले A सकिएपछि बन्छ।
pairs.en: B sits between A and C, so it is built once A is finished.

pairs.ne: तेस्रो constructor
pairs.en: Third constructor

pairs.ne: C सबैभन्दा derived हो, त्यसैले अन्तिममा बन्छ।
pairs.en: C is the most derived, so it is built last.

pairs.ne: पहिलो destructor
pairs.en: First destructor

pairs.ne: निर्माणको उल्टो: अन्तिममा बनेको पहिले नष्ट हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Reverse of construction: the last one built is the first one destroyed.

pairs.ne: पूरा क्रम
pairs.en: The whole order
englishVariants: Full order

pairs.ne: multilevel ले नियम बदल्दैन — शृङ्खला मात्र लामो बनाउँछ। तल जाँदा A B C, फर्किँदा ~C ~B ~A।
pairs.en: Multilevel changes nothing about the rule — it just makes the chain longer. A B C going down, ~C ~B ~A coming back.

pairs.ne: class Father { }; class Mother { }; class Child : public Father, public Mother { }; तपाईं लेख्नुहुन्छ: Child c; — multiple inheritance। निर्माणको क्रम दिनुहोस्।
pairs.en: class Father { }; class Mother { }; class Child : public Father, public Mother { }; You write: Child c; — multiple inheritance. Give the construction order.

pairs.ne: पहिलो
pairs.en: First

pairs.ne: दुई base हुँदा colon पछि पहिले लेखिएको पहिले बन्छ। Father, Mother भन्दा अगाडि लेखिएको छ।
pairs.en: With two bases, the one written FIRST after the colon is constructed first. Father is listed before Mother.

pairs.ne: दोस्रो
pairs.en: Second

pairs.ne: सूचीमा दोस्रो, बन्नमा पनि दोस्रो। यो वर्णक्रमसँग सम्बन्धित छैन — सूची बदल्नुहोस्, क्रम बदलिन्छ।
pairs.en: Second in the list, second to be constructed. Note this has nothing to do with alphabetical order — swap the list and the order swaps.

pairs.ne: तेस्रो
pairs.en: Third

pairs.ne: दुवै base तयार भए, त्यसैले derived कक्षा तीमाथि बन्छ।
pairs.en: Both bases are ready, so the derived class is built on top of them.

pairs.ne: फेरि उल्टो। derived पहिले, अनि Mother, अनि Father।
pairs.en: Reverse again. The derived class goes first, then Mother, then Father.

pairs.ne: base हरूको क्रम class header बाट आउँछ, अरू कतैबाट होइन। यही एउटै तथ्य यो प्रश्नले जाँच्छ।
pairs.en: The order of the bases comes from the class header, not from anything else. That is the single fact this question is testing.

pairs.ne: class X { }; class Y { }; class Z : public Y, public X { }; तपाईं लेख्नुहुन्छ: Z z; — निर्माण र विनाशको पूरा क्रम लेख्नुहोस्, खाली ठाउँले छुट्याएर, destructor लाई ~ राखेर।
pairs.en: class X { }; class Y { }; class Z : public Y, public X { }; You write: Z z; — write the full construction and destruction order, separated by spaces, using ~ for destructors.

pairs.ne: header मा "public Y, public X" लेखिएकाले Y, X भन्दा पहिले आउँछ — नाम जानीजानी वर्णक्रम बाहिर राखिएका छन्, यही समात्न। X Y Z भन्नुभयो भने header पढ्नुको सट्टा नाम क्रमबद्ध गर्नुभयो।
pairs.en: Y comes before X because the header says "public Y, public X" — the names are deliberately out of alphabetical order to catch exactly that. If you answered X Y Z, you sorted the names instead of reading the header.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् इनहेरिटेन्स भनेको एउटा क्लासले अर्को क्लासका गुण र मेम्बर फङ्सन प्राप्त गर्ने प्रक्रिया हो। गुण दिने क्लास base class (बाबु/parent) हो। गुण पाउने क्लास derived class (छोरा/child) हो। मुख्य उद्देश्य कोडको पुनः प्रयोग हो — साझा कोड एक पटक base मा लेख्ने र सबै derived क्लासमा चलाउने। इनहेरिटेन्सले "IS-A" सम्बन्ध जनाउँछ: Dog एक प्रकारको Animal हो, Circle एक प्रकारको Shape हो।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording Inheritance is the process by which one class acquires (gets) the properties and member functions of another class. The class that gives its features is the base class (also called parent or super class). The class that receives them is the derived class (also called child or sub class). The main purpose is reusability of code — common code is written once in the base class and reused by every derived class. Inheritance represents an "IS-A" relationship: a Dog IS-A Animal, a Circle IS-A Shape. If you cannot say "IS-A", inheritance is probably the wrong tool.

pairs.ne: इनहेरिटेन्सका फाइदा पुनः प्रयोग — साझा कोड एक पटक लेखेर सबै सन्तान क्लासमा चलाइन्छ। समय र कोड बचत — दोहोरो लेख्नु पर्दैन। सजिलो विस्तार — परीक्षण भइसकेको base नछोई derived मा नयाँ सुविधा थपिन्छ। Polymorphism सम्भव बनाउँछ — inheritance बिना overriding हुँदैन। राम्रो संरचना — बाबु–छोराको सम्बन्धले वास्तविक संसार प्रस्ट देखाउँछ। सजिलो मर्मत — base मा गल्ती सुधार्दा सबै derived क्लासमा एकैचोटि सुधार हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Advantages of inheritance Reusability — common code is written once and reused by every child class. Saves time and reduces code size — no duplication. Easy to extend — new features go in a derived class without touching the tested base class. Supports polymorphism — function overriding is impossible without inheritance. Better structure — the parent–child relationship models the real world clearly. Easier maintenance — fixing a bug in the base class fixes it for every derived class at once.

pairs.ne: समस्या Hybrid inheritance मा मानौं B र C दुवैले A बाट इनहेरिट गर्छन्, र D ले B र C दुवैबाट। तब D ले A का सबै कुराको दुई प्रति पाउँछ — एउटा B बाट, अर्को C बाट। d.show() लेख्दा कम्पाइलरले कुन प्रति चलाउने भन्ने निर्णय गर्न सक्दैन र ambiguity error देखाउँछ। चित्र हीरा जस्तो देखिने भएकाले यसलाई diamond problem भनिन्छ।
pairs.en: The problem In hybrid inheritance, suppose B and C both inherit from A, and D inherits from both B and C. D then receives two copies of everything in A — one through B and one through C. When you write d.show() the compiler cannot decide which copy to use, and reports an ambiguity error. Because the diagram is diamond-shaped, this is called the diamond problem.

pairs.ne: private सर्छ तर छुन मिल्दैन। सन्तानले छुनुपर्ने भए protected राख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: private is inherited but not reachable. Use protected if the child must touch it.

pairs.ne: नियम लगाउनुहोस्: बन्दा माथिबाट तल, नष्ट हुँदा तलबाट माथि।
pairs.en: For a three-level chain (Animal → Dog → Puppy) it is: Animal, Dog, Puppy going in and ~Puppy, ~Dog, ~Animal coming out.

pairs.ne: Multilevel। यो शृंखला हो: C, B बाट र B, A बाट। यहाँ हरेक क्लासको एउटै बाबु छ — शृंखलामा तह मात्र धेरै छन्। Multiple भनेको एउटै क्लासका दुई बाबु हुनु हो। तह होइन, बाबु गन्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Multilevel. It is a chain: C from B, B from A. Every class here has exactly one parent — the chain simply has more than one level. Multiple means one class with two parents (class C : public A, public B), which is a different picture entirely. Count parents, not levels.

pairs.ne: class B : public A, र class C : public B। यसलाई के भनिन्छ?
pairs.en: class B : public A, and class C : public B. What is this called?

pairs.ne: Inheritance भनेको derived कक्षाले कुन member छुन पाउँछ भन्ने हो, त्यसैले उत्तर सधैं युनिट ३ कै access specifier हुन्छ। Constructor–destructor क्रमले पनि constructor के गर्छ भन्ने थाहा भएको मान्छ।
pairs.en: Inheritance is about which members a derived class can reach, so the answer is always an access specifier from Unit 3. Constructor and destructor order also assumes you know what a constructor does at all.

pairs.ne: Puppy को constructor
pairs.en: Puppy constructor

pairs.ne: Dog को constructor
pairs.en: Dog constructor

pairs.ne: Animal को constructor
pairs.en: Animal constructor

pairs.ne: तीनै एकैचोटि चल्छन्
pairs.en: All three run at the same time

pairs.ne: सबै member छुन मिल्छ
pairs.en: All members are accessible

pairs.ne: Base class मा एक पटक लेखेको कोड हरेक derived class ले पुनः प्रयोग गर्छ
pairs.en: Code written once in the base class is reused by every derived class

pairs.ne: प्रोग्राम छिटो compile हुन्छ
pairs.en: Programs compile faster

pairs.ne: Private member public हुन्छन्
pairs.en: Private members become public

pairs.ne: Object ले कम मेमोरी खान्छ
pairs.en: Objects use less memory

pairs.ne: Multilevel inheritance; यसले compile ढिलो बनाउँछ
pairs.en: Multilevel inheritance; it causes slow compilation

pairs.ne: Hybrid inheritance; D ले A का member को दुई प्रति पाउन सक्छ
pairs.en: Hybrid inheritance; D may receive two copies of A's members

pairs.ne: Single inheritance; कुनै समस्या हुँदैन
pairs.en: Single inheritance; it causes no problem

pairs.ne: Hierarchical inheritance; यसले object बन्नै दिँदैन
pairs.en: Hierarchical inheritance; it prevents objects being created

pairs.ne: Base को private मेम्बर derived class ले छुन पाउँदैन — त्यो protected हुनुपर्छ
pairs.en: A private base member is not accessible to a derived class — it would have to be protected

pairs.ne: public inheritance ले x लाई public बनाउँछ, त्यसैले छाप्न मिल्दैन
pairs.en: public inheritance makes x public, so it cannot be printed

pairs.ne: प्रयोग गर्नुअघि x लाई मान दिनुपर्छ
pairs.en: x must be given a value before it can be used

pairs.ne: B ले प्रयोग गर्नुअघि आफ्नै x घोषणा गर्नुपर्छ
pairs.en: B must declare its own x before using it

pairs.ne: Multilevel inheritance Animal → Dog → Puppy मा Puppy अब्जेक्ट बन्दा कुन constructor सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्छ?
pairs.en: In multilevel inheritance Animal → Dog → Puppy, when a Puppy object is created, which constructor runs FIRST?

pairs.ne: एउटै base class का तीन छुट्टाछुट्टै derived class छन्। यो कुन किसिमको inheritance हो?
pairs.en: One base class has three separate derived classes. Which type of inheritance is this?

pairs.ne: Base class का कुन member लाई derived class ले सीधै छुन सक्दैन?
pairs.en: Which members of a base class can a derived class NOT access directly?

pairs.ne: Person बाट Student लाई public रूपमा derive गर्ने सही लाइन कुन हो?
pairs.en: Which line correctly derives Student publicly from Person?

pairs.ne: Inheritance को मुख्य फाइदा के हो?
pairs.en: What is the chief advantage of inheritance?

pairs.ne: Class B र C दुवैले A बाट inherit गर्छन्, र class D ले B र C दुवैबाट। यो संयोजनलाई के भनिन्छ, र यसले कुन समस्या ल्याउन सक्छ?
pairs.en: Class B and class C each inherit from A, and class D inherits from both B and C. What is this combination called, and what problem can it cause?

pairs.ne: चिन्ह लगाइएको हरफ किन compile हुँदैन? class A { private: int x; }; class B : public A { public: void show() { cout << x; } // यही हरफ };
pairs.en: Why does the marked line fail to compile? class A { private: int x; }; class B : public A { public: void show() { cout << x; } // this line };

pairs.ne: Derived class ले साँच्चै के पाउँछ
pairs.en: What the derived class actually receives

pairs.ne: Diamond problem र virtual base class
pairs.en: The diamond problem and virtual base class

pairs.ne: कोड हेरेर inheritance को प्रकार भन्नुहोस्
pairs.en: Name the type of inheritance from the code

pairs.ne: Constructor र destructor को क्रम — धेरै सोधिन्छ
pairs.en: Constructor and destructor order — asked very often

pairs.ne: इनहेरिटेन्स — गुण सर्ने प्रक्रिया
pairs.en: Inheritance

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पाँच प्रकार छिटो छुट्याउन — परीक्षामा कोड वा चित्र दिएर नाम सोधिन्छ, र अंक multilevel र multiple बीचमै गुम्छ।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to tell the five types apart quickly — the paper gives you code or a diagram and asks for the name, and multilevel versus multiple is where the mark is lost.

pairs.ne: Overloading मा कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट हेरेर प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै सही फङ्सन छान्छ, त्यसैले यो compile-time polymorphism हो।
pairs.en: In overloading the compiler picks the correct function from the arguments before the program runs, so it is compile-time (static) polymorphism.

pairs.ne: Overriding मा derived क्लासले base क्लासको फङ्सन पुनः लेख्छ, त्यसैले base र derived क्लास — अर्थात् inheritance — हुनैपर्छ।
pairs.en: Overriding means a derived class redefines a base class function, so a base and derived class — that is, inheritance — must exist.

pairs.ne: virtual फङ्सनले C++ लाई चल्दै गर्दा, base पोइन्टरले देखाएको वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेरेर निर्णय गर्न लगाउँछ।
pairs.en: A virtual function tells C++ to decide at run time, by looking at the actual object the base pointer points to.

pairs.ne: Overloading लाई उही नाम तर फरक parameter सूची चाहिन्छ — फरक किसिम, वा फरक सङ्ख्या। दोस्रोले किसिम बदल्छ, त्यसैले मान्य छ। पहिलोमा return type मात्र फरक छ, जसलाई C++ ले अस्वीकार गर्छ। तेस्रोले parameter को नाम मात्र बदल्छ, त्यसैले दुवै उही हुन्। चौथोमा नाम नै फरक छ, त्यसैले overloading होइन।
pairs.en: Overloading needs the same name with a DIFFERENT parameter list — different types, or a different number of parameters. Option 2 changes the types, so it is valid. Option 1 differs only in return type, which C++ rejects. Option 3 only renames the parameters, so the two are identical. Option 4 has two different names, so it is not overloading at all.

pairs.ne: कोड पढेरै कुन function चल्छ भनी compiler ले भन्न सक्छ भने निर्णय चाँडै हुन्छ — static वा early binding। त्यो overloading हो। Base pointer हुँदै virtual function प्रयोग गर्दा निर्णय प्रोग्राम चल्दा मात्र हुन सक्छ भने त्यो dynamic वा late binding हो।
pairs.en: If the compiler can tell which function will run just by reading the code, the decision is made early — static or early binding. That is overloading. When the decision can only be made while the program runs, using a virtual function through a base pointer, it is dynamic or late binding.

pairs.ne: virtual नभए compiler ले object होइन, pointer को किसिम हेरेर निर्णय गर्छ — त्यसैले object साँच्चै Circle भए पनि Shape कै संस्करण चल्छ। Base function मा virtual थप्दा निर्णय चल्ने बेलासम्म पर सर्छ र Circle कै संस्करण चल्छ। यस युनिटमा सबैभन्दा बढी सोधिने बिन्दु यही एउटा keyword हो।
pairs.en: Without virtual the compiler decides from the POINTER's type, not the object's, so Shape's version runs even though the object really is a Circle. Adding virtual to the base function is what defers the decision to run time and makes Circle's version run. This single keyword is the most examined point in the unit.

pairs.ne: उही लाइन p->draw() दुई पटक चल्न लागेको छ। कहाँ पुग्छ हेर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: The same line p->draw() is about to run twice. Watch where it ends up.

pairs.ne: p एउटा Shape पोइन्टर हो। यसको घोषित प्रकार बदलिँदैन — केवल यसले देखाउने वस्तु बदलिन्छ।
pairs.en: p is a Shape pointer. Its declared type never changes — only what it points at.

pairs.ne: p = &c — अब पोइन्टरसँग Circle अब्जेक्टको ठेगाना छ।
pairs.en: p = &c — the pointer now holds the address of a Circle object.

pairs.ne: p->draw() चल्यो। draw() virtual भएकाले C++ ले अब्जेक्ट हेरेर Circle::draw() बोलायो।
pairs.en: p->draw() runs. Because draw() is virtual, C++ looks at the OBJECT and calls Circle::draw().

pairs.ne: p = &s — उही पोइन्टर, अब Square तिर देखाइरहेको।
pairs.en: p = &s — the SAME pointer, now pointing at a Square.

pairs.ne: उही लाइन p->draw() ले अब Square::draw() बोलायो। लाइन बदलिएन — अब्जेक्ट बदलियो।
pairs.en: The identical line p->draw() now calls Square::draw(). The line did not change — the object did.

pairs.ne: यो draw() virtual भएकाले मात्र हुन्छ। नभए C++ ले पोइन्टरको प्रकार हेरेर कम्पाइल गर्दै निर्णय गर्थ्यो।
pairs.en: This only happens because draw() is virtual. Without it, C++ would decide from the pointer type at compile time.

pairs.ne: Overloading, overriding, कि दुवै होइन?
pairs.en: Overloading, overriding, or neither?

pairs.ne: तीन जाँच, क्रमैसँग। फङ्सनहरू एउटै क्लासमा छन् कि base र derived मा? प्यारामिटर सूची उही छ कि फरक? र उही भए base को फङ्सन virtual छ? run-time व्यवहार अन्तिमले मात्र तय गर्छ।
pairs.en: Three checks, in order. Are the functions in ONE class or in a base and a derived class? Are the parameter lists the same or different? And if they are the same, is the base function virtual? Only the last one decides run-time behaviour.

pairs.ne: दुवै होइन — base कै संस्करण चल्छ
pairs.en: Neither — the base version runs

pairs.ne: एउटै क्लास, एउटै नाम, दुई फरक प्यारामिटर सूची — एक र दुई। यहाँ inheritance नै छैन, र compiler ले call आफैंबाट सही फङ्सन छान्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यो compile-time polymorphism हो।
pairs.en: One class, one name, two different parameter lists — one argument against two. There is no inheritance here at all, and the compiler can pick the right function from the call itself, so this is compile-time polymorphism.

pairs.ne: Base र derived, उही नाम र उही खाली प्यारामिटर सूची, र base को फङ्सन virtual छ। Call base pointer मार्फत जाने भएकाले निर्णय प्रोग्राम चल्दासम्म कुर्छ र Circle::draw चल्छ।
pairs.en: Base and derived, the same name and the same empty parameter list, and the base function is virtual. The call goes through a base pointer, so the decision waits until the program runs and Circle::draw is what executes.

pairs.ne: यो माथिको केसबाट एउटा शब्द हटाएको जस्तै देखिन्छ, र त्यो शब्द नै पूरै प्रविधि हो। virtual नभए compiler ले POINTER को प्रकार — अर्थात् Shape — बाट निर्णय गर्छ, त्यसैले वस्तु Circle भए पनि Shape::draw चल्छ। यो function hiding हो, overriding होइन।
pairs.en: It looks like the case above with one word removed, and that word is the whole mechanism. Without virtual the compiler decides from the POINTER type, which is Shape, so Shape::draw runs even though the object is a Circle. This is function hiding, not overriding.

pairs.ne: प्यारामिटर सूची ठ्याक्कै उही छ, फरक रिटर्न टाइपमा मात्र — C++ ले यो स्वीकार गर्दैन, किनभने call हेरेर compiler ले कुन चाहिएको भन्न सक्दैन। यो compile हुँदैन, त्यसैले overloading होइन, र derived क्लास नै नभएकाले overriding पनि होइन।
pairs.en: The parameter lists are identical and only the return type differs, which C++ does not accept — the compiler cannot tell from a call which one you meant. This will not compile, so it is not overloading, and with no derived class it cannot be overriding either.

pairs.ne: Dog::speak ले उही हस्ताक्षरसहित Animal::speak लाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ, त्यसैले यो overriding हो र derived कै संस्करण चल्छ। तर यहाँ चल्नुको कारण virtual होइन, वस्तुको प्रकार ठ्याक्कै थाहा हुनु हो — virtual ले base pointer वा reference मार्फत मात्र फरक पार्छ।
pairs.en: Dog::speak replaces Animal::speak with the same signature, so it is overriding and the derived version runs. Note that it runs here because the object type is known exactly, not because of virtual — virtual only changes what happens through a base pointer or reference.

pairs.ne: तीन फङ्सन, एउटै नाम, हरेक पटक प्यारामिटरको प्रकार फरक। Overloading लाई प्यारामिटरको सङ्ख्या फरक हुनु जरुरी छैन — प्रकार फरक, वा क्रम मात्र फरक भए पनि compiler ले छुट्याउन सक्छ।
pairs.en: Three functions, one name, parameter TYPES different each time. Overloading does not require a different number of parameters — a different type, or even a different order, is enough for the compiler to tell them apart.

pairs.ne: यो पूरा रूख कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् — हाँगा, अर्को नाम, र कसले हासिल गर्छ।
pairs.en: Learn this whole tree — the branches, the other names, and what achieves each.

pairs.ne: कम्पाइलरले कललाई हरेक संस्करणको प्यारामिटरसँग मिलाएर सही एउटा छान्छ — प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै।
pairs.en: The compiler matches the call against each version's parameter list and picks the one that fits — all before the program runs.

pairs.ne: उही पोइन्टर, उही कल — तर दुई फरक जवाफ, किनकि virtual
pairs.en: virtual makes C++ look at the real object.

pairs.ne: उदाहरण — एउटै मान्छे, धेरै भूमिका। एउटै मान्छे घरमा छोरा, स्कुलमा विद्यार्थी, पसलमा ग्राहक र अस्पतालमा बिरामी हुन्छ। व्यक्ति उही, ठाउँ अनुसार व्यवहार फरक। नाम फेरिएन, अवस्थाले व्यवहार तय गर्‍यो — यही polymorphism हो।
pairs.en: Same person — different behaviour in different places. The name did not change; the situation decided the behaviour. That is polymorphism.

pairs.ne: यसलाई static polymorphism वा early binding भनिन्छ। कुन फङ्सन बोलाउने भन्ने कुरा कम्पाइल गर्दै आर्गुमेन्टको संख्या र प्रकार हेरेर निर्णय हुन्छ। यो छिटो हुन्छ किनकि निर्णय पहिल्यै भइसकेको हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Operator Overloading

pairs.ne: यसलाई dynamic polymorphism वा late binding भनिन्छ। निर्णय प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा हुन्छ — base पोइन्टरले वास्तवमा कुन अब्जेक्ट देखाइरहेको छ त्यो हेरेर। यो अलि ढिलो तर बढी लचिलो हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Virtual Functions

pairs.ne: कुन call ले कुन version मिलाउँछ भन्ने comment ले भन्छ। सङ्ख्या भन्दैन। खोल्नुअघि तीनै नतिजा निकाल्नुहोस् — तेस्रो चाहिँ वृत्त हो, वर्ग होइन।
pairs.en: The comments tell you which version each call matches. They do not tell you the numbers. Work out all three results before opening this — the third one is a circle, not a square.

pairs.ne: एउटै नाम, तीन काम। संस्करण १ र ३ दुवैले एउटै आर्गुमेन्ट लिन्छन् — तर प्रकार फरक (int
pairs.en: float).

pairs.ne: Base pointer ले Derived object समातेको छ, र show() virtual छैन। एउटै लाइन output भन्नुहोस्। धेरैले object को प्रकार भन्छन्; virtual नभए C++ ले pointer को प्रकार भन्छ।
pairs.en: A Base pointer is holding a Derived object, and show() is not virtual. Commit to one line of output. Most people answer with the type of the object; without virtual, C++ answers with the type of the pointer.

pairs.ne: अब Base
pairs.en: Derived show instead. One keyword changes the whole output. That is exactly what the examiner is testing.

pairs.ne: Overloading: कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट गनेर प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै छान्छ — compile-time। Virtual override: पोइन्टरले देखाएको वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेरेर चल्दै गर्दा छान्छ — run-time। उही कल, फरक आउटपुट।
pairs.en: Virtual override — the computer looks at the object the pointer actually points to, while the program is running. Run-time. Same call, different output.

pairs.ne: लिडमा दिइएका तीन जाँच क्रमैसँग गर्नुहोस्। एक क्लास कि दुई? एउटै क्लास भए overloading मात्र हुन सक्छ। प्यारामिटर उही कि फरक? फरक भए overloading; उही भए पुनर्परिभाषा हेर्दै छ। त्यसपछि मात्र virtual
pairs.en: virtual is testing case 3 on purpose.

pairs.ne: Overloading र Overriding, अनि Compile-time र Run-time — यी पूरै विषयकै सबैभन्दा बढी सोधिने प्रश्न हुन्।
pairs.en: Overloading versus overriding, and compile-time versus run-time, are the highest-frequency questions in the whole subject.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा + दुवै प्रकार + एक–एक उदाहरण। चित्र (रूख) कोरे झन् राम्रो।
pairs.en: Base *p = &derivedObj; p->show();

pairs.ne: कम्तीमा पाँच हरफको तालिका लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Write a table with at least five rows: meaning (same class, different parameters vs derived class, same parameters); inheritance (not required vs required); parameters (must differ vs must be identical); binding (early/static vs late/dynamic); type (compile-time vs run-time); and the virtual keyword (not used vs used in the base class).

pairs.ne: परिभाषा + किन चाहिन्छ (base पोइन्टरबाट derived संस्करण चलाउन) — दुवै लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: virtual the base class version would always be called, and run-time polymorphism would be impossible.

pairs.ne: Trace a Program सेक्सनको Program 3 नै यसको पूरा उत्तर हो — त्यहीँ लाइन–लाइन हेर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: The output will be "Drawing a Circle" then "Drawing a Square" — the same call giving two different results. That is the full program traced step by step in the Trace a Program section.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् Polymorphism ग्रीक शब्दबाट बनेको हो: poly = धेरै, morph = रूप। अर्थात् "धेरै रूप"। C++ मा एउटै फङ्सनको नाम वा एउटै अपरेटर ले फरक अवस्थामा फरक व्यवहार गर्ने क्षमतालाई polymorphism भनिन्छ — कुन अब्जेक्ट वा कस्तो आर्गुमेन्ट प्रयोग भयो, त्यसमा भर पर्छ।
pairs.en: Definition — learn this wording The word polymorphism comes from Greek: poly means many and morph means forms. So polymorphism literally means "many forms". In C++, polymorphism is the ability of the same function name or the same operator to behave differently in different situations, depending on the object or on the arguments used.

pairs.ne: फङ्सन ओभरलोडिङ Function overloading भनेको उही क्लास भित्र उही नाम तर फरक प्यारामिटर भएका दुई वा बढी फङ्सन लेख्नु हो। प्यारामिटर संख्या, प्रकार, वा क्रम मा फरक हुनुपर्छ। महत्त्वपूर्ण: return type मात्र फरक भएर पुग्दैन। नाम र प्यारामिटर उही तर return type फरक भए कम्पाइलर error दिन्छ।
pairs.en: Function overloading Function overloading means writing two or more functions with the same name in the same class, but with different parameter lists. The parameter lists must differ in the number of parameters, the type of parameters, or their order. Important: a difference in the return type alone is NOT enough. Two functions with the same name and same parameters but different return types cause a compiler error.

pairs.ne: अपरेटर ओभरलोडिङ Operator overloading भनेको भइरहेको C++ अपरेटरलाई थप अर्थ दिनु हो, ताकि यो तपाईंकै क्लासका अब्जेक्टसँग पनि काम गरोस्। जस्तै + ले सामान्यतया संख्या जोड्छ। ओभरलोड गरेपछि c1 + c2 ले दुई Complex अब्जेक्ट जोड्न सक्छ। Syntax मा operator कीवर्ड पछि चिन्ह लेखिन्छ।
pairs.en: Operator overloading Operator overloading means giving an additional meaning to an existing C++ operator so that it also works with objects of your own class. For example + normally adds numbers. By overloading it, you can make c1 + c2 add two Complex number objects. The syntax uses the keyword operator followed by the symbol.

pairs.ne: फङ्सन ओभरराइडिङ Function overriding भनेको derived क्लासमा base क्लासकै फङ्सन जस्तै उही नाम, उही return type र उही प्यारामिटर भएको फङ्सन लेख्नु हो। derived अब्जेक्टका लागि derived कै संस्करणले base को संस्करणलाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ। Overriding का लागि inheritance अनिवार्य छ। base फङ्सनमा virtual लेखिएको छ र base पोइन्टर बाट बोलाइयो भने C++ ले चल्दै गर्दा derived संस्करण बोलाउँछ — यही run-time polymorphism हो। virtual नलेखे base कै संस्करण चल्छ।
pairs.en: Function overriding Function overriding means the derived class defines a function with exactly the same name, the same return type and the same parameters as a function already present in its base class. The derived version replaces the base version for objects of the derived class. Overriding requires inheritance — it is impossible without a base and a derived class. If the base function is marked virtual and you call it through a base class pointer, C++ calls the derived version at run time. That is run-time polymorphism. Without virtual, the base version is called instead.

pairs.ne: पोलिमर्फिज्मका फाइदा एउटै इन्टरफेस, धेरै काम — पढ्न, लेख्न र सम्झन सजिलो। कोड पुनः प्रयोग र छोटो प्रोग्राम। लचकता — पुरानो कोड नछोई नयाँ derived क्लास थप्न सकिन्छ। Dynamic binding सम्भव बनाउँछ। फरक–फरक नाम सम्झिरहनु पर्दैन।
pairs.en: Advantages of polymorphism One interface, many implementations — easier to read, write and remember. Code reusability and shorter programs. Flexibility — new derived classes can be added without changing existing code. Supports dynamic binding and cleaner program design. Reduces the number of different function names a programmer must remember.

pairs.ne: virtual ले pointer वा reference मार्फत मात्र फरक पार्छ। वस्तु मार्फत त प्रकार पहिले नै थाहा हुन्छ।
pairs.en: virtual matters only through a pointer or reference. Through the object, the type is already known.

pairs.ne: छोटो सार Overloading = उही क्लासमा उही नाम तर फरक प्यारामिटर; inheritance चाहिँदैन; compile-time। Overriding = derived क्लासमा उही नाम र उही प्यारामिटर; inheritance चाहिन्छ; virtual राखे run-time। Practise the judgement · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Read the code and name it: overloading, overriding, or neither? What you will learn: to apply the table above to code you have not seen. The paper prints a class and asks which kind of polymorphism it is — and two of these six cases are neither, which is where the mark goes. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: माथिको तालिकालाई नदेखेको कोडमा लागू गर्न। परीक्षामा क्लास छापेर कुन किसिमको polymorphism हो सोधिन्छ — र यी छ केसमध्ये दुई "दुवै होइन" हुन्, अंक त्यहीँ जान्छ। How to use this Work the three checks in the order the lead gives them. One class or two? One class means it can only be overloading. Same parameters or different? Different means overloading; the same means you are looking at a redefinition. Only then look for virtual. Cases 3 and 4 are the two that are neither, and they fail for completely different reasons: case 3 compiles and quietly runs the wrong function, case 4 does not compile at all. Read both reasons — a question that shows you code without virtual is testing case 3 on purpose. लिडमा दिइएका तीन जाँच क्रमैसँग गर्नुहोस्। एक क्लास कि दुई? एउटै क्लास भए overloading मात्र हुन सक्छ। प्यारामिटर उही कि फरक? फरक भए overloading; उही भए पुनर्परिभाषा हेर्दै छ। त्यसपछि मात्र virtual खोज्नुहोस्। केस ३ र ४ दुवै होइन, तर कारण बेग्लै छ: केस ३ compile हुन्छ र चुपचाप गलत फङ्सन चलाउँछ, केस ४ compile नै हुँदैन।
pairs.en: …Must be the same. BindingEarly / static binding.Late / dynamic binding when virtual is used. TypeCompile-time polymorphism.Run-time polymorphism. virtual keywordNot used.virtual is used in the base class. PurposeTo give one name to several similar jobs.To give the child a different version of the parent's function.

pairs.ne: Run-time polymorphism लाई derived वस्तुतर्फ देखाउने base class pointer चाहिन्छ, जुन inheritance भएपछि मात्र हुन्छ। Overriding भनेको derived कक्षाले base कक्षाको function फेर्नु हो।
pairs.en: Run-time polymorphism needs a base class pointer pointing at a derived object, which only exists once there is inheritance. Overriding is a derived class replacing a base class function.

pairs.en: Overloading is two member functions with the same name in one class, so the class and its member functions from Unit 3 come first.

pairs.en: This is RUN-TIME polymorphism. Same pointer, same call p->show(), different output — because virtual makes C++ look at the actual object. Remove "virtual" from line 9 and this would print "I am a Shape" instead.
