pairs.ne: पाठ्यक्रममा सात, तीमध्ये चार मानक सबैलाई #include <string.h> चाहिन्छ। strlen(s) — null भन्दा अघिका अक्षरको सङ्ख्या फर्काउँछ। strlen("NEPAL") को ५। strcpy(dest, src) — src लाई null सहित dest मा सार्छ। चाहिनुको कारण — array मा dest = src चल्दैन। strcat(dest, src) — src लाई dest को अन्त्यमा जोड्छ। dest दुवै अट्ने ठूलो हुनुपर्छ। strcmp(s1, s2) — तुलना गरेर बराबर भए ० फर्काउँछ, s1 वर्णक्रममा पहिले भए ऋणात्मक, पछि भए धनात्मक। शून्यको अर्थ बराबर हुनु सबैको अपेक्षाविपरीत छ। अरू तीन — strrev, strlwr, strupr — ले string उल्टाउँछ, सानो अक्षर बनाउँछ र ठूलो अक्षर बनाउँछ। सिक्नुहोस्: यी पाठ्यक्रममा छन् र सोधिन्छन्।
pairs.en: Seven in the syllabus, four of them standard All of them need #include <string.h>. strlen(s) — returns the number of characters before the null. strlen("NEPAL") is 5. strcpy(dest, src) — copies src into dest, null included. Needed because dest = src does not work on arrays. strcat(dest, src) — joins src onto the end of dest. dest must be large enough for both. strcmp(s1, s2) — compares them and returns 0 when they are equal, a negative number if s1 comes first alphabetically, a positive number if it comes after. Zero meaning equal is the opposite of what everyone expects. The other three — strrev, strlwr, strupr — reverse a string, lower-case it and upper-case it. Learn them: they are on the syllabus and they are examined.

pairs.ne: सम्झने तरिका — Index शून्यबाट, अन्तिम आकार घटाउ एक; string देखिनेभन्दा एक बाकस लामो।
pairs.en: Memory hook — Index from zero, last is size minus one; a string is one box longer than it looks.

pairs.ne: Array भनेको के हो? एक-आयामिक array घोषणा गर्ने syntax उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is an array? Write the syntax for declaring a one-dimensional array with an example.

pairs.ne: Null अक्षर भनेको के हो? char name[5] = "NEPAL"; किन गल्ती हो?
pairs.en: What is the null character? Why is char name[5] = "NEPAL"; a mistake?

pairs.ne: दस सङ्ख्या array मा पढेर तिनको जोड र औसत छाप्ने C प्रोग्राम लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Write a C program to read ten numbers into an array and print their sum and average.

pairs.ne: प्रोग्रामले int a[5]; घोषणा गरेर a[5] मा लेख्छ। Compiler ले के गर्छ?
pairs.en: A program declares int a[5]; and then writes to a[5]. What does the compiler do?

pairs.ne: Loop नभएको array भनेको कोष्ठकसहितका पचास variable मात्र हो। यस युनिटका हरेक काम — पढ्ने, छाप्ने, जोड्ने, ठूलो खोज्ने, क्रम मिलाउने — for loop हुन् जसको counter नै index हो; त्यसैले loop कमजोर भए सबै कमजोर हुन्छन्।
pairs.en: An array without a loop is fifty variables with brackets. Every array operation in this unit — read, print, total, find the largest, sort — is a for loop whose counter is the index, so a shaky loop makes every one of them shaky.

pairs.ne: String भनेको char array हो, र %s, %c अनि escape sequence \0 सबै २.२ र २.५ बाट आउँछन्। Null अक्षर नयाँ विचार होइन, char constant हो।
pairs.en: A string is a char array and %s, %c and the escape sequence \0 all come from 2.2 and 2.5. The null character is a char constant, not a new idea.

pairs.ne: Array, index, र चल्दै गरेको जोड
pairs.en: An array, an index, and a running total

pairs.ne: पाँच integer मेमोरीमा छेउछाउ राखिन्छन्। स्थानको गन्ती 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 हो — 1 देखि 5 होइन। कोष्ठकभित्रको आकार 5 हो; अन्तिम मान्य index 4।
pairs.en: Five integers are stored side by side in memory. The positions are numbered 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — not 1 to 5. The size in the brackets is 5; the last valid index is 4.

pairs.ne: युनिट ३ को sum जस्तै कारणले total 0 बाट सुरु हुन्छ: यसमा जोड्न लागिएको छ।
pairs.en: total starts at 0 for the same reason sum did in Unit 3: it is about to be added to.

pairs.ne: i शून्यबाट सुरु हुन्छ, र यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण बानी त्यही हो। marks[0] पहिलो element हो, 70।
pairs.en: i starts at ZERO, which is the single most important habit in this unit. marks[0] is the first element, 70.

pairs.ne: total = 0 + 70। कोष्ठकभित्रको index variable हो, र त्यसैले एउटै लाइनले पालैपालो हरेक element सम्म पुग्छ।
pairs.en: total = 0 + 70. The index inside the brackets is a variable, which is what lets one line of code reach every element in turn.

pairs.ne: i++ ले i लाई 1 बनाउँछ, त्यसैले marks[i] अब marks[1] हो — दोस्रो element, 85।
pairs.en: i++ makes i 1, so marks[i] is now marks[1] — the SECOND element, 85.

pairs.ne: i 2 छ र marks[2] 60 हो।
pairs.en: i is 2 and marks[2] is 60.

pairs.ne: i 3 छ र marks[3] 90 हो।
pairs.en: i is 3 and marks[3] is 90.

pairs.ne: i 4 छ र marks[4] 45 हो। यो अन्तिम element हो, र index आकारभन्दा एक कम छ।
pairs.en: i is 4 and marks[4] is 45. This is the LAST element, and the index is one less than the size.

pairs.ne: i 5 हुन्छ र सर्त 5 < 5 असत्य भएकाले loop रोकिन्छ। सर्त i <= 5 भएको भए प्रोग्रामले marks[5] पढ्थ्यो, जुन array को भाग होइन — C ले जाँच्दैन, र नतिजा गलत जोड वा crash हुन्छ।
pairs.en: i becomes 5 and the condition 5 < 5 is false, so the loop stops. Had the condition been i <= 5, the program would have read marks[5], which is not part of the array — C does not check, and the result is a wrong total or a crash.

pairs.ne: 70 + 85 + 60 + 90 + 45 = 350। एउटा loop, एउटा index, पाँच element।
pairs.en: 70 + 85 + 60 + 90 + 45 = 350. One loop, one index, five elements.

pairs.ne: String भनेको लुकेको अन्तिम अक्षर भएको array हो
pairs.en: A string is an array with a hidden last character

pairs.ne: string.h दोस्रो header हो, र strlen त्यहीँ भएकाले चाहिन्छ। stdio.h मात्रले strlen लाई अघोषित छाड्थ्यो।
pairs.en: string.h is a second header, needed because strlen lives there. stdio.h alone would leave strlen undeclared.

pairs.ne: पाँच अक्षर भण्डारण भए — र तपाईंले कहिल्यै नटाइप गरेको छैठौं अक्षर पनि। अन्त्यमा null अक्षर \0 आफैं राखिन्छ, र त्यसैले हरेक C function ले string कहाँ सकिन्छ थाहा पाउँछ।
pairs.en: Five letters are stored — and a sixth character you never typed. The null character \0 is put at the end automatically, which is how every C function knows where the string stops.

pairs.ne: त्यसैले array लाई 5 होइन 10 घोषणा गरिएको हो। पाँच अक्षरको शब्द राख्ने char array लाई कम्तीमा छ ठाउँ चाहिन्छ, र ठ्याक्कै 5 भए terminator का लागि ठाउँ बाँकी रहँदैन।
pairs.en: This is why the array was declared as 10 and not 5. A char array holding a five-letter word needs at least six places, and a size of exactly 5 would leave no room for the terminator.

pairs.ne: %s ले एक–एक गरी अक्षर छाप्छ र \0 भेट्नेबित्तिकै रोकिन्छ। Null रोकिने निर्देशन हो, र त्यो कहिल्यै छापिँदैन।
pairs.en: %s prints characters one after another and stops the moment it meets \0. The null is the instruction to stop, and it is never printed.

pairs.ne: strlen ले null सम्म गन्छ र null आफैंलाई गन्दैन, त्यसैले छ ठाउँ ओगटे पनि पाँच अक्षरको शब्दको 5 आउँछ। लम्बाइ र भण्डारण दुई फरक सङ्ख्या हुन्। उत्तर int मा राखिएको छ, जसले अर्को लाइनमा %d ले छाप्न मिल्छ।
pairs.en: strlen counts up to the null and does not count the null itself, so a five-letter word gives 5 even though six places are used. The length and the storage are two different numbers. The answer is kept in an int so that the next line can print it with %d.

pairs.ne: len int हो, र %d int कै specifier हो। दुईलाई मिलाउनु औपचारिकता मात्र होइन — specifier र मान बाझिए printf के गर्छ, युनिट २ ले देखाएको छ।
pairs.en: len is an int, and %d is the specifier for an int. Matching the two is not a formality — Unit 2 showed what printf does when the specifier and the value disagree.

pairs.ne: name[0] एउटा अक्षर हो, string होइन, त्यसैले %c ले छापिन्छ। यहाँ %s प्रयोग गर्नु त्यस्तो गल्ती हो जुन compiler ले नरोक्न सक्छ।
pairs.en: name[0] is one character, not a string, so it is printed with %c. Using %s here would be a mistake the compiler may not stop.

pairs.ne: Garbage — त्यो मेमोरीमा जे थियो
pairs.en: Garbage — whatever was in that memory

pairs.ne: तीनै ० हुन्छन्
pairs.en: All three are 0

pairs.ne: तीनै ३ हुन्छन्
pairs.en: All three are 3

pairs.ne: २० — string लाई सधैं २० चाहिन्छ
pairs.en: 20 — strings always need 20

pairs.ne: १, अर्थात् सत्य
pairs.en: 1, meaning true

pairs.ne: String को लम्बाइ
pairs.en: The length of the strings

pairs.ne: यसले केही फर्काउँदैन
pairs.en: It returns nothing

pairs.ne: किनभने == सङ्ख्यामा मात्र चल्छ र प्रोग्राम compile हुँदैन
pairs.en: Because == only works on numbers and the program will not compile

pairs.ne: किनभने s1 र s2 ठेगाना हुन्, त्यसैले == ले दुई array कहाँ छन् तुलना गर्छ, भित्र के छ होइन
pairs.en: Because s1 and s2 are addresses, so == compares where the two arrays are, not what they contain

pairs.ne: किनभने string सधैं loop मा अक्षर–अक्षर तुलना गर्नुपर्छ
pairs.en: Because strings must always be compared letter by letter in a loop

pairs.ne: यो राम्ररी चल्छ
pairs.en: It works perfectly well

pairs.ne: scanf("%s", &name); र पूरै नाम पढिन्छ
pairs.en: scanf("%s", &name); and the whole name is read

pairs.ne: scanf("%s", name); र "Ram" मात्र पढिन्छ, किनभने %s पहिलो खाली ठाउँमा रोकिन्छ
pairs.en: scanf("%s", name); and only "Ram" is read, because %s stops at the first space

pairs.ne: scanf("%c", name); र पूरै नाम पढिन्छ
pairs.en: scanf("%c", name); and the whole name is read

pairs.ne: scanf("%d", &name); र नाम सङ्ख्यामा बदलिन्छ

pairs.en: It compiles and the loop touches a[5], which is outside the array — giving a wrong result or a crash

pairs.en: Because strrev is not part of the standard C library — it is a Turbo C and Microsoft extension

pairs.en: Because string.h was not included

pairs.ne: किनभने strrev लाई कम्तीमा १०० अक्षरको array चाहिन्छ
pairs.en: Because strrev needs an array of at least 100 characters

pairs.ne: int marks[10]; मा अन्तिम element को index कति हो?
pairs.en: For int marks[10]; what is the index of the LAST element?
int a[5] = {7, 3}; What are a[2], a[3] and a[4]?

pairs.ne: "KATHMANDU" शब्द char array मा सुरक्षित रूपमा राख्न सबैभन्दा सानो आकार कति हुनुपर्छ?
pairs.en: What is the smallest size that will safely hold the word "KATHMANDU" in a char array?

pairs.en: char s[20] = "NEPAL"; What does strlen(s) return?

pairs.ne: दुई string ठ्याक्कै उस्तै हुँदा strcmp(s1, s2) ले के फर्काउँछ?
pairs.en: What does strcmp(s1, s2) return when the two strings are identical?

pairs.ne: दुई string लाई if (s1 == s2) ले किन तुलना गर्न मिल्दैन?
pairs.en: Why can two strings not be compared with if (s1 == s2)?

pairs.ne: char name[20]; कुन scanf लाइन सही छ, र प्रयोगकर्ताले "Ram Bahadur" टाइप गरे के हुन्छ?
pairs.en: char name[20]; Which scanf line is correct, and what happens if the user types "Ram Bahadur"?

pairs.ne: int a[5] मा loop लाई for (i = 0; i <= 5; i++) लेखियो। यसको परिणाम के हुन्छ?
pairs.en: A loop over int a[5] is written as for (i = 0; i <= 5; i++). What is the consequence?

pairs.ne: strrev() प्रयोग गरेको प्रोग्राम विद्यालयको DEV C++ मा compile हुन्छ र Linux मेसिनमा "undefined reference" भन्दै असफल हुन्छ। किन?
pairs.en: A program using strrev() compiles on DEV C++ at school and fails on a Linux machine with "undefined reference". Why?

pairs.ne: छैटौं अक्षर कहाँबाट आयो
pairs.en: Where the sixth character came from

pairs.ne: — Array र string भनेको के हुन्
pairs.en: What arrays and strings are

pairs.en: Declaration and initialisation of an array

pairs.en: One-dimensional arrays in use

pairs.ne: — String को घोषणा
pairs.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A program declares int a[5]; and then writes to a[5]. What does the compiler do? प्रोग्रामले int a[5]; घोषणा गरेर a[5] मा लेख्छ। Compiler ले के गर्छ? Refuses to compile and reports an index error Compiles it without complaint, and the program may do anything at run time Compiles it and silently grows the array to six elements It compiles. C performs no bounds checking — not at compile time and not at run time. a[5] is simply "the memory five boxes past the start of a", and the compiler works out that address and uses it. What is at that address is whatever came next in memory: another variable, part of the function's bookkeeping, or nothing in particular. The program may print a strange number, may quietly corrupt a different variable, or may crash — and it may do a different one of those on each run. This is the price C pays for speed: no check means no cost, and the responsibility moves to you. It is also why i < size rather than i <= size is worth checking every single time you write a loop over an array. Compile हुन्छ। C ले bound जाँच्दैन — न compile गर्दा, न चल्दा। a[5] भनेको "a को सुरुदेखि पाँच बाकस पर भएको मेमोरी" मात्र हो, र compiler ले त्यही ठेगाना निकालेर चलाउँछ। त्यहाँ के छ भन्ने मेमोरीमा पछि जे आयो त्यही हो: अर्को variable, function को आफ्नै हिसाब, वा केही पनि होइन। प्रोग्रामले अनौठो सङ्ख्या छाप्न सक्छ, अर्कै variable चुपचाप बिगार्न सक्छ, वा crash हुन सक्छ — र हरेक पटक फरक नतिजा दिन सक्छ। गतिका लागि C ले तिरेको मूल्य यही हो: जाँच छैन भने लागत पनि छैन, र जिम्मेवारी तपाईंमा सर्छ। Array मा loop लेख्दा हरेक पटक i <= size होइन i < size हो कि भनेर जाँच्नुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही। 5.4 Declaration of a string

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक पटक marks[i] कुन element हो, र अन्त्यमा i ५ पुग्दा के हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई चरण नै ध्यान दिनुपर्ने ठाउँ हुन् — off-by-one त्रुटि वर्णन होइन, देखाइएको छ।
pairs.en: What you will learn: which element marks[i] is on each turn, and what happens at the end when i reaches 5. The last two steps are the ones worth the attention — they are the off-by-one error, shown rather than described.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पाँच अक्षरको शब्द राख्दा छ अक्षर लेखिन्छ, strlen ले पाँच भन्छ, र दुवै सङ्ख्या ठिक छन्। कुनै लाइनले केही नराखी name[5] को पङ्क्ति देखिएको हेर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: that storing a five-letter word writes six characters, that strlen reports five, and that the two numbers are both right. Watch the name[5] row appear without any line having put something there.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: के फर्कनुपर्छ हेरेर function छान्न — सङ्ख्या, बदलिएको string, कि तुलनाको नतिजा। यस विषयका एक अंकका प्रश्न यसरी नै सोधिन्छन्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to pick the function from what has to come back — a number, a changed string, or a comparison result. That is how the one-mark questions on this topic are framed.

pairs.ne: विकल्प (क) ले array को वर्णन गर्छ, जसले एउटै प्रकारका धेरै मान राख्छ। Structure उल्टो आकारको हो: एउटै कुराबारे फरक प्रकारका धेरै मान — नाम, roll नम्बर र प्रतिशत भएको विद्यार्थी। भित्रका हरेक variable लाई member भनिन्छ र हरेकको आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ — structure लाई union बाट छुट्याउने कुरा त्यही हो।
pairs.en: Option A describes an array, which holds many values of ONE type. A structure is the opposite shape: several values of DIFFERENT types about one thing — a student with a name, a roll number and a percentage. Each variable inside it is called a member and each member has its own memory, which is what separates a structure from a union.

pairs.ne: Union ले हरेक member लाई उही मेमोरी block दिन्छ, त्यसैले block सबैभन्दा ठूलो member अट्ने मात्र हुनुपर्छ — यहाँ ४ byte। उही दुई member भएको structure लाई दुवैका लागि ठाउँ चाहिन्थ्यो, त्यसैले आकार ५ र compiler ले थप्ने padding हुन्थ्यो। दुईबीचको सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट फरक आकार नै हो र तुलनात्मक प्रश्नको अंक पनि प्रायः यसैमा दिइन्छ।
pairs.en: A union gives every member the same block of memory, so the block only has to be big enough for the largest member — 4 bytes here. A structure with the same two members would need space for both, so its size would be 5 plus any padding the compiler adds. Size is the clearest single difference between the two and it is the standard way the comparison question is marked.

pairs.ne: मेमोरीको एउटै block छ र दुवै member ले त्यही पढ्छन्। b.c मा ८८ लेख्दा साझा block को पहिलो byte मा ८८ पुग्यो, त्यसैले पछि b.n पढ्दा बदलिएका byte पढिन्छन् र ८८ आउँछ। c को मात्र नाम लिने लाइनले n ले पढ्ने कुरा बदल्यो — union को पूरै व्यवहार त्यही हो। STRUCTURE मा दुवै member ले आफ्नो मान राख्थे र उत्तर ६५ हुन्थ्यो।
pairs.en: There is only one block of memory and both members read it. Writing 88 into b.c put 88 into the first byte of the shared block, so reading b.n afterwards reads the changed bytes and gives 88. A line that named only c has changed what n reads — and that is a union's whole behaviour. In a STRUCTURE both members would keep their own values and the answer would be 65.

pairs.ne: Dot operator ले structure को VARIABLE लाई यसको member सँग जोड्छ, त्यसैले s1.roll हुन्छ। Student प्रकार हो, र प्रकारले मेमोरी छुट्याउँदैन — त्यसैले Student.roll ले अस्तित्वमा भएको केही जनाउँदैन। Arrow -> त्यतिबेला चलाइन्छ जब structure आफैं होइन, त्यसको POINTER हुन्छ — त्यो कक्षा १० को कुरा हो; सामान्य variable का लागि dot नै operator हो।
pairs.en: The dot operator joins a structure VARIABLE to one of its members, so it is s1.roll. Student is the type, and a type reserves no memory, so Student.roll names nothing that exists. The arrow -> is used when you hold a POINTER to a structure rather than the structure itself, which is Grade 10 work; for a plain variable the dot is the operator.

pairs.ne: Structure को घोषणा statement हो, त्यसैले बन्द brace पछि semicolon ले सकिन्छ: struct Student { ... }; Function definition statement होइन र त्यहाँ semicolon लिँदैन; #include preprocessor directive हो र लिँदैन; अनि int main() पछि semicolon राखे खाली function बन्थ्यो र brace छुट्टै block बन्थ्यो। Structure को semicolon छुटाउँदा त्रुटि सन्देशले पछिल्लो लाइन देखाउँछ — त्यसैले भेट्न गाह्रो हुन्छ।
pairs.en: A structure declaration is a statement, so it ends with a semicolon after the closing brace: struct Student { ... }; A function definition is not a statement and takes no semicolon there; #include is a preprocessor directive and takes none; and a semicolon after int main() would make an empty function and then leave the braces as a stray block. Leaving out the structure semicolon produces an error message pointing at the NEXT line, which is why it is hard to find.

pairs.ne: C मा struct keyword प्रकारकै नामको भाग हो, त्यसैले घोषणा struct Student s1; हुन्छ। typedef ले छोटो नाम नदिएसम्म Student s1; मात्रले compile हुँदैन। अरू दुई विकल्प C++ र Java का syntax हुन्: C मा new operator छैन, र structure को variable int जस्तै घोषणा गरेरै बन्छ।
pairs.en: In C the keyword struct is part of the type name, so the declaration is struct Student s1;. Writing Student s1; alone does not compile unless a typedef has given the type a shorter name. The other two options are C++ and Java syntax: C has no new operator, and a structure variable is created by declaring it, exactly like an int.

pairs.ne: प्रश्नका दुई सर्त union लाई चाहिने ठ्याक्कै दुई सर्त हुन्: कुनै पनि क्षणमा एउटै member प्रयोगमा हुनु, र मेमोरी थोरै हुनु। तब एउटै block बाँड्दा केही लागत छैन, किनभने प्रयोगमा नभएको member सँग राख्नुपर्ने मान नै थिएन। Structure सुरक्षित त हुन्थ्यो तर दुवै member का लागि ठाउँ छुट्याउँथ्यो — र त्यही मेमोरी यन्त्रसँग छैन। Union हुनुको एकमात्र कारण मेमोरी बचत हो, र उत्तरमा दिनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।
pairs.en: The two conditions in the question are exactly the two a union needs: only one member is in use at any moment, and memory is scarce. Sharing one block then costs nothing, because the unused member had no value worth keeping. A structure would be safe but would reserve space for both members, which is the memory the device does not have. Saving memory is the only reason a union exists, and it is the reason to give in an answer.

pairs.ne: Structure कि union?
pairs.en: Structure or union?

pairs.ne: घोषणा झन्डै उस्तै र व्यवहार पूरै फरक — structure ले हरेक member लाई आफ्नै मेमोरी दिन्छ, union ले सबैलाई एउटै ठाउँ बाँड्न लगाउँछ। प्रोग्रामलाई के चाहिन्छ हेरेर निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: They are declared almost identically and they behave completely differently, because a structure gives every member its own memory and a union makes them share one space. Decide from what the program needs.

pairs.ne: हरेक member ले एकैचोटि आफ्नै मान राख्नुपर्छ, र त्यही structure ले दिन्छ, union ले दिँदैन। एउटै कुराबारे धेरै तथ्यको record राख्नु structure को मानक प्रयोग हो।
pairs.en: Every member has to hold its own value at the same time, which is precisely what a structure gives and a union cannot. A record of several facts about one thing is the standard use of a structure.

pairs.ne: कुनै पनि क्षणमा एउटा member मात्र प्रयोगमा हुन्छ, त्यसैले एउटै मेमोरी बाँड्दा केही खेर जाँदैन। Union हुनुको एकमात्र कारण मेमोरी बचाउनु हो, र उत्तरमा दिनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।
pairs.en: Only one member is in use at any moment, so sharing one block of memory wastes nothing and saves the rest. Saving memory is the only reason a union exists, and it is the reason to give in an answer.

pairs.ne: एउटा member लेख्दा साझा ठाउँ मेटिन्छ र अरूको अर्थ रहँदैन — यो union मा मात्र हुन्छ। Structure मा हरेक member का आफ्नै byte हुन्छन् र अर्को पढ्नु पूरै सुरक्षित हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Writing one member overwrites the shared space and the others become meaningless, which only happens in a union. In a structure each member keeps its own bytes and reading another is perfectly safe.

pairs.ne: एउटै साझा ठाउँ सबैभन्दा ठूलो member अट्ने हुनुपर्छ, अरू होइन — त्यसैले आकार सबैभन्दा ठूलोको हुन्छ, जोड होइन। Structure ले सबै जोड्छ, र मानक तुलनात्मक प्रश्न त्यही हो।
pairs.en: One shared space has to be big enough for the biggest member and no bigger, so the size is the largest and not the total. A structure adds its members up, which is the standard comparison question.

pairs.ne: उही दुई member, दुई पटक। बायाँको बनोटले structure को आकार किन जोड हुन्छ देखाउँछ; दायाँकोले union को आकार किन सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर हुन्छ, र एउटा member लेख्दा अर्को किन बदलिन्छ।
pairs.en: The same two members twice. The left layout is why a structure's size is the total; the right layout is why a union's is the largest member, and why writing one member changes the other.

pairs.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: structure भनेको के हो र array ले यसको काम किन गर्न सक्दैन भन्न, structure घोषणा गरेर त्यसको variable बनाउन र dot operator ले member मा पुग्न, union घोषणा गरेर यसका member मा पुग्न, union को एउटा member लेख्दा अरू किन बदलिन्छन् बुझाउन, उही member भएका structure र union को आकार दिएर किन फरक हुन्छ भन्न, र दिइएको समस्यामा दुईमध्ये एउटा छानेर कारण दिन सक्नुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: Choose between the two for a given problem and justify the choice.

pairs.ne: खोल्नुअघि scanf का लाइन लेख्नुहोस्। तीनमध्ये एउटा member लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन — कुन र किन, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Write the scanf lines before opening this. One of the three members takes no ampersand — decide which, and why.

pairs.ne: तीन कुराको अंक छ। बन्द brace पछिको semicolon। Student s1 अगाडिको struct शब्द। अनि dot operator: s1.roll को अर्थ "s1 variable को roll member" हो, र dot ले variable लाई member सँग जोड्छ — प्रकारलाई कहिल्यै होइन, किनभने Student.roll ले कुनै मेमोरी जनाउँदैन। अन्त्यको %% पनि हेर्नुहोस्: एउटै % लाई specifier को सुरु पढिन्थ्यो।
pairs.en: Three things are being marked. The semicolon after the closing brace. The word struct in front of Student s1. And the dot operator: s1.roll means "the roll member of the variable s1", and the dot joins a variable to a member — never a type to a member, because Student.roll names no memory. Note also %% at the end: a single % would be read as the start of a specifier.

pairs.ne: Structure कम्तीमा ९, union ४। Structure ले हरेक member लाई आफ्नै मेमोरी दिन्छ, त्यसैले आकार जोड हुन्छ: 4 + 1 + 4 = 9। Union ले एउटै साझा block दिन्छ, त्यसैले आकार सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर — ४। ठ्याक्कै ९ नभई "कम्तीमा" ९ भनिनुको कारण पनि जान्नु राम्रो: हरेक member लाई उसको प्रकारले मन पराउने ठेगानाबाट सुरु गराउन compiler ले padding भनिने प्रयोगविहीन byte थप्छ, त्यसैले वास्तविक मेसिनले प्रायः ९ होइन १२ भन्छ। नियम जोड हो; नाप ठूलो हुन सक्छ। परीक्षाले खोज्ने उत्तर "member को जोड" हो, र padding सँग भेट प्रयोगात्मक कक्षामा sizeof आफैं नापेर हुन्छ। विकल्प (क) मा दुई उत्तर साटिएका छन्, र यो प्रायः त्यसरी नै बिग्रन्छ।
pairs.en: Option A is the two answers swapped, which is the usual way this is got wrong.

pairs.ne: खोल्नुअघि s[i].roll कसरी पढिन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। कुन भाग index हो र कुन भाग member?
pairs.en: Decide how s[i].roll is read before opening this. Which part is the index and which part is the member?

pairs.ne: s[i].roll बायाँबाट दायाँ पढिन्छ: array को i औं element लिने, अनि त्यसको roll member। Index पहिले आउँछ, किनभने यो structure हरूको array हो, array हरूको structure होइन। scanf का दुई argument हेर्नुहोस्: s[i].name char array हो र ampersand लिँदैन, &s[i].roll int हो र लिन्छ — उही पुरानो नियम, structure भित्र लागू भएको। Structure नभए पाँच विद्यार्थीका लागि दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै array हातैले मिलाएर राख्नुपर्थ्यो।
pairs.en: s[i].roll reads left to right: take element i of the array, then take its roll member. The index comes first because the array is of structures, not a structure of arrays. Note the two scanf arguments: s[i].name is a char array and takes no ampersand, &s[i].roll is an int and does — the same rule as always, applied inside a structure. Without the structure, five students would need two separate arrays kept in step with each other by hand.

pairs.ne: बन्द brace पछि semicolon बिर्सनु: structure को घोषणा statement हो; function definition होइन। struct बिना Student s1; लेख्नु: C मा त्यो keyword प्रकारकै नामको भाग हो। Variable होइन प्रकारमा dot लगाउनु: Student.roll ले कुनै मेमोरी जनाउँदैन, s1.roll ले जनाउँछ। Union को आकार member को जोड भन्नु: त्यो सबैभन्दा ठूलो member को आकार हो। Union का दुवै member ले आफ्नो मान राख्छन् भन्ठान्नु: अन्तिम लेखिएको मात्र अर्थपूर्ण हुन्छ। scanf मा char array member अगाडि & राख्नु: s1.name आफैं ठेगाना हो; &s1.roll होइन।
pairs.en: Putting & before a char array member in scanf. s1.name is already an address; &s1.roll is not.

pairs.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ६ को सूचीबाट। यो यस साइटबाट गर्न मिल्दैन — साँच्चैको कम्प्युटरमा C compiler चाहिन्छ।
pairs.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 6. It cannot be done from this site — it needs a C compiler on a real computer.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ६.२, ६.३ र ६.६। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: नाम, roll र प्रतिशत भएको विद्यार्थीको structure, पढेर छाप्ने; उही structure लाई पाँच विद्यार्थीको array बनाएर loop मा पढ्ने र loop मै छाप्ने; अनि int र char member भएको union। दुई सङ्ख्या नापेर लेख्नुहोस्: उही member भएका आफ्नो structure र union को sizeof छापेर दुवै र किन फरक छन् लेख्नुहोस्। त्यही जोडी मानक तुलनात्मक प्रश्नको उत्तर हो — सुनेको होइन, आफ्नै मेसिनमा नापेको।
pairs.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 6.2, 6.3 and 6.6. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: a structure for a student with name, roll and percentage, read and printed; the same structure as an array of five students, read in a loop and printed in a loop; and a union with an int and a char member. Observe and record two numbers: print sizeof for your structure and for your union with the same members, and write both down with the reason they differ. That pair of numbers is the answer to the standard comparison question, measured on your own machine rather than taken on trust.

pairs.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ५ अंक र ६४ मध्ये ६ घण्टा ओगट्छ। सानो युनिट, र एउटै प्रश्न हावी छ: structure र union को फरक। त्यो, structure प्रयोग गरेको एउटा प्रोग्राम, अनि dot operator र हरेकको sizeof बारे छोटा प्रश्न अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: This unit carries 5 of the 50 external marks and 6 of the 64 theory hours. It is a small unit with one dominant question: differentiate between a structure and a union. Expect that, plus a program using a structure, and short questions on the dot operator and on what sizeof gives for each.

pairs.ne: Structure भनेको प्रयोगकर्ता-परिभाषित data type हो, जसले फरक data type का variable लाई एउटै नाममुनि समूहबद्ध गर्छ। भित्रका हरेक variable लाई member भनिन्छ र हरेकको आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ। Syntax: struct structure_name { data_type member1; data_type member2; }; उदाहरण: struct Student { char name[20]; int roll; float percent; }; अनि variable बनाउन struct Student s1;।
pairs.en: Example: struct Student { char name[20]; int roll; float percent; }; and then struct Student s1; to create a variable.

pairs.ne: १. मेमोरी: structure ले हरेक member लाई आफ्नै दिन्छ; union ले सबैलाई उही। २. आकार: structure को आकार सबै member को जोड; union को सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर। ३. एकैचोटि मान: structure मा सबै member का मान सँगै रहन्छन्; union मा अन्तिम लेखिएको मात्र अर्थपूर्ण। ४. Keyword: struct र union; dot operator सहित बाँकी syntax उस्तै। ५. प्रयोग: एउटै कुराबारे धेरै तथ्यको record लाई structure; एउटै member मात्र प्रयोगमा हुँदा मेमोरी बचाउन union। उदाहरण: { int n; char c; } मा structure लाई ५ byte चाहिन्छ र दुवै मान रहन्छन्, union लाई ४ चाहिन्छ र अन्तिम लेखिएको मात्र रहन्छ।
pairs.en: Example: for { int n; char c; } the structure needs 5 bytes and keeps both values, while the union needs 4 and keeps only the last one written.

pairs.ne: Structure ले फरक प्रकारका variable लाई एउटै नाममुनि राख्छ; हरेक member को आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ। Structure घोषणा गर्दा केही छुट्टिँदैन; त्यसको variable घोषणा गर्दा छुट्टिन्छ। बन्द brace पछिको semicolon अनिवार्य छ, र C मा struct प्रकारकै नामको भाग हो। Dot operator ले variable लाई member सँग जोड्छ: s1.roll। Union उही तरिकाले घोषणा हुन्छ र हरेक member लाई उही मेमोरी दिन्छ। Structure को आकार जोड; union को सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर। Union मा अन्तिम लेखिएको member सँग मात्र अर्थपूर्ण मान हुन्छ। Record का लागि structure, मेमोरी बचाउन union।
pairs.en: Use a structure for a record, a union to save memory.

pairs.ne: अन्तिम चरणअघि b.n ले के छाप्छ अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। झन्डै सबैले ६५ भन्छन्, किनभने त्यहाँ राखिएको त्यही थियो — र त्यसपछि कुनै लाइनले n को नाम लिएकै छैन।
pairs.en: Before the last step, predict what b.n will print. Almost everybody says 65, because that is what was put there — and no line since has mentioned n.

pairs.ne: दुई सुराकले union सधैं चिनाउँछन्: आकार जोड नभई सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर हुनु, र अर्को member लेखेपछि एउटा member अनौठो हुनु।
pairs.en: Two clues give a union away every time: a size equal to the largest member rather than the total, and a member going strange after a different member was written.

pairs.ne: एउटै कुराबारे धेरै फरक तथ्य हुँदा Array ले एउटै प्रकारका धेरै मान राख्छ। विद्यार्थीको record भनेको एउटै व्यक्तिबारे फरक प्रकारका धेरै मान हो: नाम (पाठ), roll नम्बर (integer), प्रतिशत (float)। त्यो कुनै array ले राख्न सक्दैन। Structure भनेको प्रयोगकर्ता-परिभाषित data type हो, जसले फरक प्रकारका variable लाई एउटै नाममुनि समूहबद्ध गर्छ। भित्रका हरेक variable लाई member भनिन्छ, र हरेक member को आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ। सफा देखिनुभन्दा बढी किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: struct Student बनेपछि तपाईंले structure को array बनाउन सक्नुहुन्छ — struct Student s[50]; — र एउटै घोषणाले पचास पूरा record राख्छ। मान्छे, सामान वा अंक राख्ने हरेक वास्तविक प्रोग्रामले गर्ने काम त्यही हो।
pairs.en: When one thing has several different facts about it An array holds many values of the same type. A student record is several values of different types about one person: a name (text), a roll number (an integer), a percentage (a float). No array can hold that. A structure is a user-defined data type that groups variables of different types under one name. Each variable inside it is a member, and every member has its own memory. Why it matters beyond tidiness: once struct Student exists, you can make an array of structures — struct Student s[50]; — and one declaration holds fifty complete records. That is what every real program storing people, products or marks actually does.

pairs.ne: घोषणा नक्सा हो, बाकस होइन Structure घोषणा गर्दा नयाँ data type बन्छ र मेमोरी बिलकुलै छुट्टिँदैन। यो त्यस्तो variable कस्तो हुन्छ भन्ने वर्णन मात्र हो — तलको worked example मा पूरै देखाइएको छ। त्यो प्रकारको variable घोषणा गर्दा मात्र मेमोरी छुट्टिन्छ: struct Student s1;। C मा struct keyword प्रकारको नाम कै भाग हो र छाड्न मिल्दैन — Student s1; मात्रले compile हुँदैन। बन्द गर्ने brace पछि semicolon अनिवार्य छ। Function definition भन्दा फरक, structure को घोषणा statement हो, र semicolon छुटे आउने त्रुटि सन्देशले अर्कै लाइन देखाउँछ र अरू केही बिग्रेजस्तो पढिन्छ।
pairs.en: The declaration is a blueprint, not a box Declaring a structure creates a new data type and reserves no memory at all. It is a description of what such a variable would look like — the worked example below shows one in full. Memory is reserved when you declare a variable of that type: struct Student s1;. The keyword struct is part of the type name in C and cannot be left out — Student s1; alone will not compile. The semicolon after the closing brace is compulsory. A structure declaration is a statement, unlike a function definition, and leaving the semicolon out produces an error message that points at the next line and reads as if something else were wrong.

pairs.ne: उही घोषणा, एउटै साझा बाकस Union लाई structure कै जस्तो घोषणा गरिन्छ, keyword मात्र union हुन्छ। यसले फरक प्रकारका member लाई एउटै नाममुनि राख्छ — र सबैलाई उही मेमोरी दिन्छ। त्यसैले union को आकार जोड होइन, सबैभन्दा ठूलो member को आकार हुन्छ। अनि एक पटकमा एउटै member सँग अर्थपूर्ण मान हुन्छ: एउटामा लेख्दा अरूले देखाइरहेको कुरा मेटिन्छ, किनभने byte को एउटै block छ र सबैले त्यही पढिरहेका छन्। कसैले किन त्यो चाहन्छ? मेमोरी बचाउन — जब कुनै मान कहिले एक प्रकारको र कहिले अर्को हुन्छ तर एकैचोटि दुवै कहिल्यै हुँदैन; जस्तै थोरै मेमोरी भएको यन्त्रमा कि पूर्ण गन्ती कि दशमलव नाप। Union हुनुको एकमात्र कारण मेमोरी बचत हो, र उत्तरमा दिनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।
pairs.en: The same declaration, one shared box A union is declared exactly like a structure, with the keyword union instead. It groups members of different types under one name — and it gives all of them the same memory. So a union's size is the size of its largest member, not the total. And only one member holds a meaningful value at a time: writing to one overwrites whatever the others were showing, because there is only one block of bytes and they are all reading it. Why would anyone want that? To save memory, when a value is sometimes one type and sometimes another but never both at once — a reading that is either a whole count or a decimal measurement, on a device with very little memory. Saving memory is the only reason a union exists, and it is the reason to give in an answer.

pairs.ne: ६.५ र ६.६ — घोषणा र पहुँच दुवै structure मा जस्तै ठ्याक्कै उसरी नै चल्छन्, र स्पष्ट भन्नुपर्ने कुरा त्यही हो: union Box b; ले variable घोषणा गर्छ, र b.n ले उही dot operator ले member मा पुग्छ। प्रोग्रामको कुनै ठाउँमा syntax ले union लाई structure बाट छुट्याउँदैन — न घोषणाले, न variable ले, न पहुँचले। फरक मेमोरीले के गर्छ भन्नेमा मात्र छ, र त्यसैले माथिको चित्र नै पूरै विषय हो। यसबाट एउटा व्यावहारिक नियम निस्कन्छ: अन्तिम पटक लेखेकै member पढ्नुहोस्। b.n लेखेर b.c पढ्नु compiler ले रोक्ने त्रुटि होइन, र आउने मान उही byte लाई फरक प्रकारका रूपमा पढेको नतिजा हो।
pairs.en: 6.5 and 6.6 — declaring and accessing Both work exactly as they do for a structure, and that is the point worth stating plainly: union Box b; declares the variable, and b.n reaches a member with the same dot operator. Nothing in the syntax distinguishes a union from a structure anywhere in a program — not the declaration, not the variable, not the access. The only difference is what the memory does, which is why the diagram above is the whole topic. One practical rule follows from it: read back the member you wrote last. Writing b.n and then reading b.c is not an error the compiler will stop, and the value you get is the same bytes interpreted as a different type.

pairs.ne: सम्झने तरिका — Structure: सबैलाई आ–आफ्नो कोठा। Union: सबैले एउटै कोठा बाँड्ने। आकार जोड, कि सबैभन्दा ठूलो।
pairs.en: Memory hook — Structure: everyone gets a room. Union: everyone shares one room. Size is the total, or the largest.

pairs.ne: Structure भनेको के हो? उदाहरणसहित यसको घोषणाको syntax लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is a structure? Write the syntax to declare one with an example.

pairs.ne: उदाहरणसहित structure र union को फरक लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Differentiate between a structure and a union with an example.

pairs.ne: int ४ byte, char १ र float ४ हुँदा { int n; char c; float f; } को structure र union को sizeof कति हुन्छ?
pairs.en: For { int n; char c; float f; } with int 4 bytes, char 1 and float 4, what is sizeof for the structure and for the union?

pairs.ne: Array ले खुला छाडेको प्रश्नको उत्तर नै structure हो: array ले एउटै प्रकारका धेरै मान राख्छ, record लाई फरक प्रकारका धेरै मान चाहिन्छ। Array को भाग पक्का भए मात्र यो तुलना बुझिन्छ।
pairs.en: A structure is the answer to the question an array leaves open: an array holds many values of ONE type, and a record needs several values of DIFFERENT types. The comparison only lands if the array half is solid.

pairs.ne: Union ले किन मेमोरी बचाउँछ भन्ने प्रश्न आकारको हो, र आकार २.५ हो — int ले कति byte लिन्छ, char ले कति। त्यो नभए "सबैभन्दा ठूलो member" सङ्ख्या नभई वाक्यांश मात्र हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Why a union saves memory is a question about SIZE, and size is 2.5 — how many bytes an int takes against a char. Without that, "the largest member" is a phrase rather than a number.

pairs.ne: Union ले सबै member लाई बाँड्न एउटै ठाउँ दिन्छ
pairs.en: A union gives its members one space to share

pairs.ne: Union को घोषणा structure कै जस्तो हुन्छ — keyword मात्र फरक। त्यही मिल्दोपनले दुईलाई अलमल्याउँछ, र परीक्षाले फरक सोध्नुको कारण पनि त्यही हो।
pairs.en: A union is DECLARED exactly like a structure — only the keyword differs. That similarity is why the two are confused and why the examination asks you to differentiate them.

pairs.ne: b बन्यो। यी member भएको structure ले दुवैका लागि ठाउँ छुट्याउँथ्यो; union ले सबैभन्दा ठूलो member अट्ने एउटै block छुट्याउँछ, र पूरै बचत त्यही हो।
pairs.en: b is created. A structure with these members would reserve space for BOTH; a union reserves one block, big enough for the largest member, and that is the whole saving.

pairs.ne: b.n मा 65 लेख्दा साझा block भरिन्छ। b.c ले अब उही byte लाई अक्षरका रूपमा पढ्छ, र 65 भनेको A अक्षरको सङ्केत हो — कसैले मागेको होइन, आफैं हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Writing 65 into b.n fills the shared block. b.c is now reading the same bytes as a character, and 65 is the code for the letter A — nobody asked for that, it simply follows.

pairs.ne: अन्तिम पटक लेखिएकै member पढ्दा अपेक्षित उत्तर आउँछ। लेखेकै member पढ्ने हो भने union पूरै भरपर्दो हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Reading back the member that was last written gives the expected answer. A union is perfectly reliable as long as you read the member you wrote.

pairs.ne: अब b.c मा X लेखियो। X को सङ्केत 88 हो, र त्यो उही block मा जान्छ — त्यसैले n को नाम नै नलिएको लाइनले b.n बदलिदियो।
pairs.en: Now X is written into b.c. X has the code 88, and it goes into the SAME block — so b.n has just been changed by a line that never mentioned n.

pairs.ne: b.c पढ्दा अपेक्षाअनुसार X आउँछ।
pairs.en: b.c is read and gives X, as expected.

pairs.ne: अनि b.n अब 88 छ, 65 होइन। पहिलो मान गयो। STRUCTURE मा दुवै member का आफ्नै मान रहन्थे, र मानक तुलनात्मक प्रश्नको उत्तर त्यही एउटा फरक हो।
pairs.en: And b.n is now 88, not 65. The first value is gone. In a STRUCTURE both members would still hold their own values, and that single difference is the answer to the standard comparison question.

pairs.en: A collection of elements of the same data type in continuous memory

pairs.en: A user-defined data type that groups variables of DIFFERENT data types under one name

pairs.en: Another name for an array of characters

pairs.en: 65 — n was never written to again

pairs.ne: ८८ — दुवै member ले एउटै block बाँड्छन्, त्यसैले c लेख्दा n मेटियो
pairs.en: 88 — the two members share one block, so writing c overwrote n

pairs.ne: १५३ — दुई मान जोडिन्छन्
pairs.en: 153 — the two values are added

pairs.ne: ० — हरेक पटक लेखेपछि union खाली हुन्छ
pairs.en: 0 — the union is cleared after each write

pairs.en: After the closing brace of a function definition

pairs.ne: Union, किनभने एक पटकमा एउटै member प्रयोगमा हुन्छ — एउटै block बाँड्दा केही खेर जाँदैन र बाँकी बच्छ

pairs.en: union Box { int n; char c; }; On a machine where int is 4 bytes and char is 1, what is sizeof(union Box)?

pairs.en: union Box b; b.n = 65; then b.c = 88; then printf("%d", b.n); What is printed?

pairs.ne: Sensor को रिडिङ कहिले पूर्ण गन्ती र कहिले दशमलव नाप हुन्छ, एकैचोटि कहिल्यै दुवै हुँदैन, र यन्त्रमा मेमोरी निकै थोरै छ। कुन चलाउने र किन?

pairs.en: Introduction to structure

pairs.en: Accessing a member — the dot operator

pairs.ne: — Union को परिचय
pairs.en: Write the scanf lines before opening this. One of the three members takes no ampersand — decide which, and why. खोल्नुअघि scanf का लाइन लेख्नुहोस्। तीनमध्ये एउटा member लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन — कुन र किन, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। Working #include <stdio.h> struct Student /* 1. the blueprint — no memory used yet */ { char name[20]; int roll; float percent; }; /* the semicolon here is compulsory */ int main() { struct Student s1; /* 2. NOW memory is reserved */ printf("Name : "); scanf("%s", s1.name); /* no & — an array name is an address */ printf("Roll : "); scanf("%d", &s1.roll); /* & — roll is an ordinary int */ printf("Percent: "); scanf("%f", &s1.percent); printf("\n%s has roll %d and scored %.2f%%", s1.name, s1.roll, s1.percent); return 0; } Output (if the user types Sita, 15 and 82.5) Name : Sita Roll : 15 Percent: 82.5 Sita has roll 15 and scored 82.50% Three things are being marked. The semicolon after the closing brace. The word struct in front of Student s1. And the dot operator: s1.roll means "the roll member of the variable s1", and the dot joins a variable to a member — never a type to a member, because Student.roll names no memory. Note also %% at the end: a single % would be read as the start of a specifier. तीन कुराको अंक छ। बन्द brace पछिको semicolon। Student s1 अगाडिको struct शब्द। अनि dot operator: s1.roll को अर्थ "s1 variable को roll member" हो, र dot ले variable लाई member सँग जोड्छ — प्रकारलाई कहिल्यै होइन, किनभने Student.roll ले कुनै मेमोरी जनाउँदैन। अन्त्यको %% पनि हेर्नुहोस्: एउटै % लाई specifier को सुरु पढिन्थ्यो। 6.4 Introduction to union

pairs.ne: — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू ७ घण्टा
pairs.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् For { int n; char c; float f; } with int 4 bytes, char 1 and float 4, what is sizeof for the structure and for the union? int ४ byte, char १ र float ४ हुँदा { int n; char c; float f; } को structure र union को sizeof कति हुन्छ? Structure 4, union 9 Structure at least 9, union 4 Both 9 The structure is at least 9 and the union is 4. A structure gives every member its own memory, so its size is the total: 4 + 1 + 4 = 9. A union gives them one shared block, so its size is the largest member: 4. "At least" 9 rather than exactly 9, and this is worth knowing. Compilers insert unused bytes called padding so that each member starts at an address its type likes, so a real machine will often report 12 rather than 9. The rule is the total; the measurement may be larger. Saying "the sum of the members" is the expected examination answer, and measuring it yourself with sizeof in the practical is how you meet padding. Option A is the two answers swapped, which is the usual way this is got wrong. Structure कम्तीमा ९, union ४। Structure ले हरेक member लाई आफ्नै मेमोरी दिन्छ, त्यसैले आकार जोड हुन्छ: 4 + 1 + 4 = 9। Union ले एउटै साझा block दिन्छ, त्यसैले आकार सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर — ४। ठ्याक्कै ९ नभई "कम्तीमा" ९ भनिनुको कारण पनि जान्नु राम्रो: हरेक member लाई उसको प्रकारले मन पराउने ठेगानाबाट सुरु गराउन compiler ले padding भनिने प्रयोगविहीन byte थप्छ, त्यसैले वास्तविक मेसिनले प्रायः ९ होइन १२ भन्छ। नियम जोड हो; नाप ठूलो हुन सक्छ। परीक्षाले खोज्ने उत्तर "member को जोड" हो, र padding सँग भेट प्रयोगात्मक कक्षामा sizeof आफैं नापेर हुन्छ। विकल्प (क) मा दुई उत्तर साटिएका छन्, र यो प्रायः त्यसरी नै बिग्रन्छ। Example 2 Five students in one array of structures Question: hold the records of five students and print them all. This is what the structure was for. Decide how s[i].roll is read before opening this. Which part is the index and which part is the member? खोल्नुअघि s[i].roll कसरी पढिन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। कुन भाग index हो र कुन भाग member? Working #include <stdio.h> struct Student { char name[20]; int roll; }; int main() { struct Student s[5]; /* FIVE complete records */ int i; for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) { printf("Student %d name and roll: ", i + 1); scanf("%s %d", s[i].name, &s[i].roll); } for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d - %s\n", s[i].roll, s[i].name); return 0; } s[i].roll reads left to right: take element i of the array, then take its roll member. The index comes first because the array is of structures, not a structure of arrays. Note the two scanf arguments: s[i].name is a char array and takes no ampersand, &s[i].roll is an int and does — the same rule as always, applied inside a structure. Without the structure, five students would need two separate arrays kept in step with each other by hand. s[i].roll बायाँबाट दायाँ पढिन्छ: array को i औं element लिने, अनि त्यसको roll member। Index पहिले आउँछ, किनभने यो structure हरूको array हो, array हरूको structure होइन। scanf का दुई argument हेर्नुहोस्: s[i].name char array हो र ampersand लिँदैन, &s[i].roll int हो र लिन्छ — उही पुरानो नियम, structure भित्र लागू भएको। Structure नभए पाँच विद्यार्थीका लागि दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै array हातैले मिलाएर राख्नुपर्थ्यो। Mistakes that cost marks here Forgetting the semicolon after the closing brace. A structure declaration is a statement; a function definition is not. Writing Student s1; without struct. In C the keyword is part of the type name. Using the dot on the type instead of a variable. Student.roll names no memory; s1.roll does. Saying a union's size is the total of its members. It is the size of the largest one. Expecting both union members to keep their values. Only the one written last is meaningful. Putting & before a char array member in scanf. s1.name is already an address; &s1.roll is not. बन्द brace पछि semicolon बिर्सनु: structure को घोषणा statement हो; function definition होइन। struct बिना Student s1; लेख्नु: C मा त्यो keyword प्रकारकै नामको भाग हो। Variable होइन प्रकारमा dot लगाउनु: Student.roll ले कुनै मेमोरी जनाउँदैन, s1.roll ले जनाउँछ। Union को आकार member को जोड भन्नु: त्यो सबैभन्दा ठूलो member को आकार हो। Union का दुवै member ले आफ्नो मान राख्छन् भन्ठान्नु: अन्तिम लेखिएको मात्र अर्थपूर्ण हुन्छ। scanf मा char array member अगाडि & राख्नु: s1.name आफैं ठेगाना हो; &s1.roll होइन। Memory hook — Structure: everyone gets a room. Union: everyone shares one room. Size is the total, or the largest. सम्झने तरिका — Structure: सबैलाई आ–आफ्नो कोठा। Union: सबैले एउटै कोठा बाँड्ने। आकार जोड, कि सबैभन्दा ठूलो। Practical work — this unit's other 7 hours
englishVariants:
Three of the four printf lines below are easy. Decide what &p prints and why it is different from p. तलका चार printf मध्ये तीन सजिलो छन्। &p ले के छाप्छ र p भन्दा किन फरक हुन्छ, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। Working #include <stdio.h> int main() { int n = 25; int *p; p = &n; /* p now holds the address of n */ printf("Value of n : %d
", n); printf("Address of n : %p
", (void *) &n); printf("Value in p : %p
", (void *) p); /* same as &n */ printf("Value at p (*p) : %d
", *p); /* same as n */ printf("Address of p : %p
", (void *) &p); /* p's OWN address */ *p = 50; /* write through the pointer */ printf("n is now : %d
", n); return 0; } Output — the addresses here are illustrative; read the note Value of n : 25 Address of n : 0x7ffd1a2b3c4c Value in p : 0x7ffd1a2b3c4c Value at p (*p) : 25 Address of p : 0x7ffd1a2b3c40 n is now : 50 Lines 2 and 3 print the same number, which is the point: p's value is n's address. Line 5 prints a different one, because p is itself a variable living somewhere of its own. And the last two lines are the unit in miniature — a line that does not mention n changes n. दोस्रो र तेस्रो लाइनले उही सङ्ख्या छाप्छन्, र मुख्य कुरा त्यही हो: p को मान नै n को ठेगाना हो। पाँचौंले फरक छाप्छ, किनभने p आफैं कतै बस्ने variable हो। अन्तिम दुई लाइन पूरै युनिटको सानो रूप हुन् — n को नाम नलिने लाइनले n बदल्छ। Three things in that output are not promised. The addresses change on every run. The shape of them belongs to the compiler's library: gcc on Linux writes an address as 0x7ffd1a2b3c4c, and MinGW gcc on Windows writes the same kind of address as 000000F7EBBFF74C — sixteen digits, upper case, no 0x. And whether p sits above or below n is the compiler's business: when this listing was run on Windows to check it, p turned out to be twelve bytes below n. What is promised is the relationship — lines 2 and 3 equal, line 5 different. The (void *) before each address is there because %p is defined to take a void *; most textbooks write printf("%p", &n) and most compilers accept it, but gcc -Wall will tell you about it. त्यो output का तीन कुराको वाचा छैन। ठेगाना हरेक पटक फेरिन्छ। त्यसको रूप compiler को library को कुरा हो: Linux को gcc ले 0x7ffd1a2b3c4c लेख्छ, Windows को MinGW gcc ले उही किसिमको ठेगानालाई 000000F7EBBFF74C लेख्छ — सोह्र अङ्क, ठूलो अक्षर, 0x छैन। र p, n भन्दा माथि बस्छ कि तल — त्यो compiler को कुरा हो: यो listing जाँच्न Windows मा चलाउँदा p, n भन्दा बाह्र byte तल निस्कियो। वाचा भएको कुरा सम्बन्ध हो — दोस्रो र तेस्रो लाइन बराबर, पाँचौं फरक। हरेक ठेगानाअघिको (void *) त्यहाँ छ किनभने %p ले void * लिने परिभाषा छ; धेरै पाठ्यपुस्तक printf("%p", &n) लेख्छन् र धेरै compiler ले मान्छन्, तर gcc -Wall ले यसबारे भनिदिन्छ। Example 2 The scanf you have been writing since Unit 2 Question: explain, using this unit's vocabulary, why scanf needs &n for an int and nothing for a char array. Answer it in one sentence before opening this, using the word "address" twice. खोल्नुअघि "ठेगाना" शब्द दुई पटक प्रयोग गरेर एक वाक्यमा उत्तर दिनुहोस्। Working #include <stdio.h> int main() { int n; char name[20]; scanf("%d", &n); /* & REQUIRED : n is an ordinary int */ scanf("%s", name); /* no & : the array name IS an */ /* address already */ printf("%d %s", n, name); return 0; } WHY scanf NEEDS AN ADDRESS AT ALL Arguments in C are passed BY VALUE, so a function receives copies. scanf has to change the caller's variable, and it cannot change a copy. It therefore takes the ADDRESS and writes through it — which is call by reference, and which is this unit. WHY THE ARRAY TAKES NO AMPERSAND An array name used on its own already IS the address of its first element. Writing &name is asking for the address of something that is one, which is not what scanf wants here. printf TAKES NEITHER printf only READS its arguments, so copies are enough and no address is needed. Nothing in this program is new. The only thing that changed between Unit 2 and now is that you can say why — and that sentence is what a two-mark question on pointers is actually asking for. यस प्रोग्राममा नयाँ केही छैन। युनिट २ देखि अहिलेसम्म बदलिएको एउटै कुरा हो — अब तपाईं किन भन्न सक्नुहुन्छ। Pointer बारे दुई अंकको प्रश्नले साँच्चै खोज्ने वाक्य त्यही हो। Mistakes that cost marks here Confusing p with *p. One is an address, the other is the value there. Thinking the star in int *p; dereferences. There it is part of the type; it only dereferences in a statement. Dereferencing a pointer that was never given an address. It holds garbage, and the program crashes. Writing p = n; instead of p = &n;. That stores a value where an address belongs. Putting & before an array name. The name is already the address of the first element. Quoting a specific address as a fact. It changes every run; say "the address of n", never "1000". p र *p मिसाउनु: एउटा ठेगाना, अर्को त्यहाँको मान। int *p; को star ले dereference गर्छ भन्ठान्नु: त्यहाँ त्यो प्रकारको भाग हो; dereference statement मा मात्र गर्छ। ठेगाना नदिइएको pointer dereference गर्नु: त्यसमा garbage हुन्छ र प्रोग्राम crash हुन्छ। p = &n; को ठाउँमा p = n; लेख्नु: ठेगाना चाहिने ठाउँमा मान राखिन्छ। Array को नाम अगाडि & राख्नु: नाम आफैं पहिलो element को ठेगाना हो। कुनै निश्चित ठेगानालाई तथ्य भन्नु: त्यो हरेक पटक बदलिन्छ; "n को ठेगाना" भन्नुहोस्, "१०००" कहिल्यै होइन। Memory hook — & asks "where?", * asks "what's there?" Address out, value out — opposite directions. सम्झने तरिका — & ले "कहाँ?" सोध्छ, * ले "त्यहाँ के छ?" ठेगाना बाहिर, मान बाहिर — उल्टा दिशा। Practical work — this unit's other 7 hours

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: b.c को मात्र नाम लिने लाइनले b.n ले पढ्ने कुरा बदल्छ। साझा मेमोरीको पङ्क्ति हेर्नुहोस्: त्यहाँ एउटै मान छ, र दुवै member त्यसलाई पढ्ने दुई तरिका मात्र हुन्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: that a line naming only b.c changes what b.n reads back. Watch the shared-memory row: it has one value, and both members are simply two ways of reading it.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्रोग्रामलाई के चाहिन्छ हेरेर दुईमध्ये छान्न — परीक्षाको प्रश्न यही रूपमा आउँछ। निर्णय गर्ने प्रश्न यही हो: एकैचोटि एकभन्दा बढी member सँग मान हुनुपर्छ कि पर्दैन?
pairs.en: What you will learn: to choose between them from what the program needs, which is the form the examination question takes. The deciding question is whether more than one member must hold a value at the same time.

pairs.ne: Pointer हरेक हिसाबले सामान्य variable नै हो — यसको प्रकार, नाम र आफ्नै ठेगाना हुन्छ — र यसले राख्ने कुरा परिमाण नभई स्थान हो। int *p; p = &n; पछि p सँग n कहाँ बस्छ भन्ने हुन्छ, n मा के छ भन्ने होइन। त्यहाँबाट मानसम्म पुग्ने तरिका *p हो, र यी दुई मिसाउनु हुँदैन: p ठेगाना हो र *p त्यहाँको सङ्ख्या।
pairs.en: A pointer is an ordinary variable in every respect — it has a type, a name and an address of its own — and what it holds is a location rather than a quantity. int *p; p = &n; leaves p holding where n lives, not what n contains. *p is how you reach the value from there, and the two must not be confused: p is an address and *p is the number at it.

pairs.ne: & address-of operator हो: variable अगाडि लेख्दा त्यो variable कहाँ बस्छ भन्ने दिन्छ। * value-at वा dereference operator हो: pointer अगाडि लेख्दा pointer ले बोकेको ठेगानामा भएको कुरा दिन्छ। यी उल्टा दिशामा चल्छन् र एकअर्कालाई उल्ट्याउँछन्, त्यसैले *(&n) भनेको n नै हो। विकल्प (क) मा दुई परिभाषा साटिएका छन्, र यो प्रायः त्यसरी नै बिग्रन्छ।
pairs.en: & is the address-of operator: written before a variable, it gives where that variable lives. * is the value-at, or dereference, operator: written before a pointer, it gives what is stored at the address the pointer holds. They work in opposite directions and undo each other, so *(&n) is simply n. Option A is the two definitions swapped, which is the usual way this is got wrong.

pairs.ne: *p = *p + 3 लाई "p को ठेगानाको मान बराबर p को ठेगानाको मान जोड तीन" भनेर पढ्नुहोस्। P को ठेगानाको मान n हो, त्यसैले यो लाइन n = n + 3 कै अर्को लेखाइ हो र n १० हुन्छ। कसैसँग ठेगाना छ भने नाम नै नलिने लाइनले variable बदल्न सक्छ — यो जादू होइन, युनिट २ देखि scanf("%d", &n) ले गरिरहेकै काम हो। n होइन p छापेको भए ठेगाना देखिन्थ्यो; पूरै फरक एउटा star को हो।
pairs.en: Read *p = *p + 3 as "the value at p becomes the value at p plus three". The value at p is n, so this line is n = n + 3 written another way, and n becomes 10. A variable can be changed by a line that never names it, provided something holds its address — which is not a trick but exactly what scanf("%d", &n) has been doing since Unit 2. Printing p rather than n would show an address; one star is the whole difference.

pairs.ne: int *p; ले p लाई int को pointer घोषणा गर्छ — त्यहाँको star प्रकारको भाग हो, dereference होइन। अनि p = &n; ले यसमा n को ठेगाना राख्छ। विकल्प (ग) ले pointer त ठिकै घोषणा गर्छ तर ठेगाना चाहिने ठाउँमा मान राख्छ। विकल्प (क) ले सामान्य int घोषणा गर्छ, र (घ) ले सामान्य int घोषणा गरेर त्यसलाई dereference गर्छ, जुन compiler ले स्वीकार गर्दैन।
pairs.en: int *p; declares p as a pointer to an int — the star there is part of the type, not a dereference. p = &n; then stores n's address in it. Option C declares the pointer correctly and then puts a VALUE where an address belongs. Option A declares an ordinary int, and option D declares an ordinary int and then dereferences it, which is not something the compiler will accept.

pairs.ne: Call by reference यस विषयले पहिल्यै दुई पटक भर परेको फाइदा हो: युनिट २ देखि हरेक scanf को ampersand, र युनिट ४ को swap function। अरू फाइदा हुन् — प्रतिलिपि नबनाई array पठाउनु, प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा मेमोरी छुट्याउनु, र linked list जस्ता data structure बनाउनु। विकल्प (घ) सत्यको ठिक उल्टो हो — C ले bound जाँच्दै जाँच्दैन, र pointer लाई शक्तिशाली बनाउने सम्झौताकै भाग त्यो हो।
pairs.en: Call by reference is the advantage this subject has already relied on twice: the ampersand in every scanf since Unit 2, and the swap function in Unit 4. The other advantages are passing an array without copying it, allocating memory while the program runs, and building data structures such as linked lists. Option D is the opposite of the truth — C checks no bounds at all, which is part of the same bargain that makes pointers powerful.

pairs.ne: यहाँ कुन pointer operator चाहिन्छ?
pairs.en: Which pointer operator is needed here?

pairs.ne: दुई operator, उल्टा दिशा। Ampersand ले variable बाट ठेगाना निकाल्छ; star ले ठेगानाबाट मान निकाल्छ। लाइन कुन दिशामा गइरहेको छ, त्यही निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Two operators, opposite directions. The ampersand takes an address out of a variable; the star takes a value out of an address. Decide which direction the line is travelling.

pairs.ne: & — ठेगाना लिने
pairs.en: & — address of

pairs.ne: * — ठेगानाको मान
pairs.en: * — value at

pairs.ne: दुवै होइन
pairs.en: Neither

pairs.ne: Pointer ले ठेगाना राख्छ, त्यसैले भण्डारण गर्नुअघि n बाट n को ठेगाना निकाल्नुपर्छ। ठेगाना निकाल्ने एकमात्र operator ampersand हो, र pointer लाई तेर्स्याउने मानक तरिका यही लाइन हो।
pairs.en: A pointer stores an address, so the address of n has to be taken out of n before it can be stored. The ampersand is the only operator that produces an address, and this line is the standard way to aim a pointer.

pairs.ne: Pointer सँग ठेगाना छ, र त्यहाँको मान छाप्न पहिले pointer पछ्याउनुपर्छ। Star ले त्यही पछ्याउँछ — dereference को अर्थ त्यही हो, र यसलाई "ठेगानाको मान" भनेर पढिन्छ।
pairs.en: The pointer holds an address, and printing the value stored there means following the pointer first. The star does that following, which is what dereferencing means and why it is read as value at.

pairs.ne: Array को एउटा element सामान्य int variable जस्तै हो, त्यसैले scanf लाई यसको ठेगाना चाहिन्छ। Array को नाम मात्र भए ठेगाना हुन्छ, तर कोष्ठकसहितको एउटा element हुँदैन — यहीँ विद्यार्थी अल्झिन्छन्।
pairs.en: One element of an array is an ordinary int variable, so scanf still needs its address. The array name alone is already an address, but a single element written with brackets is not, and this trips students.

pairs.ne: Array को नाम आफैंमा पहिलो element को ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले यहाँ अगाडि ampersand लेख्नु आवश्यक छैन। विषयभरिमा ampersand नचाहिने scanf यही हो, र यसबारे बारम्बार सोधिन्छ।
pairs.en: An array name already is the address of its first element, so writing an ampersand in front of it is unnecessary here. This is the one scanf in the subject that takes no ampersand, and it is asked about often.

pairs.ne: Function भित्र a सँग ठेगाना छ, त्यसैले त्यो ठेगानामा भएको मानसम्म star ले पुगिन्छ। t = a लेखे ठेगाना नै int मा सर्थ्यो, र swap ले केही साट्दैनथ्यो।
pairs.en: Inside the function a holds an address, so the value living at that address is reached with the star. Writing t = a would copy the address into an int instead, and the swap would then exchange nothing.

pairs.ne: दुई variable, हरेक आफ्नै ठेगानामा। तीर कतै भण्डारण हुँदैन — यो p भित्रको मान बाट n को स्थान सम्म कोरिएको हो, र pointer भनेकै त्यही हो।
pairs.en: Two variables, each at its own address. The arrow is not stored anywhere — it is drawn from the value inside p to the location of n, which is exactly what a pointer is.

pairs.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: pointer भनेको के हो र यसले मानको ठाउँमा के राख्छ भन्न, pointer variable घोषणा गरेर कुनै variable तिर तेर्स्याउन, & र * चलाउन अनि हरेक कुन दिशामा काम गर्छ भन्न, pointer मार्फत variable बदल्ने प्रोग्राम पढेर output अनुमान गर्न, र pointer का फाइदा दिन अनि यसै विषयमा तपाईंले पहिल्यै दुई ठाउँमा pointer मा भर परिसक्नुभएको छ भन्ने देखाउन सक्नुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: Give the advantages of pointers, and name the two places in this subject you have already relied on one.

pairs.ne: कागजमा सबैभन्दा हलुका, तर हलुका युनिट होइन। ६४ मध्ये चार घण्टा र ५० मध्ये २ अंक — अरू कुनै युनिटभन्दा कम। तर प्रयोगात्मक सात घण्टा छन्, र तपाईंले पहिल्यै भेटिसकेका दुई विषय पनि: युनिट २ देखि हरेक scanf मा आएको &, र युनिट ४ को पूरै call by reference। यस युनिटले तपाईंले चलाइरहेकै कुरालाई नाम दिन्छ।
pairs.en: The lightest unit on paper, and not a light unit. Four of the 64 theory hours and 2 of the 50 external marks — less than any other unit. Seven practical hours, though, and two topics you have already met: the & in every scanf since Unit 2, and the whole of call by reference in Unit 4. This unit names what you have been using.

pairs.ne: १०। *p = *p + 3; लाई "p को ठेगानाको मान बराबर p को ठेगानाको मान जोड तीन" भनेर पढ्नुहोस्। P को ठेगानाको मान नै n हो, त्यसैले यो n = n + 3 कै अर्को लेखाइ हो। विकल्प (क) यस युनिटले हटाउन खोजेकै विश्वास हो: कसैसँग ठेगाना छ भने नाम नलिने लाइनले पनि variable बदल्न सक्छ। यो जादू होइन — युनिट २ देखि scanf("%d", &n) ले गरिरहेकै काम हो, र युनिट ४ को call by reference ले गर्ने पनि त्यही। विकल्प (ग) ले p र *p मिसाउँछ। p छापे ठेगाना देखिन्थ्यो; n वा *p छापे १०। पूरै फरक एउटा star को हो।
pairs.en: Option C confuses p with *p. Printing p would show an address; printing n or *p shows 10. One star is the whole difference.

pairs.ne: तलका चार printf मध्ये तीन सजिलो छन्। &p ले के छाप्छ र p भन्दा किन फरक हुन्छ, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Three of the four printf lines below are easy. Decide what &p prints and why it is different from p.

pairs.ne: दोस्रो र तेस्रो लाइनले उही सङ्ख्या छाप्छन्, र मुख्य कुरा त्यही हो: p को मान नै n को ठेगाना हो। पाँचौंले फरक छाप्छ, किनभने p आफैं कतै बस्ने variable हो। अन्तिम दुई लाइन पूरै युनिटको सानो रूप हुन् — n को नाम नलिने लाइनले n बदल्छ।
pairs.en: Lines 2 and 3 print the same number, which is the point: p's value is n's address. Line 5 prints a different one, because p is itself a variable living somewhere of its own. And the last two lines are the unit in miniature — a line that does not mention n changes n.

pairs.ne: त्यो output का तीन कुराको वाचा छैन। ठेगाना हरेक पटक फेरिन्छ। त्यसको रूप compiler को library को कुरा हो: Linux को gcc ले 0x7ffd1a2b3c4c लेख्छ, Windows को MinGW gcc ले उही किसिमको ठेगानालाई 000000F7EBBFF74C लेख्छ — सोह्र अङ्क, ठूलो अक्षर, 0x छैन। र p, n भन्दा माथि बस्छ कि तल — त्यो compiler को कुरा हो: यो listing जाँच्न Windows मा चलाउँदा p, n भन्दा बाह्र byte तल निस्कियो। वाचा भएको कुरा सम्बन्ध हो — दोस्रो र तेस्रो लाइन बराबर, पाँचौं फरक। हरेक ठेगानाअघिको (void *) त्यहाँ छ किनभने %p ले void * लिने परिभाषा छ; धेरै पाठ्यपुस्तक printf("%p", &n) लेख्छन् र धेरै compiler ले मान्छन्, तर gcc -Wall ले यसबारे भनिदिन्छ।
pairs.en: Three things in that output are not promised. The addresses change on every run. The shape of them belongs to the compiler's library: gcc on Linux writes an address as 0x7ffd1a2b3c4c, and MinGW gcc on Windows writes the same kind of address as 000000F7EBBFF74C — sixteen digits, upper case, no 0x. And whether p sits above or below n is the compiler's business: when this listing was run on Windows to check it, p turned out to be twelve bytes below n. What is promised is the relationship — lines 2 and 3 equal, line 5 different. The (void *) before each address is there because %p is defined to take a void *; most textbooks write printf("%p", &n) and most compilers accept it, but gcc -Wall will tell you about it.

pairs.ne: खोल्नुअघि "ठेगाना" शब्द दुई पटक प्रयोग गरेर एक वाक्यमा उत्तर दिनुहोस्।
pairs.en: Answer it in one sentence before opening this, using the word "address" twice.

pairs.ne: यस प्रोग्राममा नयाँ केही छैन। युनिट २ देखि अहिलेसम्म बदलिएको एउटै कुरा हो — अब तपाईं किन भन्न सक्नुहुन्छ। Pointer बारे दुई अंकको प्रश्नले साँच्चै खोज्ने वाक्य त्यही हो।
pairs.en: Nothing in this program is new. The only thing that changed between Unit 2 and now is that you can say why — and that sentence is what a two-mark question on pointers is actually asking for.

pairs.ne: p र *p मिसाउनु: एउटा ठेगाना, अर्को त्यहाँको मान। int *p; को star ले dereference गर्छ भन्ठान्नु: त्यहाँ त्यो प्रकारको भाग हो; dereference statement मा मात्र गर्छ। ठेगाना नदिइएको pointer dereference गर्नु: त्यसमा garbage हुन्छ र प्रोग्राम crash हुन्छ। p = &n; को ठाउँमा p = n; लेख्नु: ठेगाना चाहिने ठाउँमा मान राखिन्छ। Array को नाम अगाडि & राख्नु: नाम आफैं पहिलो element को ठेगाना हो। कुनै निश्चित ठेगानालाई तथ्य भन्नु: त्यो हरेक पटक बदलिन्छ; "n को ठेगाना" भन्नुहोस्, "१०००" कहिल्यै होइन।
pairs.en: Quoting a specific address as a fact. It changes every run; say "the address of n", never "1000".

pairs.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ७ को सूचीबाट। दुई बाह्य अंकको तुलनामा सात प्रयोगात्मक घण्टा — पाठ्यक्रमले यहाँ जाँच्नुभन्दा धेरै गर्न खोजेको छ, र pointer का लागि त्यही ठिक छ। यो यस साइटबाट गर्न मिल्दैन: साँच्चैको कम्प्युटरमा C compiler चाहिन्छ।
pairs.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 7. Seven practical hours against two external marks — the curriculum expects far more doing than examining here, and that is the right way round for pointers. It cannot be done from this site: it needs a C compiler on a real computer.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ७.२, ७.३ र युनिट ४ को call by reference। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: variable को मान र ठेगाना छाप्ने; pointer मार्फत variable बदल्ने; pointer ले दुई सङ्ख्या साट्ने; अनि हरेक element दोब्बर पार्ने function लाई array पठाएर main मा फेरि छापेर बदलियो भनी देखाउने। ध्यान दिएर लेख्ने: पहिलो प्रोग्राम तीन पटक चलाएर हरेक पटकको ठेगाना लेख्नुहोस्। ती फरक हुनेछन्, र आफैंले त्यो देख्नुले तपाईंलाई कहिल्यै प्रोग्राममा ठेगाना लेख्नबाट रोक्छ।
pairs.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 7.2, 7.3 and Unit 4's call by reference. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: print a variable's value and address; change a variable through a pointer; swap two numbers using pointers; and pass an array to a function that doubles every element, then print the array back in main to prove it changed. Observe and record: run your first program three times and write down the address each time. They will differ, and seeing that for yourself is what stops you ever writing an address into a program.

pairs.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये २ अंक ओगट्छ — विषयको सबैभन्दा सानो हिस्सा — र ६४ मध्ये ४ घण्टा। छोटो प्रश्न अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस्: pointer को परिभाषा; घोषणाको syntax; & र * ले के गर्छन्; pointer का दुई फाइदा। यस युनिटबाट मात्र लामो प्रश्न आउने सम्भावना कम छ। तर युनिट ४ को १० अंक छ र त्यसको लामो प्रश्नलाई यही युनिट चाहिन्छ, त्यसैले यहाँ खर्चिएको समय दुई अंकका लागि मात्र होइन।
pairs.en: This unit carries 2 of the 50 external marks — the smallest share in the subject — and 4 of the 64 theory hours. Expect a short question: define a pointer; write the syntax to declare one; what do & and * do; give two advantages of pointers. A long question from this unit alone is unlikely. But Unit 4 is worth 10 marks and its long question needs this unit, so time spent here is not spent for two marks.

pairs.ne: Pointer भनेको आफ्नो मान नभई अर्को variable को मेमोरी ठेगाना राख्ने variable हो। Syntax: data_type *pointer_name; उदाहरण: int n = 25; int *p; p = &n; — यहाँ p integer को pointer हो र अहिले n को ठेगाना बोकेको छ। *p ले २५ दिन्थ्यो।
pairs.en: Example: int n = 25; int *p; p = &n; — here p is a pointer to an integer and now holds the address of n. *p would give 25.

pairs.ne: & address-of operator हो — variable अगाडि लेखिन्छ र त्यसको मेमोरी ठेगाना दिन्छ। * value-at वा dereference operator हो — pointer अगाडि लेखिन्छ र pointer ले बोकेको ठेगानामा भएको मान दिन्छ। दुवै उल्टो दिशामा चल्छन्, त्यसैले *(&n) भनेको n नै हो। फाइदा (कुनै दुई): function ले बोलाउनेका variable बदल्न सक्नु — call by reference; array प्रतिलिपि नबनाई function लाई पठाइनु; प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा मेमोरी छुट्याउन सकिनु; linked list जस्ता data structure बनाउन सकिनु।
pairs.en: Advantages (any two): a function can change the caller's variables, which is call by reference; arrays are passed to functions without being copied; memory can be allocated while the program runs; and data structures such as linked lists can be built.

pairs.ne: Pointer भनेको अर्को variable को ठेगाना राख्ने variable हो। int *p; ले int को pointer घोषणा गर्छ; त्यहाँको star प्रकारकै भाग हो। & ले ठेगाना दिन्छ; * ले ठेगानाको मान — यी उल्टा हुन्। *p = 50; ले नाम नलिई p ले देखाएको variable बदल्छ। ठेगाना हरेक पटक बदलिन्छ, त्यसैले प्रोग्रामले & ले सोध्छ र कहिल्यै लेखेर राख्दैन। Array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले scanf("%s", name) लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन। फाइदा: call by reference, प्रतिलिपि नबनाई array पठाउनु, dynamic memory, र data structure। युनिट ४ को call by reference र युनिट २ को scanf सुरुदेखि नै pointer थिए।
pairs.en: Unit 4's call by reference and Unit 2's scanf were both pointers all along.

pairs.ne: चारै पङ्क्तिलाई दुई जोडी बनाएर पढ्नुहोस्: n के हो र n कहाँ छ, अनि p सँग के छ र त्यो ठाउँमा के छ। अन्तिम चरणले दोस्रो जोडीबाटै n बदल्छ।
pairs.en: Read the four variable rows as two pairs: what n is and where n is, then what p holds and what is at that place. The last step changes n through the second pair alone.

pairs.ne: एउटा केसमा कुनै पनि operator चाहिँदैन। Array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो — त्यसैले scanf("%s", name) लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन र scanf("%d", &n) लाई चाहिन्छ।
pairs.en: One case needs neither operator. An array name is already an address, which is why scanf("%s", name) takes no ampersand while scanf("%d", &n) does.

pairs.ne: हरेक variable कतै बस्छ, र ठेगाना आफैंमा एउटा मान हो int n = 25; घोषणा गर्दा दुई तथ्य जन्मन्छन्: n सँग २५ छ, र n मेमोरीको कुनै ठेगानामा बस्छ। पहिलो तथ्य तपाईंले युनिट २ देखि चलाइरहनुभएको छ। दोस्रो यही युनिट हो। Pointer भनेको अर्को variable को ठेगाना राख्ने variable हो। यो हरेक हिसाबले सामान्य variable नै हो — यसको प्रकार छ, नाम छ, आफ्नै ठेगाना छ — र यसले राख्ने कुरा परिमाण नभई स्थान हो। प्रोग्रामले देख्ने ठेगाना स्थिर हुँदैन। उही प्रोग्राम दुई पटक चलाउँदा n हरेक पटक फरक ठेगानामा हुन सक्छ। त्यसैले प्रोग्रामले ठेगाना कहिल्यै लेखेर राख्दैन, सधैं & ले सोध्छ — र तलको चित्रमा देखिने १००० सङ्ख्या उदाहरण हो, तथ्य होइन।
pairs.en: Every variable lives somewhere, and the address is a value When you declare int n = 25;, two facts come into existence: n holds 25, and n lives at some address in memory. You have been using the first fact since Unit 2. The second is this unit. A pointer is a variable that stores the address of another variable. It is an ordinary variable in every respect — it has a type, it has a name, it lives at an address of its own — and what it holds happens to be a location rather than a quantity. The address a program sees is not fixed. Run the same program twice and n may be at a different address each time. That is why a program never writes an address down and always asks for it with &, and why the number 1000 in the figure below is an illustration and not a fact.

pairs.ne: घोषणामा आउने star प्रकारकै भाग हो int *p; ले p लाई "int को pointer" घोषणा गर्छ। यहाँको star dereference operator होइन — यो प्रकारकै भाग हो, र C मा उही चिन्हले एक लाइनको फरकमा दुई फरक अर्थ दिने ठाउँ यही एक हो। प्रकारले फरक पार्छ। int *p; र float *q; दुवैले ठेगाना राख्छन्, र प्रकारले compiler लाई त्यहाँका byte कसरी पढ्ने अनि एक पाइला कति टाढा हो भन्छ। गलत प्रकारको pointer ले त्रुटि होइन, बेकारको नतिजा दिन्छ। घोषणा गरिएको pointer लाई ठेगाना नदिएसम्म यो काम लाग्ने कतै देखाउँदैन: int *p; — p छ र यसमा garbage छ। अहिले dereference गर्नु भनेको crash निम्त्याउनु हो। p = &n; — अब p सँग n को ठेगाना छ। int *p = &n; — दुवै एउटै लाइनमा, र सुरक्षित बानी यही हो। ठेगाना छाप्न %p चलाउनुहोस्। %d ले ठाडै असफल हुँदैन — एउटा सङ्ख्या छाप्छ — तर ६४-bit मेसिनमा ठेगाना ८ byte को हुन्छ र int ४ byte को, त्यसैले देखिने सङ्ख्या ठेगानाको अंश मात्र हो। gcc मा जाँचिएको: printf("%d", &n) कुनै सन्देशविनै compile भयो र 0x9B659FF94C ठेगानाको ठाउँमा 830470604 छाप्यो। gcc -Wall ले यसबारे चेतावनी दिन्छ।
pairs.en: The star in the declaration is part of the type int *p; declares p as "a pointer to an int". The star here is not the dereference operator — it is part of the type, and it is the one place in C where the same symbol means two different things a line apart. The type matters. int *p; and float *q; both hold an address, and the type tells the compiler how to interpret the bytes found there and how far one step is. A pointer with the wrong type gives nonsense, not an error. A declared pointer points at nothing useful until it is given an address: int *p; — p exists and holds garbage. Dereferencing it now is a genuine crash waiting to happen. p = &n; — p now holds n's address. int *p = &n; — both on one line, which is the safer habit. Print an address with %p. Printing it with %d does not fail loudly — it prints a number — but on a 64-bit machine an address is 8 bytes and an int is 4, so the number you see is only part of the address. Checked on gcc: printf("%d", &n) compiled with no message at all and printed 830470604 for an address whose real value was 0x9B659FF94C. gcc -Wall does warn about it.

pairs.ne: दुई operator, उल्टा दिशा Referencing — address-of operator & ले variable लिएर त्यसको ठेगाना दिन्छ। &n भनेको "n कहाँ बस्छ" हो। Dereferencing — value-at operator * ले ठेगाना लिएर त्यहाँ भएको कुरा दिन्छ। *p भनेको "p मा भएको ठेगानाको मान" हो। यी एकअर्कालाई उल्ट्याउँछन्: *(&n) भनेको n नै हो। कण्ठ गर्नुभन्दा अङ्ग्रेजीमा पढ्दा बढी सजिलो हुन्छ — "address of n", "value at p"। Star दुवै दिशामा चल्छ। printf("%d", *p); ले pointer मार्फत मान निकाल्छ; *p = 50; ले त्यसैमार्फत मान भित्र राख्छ, र लाइनले n को नाम नलिई पनि n बदलिन्छ। दोस्रो प्रयोग नै पूरै call by reference हो, र pointer लाई होसियारीसाथ चलाउनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।
pairs.en: Two operators, opposite directions Referencing — the address-of operator & takes a variable and gives its address. &n is "where n lives". Dereferencing — the value-at operator * takes an address and gives what is stored there. *p is "the value at the address in p". They undo each other: *(&n) is simply n. Reading them as English helps more than memorising them — "address of n", "value at p". The star works in both directions. printf("%d", *p); reads a value out through the pointer; *p = 50; writes a value in through it, and n changes although the line never mentions n. That second use is the whole of call by reference, and the whole of why pointers are treated with care.

pairs.ne: चार, र तपाईंले दुई त चलाइसक्नुभयो Function ले बोलाउनेका variable बदल्न सक्छ। यही call by reference हो, र function ले एकभन्दा बढी उत्तर फर्काउने एकमात्र उपाय यही हो। युनिट ४ मा भेट्नुभयो; यो युनिट त्यो कसरी चल्यो भन्ने व्याख्या हो। Array प्रतिलिपि नबनाई पठाइन्छ। Array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले हजार element को array function लाई पठाउँदा हजार प्रतिलिपि होइन एउटा ठेगाना मात्र लाग्छ — र function भित्र क्रम मिलाउँदा बोलाउनेकै array बदलिनुको कारण पनि त्यही। प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा मेमोरी माग्न सकिन्छ — dynamic memory allocation, malloc र free सहित। लेख्ने बेला आकार कसैलाई थाहा नभएको सूची प्रोग्रामले यसैगरी सम्हाल्छ। कक्षा ९ को पाठ्यक्रममा छैन; कक्षा १० र त्यसपछि pointer किन महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ भन्ने कारण भएकाले यहाँ नाम लिइएको हो। Data structure सम्भव हुन्छन्। Linked list, tree र graph अर्को वस्तुको ठेगाना राख्ने वस्तुहरूबाट बन्छन्। Pointer नभए यी लेख्ने उपायै हुँदैन, र कक्षा १० को युनिट १ त्यहींबाट सुरु हुन्छ। लागत, इमानदारीसाथ: गलत ठेगाना बोकेको pointer ले नपुग्नुपर्ने ठाउँमा पढ्छ वा लेख्छ, र C ले रोक्दैन। शक्ति र जोखिम एउटै गुणलाई दुई तिरबाट हेरेको हो।
pairs.en: Four, and you have used two already A function can change the caller's variables. This is call by reference, and it is the only way a function can hand back more than one answer. You met it in Unit 4; this unit is the explanation of how it worked. Arrays are passed without copying. An array name is already an address, so sending an array of a thousand elements to a function costs one address rather than a thousand copies — and it is why sorting inside a function changes the caller's array. Memory can be asked for while the program runs — dynamic memory allocation, with malloc and free. It is how a program handles a list whose size nobody knew when it was written. Not on the Grade 9 syllabus; named here because it is the reason pointers matter in Grade 10 and beyond. Data structures become possible. A linked list, a tree and a graph are built out of items that hold the address of the next item. Without pointers there is no way to write one, which is where Grade 10 Unit 1 begins. The cost, stated honestly: a pointer that holds a wrong address will read or write somewhere it should not, and C will not stop it. Power and risk are the same property seen from two sides.

pairs.ne: सम्झने तरिका — & ले "कहाँ?" सोध्छ, * ले "त्यहाँ के छ?" ठेगाना बाहिर, मान बाहिर — उल्टा दिशा।
pairs.en: Memory hook — & asks "where?", * asks "what's there?" Address out, value out — opposite directions.

pairs.ne: Pointer भनेको के हो? उदाहरणसहित pointer variable घोषणा गर्ने syntax लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is a pointer? Write the syntax to declare a pointer variable with an example.

pairs.ne: & र * को फरक के हो? Pointer का कुनै दुई फाइदा लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is the difference between & and *? Write any two advantages of pointers.

pairs.ne: int n = 7; int *p = &n; *p = *p + 3; पछि printf("%d", n); ले के छाप्छ?
pairs.en: After int n = 7; int *p = &n; *p = *p + 3; what does printf("%d", n); print?

pairs.ne: शब्द नजानिकनै तपाईंले pointer दुई पटक चलाइसक्नुभएको छ: युनिट २ देखि हरेक scanf को &, र ४.४ को पूरै call by reference। यो युनिट तपाईंले भर परिरहेकै व्यवस्थाको व्याख्या हो — त्यसैले चलेको swap फेरि पढेर किन चल्यो सोध्दै सुरु गर्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: You have already used pointers twice without the word: the & in every scanf since Unit 2, and the whole of call by reference in 4.4. This unit is the explanation of a mechanism you have been relying on, so start by re-reading the swap that worked and asking why it did.

pairs.ne: Pointer ले मान होइन ठेगाना राख्छ
pairs.en: A pointer holds an address, not a value

pairs.ne: n सँग 25 छ र यो मेमोरीमा कतै बस्छ। यहाँ देखाइएको ठेगाना 1000 उदाहरणका लागि बनाइएको हो — वास्तविक ठेगाना हरेक पटक फरक हुन्छ, त्यसैले प्रोग्रामले त्यो सङ्ख्यामा भर पर्नु हुँदैन।
pairs.en: n holds 25 and lives somewhere in memory. The address 1000 is made up for this illustration — a real one changes every run, which is exactly why a program must never depend on the number.

pairs.ne: p घोषणा भयो। यहाँको star TYPE को भाग हो: यसले p int को pointer हो भन्छ, p आफैं int हो भन्दैन। कतै नतेर्स्याएसम्म यो खाली छ।
pairs.en: p is declared. The star here is part of the TYPE: it says p is a pointer to an int, not that p is an int. It is empty until it is aimed at something.

pairs.ne: &n ले n को ठेगाना दिन्छ र p ले त्यो राख्छ। p भित्र 25 छैन — 25 कहाँ छ भन्ने छ। यी दुई फरक तथ्य हुन् र परीक्षाले दुवै सोध्छ।
pairs.en: &n gives the address of n, and p stores it. p does not contain 25 — it contains where 25 is kept. Those are two different facts and the examination asks for both.

pairs.ne: n लाई सिधै पढ्दा सधैंझैं 25 आउँछ।
pairs.en: Reading n directly gives 25, as always.

pairs.ne: *p को अर्थ "p मा भएको ठेगानामा गएर त्यहाँको कुरा ल्याउनु" हो। उही 25, अर्कै बाटोबाट। यही dereferencing हो।
pairs.en: *p means "go to the address in p and bring back what is there". The same 25, reached by a different route. This is dereferencing.

pairs.ne: Pointer मार्फत लेख्दा n आफैं बदलिन्छ। Star दुवै दिशामा चल्छ: मान निकाल्न, वा मान राख्न। Call by reference चल्नुको कारण यही एउटा लाइन हो।
pairs.en: Writing through the pointer changes n itself. The star works in both directions: read a value out, or put a value in. This one line is why call by reference works.

pairs.ne: कुनै लाइनले n = 50 नभने पनि n 50 भयो। Pointer को शक्ति र खतरा एउटै वाक्यमा यही हो।
pairs.en: n is 50 although no line ever said n = 50. That is the power and the danger of pointers in one sentence.

pairs.ne: अर्को variable को मानको प्रतिलिपि
pairs.en: A copy of another variable's value

pairs.en: The name of another variable

pairs.en: The data type of another variable

pairs.ne: & ले ठेगानाको मान दिन्छ; * ले variable को ठेगाना दिन्छ
pairs.en: & gives the value at an address; * gives the address of a variable

pairs.ne: & ले variable को ठेगाना दिन्छ; * ले ठेगानाको मान दिन्छ
pairs.en: & gives the address of a variable; * gives the value at an address
