pairs.en: The components of a computer system

pairs.ne: · प्रवाह हेर्नुहोस्
pairs.en: Explore the flow

pairs.ne: — Input एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
pairs.en: · प्रवाह हेर्नुहोस् Which unit does what? What you will learn: where each unit sits in the flow and exactly what it is responsible for — so that when a question asks which unit does the comparing, you can see the answer rather than try to recall a sentence. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक एकाइ प्रवाहमा कहाँ पर्छ र कसको के जिम्मेवारी हो — ताकि तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्ने प्रश्नमा वाक्य सम्झनुभन्दा उत्तर देख्न सकियोस्। {{dia:hwSystemUnits}} Why this matters: "differentiate between the ALU and the control unit" is a standard question, and the marks go to students who attach the right job to each word. Seeing them in the flow is what makes that stick.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "ALU र control unit छुट्याउनुहोस्" मानक प्रश्न हो, र अंक ती विद्यार्थीले पाउँछन् जसले ठिक काम ठिक शब्दसँग जोड्छन्। प्रवाहमा देखेपछि यो पक्का हुन्छ। 2.2 The input unit and its devices

pairs.ne: — Output एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
pairs.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which input device is this job asking for? What you will learn: to pick a device from what the job needs rather than from the first name you remember. Two of the six cases differ only in what is printed on the paper. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पहिलो सम्झिएको नाम होइन, कामको आवश्यकता हेरेर उपकरण छान्न। छ केसमध्ये दुईको फरक कागजमा के छापिएको छ भन्नेमा मात्र छ। How to use this Before answering, say what is physically being read: a filled box, a letter shape, a stripe pattern, or magnetic ink. The device follows from that. उत्तर दिनुअघि के पढिँदै छ भन्नुहोस्: भरिएको बाकस, अक्षरको आकार, धर्काको बान्की, कि चुम्बकीय मसी। उपकरण त्यसैबाट निस्कन्छ। 2.3 The output unit and its devices

pairs.ne: — Memory एकाइ
pairs.en: Decide before opening this: which printer type can produce more than one copy at a time, and what physical fact makes that possible? खोल्नुअघि निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: कुन किसिमको प्रिन्टरले एकैपटक एकभन्दा बढी प्रति निकाल्न सक्छ, र कुन भौतिक कुराले त्यो सम्भव बनाउँछ? Working Needed three copies in one pass Impact? YES — the print head strikes the ribbon against the paper Why it works the strike presses through to carbon paper underneath Answer dot-matrix printer (impact) Why not laser laser fuses powder onto the top sheet only; nothing presses through, so sheets two and three stay blank This is the one job where the noisy old technology is the correct answer. "Impact printers are obsolete" is wrong in a question about carbon copies. हल्ला गर्ने पुरानो प्रविधि नै ठिक उत्तर हुने काम यही हो। कार्बन कपीको प्रश्नमा "impact printer पुरानो भइसक्यो" भन्नु गलत हो। 2.4 The memory unit

pairs.ne: — प्रशोधन एकाइ — microprocessor
pairs.en: The processing unit — the microprocessor

pairs.ne: — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १० घण्टा
pairs.en: Chip A runs at 2 GHz with a 64-bit word length. Chip B runs at 4 GHz with an 8-bit word length. Both are given the same job: add up eight bytes of data. Which finishes the addition in fewer clock cycles? चिप A: 2 GHz, word length 64-bit। चिप B: 4 GHz, word length 8-bit। दुवैलाई उही काम: आठ byte data जोड्ने। कुनले कम clock cycle मा सक्छ? Chip A — it moves all eight bytes in one cycle Chip B — it has twice the clock speed Both take the same number of cycles Chip A's word length is 64 bits, which is 8 bytes, so all eight arrive in one cycle. Chip B handles 8 bits — one byte — per cycle, so it needs eight cycles. Clock speed was not the question: B does more cycles per second, but it needs eight times as many of them. This is exactly why both numbers are quoted and neither alone tells you how fast a chip is. चिप A को word length ६४ bit = ८ byte, त्यसैले आठै byte एक चक्रमा पुग्छन्। चिप B ले प्रति चक्र ८ bit — एक byte — चलाउँछ, त्यसैले आठ चक्र चाहिन्छ। प्रश्न clock speed को थिएन: B ले सेकेन्डमा बढी चक्र चलाउँछ, तर उसलाई आठ गुणा बढी चक्र चाहिन्छ। दुवै संख्या किन भनिन्छ र एक्लैले गति बताउँदैन भन्ने कारण यही हो। Example 2 Sorting a shop's devices into units Question: a shop lists: barcode reader, laser printer, speaker, RAM module, microphone, graphic plotter. Place each in the correct unit of the computer system, and say which two belong to the same unit for different reasons. Work down the list and ask one question each time: does this bring data IN, send results OUT, or hold data while the work happens? Write your six answers before opening this. सूची क्रमैसँग हेर्नुहोस् र हरेक पटक एउटै प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: यसले data भित्र ल्याउँछ, नतिजा बाहिर पठाउँछ, कि काम हुँदासम्म राख्छ? खोल्नुअघि आफ्ना छ उत्तर लेख्नुहोस्। Working barcode reader INPUT converts stripes into a number microphone INPUT converts a sound wave into binary laser printer OUTPUT hardcopy, non-impact graphic plotter OUTPUT hardcopy — it draws on paper speaker OUTPUT softcopy — sound, nothing to carry away RAM module MEMORY holds data and program during the work The two in the same unit for different reasons: the barcode reader and the microphone are both INPUT, but one reads a printed pattern and the other converts a wave. Input is defined by CONVERSION, not by what is being converted. A question that gives you a list and asks you to classify it is marked on the placements, not on the explanations — but writing the reason protects you when a device could plausibly go two ways. सूची दिएर वर्गीकरण गर्न भन्ने प्रश्नमा अंक राखेको ठाउँको हुन्छ, व्याख्याको होइन — तर कुनै उपकरण दुईतिर पर्न सक्ने देखिए कारण लेख्दा सुरक्षित हुन्छ। Mistakes that cost marks here Calling the CPU "memory". The CPU is ALU plus control unit. Memory is a separate unit. A question that asks "which unit stores data during processing" wants the memory unit, not the CPU. Saying a scanner and an OCR are the same thing. A scanner produces a picture of the page. OCR is what reads letters out of that picture and makes them editable text. Putting the plotter under softcopy. A plotter draws on paper. Paper is hardcopy. Answering "impact or non-impact" for a monitor. That cut applies to printers only. A monitor is softcopy and the question stops there. Writing "1 MB = 1000 KB". It is 1024. The marker is checking whether you know why memory counts in powers of two. CPU लाई memory भन्नु: CPU = ALU + control unit; memory छुट्टै एकाइ हो। Scanner र OCR उस्तै भन्नु: scanner ले पानाको तस्बिर बनाउँछ; OCR ले त्यही तस्बिरबाट अक्षर पढेर सम्पादनयोग्य पाठ बनाउँछ। Plotter लाई softcopy मा राख्नु: plotter कागजमा कोर्छ, कागज भनेको hardcopy। Monitor लाई impact/non-impact भन्नु: त्यो भाग प्रिन्टरका लागि मात्र हो। "1 MB = 1000 KB" लेख्नु: १०२४ हो। Memory hook — Mark, Character, Bar, Magnetic. The second letter names what it reads. सम्झने तरिका — Mark, Character, Bar, Magnetic. नामको दोस्रो अक्षरले के पढ्छ भन्छ। Practical work — this unit's other 10 hours
englishVariants: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A cipher's algorithm is published in a textbook that anyone can buy. Does publishing it make messages encrypted with that algorithm insecure? कुनै cipher को एल्गोरिदम जोसुकैले किन्न सक्ने पाठ्यपुस्तकमा छापिएको छ। छापिएकै कारण त्यस एल्गोरिदमले encrypt गरिएका सन्देश असुरक्षित हुन्छन्? Yes — anyone who knows the method can read the message Yes, but only if they also own a fast computer No — the method being known is fine; it is the key that must stay secret No, and this is the central idea of the whole topic. Security that depends on hiding the method collapses the moment somebody works the method out, and it cannot be repaired — you would have to invent a new cipher. Security that depends on a key survives publication: the algorithm can be printed, studied and attacked by experts, and if a key is ever exposed you simply change the key. That is why the same published algorithm can protect millions of different conversations at once. Each pair of people uses a different key, and knowing the method tells you nothing about any of them. हुँदैनन्, र पूरै विषयको केन्द्रीय विचार यही हो। तरिका लुकाएर पाइने सुरक्षा कसैले तरिका पत्ता लगाउने बित्तिकै ढल्छ, र मर्मत गर्न मिल्दैन — नयाँ cipher नै बनाउनुपर्छ। Key मा अडेको सुरक्षा छापिए पनि टिक्छ: एल्गोरिदम छापेर विज्ञहरूले अध्ययन र आक्रमण गर्न दिन सकिन्छ, र key चुहिए key फेरे पुग्छ। एउटै छापिएको एल्गोरिदमले एकैपटक लाखौं फरक कुराकानी जोगाउन सक्नुको कारण यही हो। हरेक जोडीले फरक key चलाउँछ, र तरिका थाहा हुँदैमा कुनैको key थाहा हुँदैन। Example 1 Encrypt and decrypt by hand Question: encrypt the word NEPAL with a shift of 4, then decrypt XSVOH with the same key. Do both on paper before opening this. Remember that the alphabet wraps: after Z comes A again. खोल्नुअघि दुवै कागजमै गर्नुहोस्। वर्णमाला घुम्छ भन्ने नबिर्सनुहोस्: Z पछि फेरि A आउँछ। Working ENCRYPT shift each letter FORWARD 4 N -> R E -> I P -> T A -> E L -> P NEPAL -> RITEP DECRYPT shift each letter BACK 4 X -> T S -> O V -> R O -> K H -> D XSVOH -> TORKD Check the wrap: with a shift of 4, W -> A, X -> B, Y -> C, Z -> D. Nothing falls off the end of the alphabet. Notice that decryption used no new method — the same operation, run in the other direction with the same key. That is the point the bench above is making, and it is what makes the key, not the algorithm, the thing worth keeping secret. Decryption मा नयाँ तरिका लागेन — उही काम, उही key, उल्टो दिशामा। माथिको बेन्चले भन्न खोजेको कुरा यही हो, र एल्गोरिदम होइन key नै गोप्य राख्नुपर्ने कारण पनि। Example 2 Naming the technology in one paragraph Question: "A municipality fits sensors to 500 water taps. The readings go to a server rented from a company in Singapore. Software examines two years of those readings and finds which wards lose the most water at night." Name the three technologies, in order. Three different things are happening in three sentences. Name each before opening this. तीन वाक्यमा तीन फरक कुरा भइरहेका छन्। खोल्नुअघि हरेकको नाम भन्नुहोस्। Working 1 sensors on 500 taps IoT a tap is not a computer, and now it is on the network 2 a server rented in Singapore CLOUD COMPUTING whose computer? somebody else's, reached over the Internet. NOT distributed — nothing says the work is split across many machines 3 examining two years of DATA MINING readings to FIND a pattern the readings themselves are big data; the examining is the mining Questions in this unit often hide three technologies in one short paragraph, exactly like this. Read it sentence by sentence rather than looking for one answer. यस युनिटका प्रश्नले प्रायः छोटो अनुच्छेदमै तीन प्रविधि लुकाउँछन्, ठ्याक्कै यसरी। एउटा उत्तर खोज्नुभन्दा वाक्य–वाक्य गरी पढ्नुहोस्। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying cloud computing and distributed computing are the same. Cloud is about whose computer; distributed is about how many. Defining big data as "mining big data". Big data is the material, data mining is the activity. Calling a laptop on Wi-Fi an IoT device. IoT is for things that are not computers. Swapping VR and AR. VR replaces the world, AR adds to it. Saying encryption hides the method. The algorithm is usually public — the key is what is secret. Cloud र distributed उस्तै भन्नु: cloud — कम्प्युटर कसको; distributed — कतिवटा। Big data लाई "ठूलो data को mining" भन्नु: big data सामग्री, data mining काम। Wi-Fi मा जोडिएको ल्यापटपलाई IoT भन्नु: IoT कम्प्युटर नभएका वस्तुका लागि हो। VR र AR साट्नु: VR ले संसार हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ। Encryption ले तरिका लुकाउँछ भन्नु: एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ — गोप्य त key हो। Memory hook — VR replaces, AR adds. Big data is the pile; data mining is the digging. सम्झने तरिका — VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ। Big data थुप्रो, data mining खन्ने काम। Practical work — this unit's other 10 hours

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक एकाइ प्रवाहमा कहाँ पर्छ र कसको के जिम्मेवारी हो — ताकि तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्ने प्रश्नमा वाक्य सम्झनुभन्दा उत्तर देख्न सकियोस्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: where each unit sits in the flow and exactly what it is responsible for — so that when a question asks which unit does the comparing, you can see the answer rather than try to recall a sentence.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पहिलो सम्झिएको नाम होइन, कामको आवश्यकता हेरेर उपकरण छान्न। छ केसमध्ये दुईको फरक कागजमा के छापिएको छ भन्नेमा मात्र छ।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to pick a device from what the job needs rather than from the first name you remember. Two of the six cases differ only in what is printed on the paper.

pairs.ne: जाँच यही हो — सफ्टवेयरले कसको सेवा गर्छ। भाइरस खोज्नु आफैंमा कसैको उद्देश्य होइन — यो मेसिनकै मर्मत हो, त्यसैले utility। खोल्ने चाहिँ application जस्तै हो, र प्रश्न सोधिनुको कारण पनि त्यही हो।
pairs.en: The test is who the software serves. Nobody sits down to scan for viruses as a goal in itself — it is maintenance on the machine, which makes it a utility. You do start it like an application, and that is exactly why this question is asked.

pairs.ne: भाषा अनुवादक — compiler, interpreter, assembler — system software हुन्। यिनले मेसिनकै सेवा गर्छन्: compiler ले बनाउने machine code विना प्रोसेसरले प्रोग्राम चलाउनै सक्दैन। प्रोग्रामरले खोल्छ भन्दैमा सफ्टवेयर कसका लागि काम गर्दै छ भन्ने बदलिँदैन।
pairs.en: Language translators — compiler, interpreter and assembler — are system software. They serve the MACHINE: without the machine code a compiler produces, the processor cannot run the program at all. Being started by a programmer does not change who the software is working for.

pairs.ne: विकल्प (क) ले तीन उदाहरण दिन्छ, र उदाहरण परिभाषा होइन — प्रश्नले जाँच्न खोजेको गल्ती त्यही हो। परिभाषाका तीन भाग छन्: हार्डवेयर नियन्त्रण, स्रोत व्यवस्थापन, इन्टरफेस।
pairs.en: Option A names three examples, and examples are not a definition — that is the mistake the question is testing. The definition has three parts worth stating: controls hardware, manages resources, provides an interface.

pairs.ne: एउटा प्रोसेसरले एकैपटक एउटै निर्देशन चलाउँछ। Process management ले हरेक प्रोग्रामलाई प्रोसेसरको समयको टुक्रा दिन्छ र यति छिटो फेरिदिन्छ कि दुवै निरन्तर देखिन्छन्। यसको नाम multitasking हो। Memory management पनि चलिरहेको हुन्छ, तर त्यसले दुई प्रोग्रामलाई छुट्याएर राख्छ, एकैचोटि चलेजस्तो बनाउँदैन।
pairs.en: One processor runs one instruction at a time. Process management gives each program a slice of processor time and switches between them fast enough that both look continuous. The word for the effect is multitasking, and it is a scheduling job. Memory management is also running, but it is what keeps the two programs apart, not what makes them look simultaneous.

pairs.ne: हरेक पटक तोकिएकै समयसीमा — यही real-time को परिभाषा हो। यस्तो प्रणालीमा ढिलो हुनु र गलत हुनु उस्तै हो; दुई सेकेन्डपछि आएको सही नतिजाले बिरामीलाई केही गरेन। Batch ठिक उल्टो हो: काम जम्मा गरेर सुविधाअनुसार चलाइन्छ, कोही पर्खेर बस्दैन।
pairs.en: A guaranteed deadline, every time, is the definition of real-time. In this kind of system being late is the same as being wrong — a correct reading delivered two seconds afterwards has not helped the patient. Batch is the opposite: jobs are collected and run when convenient, with nobody waiting.

pairs.ne: दोहोरिने र उस्तै काम आदेशले राम्ररी बताउँछ: GUI मा करिब १२०० कार्य, CUI मा एउटै आदेश — जुन सुरक्षित गरेर अर्को वर्ष फेरि चलाउन पनि मिल्छ। एउटै फाइलको नाम फेर्न भने GUI जित्छ: देखिन्छ र केही सम्झनै पर्दैन। कुनै एउटा राम्रो होइन; फरक काममा फरक सुहाउँछ, त्यसैले दुवै अझै छन्।
pairs.en: Repetitive and identical work is exactly what a command describes well: about 1200 actions in a GUI against one command that can also be saved and reused next year. Note that a GUI wins for renaming ONE file — you can see it and nothing has to be remembered. Neither interface is simply better; they suit different work, which is why both still exist.

pairs.ne: देखिनु नै GUI को साँचो फाइदा हो — उपलब्ध सबै पर्दामै हुन्छ, सम्झनै पर्दैन। बाँकी तीनै विकल्प CUI का फाइदा हुन्, र यही आधा भाग विद्यार्थीले प्रायः छुटाउँछन्।
pairs.en: Visibility is the GUI’s real advantage — everything available is on the screen, so nothing has to be recalled. The other three options are all advantages of the CUI, which is the half of this comparison students usually leave out.

pairs.ne: खुला भनेको source code हो, मूल्य होइन। Open source प्रायः निःशुल्क हुन्छ, तर त्यो परिभाषा होइन परिणाम हो — कानुनी रूपमा बेच्न पाइन्छ। नपाइने कुरा चाहिँ पाउनेबाट code लुकाउनु हो।
pairs.en: Open refers to the SOURCE CODE, not the price. Open source software is usually free of charge, but that is a consequence rather than the definition — it may legally be sold. What may not be done is withhold the code from the people who receive it.

pairs.ne: Microsoft Office proprietary हो: पैसा तिरे पनि नतिरे पनि यसको source code सार्वजनिक हुँदैन। Linux, LibreOffice र Firefox ले code सार्वजनिक गर्छन्। Open source छान्ने विद्यालयले प्रति कम्प्युटर लाइसेन्स शुल्क तिर्नु पर्दैन, र त्यो बचाउन कानुन मिच्नु पनि पर्दैन।
pairs.en: Microsoft Office is proprietary: its source code is not published, whether or not you have paid for it. Linux, LibreOffice and Firefox all publish their code. A school choosing the open-source alternatives is not paying a licence fee per computer, and is not breaking the law to avoid one.

pairs.ne: सफ्टवेयरको तह प्रयोगकर्ता → application → OS → हार्डवेयर क्रममा चल्छ, र हरेक तहले तलको एउटासँग मात्र कुरा गर्छ। हार्डवेयरसम्म पुग्न पाउने एक मात्र सफ्टवेयर OS हो — "OS ले इन्टरफेस दिन्छ" भन्नुको साँचो अर्थ यही हो। यसैले एउटा प्रोग्रामले अर्काको फाइल संयोगले बिगार्न पनि सक्दैन।
pairs.en: The software stack runs user to application to operating system to hardware, and each layer talks only to the one below it. The operating system is the only software permitted to reach the hardware, which is what "the OS provides an interface" actually means. It also means one program cannot damage another’s files by accident.

pairs.ne: System, application कि utility?
pairs.en: System, application or utility?

pairs.ne: हरेक कुन किसिमको सफ्टवेयर हो छान्नुहोस्। जाँच: यो नभए पनि कम्प्युटर चल्छ? चल्दैन भने system software। चल्छ तर मेसिनकै हेरचाह गर्छ भने utility। चल्छ र तपाईंको काम गर्छ भने application।
pairs.en: Decide which kind of software each one is. The test: would the computer still work without it? If no, it is system software. If yes but it still looks after the machine, it is a utility. If yes and it does a job for you, it is an application.

pairs.ne: Operating system नै system software को सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट उदाहरण हो: यो नभए हार्डवेयरसँग मान्ने निर्देशन हुँदैन, र अरू हरेक प्रोग्राम यसैले सुरु गर्छ।
pairs.en: An operating system is the clearest case of system software: without it the hardware has nothing to obey, and every other program is started by it.

pairs.ne: यसले प्रयोगकर्ताले चाहेको काम गर्छ। हटाए पनि कम्प्युटर सुरु हुन्छ र राम्रै चल्छ; चिठी टाइप गर्न मात्र पाइँदैन।
pairs.en: It does a job the USER wanted done. Remove it and the computer still starts and runs perfectly; you simply cannot type that letter.

pairs.ne: विद्यार्थीले बिगार्ने केस यही हो। यसले तपाईंको काम गर्दैन — भाइरस खोज्नु आफैंमा कसैको उद्देश्य होइन। मेसिनकै हेरचाह गर्छ, त्यसैले utility — application जस्तै खोल्ने भए पनि।
pairs.en: The one students get wrong. It is not doing YOUR job — nobody sits down to scan for viruses as an end in itself. It looks after the machine, so it is a utility, even though you start it like an application.

pairs.ne: विद्यार्थीले छुटाउने अर्को केस। भाषा अनुवादकले मेसिनकै सेवा गर्छ: यसले बनाउने machine code विना प्रोसेसरले प्रोग्राम चलाउनै सक्दैन। Compiler, interpreter र assembler — सबै system software।
pairs.en: The other case students miss. A language translator serves the MACHINE: it produces the machine code without which the processor cannot run the program at all. Compiler, interpreter and assembler are all system software.

pairs.ne: थिच्नु भनेको फाइलको मर्मत हो, तपाईंले गर्न खोजेको काम होइन। Backup, disk cleaner र compressor — मानक utility उदाहरण।
pairs.en: Compressing is maintenance on files, not the task you set out to do. Backup tools, disk cleaners and compressors are the standard utility examples.

pairs.ne: एउटै संस्था र एउटै कामका लागि लेखिएको — application software भनेकै यही हो। बनाइएको आफ्नै हो भन्दैमा system software हुँदैन; कसले लेख्यो होइन, कसको सेवा गर्छ भन्नेले तय गर्छ।
pairs.en: Written for one organisation and one job, which is what application software is. Being custom-made does not make it system software — who it serves is what decides, not who wrote it.

pairs.ne: माथिबाट तल पढ्नुहोस्। Application ले OS सँग माग्छ, र हार्डवेयरसँग बोल्ने एक मात्र तह OS हो — "OS प्रयोगकर्ता र हार्डवेयरबीचको इन्टरफेस हो" भन्नुको अर्थ यही।
pairs.en: Read it downwards. An application asks the operating system, and the operating system is the only layer that speaks to the hardware — which is what "the OS is an interface between the user and the hardware" means.

pairs.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: सफ्टवेयर के हो र हार्डवेयर यसविना किन चल्दैन भन्न, system र application software छुट्याउन अनि utility software कहाँ पर्छ भन्न, operating system लाई Windows को नाम लिएर होइन कामले परिभाषित गर्न, OS का कार्य उदाहरणसहित लेख्न, OS का किसिम र कुन अवस्थामा कुन सुहाउँछ भन्न, CUI र GUI तुलना गर्न — CUI को पनि एउटा फाइदासहित — र open source सफ्टवेयर के हो अनि के होइन बुझाउन सक्नुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: Explain what makes software open source, and what it does not mean.

pairs.ne: Process management। एउटा प्रोसेसरले एकैपटक एउटै निर्देशन चलाउन सक्छ। OS ले हरेक प्रोग्रामलाई प्रोसेसरको समयको टुक्रा — केही मिलिसेकेन्ड — दिन्छ र यति छिटो फेरिदिन्छ कि तीनै निरन्तर देखिन्छन्। Memory management पनि भइरहेको हुन्छ र त्यसैले तीन प्रोग्रामले एकअर्काको ठाउँ बिगार्दैनन्, तर एकैचोटि चलेको देखावट त्यसले बनाउँदैन। यसको नाम multitasking हो, र यो समय बाँड्ने काम हो।
pairs.en: Process management. One processor can run exactly one instruction at a time. The operating system gives each program a slice of processor time — a few milliseconds each — and switches between them so quickly that all three appear continuous to you. Memory management is also happening, and it is what keeps the three programs from overwriting each other, but it is not what creates the appearance of simultaneity. The word for this is multitasking, and it is a scheduling job.

pairs.ne: खोल्नुअघि सोच्नुहोस्: यो काम GUI मा कति कार्य हो, CUI मा कति? अनुमान होइन, गन्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Think before opening: how many actions is this in a GUI, and how many in a CUI? Count, do not guess.

pairs.ne: पाठ यो होइन कि कुनै एउटा राम्रो हो। दोहोरिने काम आदेशलाई सुहाउँछ, एकपटकको काम चित्रलाई — त्यसैले दुवै अझै छन्।
pairs.en: The lesson is not that one interface is better. It is that repetitive work suits a command and one-off work suits a picture — which is why both still exist.

pairs.ne: हरेकका लागि सोध्नुहोस्: यो नभए पनि कम्प्युटर चल्छ? पहिले आफ्ना पाँच उत्तर लेख्नुहोस् — तीमध्ये दुई प्रायः गलत हुन्छन्।
pairs.en: For each one ask: would the computer still work without it? Write your five answers first — two of them are the ones people get wrong.

pairs.ne: सर्ने दुई — compiler र antivirus। दुवै मान्छेले खोल्छ, त्यसैले application जस्तो लाग्छ — तर कसले खोल्छ भन्ने जाँच होइन। कसको सेवा गर्छ भन्ने हो।
pairs.en: The compiler and the antivirus are the two that move. Both are started by a person, which is why they feel like applications — but who starts it is not the test. Who it serves is.

pairs.ne: OS लाई "Windows" भन्नु: Windows उदाहरण हो; परिभाषा हार्डवेयर नियन्त्रण, स्रोत व्यवस्थापन र इन्टरफेसको हो। Antivirus लाई application भन्नु: यसले मेसिनको सेवा गर्छ — utility software हो। Open source लाई निःशुल्क भन्नु: अर्थ source code खुला हुनु हो। CUI/GUI मा "GUI सजिलो" मात्र लेख्नु: चार अंकले दुवैतिरका दुई–दुई फाइदा खोज्छ। OS का कार्य र विशेषता मिसाउनु: कार्य भनेको गर्ने काम, विशेषता भनेको गुण।
pairs.en: Confusing functions with characteristics of an OS. A function is a job it performs; a characteristic is a quality it has.

pairs.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ३ को सूचीबाट; यसले यिनलाई नमुना भनेको छ। ८ घण्टा चाहिँ नमुना होइन।
pairs.en: From the curriculum's own practical list for Unit 3, which calls these samples. The 8 hours are not a sample.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: सोध्ने मानिस र छलफल गर्ने समूह। आधार: ३.२। बुझाउने: क्षेत्रअनुसार मिलाएको सूची, हरेकमा कुन समस्या हल गर्छ भन्ने एक वाक्य। छलफल नै क्रियाकलाप हो; सूची प्रमाण।
pairs.en: You need: people to ask, and a group to discuss with. Builds on: 3.2. Hand in: your list, grouped by sector, with one sentence per item saying what problem it solves. The discussion is the activity; the list is the evidence.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: विद्यालयको ल्याबमा पुग्ने अनुमति। आधार: ३.२। बुझाउने: फाइल, जहाँ हरेक प्रोग्राम तीनमध्ये एउटा समूहमा राखिएको र कारण लेखिएको होस्। अंक कारणमै छ।
pairs.en: You need: access to your school lab. Builds on: 3.2. Hand in: the file, with every program placed in one of the three groups and a reason for each placement. The reason is where the marks are.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रोग्राम इन्स्टल भएको कम्प्युटर — LibreOffice, GIMP, VLC, Firefox सबै open source र निःशुल्क। आधार: ३.७। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। देखाउनु भनेको चलिरहेको देखाउनु हो, स्क्रिनसट होइन।
pairs.en: You need: a computer with the program installed — LibreOffice, GIMP, VLC or Firefox are all open source and all free to install. Builds on: 3.7. Hand in: the file and your notes. Demonstrating means showing it running, not showing a screenshot.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: कम्तीमा आठ जना र नोटबुक। यो विषयकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो क्षेत्रकार्य हो र प्रोजेक्ट कामका लागि सबैभन्दा उपयुक्त। आधार: ३.३ र ३.५। बुझाउने: तालिका — प्रति व्यक्ति एक हरफ, स्तम्भमा उपकरण, OS र app — अनि बान्कीले के देखाउँछ भन्ने छोटो अनुच्छेद। रिपोर्ट भनेको अनुच्छेद हो; तालिका त data मात्र।
pairs.en: You need: at least eight people and a notebook. This is the largest piece of fieldwork in the subject and the strongest candidate for your project work. Builds on: 3.3 and 3.5. Hand in: a table — one row per person, columns for device, operating system and apps — then a short paragraph on what the pattern shows. The paragraph is the report; the table is only the data.

pairs.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ९ अंक ओगट्छ — यस विषयमा सबैभन्दा धेरै — र ६४ मध्ये १० घण्टा। सफ्टवेयर वा OS को परिभाषा, सफ्टवेयर/OS का किसिमको वर्गीकरण, र CUI/GUI तुलना अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस्। OS का कार्यको सूची प्रश्नपत्रकै सबैभन्दा भरपर्दो ४ अंकको प्रश्न हो।
pairs.en: This unit carries 9 of the 50 external marks — the most of any unit in this subject — and 10 of the 64 theory hours. Expect a definition of software or operating system, a classification question on types of software or types of OS, and a CUI/GUI comparison. The OS functions list is the most reliable 4-mark question in the paper.

pairs.ne: कुनै चार: process management, memory management, file management, device management, security, user interface दिने। प्रत्येकको एक अंक; नाम लेखे पुग्छ, तर छोटो व्याख्या थपे सुरक्षित हुन्छ।
pairs.en: One mark each. Naming the function is enough, but a short phrase of explanation protects you if the marker wants it.

pairs.ne: CUI — आदेश टाइप गर्ने; आदेश सम्झनुपर्ने, मेमोरी थोरै, दक्ष प्रयोगकर्तालाई छिटो, आदेश सुरक्षित गरेर फेरि चलाउन मिल्ने। उदाहरण: MS-DOS, Linux terminal। GUI — window, icon, menu मा देखाउने; सम्झनै नपर्ने, नयाँलाई सजिलो, तर बढी मेमोरी र प्रशोधन चाहिने। उदाहरण: Windows, macOS, Android।
pairs.en: Write it as pairs of opposites. Four marks usually means two differences stated from both sides.

pairs.ne: Open source software त्यो हो जसको source code सार्वजनिक हुन्छ — जोसुकैले पढ्न, बदल्न र पुनर्वितरण गर्न सक्छ। फाइदा: प्रायः निःशुल्क; वा आवश्यकताअनुसार बदल्न मिल्ने; वा ठूलो समुदायले गल्ती भेटेर सच्याउने। "निःशुल्क सफ्टवेयर" भनेर परिभाषा नलेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Do not define it as "free software" — that is a consequence, not the meaning.

pairs.ne: सफ्टवेयर = निर्देशन, हार्डवेयर = क्षमता। System ले कम्प्युटरको, application ले प्रयोगकर्ताको, utility ले कम्प्युटरकै सेवा गर्छ तर प्रयोगकर्ताले खोल्छ। OS ले हार्डवेयर नियन्त्रण, स्रोत व्यवस्थापन र इन्टरफेस दिन्छ, र सबैभन्दा पहिले लोड हुन्छ। कार्य: process, memory, file, device management, security, user interface। CUI: सम्झने, छिटो, स्क्रिप्ट गर्न मिल्ने, हलुका। GUI: देखिने, सजिलो, गह्रौं। Open source = खुला source code।
pairs.en: Open source = published source code. Free of charge is usual, not the definition.

pairs.ne: हरेक केसमा सोध्नुहोस्: यो नभए पनि कम्प्युटर चल्छ? चल्दैन भने system software। चल्छ तर मेसिनकै हेरचाह गर्छ भने utility। चल्छ र तपाईंको काम गर्छ भने application।
pairs.en: For each case ask: would the computer still work without it? If no, it is system software. If yes but it still looks after the machine, it is a utility. If yes and it does a job for you, it is an application.

pairs.ne: खुट्टामा खसाल्न नमिल्ने भाग सफ्टवेयर भनेको हार्डवेयरलाई के गर्ने भन्ने निर्देशनको सेट हो। छुन मिल्ने हरेक भौतिक भाग हार्डवेयर; छुन नमिल्ने सबै सफ्टवेयर। सफ्टवेयर नभएको कम्प्युटर पूरा तर बेकामको मेसिन हो। सर्किट तयार छ, पर्दा बलेको छ, तर केही हुँदैन — किनभने प्रोसेसरलाई आफ्ना अर्बौं सम्भावित काममध्ये अब कुन गर्ने कसैले भनेको छैन। हार्डवेयरले क्षमता दिन्छ; सफ्टवेयरले निर्देशन। एउटै कम्प्युटर बिहान टाइपराइटर र दिउँसो क्यालकुलेटर हुन सक्नुको कारण पनि यही हो। हार्डवेयर बदलिएन, निर्देशन बदलियो।
pairs.en: The part you cannot drop on your foot Software is the set of instructions that tells the hardware what to do. Hardware is every physical part you can touch; software is everything you cannot. A computer with no software is a complete and useless machine. The circuits are willing and the screen is lit, and nothing happens, because nothing has told the processor which of its billions of possible operations to perform next. Hardware supplies the ability; software supplies the instructions. That is also why the same computer can be a typewriter in the morning and a calculator in the afternoon. The hardware did not change. The instructions did.

pairs.ne: सफ्टवेयर कसका लागि काम गर्दै छ सोध्नुहोस् सफ्टवेयरको भाग कसको सेवा गर्छ भन्नेले निर्धारण हुन्छ। यो एउटै प्रश्नले झन्डै हरेक केस टुङ्ग्याउँछ। System software ले कम्प्युटर को सेवा गर्छ। मेसिन आफैं चलाउँछ र प्रयोगयोग्य बनाउँछ: operating system, भाषा अनुवादक (compiler, interpreter, assembler) र device driver। नभनिकनै सुरु हुन्छ र धेरैजसो तपाईंले देख्नै पर्दैन। Application software ले प्रयोगकर्ता को सेवा गर्छ। तपाईं जुन काम गर्न बस्नु भयो त्यही गर्छ: word processor, spreadsheet, browser, खेल, विद्यालयको नतिजा प्रणाली। तपाईंले छानेर खोल्नुहुन्छ, र यो नभए पनि कम्प्युटर राम्रै चल्छ। Utility software बीचमा पर्छ। सेवा कम्प्युटरकै गर्छ — सफा गर्ने, थिच्ने, भाइरस खोज्ने, ब्याकअप लिने — तर application जस्तै तपाईं आफैं खोल्नुहुन्छ। धेरै पुस्तकले यसलाई system software कै किसिम मान्छन्, केहीले छुट्टै लेख्छन्। के गर्छ भन्यौं भने दुवै मान्य हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Ask who the software is working for Software divides by who it serves. That one question settles almost every case. System software serves the computer. It runs the machine itself and makes it usable: the operating system, language translators (compiler, interpreter, assembler) and device drivers. It starts without being asked and most of it you never see. Application software serves the user. It does the job you sat down to do: word processor, spreadsheet, browser, game, a school's result system. You choose to start it, and the computer runs perfectly well without it. Utility software sits between them. It serves the computer — cleaning, compressing, scanning for viruses, backing up — but you start it yourself, like an application. Most books treat it as a kind of system software, and a few list it separately. Either is accepted if you say what it does.

pairs.ne: नामले होइन, कामले परिभाषित Operating system त्यो system software हो जसले हार्डवेयर नियन्त्रण गर्छ, कम्प्युटरका स्रोत व्यवस्थापन गर्छ, र प्रयोगकर्ता तथा मेसिनबीच इन्टरफेस दिन्छ। Windows, Linux, macOS र Android उदाहरण हुन्; तीमध्ये कुनै पनि परिभाषा होइन। यो वाक्यका दुई शब्दले अंक बोक्छन्। स्रोत भनेको प्रोसेसरको समय, मेमोरी, डिस्क र उपकरण — सबै सीमित, सबै एकैपटक धेरै प्रोग्रामलाई चाहिने। इन्टरफेस भनेको तपाईंले फाइललाई नामले माग्नुहुन्छ र त्यो कुन डिस्कको कुन भागमा छ जान्नै पर्दैन। यो लोड हुने पहिलो सफ्टवेयर पनि हो। हार्डवेयर सुरु हुन्छ, OS भेट्छ र नियन्त्रण सुम्पिन्छ; त्यसपछि तपाईंले चलाउने सबै OS ले नै सुरु गर्छ।
pairs.en: Defined by its job, not by its name An operating system is the system software that controls the hardware, manages the computer's resources, and provides an interface between the user and the machine. Windows, Linux, macOS and Android are examples; none of them is the definition. Two words in that sentence carry the marks. Resources means the processor's time, the memory, the disk and the devices — all limited, all wanted by several programs at once. Interface means you ask for a file by its name and never need to know which part of which disk it is on. It is also the first software to load. The hardware starts, finds the operating system, and hands control to it; everything else you run is started by the operating system afterwards.

pairs.ne: छ काम, हरेकसँग देखाउन मिल्ने उदाहरण परीक्षकले कार्यको नाम र त्यसपछि उदाहरण खोज्छन्। उदाहरण जोडेरै सिक्नुहोस्। Process management — कुन प्रोग्रामले प्रोसेसर कति बेर पाउने तय गर्छ। टाइप गर्दागर्दै गीत बजिरहनुमा यही देखिन्छ। Memory management — हरेक प्रोग्रामलाई RAM को आफ्नै भाग दिन्छ र बन्द भएपछि फिर्ता लिन्छ। एउटा प्रोग्राम क्र्यास हुँदा अर्कोको काम नमेटिनुमा यही देखिन्छ। File management — फाइल बनाउने, नाम राख्ने, राख्ने, खोज्ने, मेट्ने र फोल्डर रुख मिलाउने। नाम दिएर सेभ गर्दा हरेक पटक देखिन्छ। Device management — driver मार्फत keyboard, printer र disk सँग कुरा गर्छ। प्रोग्रामलाई प्रिन्टरको मोडेल थाहै नभई छापिनुमा देखिन्छ। Security — पासवर्ड, प्रयोगकर्ता खाता, अनुमति। लगइन पर्दामा देखिन्छ। User interface — डेस्कटप वा command prompt, जसमार्फत तपाईं केही पनि माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ। विशेषता कार्यभन्दा फरक हो: OS भरपर्दो हुनुपर्छ (क्र्यास नहुने), दक्ष (आफैंले व्यवस्थापन गरेको स्रोत नखेर फाल्ने), सुविधाजनक, र एकैपटक धेरै प्रोग्राम चलाउन सक्ने।
pairs.en: Six jobs, each with something you can point at Examiners want the function named and then shown. Learn each with its example attached. Process management — decides which program gets the processor and for how long. You see it when music keeps playing while you type. Memory management — gives each program its own area of RAM and takes it back when the program closes. You see it when one program crashing does not erase another's work. File management — creates, names, stores, finds and deletes files, and keeps the folder tree. You see it every time you save by name. Device management — talks to the keyboard, printer and disk through drivers. You see it when a printer works without the program knowing its model. Security — passwords, user accounts, permissions. You see it at the login screen. User interface — the desktop or the command prompt through which you ask for anything at all. Characteristics are different from functions: an OS is reliable (it must not crash), efficient (it must not waste the resources it is managing), convenient and able to run several programs at once.

pairs.ne: हरेक किसिमले फरक दबाबको जवाफ दिन्छ OS लाई कति प्रयोगकर्ता, कति काम र कति हतारो भन्ने आधारमा समूह बनाइन्छ। Single-user, single-tasking — एक जना, एकैपटक एउटा काम। MS-DOS। सरल, तर प्रयोगकर्ता सोचिरहेको बेला प्रोसेसर खेर जान्छ। Single-user, multi-tasking — एक जना, एकैपटक धेरै काम। आफ्नै ल्यापटपको Windows। आजको सामान्य अवस्था यही हो। Multi-user — धेरै जनाले एउटै कम्प्युटर एकैपटक चलाउँछन्, terminal वा नेटवर्क मार्फत। Unix र Linux सर्भर। Real-time — काम तोकिएकै समयभित्र, हरेक पटक सकिनैपर्छ। एम्बुलेन्सको मोनिटर वा विमानको कम्प्युटर। ढिलो हुनु र गलत हुनु उस्तै हो। Batch — कामहरू जम्मा गरेर सँगै चलाइन्छ, कोही पर्खेर बस्दैन। तलब र बिजुलीको बिल, रातभरि चल्ने। Distributed — धेरै कम्प्युटर मिलेर काम गर्छन् र प्रयोगकर्तालाई एउटै प्रणाली जस्तो देखिन्छ।
pairs.en: Each type answers a different pressure Operating systems are grouped by how many users, how many jobs, and how urgently a job must finish. Single-user, single-tasking — one person, one job at a time. MS-DOS. Simple, and it wastes the processor whenever the user is thinking. Single-user, multi-tasking — one person, several jobs at once. Windows on your own laptop. This is the ordinary case today. Multi-user — several people use one computer at the same time, through terminals or over a network. Unix and Linux servers. Real-time — a job must finish inside a guaranteed time, every time. The computer in an ambulance monitor or an aircraft. Being late is the same as being wrong. Batch — jobs are collected and run together with no user waiting. Payroll and electricity-bill printing, run overnight. Distributed — several computers work together and appear as one system to the user.

pairs.ne: आदेश टाइप गर्ने, कि चित्रमा देखाउने User interface भनेको तपाईंले कम्प्युटरलाई के चाहियो भन्ने तरिका हो। CUI — Character User Interface, वा command-line interface — मा तपाईं आदेश टाइप गरेर Enter थिच्नुहुन्छ। dir ले फोल्डरको सूची देखाउँछ। आदेश छ भन्ने र कसरी लेख्ने थाहा हुनैपर्छ; पर्दाले केही सुराक दिँदैन। GUI — Graphical User Interface — मा तपाईं window, icon, menu र button मा देखाउनुहुन्छ। केही सम्झनै पर्दैन, किनभने उपलब्ध सबै कुरा पर्दामै देखिन्छ। परीक्षालाई यो प्रश्न मन पर्छ किनभने विद्यार्थीले स्पष्ट आधा मात्र लेख्छन्: GUI सजिलो। सजिलो हो, तर पूरा उत्तर होइन। आदेश थाहा भएकालाई CUI छिटो हुन्छ, मेमोरी निकै कम खान्छ, र — मुख्य कुरा — टाइप गरेको आदेश फाइलमा राखेर हजार कम्प्युटरमा फेरि चलाउन सकिन्छ। माउसका क्लिकको शृंखला त्यसरी राख्न मिल्दैन। सर्भर अहिले पनि command line बाटै चलाइनुको कारण यही हो।
pairs.en: Typing a command, or pointing at a picture The user interface is how you tell the computer what you want. In a CUI — Character User Interface, also called a command-line interface — you type a command and press Enter. dir lists a folder. You must know the command exists and how to spell it; the screen offers no clue. In a GUI — Graphical User Interface — you point at windows, icons, menus and buttons. Nothing has to be remembered, because everything available is on the screen to be seen. The examination likes this question because students write only the obvious half: GUI is easier. It is, and it is not the whole answer. CUI is faster for someone who knows the commands, uses far less memory, and — the important one — a typed command can be saved in a file and run again on a thousand computers. You cannot save a sequence of mouse clicks that way. That is why servers are still administered by command line.

pairs.ne: खुला भनेको source code, मूल्य होइन Open source software त्यो हो जसको source code सार्वजनिक गरिएको हुन्छ — जोसुकैले पढ्न, बदल्न र बदलेको संस्करण बाँड्न पाउँछ। Linux, LibreOffice, Firefox, GIMP र VLC उदाहरण हुन्। गलत बुझिने शब्द निःशुल्क हो। Open source प्रायः निःशुल्क हुन्छ, तर त्यो परिभाषा होइन, परिणाम हो — open source सफ्टवेयर कानुनी रूपमै बेच्न पाइन्छ। नपाइने कुरा के भने जसलाई बेच्नुभयो उसबाट code लुकाउन मिल्दैन। बन्द वा proprietary सफ्टवेयर — Windows, MS Office, Photoshop — ले पैसा तिरे पनि source code गोप्य राख्छ। फाइदा: प्रायः निःशुल्क, अध्ययन र परिमार्जन गर्न मिल्ने, धेरैले गल्ती भेट्ने र सच्याउने, र कुनै एउटै कम्पनीले फिर्ता लिन नसक्ने। बेफाइदा: कुनै कम्पनीले सहयोग गर्नैपर्ने बाध्यता छैन, कागजात पातलो हुन सक्छ, र हार्डवेयर बनाउनेले driver नदिन सक्छन्। नेपालका सन्दर्भमा यसको खास अर्थ छ: open source चलाउने विद्यालयले हरेक कम्प्युटरको लाइसेन्स शुल्क तिर्नु पर्दैन, र त्यो बचाउन कानुन मिच्नु पनि पर्दैन।
pairs.en: Open means the source code, not the price Open source software is software whose source code is published, so that anyone may read it, change it and share their changed version. Linux, LibreOffice, Firefox, GIMP and VLC are examples. The word that is misread is free. Open source software is usually free of charge, but that is a side effect, not the definition — you may legally sell open source software. What you may not do is take the code away from the people you sell it to. Closed or proprietary software — Windows, MS Office, Photoshop — keeps its source code secret, whether or not you paid for it. Advantages: usually free, can be studied and modified, faults are found and fixed by many people, and no single company can withdraw it. Disadvantages: no company is obliged to help you, documentation can be thin, and hardware makers may not supply drivers for it. This matters in Nepal in a specific way: a school that uses open source software is not paying a licence fee for each of its computers, and is not breaking the law to avoid it.

pairs.ne: सम्झने तरिका — System ले मेसिनको, application ले तपाईंको सेवा गर्छ; utility ले मेसिनकै गर्छ तर भनेपछि।
pairs.en: Memory hook — System serves the machine, application serves you, utility serves the machine but waits to be asked.

pairs.ne: System software ले कम्प्युटर आफैंलाई नियन्त्रण र व्यवस्थापन गर्छ र प्रयोगकर्ता तथा application चल्न तयार बनाउँछ। उदाहरण: operating system, भाषा अनुवादक, device driver — कुनै दुई।
pairs.en: Examples: operating system (Windows, Linux), language translators (compiler, interpreter, assembler), device drivers. Any two.

pairs.ne: System software भनेको के हो? दुई उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is system software? Give two examples.

pairs.en: List any four functions of an operating system.

pairs.ne: CUI र GUI बीचको फरक उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Differentiate between CUI and GUI with examples.

pairs.ne: Open source software भनेको के हो? कुनै एक फाइदा लेख्नुहोस्।

pairs.ne: एउटै प्रोसेसर भएको कम्प्युटरमा तपाईंले एकैपटक document, browser र music player खोल्नुभयो। तीनै एकैचोटि चलिरहेको देखिनु कुन OS कार्यले बनाउँछ?
pairs.en: You open a document, a browser and a music player at the same time on a computer with one processor. Which operating system function makes it look as if all three are running at once?

pairs.ne: Application software, किनभने प्रयोगकर्ताले खोल्छ
pairs.en: Application software, because the user starts it

pairs.ne: Utility software, किनभने यसले प्रयोगकर्ताको आफ्नो काम होइन, कम्प्युटरकै हेरचाह गर्छ
pairs.en: Utility software, because it maintains the computer rather than doing the user’s own task

pairs.ne: Operating system, किनभने पूरै मेसिन नियन्त्रण गर्छ
pairs.en: An operating system, because it controls the whole machine

pairs.ne: Device driver, किनभने डिस्कसँग काम गर्छ
pairs.en: A device driver, because it works with the disk

pairs.ne: Windows, Linux र macOS
pairs.en: Windows, Linux and macOS

pairs.ne: हार्डवेयर नियन्त्रण गर्ने, कम्प्युटरका स्रोत व्यवस्थापन गर्ने र प्रयोगकर्ता तथा मेसिनबीच इन्टरफेस दिने system software
pairs.en: System software that controls the hardware, manages the computer’s resources and provides an interface between the user and the machine

pairs.ne: प्रयोगकर्तालाई कागजात टाइप गर्न दिने प्रोग्राम
pairs.en: A program that lets the user type documents

pairs.en: The physical parts that make the computer start

pairs.ne: किनभने CUI बढी व्यावसायिक देखिन्छ
pairs.en: Because a CUI looks more professional

pairs.ne: किनभने एउटै आदेशले पूरै बान्की बताउँछ र एक पटक चल्छ, GUI मा प्रति फाइल करिब चार कार्य चाहिन्छ
pairs.en: Because one command describes the whole pattern and runs once, while a GUI needs roughly four actions per file

pairs.ne: किनभने GUI ले फाइलको नाम फेर्नै सक्दैन
pairs.en: Because a GUI cannot rename files at all

pairs.ne: किनभने CUI ले बढी मेमोरी खान्छ र त्यसैले छिटो हुन्छ
pairs.en: Because a CUI uses more memory and is therefore faster

pairs.ne: यसले कम मेमोरी खान्छ
pairs.en: It uses less memory

pairs.ne: आदेश फाइलमा राखेर दोहोर्‍याउन मिल्छ
pairs.en: Commands can be saved in a file and repeated

pairs.ne: प्रयोगकर्ताले आदेश सम्झनु पर्दैन, किनभने विकल्प पर्दामै देखिन्छन्
pairs.en: The user does not have to memorise commands, because the options are visible on screen

pairs.ne: धेरै पुराना कम्प्युटरमा छिटो चल्छ
pairs.en: It works faster on very old computers

pairs.ne: यो निःशुल्क हुन्छ
pairs.en: It is free of charge

pairs.ne: यसको source code सार्वजनिक हुन्छ, जोसुकैले पढ्न, बदल्न र पुनर्वितरण गर्न सक्छ
pairs.en: Its source code is published, so anyone may read, modify and redistribute it

pairs.ne: इन्टरनेटबाट डाउनलोड गर्न मिल्छ
pairs.en: It can be downloaded from the Internet

pairs.ne: जुनसुकै OS मा चल्छ
pairs.en: It runs on any operating system

pairs.ne: किनभने hard disk application software का लागि धेरै ढिलो छ
pairs.en: Because the hard disk is too slow for application software

pairs.ne: किनभने हार्डवेयरसँग बोल्ने तह OS हो, र application ले त्यही मार्फत अनुरोध गर्छ
pairs.en: Because the operating system is the layer that talks to the hardware, and applications ask it to do so on their behalf

pairs.ne: किनभने डिस्क छुन utility software लाई मात्र पाइन्छ
pairs.en: Because only utility software may touch a disk

pairs.ne: सक्छ — application ले सिधै डिस्कमा पढ्छ र लेख्छ
pairs.en: It can — applications read and write disks directly

pairs.ne: Antivirus सफ्टवेयरलाई कुन वर्गमा राख्नु सबैभन्दा ठिक हुन्छ?
pairs.en: Antivirus software is best classified as:

pairs.ne: C compiler ले विद्यार्थीको प्रोग्राम machine code मा अनुवाद गर्छ। यो कुन किसिमको सफ्टवेयर हो?
pairs.en: A C compiler translates a student’s program into machine code. Which type of software is it?

pairs.ne: Operating system को सबैभन्दा राम्रो परिभाषा कुन हो?
pairs.en: Which statement best defines an operating system?

pairs.ne: एउटै प्रोसेसर भएको कम्प्युटरमा विद्यार्थीले गीत बजाउँदै कागजात टाइप गर्छ। दुवै एकैचोटि चलेजस्तो कुन OS कार्यले बनाउँछ?
pairs.en: On a computer with one processor, a student types a document while music plays. Which operating system function makes both appear to run at once?

pairs.ne: अस्पतालको बिरामी मोनिटरको कम्प्युटरले मुटुको धड्कनमा आएको परिवर्तनलाई हरेक पटक तोकिएकै समयभित्र जवाफ दिनुपर्छ। यसलाई कुन किसिमको OS चाहिन्छ?
pairs.en: The computer in a hospital patient monitor must respond to a change in heartbeat within a guaranteed time, every time. Which type of operating system does it need?

pairs.ne: विद्यालयले ३०० फोटोको नाम उही तरिकाले फेर्नुपर्छ। यहाँ command-line interface किन उपयुक्त हुन्छ?
pairs.en: A school must rename 300 photographs, all in the same way. Why is a command-line interface the better choice here?

pairs.ne: CUI भन्दा GUI को फाइदा कुन हो?
pairs.en: Which is an advantage of a GUI over a CUI?

pairs.ne: सफ्टवेयर open source हो भन्नुको अर्थ के हो?
pairs.en: What does it mean to say software is open source?

pairs.en: Which of these is NOT open source software?

pairs.en: Why can a word processor not write directly to the hard disk itself?

pairs.ne: — सफ्टवेयर भनेको के हो
pairs.en: What software is

pairs.ne: — सफ्टवेयरका किसिम र तिनका विशेषता
pairs.en: Types of software and their features

pairs.ne: — Operating system भनेको के हो
pairs.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् System, application or utility? What you will learn: to classify software by who it serves rather than by whether you have heard of it. Two of the cases are the ones students reliably get wrong. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: नाम सुनेको छ कि छैन होइन, कसको सेवा गर्छ हेरेर वर्गीकरण गर्न। दुई केस विद्यार्थीले नियमित रूपमा बिगार्ने खालका छन्। How to use this For each case ask: would the computer still work without it? If no, it is system software. If yes but it still looks after the machine, it is a utility. If yes and it does a job for you, it is an application. हरेक केसमा सोध्नुहोस्: यो नभए पनि कम्प्युटर चल्छ? चल्दैन भने system software। चल्छ तर मेसिनकै हेरचाह गर्छ भने utility। चल्छ र तपाईंको काम गर्छ भने application। 3.3 What an operating system is

pairs.ne: — Operating system का कार्य र विशेषता
pairs.en: Functions and characteristics of an operating system

pairs.ne: — Operating system का किसिम
pairs.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् You open a document, a browser and a music player at the same time on a computer with one processor. Which operating system function makes it look as if all three are running at once? एउटै प्रोसेसर भएको कम्प्युटरमा तपाईंले एकैपटक document, browser र music player खोल्नुभयो। तीनै एकैचोटि चलिरहेको देखिनु कुन OS कार्यले बनाउँछ? Memory management Process management Device management Process management. One processor can run exactly one instruction at a time. The operating system gives each program a slice of processor time — a few milliseconds each — and switches between them so quickly that all three appear continuous to you. Memory management is also happening, and it is what keeps the three programs from overwriting each other, but it is not what creates the appearance of simultaneity. The word for this is multitasking, and it is a scheduling job. Process management। एउटा प्रोसेसरले एकैपटक एउटै निर्देशन चलाउन सक्छ। OS ले हरेक प्रोग्रामलाई प्रोसेसरको समयको टुक्रा — केही मिलिसेकेन्ड — दिन्छ र यति छिटो फेरिदिन्छ कि तीनै निरन्तर देखिन्छन्। Memory management पनि भइरहेको हुन्छ र त्यसैले तीन प्रोग्रामले एकअर्काको ठाउँ बिगार्दैनन्, तर एकैचोटि चलेको देखावट त्यसले बनाउँदैन। यसको नाम multitasking हो, र यो समय बाँड्ने काम हो। 3.5 Types of operating system

pairs.ne: — प्रयोगकर्ता इन्टरफेस — CUI र GUI
pairs.en: User interface — CUI and GUI

pairs.ne: — खुला स्रोत सफ्टवेयर (OSS)
pairs.en: Think before opening: how many actions is this in a GUI, and how many in a CUI? Count, do not guess. खोल्नुअघि सोच्नुहोस्: यो काम GUI मा कति कार्य हो, CUI मा कति? अनुमान होइन, गन्नुहोस्। Working In a GUI select file, rename, type new name, press Enter = 4 actions × 300 files = about 1200 actions In a CUI one command describing the pattern, run once = 1 action, and it can be saved and reused next year Answer CUI — the work is repetitive and identical, which is exactly what a command describes well Note for renaming ONE file, the GUI wins: you can see the file, and no command has to be remembered The lesson is not that one interface is better. It is that repetitive work suits a command and one-off work suits a picture — which is why both still exist. पाठ यो होइन कि कुनै एउटा राम्रो हो। दोहोरिने काम आदेशलाई सुहाउँछ, एकपटकको काम चित्रलाई — त्यसैले दुवै अझै छन्। 3.7 Open Source Software (OSS)

pairs.ne: — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू ८ घण्टा
pairs.en: For each one ask: would the computer still work without it? Write your five answers first — two of them are the ones people get wrong. हरेकका लागि सोध्नुहोस्: यो नभए पनि कम्प्युटर चल्छ? पहिले आफ्ना पाँच उत्तर लेख्नुहोस् — तीमध्ये दुई प्रायः गलत हुन्छन्। Working Windows SYSTEM the machine cannot run at all without it C compiler SYSTEM produces machine code the processor needs; serves the MACHINE, not your task MS-Word APPLICATION does the job you sat down to do antivirus UTILITY looks after the machine; you start it compression tool UTILITY maintenance on files, not your task Remove-and-it-stops: WINDOWS. Remove any of the other four and the computer still starts and runs. The compiler and the antivirus are the two that move. Both are started by a person, which is why they feel like applications — but who starts it is not the test. Who it serves is. सर्ने दुई — compiler र antivirus। दुवै मान्छेले खोल्छ, त्यसैले application जस्तो लाग्छ — तर कसले खोल्छ भन्ने जाँच होइन। कसको सेवा गर्छ भन्ने हो। Mistakes that cost marks here Defining an operating system as "Windows". Windows is an example. The definition is about controlling hardware, managing resources and providing an interface. Calling antivirus an application. It serves the machine, not your task — it is utility software. Saying open source means free of cost. It means the source code is open. Free of charge is usual, not required. Writing only "GUI is easier" for a CUI/GUI comparison. Four marks want two advantages each way, and CUI's advantages are speed for an expert, low memory use, and commands that can be saved and repeated. Confusing functions with characteristics of an OS. A function is a job it performs; a characteristic is a quality it has. OS लाई "Windows" भन्नु: Windows उदाहरण हो; परिभाषा हार्डवेयर नियन्त्रण, स्रोत व्यवस्थापन र इन्टरफेसको हो। Antivirus लाई application भन्नु: यसले मेसिनको सेवा गर्छ — utility software हो। Open source लाई निःशुल्क भन्नु: अर्थ source code खुला हुनु हो। CUI/GUI मा "GUI सजिलो" मात्र लेख्नु: चार अंकले दुवैतिरका दुई–दुई फाइदा खोज्छ। OS का कार्य र विशेषता मिसाउनु: कार्य भनेको गर्ने काम, विशेषता भनेको गुण। Memory hook — System serves the machine, application serves you, utility serves the machine but waits to be asked. सम्झने तरिका — System ले मेसिनको, application ले तपाईंको सेवा गर्छ; utility ले मेसिनकै गर्छ तर भनेपछि। Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours
englishVariants: Name each item before opening this. One of the four is not the component it first appears to be. खोल्नुअघि हरेक वस्तुको नाम भन्नुहोस्। चारमध्ये एउटा पहिलो नजरमा देखिएको भाग होइन। Working photograph IMAGE a single still picture caption with height TEXT letters and numbers recorded narration AUDIO sound growing bar chart ANIMATION not image — it CHANGES over time, and the frames are generated, not filmed Components present: 4 of the 5 (video is missing) Is it multimedia? YES — more than one medium is the test, and four is comfortably more than one The chart is the one that moves. A static chart would be an image; this one changes over time and was generated rather than recorded, which is animation. सर्ने वस्तु चार्ट नै हो। स्थिर चार्ट image हुन्थ्यो; यो समयसँगै बदलिन्छ र रेकर्ड होइन, बनाइएको हो — त्यही animation। Example 2 Which medium is doing the work? Question: a health message must reach villagers, some of whom cannot read. Which components of multimedia should carry the message, and which one cannot be relied on? One component requires a skill the audience may not have. Decide which, and what replaces it. एउटा भागलाई श्रोतासँग नहुन सक्ने सीप चाहिन्छ। कुन हो र त्यसको ठाउँमा के आउँछ, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। Working TEXT cannot be relied on — it needs literacy AUDIO works — spoken Nepali needs no reading IMAGE works — a picture of the right action ANIMATION works, and is better than an image where the message is a SEQUENCE: wash, then cover, then store VIDEO works, but the file is large and a village connection may not carry it Answer: audio + image, with animation where a process must be shown. Keep text as a caption for those who can read it, not as the carrier of the message. This is the real argument for multimedia, and it is not that pictures are nicer. One medium alone would have left part of the audience out. मल्टिमिडियाको साँचो तर्क यही हो, र त्यो "तस्बिर राम्रो देखिन्छ" भन्नु होइन। एउटै माध्यमले श्रोताको एक हिस्सा छुटाउँथ्यो। Mistakes that cost marks here Calling a single photograph multimedia. One medium is not many. The word needs at least two. Saying animation and video are the same. Video is recorded from reality; animation is created frame by frame. Listing only four components. Text, audio, video, image, animation — five. The one usually dropped is text, which is also the oldest. Leaving interactivity out of the features. It is what separates a multimedia application from a film. Giving a file format for the wrong component. .mp3 is audio, .mp4 is video. The digits are not decoration. एउटै फोटोलाई मल्टिमिडिया भन्नु: एउटा माध्यम धेरै होइन। Animation र video उस्तै भन्नु: video वास्तविकताबाट रेकर्ड, animation फ्रेम–फ्रेम बनाइएको। चार भाग मात्र लेख्नु: पाँच हुन् — प्रायः छुट्ने text, जुन सबैभन्दा पुरानो पनि हो। विशेषतामा अन्तरक्रियात्मकता छुटाउनु: चलचित्रभन्दा मल्टिमिडिया app लाई छुट्याउने त्यही हो। गलत भागको ढाँचा दिनु: .mp3 audio, .mp4 video। Memory hook — TAVIA: Text, Audio, Video, Image, Animation. Recorded moves is video; drawn moves is animation. सम्झने तरिका — TAVIA। रेकर्ड गरेको चल्छ भने video, कोरेको चल्छ भने animation। Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: नाम सुनेको छ कि छैन होइन, कसको सेवा गर्छ हेरेर वर्गीकरण गर्न। दुई केस विद्यार्थीले नियमित रूपमा बिगार्ने खालका छन्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to classify software by who it serves rather than by whether you have heard of it. Two of the cases are the ones students reliably get wrong.

pairs.ne: RAM ले हरेक bit लाई ताजा पार्नुपर्ने विद्युतीय चार्जका रूपमा राख्छ, त्यसैले बत्ती गए रित्तिन्छ — volatile। Hard disk ले चुम्बकत्वको दिशाका रूपमा र SSD ले थुनिएको चार्जका रूपमा राख्छ; दुवैलाई रहन बिजुली चाहिँदैन। "Save" भनेकै volatile ठाउँबाट non-volatile ठाउँमा सार्ने काम हो।
pairs.en: RAM stores each bit as an electrical charge that must be refreshed, so cutting the power empties it — volatile. A hard disk stores each bit as a direction of magnetism and an SSD as a trapped charge; neither needs power to stay put. "Save" is precisely the act of copying from the volatile place to the non-volatile one.

pairs.ne: Cache हुनुको कारण गतिको बेमेल हो: CPU ले एक निर्देशन नानोसेकेन्डभन्दा कममा सक्छ, तर RAM बाट ल्याउन दसौं नानोसेकेन्ड लाग्छ। Cache नभए प्रोसेसरको धेरैजसो समय पर्खाइमै जान्थ्यो। विकल्प (घ) ले ROM को वर्णन गर्छ, cache को होइन।
pairs.en: Cache exists because of a speed mismatch: a CPU can execute an instruction in well under a nanosecond while fetching from RAM takes tens of nanoseconds. Without cache the processor would spend most of its time waiting. Option D describes ROM, not cache.

pairs.ne: साँचो फरक refresh हो, र बाँकी सबै त्यसैबाट निस्कन्छ: refresh का कारण DRAM ढिलो हुन्छ, र capacitor सर्किटभन्दा सरल भएकाले निकै सस्तो — त्यसैले main memory DRAM र सानो, महँगो cache SRAM हुन्छ। विकल्प (घ) ले दुईलाई उल्टो पारेको छ। दुवै volatile हुन्।
pairs.en: Refreshing is the real difference, and everything else follows from it: DRAM is slower because of the refreshing and far cheaper because a capacitor is simpler than a circuit, which is why main memory is DRAM and the small, costly cache is SRAM. Option D has those two the wrong way round. Both are volatile.

pairs.ne: EPROM भनेको Erasable Programmable ROM हो, र पराबैजनी किरण कक्षसम्म पुग्न चिपमा सानो क्वार्ज झ्याल हुन्छ। PROM एक पटक लेखिन्छ, कहिल्यै मेटिँदैन; EEPROM विद्युतीय रूपमा मेटिन्छ — झ्याल नचाहिने, चिप नझिकी — त्यसैले EEPROM कै विकास flash memory ठाउँमै पुनर्लेखन गर्न मिल्छ।
pairs.en: EPROM is Erasable Programmable ROM, and the chip carries a small quartz window for the ultraviolet light to reach the cells. PROM can be written once and never erased; EEPROM is erased electrically, with no window and without removing the chip — which is why flash memory, a development of EEPROM, can be rewritten in place.

pairs.ne: CPU ले primary memory मा भएको कुरामा मात्र काम गर्न सक्छ, त्यसैले फाइलको केही भाग ढिलो यान्त्रिक डिस्कबाट छिटो विद्युतीय RAM मा पहिले सार्नुपर्छ। त्यही सार्ने काम शृंखलाको सबैभन्दा ढिलो कडी हो र तपाईं त्यसैलाई पर्खिरहनुभएको हुन्छ। पुरानो कम्प्युटरमा SSD हाल्दा नयाँ जस्तो हुनु तर छिटो प्रोसेसरले प्रायः फरक नपर्नुको कारण पनि यही हो।
pairs.en: The CPU can only work on what is in primary memory, so part of the file must be copied from the slow mechanical disk into fast electronic RAM first. That copy is the slowest link in the chain and it is what you are waiting for. This is also why fitting an SSD makes an old computer feel new while a faster processor often does not — the wait was never the CPU.

pairs.ne: Optical storage: लेजरले खाल्डा पोल्छ, र पढ्दा प्रकाश खाल्डाबाट फर्कियो कि समथर भागबाट भनेर थाहा पाइन्छ। चुम्बकत्व hard disk को, थुनिएको चार्ज pen drive जस्ता flash memory को। तीन परिवार छुट्याउने आधार यही हो — एउटा bit भौतिक रूपमा कसरी राखिन्छ।
pairs.en: Optical storage: a laser burns pits, and reading detects whether light reflects from a pit or a flat area. Magnetism is the hard disk, trapped charge is flash memory such as a pen drive. The three families are told apart by exactly this — how a single bit is physically held.

pairs.ne: तह यसरी चल्छ: register, cache, RAM, secondary storage — CPU सँग जति नजिक, त्यति छिटो, सानो र प्रति byte महँगो। सामान्य गल्ती cache लाई RAM भन्दा तल राख्नु हो; cache, RAM भन्दा छिटो भएकैले CPU र RAM बीचमा बस्छ।
pairs.en: The hierarchy runs registers, cache, RAM, secondary storage — closest to the CPU is fastest, smallest and costliest per byte. The common error is placing cache below RAM; cache sits between the CPU and RAM precisely because it is faster than RAM.

pairs.ne: सुरु हुँदा दुवै सर्त पूरा हुनुपर्छ: बत्ती बन्द हुँदा पनि सामग्री बाँचेको हुनुपर्‍यो — यसले RAM हटाउँछ; र कुनै disk driver लोड हुनुअघि नै पुग्न सकिनुपर्‍यो — यसले disk हटाउँछ। दुवै पूरा गर्ने भनेको बोर्डमै भएको non-volatile मेमोरी हो, अर्थात् BIOS बोक्ने ROM।
pairs.en: Two conditions must both hold at startup: the contents must have survived the power being off, which rules out RAM, and they must be reachable before any disk driver has loaded, which rules out the disk. Only non-volatile memory on the board itself satisfies both, and that is ROM holding the BIOS.

pairs.ne: एक byte = ८ bit, र एक byte ले लगभग एक अक्षर राख्छ। यसलाई 1 KB = 1024 byte सँग नमिसाउनुहोस् — ८ र १०२४ फरक सम्बन्ध हुन् र दुवै सोधिन्छन्।
pairs.en: One byte is 8 bits, and one byte holds roughly one character. Do not confuse this with 1 KB = 1024 bytes — the 8 and the 1024 are different relationships and both are asked.

pairs.ne: कुन मेमोरीको वर्णन हो?
pairs.en: Which memory is being described?

pairs.ne: हरेक केसमा नाम होइन, व्यवहार लेखिएको छ। क्रमैसँग दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: बत्ती गएपछि बाँच्छ? CPU ले सिधै पढ्न सक्छ? यी दुई उत्तरले यस विषयका झन्डै सबै मेमोरी ठाउँमा राख्छन्।
pairs.en: Each case describes a behaviour, not a name. Ask two questions in order: does it survive the power going off, and can the CPU read it directly? Those two answers place almost every memory in this subject.

pairs.ne: सुराक "कुनै डिस्क पढिनुअघि" भन्नेमा छ। सुरुवाती निर्देशन डिस्कमा हुनै सक्दैन, किनभने डिस्क कसरी पढ्ने भन्नै कसैलाई थाहा छैन। ती ROM मा हुन्छन्, जुन non-volatile छ।
pairs.en: Before any disk is read is the clue. The startup instructions cannot be on the disk, because nothing yet knows how to read a disk. They are in ROM, which is non-volatile and therefore still there.

pairs.ne: चलिरहेको काम र बत्ती गएपछि हराउने — यो RAM हो। पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने र volatile; "save" भनेको नहराउने ठाउँमा सार्नु भनेकै त्यसैले हो।
pairs.en: Work in progress plus lost on power cut is RAM. It is read-write and volatile, which is exactly why "save" means copying it somewhere that is not.

pairs.ne: CPU र main memory बीचमा हुनु नै cache को परिभाषा हो। CPU, RAM भन्दा धेरै छिटो भएकाले मात्र यो छ, र यो SRAM मा बनेको हुन्छ — refresh चाहिँदैन।
pairs.en: Between the CPU and main memory is the definition of cache. It exists only because the CPU is much faster than RAM, and it is made of SRAM, which needs no refreshing.

pairs.ne: बत्ती बन्द अवस्थामै स्थायी रूपमा राख्नु भनेको secondary storage हो — hard disk, SSD, optical disc वा pen drive। सबै non-volatile, र RAM मा नसारी CPU ले कुनै पनि पढ्न सक्दैन।
pairs.en: Permanent keeping with the power off is secondary storage — hard disk, SSD, optical disc or pen drive. All non-volatile, and none of them readable by the CPU without being copied into RAM first.

pairs.ne: Refresh भनेको DRAM हो, र main memory DRAM कै बनेको हुन्छ — त्यसैले उत्तर RAM। Cache चाहिँ SRAM हो, जसले bit सर्किटमा राख्छ र refresh चाहिँदैन। दुईलाई छुट्याउने शब्द refresh नै हो।
pairs.en: Refreshing is DRAM, and DRAM is what main memory is made of — so the answer is RAM. Cache is SRAM, which holds each bit in a circuit and never needs refreshing. Refresh is the word that separates the two.

pairs.ne: यो EPROM — Erasable Programmable ROM — हो, र EPROM, ROM कै एक किसिम हो। मेटिन सक्ने भयो भन्दैमा RAM हुँदैन: ROM भनेको सामान्य प्रयोगमा पढ्न मात्र मिल्ने हो, र मेट्न चलिरहेको कम्प्युटरबाहिरको विशेष प्रक्रिया चाहिन्छ।
pairs.en: That is EPROM — Erasable Programmable ROM — and EPROM is a kind of ROM. Being erasable does not make it RAM: ROM is read-only in NORMAL USE, and erasing it needs a special process outside the running computer.

pairs.ne: पहिले दुवैतिरका तीर पढ्नुहोस्, अनि तह। "Cache किन चाहिन्छ?" भन्ने प्रश्नको उत्तर माथिको CPU र बीचको RAM बीचको खाडलमा छ।
pairs.en: Read the two side arrows first, then the levels. A question asking "why is cache memory used?" is answered by the gap between the CPU at the top and RAM in the middle.

pairs.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: कम्प्युटर मेमोरीको परिभाषा र यसले data बाहेक के राख्छ भन्न, जुनसुकै मेमोरीलाई तहमा राखेर किन त्यहीँ पर्छ बुझाउन, cache किन चाहिन्छ भन्न (ठाउँ मात्र होइन, कारण), RAM र ROM अनि SRAM/DRAM र PROM/EPROM/EEPROM छुट्याउन, secondary storage का तीन परिवार उदाहरणसहित नाम लिन, र फाइल CPU ले चलाउनुअघि किन RAM मा सार्नुपर्छ बुझाउन सक्नुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: Explain why a file must be copied into RAM before the CPU can work on it.

pairs.ne: तपाईं निबन्ध टाइप गर्दै हुनुहुन्थ्यो, सेभ गर्नुअघि बत्ती गयो। निबन्ध हरायो। गत वर्षका फोटा भने छँदै छन्। दुवै "कम्प्युटरमै" थिए। एउटा किन बाँच्यो र अर्को किन बाँचेन?
pairs.en: You are typing an essay and the power goes off before you save. The essay is gone. Your photographs from last year are still there. Both were "in the computer". Why did one survive and the other not?

pairs.ne: दुई फरक किसिमको मेमोरी। टाइप गरिरहेको निबन्ध RAM मा थियो, जहाँ हरेक bit चार्जका रूपमा रहन्छ र सेकेन्डमा हजारौं पटक ताजा पार्नुपर्छ। बत्ती गए चार्ज रित्तिन्छ — यसलाई volatile भनिन्छ। फोटा hard disk मा थिए, जहाँ हरेक bit चुम्बकत्वको दिशा हो, वा SSD मा, जहाँ इन्सुलेट गरिएको कक्षमा चार्ज थुनिएको हुन्छ। दुवैलाई रहन बिजुली चाहिँदैन: non-volatile। "Save" भनेकै volatile ठाउँबाट non-volatile ठाउँमा सार्ने काम हो।
pairs.en: "Save" is exactly the act of copying from the volatile place to the non-volatile one. That is why the instruction to save often is not nagging — it is a statement about physics.

pairs.ne: RAM — पढ्न र लेख्न मिल्ने, volatile; कम्प्युटरको काम गर्ने ठाउँ। SRAM: flip-flop मा, refresh नचाहिने, धेरै छिटो, महँगो — cache यही हो। DRAM: साना capacitor मा चार्ज, चुहिने भएकाले सेकेन्डमा हजारौं पटक refresh गर्नुपर्ने; ढिलो तर निकै सस्तो — main memory यही हो। ROM — सामान्य प्रयोगमा पढ्न मात्र, non-volatile; कम्प्युटर सुरु हुने बित्तिकै चाहिने निर्देशन (BIOS) राख्छ। PROM: एक पटक मात्र लेख्न मिल्ने। EPROM: पराबैजनी किरण ले मेटेर फेरि लेख्न मिल्ने; चिपमा सानो क्वार्ज झ्याल हुन्छ। EEPROM: विद्युतीय रूपमा मेटिने, झ्याल नचाहिने, चिप नझिकी — flash memory यसैको विकास हो।
pairs.en: EEPROM (Electrically Erasable PROM) — erased electrically, with no window and without removing the chip. Flash memory is a development of this, which is why a pen drive can be rewritten in place.

pairs.ne: खोल्नुअघि: माथिका मेमोरीमध्ये CPU ले कुनबाट सिधै पढ्न सक्छ, र भिडियो अहिले कहाँ छ?
pairs.en: Before opening: which of the memories above can the CPU read from directly, and where is the video right now?

pairs.ne: पुरानो कम्प्युटरमा SSD हाल्दा नयाँ जस्तो हुनुको र छिटो प्रोसेसरले प्रायः फरक नपर्नुको कारण यही हो: पर्खाइ CPU को कहिल्यै थिएन।
pairs.en: This is why installing an SSD makes an old computer feel new while a faster processor often does not: the wait was never the CPU.

pairs.ne: दुई तथ्य चाहिन्छ: एक gigabyte मा कति byte, र एक अक्षरले कति byte लिन्छ। खोल्नुअघि निकाल्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Two facts are needed: how many bytes are in a gigabyte, and how many bytes one character takes. Work it out before opening this.

pairs.ne: "2 GB" को पेन ड्राइभ र "2 GB" को विज्ञापन किन मिल्दैनन् भन्ने कारण यही हो: कतिपय उत्पादकले हजारमा गन्छन्, कम्प्युटरले १०२४ मा।
pairs.en: This is why a "2 GB" pen drive and a "2 GB" advertisement can disagree: some manufacturers count in thousands and the computer counts in 1024s.

pairs.ne: RAM लाई "अस्थायी" मात्र भन्नु: अंक volatile र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने भन्नुमा छ। ROM लाई "लेख्नै नमिल्ने" भन्नु: PROM, EPROM, EEPROM मा लेख्न मिल्छ — एक पटक, UV ले, वा विद्युतीय रूपमा। Cache लाई RAM भन्दा तल राख्नु: cache RAM भन्दा छिटो छ र CPU सँग नजिक। CPU ले hard disk बाट फाइल पढ्छ भन्नु: सक्दैन — हरेक पटक RAM मा सारिन्छ। SRAM/DRAM लाई गतिले मात्र छुट्याउनु: साँचो फरक refresh मा छ।
pairs.en: Confusing SRAM and DRAM by speed alone. The real difference is refreshing: DRAM leaks and must be refreshed, SRAM does not.

pairs.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ४ को सूचीबाट; यसले यिनलाई नमुना भनेको छ। यस युनिटमा विषयकै सबैभन्दा कम — ६ — प्रयोगात्मक घण्टा र सबैभन्दा धेरै क्रियाकलाप छन्। शिक्षकले छानेर दिनुहुनेछ।
pairs.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 4, which calls these samples. Note that this unit has the fewest practical hours in the subject — six — and the most activities. Your teacher will almost certainly choose among them.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: ४.१ र ४.२। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। चारै तह एउटै स्लाइडमा नराखी एक तह एक स्लाइड बनाउनुहोस् — क्रम नै मुख्य कुरा हो।
pairs.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 4.1 and 4.2. Hand in: the file and your notes. Build the pyramid one level per slide rather than putting all four on one — the order is the point.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: ४.५। बुझाउने: फाइल। राम्रो प्रस्तुतीकरणले चार आधारमा तुलना गर्छ — चल्ने भाग, गति, प्रति GB मूल्य, र खसाले के हुन्छ — "SSD छिटो छ" मात्र होइन।
pairs.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 4.5. Hand in: the file. A good version compares on four grounds — moving parts, speed, price per GB, and what happens if you drop it — not just "SSD is faster".

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: विद्यालयको ल्याब। यो यहाँबाट हुँदैन — यो तपाईंकै ल्याबको कुरा हो। बुझाउने: फाइल, हरेक उपकरणको क्षमता र परिवार (magnetic, optical, flash) सहित।
pairs.en: You need: access to your school lab. This cannot be done from this site — it is about your lab. Hand in: the file, with each device's capacity and family (magnetic, optical or flash).

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: चार्ट पेपर, मार्कर। आधार: ४.२, ४.४, ४.५। बुझाउने: चार्ट र फोटो। सूची होइन, पिरामिड बनाउनुहोस् — क्रम देखाउने चार्टले सूचीले नसक्ने कुरा सिकाउँछ।
pairs.en: You need: chart paper, markers. Builds on: 4.2, 4.4, 4.5. Hand in: the chart and a photograph in your record file. Draw it as the pyramid, not as a list — a chart that shows the order teaches something a list cannot.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: शिक्षक वा अभिभावकसँग मिलाएको भ्रमण। सिमुलेसनले हुँदैन। बुझाउने: देखेका उपकरणको सूची, क्षमता, मूल्य र मिति। त्यहाँ एउटा प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: सबैभन्दा धेरै के बिग्रन्छ, र किन।
pairs.en: You need: a visit arranged with your teacher or guardian. This cannot be simulated. Hand in: a list of what you saw with capacity and price, and the date. Ask one question while you are there: what fails most often, and why.

pairs.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ८ अंक र ६४ मध्ये १० घण्टा ओगट्छ। मानक प्रश्न: RAM र ROM छुट्याउने; cache memory के हो र किन चाहिन्छ; secondary storage का किसिम उदाहरणसहित; र RAM, ROM, PROM, EPROM, EEPROM का पूरा रूप। पूरा रूप सजिला अंक हुन् र हरेक वर्ष गुम्छन्।
pairs.en: This unit carries 8 of the 50 external marks and 10 of the 64 theory hours. The standard questions are: differentiate RAM and ROM; what is cache memory and why is it used; types of secondary storage with examples; and the full forms of RAM, ROM, PROM, EPROM and EEPROM. The full forms are free marks and are lost every year.

pairs.ne: RAM — पढ्न र लेख्न दुवै मिल्ने; volatile; अहिले चलिरहेका प्रोग्राम र data राख्ने; किसिम SRAM र DRAM। ROM — सामान्य प्रयोगमा पढ्न मात्र; non-volatile; BIOS जस्ता सुरुवाती निर्देशन राख्ने; किसिम PROM, EPROM, EEPROM। जोडी मिलाएर लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Write them as matched pairs. Four marks is normally four differences, one mark each.

pairs.ne: Secondary memory भनेको data र प्रोग्राम स्थायी रूपमा राख्ने non-volatile भण्डारण हो; ठूलो क्षमता, प्रति byte सस्तो, र CPU ले सिधै पुग्न नसक्ने। किसिम: Magnetic (hard disk, SSD), Optical (CD, DVD, Blu-ray), Flash (pen drive)।
pairs.en: 1. Magnetic storage — stores bits as magnetism. Examples: hard disk, SSD (as grouped by the curriculum). 2. Optical storage — stores bits as pits read by a laser. Examples: CD, DVD, Blu-ray disc. 3. Flash memory — stores bits as trapped charge, no moving parts. Example: pen drive.

pairs.ne: बान्की हेर्नुहोस्: हरेक लामो नामले छोटोको अगाडि एउटा शब्द थप्छ। पहिले PROM सिक्नुहोस्, अरू दुई आफैं आउँछन्।
pairs.en: Notice the pattern: each longer name adds one word to the front of the shorter one. Learn PROM first and the other two follow.

pairs.ne: मेमोरीले data र निर्देशन दुवै राख्छ; 1 KB = 1024 byte। तह एउटै सम्झौता हो: माथि छिटो–सानो–महँगो, तल उल्टो। CPU, RAM भन्दा धेरै छिटो भएकाले cache चाहिन्छ। RAM: पढ्न–लेख्न, volatile — SRAM (cache) र DRAM (main, refresh चाहिने)। ROM: पढ्न मात्र, non-volatile — PROM, EPROM (UV), EEPROM (विद्युतीय)। Secondary: non-volatile र CPU ले सिधै नपुग्ने — magnetic, optical, flash।
pairs.en: Secondary storage is non-volatile and not directly reachable by the CPU: magnetic, optical, flash.

pairs.ne: हरेक केसमा क्रमैसँग दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: बत्ती गएपछि बाँच्छ? CPU ले सिधै पुग्छ? यी दुई उत्तरले यस विषयका झन्डै सबै मेमोरी ठाउँमा राख्छन्।
pairs.en: For each case ask two questions in order: does it survive a power cut, and can the CPU reach it directly? Those two answers place almost every memory in the subject.

pairs.ne: परिभाषा, र विद्यार्थीले छुटाउने भाग मेमोरी कम्प्युटरको त्यो भाग हो जसले data, निर्देशन र नतिजा राख्छ, ताकि आवश्यक पर्दा प्रयोग गर्न सकियोस्। प्रायः छुट्ने भाग निर्देशन हो। मेमोरीले तपाईंले चलाइरहेको संख्या मात्र होइन, त्यो चलाउने प्रोग्राम पनि राख्छ। युनिट १ को stored-program विचार यही हो, र भण्डारण हुने ठाउँ मेमोरी। मेमोरी bit र byte मा नापिन्छ: 1 byte = 8 bit, 1 KB = 1024 byte, 1 MB = 1024 KB, 1 GB = 1024 MB, 1 TB = 1024 GB। हरेक एकाइ तलकोभन्दा २१० गुणा, किनभने मेमोरीका ठेगाना binary मा हुन्छन्।
pairs.en: The definition, with the part students leave out Memory is the part of a computer that stores data, instructions and results, so that they can be used when needed. The part usually left out is instructions. Memory does not only hold the numbers you are working on — it holds the program that is working on them. That is the stored-program idea from Unit 1, and memory is where it is stored. Memory is measured in bits and bytes: 1 byte = 8 bits, 1 KB = 1024 bytes, 1 MB = 1024 KB, 1 GB = 1024 MB, 1 TB = 1024 GB. Each unit is 210 of the one below because memory addresses are binary.

pairs.ne: सूची होइन, पिरामिड मेमोरीलाई सामान्यतया primary (मुख्य) र secondary (सहायक) मा बाँडिन्छ, र दुवैभन्दा माथि cache तथा register हुन्छन्। पिरामिडका रूपमा सिक्नुहोस्, किनभने आकारले नै क्रम बुझाउँछ। यो पूरै बनावट एउटै सम्झौताबाट आउँछ: छिटो मेमोरी महँगो हुन्छ, त्यसैले थोरै हुन्छ; सस्तो मेमोरी ढिलो हुन्छ, त्यसैले धेरै हुन्छ। एउटै किसिम छिटो, ठूलो र सस्तो हुन सक्थ्यो भने चार किसिम कसैले बनाउने थिएन। पिरामिडमा माथि जाँदा: छिटो, सानो, प्रति byte महँगो। तल जाँदा: ढिलो, ठूलो, प्रति byte सस्तो। यस युनिटका हरेक तथ्य यिनै दुई वाक्यबाट निस्कन्छन्।
pairs.en: A pyramid, not a list Memory is usually divided into primary (main) memory and secondary (auxiliary) storage, with cache and registers above both. Learn it as a pyramid, because the shape explains the order. The whole arrangement comes from one trade-off: fast memory is expensive, so there is little of it; cheap memory is slow, so there is a lot of it. Nobody would build four kinds of memory if one kind could be fast, big and cheap at once. Going up the pyramid: faster, smaller, costlier per byte. Going down: slower, bigger, cheaper per byte. Every fact in this unit follows from those two sentences.

pairs.ne: दुई नमिल्ने गतिबीचको सानो छिटो तखता Cache memory भनेको CPU र RAM बीचमा राखिएको थोरै तर धेरै छिटो मेमोरी हो। CPU ले भर्खरै चलाएको data र निर्देशन राख्छ, चाँडै फेरि चाहिन्छ भन्ने व्यावहारिक अनुमानमा। यो हुनुको कारण गतिको बेमेल हो। आजको CPU ले एक निर्देशन नानोसेकेन्डभन्दा कममा सक्छ; RAM बाट ल्याउन दसौं नानोसेकेन्ड लाग्छ। Cache नभए प्रोसेसरको धेरैजसो समय पर्खाइमै जान्थ्यो। Cache हात पुग्ने तखता हो, RAM कोठा पारिको दराज। CPU ले खोजेको कुरा cache मै भेट्यो भने cache hit; भेटेन भने cache miss र RAM सम्म जानुपर्छ। बढी cache = बढी hit, त्यसैले प्रोसेसरको विज्ञापनमा cache को आकार लेखिन्छ। Cache RAM जस्तै volatile हो, र प्रायः प्रोसेसर चिपमै बनेको हुन्छ। छुट्टै किन्न वा थप्न मिल्दैन।
pairs.en: A small fast shelf between two mismatched speeds Cache memory is a small amount of very fast memory placed between the CPU and RAM. It holds the data and instructions the CPU has used most recently, on the reasonable bet that it will want them again soon. It exists because of a mismatch. A modern CPU can carry out an instruction in well under a nanosecond; fetching from RAM takes tens of nanoseconds. Without cache the processor would spend most of its life waiting. Cache is the shelf within arm's reach, while RAM is the cupboard across the room. When the CPU finds what it wants in cache that is a cache hit; when it does not, a cache miss, and it must go to RAM. More cache means more hits, which is why cache size appears in processor advertisements. Cache is volatile, like RAM, and it is usually built onto the processor chip itself. You cannot buy it separately or add more to a computer you own.

pairs.ne: CPU ले सिधै पुग्न सक्ने मेमोरी Primary memory त्यो हो जसमा CPU ले सिधै पढ्न र लेख्न सक्छ। Secondary storage को कुनै पनि कुरा यहाँ नसारेसम्म चलाउनै मिल्दैन — ठूलो फाइल खोल्दा केही क्षण लाग्नुको कारण यही हो। विशेषता: CPU ले सिधै पुग्न सक्ने; secondary भन्दा धेरै छिटो; क्षमता सीमित; प्रति byte महँगो; र यान्त्रिक होइन, semiconductor मा बनेको। Primary memory दुई किसिमका छन्, र फरक एउटै कुरामा छ जसले बाँकी सबै तय गर्छ: CPU ले त्यसमा लेख्न सक्छ?
pairs.en: The memory the CPU can reach directly Primary memory is the memory the CPU can read from and write to directly. Nothing in secondary storage can be worked on until it has been copied here first — which is why a large file takes a moment to open. Characteristics: directly accessible by the CPU; much faster than secondary storage; limited in capacity; costlier per byte; and semiconductor-based rather than mechanical. Primary memory is of two kinds, and they differ in a single respect that decides everything else: can the CPU write to it?

pairs.ne: बत्ती नभए पनि रहने ठाउँ Secondary memory — सहायक वा ब्याकअप भण्डारण — ले data र प्रोग्राम स्थायी रूपमा राख्छ, कम्प्युटर खुला होस् या नहोस्। विशेषता: non-volatile; ठूलो क्षमता; प्रति byte सस्तो; primary भन्दा ढिलो; र CPU ले सिधै पुग्न नसक्ने — प्रयोग गर्नुअघि सबै RAM मा सार्नैपर्छ। अन्तिम विशेषता नै अंक बोक्ने हो। यसका तीन परिवार छन्, bit भौतिक रूपमा कसरी राखिन्छ भन्ने आधारमा: Magnetic — bit भनेको लेपित सतहमा चुम्बकत्वको दिशा। Hard disk: घुम्ने थाल र चल्ने head, त्यसैले चल्ने भाग हुन्छन् र ठक्कर लाग्दा बिग्रन सक्छ। SSD लाई पाठ्यक्रमले यहीँ राखेको छ, वास्तवमा यो flash हो: चल्ने भाग छैन, धेरै छिटो, प्रति GB महँगो। Optical — bit भनेको सतहमा पोलिएको खाल्डो वा समथर भाग, लेजरले पढ्छ। CD (करिब ७०० MB), DVD (4.7 GB), Blu-ray (25 GB वा बढी)। सस्तो, झिक्न मिल्ने, चाँडै कोतरिने। Flash — bit भनेको इन्सुलेट कक्षमा थुनिएको चार्ज, चल्ने भाग शून्य। Pen drive, memory card। सानो, बलियो, पुनर्लेखनयोग्य, तर हरेक कक्ष कति पटक लेख्न मिल्ने भन्ने सीमा हुन्छ।
pairs.en: Where things stay when the power does not Secondary memory — also called auxiliary or backup storage — holds data and programs permanently, for as long as you want them, whether or not the computer is on. Characteristics: non-volatile; large capacity; cheap per byte; slower than primary memory; and not directly accessible by the CPU — everything must be copied into RAM before it can be used. That last one is the characteristic worth the mark. It comes in three families, told apart by how a bit is physically stored: Magnetic — a bit is a direction of magnetism on a coated surface. Hard disk: spinning platters and a moving head, so it has moving parts and can be damaged by a knock. SSD is grouped here by the curriculum, though it is really flash: no moving parts, much faster, costlier per gigabyte. Optical — a bit is a pit or a flat area burned into a surface and read by a laser. CD (about 700 MB), DVD (4.7 GB), Blu-ray (25 GB and up). Cheap, removable, scratch easily. Flash — a bit is a charge trapped in an insulated cell, with no moving parts at all. Pen drive, memory card. Small, sturdy, rewritable, limited in how many times each cell can be rewritten.

pairs.ne: सम्झने तरिका — RAM बिर्सन्छ, ROM सम्झन्छ। Cache नजिक, disk टाढा।
pairs.en: Memory hook — RAM forgets, ROM remembers. Cache is close, disk is far.

pairs.ne: Cache memory भनेको CPU र main memory बीचमा राखिएको सानो तर धेरै छिटो मेमोरी हो, जसले CPU ले भर्खरै चलाएका data र निर्देशन राख्छ। CPU, RAM भन्दा धेरै छिटो भएकाले यो चाहिन्छ: नजिकै राखेपछि प्रोसेसरले RAM कुर्नुपर्ने समय घट्छ।
pairs.en: It is used because the CPU is much faster than RAM. Keeping recently used items close by means the processor spends less time waiting for RAM, so the computer runs faster.

pairs.ne: RAM र ROM बीचको फरक लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Differentiate between RAM and ROM.

pairs.ne: Cache memory भनेको के हो? किन प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
pairs.en: What is cache memory? Why is it used?
