pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: ७.३। बुझाउने: फाइल। कम्पनीका नाम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुभन्दा के भाडामा लिइँदै छ — भण्डारण, सफ्टवेयर, कि प्रशोधन — अनुसार समूह बनाउनुहोस्।
pairs.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 7.3. Hand in: the file. Group the services by what is being rented — storage, software, or processing — rather than listing company names.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर र नाम भन्न मिल्ने स्रोत। यसमा ध्यान चाहिन्छ: यो वास्तविक घटनाबारे मिति सहितको ठोस दाबी हो, त्यसैले हरेक तथ्यको स्रोत — समाचार र त्यसको मिति — चाहिन्छ। आधार: ७.२। बुझाउने: फाइल र स्रोतको सूची। स्रोतसहितका तीन तथ्य, स्रोतविहीन दस भन्दा बढी मूल्यवान्।
pairs.en: You need: presentation software, and sources you can name. This one needs care: it is a specific, dateable claim about a real event, so every fact you state needs a source — a news report, with its date. Builds on: 7.2. Hand in: the file and your source list. A presentation with three sourced facts is worth more than one with ten unsourced ones.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: ७.४। बुझाउने: फाइल। सकेसम्म नेपालकै उदाहरण — स्मार्ट बिजुली मिटर वा सवारी ट्र्याकर — छान्नुहोस् र कुन data कसलाई पठाउँछ भन्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 7.4. Hand in: the file. Choose an example from Nepal if you can — a smart electricity meter, or a vehicle tracker — and say what data it sends and to whom.

pairs.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: युनिट ५ को ५.३ र यो युनिट। बुझाउने: फाइल। बलियो प्रस्तुतीकरणले तपाईं वा परिवारले साँच्चै चलाएको सेवा नाम लिन्छ र त्यसले केलाई विस्थापित गर्‍यो भन्छ।
pairs.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: Unit 5 topic 5.3 as well as this unit. Hand in: the file. The strongest version names a service you or your family have actually used, and says what it replaced.

pairs.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ६ अंक र ६४ मध्ये ८ घण्टा ओगट्छ — छ अंकका लागि नौ विषय, त्यसैले हरेक छोटो सोधिन्छ। छोटा परिभाषा र एउटा "फरक लेख्नुहोस्" अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस्। तयारी गर्नुपर्ने तीन जोडी: cloud–distributed, big data–data mining, VR–AR।
pairs.en: This unit carries 6 of the 50 external marks and 8 of the 64 theory hours — nine topics for six marks, so each is asked briefly. Expect short definitions and one differentiate question. The three pairs worth preparing are cloud against distributed, big data against data mining, and VR against AR.

pairs.ne: AI भनेको कम्प्युटर विज्ञानको त्यो शाखा हो जसले सामान्यतया मानवीय बुद्धि चाहिने काम — भाषा बुझ्ने, तस्बिर चिन्ने, निर्णय गर्ने र अनुभवबाट सिक्ने — गर्न सक्ने मेसिन र प्रोग्राम बनाउँछ। प्रयोग: भ्वाइस असिस्टेन्ट, अनुहार पहिचान, मेसिन अनुवाद, रोग पहिचान, स्वचालित सवारी, ठगी पत्ता लगाउने — कुनै दुई।
pairs.en: Applications: voice assistants; face recognition; machine translation; medical diagnosis; self-driving vehicles; fraud detection. Any two.

pairs.ne: VR ले पूरै कम्प्युटरले बनाएको वातावरण दिन्छ जसले वास्तविक संसार प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ; हेडसेट लगाएपछि वरिपरि देखिँदैन; विशेष हार्डवेयर चाहिन्छ। उदाहरण: पाइलट तालिमको फ्लाइट सिमुलेटर। AR ले वास्तविक संसारमाथि सूचना थप्छ, प्रयोगकर्ताले वरिपरि देख्दै गर्छ; प्रायः साधारण स्मार्टफोनमै चल्छ। उदाहरण: कोठामा फर्निचर कस्तो देखिन्छ देखाउने app। मुख्य फरक: VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ।
pairs.en: The single difference to state clearly: VR replaces reality, AR adds to it.

pairs.ne: Cloud computing भनेको सेवा प्रदायकले राखेका कम्प्युटिङ स्रोत — भण्डारण, प्रशोधन, सफ्टवेयर — इन्टरनेटमार्फत प्रयोग गर्नु हो; उपकरण किन्नुको साटो जति चलायो त्यति तिर्ने। फाइदा: हार्डवेयर किन्नु/मर्मत गर्नु नपर्ने; जहाँबाट पनि पुग्न सकिने; चाहिएअनुसार बढाउन मिल्ने। बेफाइदा: भरपर्दो इन्टरनेट चाहिने; data अर्कैको कम्प्युटरमा रहने; खर्च निरन्तर चलिरहने।
pairs.en: Disadvantage: it requires a reliable Internet connection; data is stored on someone else's computer, raising privacy and security concerns; the cost is ongoing.

pairs.ne: Encryption भनेको plaintext (पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश) लाई ciphertext (पढ्न नमिल्ने रूप) मा बदल्ने प्रक्रिया हो, ताकि अधिकार पाएकोले मात्र पढोस्। Decryption उल्टो प्रक्रिया। Key भनेको एल्गोरिदमले रूपान्तरण गर्न प्रयोग गर्ने गोप्य मान हो। एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ; सुरक्षा key गोप्य राख्नुमा भर पर्छ, र फरक key ले उही सन्देशबाट फरक ciphertext बनाउँछ।
pairs.en: The key is the secret value used by the algorithm to perform the conversion. The algorithm is usually publicly known; the security depends on keeping the key secret, and a different key produces a different ciphertext from the same message.

pairs.ne: उदीयमान = नियम नै थामिनसक्दै प्रयोगमा छिर्दै गरेको, नयाँ मात्र होइन। AI: मानवीय बुद्धि चाहिने काम गर्ने र अनुभवबाट सिक्ने। Cloud = कम्प्युटर कसको; distributed = कतिवटा। IoT: कम्प्युटर नभएका वस्तु नेटवर्कमा। Big data सामग्री (volume, velocity, variety), data mining काम। Encryption लाई एल्गोरिदम र key चाहिन्छ; एल्गोरिदम सार्वजनिक, key गोप्य। VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ।
pairs.en: VR replaces the real world; AR adds to it.

pairs.ne: तीन प्रश्नले धेरैजसो टुङ्ग्याउँछन्: कम्प्युटर कसको हो, प्रयोगकर्ताले कोठा अझै देख्छ कि देख्दैन, र यो data हो कि खोतल्ने काम?
pairs.en: Three questions settle most of them: whose computer is it, is the user still able to see the room, and is this the data or the digging?

pairs.ne: नयाँ होइन — महत्त्वपूर्ण बन्दै गरेको उदीयमान प्रविधि भनेका ती प्रविधि हुन् जो अझै विकसित हुँदै छन्, दैनिक सामान्य प्रयोगमा आइसकेका छैनन्, र आउँदा केही वर्षभित्रै मानिसको जीवन र कामको तरिका बदल्ने अपेक्षा गरिन्छ। जाँच "नयाँ" भन्नु होइन। फोनको नयाँ मोडेल नयाँ त हो, तर केही बदल्दैन। कुनै प्रविधि प्रयोगशालाबाट निस्केर प्रयोगमा यति छिटो सर्दै छ कि वरिपरिका नियम र पेसा नै थामिइसकेका छैनन् भने त्यो उदीयमान हो। यसको अर्थ सूची बदलिन्छ पनि। यो पाठ्यक्रम लेखिँदा यस युनिटका सबै उदीयमान छन्; तपाईं काम गर्ने बेलासम्म केही सामान्य भइसक्नेछन् — शब्दले भनेकै त्यही हो।
pairs.en: Not new — becoming important Emerging technologies are technologies that are still developing, are not yet in ordinary everyday use, and are expected to change how people live and work within the next several years. "New" is not the test. A new model of phone is new and changes nothing. A technology is emerging when it is moving out of the laboratory and into use, fast enough that the rules and the jobs around it have not settled yet. That also means the list changes. Everything in this unit is emerging as this curriculum is written; some of it will be ordinary by the time you are working, and that is what the word predicts.

pairs.ne: पहिले मान्छे चाहिने काम मेसिनले गर्नु Artificial Intelligence कम्प्युटर विज्ञानको त्यो शाखा हो जसले मेसिनलाई सामान्यतया मानवीय बुद्धि चाहिने काम गर्न लगाउँछ — भाषा बुझ्ने, तस्बिर र बोली चिन्ने, निर्णय गर्ने, र अनुभवबाट सिक्ने। अंक बोक्ने वाक्यांश अनुभवबाट सिक्ने हो। साधारण प्रोग्रामले भनेकै गर्छ। AI प्रणालीलाई उदाहरण दिइन्छ र नियम आफैं निकाल्छ — त्यसैले फेरि नलेखिकनै सुध्रन सक्छ। तपाईंले भेटिसकेका उदाहरण: भ्वाइस असिस्टेन्ट, फोनको face unlock, खोज बाकसका सुझाव, नेपाली–अंग्रेजी मेसिन अनुवाद, र बैंकले तपाईंको कारोबारमा गर्ने ठगी जाँच।
pairs.en: Machines doing what used to need a person Artificial Intelligence is the branch of computer science concerned with making machines perform tasks that normally require human intelligence — understanding language, recognising images and speech, making decisions, and learning from experience. The phrase that carries the mark is learning from experience. An ordinary program does exactly what it was told. An AI system is given examples and works out the rule itself, which is why it can improve without being rewritten. Examples you already meet: voice assistants, face unlock on a phone, the suggestions in a search box, machine translation between Nepali and English, and the fraud checks a bank runs on your transactions.

pairs.ne: एउटै चित्र बाँड्ने, फरक प्रश्नको उत्तर दिने दुई विचार Cloud computing भनेको अर्कैले किनेर चलाएका कम्प्युटिङ स्रोत — भण्डारण, प्रशोधन, सफ्टवेयर — इन्टरनेटमार्फत प्रयोग गर्नु हो, मेसिन किन्नुको साटो जति चलायो त्यति तिरेर। Google Drive, Gmail र अनलाइन ब्याकअप cloud सेवा हुन्। Distributed computing भनेको एउटै ठूलो काम धेरै कम्प्युटरमा बाँडेर सँगै गराउनु हो, ताकि एउटैले सक्ने भन्दा छिटो सकियोस्। मौसम पूर्वानुमान र ठूला वैज्ञानिक गणना यसरी गरिन्छन्। परीक्षाले यी छुट्याउन भन्छ, र सफा फरक यही हो: cloud computing कम्प्युटर कसको हो भन्ने कुरा हो; distributed computing काम कति कम्प्युटरले बाँड्छन् भन्ने। Cloud सेवा भित्री रूपमा distributed हुन सक्छ, र distributed प्रणाली एउटै संस्थाकै भवनभित्र हुन सक्छ। यी उल्टा पनि होइनन्, उही पनि होइनन्। Cloud का फाइदा: हार्डवेयर किन्नु नपर्ने, जहाँबाट पनि पुग्न सकिने, चाहिएअनुसार बढ्ने। बेफाइदा: चल्ने इन्टरनेट चाहिने, तपाईंको data अर्कैको कम्प्युटरमा रहने, र मासिक खर्च कहिल्यै नसकिने — नेपालमा तीनै कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण छन्, जहाँ जडान बिग्रन्छ र बिजुलीको ग्यारेन्टी छैन।
pairs.en: Two ideas that share a picture and answer different questions Cloud computing is using computing resources — storage, processing, software — that are owned and run by somebody else and reached over the Internet, paying for what you use instead of buying the machines. Google Drive, Gmail and online backup are cloud services. Distributed computing is splitting one large task across many computers that work on it together, so that it finishes faster than any one of them could manage. Weather forecasting and large scientific calculations are done this way. The examination asks you to separate them, and the clean separation is this: cloud computing is about WHO OWNS the computer; distributed computing is about HOW MANY computers share the work. A cloud service may be distributed underneath, and a distributed system may sit entirely inside one organisation's own building. They are not opposites and they are not the same. Cloud computing's advantages: no hardware to buy, reachable from anywhere, grows when you need more. Its disadvantages: it needs a working Internet connection, your data sits on someone else's computer, and the monthly cost never stops — all three matter in Nepal, where connections fail and electricity is not guaranteed.

pairs.ne: जानकारी दिन र आदेश लिन सक्ने सामान्य वस्तु Internet of Things भनेको दैनिक प्रयोगका भौतिक वस्तुहरूलाई — सेन्सर र सफ्टवेयर राखेर — इन्टरनेटमा जोड्नु हो, ताकि तिनले data जम्मा गरून्, पठाऊन् र टाढैबाट नियन्त्रण गर्न सकियोस्। IoT हो कि होइन भन्ने जाँच सरल छ: त्यो कम्प्युटर नभएको वस्तु हो, र नेटवर्कमा छ। Wi-Fi मा जोडिएको ल्यापटप IoT होइन, किनभने ल्यापटप कम्प्युटर हो। पानीको ट्यांकीमा लेभल सेन्सर राखेर कम भएपछि सन्देश पठाउने प्रणाली IoT हो, किनभने ट्यांकी कम्प्युटर होइन। उदाहरण: मिटर पढ्न कोही नआई बिजुली खपत पठाउने स्मार्ट मिटर; कहिले सिँचाइ गर्ने भन्ने किसानलाई बताउने माटोको सेन्सर; स्वास्थ्य ब्यान्ड; सवारी ट्र्याकर; आफैं बल्ने सडक बत्ती। जोखिम हरेक ठाउँमा उही हो — नेटवर्कमा भएको वस्तुमा तपाईंले नचाहेका मानिस पनि पुग्न सक्छन्।
pairs.en: Ordinary objects that can report and be told The Internet of Things is the connection of everyday physical objects — fitted with sensors and software — to the Internet, so that they can collect data, send it, and be controlled remotely. The test for an IoT device is simple: it is a thing that is not a computer, and it is on the network. A laptop on Wi-Fi is not IoT, because a laptop is a computer. A water tank with a level sensor that messages you when it is low is IoT, because a water tank is not a computer. Examples: smart meters that report electricity use without a reader visiting; soil sensors that tell a farmer when to irrigate; health bands; vehicle trackers; street lights that switch themselves on. The risk is the same in every case — a thing on the network can be reached by people you did not intend.

pairs.ne: साधारण उपकरणका लागि निकै ठूलो, छिटो र मिश्रित Big data भनेको यति ठूलो, यति छिटो आउने र यति विविध data को संग्रह हो कि साधारण डाटाबेस सफ्टवेयरले काम लाग्ने गरी राख्न वा प्रशोधन गर्नै सक्दैन। यसलाई प्रायः तीन V ले वर्णन गरिन्छ: Volume — टेराबाइट र त्योभन्दा माथि; Velocity — पोकामा होइन, निरन्तर आउने; Variety — पाठ, तस्बिर, भिडियो, सेन्सरका मान र अभिलेख सबै मिसिएका। ठूलो हुनु मात्र मुख्य कुरा होइन। एउटै विशाल भिडियो फाइल ठूलो त हो, big data होइन। Big data ठूलो र अव्यवस्थित र निरन्तर हुन्छ — त्यसैले ठूलो डिस्क होइन, फरक उपकरण चाहिन्छ। उदाहरण: मोबाइल वालेटका हरेक कारोबार; सामाजिक सञ्जालका हरेक पोस्ट; हजारौं मौसम सेन्सरका मान; टेलिकम कम्पनीका कल रेकर्ड।
pairs.en: Too big, too fast, too mixed for ordinary tools Big data means collections of data so large, so fast-arriving and so varied that ordinary database software cannot store or process them usefully. It is usually described by three Vs: Volume — terabytes and beyond; Velocity — arriving continuously rather than in batches; Variety — text, images, video, sensor readings and records all mixed together. Size alone is not the point. A single enormous video file is large and is not big data. Big data is large and messy and continuous — which is why it needs different tools, not just a bigger disk. Examples: every transaction of a mobile wallet; every post on a social network; the readings of thousands of weather sensors; a telecom company's call records.

pairs.ne: भएकै data बाट बान्की खोतल्नु Data mining भनेको भण्डारण गरिएको ठूलो मात्राको data केलाएर स्पष्ट नदेखिएका बान्की र सम्बन्ध पत्ता लगाउने र त्यसैबाट अनुमान वा निर्णय गर्ने प्रक्रिया हो। Big data र data mining जोडी हुन्, उही होइनन्। Big data सामग्री हो; data mining काम। एउटा तपाईंसँग भएको नाम हो, अर्को त्यसमाथि गरिने क्रिया। "Big data भनेको ठूलो data को mining हो" लेख्ने उत्तरले दुईलाई मिसाएको हुन्छ र अंक गुमाउँछ। उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण: पसलले हजारौं बिल केलाउँदा पाउरोटी किन्नेले प्रायः उही पटक अन्डा पनि किन्छन् भन्ने भेट्छ — त्यसैले दुवै नजिक राखिन्छ। पाउरोटी र अन्डा खोज् भनेर कसैले भनेको थिएन; बान्की कम्प्युटरले भेट्यो। नेपालमा यही तरिकाले कुन जिल्लामा कुन बाली सँगै बिग्रन्छ वा कुन कारोबार ठगी जस्तो देखिन्छ पत्ता लाग्छ।
pairs.en: Digging patterns out of data you already have Data mining is the process of examining large amounts of stored data to discover patterns and relationships that were not obvious, and using them to predict or to decide. Big data and data mining are a pair and are not the same. Big data is the material; data mining is the activity. One is a noun you have; the other is a verb you do to it. An examination answer that says "big data is mining large data" has merged the two and loses the mark. The classic example: a shop analyses thousands of receipts and finds that customers who buy bread often buy eggs on the same visit — so the two are placed near each other. Nobody told the computer to look for bread and eggs; it found the pattern. In Nepal the same technique finds which crops fail together in a district, or which transactions look like fraud.

pairs.ne: जानीजानी सन्देश नपढिने बनाउनु Cryptography भनेको सूचनालाई पढ्न नहुनेले पढ्नै नसक्ने रूपमा बदलेर जोगाउने अभ्यास हो। Encryption ले plaintext — पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश — लाई एल्गोरिदम र key प्रयोग गरी ciphertext मा बदल्छ। Decryption उल्टो हो: key कै प्रयोगले ciphertext बाट फेरि plaintext। बुझ्नुपर्ने भाग key हो। एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ — तरिका सबैलाई थाहा हुन्छ। पठाउने र पाउनेले गोप्य राख्ने भनेको key हो। तरिका लुकाएर पाइने सुरक्षा कसैले तरिका पत्ता लगाउने बित्तिकै सकिन्छ; key मा अडेको सुरक्षा टिक्छ, किनभने तरिका छापे पनि key फेर्न सकिन्छ। तपाईं अहिल्यै भर परिरहेका ठाउँ: अनलाइन तिर्दा browser मा देखिने ताल्चा, messaging app को encryption, र वेबसाइटले राख्ने पासवर्ड — encrypt गरेर राखिन्छ, ताकि फाइल चोरिए पनि पासवर्ड नपाइयोस्।
pairs.en: Making a message unreadable on purpose Cryptography is the practice of protecting information by converting it into a form that cannot be read by anyone who is not meant to read it. Encryption converts plaintext — the readable message — into ciphertext, using an algorithm and a key. Decryption is the reverse: ciphertext back to plaintext, using the key. The key is the part worth understanding. The algorithm is usually public — everyone knows how the method works. What the sender and receiver keep secret is the key. Security that depends on hiding the method fails as soon as somebody works the method out; security that depends on a key survives, because the method can be published and the key changed. Where you already rely on it: the padlock in a browser when you pay online, the encryption on a messaging app, and the password stored by a website — stored encrypted, so that stealing the file does not hand over the passwords.

pairs.ne: वास्तविक संसार नै प्रतिस्थापित Virtual Reality भनेको कम्प्युटरले बनाएको त्यस्तो वातावरण हो जसले प्रयोगकर्ताको वरिपरिको संसार पूरै प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ। हेडसेट लगाएपछि तपाईंले कम्प्युटरले देखाएको र सुनाएको मात्र पाउनुहुन्छ; उभिएको कोठा हराउँछ। प्रयोग: गल्तीले वास्तविक क्षति नहुनुपर्ने पाइलट र शल्यक्रिया तालिम; नबनेकै भवनभित्र हिँड्ने; खेल; र पुग्नै नसकिने ठाउँ — संग्रहालय, हिमाल — घुम्ने।
pairs.en: The real world replaced Virtual Reality is a computer-generated environment that replaces the user's surroundings entirely. Wearing a headset, you see and hear only what the computer produces; the room you are standing in is gone. Uses: pilot and surgical training where a mistake must not cost anything real; walking through a building before it is built; games; and visiting a place — a museum, a mountain — that you cannot travel to.

pairs.ne: वास्तविक संसारमा थपिएको Augmented Reality ले वास्तविक संसार हटाउने होइन, त्यसमाथि कम्प्युटरले बनाएको सूचना थप्छ। फोनको क्यामेरा वा पारदर्शी चस्माबाट तपाईंले कोठा देख्दै गर्नुहुन्छ, माथि थप कुरा कोरिएको हुन्छ। प्रयोग: आफ्नै कोठामा फर्निचर कस्तो देखिन्छ देखाउने फोन; अगाडिको सडकमै कोरिएका बाटो देखाउने तीर; हेरिरहेकै इन्जिनका भाग नाम लेखिदिने मर्मत निर्देशिका; र डेस्कमै ३डी मुटु राख्ने कक्षा app। पूरै फरक तपाईंले अझै के देख्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्नेमा छ। VR: वास्तविक संसार हराउँछ। AR: वास्तविक संसार छँदै छ, केही थपिएको। प्रश्नमा सबै छेक्ने हेडसेटको कुरा छ भने VR; प्रयोगकर्ताले सडक अझै देख्छ भने AR।
pairs.en: The real world added to Augmented Reality adds computer-generated information to the real world instead of replacing it. Through a phone camera or clear glasses you still see the room, with extra things drawn on top of it. Uses: a phone showing how furniture would look in your own room; navigation arrows drawn on the street ahead; a repair manual that labels the parts of the engine you are actually looking at; and classroom apps that place a 3D heart on your desk. The whole difference is what you can still see. VR: the real world is gone. AR: the real world is there with something added. If an examination question describes a headset that blocks everything out, it is VR; if the user can still see the road, it is AR.

pairs.ne: सम्झने तरिका — VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ। Big data थुप्रो, data mining खन्ने काम।
pairs.en: Memory hook — VR replaces, AR adds. Big data is the pile; data mining is the digging.

pairs.ne: Artificial intelligence भनेको के हो? यसका कुनै दुई प्रयोग लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is artificial intelligence? Write any two of its applications.

pairs.ne: Virtual reality र augmented reality बीचको फरक उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Differentiate between virtual reality and augmented reality with examples.

pairs.ne: Cloud computing भनेको के हो? कुनै एक फाइदा र एक बेफाइदा लेख्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: What is cloud computing? Write any one advantage and one disadvantage.

pairs.ne: Encryption भनेको के हो? Key को भूमिका के हो?
pairs.en: What is encryption? What is the role of the key?

pairs.ne: कुनै cipher को एल्गोरिदम जोसुकैले किन्न सक्ने पाठ्यपुस्तकमा छापिएको छ। छापिएकै कारण त्यस एल्गोरिदमले encrypt गरिएका सन्देश असुरक्षित हुन्छन्?
pairs.en: A cipher's algorithm is published in a textbook that anyone can buy. Does publishing it make messages encrypted with that algorithm insecure?

pairs.ne: Cloud computing, किनभने धेरै कम्प्युटर छन्
pairs.en: Cloud computing, because many computers are involved

pairs.ne: Distributed computing, किनभने एउटै काम धेरै कम्प्युटरले सँगै बाँड्छन्
pairs.en: Distributed computing, because one task is shared among many computers working together

pairs.ne: Big data, किनभने गणना ठूलो छ
pairs.en: Big data, because the calculation is large

pairs.ne: IoT, किनभने कम्प्युटर नेटवर्कमा छन्
pairs.en: IoT, because the computers are networked

pairs.ne: Wi-Fi मा जोडिएको ल्यापटप
pairs.en: A laptop connected to Wi-Fi

pairs.ne: पानी घट्दा मालिकलाई सन्देश पठाउने लेभल सेन्सर भएको ट्यांकी
pairs.en: A water tank with a level sensor that messages the owner when it runs low

pairs.ne: विद्यालय ल्याबको डेस्कटप कम्प्युटर
pairs.en: A desktop computer in a school lab

pairs.ne: एउटै कम्प्युटरमा तारले जोडिएको प्रिन्टर
pairs.en: A printer attached by cable to one computer

pairs.ne: एल्गोरिदम, किनभने तरिका थाहा भए मानिसले सन्देश पढ्न सक्थे
pairs.en: The algorithm, because if people knew the method they could read the message

pairs.ne: Key — एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ, र सुरक्षा key गोप्य रहनुमा भर पर्छ
pairs.en: The key — the algorithm is usually public, and security depends on the key being secret

pairs.ne: दुवै सधैं गोप्य हुनुपर्छ
pairs.en: Both must be secret at all times

pairs.ne: कुनै पनि होइन — encryption गोपनीयतामा भर पर्दैन
pairs.en: Neither — encryption does not rely on secrecy

pairs.ne: यो छिटो चल्छ
pairs.en: It runs faster

pairs.ne: यसले उदाहरणबाट सिक्न र फेरि नलेखिकनै सुध्रन सक्छ
pairs.en: It can learn from examples and improve without being rewritten

pairs.ne: — भर्चुअल रियालिटी (VR)
pairs.en: · आफैं गरेर हेर्नुहोस् Encrypt a message, then decrypt it What you will learn: what the key actually does. Move it and the ciphertext changes; the algorithm never changes. That is why secrecy lives in the key, and why decryption is the same operation run backwards. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: key ले साँच्चै के गर्छ। सार्नुहोस्, ciphertext बदलिन्छ; एल्गोरिदम कहिल्यै बदलिँदैन। गोपनीयता key मै बस्नुको र decryption उही कामको उल्टो हुनुको कारण यही हो। Three things to try 1. Set the key to 3 and read the ciphertext — this exact cipher is about 2000 years old. 2. Set it to 0 and see why a key of zero is no key at all. 3. Notice that the spaces do not move: the shape of the message leaks even when the letters do not. A real weakness, and one reason this cipher is not used for anything that matters — a computer breaks it by trying all 25 keys in well under a second. १. Key ३ राखेर ciphertext पढ्नुहोस् — यही cipher करिब दुई हजार वर्ष पुरानो हो। २. ० राखेर हेर्नुहोस्, शून्य key किन key नै होइन। ३. खाली ठाउँ नसरेको ध्यान दिनुहोस्: अक्षर नसरे पनि सन्देशको आकार चुहिन्छ। यो साँचो कमजोरी हो, र यस cipher लाई महत्त्वपूर्ण काममा नचलाइनुको एउटा कारण — कम्प्युटरले २५ वटै key एक सेकेन्डभित्रै प्रयास गरेर फोड्छ। 7.8 Virtual Reality (VR)

pairs.en: Augmented Reality (AR)

pairs.ne: सन्देश टाइप गर्नुहोस्, अनि key सार्नुहोस्।
pairs.en: Type a message, then move the key.

pairs.ne: Plaintext — पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश
pairs.en: Plaintext — the readable message

pairs.ne: Key — हरेक अक्षर कति ठाउँ सर्ने
pairs.en: Key — how many places each letter moves

pairs.ne: Ciphertext — बीचमा पक्रनेले देख्ने कुरा
pairs.en: Ciphertext — what an interceptor would see

pairs.ne: Key ० ले केही सार्दैन — ciphertext नै सन्देश हो। Key शून्य नभए मात्र काम लाग्छ, र अरूलाई थाहा नभएसम्म मात्र गोप्य रहन्छ।
pairs.en: A key of 0 moves nothing — the ciphertext is the message. A key is only useful when it is not zero, and only secret while nobody else knows it.

pairs.ne: Decrypt गर्न {…} ले पछाडि सार्नुहोस् — उही काम, उल्टो दिशामा। Key नभए बीचमा पक्रनेले २५ वटै प्रयास गर्नुपर्छ।
pairs.en: To decrypt, shift back by {…} — the same operation, the other way. Without the key, an interceptor must try all 25.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: key ले साँच्चै के गर्छ। सार्नुहोस्, ciphertext बदलिन्छ; एल्गोरिदम कहिल्यै बदलिँदैन। गोपनीयता key मै बस्नुको र decryption उही कामको उल्टो हुनुको कारण यही हो।
pairs.en: What you will learn: what the key actually does. Move it and the ciphertext changes; the algorithm never changes. That is why secrecy lives in the key, and why decryption is the same operation run backwards.

pairs.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: परिस्थितिबाटै प्रविधि चिन्न — यो युनिट यसरी नै जाँचिन्छ। अलमल पार्ने जोडी — cloud र distributed, big data र data mining, VR र AR — सबै यहीँ छन्।
pairs.en: What you will learn: to identify a technology from a situation, which is how this unit is examined. The pairs that get confused — cloud against distributed, big data against data mining, VR against AR — are all here.

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Data is a raw fact with no meaning attached. 78 on its own tells you nothing. The other three have been processed and given meaning, which makes them information.
items.ne: Data भनेको अर्थ नजोडिएको काँचो तथ्य हो। ७८ एक्लैले केही बताउँदैन। बाँकी तीनलाई प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको छ, त्यसैले ती information हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: MySQL is a DBMS: the software. The database is the collection of data it manages. Calling the DBMS "the database" is the most common slip in this unit.
items.ne: MySQL एउटा DBMS हो — सफ्टवेयर। डाटाबेस भनेको त्यसले व्यवस्थापन गर्ने data को सङ्ग्रह हो। DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Storing the same fact three times is redundancy; the copies disagreeing after one is updated is inconsistency. The question asks about the result of the update, so the answer is inconsistency.
items.ne: उही तथ्य तीन पटक राख्नु redundancy हो; एउटा बदलेपछि प्रतिलिपिहरू बाझिनु inconsistency हो। प्रश्नले अद्यावधिकपछिको नतिजा सोधेकाले उत्तर inconsistency हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The external (or view) level is the top of the diagram, nearest the user. The conceptual level says what data exists overall; the internal level says how it is stored on disk.
items.ne: External (view) तह चित्रको सबैभन्दा माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक। Conceptual तहले समग्रमा कुन data छ भन्छ; internal तहले डिस्कमा कसरी राखिएको छ भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The instance is the data in the database right now, so inserting a row changes it. The schema is the structure — the table name, columns and keys — and adding a student does not change any of those.
items.ne: Instance भनेको अहिलेको data हो, त्यसैले पङ्क्ति थप्दा बदलिन्छ। Schema भनेको संरचना — तालिकाको नाम, स्तम्भ र कुञ्जी — र विद्यार्थी थप्दा ती बदलिँदैनन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The DBA has complete control of the database: creating it, controlling who may use it, taking backups and tuning performance.
items.ne: DBA सँग डाटाबेसको पूर्ण नियन्त्रण हुन्छ: बनाउने, कसले प्रयोग गर्न पाउने नियन्त्रण गर्ने, backup लिने र कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The hierarchical model is a tree, so a record has exactly one parent. The network model is a graph and allows several, which is the single examinable difference between the two.
items.ne: Hierarchical model रूख हो, त्यसैले रेकर्डको एउटै parent हुन्छ। Network model ग्राफ हो र धेरै हुन दिन्छ — दुईबीचको परीक्षामा सोधिने फरक यही एउटा हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Centralisation is what makes a database powerful and also what makes it a single point of failure. The other three options are advantages. A question asking for both wants at least one of each.
items.ne: एकै ठाउँमा राख्नुले डाटाबेसलाई बलियो बनाउँछ र सँगै एउटै जोखिम बिन्दु पनि। बाँकी तीन फाइदा हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough
items.en: 1.4 — Where database systems are used. Banking (accounts and transactions), airlines and bus booking (seats), schools and universities (students, marks, fees), hospitals (patient records), telecom (call records), online shops (products, orders), and government records — citizenship, land, voter rolls.
items.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीको प्रयोग: बैंकिङ (खाता र कारोबार), हवाई तथा बस टिकट (सिट), विद्यालय र विश्वविद्यालय (विद्यार्थी, अंक, शुल्क), अस्पताल (बिरामीको रेकर्ड), टेलिकम (कल रेकर्ड), अनलाइन पसल (सामान, अर्डर), र सरकारी अभिलेख — नागरिकता, जग्गा, मतदाता नामावली।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Calling the DBMS "the database". The database is the data; the DBMS is the program. MySQL is a DBMS.
items.ne: DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। डाटाबेस भनेको data, DBMS भनेको प्रोग्राम।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Three levels, and what each one hides.
items.ne: तीन तह, र हरेकले के लुकाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Start at the bottom. The INTERNAL level is how the data physically sits on the disk — files, blocks, indexes.
items.ne: तलबाट सुरु। INTERNAL तह भनेको डिस्कमा डाटा भौतिक रूपमा कसरी बस्छ — फाइल, ब्लक, इन्डेक्स।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Above it, the CONCEPTUAL level says WHAT data exists and how it relates — the tables and keys. It does not care how the disk stores them.
items.ne: माथि CONCEPTUAL तहले कुन डाटा छ र कसरी सम्बन्धित छ भन्छ — तालिका र कुञ्जी। डिस्कले कसरी राख्छ भन्ने वास्ता गर्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: At the top, the EXTERNAL level is what each user sees. A teacher sees marks; a clerk sees addresses. Neither sees the whole database.
items.ne: सबैभन्दा माथि EXTERNAL तह — हरेक प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने कुरा। शिक्षकले अंक, कर्मचारीले ठेगाना। कसैले पूरै डाटाबेस देख्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The gaps between the levels are DATA INDEPENDENCE. Change the disk storage and the tables do not change; change a table and a user's view can stay the same.
items.ne: तहबीचका खाली ठाउँ नै DATA INDEPENDENCE हुन्। डिस्क भण्डारण बदल्दा तालिका बदलिँदैन; तालिका बदल्दा प्रयोगकर्ताको view उही रहन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Data, information, database or DBMS?
items.ne: Data, information, database कि DBMS?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The four words of 1.1, drilled on real cases. The one students lose a mark on is calling the software "the database" — so decide carefully which of those two you are looking at.
items.ne: १.१ का चार शब्द, वास्तविक उदाहरणमा। विद्यार्थीले अंक गुमाउने ठाउँ एउटै हो — सफ्टवेयरलाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। त्यसैले ती दुईमध्ये कुन हो ध्यान दिएर छान्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: MySQL is software — it creates, manages and controls access to a database. The database is the data it looks after. This is the single most common slip in the unit.
items.ne: MySQL सफ्टवेयर हो — यसले डाटाबेस बनाउँछ, व्यवस्थापन गर्छ र पहुँच नियन्त्रण गर्छ। डाटाबेस भनेको यसले हेर्ने data हो। युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A raw fact with no meaning attached. 78 what? Of whom? Until those are answered it is data, not information.
items.ne: अर्थ नजोडिएको काँचो तथ्य। ७८ के को? कसको? यी उत्तर नआएसम्म यो data हो, information होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The same fact, processed and given meaning. Information is what data becomes once you can act on it.
items.ne: उही तथ्य, प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको। Data मा काम गर्न सकिने भएपछि त्यो information बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: An organised collection of related data. Note that the software managing it is a separate thing — that separation is the whole point of the question.
items.ne: सम्बन्धित data को व्यवस्थित सङ्ग्रह। यसलाई व्यवस्थापन गर्ने सफ्टवेयर छुट्टै कुरा हो — यही छुट्याइ नै प्रश्नको सार हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Another DBMS, like MySQL and MS Access. If you can install it, it is software; if it holds your rows, it is the database.
items.ne: MySQL र MS Access जस्तै अर्को DBMS। install गर्न मिल्ने भए सफ्टवेयर; तपाईंका पङ्क्ति राख्ने भए डाटाबेस।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Each word is built on the one before it. Getting the order right is most of the answer to "differentiate between…".
items.ne: हरेक शब्द अघिल्लोमाथि बनेको छ। "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको प्रायः पूरै उत्तर यही क्रममा छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough
items.en: Learn these as pairs. A question asking for the limitations of the file system is really asking what a database fixes.
items.ne: यिनलाई जोडीमा सम्झनुहोस्। फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा सोध्नु भनेको डाटाबेसले के सुधार्छ भनी सोध्नु हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Hierarchical and network are separated by one question: how many parents may a record have?
items.ne: Hierarchical र network लाई एउटै प्रश्नले छुट्याउँछ: एउटा रेकर्डका कति parent हुन सक्छन्?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Compare the four database models, and define schema and instance.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: data, information, database र DBMS को परिभाषा दिन र फरक छुट्याउन, फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा र डाटाबेसले तिनको के जवाफ दिन्छ भन्न, फाइदा–बेफाइदा सूचीबद्ध गर्न, वास्तविक प्रयोग बताउन, प्रयोगकर्ताका प्रकार नाम लिन, तीन तहको संरचना कोरेर व्याख्या गर्न, र चार डाटाबेस मोडेल तुलना गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Then separate data from information by asking whether it means anything on its own. 78 does not. "Ram scored 78" does.
items.ne: पाँचमध्ये दुई सफ्टवेयर हुन्, दुई सामग्री। उत्तर दिनुअघि एउटा प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: के यो install गर्न मिल्छ? मिल्छ भने DBMS; DBMS ले राख्ने वा दिने कुरा भए बाँकी तीनमध्ये एक। अनि आफैंमा अर्थ लाग्छ कि लाग्दैन सोधेर data र information छुट्याउनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Data independence in one sentence each. Physical data independence — you can change how the data is stored on disk without changing the tables. Logical data independence — you can change the tables without changing what a user sees. Physical is the easier of the two to achieve; logical is harder, because a user's view is built directly on the tables.
items.ne: एक–एक वाक्यमा: Physical data independence — डिस्कमा data कसरी राखिन्छ त्यो बदल्दा तालिका बदल्नु पर्दैन। Logical data independence — तालिका बदल्दा प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने कुरा बदल्नु पर्दैन। पहिलो हासिल गर्न सजिलो, दोस्रो गाह्रो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Four marks, four lines. Answer in a two-column layout like this and you cannot accidentally define only one side of the pair — which is how this question is usually half-answered.
items.ne: चार अंक, चार हरफ। यसरी दुई स्तम्भमा लेख्नुभयो भने जोडीको एउटा पक्ष मात्र लेख्ने गल्ती हुँदैन — यो प्रश्न प्रायः त्यसैगरी आधा उत्तर हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Two changes are coming: moving the database to a faster disk, and adding an email column. Decide the level for each before you open this. The name of the independence follows from the level — get the level right and the second half is free.
items.ne: दुई परिवर्तन आउँदैछन्: डाटाबेस छिटो disk मा सार्नु, र email स्तम्भ थप्नु। खोल्नुअघि दुवैको level निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। independence को नाम level बाटै आउँछ — level ठिक भए दोस्रो आधा आफैँ आउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Work from the bottom up: is this about the disk, about what data exists, or about who sees it? Those three questions map onto the three levels exactly, and the independence is always named after the level below the boundary it protects.
items.ne: तलबाट माथि सोच्नुहोस्: यो डिस्कको कुरा हो, कुन data छ भन्ने कुरा हो, कि कसले देख्छ भन्ने कुरा हो? यी तीन प्रश्न ठ्याक्कै तीन तहमा मिल्छन्, र independence को नाम सधैं आफूले जोगाउने सीमाको तल्लो तहबाट राखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Listing advantages when the question says advantages AND disadvantages. Half the question, half the marks.
items.ne: फाइदा र बेफाइदा दुवै सोधिएको ठाउँमा फाइदा मात्र लेख्नु। आधा प्रश्न, आधा अंक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Mixing up schema and instance. Adding a student changes the instance, not the schema.
items.ne: Schema र instance मिसाउनु। विद्यार्थी थप्दा instance बदलिन्छ, schema होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Drawing the three-level architecture upside down. External is at the top, nearest the user; internal is at the bottom, nearest the disk.
items.ne: तीन तहको चित्र उल्टो कोर्नु। External माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक; internal तल — डिस्कनजिक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit is short — 6 hours — but it supplies the definitions the whole subject is built on. Almost every question here is either define, differentiate or list. All three are answered from memory, so the work is learning the exact wording rather than reasoning it out in the hall. The three-level architecture is the one diagram from this unit you may be asked to draw.
items.ne: यो युनिट छोटो छ — ६ घण्टा — तर पूरै विषय यसैका परिभाषामाथि बनेको छ। यहाँका प्रायः सबै प्रश्न परिभाषा दिने, फरक छुट्याउने वा सूची बनाउने हुन्। तीनै सम्झेर लेख्ने भएकाले ठ्याक्कै शब्द याद गर्नु नै काम हो। यस युनिटबाट कोर्न सकिने चित्र तीन तहको संरचना हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark for the diagram with all three levels in the right order, and one mark for explaining each level. Mentioning data independence between the levels is what turns a three-mark answer into a four-mark one.
items.ne: तीनै तह सही क्रममा भएको चित्रलाई एक अंक, हरेक तहको व्याख्यालाई एक–एक। तहबीचको data independence उल्लेख गर्दा तीन अंकको उत्तर चार अंकको बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Any three, each named and explained in one line.
items.ne: कुनै तीन — नाम दिएर एक–एक हरफमा व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The file system's four problems are redundancy, inconsistency, isolation and no concurrency control. A database answers each one.
items.ne: फाइल प्रणालीका चार समस्या: दोहोरोपन, असङ्गति, अलगाव, र समवर्ती नियन्त्रणको अभाव। डाटाबेसले हरेकको जवाफ दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A database system also has real costs: money, hardware, trained staff, and one point of failure.
items.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीका वास्तविक लागत पनि छन्: पैसा, हार्डवेयर, तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी, र एउटै ठाउँमा जोखिम।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Users: DBA, designer, application programmer, end user.
items.ne: प्रयोगकर्ता: DBA, डिजाइनर, एप्लिकेसन प्रोग्रामर, end user।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Three levels: external (what a user sees), conceptual (what data exists), internal (how it is stored). The gaps between them are data independence.
items.ne: तीन तह: external (प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने), conceptual (कुन data छ), internal (कसरी राखिएको)। बीचका खाली ठाउँ नै data independence हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Schema is the structure and rarely changes; instance is today's data and changes constantly.
items.ne: Schema संरचना हो, विरलै बदलिन्छ; instance आजको data हो, निरन्तर बदलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Data → information → database → DBMS. Each is built on the one before, and the DBMS is software, not data.
items.ne: Data → information → database → DBMS। हरेक अघिल्लोमाथि बनेको, र DBMS सफ्टवेयर हो, data होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Data is raw, unprocessed facts. On their own they carry no meaning: 78, Ram, 10. Information is data that has been processed and given meaning: "Ram scored 78 in class 10." The same facts, now useful. A database is a collection of related data, organised so it can be stored and retrieved efficiently. A DBMS (Database Management System) is the software that creates, manages and controls access to a database — MySQL, Oracle, MS Access.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Data भनेको काँचो, प्रशोधन नगरिएको तथ्य हो। एक्लै यसको अर्थ हुँदैन: 78, Ram, 10। Information भनेको प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको data हो: "रामले कक्षा १० मा ७८ अंक ल्याए।" उही तथ्य, अब काम लाग्ने। Database भनेको सम्बन्धित data को सङ्ग्रह हो, जुन राख्न र झिक्न सजिलो हुने गरी व्यवस्थित गरिएको हुन्छ। DBMS (Database Management System) भनेको डाटाबेस बनाउने, व्यवस्थापन गर्ने र पहुँच नियन्त्रण गर्ने सफ्टवेयर हो — MySQL, Oracle, MS Access।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough
items.en: Advantages and disadvantages Advantages: redundancy is controlled; data stays consistent; data is shared between users; security and access control are possible; backup and recovery are built in; standards can be enforced. Disadvantages — and they are real: a DBMS is expensive to buy and to run; it needs powerful hardware; it needs trained staff; and because everything is in one place, a failure affects everything at once. An answer that lists only advantages is an incomplete answer. Examiners ask for both.
items.ne: फाइदा र बेफाइदा फाइदा: दोहोरोपन नियन्त्रण हुन्छ; data एकरूप रहन्छ; प्रयोगकर्ताबीच साझेदारी हुन्छ; सुरक्षा र पहुँच नियन्त्रण सम्भव हुन्छ; backup र recovery भित्रै हुन्छ; मानक लागू गर्न सकिन्छ। बेफाइदा — र यी साँच्चिकै हुन्: DBMS किन्न र चलाउन महँगो हुन्छ; बलियो हार्डवेयर चाहिन्छ; तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी चाहिन्छन्; र सबै एकै ठाउँमा हुने भएकाले एउटै बिग्रँदा सबै प्रभावित हुन्छ। फाइदा मात्र लेखेको उत्तर अपूरो हुन्छ। परीक्षकले दुवै सोध्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Four users, four jobs Database Administrator (DBA) — has complete control. Creates the database, grants and revokes permission, takes backups, tunes performance. One person, or a small team. Database Designer — decides what entities and relationships the database needs, before it is built. Application Programmer — writes the programs that read and write the database through SQL. End User — uses those programs. A naive end user works through a form or a menu and never sees SQL; a sophisticated end user writes their own queries.
items.ne: चार प्रयोगकर्ता, चार काम Database Administrator (DBA) — पूर्ण नियन्त्रण। डाटाबेस बनाउने, अधिकार दिने–खोस्ने, backup लिने, कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने। Database Designer — बन्नुअघि नै कुन इन्टिटी र सम्बन्ध चाहिन्छ भन्ने तय गर्ने। Application Programmer — SQL मार्फत डाटाबेस पढ्ने–लेख्ने प्रोग्राम लेख्ने। End User — ती प्रोग्राम चलाउने। naive प्रयोगकर्ताले फारम वा मेनुबाट काम गर्छ र SQL देख्दैन; sophisticated प्रयोगकर्ताले आफैं क्वेरी लेख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Schema and instance A schema is the structure of the database — the table names, the columns and their types, the keys and the constraints. It is designed once and changes rarely. An instance is the data actually in the database at a given moment. It changes every time a row is inserted, updated or deleted. The same schema has a different instance every day. The schema of the Student table does not change when a new student joins — only its instance does.
items.ne: Schema र instance Schema भनेको डाटाबेसको संरचना हो — तालिकाका नाम, स्तम्भ र तिनका टाइप, कुञ्जी र बन्धन। एक पटक डिजाइन हुन्छ र विरलै बदलिन्छ। Instance भनेको कुनै क्षणमा डाटाबेसमा साँच्चै भएको data हो। पङ्क्ति थपिँदा, बदलिँदा वा हट्दा हरेक पटक फेरिन्छ। उही schema को instance हरेक दिन फरक हुन्छ। नयाँ विद्यार्थी भर्ना हुँदा Student तालिकाको schema बदलिँदैन — instance मात्र बदलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The data is the database. The program is the DBMS. MySQL is a program.
items.ne: डाटा नै database हो। प्रोग्राम चाहिँ DBMS हो। MySQL एउटा प्रोग्राम हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A DBMS is the software that creates, manages and controls access to a database. Examples: MySQL, Oracle, MS Access.
items.ne: दुवैको परिभाषा र DBMS का दुई उदाहरण लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Define database and DBMS.
items.ne: डाटाबेस र DBMS को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Explain the three-level architecture of a DBMS with a diagram.
items.ne: चित्रसहित DBMS को तीन तहको संरचना व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: State any three limitations of the traditional file system.
items.ne: परम्परागत फाइल प्रणालीका कुनै तीन सीमा लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Sort each one: data, information, database or DBMS? What you will learn: to separate the four words on real examples, so the "differentiate between…" question is answered from recognition rather than from a memorised sentence. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक उदाहरणमा चारै शब्द छुट्याउन — ताकि "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न घोकेको वाक्यबाट होइन, चिनेरै उत्तर दिन सकियोस्। How to use this Two of the five cases are software and two are content. Before you answer, ask one question: could I install this? If yes it is a DBMS; if it is something the DBMS stores or produces, it is one of the other three. Then separate data from information by asking whether it means anything on its own. 78 does not. "Ram scored 78" does. पाँचमध्ये दुई सफ्टवेयर हुन्, दुई सामग्री। उत्तर दिनुअघि एउटा प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: के यो install गर्न मिल्छ? मिल्छ भने DBMS; DBMS ले राख्ने वा दिने कुरा भए बाँकी तीनमध्ये एक। अनि आफैंमा अर्थ लाग्छ कि लाग्दैन सोधेर data र information छुट्याउनुहोस्। 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough {{dia:fileVsDb}} Learn these as pairs. A question asking for the limitations of the file system is really asking what a database fixes. यिनलाई जोडीमा सम्झनुहोस्। फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा सोध्नु भनेको डाटाबेसले के सुधार्छ भनी सोध्नु हो। Advantages and disadvantages Advantages: redundancy is controlled; data stays consistent; data is shared between users; security and access control are possible; backup and recovery are built in; standards can be enforced. Disadvantages — and they are real: a DBMS is expensive to buy and to run; it needs powerful hardware; it needs trained staff; and because everything is in one place, a failure affects everything at once. An answer that lists only advantages is an incomplete answer. Examiners ask for both. फाइदा र बेफाइदा फाइदा: दोहोरोपन नियन्त्रण हुन्छ; data एकरूप रहन्छ; प्रयोगकर्ताबीच साझेदारी हुन्छ; सुरक्षा र पहुँच नियन्त्रण सम्भव हुन्छ; backup र recovery भित्रै हुन्छ; मानक लागू गर्न सकिन्छ। बेफाइदा — र यी साँच्चिकै हुन्: DBMS किन्न र चलाउन महँगो हुन्छ; बलियो हार्डवेयर चाहिन्छ; तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी चाहिन्छन्; र सबै एकै ठाउँमा हुने भएकाले एउटै बिग्रँदा सबै प्रभावित हुन्छ। फाइदा मात्र लेखेको उत्तर अपूरो हुन्छ। परीक्षकले दुवै सोध्छन्। 1.4 — Where database systems are used. Banking (accounts and transactions), airlines and bus booking (seats), schools and universities (students, marks, fees), hospitals (patient records), telecom (call records), online shops (products, orders), and government records — citizenship, land, voter rolls. डाटाबेस प्रणालीको प्रयोग: बैंकिङ (खाता र कारोबार), हवाई तथा बस टिकट (सिट), विद्यालय र विश्वविद्यालय (विद्यार्थी, अंक, शुल्क), अस्पताल (बिरामीको रेकर्ड), टेलिकम (कल रेकर्ड), अनलाइन पसल (सामान, अर्डर), र सरकारी अभिलेख — नागरिकता, जग्गा, मतदाता नामावली। 1.5 Types of database user Four users, four jobs Database Administrator (DBA) — has complete control. Creates the database, grants and revokes permission, takes backups, tunes performance. One person, or a small team. Database Designer — decides what entities and relationships the database needs, before it is built. Application Programmer — writes the programs that read and write the database through SQL. End User — uses those programs. A naive end user works through a form or a menu and never sees SQL; a sophisticated end user writes their own queries. चार प्रयोगकर्ता, चार काम Database Administrator (DBA) — पूर्ण नियन्त्रण। डाटाबेस बनाउने, अधिकार दिने–खोस्ने, backup लिने, कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने। Database Designer — बन्नुअघि नै कुन इन्टिटी र सम्बन्ध चाहिन्छ भन्ने तय गर्ने। Application Programmer — SQL मार्फत डाटाबेस पढ्ने–लेख्ने प्रोग्राम लेख्ने। End User — ती प्रोग्राम चलाउने। naive प्रयोगकर्ताले फारम वा मेनुबाट काम गर्छ र SQL देख्दैन; sophisticated प्रयोगकर्ताले आफैं क्वेरी लेख्छ। 1.6 DBMS architecture {{dia:dbArchitecture}} Data independence in one sentence each. Physical data independence — you can change how the data is stored on disk without changing the tables. Logical data independence — you can change the tables without changing what a user sees. Physical is the easier of the two to achieve; logical is harder, because a user's view is built directly on the tables. एक–एक वाक्यमा: Physical data independence — डिस्कमा data कसरी राखिन्छ त्यो बदल्दा तालिका बदल्नु पर्दैन। Logical data independence — तालिका बदल्दा प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने कुरा बदल्नु पर्दैन। पहिलो हासिल गर्न सजिलो, दोस्रो गाह्रो। 1.7 & 1.8 Database models, schema and instance {{dia:dbModels}} Hierarchical and network are separated by one question: how many parents may a record have? Hierarchical र network लाई एउटै प्रश्नले छुट्याउँछ: एउटा रेकर्डका कति parent हुन सक्छन्? Schema and instance A schema is the structure of the database — the table names, the columns and their types, the keys and the constraints. It is designed once and changes rarely. An instance is the data actually in the database at a given moment. It changes every time a row is inserted, updated or deleted. The same schema has a different instance every day. The schema of the Student table does not change when a new student joins — only its instance does. Schema र instance Schema भनेको डाटाबेसको संरचना हो — तालिकाका नाम, स्तम्भ र तिनका टाइप, कुञ्जी र बन्धन। एक पटक डिजाइन हुन्छ र विरलै बदलिन्छ। Instance भनेको कुनै क्षणमा डाटाबेसमा साँच्चै भएको data हो। पङ्क्ति थपिँदा, बदलिँदा वा हट्दा हरेक पटक फेरिन्छ। उही schema को instance हरेक दिन फरक हुन्छ। नयाँ विद्यार्थी भर्ना हुँदा Student तालिकाको schema बदलिँदैन — instance मात्र बदलिन्छ। Example 1 Distinguishing the four terms in one answer Question: differentiate between data and information, and between database and DBMS, with one example each. (4 marks) Model answer DATA vs INFORMATION Data raw facts with no meaning 78 Information processed data with meaning Ram scored 78 DATABASE vs DBMS Database the organised collection of data the Student table DBMS the software that manages it MySQL Four marks, four lines. Answer in a two-column layout like this and you cannot accidentally define only one side of the pair — which is how this question is usually half-answered. चार अंक, चार हरफ। यसरी दुई स्तम्भमा लेख्नुभयो भने जोडीको एउटा पक्ष मात्र लेख्ने गल्ती हुँदैन — यो प्रश्न प्रायः त्यसैगरी आधा उत्तर हुन्छ। Example 2 Deciding which level a change belongs to Question: for each change, say which level of the three-level architecture it happens at, and which kind of data independence protects the level above it. Two changes are coming: moving the database to a faster disk, and adding an email column. Decide the level for each before you open this. The name of the independence follows from the level — get the level right and the second half is free. दुई परिवर्तन आउँदैछन्: डाटाबेस छिटो disk मा सार्नु, र email स्तम्भ थप्नु। खोल्नुअघि दुवैको level निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। independence को नाम level बाटै आउँछ — level ठिक भए दोस्रो आधा आफैँ आउँछ। Working "The database is moved to a faster disk." INTERNAL level — how the bytes are stored. Physical data independence means the tables above it do not change. "A new column 'email' is added to Student." CONCEPTUAL level — what data exists. Logical data independence means a teacher's view that never showed email is unaffected. "The class teacher is given a screen showing only name and marks." EXTERNAL level — what one user sees. Nothing below it changes at all. Answer disk change → internal (physical independence) new column → conceptual (logical independence) new user screen → external (no effect below) Work from the bottom up: is this about the disk, about what data exists, or about who sees it? Those three questions map onto the three levels exactly, and the independence is always named after the level below the boundary it protects. तलबाट माथि सोच्नुहोस्: यो डिस्कको कुरा हो, कुन data छ भन्ने कुरा हो, कि कसले देख्छ भन्ने कुरा हो? यी तीन प्रश्न ठ्याक्कै तीन तहमा मिल्छन्, र independence को नाम सधैं आफूले जोगाउने सीमाको तल्लो तहबाट राखिन्छ। Mistakes that cost marks here Calling the DBMS "the database". The database is the data; the DBMS is the program. MySQL is a DBMS. DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। डाटाबेस भनेको data, DBMS भनेको प्रोग्राम। Listing advantages when the question says advantages AND disadvantages. Half the question, half the marks. फाइदा र बेफाइदा दुवै सोधिएको ठाउँमा फाइदा मात्र लेख्नु। आधा प्रश्न, आधा अंक। Mixing up schema and instance. Adding a student changes the instance, not the schema. Schema र instance मिसाउनु। विद्यार्थी थप्दा instance बदलिन्छ, schema होइन। Drawing the three-level architecture upside down. External is at the top, nearest the user; internal is at the bottom, nearest the disk. तीन तहको चित्र उल्टो कोर्नु। External माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक; internal तल — डिस्कनजिक। The data is the database. The program is the DBMS. MySQL is a program. डाटा नै database हो। प्रोग्राम चाहिँ DBMS हो। MySQL एउटा प्रोग्राम हो। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit This unit is short — 6 hours — but it supplies the definitions the whole subject is built on. Almost every question here is either define, differentiate or list. All three are answered from memory, so the work is learning the exact wording rather than reasoning it out in the hall. The three-level architecture is the one diagram from this unit you may be asked to draw. यो युनिट छोटो छ — ६ घण्टा — तर पूरै विषय यसैका परिभाषामाथि बनेको छ। यहाँका प्रायः सबै प्रश्न परिभाषा दिने, फरक छुट्याउने वा सूची बनाउने हुन्। तीनै सम्झेर लेख्ने भएकाले ठ्याक्कै शब्द याद गर्नु नै काम हो। यस युनिटबाट कोर्न सकिने चित्र तीन तहको संरचना हो। 2 marks Practice question Define database and DBMS. डाटाबेस र DBMS को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। Show the answer A database is a collection of related data organised so that it can be stored and retrieved efficiently. A DBMS is the software that creates, manages and controls access to a database. Examples: MySQL, Oracle, MS Access. दुवैको परिभाषा र DBMS का दुई उदाहरण लेख्नुहोस्। 4 marks Practice question Explain the three-level architecture of a DBMS with a diagram. चित्रसहित DBMS को तीन तहको संरचना व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Show the answer EXTERNAL LEVEL what each user sees ↑ logical data independence CONCEPTUAL LEVEL what data exists, and how it relates ↑ physical data independence INTERNAL LEVEL how the data is stored on disk One mark for the diagram with all three levels in the right order, and one mark for explaining each level. Mentioning data independence between the levels is what turns a three-mark answer into a four-mark one. तीनै तह सही क्रममा भएको चित्रलाई एक अंक, हरेक तहको व्याख्यालाई एक–एक। तहबीचको data independence उल्लेख गर्दा तीन अंकको उत्तर चार अंकको बन्छ। 3 marks Practice question State any three limitations of the traditional file system. परम्परागत फाइल प्रणालीका कुनै तीन सीमा लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer Data redundancy — the same fact is stored in several files. Data inconsistency — one copy is updated and the others are left stale. Data isolation — data sits in different files and formats, so combining it is hard. No concurrency control — two users writing at once can corrupt the file. Weak security — access cannot be controlled at the level of individual records. Any three, each named and explained in one line. कुनै तीन — नाम दिएर एक–एक हरफमा व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Key points to revise

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: What you will learn: to separate the four words on real examples, so the "differentiate between…" question is answered from recognition rather than from a memorised sentence.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक उदाहरणमा चारै शब्द छुट्याउन — ताकि "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न घोकेको वाक्यबाट होइन, चिनेरै उत्तर दिन सकियोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A diamond holds the relationship, written as a verb — ENROLS, TEACHES. Entities are rectangles and attributes are ellipses.
items.ne: चतुर्भुजभित्र सम्बन्ध हुन्छ, क्रियापदमा लेखिएको — ENROLS, TEACHES। इन्टिटी आयत हुन् र एट्रिब्युट दीर्घवृत्त।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A derived attribute is drawn with a dashed ellipse. A double ellipse means multivalued, an underline marks the key, and a double rectangle is a weak entity.
items.ne: व्युत्पन्न (derived) एट्रिब्युट धर्के दीर्घवृत्तले कोरिन्छ। दोहोरो दीर्घवृत्त = बहुमान, मुनि रेखा = कुञ्जी, दोहोरो आयत = कमजोर इन्टिटी।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: "Weak" is about identification, not importance. A weak entity cannot be identified on its own and must borrow its owner's key. It is drawn with a double rectangle.
items.ne: "कमजोर" भनेको चिनारीको कुरा हो, महत्त्वको होइन। कमजोर इन्टिटी आफैंले चिनिँदैन र मालिकको कुञ्जी लिनुपर्छ। दोहोरो आयतले कोरिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Test both directions. Class → students is "many", but student → class is "one". Many one way and one the other way is 1:M. It would only be M:N if a student could also be in several classes.
items.ne: दुवै दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्। कक्षा → विद्यार्थी "धेरै" हो, तर विद्यार्थी → कक्षा "एक"। एकातिर धेरै र अर्कोतिर एक भए 1:M। विद्यार्थी धेरै कक्षामा हुन सक्ने भए मात्र M:N हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A many-to-many relationship cannot be recorded by a foreign key, because a column holds one value and each side has many partners. It becomes a third table holding one row per link.
items.ne: धेरै–धेरै सम्बन्धलाई foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन, किनभने स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्छ र दुवैतर्फ धेरै जोडी छन्। यो तेस्रो तालिका बन्छ, हरेक जोडका लागि एक पङ्क्ति।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Unique and NOT NULL are the two rules a primary key must obey — together they are what let a row be found reliably. Pointing at another table is a foreign key, which may be NULL and may repeat.
items.ne: अद्वितीय र NOT NULL — primary key ले पालना गर्नुपर्ने दुई नियम यिनै हुन्। अर्को तालिका देखाउने काम foreign key को हो, जुन NULL हुन र दोहोरिन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Any identifying set is a super key. Strip out everything unnecessary and it becomes a candidate key. One candidate key is then chosen as the primary key; the rest are alternate keys.
items.ne: पङ्क्ति चिनाउने जुनसुकै समूह super key हो। अनावश्यक कुरा हटाएपछि candidate key बन्छ। तीमध्ये एउटा primary key छानिन्छ; बाँकी alternate key हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The degree of a relationship counts the entities in it, not the rows. Only EMPLOYEE takes part here, related to itself, so the degree is unary. Do not confuse degree with cardinality.
items.ne: सम्बन्धको degree ले त्यसमा सहभागी इन्टिटी गन्छ, पङ्क्ति होइन। यहाँ EMPLOYEE मात्र छ, आफैंसँग सम्बन्धित, त्यसैले degree unary हो। Degree लाई cardinality सँग नमिसाउनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Calling a weak entity "unimportant". It means the entity has no key of its own and must borrow its owner's. Draw it with a double rectangle.
items.ne: कमजोर इन्टिटीलाई "महत्त्वहीन" भन्नु। यसको अर्थ आफ्नो कुञ्जी नभएको र मालिकको कुञ्जी लिनुपर्ने भन्ने हो। दोहोरो आयतले कोर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Which mapping cardinality?
items.ne: कुन mapping cardinality?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Read both directions before you answer. A sentence that only tells you one direction has not told you the cardinality.
items.ne: उत्तर दिनुअघि दुवै दिशा पढ्नुहोस्। एउटा दिशा मात्र बताउने वाक्यले cardinality बताएकै हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Many one way, one the other. The second sentence is what settles it — without it this could equally have been many-to-many.
items.ne: एकातिर धेरै, अर्कोतिर एक। दोस्रो वाक्यले नै तय गर्छ — त्यो नभए यो धेरै–धेरै पनि हुन सक्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Many in both directions, so no single foreign key can record it. This is the one that forces a third table.
items.ne: दुवै दिशामा धेरै, त्यसैले एउटै foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन। तेस्रो तालिका बाध्य पार्ने यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: One in both directions. Two tables still, and the foreign key may sit in either one.
items.ne: दुवै दिशामा एक। तालिका दुई नै हुन्छन्, र foreign key जुनसुकैमा राख्न सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: "May be treated by several" is the second "many". Read carefully — the wording is softer than in the course example, but the cardinality is the same.
items.ne: "धेरै डाक्टरले उपचार गर्न सक्छन्" भन्नु नै दोस्रो "धेरै" हो। शब्द नरम छ, तर cardinality उही।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Both directions are "at most one". A teacher works in a department alongside others, but HEADS only one — the relationship named is what you judge, not the entities.
items.ne: दुवै दिशा "बढीमा एक"। शिक्षक विभागमा अरूसँगै काम गर्छन्, तर नेतृत्व एउटैको गर्छन् — इन्टिटी होइन, नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध हेर्ने हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: A drawing question is marked on the shapes. A rectangle where an ellipse belongs loses the mark even when the word inside it is right.
items.ne: कोर्ने प्रश्नमा आकार नै जाँचिन्छ। दीर्घवृत्त हुनुपर्ने ठाउँमा आयत कोर्दा भित्रको शब्द सही भए पनि अंक जान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Each key is a narrowing of the one above it. Every primary key is a candidate key, and every candidate key is a super key — but not the reverse.
items.ne: हरेक कुञ्जी माथिकोभन्दा साँघुरो हुँदै जान्छ। हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो, र हरेक candidate key एउटा super key — तर उल्टो होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Draw a complete ER diagram for a small scenario.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: ER मोडेल किन चाहिन्छ भन्न, इन्टिटी–कमजोर इन्टिटी चिन्न र चिन्ह कोर्न, एट्रिब्युटका प्रकार नाम लिन, सम्बन्ध र यसको degree भन्न, 1:1–1:M–M:N को अर्थ र तालिकामा पर्ने असर भन्न, कुञ्जीका प्रकार परिभाषित गर्न, र सानो परिदृश्यको पूरा ER चित्र कोर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: Pay attention to weak entity. "Weak" does not mean unimportant. It means the thing cannot be identified without its owner: a dependant is identified by which employee they belong to, plus their name.
items.ne: हरेक भाग क्रमैसँग थिच्नुहोस् र चित्रको कुन भाग बल्छ हेर्नुहोस्। आकारको नाम पढ्नुहोस् — परीक्षामा कोर्नुपर्ने त्यही हो — अनि वाक्य पढ्नुहोस्, जसले त्यो भाग वास्तविक तालिकामा के बन्छ बताउँछ। कमजोर इन्टिटी मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्। "कमजोर" को अर्थ महत्त्वहीन होइन; मालिकविना चिनिन नसक्ने भन्ने हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: Degree of a relationship is how many entities take part in it — not how many rows. Unary (one entity related to itself: an employee manages an employee), binary (two entities — almost every relationship you will meet), ternary (three). Degree and cardinality are different questions: degree counts entities, cardinality counts how many rows link to how many.
items.ne: सम्बन्धको degree भनेको त्यसमा कति इन्टिटी सहभागी छन् भन्ने हो — कति पङ्क्ति भन्ने होइन। Unary (एउटै इन्टिटी आफैंसँग), binary (दुई — प्रायः सबै), ternary (तीन)। Degree र cardinality फरक प्रश्न हुन्: degree ले इन्टिटी गन्छ, cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्ने।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Only M:N produces a junction table. Watch it appear, and notice it holds nothing but two foreign keys — one row per link, which is exactly what the relationship is.
items.ne: माथिको चिन्ह तीन बटनबीच झन्डै बदलिँदैन — एउटा अक्षर मात्र। तलका पङ्क्ति भने पूरै बदलिन्छन्, र वास्तविक फरक त्यही हो। 1:M मा सूचीमुनिको टिप्पणी पढ्नुहोस्: हरेक विषयले ठ्याक्कै एउटा विद्यार्थी देखाउँछ। अब M:N थिच्नुहोस् — Maths अब दुई विद्यार्थीबाट जोडिन्छ। दुवैतर्फ "धेरै", र पूरा परिभाषा यही हो। M:N ले मात्र junction तालिका बनाउँछ; त्यसमा दुई foreign key बाहेक केही हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The last two cases are the ones worth slowing down for. One uses softer wording — "may be treated by several" is still "many". The other describes a relationship between entities that also relate in other ways: judge the relationship that is named, not the entities.
items.ne: हरेक केसमा दुई वाक्यलाई दुई छुट्टै प्रश्न मानेर पढ्नुहोस्: बायाँको एउटालाई दायाँ कति? अनि दायाँको एउटालाई बायाँ कति? दुवैपछि मात्र cardinality थाहा हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई केसमा बिस्तारै जानुहोस् — एउटामा शब्द नरम छ, अर्कोमा नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध हेर्नुपर्छ, इन्टिटी होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Always test both directions. A sentence that only tells you one direction has not told you the cardinality. "A class has many students" alone could be 1:M or M:N — you have to ask whether a student can be in two classes.
items.ne: सधैं दुवै दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्। एउटा दिशा मात्र बताउने वाक्यले cardinality बताएकै हुँदैन। "एउटा कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी" भन्ने मात्रले 1:M कि M:N भन्न मिल्दैन — एउटा विद्यार्थी दुई कक्षामा हुन सक्छ कि भनी सोध्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Four kinds of key are being asked for. Before you open this, commit to one number: how many candidate keys does this table have? If your answer is 1, look at the question again.
items.ne: चार किसिमका key सोधिएका छन्। खोल्नुअघि एउटा सङ्ख्या भन्नुहोस्: यो तालिकामा कति वटा candidate key छन्? जवाफ १ आयो भने प्रश्न फेरि हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The examiner is checking that you know these are nested, not five unrelated things. Every primary key is a candidate key, and every candidate key is a super key. Saying so in one line is often worth a mark by itself.
items.ne: परीक्षकले यी पाँच असम्बन्धित कुरा होइनन्, एकभित्र अर्को हुन् भन्ने जान्नुभएको छ कि छैन हेर्छन्। हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो, र हरेक candidate key एउटा super key। यही एक हरफले प्रायः एक अंक दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Answering "many students in a class" as M:N. Check the other direction: a student is in one class, so it is 1:M.
items.ne: "एउटा कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी" लाई M:N भन्नु। अर्को दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्: विद्यार्थी एउटै कक्षामा हुन्छ, त्यसैले 1:M।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Confusing degree with cardinality. Degree counts the entities in a relationship; cardinality counts how many rows link to how many.
items.ne: Degree र cardinality मिसाउनु। Degree ले सम्बन्धका इन्टिटी गन्छ; cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Underlining nothing in an ER diagram. The key attribute must be underlined — that is the notation for a primary key, and a marker looks for it.
items.ne: ER चित्रमा कुनै पनि नाममुनि रेखा नकोर्नु। कुञ्जी एट्रिब्युटमुनि रेखा हुनैपर्छ — primary key को चिन्ह त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Writing a relationship as a noun. A diamond holds a verb: ENROLS, TEACHES, CONTAINS — not "enrolment".
items.ne: सम्बन्धलाई नामपदमा लेख्नु। चतुर्भुजभित्र क्रियापद हुन्छ: ENROLS, TEACHES, CONTAINS — "enrolment" होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit is examined mostly by drawing. The commonest question gives you two or three sentences describing a small system and asks for an ER diagram — entities, attributes with the key underlined, a relationship named as a verb, and the cardinality marked on both lines. Marks are given for each of those four things separately, so a diagram missing its cardinalities still earns most of them. Draw it big, and label everything.
items.ne: यो युनिट प्रायः कोरेर जाँचिन्छ। सामान्य प्रश्नले दुई–तीन वाक्यमा सानो प्रणाली वर्णन गरेर ER चित्र माग्छ — इन्टिटी, कुञ्जीमुनि रेखासहितका एट्रिब्युट, क्रियापदमा नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध, र दुवै रेखामा cardinality। यी चार कुरालाई छुट्टाछुट्टै अंक हुन्छ, त्यसैले cardinality छुटे पनि धेरैजसो अंक आउँछ। ठूलो कोर्नुहोस् र सबैमा नाम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: An attribute is a property or characteristic of an entity. Example: the student's name. It is drawn as an ellipse and becomes a column.
items.ne: दुवैको परिभाषा, एक–एक उदाहरण, र चाहेमा कुन आकारले कोरिन्छ भन्ने पनि।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark per cardinality with its example, and the fourth for stating that M:N requires an extra table.
items.ne: हरेक cardinality र उदाहरणलाई एक–एक अंक, र M:N लाई थप तालिका चाहिन्छ भनेकोमा चौथो अंक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark for the two entities as rectangles, one for the attributes as ellipses with the keys underlined, one for the relationship in a diamond named as a verb, and one for the M:N cardinality marked on both lines.
items.ne: आयतमा दुई इन्टिटीलाई एक अंक, कुञ्जीमुनि रेखासहित दीर्घवृत्तका एट्रिब्युटलाई एक, चतुर्भुजमा क्रियापद रूपको सम्बन्धलाई एक, र दुवै रेखामा M:N लेखेकोमा एक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Degree counts the entities in a relationship; cardinality counts how many rows link to how many. They are different questions.
items.ne: Degree ले सम्बन्धका इन्टिटी गन्छ; cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ। दुई फरक प्रश्न हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Always test cardinality in BOTH directions. Many one way and one the other is 1:M; many both ways is M:N.
items.ne: Cardinality सधैं दुवै दिशामा जाँच्नुहोस्। एकातिर धेरै र अर्कोतिर एक भए 1:M; दुवैतिर धेरै भए M:N।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: M:N always needs a third table. 1:1 and 1:M do not.
items.ne: M:N लाई सधैं तेस्रो तालिका चाहिन्छ। 1:1 र 1:M लाई चाहिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A primary key is unique and never NULL. A foreign key may be NULL and may repeat, but its value must already exist in the table it points at.
items.ne: Primary key अद्वितीय हुन्छ र कहिल्यै NULL हुँदैन। Foreign key NULL हुन र दोहोरिन सक्छ, तर यसको मान देखाइएको तालिकामा पहिले नै हुनुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Every primary key is a candidate key; every candidate key is a super key. The reverse is not true.
items.ne: हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो; हरेक candidate key एउटा super key। उल्टो होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Rectangle = entity, ellipse = attribute, diamond = relationship. Double rectangle = weak entity, double ellipse = multivalued, dashed ellipse = derived, underlined = key.

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Why model before you build A database is expensive to change once it holds real data. The ER model is a picture of the database drawn before any table exists, so that mistakes are found on paper instead of after a year of records. It is deliberately not SQL and not tables. It is a diagram of things and how they are connected, in language a school clerk could check. Only once the picture is agreed is it turned into tables — and that translation is Unit 3. An ER diagram has exactly three kinds of shape: rectangles for things, ellipses for their properties, and diamonds for the connections between them.
items.ne: बनाउनुअघि मोडेल किन वास्तविक data भरिसकेपछि डाटाबेस बदल्न महँगो पर्छ। ER मोडेल भनेको कुनै तालिका बन्नुभन्दा अघि कोरिने डाटाबेसको चित्र हो, ताकि गल्ती वर्ष दिनको रेकर्डपछि होइन, कागजमै भेटियोस्। यो जानाजान SQL पनि होइन, तालिका पनि होइन। यो वस्तु र तिनका सम्बन्ध को चित्र हो — विद्यालयको कर्मचारीले पनि जाँच्न सक्ने भाषामा। चित्र मिलेपछि मात्र तालिकामा बदलिन्छ, र त्यो अनुवाद युनिट ३ मा छ। ER चित्रमा ठ्याक्कै तीन किसिमका आकार हुन्छन्: वस्तुका लागि आयत, तिनका गुणका लागि दीर्घवृत्त, र जोडाइका लागि चतुर्भुज।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: Entity, entity set, weak entity — three words, one shape An entity is one single thing the database stores: Ram, one student. You can point at it. An entity set is every entity of the same kind, taken together: all the students. The rectangle you draw in an ER diagram names the set — it says STUDENT, not Ram. This is the distinction a one-mark question is testing when it asks you to "define entity and entity set", and the two answers are not interchangeable. The easiest way to keep them apart is to look one step ahead, at Unit 3. When the diagram becomes tables, the entity set becomes the table and each entity becomes one row. A table is a set of rows; that is the same sentence said twice. A weak entity is not a third kind of thing but an entity with a missing key: it cannot be identified without its owner. Drawn as a double rectangle.
items.ne: इन्टिटी, इन्टिटी सेट, कमजोर इन्टिटी — तीन शब्द, एउटै आकार इन्टिटी भनेको डाटाबेसले राख्ने एउटै वस्तु: राम, एक विद्यार्थी। औंला ठड्याएर देखाउन सकिन्छ। इन्टिटी सेट भनेको उही किसिमका सबै इन्टिटी सँगै: सबै विद्यार्थी। ER चित्रमा कोरिने आयतले सेट को नाम लेख्छ — STUDENT लेख्छ, Ram लेख्दैन। "इन्टिटी र इन्टिटी सेट परिभाषित गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने एक अंकको प्रश्नले जाँच्ने यही फरक हो, र दुई उत्तर साटासाट मिल्दैनन्। छुट्याउने सजिलो उपाय युनिट ३ तर्फ एक पाइला अघि हेर्नु हो। चित्र तालिकामा बदलिँदा इन्टिटी सेट तालिका बन्छ र हरेक इन्टिटी एक पङ्क्ति बन्छ। तालिका भनेको पङ्क्तिहरूको सेट हो — उही वाक्य दुई पटक भनिएको। कमजोर इन्टिटी तेस्रो किसिमको वस्तु होइन, कुञ्जी नभएको इन्टिटी हो: मालिकविना चिनिन सक्दैन। दोहोरो आयतले कोरिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The two rules a primary key must obey A primary key must be unique — no two rows may share its value — and it must be NOT NULL — it can never be left empty. Those two rules are what allow a row to be found reliably. A foreign key is different in kind. It is not about identifying a row in its own table; it is a column whose value must already exist as a primary key in another table. That rule is what links two tables together, and it is called referential integrity. A foreign key may be NULL — Gita has no class yet — and it may repeat, since many students share one class. A primary key may do neither.
items.ne: Primary key ले पालना गर्नुपर्ने दुई नियम Primary key अद्वितीय हुनुपर्छ — दुई पङ्क्तिको मान उही हुन नहुने — र NOT NULL हुनुपर्छ — कहिल्यै खाली छाड्न नहुने। यी दुई नियमले नै पङ्क्ति भरपर्दो रूपमा खोज्न दिन्छन्। Foreign key फरक किसिमको हो। यसले आफ्नै तालिकाको पङ्क्ति चिनाउँदैन; यो त्यस्तो स्तम्भ हो जसको मान अर्को तालिकाको primary key मा पहिले नै हुनैपर्छ। यही नियमले दुई तालिका जोड्छ, र यसलाई referential integrity भनिन्छ। Foreign key NULL हुन सक्छ — गीताको कक्षा अझै छैन — र दोहोरिन पनि सक्छ, किनभने धेरै विद्यार्थीको कक्षा एउटै हुन्छ। Primary key ले यी दुवै गर्न पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Every ER component, one at a time What you will learn: which shape belongs to which idea, and what each one becomes when the diagram is turned into tables. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: कुन आकार कुन विचारको हो, र चित्र तालिकामा बदलिँदा हरेक के बन्छ। How to use this Press each component in turn and watch which part of the diagram lights up. Read the shape name — that is what you have to draw in the exam — and then the sentence, which tells you what the component becomes in a real table. Pay attention to weak entity. "Weak" does not mean unimportant. It means the thing cannot be identified without its owner: a dependant is identified by which employee they belong to, plus their name. हरेक भाग क्रमैसँग थिच्नुहोस् र चित्रको कुन भाग बल्छ हेर्नुहोस्। आकारको नाम पढ्नुहोस् — परीक्षामा कोर्नुपर्ने त्यही हो — अनि वाक्य पढ्नुहोस्, जसले त्यो भाग वास्तविक तालिकामा के बन्छ बताउँछ। कमजोर इन्टिटी मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्। "कमजोर" को अर्थ महत्त्वहीन होइन; मालिकविना चिनिन नसक्ने भन्ने हो। Degree of a relationship is how many entities take part in it — not how many rows. Unary (one entity related to itself: an employee manages an employee), binary (two entities — almost every relationship you will meet), ternary (three). Degree and cardinality are different questions: degree counts entities, cardinality counts how many rows link to how many. सम्बन्धको degree भनेको त्यसमा कति इन्टिटी सहभागी छन् भन्ने हो — कति पङ्क्ति भन्ने होइन। Unary (एउटै इन्टिटी आफैंसँग), binary (दुई — प्रायः सबै), ternary (तीन)। Degree र cardinality फरक प्रश्न हुन्: degree ले इन्टिटी गन्छ, cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्ने। 2.5 Mapping cardinalities Predict first
