items.topic: 2.1 The basic units of a computer system
items.en: What you will learn: where each unit sits in the flow and exactly what it is responsible for — so that when a question asks which unit does the comparing, you can see the answer rather than recall a sentence.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्रवाहमा हरेक एकाइ कहाँ पर्छ र ठ्याक्कै कसको के जिम्मेवारी हो — ताकि तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्ने प्रश्न आउँदा वाक्य सम्झनुभन्दा उत्तर देख्न सकियोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What you will learn: to match a symptom or a description to resolution, colour depth or refresh rate — which is how these three are actually asked about, rather than as bare definitions.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: कुनै लक्षण वा विवरणलाई resolution, colour depth वा refresh rate सँग मिलाउन — किनकि यी तीन कुरा खाली परिभाषाका रूपमा होइन, यसरी नै सोधिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Choose a component and it will be highlighted on the diagram.
items.ne: कुनै भाग छान्नुहोस्, चित्रमा त्यही ठाउँ उज्यालो हुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: In the exam
items.ne: परीक्षामा

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Accepts data and instructions from outside and converts them into a form the computer can process.
items.ne: बाहिरबाट data र निर्देशन लिन्छ र कम्प्युटरले प्रशोधन गर्न सक्ने रूपमा बदल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Keyboard, mouse, scanner, digital camera. Naming four is a standard 2-mark answer.
items.ne: Keyboard, mouse, scanner, digital camera। चार वटा नाम लेख्नु मानक २ अंकको उत्तर हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Arithmetic and Logic Unit — performs every calculation and every comparison. Nothing is decided anywhere else.
items.ne: Arithmetic and Logic Unit — हरेक गणना र हरेक तुलना यहीँ हुन्छ। निर्णय अरू कतै हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Arithmetic: + − × ÷. Logic: greater than, less than, equal to, AND/OR/NOT.
items.ne: Arithmetic: + − × ÷। Logic: ठूलो, सानो, बराबर, AND/OR/NOT।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Directs the whole system: fetches each instruction, decodes it, and tells every other unit what to do and when.
items.ne: पूरै प्रणाली निर्देशित गर्छ: हरेक निर्देशन ल्याउँछ, बुझ्छ, र अरू हरेक एकाइलाई कहिले के गर्ने भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: It does NOT perform calculations — that is the ALU. Saying the CU calculates is the most common slip in this unit.
items.ne: यसले गणना गर्दैन — त्यो ALU को काम हो। CU ले गणना गर्छ भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Holds the data and instructions being worked on now, and the results until they are sent out.
items.ne: अहिले काम भइरहेको data र निर्देशन, र नतिजा बाहिर नपठाएसम्म राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: ALU + Control unit + Memory together are the CPU. The examiner expects that grouping named.
items.ne: ALU + Control unit + Memory मिलेर CPU बन्छ। परीक्षकले यही समूह नाम लिइएको खोज्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Converts processed results into a form a person can understand and presents them.
items.ne: प्रशोधित नतिजालाई मान्छेले बुझ्ने रूपमा बदलेर देखाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Monitor, printer, speaker. A monitor is output only — a touchscreen is both.
items.ne: Monitor, printer, speaker। Monitor आउटपुट मात्र हो — touchscreen भने दुवै हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Holds the processor and connects it to the board. The socket type must match the processor exactly.
items.ne: प्रोसेसर राख्छ र बोर्डसँग जोड्छ। Socket को प्रकार प्रोसेसरसँग ठ्याक्कै मिल्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Always under the heatsink and fan. A processor cannot be moved to a board with a different socket.
items.ne: सधैं heatsink र पंखा मुनि हुन्छ। फरक socket भएको बोर्डमा प्रोसेसर सार्न मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Long slots holding the memory modules. Clips at both ends lock a module in place.
items.ne: मेमोरी मोड्युल राख्ने लामा slot। दुवै छेउका क्लिपले मोड्युल अड्काउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: A module that is not fully seated is the classic cause of "powers on, no display, repeated beeps".
items.ne: राम्ररी नबसेको मोड्युल नै "चल्छ, स्क्रिन आउँदैन, बारम्बार बीप" को उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Take add-on cards — graphics, sound, network — extending what the board can do.
items.ne: थप कार्ड लिन्छन् — graphics, sound, network — बोर्डको क्षमता बढाउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: PCI is a local bus: it connects expansion cards close to the processor at high speed.
items.ne: PCI एउटा local bus हो: यसले expansion कार्डलाई प्रोसेसरको नजिक उच्च गतिमा जोड्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Routes traffic between the processor, memory, expansion slots and the ports.
items.ne: प्रोसेसर, मेमोरी, expansion slot र पोर्टबीचको ट्राफिक व्यवस्थापन गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Think of it as the board's traffic controller — it decides what talks to what.
items.ne: यसलाई बोर्डको ट्राफिक नियन्त्रक ठान्नुहोस् — कसले कोसँग कुरा गर्ने यसैले तय गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: BIOS chip and CMOS battery
items.ne: BIOS चिप र CMOS ब्याट्री

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: The BIOS chip holds the firmware that starts the machine. The battery keeps the settings and clock alive when the power is off.
items.ne: BIOS चिपमा मेसिन सुरु गर्ने firmware हुन्छ। ब्याट्रीले बिजुली नहुँदा सेटिङ र घडी जीवित राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: A clock that resets to a wrong date on every boot is the standard symptom of a dead CMOS battery.
items.ne: हरेक पटक बुट हुँदा घडी गलत मितिमा फर्किनु मरेको CMOS ब्याट्रीको मानक लक्षण हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Where the power supply feeds the board. A separate smaller connector feeds the processor.
items.ne: पावर सप्लाईले बोर्डलाई बिजुली दिने ठाउँ। प्रोसेसरका लागि छुट्टै सानो connector हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Forgetting the separate CPU power connector gives a machine with fans spinning and no display.
items.ne: छुट्टै CPU power connector बिर्सिँदा पंखा घुम्छ तर स्क्रिन आउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Drive connectors
items.ne: ड्राइभ connector

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Connect the hard disk and optical drive to the board for data.
items.ne: Hard disk र optical drive लाई data का लागि बोर्डसँग जोड्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.unitTitle: Introduction to Computer System / Overview on System's Core
items.en: Data and power are two separate cables. A drive with only power connected spins but is never detected.
items.ne: Data र power छुट्टाछुट्टै केबल हुन्। पावर मात्र जोडिएको ड्राइभ घुम्छ तर कहिल्यै पत्ता लाग्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The BIOS is firmware on a motherboard chip. It has to run before any disk is read — it is what finds and loads the operating system — so it cannot be stored on the disk. RAM is wrong because RAM is empty at power-on.
items.ne: BIOS मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो। कुनै disk पढिनुअघि नै यो चल्नुपर्छ — अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर लोड गर्ने यही हो — त्यसैले disk मा हुनै सक्दैन। RAM गलत हो किनकि बिजुली लाग्दा RAM खाली हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: CMOS memory holds the BIOS settings and runs the clock, and it needs power even when the machine is unplugged. That power comes from a coin battery on the board. When it dies, everything CMOS remembers is lost each time mains power goes — which is exactly this symptom.
items.ne: CMOS मेमोरीले BIOS सेटिङ राख्छ र घडी चलाउँछ, र मेसिन अनप्लग हुँदा पनि यसलाई बिजुली चाहिन्छ। त्यो बोर्डको सिक्का ब्याट्रीबाट आउँछ। त्यो सकिएपछि मुख्य बिजुली जाँदा CMOS ले सम्झेको सबै हराउँछ — लक्षण ठ्याक्कै यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A sector is one slice of a track and is the smallest addressable unit. A track is a whole concentric ring, a cylinder is the same track across all platters, and a platter is the entire disk — all three are larger than a sector.
items.ne: Sector भनेको track को एउटा टुक्रा हो र ठेगाना दिन मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ हो। Track पूरै केन्द्रित रिङ हो, cylinder सबै platter का उही track, र platter पूरै डिस्क — तीनै sector भन्दा ठूला छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Seek time is the arm moving to the correct track, rotational delay is waiting for the sector to come round under the head, and transfer time is reading or writing the data. The first two are mechanical, which is why they dominate and why a solid-state drive is so much faster.
items.ne: Seek time भनेको arm ठीक track मा जाने, rotational delay भनेको sector head मुनि आइपुग्न पर्खने, र transfer time भनेको data पढ्ने वा लेख्ने। पहिलो दुई यान्त्रिक हुन् — त्यसैले तिनकै बढी समय लाग्छ, र solid-state drive यति छिटो हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A quick format rewrites the file system index only, so the drive reports itself as empty while the sectors still hold the data. Recovery software scans sectors directly instead of trusting the index. To remove data properly you need a full format or a wipe utility that overwrites every sector.
items.ne: Quick format ले file system को सूची मात्र फेरि लेख्छ, त्यसैले ड्राइभ खाली देखिन्छ तर sector मा data रहन्छ। Recovery सफ्टवेयरले सूचीमा भर नपरी sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। Data ठीकसँग हटाउन full format वा हरेक sector ओभरराइट गर्ने wipe utility चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: An extended partition exists to get round the limit on primary partitions: it holds logical drives, and those get the letters. The extended partition itself has none, and you boot from a primary partition, not from it.
items.ne: Primary partition को सीमा नाघ्न extended partition बनाइन्छ: यसले logical drive राख्छ, र अक्षर तिनैले पाउँछन्। Extended partition आफैँले पाउँदैन, र boot primary partition बाट हुन्छ, यसबाट होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying the BIOS is stored on the hard disk. It is firmware on a chip on the motherboard — it has to run before any disk is read.
items.ne: BIOS hard disk मा हुन्छ भन्नु। यो मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो — कुनै disk पढिनुअघि नै यो चल्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: How a hard disk finds and reads one block of data.
items.ne: Hard disk ले data को एउटा ब्लक कसरी खोजेर पढ्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The platter is a rigid magnetic disk, and it spins the whole time the drive is powered — typically 5400 or 7200 revolutions per minute.
items.ne: Platter एउटा कडा चुम्बकीय डिस्क हो, र ड्राइभमा बिजुली भएसम्म यो निरन्तर घुमिरहन्छ — सामान्यतया मिनेटमा ५४०० वा ७२०० पटक।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The surface is divided into concentric rings called TRACKS. The same track on every platter, stacked, is called a cylinder.
items.ne: सतहलाई TRACK भनिने केन्द्रित रिङमा बाँडिएको हुन्छ। हरेक platter को उही track माथिमाथि राखिएको समूहलाई cylinder भनिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Each track is cut into SECTORS. A sector is the smallest unit the drive can read or write — traditionally 512 bytes.
items.ne: हरेक track लाई SECTOR मा काटिन्छ। ड्राइभले पढ्न वा लेख्न सक्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ sector हो — परम्परागत रूपमा ५१२ बाइट।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The read-write head sits on an actuator arm and floats microns above the surface on a cushion of air. It never touches the platter — if it does, that is a head crash.
items.ne: Read-write head actuator arm मा हुन्छ र हावाको तकियामा सतहभन्दा माइक्रोन मात्र माथि तैरिन्छ। यसले platter छुँदैन — छोयो भने त्यो head crash हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: SEEK TIME: the arm swings the head to the right track. This is mechanical movement, which is why it is the slowest part of a read.
items.ne: SEEK TIME: arm ले head लाई ठीक track मा पुर्‍याउँछ। यो यान्त्रिक चाल हो — त्यसैले पढाइको सबैभन्दा ढिलो भाग यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: ROTATIONAL DELAY: the head is on the right track but the sector it wants has not come round yet, so it waits for the disk to bring it.
items.ne: ROTATIONAL DELAY: head ठीक track मा छ तर चाहिएको sector अझै आइपुगेको छैन, त्यसैले डिस्कले ल्याउन्जेल पर्खिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: DATA TRANSFER: the sector passes under the head and the block is read into memory. Access time is all three added together — seek, rotation, transfer.
items.ne: DATA TRANSFER: sector head मुनिबाट जान्छ र ब्लक मेमोरीमा पढिन्छ। Access time भनेको तीनै वटाको योग हो — seek, rotation, transfer।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Step through one read. "Explain the operation of a hard disk" is answered by this sequence, and the three parts of access time are usually worth a mark each.
items.ne: एउटा पढाइ चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस्। "Hard disk को सञ्चालन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको उत्तर यही क्रम हो, र access time का तीन भागको प्रायः एक–एक अंक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: One disk, several drives. The extended partition is the box, not one of the drives inside it — a distinction that is regularly worth a mark.
items.ne: एउटै डिस्क, धेरै ड्राइभ। Extended partition भाँडो हो, त्यसभित्रको कुनै ड्राइभ होइन — यही भिन्नताको प्रायः अंक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Explain partitioning and drive lettering, and distinguish quick from full formatting.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: BIOS के हो र POST सहित यसका मुख्य काम भन्न, मदरबोर्डका प्रमुख भाग चिन्न र हरेकले के जोड्छ भन्न, form factor के हो र बोर्ड साट्दा किन महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ बताउन, PCI local bus र expansion slot को काम वर्णन गर्न, आन्तरिक पावर सप्लाईका भाग र यसले दिने भोल्टेज नाम लिन, hard disk को बनावट वर्णन गर्न र एउटा ब्लक कसरी पढिन्छ व्याख्या गर्न, र partitioning–drive lettering बुझाउन तथा quick र full formatting छुट्याउन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The CMOS memory that holds the settings and runs the clock needs power even when the machine is unplugged, and that comes from a small coin battery on the board. When it dies, everything CMOS remembers is lost each time mains power goes. It is a cheap part and a two-minute fix — but only if you read the symptom correctly instead of suspecting the disk.
items.ne: सेटिङ राख्ने र घडी चलाउने CMOS मेमोरीलाई मेसिन अनप्लग हुँदा पनि बिजुली चाहिन्छ, र त्यो बोर्डको सानो सिक्का ब्याट्रीबाट आउँछ। त्यो सकिएपछि मुख्य बिजुली जाँदा CMOS ले सम्झेको सबै हराउँछ। सस्तो पार्ट र दुई मिनेटको काम हो — तर लक्षण ठीक पढेमा मात्र, disk मा शंका गरेर होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: This is the practical reason the two format types are in the syllabus at all — the difference has consequences for privacy, not just for time taken.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रममा दुई किसिमको format राखिनुको व्यावहारिक कारण यही हो — फरकले समय मात्र होइन, गोपनीयतामा पनि असर पार्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Step 2 is where marks are lost. A cylinder is not one track — it is the same track number on every surface, so you must multiply by the number of surfaces. Miss that and your answer is four times too small.
items.ne: अंक चरण २ मै गुम्छ। Cylinder एउटा track होइन — हरेक सतहको उही नम्बरको track हो, त्यसैले सतह सङ्ख्याले गुणन गर्नैपर्छ। यो छुटे उत्तर चार गुणा सानो आउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying a quick format erases the data. It clears the index. The data stays on the platters until something overwrites it.
items.ne: Quick format ले data मेटाउँछ भन्नु। यसले सूची मात्र सफा गर्छ। कुनै कुराले नओभरराइट गरेसम्म data platter मै रहन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Treating a partition as a physical disk. C: and D: are very often two areas of one drive — if that drive fails, both go together.
items.ne: Partition लाई भौतिक डिस्क ठान्नु। C: र D: प्रायः एउटै ड्राइभका दुई क्षेत्र हुन् — ड्राइभ बिग्रिए दुवै सँगै जान्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Giving the extended partition a drive letter. It is a container. The logical drives inside it get the letters.
items.ne: Extended partition लाई ड्राइभ अक्षर दिनु। त्यो भाँडो हो। अक्षर त्यसभित्रका logical drive ले पाउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This is the heaviest unit for definitions — 12 hours and 9 marks — and it is where the practical exam gets its component questions. Expect list the functions of the BIOS (POST is always one of them), explain the construction and operation of a hard disk (track, sector, cylinder, head, and the three parts of access time), and differentiate questions on primary vs extended partition and quick vs full format. Be ready to label a motherboard diagram and to name the parts of an SMPS with its output voltages.
items.ne: परिभाषाका हिसाबले सबैभन्दा भारी युनिट यही हो — १२ घण्टा, ९ अंक — र व्यावहारिक परीक्षाका पार्ट्ससम्बन्धी प्रश्न यहीँबाट आउँछन्। BIOS का काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (POST सधैं एक हो), hard disk को बनावट र सञ्चालन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस् (track, sector, cylinder, head, र access time का तीन भाग), र primary–extended partition तथा quick–full format को फरक सोधिन्छ। मदरबोर्ड चित्रमा नाम लेख्न र SMPS का भाग तथा आउटपुट भोल्टेज भन्न तयार रहनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: BIOS (Basic Input Output System) is firmware held on a chip on the motherboard, and it is the first program to run when the computer is switched on. Its main functions are: POST (Power-On Self Test), which checks the essential hardware and reports failures by beep codes; the bootstrap loader, which locates the operating system and loads it into memory; BIOS drivers, which give low-level control of basic hardware before the operating system's own drivers are available; and CMOS setup, which lets the user view and change hardware settings such as boot order and system time.
items.ne: BIOS (Basic Input Output System) मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो, र कम्प्युटर खोल्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्ने प्रोग्राम यही हो। यसका मुख्य काम: POST (Power-On Self Test), जसले आवश्यक हार्डवेयर जाँच्छ र बिग्रिएमा बीप कोडले सुनाउँछ; bootstrap loader, जसले अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर मेमोरीमा लोड गर्छ; BIOS drivers, जसले OS का आफ्नै driver उपलब्ध हुनुअघि आधारभूत हार्डवेयरको तल्लो तहको नियन्त्रण दिन्छ; र CMOS setup, जसबाट boot order र समयजस्ता सेटिङ हेर्न र बदल्न मिल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A track is one concentric ring on the surface of a platter. A sector is one slice of a track and is the smallest unit that can be read or written. A cylinder is the set of tracks of the same number on all the platters taken together. Access time = seek time (moving the head to the correct track) + rotational delay (waiting for the sector to come round) + transfer time (reading or writing the data).
items.ne: Track भनेको platter को सतहमा भएको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ हो। Sector भनेको track को एउटा टुक्रा र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ हो। Cylinder भनेको सबै platter का उही नम्बरका track सँगै लिँदा बन्ने समूह हो। Access time = seek time (head लाई ठीक track मा लाने) + rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न पर्खने) + transfer time (data पढ्ने वा लेख्ने)।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A quick format only rewrites the file system index, so the partition reports itself as empty while the data physically remains on the disk until overwritten; it takes a few seconds. A full format also scans every sector for defects and marks any bad ones so they are not used, which takes much longer but gives a genuine check of the disk's condition.
items.ne: Quick format ले file system को सूची मात्र फेरि लेख्छ, त्यसैले partition खाली देखिन्छ तर data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा डिस्कमै रहन्छ; केही सेकेन्ड लाग्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ र बिग्रिएका sector चिन्ह लगाएर प्रयोग नगर्ने बनाउँछ — समय धेरै लाग्छ तर डिस्कको अवस्थाको साँचो जाँच हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A form factor fixes a board's size, mounting holes and port positions — ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX.
items.ne: Form factor ले बोर्डको आकार, स्क्रु प्वाल र पोर्टको स्थान तय गर्छ — ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: PCI is a local bus with expansion slots for add-on cards, and it is plug and play.
items.ne: PCI एउटा local bus हो, जसका expansion slot मा थप कार्ड राखिन्छ, र यो plug and play हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: An SMPS has a transformer, rectifier, filter, regulator and fan, and outputs +12 V, +5 V and +3.3 V.
items.ne: SMPS मा transformer, rectifier, filter, regulator र पंखा हुन्छन्, र +१२ V, +५ V तथा +३.३ V दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Access time = seek time + rotational delay + transfer time.
items.ne: Access time = seek time + rotational delay + transfer time।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Primary partitions boot; an extended partition holds logical drives and gets no letter itself. Quick format clears the index; full format also checks every sector.
items.ne: Primary partition बाट boot हुन्छ; extended partition ले logical drive राख्छ र आफैँ अक्षर पाउँदैन। Quick format ले सूची सफा गर्छ; full format ले हरेक sector पनि जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 3.2 The motherboard and its form factors
items.en: Why this matters: the practical exam can put a board in front of you and ask you to point at a component. Reading its name in a list is not the same skill as recognising it on a board — and the fault note attached to each part is what Unit 4 will ask you to reason with.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: व्यावहारिक परीक्षामा तपाईंअघि बोर्ड राखेर कुनै भाग देखाउन भन्न सकिन्छ। सूचीमा नाम पढ्नु र बोर्डमा चिन्नु एउटै सीप होइन — र हरेक भागसँग जोडिएको खराबीकै आधारमा युनिट ४ ले तर्क गर्न लगाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: BIOS is firmware on a motherboard chip. Its functions: POST, bootstrap loader, BIOS drivers, CMOS setup.
items.ne: BIOS मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो। काम: POST, bootstrap loader, BIOS drivers, CMOS setup।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording BIOS (Basic Input Output System) is firmware stored on a chip on the motherboard. It is the first program that runs when the machine is switched on — before any operating system exists in memory. Its four functions: 1. POST (Power-On Self Test) — checks that the essential hardware is present and working. If something fails, it reports with beep codes, because the screen may not be available yet. 2. Bootstrap loader — finds the operating system on a drive and loads it into memory. 3. BIOS drivers — low-level control of the basic hardware so the machine can work before the OS drivers load. 4. CMOS setup — the screen where boot order, time and hardware settings are changed. Those settings are kept in CMOS memory, powered by a small battery.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् BIOS (Basic Input Output System) मदरबोर्डको चिपमा राखिएको firmware हो। मेसिन खोल्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्ने प्रोग्राम यही हो — मेमोरीमा कुनै अपरेटिङ सिस्टम आउनुअघि नै। यसका चार काम: १. POST (Power-On Self Test) — आवश्यक हार्डवेयर छ र चलिरहेको छ कि जाँच्छ। केही बिग्रिए बीप कोड ले सुनाउँछ, किनकि स्क्रिन अझै उपलब्ध नहुन सक्छ। २. Bootstrap loader — ड्राइभमा अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर मेमोरीमा लोड गर्छ। ३. BIOS drivers — आधारभूत हार्डवेयरको तल्लो तहको नियन्त्रण, ताकि OS का driver लोड हुनुअघि पनि मेसिन चल्न सकोस्। ४. CMOS setup — boot order, समय र हार्डवेयर सेटिङ बदल्ने स्क्रिन। ती सेटिङ CMOS मेमोरीमा रहन्छन्, जसलाई सानो ब्याट्रीले चलाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 3.2 The motherboard and its form factors
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The motherboard is the main printed circuit board. Every other component either plugs into it or connects to it, and it carries the buses that let them communicate. A form factor is the standard that fixes a board's size, its mounting-hole positions, and where its ports and power connector sit. ATX is the common desktop standard; Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX are smaller versions with fewer slots. The form factor is why a replacement board is not simply "any board" — it must match the case it has to screw into and the power supply that has to feed it.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Motherboard मुख्य printed circuit board हो। अरू हरेक भाग या त यसमा जोडिन्छ या यससँग जडान हुन्छ, र तिनलाई कुरा गर्न दिने bus यसैले बोक्छ। Form factor भनेको बोर्डको आकार, स्क्रु प्वालको स्थान, र पोर्ट तथा power connector कहाँ पर्ने भन्ने तय गर्ने मानक हो। ATX सामान्य डेस्कटप मानक हो; Micro-ATX र Mini-ITX कम slot भएका साना संस्करण हुन्। Form factor कै कारण साट्ने बोर्ड "जुनसुकै बोर्ड" हुँदैन — यो अटाउने केस र बिजुली दिने पावर सप्लाई दुवैसँग मिल्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A bus is a set of parallel wires that carries data, addresses and control signals between components. PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) is a local bus — "local" meaning it runs close to the processor and at high speed, rather than out on a slow peripheral path. Its expansion slots take add-on cards: graphics, sound, network, additional ports. This is what makes a desktop upgradable — a capability the board does not have can be added as a card instead of replacing the whole machine. PCI cards are also plug and play: the system detects the card and allocates the resources it needs, instead of the user setting jumpers by hand.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Bus भनेको भागहरूबीच data, ठेगाना र नियन्त्रण सङ्केत बोक्ने समानान्तर तारहरूको समूह हो। PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) एउटा local bus हो — "local" भनेको यो ढिलो peripheral बाटोमा नभई प्रोसेसरको नजिक, उच्च गतिमा चल्छ। यसका expansion slot ले थप कार्ड लिन्छन्: graphics, sound, network, थप पोर्ट। डेस्कटप अपग्रेड गर्न मिल्ने यसैले हुन्छ — बोर्डमा नभएको क्षमता पूरै मेसिन साट्नुको साटो कार्ड थपेर ल्याउन सकिन्छ। PCI कार्ड plug and play पनि हुन्छन्: प्रयोगकर्ताले हातले jumper मिलाउनुपर्दैन, प्रणालीले कार्ड पत्ता लगाएर चाहिने साधन बाँडिदिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) converts the AC mains supply into the low DC voltages the components need, and it must do so cleanly and steadily. Its main parts: a transformer to change the voltage, a rectifier to convert AC into DC, a filter to smooth what is left of the ripple, a voltage regulator to hold each output steady as the load changes, and a cooling fan. The outputs: +12 V for motors and the processor circuits, +5 V and +3.3 V for the board's logic and the drives. A supply that is failing does not always die outright. It often produces voltages that are out of range under load, which shows up as random restarts and faults that move around — the hardest kind to diagnose.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) ले मुख्य AC बिजुलीलाई भागहरूलाई चाहिने कम DC भोल्टेजमा बदल्छ, र त्यो सफा तथा स्थिर हुनुपर्छ। यसका मुख्य भाग: भोल्टेज बदल्न transformer, AC लाई DC बनाउन rectifier, बाँकी ripple मिलाउन filter, भार बदलिँदा पनि हरेक आउटपुट स्थिर राख्न voltage regulator, र कुलिङ पंखा। आउटपुट: मोटर र प्रोसेसर परिपथका लागि +१२ V, बोर्डको लजिक र ड्राइभका लागि +५ V र +३.३ V। बिग्रँदै गएको सप्लाई सधैं एकैचोटि मर्दैन। भार पर्दा दायराबाहिरको भोल्टेज दिन्छ, जुन अनियमित रिस्टार्ट र ठाउँ बदलिरहने खराबीका रूपमा देखिन्छ — निदान गर्न सबैभन्दा गाह्रो किसिम।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A hard disk drive stores data magnetically on rigid rotating platters. Track — one concentric ring on a platter surface. Sector — one slice of a track, and the smallest unit that can be read or written. Cylinder — the same track number on every platter, taken together. Read-write head — mounted on an actuator arm, floating microns above the surface on a cushion of air. Access time is made of three parts added together: seek time (the arm moves to the right track), rotational delay (the disk turns until the sector arrives), and transfer time (the data is read). The head never touches the platter. When it does — from a knock while running — that is a head crash, and the damage is physical.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Hard disk drive ले घुम्ने कडा platter मा चुम्बकीय रूपमा data राख्छ। Track — platter सतहको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ। Sector — track को एउटा टुक्रा, र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ। Cylinder — हरेक platter को उही नम्बरको track सँगै लिँदा। Read-write head — actuator arm मा जडित, हावाको तकियामा सतहभन्दा माइक्रोन मात्र माथि तैरिने। Access time तीन भागको योग हो: seek time (arm ठीक track मा जाने), rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न डिस्क घुम्ने), र transfer time (data पढिने)। Head ले platter छुँदैन। चलिरहेको बेला धक्का लागेर छोयो भने त्यो head crash हो, र क्षति भौतिक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Partitioning divides one physical disk into separate areas that the operating system treats as independent drives. A primary partition can be booted from. An extended partition is a container that holds logical drives; the extended partition itself gets no drive letter. Drive lettering assigns C:, D:, E: and so on. Reasons to partition: separating the operating system from data so the OS can be reinstalled without losing files, running more than one OS, and keeping backups organised. Formatting writes a file system onto a partition so files can be stored. Quick format clears the index only — the data is still physically there until it is overwritten. Full format also scans every sector for defects, which is why it takes far longer.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Partitioning ले एउटै भौतिक डिस्कलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै क्षेत्रमा बाँड्छ, जसलाई अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले स्वतन्त्र ड्राइभ मान्छ। Primary partition बाट boot गर्न सकिन्छ। Extended partition भनेको logical drive राख्ने भाँडो हो; extended partition आफैँले ड्राइभ अक्षर पाउँदैन। Drive lettering ले C:, D:, E: आदि दिन्छ। Partition गर्ने कारण: अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई data बाट छुट्याउनु ताकि फाइल नगुमाई OS फेरि इन्स्टल गर्न सकियोस्, एकभन्दा बढी OS चलाउनु, र ब्याकअप व्यवस्थित राख्नु। Formatting ले partition मा file system लेख्छ ताकि फाइल राख्न सकियोस्। Quick format ले सूची मात्र मेटाउँछ — data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा त्यहीँ हुन्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले धेरै समय लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Quick format hides the data; full format checks the disk. BIOS is on the board, not the disk.
items.ne: Quick format ले data लुकाउँछ; full format ले disk जाँच्छ। BIOS बोर्डमा हुन्छ, disk मा होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: What is BIOS? List its main functions.
items.ne: BIOS के हो? यसका मुख्य काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Define track, sector and cylinder. State the three components of access time.
items.ne: Track, sector र cylinder को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। Access time का तीन भाग लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Differentiate between quick formatting and full formatting.
items.ne: Quick formatting र full formatting बीचको फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्।
