items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A computer shows the wrong date every time it is switched on, and the BIOS settings keep returning to default. What is the most likely cause? कम्प्युटर खोल्दा हरेक पटक गलत मिति देखिन्छ, र BIOS सेटिङ बारम्बार पूर्वनिर्धारितमा फर्किन्छ। सबैभन्दा सम्भावित कारण के हो? The hard disk is failing The CMOS battery is dead The operating system needs reinstalling The CMOS memory that holds the settings and runs the clock needs power even when the machine is unplugged, and that comes from a small coin battery on the board. When it dies, everything CMOS remembers is lost each time mains power goes. It is a cheap part and a two-minute fix — but only if you read the symptom correctly instead of suspecting the disk. सेटिङ राख्ने र घडी चलाउने CMOS मेमोरीलाई मेसिन अनप्लग हुँदा पनि बिजुली चाहिन्छ, र त्यो बोर्डको सानो सिक्का ब्याट्रीबाट आउँछ। त्यो सकिएपछि मुख्य बिजुली जाँदा CMOS ले सम्झेको सबै हराउँछ। सस्तो पार्ट र दुई मिनेटको काम हो — तर लक्षण ठीक पढेमा मात्र, disk मा शंका गरेर होइन। 3.2 The motherboard and its form factors Definition — learn this wording The motherboard is the main printed circuit board. Every other component either plugs into it or connects to it, and it carries the buses that let them communicate. A form factor is the standard that fixes a board's size, its mounting-hole positions, and where its ports and power connector sit. ATX is the common desktop standard; Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX are smaller versions with fewer slots. The form factor is why a replacement board is not simply "any board" — it must match the case it has to screw into and the power supply that has to feed it. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Motherboard मुख्य printed circuit board हो। अरू हरेक भाग या त यसमा जोडिन्छ या यससँग जडान हुन्छ, र तिनलाई कुरा गर्न दिने bus यसैले बोक्छ। Form factor भनेको बोर्डको आकार, स्क्रु प्वालको स्थान, र पोर्ट तथा power connector कहाँ पर्ने भन्ने तय गर्ने मानक हो। ATX सामान्य डेस्कटप मानक हो; Micro-ATX र Mini-ITX कम slot भएका साना संस्करण हुन्। Form factor कै कारण साट्ने बोर्ड "जुनसुकै बोर्ड" हुँदैन — यो अटाउने केस र बिजुली दिने पावर सप्लाई दुवैसँग मिल्नुपर्छ। Interactive experiment
items.ne: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Find each part of the board, and learn what it is blamed for What you will learn: where each major component sits on a motherboard, what it connects, and — for each one — the fault a technician most often traces back to it. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: मदरबोर्डमा हरेक प्रमुख भाग कहाँ पर्छ, के जोड्छ, र हरेकको हकमा टेक्निसियनले प्रायः त्यसैसँग जोड्ने खराबी कुन हो। {{dia:hwMotherboard}} Why this matters: the practical exam can put a board in front of you and ask you to point at a component. Reading its name in a list is not the same skill as recognising it on a board — and the fault note attached to each part is what Unit 4 will ask you to reason with.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: व्यावहारिक परीक्षामा तपाईंअघि बोर्ड राखेर कुनै भाग देखाउन भन्न सकिन्छ। सूचीमा नाम पढ्नु र बोर्डमा चिन्नु एउटै सीप होइन — र हरेक भागसँग जोडिएको खराबीकै आधारमा युनिट ४ ले तर्क गर्न लगाउँछ। 3.3 The PCI local bus Definition — learn this wording A bus is a set of parallel wires that carries data, addresses and control signals between components. PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) is a local bus — "local" meaning it runs close to the processor and at high speed, rather than out on a slow peripheral path. Its expansion slots take add-on cards: graphics, sound, network, additional ports. This is what makes a desktop upgradable — a capability the board does not have can be added as a card instead of replacing the whole machine. PCI cards are also plug and play: the system detects the card and allocates the resources it needs, instead of the user setting jumpers by hand. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Bus भनेको भागहरूबीच data, ठेगाना र नियन्त्रण सङ्केत बोक्ने समानान्तर तारहरूको समूह हो। PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) एउटा local bus हो — "local" भनेको यो ढिलो peripheral बाटोमा नभई प्रोसेसरको नजिक, उच्च गतिमा चल्छ। यसका expansion slot ले थप कार्ड लिन्छन्: graphics, sound, network, थप पोर्ट। डेस्कटप अपग्रेड गर्न मिल्ने यसैले हुन्छ — बोर्डमा नभएको क्षमता पूरै मेसिन साट्नुको साटो कार्ड थपेर ल्याउन सकिन्छ। PCI कार्ड plug and play पनि हुन्छन्: प्रयोगकर्ताले हातले jumper मिलाउनुपर्दैन, प्रणालीले कार्ड पत्ता लगाएर चाहिने साधन बाँडिदिन्छ। 3.4 The internal power supply Definition — learn this wording The SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) converts the AC mains supply into the low DC voltages the components need, and it must do so cleanly and steadily. Its main parts: a transformer to change the voltage, a rectifier to convert AC into DC, a filter to smooth what is left of the ripple, a voltage regulator to hold each output steady as the load changes, and a cooling fan. The outputs: +12 V for motors and the processor circuits, +5 V and +3.3 V for the board's logic and the drives. A supply that is failing does not always die outright. It often produces voltages that are out of range under load, which shows up as random restarts and faults that move around — the hardest kind to diagnose. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) ले मुख्य AC बिजुलीलाई भागहरूलाई चाहिने कम DC भोल्टेजमा बदल्छ, र त्यो सफा तथा स्थिर हुनुपर्छ। यसका मुख्य भाग: भोल्टेज बदल्न transformer, AC लाई DC बनाउन rectifier, बाँकी ripple मिलाउन filter, भार बदलिँदा पनि हरेक आउटपुट स्थिर राख्न voltage regulator, र कुलिङ पंखा। आउटपुट: मोटर र प्रोसेसर परिपथका लागि +१२ V, बोर्डको लजिक र ड्राइभका लागि +५ V र +३.३ V। बिग्रँदै गएको सप्लाई सधैं एकैचोटि मर्दैन। भार पर्दा दायराबाहिरको भोल्टेज दिन्छ, जुन अनियमित रिस्टार्ट र ठाउँ बदलिरहने खराबीका रूपमा देखिन्छ — निदान गर्न सबैभन्दा गाह्रो किसिम। 3.5 Hard disk construction and operation Definition — learn this wording A hard disk drive stores data magnetically on rigid rotating platters. Track — one concentric ring on a platter surface. Sector — one slice of a track, and the smallest unit that can be read or written. Cylinder — the same track number on every platter, taken together. Read-write head — mounted on an actuator arm, floating microns above the surface on a cushion of air. Access time is made of three parts added together: seek time (the arm moves to the right track), rotational delay (the disk turns until the sector arrives), and transfer time (the data is read). The head never touches the platter. When it does — from a knock while running — that is a head crash, and the damage is physical. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Hard disk drive ले घुम्ने कडा platter मा चुम्बकीय रूपमा data राख्छ। Track — platter सतहको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ। Sector — track को एउटा टुक्रा, र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ। Cylinder — हरेक platter को उही नम्बरको track सँगै लिँदा। Read-write head — actuator arm मा जडित, हावाको तकियामा सतहभन्दा माइक्रोन मात्र माथि तैरिने। Access time तीन भागको योग हो: seek time (arm ठीक track मा जाने), rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न डिस्क घुम्ने), र transfer time (data पढिने)। Head ले platter छुँदैन। चलिरहेको बेला धक्का लागेर छोयो भने त्यो head crash हो, र क्षति भौतिक हुन्छ। {{dia:hwHddRead}} Step through one read. "Explain the operation of a hard disk" is answered by this sequence, and the three parts of access time are usually worth a mark each. एउटा पढाइ चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस्। "Hard disk को सञ्चालन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको उत्तर यही क्रम हो, र access time का तीन भागको प्रायः एक–एक अंक हुन्छ। 3.6 Partitioning and formatting Definition — learn this wording Partitioning divides one physical disk into separate areas that the operating system treats as independent drives. A primary partition can be booted from. An extended partition is a container that holds logical drives; the extended partition itself gets no drive letter. Drive lettering assigns C:, D:, E: and so on. Reasons to partition: separating the operating system from data so the OS can be reinstalled without losing files, running more than one OS, and keeping backups organised. Formatting writes a file system onto a partition so files can be stored. Quick format clears the index only — the data is still physically there until it is overwritten. Full format also scans every sector for defects, which is why it takes far longer. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Partitioning ले एउटै भौतिक डिस्कलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै क्षेत्रमा बाँड्छ, जसलाई अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले स्वतन्त्र ड्राइभ मान्छ। Primary partition बाट boot गर्न सकिन्छ। Extended partition भनेको logical drive राख्ने भाँडो हो; extended partition आफैँले ड्राइभ अक्षर पाउँदैन। Drive lettering ले C:, D:, E: आदि दिन्छ। Partition गर्ने कारण: अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई data बाट छुट्याउनु ताकि फाइल नगुमाई OS फेरि इन्स्टल गर्न सकियोस्, एकभन्दा बढी OS चलाउनु, र ब्याकअप व्यवस्थित राख्नु। Formatting ले partition मा file system लेख्छ ताकि फाइल राख्न सकियोस्। Quick format ले सूची मात्र मेटाउँछ — data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा त्यहीँ हुन्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले धेरै समय लाग्छ। {{dia:hwPartition}} One disk, several drives. The extended partition is the box, not one of the drives inside it — a distinction that is regularly worth a mark. एउटै डिस्क, धेरै ड्राइभ। Extended partition भाँडो हो, त्यसभित्रको कुनै ड्राइभ होइन — यही भिन्नताको प्रायः अंक हुन्छ। Example 1 Choosing a format before handing on a disk Question: a school is donating old computers. A technician quick-formats the disks. Is the data safe from recovery? Step 1 — what did the quick format actually do? It rewrote the file system index, so the drive reports itself as empty. Step 2 — where is the data now? Still on the platters. Nothing overwrote the sectors that hold it; only the entries pointing at them were cleared. Step 3 — so can it be read back? Yes. Recovery software scans sectors directly rather than trusting the index, and will find most of it. Answer No. A quick format does not remove data. Use a full format, or a wipe utility that overwrites every sector. This is the practical reason the two format types are in the syllabus at all — the difference has consequences for privacy, not just for time taken. पाठ्यक्रममा दुई किसिमको format राखिनुको व्यावहारिक कारण यही हो — फरकले समय मात्र होइन, गोपनीयतामा पनि असर पार्छ। Example 2 Working out a disk's capacity from its geometry Question: a hard disk has 4 platter surfaces, 8192 cylinders, 63 sectors per track and 512 bytes per sector. What is its capacity? Step 1 — what does one track hold? 63 sectors × 512 bytes = 32,256 bytes. Step 2 — how many tracks are there in total? A cylinder is one track on every surface, so tracks = cylinders × surfaces = 8192 × 4 = 32,768 tracks. Step 3 — multiply. 32,768 × 32,256 = 1,056,964,608 bytes. Step 4 — convert. Divide by 1024 three times: ÷1024 = 1,032,192 KB, ÷1024 = 1008 MB, which is roughly 0.98 GB. Answer 1,056,964,608 bytes ≈ 1008 MB ≈ 0.98 GB Step 2 is where marks are lost. A cylinder is not one track — it is the same track number on every surface, so you must multiply by the number of surfaces. Miss that and your answer is four times too small. अंक चरण २ मै गुम्छ। Cylinder एउटा track होइन — हरेक सतहको उही नम्बरको track हो, त्यसैले सतह सङ्ख्याले गुणन गर्नैपर्छ। यो छुटे उत्तर चार गुणा सानो आउँछ। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying the BIOS is stored on the hard disk. It is firmware on a chip on the motherboard — it has to run before any disk is read. BIOS hard disk मा हुन्छ भन्नु। यो मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो — कुनै disk पढिनुअघि नै यो चल्नुपर्छ। Saying a quick format erases the data. It clears the index. The data stays on the platters until something overwrites it. Quick format ले data मेटाउँछ भन्नु। यसले सूची मात्र सफा गर्छ। कुनै कुराले नओभरराइट गरेसम्म data platter मै रहन्छ। Treating a partition as a physical disk. C: and D: are very often two areas of one drive — if that drive fails, both go together. Partition लाई भौतिक डिस्क ठान्नु। C: र D: प्रायः एउटै ड्राइभका दुई क्षेत्र हुन् — ड्राइभ बिग्रिए दुवै सँगै जान्छन्। Giving the extended partition a drive letter. It is a container. The logical drives inside it get the letters. Extended partition लाई ड्राइभ अक्षर दिनु। त्यो भाँडो हो। अक्षर त्यसभित्रका logical drive ले पाउँछन्। Quick format hides the data; full format checks the disk. BIOS is on the board, not the disk. Quick format ले data लुकाउँछ; full format ले disk जाँच्छ। BIOS बोर्डमा हुन्छ, disk मा होइन। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit This is the heaviest unit for definitions — 12 hours and 9 marks — and it is where the practical exam gets its component questions. Expect list the functions of the BIOS (POST is always one of them), explain the construction and operation of a hard disk (track, sector, cylinder, head, and the three parts of access time), and differentiate questions on primary vs extended partition and quick vs full format. Be ready to label a motherboard diagram and to name the parts of an SMPS with its output voltages. परिभाषाका हिसाबले सबैभन्दा भारी युनिट यही हो — १२ घण्टा, ९ अंक — र व्यावहारिक परीक्षाका पार्ट्ससम्बन्धी प्रश्न यहीँबाट आउँछन्। BIOS का काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (POST सधैं एक हो), hard disk को बनावट र सञ्चालन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस् (track, sector, cylinder, head, र access time का तीन भाग), र primary–extended partition तथा quick–full format को फरक सोधिन्छ। मदरबोर्ड चित्रमा नाम लेख्न र SMPS का भाग तथा आउटपुट भोल्टेज भन्न तयार रहनुहोस्। Q1 4 marks What is BIOS? List its main functions. BIOS के हो? यसका मुख्य काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस्। Show the answer BIOS (Basic Input Output System) is firmware held on a chip on the motherboard, and it is the first program to run when the computer is switched on. Its main functions are: POST (Power-On Self Test), which checks the essential hardware and reports failures by beep codes; the bootstrap loader, which locates the operating system and loads it into memory; BIOS drivers, which give low-level control of basic hardware before the operating system's own drivers are available; and CMOS setup, which lets the user view and change hardware settings such as boot order and system time. BIOS (Basic Input Output System) मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो, र कम्प्युटर खोल्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्ने प्रोग्राम यही हो। यसका मुख्य काम: POST (Power-On Self Test), जसले आवश्यक हार्डवेयर जाँच्छ र बिग्रिएमा बीप कोडले सुनाउँछ; bootstrap loader, जसले अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर मेमोरीमा लोड गर्छ; BIOS drivers, जसले OS का आफ्नै driver उपलब्ध हुनुअघि आधारभूत हार्डवेयरको तल्लो तहको नियन्त्रण दिन्छ; र CMOS setup, जसबाट boot order र समयजस्ता सेटिङ हेर्न र बदल्न मिल्छ। Q2 3 marks Define track, sector and cylinder. State the three components of access time. Track, sector र cylinder को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। Access time का तीन भाग लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer A track is one concentric ring on the surface of a platter. A sector is one slice of a track and is the smallest unit that can be read or written. A cylinder is the set of tracks of the same number on all the platters taken together. Access time = seek time (moving the head to the correct track) + rotational delay (waiting for the sector to come round) + transfer time (reading or writing the data). Track भनेको platter को सतहमा भएको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ हो। Sector भनेको track को एउटा टुक्रा र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ हो। Cylinder भनेको सबै platter का उही नम्बरका track सँगै लिँदा बन्ने समूह हो। Access time = seek time (head लाई ठीक track मा लाने) + rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न पर्खने) + transfer time (data पढ्ने वा लेख्ने)। Q3 2 marks Differentiate between quick formatting and full formatting. Quick formatting र full formatting बीचको फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्। Show the answer A quick format only rewrites the file system index, so the partition reports itself as empty while the data physically remains on the disk until overwritten; it takes a few seconds. A full format also scans every sector for defects and marks any bad ones so they are not used, which takes much longer but gives a genuine check of the disk's condition. Quick format ले file system को सूची मात्र फेरि लेख्छ, त्यसैले partition खाली देखिन्छ तर data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा डिस्कमै रहन्छ; केही सेकेन्ड लाग्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ र बिग्रिएका sector चिन्ह लगाएर प्रयोग नगर्ने बनाउँछ — समय धेरै लाग्छ तर डिस्कको अवस्थाको साँचो जाँच हुन्छ। Key points to revise
items.ne: — दोहोर्‍याउनुपर्ने मुख्य बुँदा

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Overview on System's Core
items.ne: प्रणालीको मुख्य भागको सिंहावलोकन

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 3.2 The motherboard and its form factors
items.en: What you will learn: where each major component sits on a motherboard, what it connects, and — for each one — the fault a technician most often traces back to it.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: मदरबोर्डमा हरेक प्रमुख भाग कहाँ पर्छ, के जोड्छ, र हरेकको हकमा टेक्निसियनले प्रायः त्यसैसँग जोड्ने खराबी कुन हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: If you change two things and the fault clears, you have no idea which one was responsible. You have not diagnosed anything, cannot document it, and cannot prevent the same fault returning. It is usually slower, not faster — the point is that the result means something.
items.ne: दुई कुरा बदल्दा खराबी हट्यो भने कुनले हटायो थाहै हुँदैन। तपाईंले केही निदान गर्नुभएन, अभिलेख राख्न सक्नुहुन्न, र उही खराबी फेरि आउन रोक्न सक्नुहुन्न। यो प्रायः छिटो होइन, ढिलो हुन्छ — कुरा नतिजाको अर्थ हुनु हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Beeping IS the POST reporting, so power reached the board and the BIOS started — the power path is already ruled out. It is beeping rather than displaying because the fault was found before video was initialised, which makes memory the first suspect. The OS and the disk are not read until much later.
items.ne: बीप गर्नु नै POST ले सुनाएको हो, त्यसैले बोर्डमा बिजुली पुग्यो र BIOS सुरु भयो — बिजुलीको बाटो पहिल्यै हट्यो। देखाउनुको साटो बीप गर्नुको कारण खराबी video सुरु हुनुअघि भेटियो, जसले मेमोरीलाई पहिलो शंका बनाउँछ। OS र disk धेरै पछि मात्र पढिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A readable message on screen proves video works, and the BIOS only reaches the point of looking for an operating system after POST has passed — so power, memory and video are all fine. What has NOT been proved is the disk: the message says the OS was not found, which is exactly what is still in question.
items.ne: स्क्रिनमा पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश आउनुले video चलेको प्रमाणित गर्छ, र POST पास भएपछि मात्र BIOS अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोज्ने चरणमा पुग्छ — त्यसैले बिजुली, मेमोरी र video ठीक छन्। प्रमाणित नभएको कुरा disk हो: सन्देशले OS भेटिएन भन्छ, र प्रश्न अझै त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The timing is the evidence. A fault present from the start would be slow immediately — too many startup programs is slow from boot. Something that only appears after the machine has warmed up, and appears sooner under load because load makes more heat, is thermal. The processor deliberately reduces its speed to protect itself.
items.ne: प्रमाण भनेको समय हो। सुरुदेखिको खराबी भए तुरुन्तै ढिलो हुन्थ्यो — startup मा धेरै प्रोग्राम भए boot देखि नै ढिलो हुन्छ। मेसिन तातेपछि मात्र देखिने, र भार पर्दा झन् चाँडो देखिने (किनकि भारले बढी ताप निकाल्छ) कुरा तापसम्बन्धी हो। प्रोसेसरले आफूलाई जोगाउन जानाजान गति घटाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A disproved theory sends you back to step 3, not forward. That loop is the part students leave out of the answer, and it is what separates diagnosis from guessing — you now know one more thing that is NOT the cause, which is real progress.
items.ne: गलत साबित भएको अनुमानले तपाईंलाई अगाडि होइन, चरण ३ मा फर्काउँछ। उत्तरमा विद्यार्थीले छुटाउने भाग यही हो, र निदान र अनुमानबीचको भिन्नता पनि यही — अब तपाईंलाई कारण होइन भन्ने एउटा कुरा थप थाहा भयो, जुन साँचो प्रगति हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Replacing parts to find the fault. Substituting a known-good part is a test; buying a new part on suspicion is not diagnosis, and the exam marks the method.
items.ne: खराबी खोज्न पार्ट साट्नु। चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको पार्ट राखेर हेर्नु परीक्षण हो; शंकामा नयाँ किन्नु निदान होइन, र परीक्षाले तरिकाको अंक दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The boot sequence, and the symptom you see if it stops at each stage.
items.ne: Boot को क्रम, र हरेक चरणमा रोकिए देखिने लक्षण।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: POWER ON. The supply delivers +12 V, +5 V and +3.3 V and the fans start. If nothing at all happens — no lights, no fan — it never got this far, and the fault is in the power path.
items.ne: POWER ON। सप्लाईले +१२ V, +५ V र +३.३ V दिन्छ र पंखा सुरु हुन्छ। केही पनि नभएमा — बत्ती छैन, पंखा छैन — यो यहाँसम्म पुगेकै छैन, र खराबी बिजुलीको बाटोमा छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: POST — the Power-On Self Test. The BIOS checks the essential hardware. Because video is not ready yet, it reports a failure by BEEPING. Fans running plus beeps means power is already proved good.
items.ne: POST — Power-On Self Test। BIOS ले आवश्यक हार्डवेयर जाँच्छ। Video अझै तयार नभएकाले खराबी बीप गरेर सुनाउँछ। पंखा घुम्नु र बीप हुनुले बिजुली ठीक छ भन्ने पहिल्यै प्रमाणित गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: BIOS reads its stored settings from CMOS — the time, and the boot order. A dead CMOS battery shows here: "CMOS checksum error", and a clock that resets on every start.
items.ne: BIOS ले CMOS बाट भण्डारित सेटिङ पढ्छ — समय, र boot order। मरेको CMOS ब्याट्री यहीँ देखिन्छ: "CMOS checksum error", र हरेक पटक सुरु हुँदा फर्किने घडी।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: It now looks for a bootable drive in the order the BIOS lists, and reads its boot sector. Failing here gives a MESSAGE ON SCREEN — which itself proves POST passed and video works.
items.ne: अब BIOS ले तोकेको क्रममा boot हुने ड्राइभ खोज्छ र त्यसको boot sector पढ्छ। यहाँ असफल भए स्क्रिनमा सन्देश आउँछ — र त्यही सन्देशले POST पास भयो र video चल्छ भन्ने प्रमाणित गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The bootstrap loader hands control to the operating system, which loads its drivers. A logo followed by a freeze, a crash or a restart loop is a fault at this stage — the hardware has already done its job.
items.ne: Bootstrap loader ले नियन्त्रण अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई सुम्पिन्छ, जसले आफ्ना driver लोड गर्छ। लोगोपछि अड्किनु, बन्द हुनु वा बारम्बार रिस्टार्ट हुनु यही चरणको खराबी हो — हार्डवेयरले आफ्नो काम गरिसक्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The desktop appears. Anything slow or unstable from here on is software, drivers or heat — every piece of hardware has already proved itself by getting you this far.
items.ne: डेस्कटप देखिन्छ। यहाँदेखि उता ढिलो वा अस्थिर हुनु सफ्टवेयर, driver वा तापको कुरा हो — यहाँसम्म ल्याएरै हरेक हार्डवेयरले आफूलाई प्रमाणित गरिसक्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: And this is the whole of diagnosis in one line. Find the last stage it completed; everything after that stage is ruled out without a single tool.
items.ne: र पूरै निदान यही एउटा वाक्यमा छ। पूरा भएको अन्तिम चरण पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्; त्यसपछिका सबै चरण कुनै औजारबिनै हट्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Six steps, always in this order. The loop back from step 4 to step 3 is the part students leave out — and it is what separates diagnosis from guessing.
items.ne: छ चरण, सधैं यही क्रममा। चरण ४ बाट ३ मा फर्किने बाटो विद्यार्थीले छुटाउने भाग हो — र निदान र अनुमानबीचको भिन्नता यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Step through it once before reading on. Each stage carries the symptom you see if the machine stops there — so this is not a picture of booting, it is the diagnostic map, walked forwards.
items.ne: पढ्नुअघि एक पटक चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस्। हरेक चरणले त्यहीँ रोकिए देखिने लक्षण बोक्छ — त्यसैले यो boot हुने चित्र मात्र होइन, अगाडिबाट हिँडेको निदान नक्सा हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Apply a diagnostic sequence to a specific component that is suspected of failing.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: टेक्निसियनले पालना गर्ने सामान्य सिद्धान्त — एकपटकमा एउटा मात्र कुरा बदल्नेसहित — भन्न, troubleshooting का चरण क्रमैसँग सूचीबद्ध गर्न र हरेक चरणले के दिन्छ बताउन, अनुमान नगरी boot समस्यालाई लक्षणबाट कारणसम्म पुर्‍याउन, सामान्य boot त्रुटि सन्देश र बीप कोड बुझ्न, प्रणाली ढिलो हुनुका सामान्य कारण र तिनलाई छुट्याउने तरिका भन्न, र बिग्रेको शंका गरिएको कुनै भागमा निदान क्रम लागू गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Beeping is the POST reporting. It only happens once power has reached the board and the BIOS is running — so the power supply, the switch and the mains are all already ruled out. And it is beeping rather than displaying because the fault was found before video was initialised, which is why memory is the first suspect. The operating system is nowhere near loading yet.
items.ne: बीप गर्नु नै POST ले सुनाएको हो। बोर्डसम्म बिजुली पुगेर BIOS चलेपछि मात्र यो हुन्छ — त्यसैले पावर सप्लाई, स्विच र मुख्य लाइन सबै पहिल्यै हट्छन्। र देखाउनुको साटो बीप गर्नुको कारण खराबी video सुरु हुनअघि भेटियो — त्यसैले पहिलो शंका मेमोरीमा जान्छ। अपरेटिङ सिस्टम लोड हुने अवस्था नजिकै छैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: POST failed before video
items.ne: Video अघि नै POST असफल

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: RAM seating, then the RAM itself
items.ne: RAM को बसाइ, अनि RAM आफैँ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: POST passed — this is normal
items.ne: POST पास — यो सामान्य हो

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: Nothing. Look past POST.
items.ne: केही होइन। POST पछाडि हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: POST passed; no bootable drive was located
items.ne: POST पास; boot हुने ड्राइभ भेटिएन

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: Boot order in BIOS, then the drive's data cable
items.ne: BIOS को boot order, अनि ड्राइभको data केबल

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: The drive was found; the OS on it was not
items.ne: ड्राइभ भेटियो; त्यसको OS भेटिएन

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: Boot sector or a damaged OS installation
items.ne: Boot sector वा बिग्रिएको OS

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: Stored BIOS settings are lost or corrupt
items.ne: भण्डारित BIOS सेटिङ हराए वा बिग्रिए

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: The CMOS battery
items.ne: CMOS ब्याट्री

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: The boot drive could not be read
items.ne: Boot ड्राइभ पढ्न सकिएन

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes
items.en: Cable, then the drive's health
items.ne: केबल, अनि ड्राइभको अवस्था

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Before reading on, answer one question: what has the message already proved is working?
items.ne: पढ्नुअघि एउटा प्रश्नको उत्तर दिनुहोस्: यो सन्देशले के चलिरहेको छ भनी पहिल्यै प्रमाणित गरिसक्यो?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Notice that no part was replaced and nothing was guessed. Step 1 removed most of the machine from suspicion and step 2 supplied the theory — the actual repair took thirty seconds.
items.ne: ध्यान दिनुहोस्, कुनै पार्ट साटिएन र केही अनुमान गरिएन। चरण १ ले मेसिनको ठूलो हिस्सालाई शंकाबाट हटायो र चरण २ ले अनुमान दियो — वास्तविक मर्मत तीस सेकेन्डको थियो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: "It is slow" is not a symptom. "It is slow after twenty minutes" is. Most of the work in this unit is turning the first sentence into the second.
items.ne: "ढिलो छ" लक्षण होइन। "बीस मिनेटपछि ढिलो हुन्छ" लक्षण हो। यस युनिटको धेरैजसो काम पहिलो वाक्यलाई दोस्रोमा बदल्नु नै हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Changing two things at once. If the fault clears you have no idea which change did it, so you have not learned anything and cannot prevent a repeat.
items.ne: एकैचोटि दुई कुरा बदल्नु। खराबी हट्यो भने कुनले हटायो थाहै हुँदैन, त्यसैले केही सिकिँदैन र फेरि हुन रोक्न पनि सकिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Skipping "ask the user what changed". It is a step in the method and it is free. Most faults follow a change the user can name.
items.ne: "के बदलियो?" सोध्ने चरण छोड्नु। यो विधिकै एउटा चरण हो र निःशुल्क छ। धेरैजसो खराबी प्रयोगकर्ताले नाम लिन सक्ने परिवर्तनपछि आउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Reinstalling the operating system for a hardware symptom. If the screen is blank before any OS could load, the OS cannot be the cause — and reinstalling destroys the user's data for nothing.
items.ne: हार्डवेयरको लक्षणमा अपरेटिङ सिस्टम फेरि इन्स्टल गर्नु। कुनै OS लोड हुनुअघि नै स्क्रिन खाली छ भने OS कारण हुनै सक्दैन — र फेरि इन्स्टल गर्दा प्रयोगकर्ताको data बेकारमा नष्ट हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit carries 9 marks in the written paper and is most of what the practical exam actually tests. The written questions are predictable: list the steps of troubleshooting (in order — the order is the answer), what would you check if… given a symptom, and state the causes of a slow system or a boot failure. The examiner is looking for a sequence of checks with reasons, not a single guessed cause. Write the order you would work in and say what each check rules out; that is where the marks are.
items.ne: यो युनिटले लिखित परीक्षामा ९ अंक बोक्छ र व्यावहारिक परीक्षाले जाँच्ने कुराको ठूलो हिस्सा यही हो। लिखित प्रश्न अनुमान गर्न सकिने खालका छन्: troubleshooting का चरण सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (क्रमैसँग — क्रम नै उत्तर हो), लक्षण दिएर के जाँच्नुहुन्छ, र ढिलो प्रणाली वा boot असफलताका कारण लेख्नुहोस्। परीक्षकले अनुमान गरिएको एउटा कारण होइन, कारणसहितको जाँच क्रम खोज्छ। तपाईं कुन क्रममा काम गर्नुहुन्छ लेख्नुहोस् र हरेक जाँचले के हटाउँछ भन्नुहोस्; अंक त्यहीँ छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: 1. Identify the problem — state exactly what happens and when. 2. Gather information — ask the user what changed. 3. Establish a theory of probable cause — the most likely cause consistent with the symptom. 4. Test the theory, changing one thing at a time; if it is disproved, return to step 3. 5. Apply the fix and verify the original symptom has gone. 6. Document the symptom, the cause and the solution.
items.ne: १. समस्या पहिचान — के हुन्छ र कहिले हुन्छ ठ्याक्कै भन्ने। २. जानकारी सङ्कलन — प्रयोगकर्तालाई के बदलियो सोध्ने। ३. सम्भावित कारणको अनुमान — लक्षणसँग मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सम्भावित कारण। ४. अनुमानको परीक्षण, एकपटकमा एउटा कुरा बदलेर; गलत साबित भए चरण ३ मा फर्किने। ५. समाधान लागू गरी सुरुको लक्षण हट्यो कि पुष्टि गर्ने। ६. लक्षण, कारण र समाधानको अभिलेख राख्ने।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Work from the cheapest check outward. First confirm the monitor has power and the video cable is firm at both ends, and try a monitor known to work — this rules out the display path. Then listen at power-on: repeated beeps mean POST found a fault before video was available, which points to memory. Power off, unplug, and reseat the RAM modules one at a time until the clips close. If the beeps continue with a module known to be good, the slot or the board is at fault. Change only one thing at a time, and verify the display returns before closing the case.
items.ne: सबैभन्दा सस्तो जाँचबाट बाहिरतिर बढ्नुहोस्। पहिले monitor मा बिजुली छ र video केबल दुवै छेउमा कसिएको छ पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्, र चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको monitor जोडेर हेर्नुहोस् — यसले display को बाटो हटाउँछ। अनि बिजुली लाग्दा सुन्नुहोस्: बारम्बार बीप भनेको video उपलब्ध हुनुअघि POST ले खराबी भेट्यो, जसले मेमोरीतिर देखाउँछ। बिजुली बन्द गरी प्लग निकाली क्लिप बन्द नहुन्जेल RAM एक–एक गरी फेरि बसाल्नुहोस्। चल्ने मोड्युल राख्दा पनि बीप जारी रहे slot वा बोर्डमा खराबी छ। एकपटकमा एउटा मात्र कुरा बदल्नुहोस्, र केस बन्द गर्नुअघि स्क्रिन फर्कियो कि पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Causes: insufficient RAM; too many programs loading at startup; a nearly full or fragmented hard disk; malware infection; overheating causing the processor to reduce its speed. Overheating is told apart by its timing — the machine is normal when first switched on and only becomes slow after it has been running for a while, and sooner when a demanding program is open. The other causes are slow from the start.
items.ne: कारण: RAM अपुग; startup मा धेरै प्रोग्राम लोड हुनु; hard disk झन्डै भरिनु वा टुक्रिनु; malware सङ्क्रमण; तात्दा प्रोसेसरले गति घटाउनु। तात्ने समस्या समयले छुट्टिन्छ — खोल्दा सामान्य हुन्छ र केही बेर चलेपछि मात्र ढिलो हुन्छ, र भारी प्रोग्राम खोले झन् चाँडो। अरू कारणमा सुरुदेखि नै ढिलो हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Cheapest check first; change one thing at a time; never diagnose by buying parts.
items.ne: सस्तो जाँच पहिले; एकपटकमा एउटा परिवर्तन; पार्ट किनेर निदान कहिल्यै नगर्ने।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The symptom tells you how far the boot got, and that rules out everything after it. Beeps mean POST is running and video is not yet available.
items.ne: Boot कहाँसम्म पुग्यो लक्षणले भन्छ, र त्यसपछिका सबै सम्भावना हट्छन्। बीप भनेको POST चलिरहेको र video अझै नआएको।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: "No boot device" points at boot order and cables; "CMOS checksum error" points at the battery.
items.ne: "No boot device" ले boot order र केबलतिर देखाउँछ; "CMOS checksum error" ले ब्याट्रीतिर।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Slowdowns: too little RAM, too many startup programs, a full or fragmented disk, malware, or overheating — which is the one identified by its timing.
items.ne: ढिलो हुनु: RAM कम, startup मा धेरै प्रोग्राम, डिस्क भरिएको वा टुक्रिएको, malware, वा तात्ने — जुन समयले चिनिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Read a symptom, decide how far the boot reached, and name what that rules out
items.ne: लक्षण पढ्नुहोस्, boot कहाँसम्म पुग्यो निर्णय गर्नुहोस्, र त्यसले के हटाउँछ भन्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A boot symptom tells you the last stage the machine completed, and everything AFTER that stage is ruled out. No power at all = power path. Fans but beeps and no video = POST is running, so power is fine and video was not ready — memory first. A message on screen = POST passed, so all the hardware POST checks are fine and the problem is finding or loading the operating system. The OS starting and then failing = hardware and boot sector are fine; the fault is software.
items.ne: Boot को लक्षणले मेसिनले पूरा गरेको अन्तिम चरण बताउँछ, र त्यस चरणपछिका सबै सम्भावना हट्छन्। बिजुली नै छैन = बिजुलीको बाटो। पंखा घुम्छ तर बीप र video छैन = POST चलिरहेको, त्यसैले बिजुली ठीक र video तयार थिएन — पहिले मेमोरी। स्क्रिनमा सन्देश = POST पास, त्यसैले POST ले जाँच्ने सबै हार्डवेयर ठीक र समस्या अपरेटिङ सिस्टम भेट्न वा लोड गर्नमा। OS सुरु भएर बिग्रिनु = हार्डवेयर र boot sector ठीक; खराबी सफ्टवेयरमा।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A computer shows no lights and no fan movement at all when the power button is pressed. How far did it get, and what does that rule out?
items.ne: पावर बटन थिच्दा कम्प्युटरमा कुनै बत्ती र पंखाको चाल देखिँदैन। यो कहाँसम्म पुग्यो, र त्यसले के हटाउँछ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Did the machine receive power at all? Answer yes or no
items.ne: मेसिनमा बिजुली आयो कि आएन? yes वा no

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: No lights and no fans means nothing electrical started. Power never reached the board.
items.ne: बत्ती छैन, पंखा छैन भनेको कुनै विद्युतीय काम सुरु नै भएन। बोर्डसम्म बिजुली पुगेन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Did POST run? Answer yes or no
items.ne: POST चल्यो? yes वा no

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: POST is a program on the board. With no power reaching the board, nothing can run — so POST is not a suspect and neither is memory.
items.ne: POST बोर्डको प्रोग्राम हो। बोर्डमा बिजुली नै नपुगेपछि केही चल्न सक्दैन — त्यसैले POST पनि शंकास्पद होइन, मेमोरी पनि होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: So which single area do you check? Answer power, memory, disk or software
items.ne: त्यसैले कुन एउटा क्षेत्र जाँच्नुहुन्छ? power, memory, disk वा software

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Everything after power is ruled out because nothing after power got a chance to happen. Check the wall socket, the cable, the switch at the back of the supply, and then the supply itself.
items.ne: बिजुलीपछिका सबै कुरा हट्छन्, किनकि बिजुलीपछि केही हुने मौकै भएन। भित्ताको सकेट, केबल, सप्लाई पछाडिको स्विच, अनि सप्लाई आफैँ जाँच्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Area to check
items.ne: जाँच्ने क्षेत्र

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: It reached nothing at all, so the fault is in the power path and every later stage is ruled out. Notice what this saves you: there is no point testing RAM, the disk or the operating system, because none of them was ever reached.
items.ne: यो कतै पुगेन, त्यसैले खराबी बिजुलीको बाटोमा छ र पछिका सबै चरण हट्छन्। यसले के बचायो हेर्नुहोस्: RAM, disk वा अपरेटिङ सिस्टम जाँच्नुको कुनै अर्थ छैन, किनकि तीमध्ये कुनैसम्म पुगिएकै थिएन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A computer powers on, the fans run, and it beeps in a repeating pattern with a black screen. How far did it get, and which area do you check?
items.ne: कम्प्युटरमा बिजुली आउँछ, पंखा घुम्छ, र कालो स्क्रिनसहित दोहोरिने ढाँचामा बीप गर्छ। यो कहाँसम्म पुग्यो, र कुन क्षेत्र जाँच्नुहुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Did POST run? Answer yes or no
items.ne: POST चल्यो? yes वा no

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The beeping IS the POST reporting. It can only beep if power reached the board and the BIOS started — so power is already ruled out.
items.ne: बीप गर्नु नै POST ले सुनाएको हो। बोर्डमा बिजुली पुगेर BIOS सुरु भएमा मात्र बीप हुन्छ — त्यसैले बिजुली पहिल्यै हट्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which single area do you check first? Answer power, memory, disk or software
items.ne: पहिले कुन एउटा क्षेत्र जाँच्नुहुन्छ? power, memory, disk वा software

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: It is reporting by sound rather than on screen, which means the fault was found BEFORE video was initialised. Memory is tested that early in the POST, so it is the first suspect.
items.ne: यसले स्क्रिनमा होइन आवाजमा सुनाइरहेको छ — अर्थात् खराबी video सुरु हुनअघि भेटियो। POST मा मेमोरी त्यति नै चाँडो जाँचिन्छ, त्यसैले पहिलो शंका त्यहीँ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Area to check
items.ne: जाँच्ने क्षेत्र

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Beeps mean POST is running, so power is fine; a black screen at that moment means video was not ready yet, which puts memory first. If you answered "power", re-read the symptom — fans running is already proof that power arrived.
items.ne: बीप भनेको POST चलिरहेको, त्यसैले बिजुली ठीक छ; त्यही बेला कालो स्क्रिन भनेको video अझै तयार थिएन, जसले मेमोरीलाई पहिलो बनाउँछ। "power" भन्नुभयो भने लक्षण फेरि पढ्नुहोस् — पंखा घुम्नु नै बिजुली आइपुगेको प्रमाण हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A computer shows the manufacturer logo, then the message "Operating system not found". How far did it get, and which area do you check?
items.ne: कम्प्युटरमा कम्पनीको लोगो देखिन्छ, अनि "Operating system not found" सन्देश आउँछ। यो कहाँसम्म पुग्यो, र कुन क्षेत्र जाँच्नुहुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Did POST pass? Answer yes or no
items.ne: POST पास भयो? yes वा no

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A logo and a readable message on screen mean video is working and the BIOS finished its checks. POST passed, so memory, video and the power path are all ruled out.
items.ne: स्क्रिनमा लोगो र पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश आउनुले video चलिरहेको र BIOS ले जाँच सकेको जनाउँछ। POST पास भयो, त्यसैले मेमोरी, video र बिजुलीको बाटो सबै हट्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which single area do you check? Answer power, memory, disk or software
items.ne: कुन एउटा क्षेत्र जाँच्नुहुन्छ? power, memory, disk वा software

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The BIOS got far enough to look for an operating system and could not find one. That points at the boot drive: the boot order in BIOS, the data cable, or a damaged boot sector.
items.ne: BIOS अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोज्ने चरणसम्म पुग्यो तर भेटेन। यसले boot ड्राइभतिर देखाउँछ: BIOS को boot order, data केबल, वा बिग्रेको boot sector।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Area to check
items.ne: जाँच्ने क्षेत्र

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A message ON the screen is proof POST passed, and that alone rules out most of the hardware. The fault is in finding or loading the operating system, which means the drive, its cable or the boot order.
items.ne: स्क्रिनमा सन्देश आउनु POST पास भएको प्रमाण हो, र त्यति एक्लैले धेरैजसो हार्डवेयर हटाउँछ। खराबी अपरेटिङ सिस्टम भेट्न वा लोड गर्नमा छ — अर्थात् ड्राइभ, यसको केबल वा boot order।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A computer boots to the desktop normally, then freezes about a minute later. It does this every time. Which single area do you check — power, memory, disk or software?
items.ne: कम्प्युटर सामान्य रूपमा डेस्कटपसम्म आउँछ, अनि करिब एक मिनेटपछि अड्किन्छ। हरेक पटक यसै हुन्छ। कुन एउटा क्षेत्र जाँच्नुहुन्छ — power, memory, disk वा software?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Area to check
items.ne: जाँच्ने क्षेत्र

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The machine completed every hardware stage, so the symptom itself rules the hardware out. Check startup programs, recently installed drivers and updates, and scan for malware — booting into safe mode is the standard test, because it loads almost none of them.
items.ne: मेसिनले हार्डवेयरका सबै चरण पूरा गर्‍यो, त्यसैले लक्षणले नै हार्डवेयर हटाउँछ। Startup प्रोग्राम, भर्खर राखिएका driver र अपडेट जाँच्नुहोस्, र malware स्क्यान गर्नुहोस् — safe mode मा boot गर्नु मानक परीक्षण हो, किनकि त्यसले तीमध्ये झन्डै कुनै पनि लोड गर्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A printer prints the first two pages of every job correctly and then stops, on any document. Apply the same reasoning: two good pages rule out the driver, the cable and the printer, because none of those could work twice and then fail. So what kind of cause is left — a capacity limit, a driver, or a cable? Answer in one word.
items.ne: एउटा प्रिन्टरले हरेक कामको पहिलो दुई पाना ठीकसँग छाप्छ अनि रोकिन्छ — जुनसुकै कागजातमा। उही तर्क लगाउनुहोस्: दुई पाना ठीक आउनुले driver, केबल र प्रिन्टरलाई हटाउँछ, किनकि तीमध्ये कुनै पनि दुई पटक चलेर अनि बिग्रिन सक्दैन। त्यसो भए कस्तो कारण बाँकी रह्यो — capacity, driver कि cable? एक शब्दमा उत्तर दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Kind of cause
items.ne: कारणको किसिम

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The rule transferred: "how far did it get" is not about booting — it is about reading a partial success as evidence. Two good pages rule out the driver, the cable and the printer itself, because none of those could work twice and then fail. What is left is something that runs out: printer memory, or a spooler that cannot hold the rest of the job.
items.ne: नियम सर्‍यो: "कहाँसम्म पुग्यो" भन्नु boot कै कुरा होइन — आंशिक सफलतालाई प्रमाणका रूपमा पढ्नु हो। दुई पाना ठीक आउनुले driver, केबल र प्रिन्टर आफैँलाई हटाउँछ, किनकि तीमध्ये कुनै पनि दुई पटक चलेर अनि बिग्रिन सक्दैन। बाँकी रहन्छ — सकिने कुरा: प्रिन्टरको मेमोरी, वा बाँकी काम राख्न नसक्ने spooler।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: the practical exam does not ask you to recite the six steps — it puts a symptom in front of you and watches the order you work in. A correct diagnosis reached by opening the case first is still a bad answer, because it is not repeatable.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: व्यावहारिक परीक्षाले छ चरण घोकेर सुनाउन भन्दैन — लक्षण अगाडि राखेर तपाईं कुन क्रममा काम गर्नुहुन्छ हेर्छ। पहिले केस खोलेर पुगेको सही निदान पनि नराम्रो उत्तर हो, किनकि त्यो दोहोर्‍याउन मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: reading a worked diagnosis feels like learning and is not. The only way to find out whether you can do it is to be given a symptom with the working removed.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: गरिसकेको निदान पढ्दा सिकेजस्तो लाग्छ, तर सिकिँदैन। आफूले गर्न सक्छु कि सक्दिनँ भन्ने थाहा पाउने एउटै तरिका छ — काम हटाइएको लक्षण दिइनु।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Steps: identify, gather information, form a theory, test it, fix and verify, document. A failed test sends you back to forming a theory, not to swapping parts.
items.ne: चरण: पहिचान, जानकारी सङ्कलन, अनुमान, परीक्षण, समाधान र पुष्टि, अभिलेख। परीक्षण असफल भए पार्ट साट्न होइन, अनुमान बनाउनतिरै फर्किने।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The principles a technician works by Check the simplest and cheapest thing first. A loose cable costs five seconds to rule out; an opened case costs twenty minutes and a risk of damage. Change one thing at a time. Change two and the fault goes away, you no longer know which change fixed it — and you cannot prevent it happening again. Work from the symptom, not from a hunch. The symptom already tells you how far the machine got before it stopped, which rules out everything that happens later. Do not replace parts to diagnose. Substituting a known-good part is a legitimate test; buying a new one because you suspect it is not. Observe safety. Power off and unplug before opening a case. Never work inside a power supply or a CRT monitor — both store dangerous charge after being unplugged.
items.ne: टेक्निसियनले पालना गर्ने सिद्धान्त सबैभन्दा सजिलो र सस्तो कुरा पहिले जाँच्नुहोस्। खुकुलो केबल हटाउन पाँच सेकेन्ड लाग्छ; केस खोल्न बीस मिनेट र बिगार्ने जोखिम। एकपटकमा एउटा मात्र कुरा बदल्नुहोस्। दुई बदल्दा खराबी हट्यो भने कुनले मिलायो थाहा हुँदैन — र फेरि हुन नदिन पनि सकिँदैन। अनुमानबाट होइन, लक्षणबाट काम गर्नुहोस्। मेसिन रोकिनुअघि कहाँसम्म पुगेको थियो भन्ने लक्षणले नै बताउँछ, र त्यसपछि हुने सबै कुरा हट्छ। निदानका लागि पार्ट नसाट्नुहोस्। चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको पार्ट राखेर हेर्नु वैध परीक्षण हो; शंकाकै भरमा नयाँ किन्नु होइन। सुरक्षा अपनाउनुहोस्। केस खोल्नुअघि बिजुली बन्द गरी प्लग निकाल्नुहोस्। पावर सप्लाई र CRT monitor भित्र कहिल्यै काम नगर्नुहोस् — प्लग निकालेपछि पनि दुवैमा खतरनाक चार्ज जम्मा रहन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What each step produces 1. Identify the problem — a precise statement of what happens and when. "It does not work" is not one; "it powers on, fans spin, screen stays black" is. 2. Gather information — ask the user what changed. New hardware, a storm, a move, a spill, an update. Most faults have a cause the user can tell you about. 3. Establish a theory of probable cause — the most likely cause consistent with the symptom, not every possible cause. 4. Test the theory — one check, one change. If the test disproves the theory, go back to step 3 and form a new one. Do not start swapping parts. 5. Apply the fix and verify — confirm the original symptom is actually gone, and that nothing else broke while you were working. 6. Document — what the symptom was, what caused it, what fixed it. This is what makes the second occurrence quick.
items.ne: हरेक चरणले के दिन्छ १. समस्या पहिचान — के हुन्छ र कहिले हुन्छ भन्ने ठ्याक्कै कथन। "चल्दैन" कथन होइन; "बिजुली आउँछ, पंखा घुम्छ, स्क्रिन कालै रहन्छ" कथन हो। २. जानकारी सङ्कलन — प्रयोगकर्तालाई के बदलियो सोध्नुहोस्। नयाँ हार्डवेयर, चट्याङ, सारेको, पानी खसेको, अपडेट। धेरैजसो खराबीको कारण प्रयोगकर्ताले नै बताउन सक्छ। ३. सम्भावित कारणको अनुमान बनाउनुहोस् — लक्षणसँग मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सम्भावित कारण, हरेक सम्भावित कारण होइन। ४. अनुमान परीक्षण — एउटा जाँच, एउटा परिवर्तन। परीक्षणले अनुमान गलत साबित गरे चरण ३ मा फर्किनुहोस् र नयाँ बनाउनुहोस्। पार्ट साट्न नथाल्नुहोस्। ५. समाधान लागू गरी पुष्टि — सुरुको लक्षण साँच्चै हट्यो कि, र काम गर्दा अरू केही बिग्रियो कि जाँच्नुहोस्। ६. अभिलेख — लक्षण के थियो, कारण के थियो, केले मिलायो। दोस्रो पटक छिटो हुनुको कारण यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Read how far it got A boot problem is diagnosed by asking how far the machine reached before it stopped. Each stage rules out everything after it. Nothing at all — no lights, no fans. Power is not arriving: mains, cable, switch, power supply. Fans spin, screen black, beeps — power is fine and POST is running. The BIOS found a fault before video was available; memory is the usual cause. Manufacturer logo, then an error message — POST passed. The hardware is working and the problem is with finding or loading the operating system. OS starts, then fails — hardware and boot sector are fine. The fault is in the operating system, a driver, or software.
items.ne: कहाँसम्म पुग्यो पढ्नुहोस् Boot समस्याको निदान मेसिन रोकिनुअघि कहाँसम्म पुग्यो भनेर गरिन्छ। हरेक चरणले त्यसपछिका सबै सम्भावना हटाउँछ। केही पनि छैन — बत्ती छैन, पंखा छैन। बिजुली नै आइरहेको छैन: मुख्य लाइन, केबल, स्विच, पावर सप्लाई। पंखा घुम्छ, स्क्रिन कालो, बीप — बिजुली ठीक छ र POST चलिरहेको छ। Video उपलब्ध हुनुअघि नै BIOS ले खराबी भेट्यो; प्रायः मेमोरी कारण हुन्छ। कम्पनीको लोगो, अनि त्रुटि सन्देश — POST पास भयो। हार्डवेयर चलिरहेको छ र समस्या अपरेटिङ सिस्टम भेट्न वा लोड गर्नमा छ। OS सुरु हुन्छ, अनि बिग्रिन्छ — हार्डवेयर र boot sector ठीक छन्। खराबी अपरेटिङ सिस्टम, driver वा सफ्टवेयरमा छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The usual causes, and how to tell them apart Too little RAM — the machine slows badly when several programs are open, and the disk light stays on as it swaps memory to disk. Closing programs helps immediately. Too many startup programs — slow from the moment it boots, and slow at everything rather than at one task. A nearly full or fragmented disk — everything involving files is slow. There is no room left for temporary files and virtual memory. Malware — slow with no obvious cause, often with network activity when nothing is open, and often appearing suddenly rather than gradually. Overheating — fast at first, then slow after a while, because the processor deliberately reduces its speed to protect itself. The timing is the clue.
items.ne: सामान्य कारण, र छुट्याउने तरिका RAM कम — धेरै प्रोग्राम खोल्दा एकदम ढिलो हुन्छ, र मेमोरी डिस्कमा सार्दा डिस्कको बत्ती बलिरहन्छ। प्रोग्राम बन्द गर्दा तुरुन्तै सहज हुन्छ। Startup मा धेरै प्रोग्राम — बुट भएकै बेलादेखि ढिलो, र एउटै काममा होइन, सबैमा ढिलो। डिस्क झन्डै भरिएको वा टुक्रिएको — फाइलसँग सम्बन्धित सबै काम ढिलो। अस्थायी फाइल र virtual memory लाई ठाउँ बाँकी हुँदैन। Malware — स्पष्ट कारणबिनै ढिलो, प्रायः केही नखोल्दा पनि नेटवर्क चलिरहने, र बिस्तारै होइन अचानक सुरु हुने। तात्ने समस्या — सुरुमा छिटो, केही बेरपछि ढिलो — किनकि प्रोसेसरले आफूलाई जोगाउन जानाजान गति घटाउँछ। सङ्केत भनेको समय हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A machine powers on, the fans spin, and it beeps repeatedly with a completely black screen. Which part of the boot has it reached? मेसिनमा बिजुली आउँछ, पंखा घुम्छ, र पूरै कालो स्क्रिनसहित बारम्बार बीप गर्छ। Boot को कुन चरणसम्म पुगेको हो? It has not received power POST is running and has found a fault The operating system is loading Beeping is the POST reporting. It only happens once power has reached the board and the BIOS is running — so the power supply, the switch and the mains are all already ruled out. And it is beeping rather than displaying because the fault was found before video was initialised, which is why memory is the first suspect. The operating system is nowhere near loading yet. बीप गर्नु नै POST ले सुनाएको हो। बोर्डसम्म बिजुली पुगेर BIOS चलेपछि मात्र यो हुन्छ — त्यसैले पावर सप्लाई, स्विच र मुख्य लाइन सबै पहिल्यै हट्छन्। र देखाउनुको साटो बीप गर्नुको कारण खराबी video सुरु हुनअघि भेटियो — त्यसैले पहिलो शंका मेमोरीमा जान्छ। अपरेटिङ सिस्टम लोड हुने अवस्था नजिकै छैन। Diagnose it yourself
items.ne: · आफैँ निदान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · आफैँ निदान गर्नुहोस् The fault lab — powers on, no display What you will learn: to narrow a fault by choosing what to check, in the right order. Every choice tells you what it ruled in and what it ruled out — including when your choice was reasonable but expensive, or when it was a step you should never take. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: के जाँच्ने भनी ठीक क्रममा छानेर खराबी साँघुरो पार्न। हरेक छनोटले के पुष्टि गर्‍यो र के हटायो बताउँछ — तपाईंको छनोट ठीकै भए पनि महँगो भएको, वा कहिल्यै नगर्नुपर्ने कदम भएको अवस्थासहित। Why this matters: the practical exam does not ask you to recite the six steps — it puts a symptom in front of you and watches the order you work in. A correct diagnosis reached by opening the case first is still a bad answer, because it is not repeatable.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: व्यावहारिक परीक्षाले छ चरण घोकेर सुनाउन भन्दैन — लक्षण अगाडि राखेर तपाईं कुन क्रममा काम गर्नुहुन्छ हेर्छ। पहिले केस खोलेर पुगेको सही निदान पनि नराम्रो उत्तर हो, किनकि त्यो दोहोर्‍याउन मिल्दैन। 4.4 Boot-time error messages and beep codes Message or signal What it means Where to look first Repeating beeps, no display POST failed before videoVideo अघि नै POST असफल RAM seating, then the RAM itselfRAM को बसाइ, अनि RAM आफैँ One short beep POST passed — this is normalPOST पास — यो सामान्य हो Nothing. Look past POST.केही होइन। POST पछाडि हेर्नुहोस्। "No boot device found" POST passed; no bootable drive was locatedPOST पास; boot हुने ड्राइभ भेटिएन Boot order in BIOS, then the drive's data cableBIOS को boot order, अनि ड्राइभको data केबल "Operating system not found" The drive was found; the OS on it was notड्राइभ भेटियो; त्यसको OS भेटिएन Boot sector or a damaged OS installationBoot sector वा बिग्रिएको OS "CMOS checksum error" Stored BIOS settings are lost or corruptभण्डारित BIOS सेटिङ हराए वा बिग्रिए The CMOS batteryCMOS ब्याट्री "Disk boot failure" The boot drive could not be readBoot ड्राइभ पढ्न सकिएन Cable, then the drive's healthकेबल, अनि ड्राइभको अवस्था 4.5 Troubleshooting system slowdowns The usual causes, and how to tell them apart Too little RAM — the machine slows badly when several programs are open, and the disk light stays on as it swaps memory to disk. Closing programs helps immediately. Too many startup programs — slow from the moment it boots, and slow at everything rather than at one task. A nearly full or fragmented disk — everything involving files is slow. There is no room left for temporary files and virtual memory. Malware — slow with no obvious cause, often with network activity when nothing is open, and often appearing suddenly rather than gradually. Overheating — fast at first, then slow after a while, because the processor deliberately reduces its speed to protect itself. The timing is the clue. सामान्य कारण, र छुट्याउने तरिका RAM कम — धेरै प्रोग्राम खोल्दा एकदम ढिलो हुन्छ, र मेमोरी डिस्कमा सार्दा डिस्कको बत्ती बलिरहन्छ। प्रोग्राम बन्द गर्दा तुरुन्तै सहज हुन्छ। Startup मा धेरै प्रोग्राम — बुट भएकै बेलादेखि ढिलो, र एउटै काममा होइन, सबैमा ढिलो। डिस्क झन्डै भरिएको वा टुक्रिएको — फाइलसँग सम्बन्धित सबै काम ढिलो। अस्थायी फाइल र virtual memory लाई ठाउँ बाँकी हुँदैन। Malware — स्पष्ट कारणबिनै ढिलो, प्रायः केही नखोल्दा पनि नेटवर्क चलिरहने, र बिस्तारै होइन अचानक सुरु हुने। तात्ने समस्या — सुरुमा छिटो, केही बेरपछि ढिलो — किनकि प्रोसेसरले आफूलाई जोगाउन जानाजान गति घटाउँछ। सङ्केत भनेको समय हो। Faded practice
items.ne: · क्रमशः कम सहयोग

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · क्रमशः कम सहयोग Working a symptom down to a cause What you will learn: to produce the diagnostic sequence yourself. The first problem is worked for you, the next shows fewer steps, and by the last one you write the reasoning with no prompts at all. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: निदानको क्रम आफैँ बनाउन। पहिलो समस्या तपाईंका लागि गरिदिइन्छ, अर्कोमा कम चरण देखिन्छन्, र अन्तिममा कुनै सङ्केतबिनै तपाईं आफैँ तर्क लेख्नुहुन्छ। Why this matters: reading a worked diagnosis feels like learning and is not. The only way to find out whether you can do it is to be given a symptom with the working removed.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: गरिसकेको निदान पढ्दा सिकेजस्तो लाग्छ, तर सिकिँदैन। आफूले गर्न सक्छु कि सक्दिनँ भन्ने थाहा पाउने एउटै तरिका छ — काम हटाइएको लक्षण दिइनु। Example 1 "No boot device found" — reasoning it out Question: a computer shows the manufacturer logo, then "No boot device found". The user says it worked yesterday. Where do you look, and in what order? Before reading on, answer one question: what has the message already proved is working?पढ्नुअघि एउटा प्रश्नको उत्तर दिनुहोस्: यो सन्देशले के चलिरहेको छ भनी पहिल्यै प्रमाणित गरिसक्यो? Step 1 — read how far it got. A logo and a readable message mean video works and POST passed. Power, memory and the display path are all ruled out before you touch anything. Step 2 — ask what changed. The user mentions the machine was moved to a new desk yesterday. A move disturbs cables; this is now the most probable cause. Step 3 — check the cheapest thing consistent with that theory. Enter BIOS setup and look at the detected drives. The disk is not listed at all. Step 4 — a disk that is not detected is a connection or a drive fault. Power off, unplug, and reseat both the data cable and the power cable at the drive and at the board. Step 5 — verify. The drive now appears in BIOS and the machine boots. Answer A data cable loosened by the move. Found without opening a single component, because the message ruled out everything before the disk. Notice that no part was replaced and nothing was guessed. Step 1 removed most of the machine from suspicion and step 2 supplied the theory — the actual repair took thirty seconds. ध्यान दिनुहोस्, कुनै पार्ट साटिएन र केही अनुमान गरिएन। चरण १ ले मेसिनको ठूलो हिस्सालाई शंकाबाट हटायो र चरण २ ले अनुमान दियो — वास्तविक मर्मत तीस सेकेन्डको थियो। Example 2 Separating two causes of the same complaint Question: two users both report "my computer is slow". How do you tell whether it is too little RAM or overheating, without opening either machine? Step 1 — ask when it is slow, not how slow. The two causes have different timing, and timing is free to collect. Step 2 — the first user says it is slow whenever several programs are open, from the moment it starts. Present from boot, and tied to load rather than to elapsed time. That is memory: the machine is swapping to disk because RAM has run out. Step 3 — the second says it is fine for half an hour and then gets slow, every day. Absent at first and appearing only after the machine has warmed up. That is thermal: the processor is reducing its own speed to protect itself. Step 4 — confirm each cheaply. For the first, watch the disk light while opening programs; for the second, read the temperature in BIOS setup after it has been running. Answer User 1 — insufficient RAM. User 2 — overheating. The same complaint, separated by one question about timing. "It is slow" is not a symptom. "It is slow after twenty minutes" is. Most of the work in this unit is turning the first sentence into the second. "ढिलो छ" लक्षण होइन। "बीस मिनेटपछि ढिलो हुन्छ" लक्षण हो। यस युनिटको धेरैजसो काम पहिलो वाक्यलाई दोस्रोमा बदल्नु नै हो। Mistakes that cost marks here Replacing parts to find the fault. Substituting a known-good part is a test; buying a new part on suspicion is not diagnosis, and the exam marks the method. खराबी खोज्न पार्ट साट्नु। चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको पार्ट राखेर हेर्नु परीक्षण हो; शंकामा नयाँ किन्नु निदान होइन, र परीक्षाले तरिकाको अंक दिन्छ। Changing two things at once. If the fault clears you have no idea which change did it, so you have not learned anything and cannot prevent a repeat. एकैचोटि दुई कुरा बदल्नु। खराबी हट्यो भने कुनले हटायो थाहै हुँदैन, त्यसैले केही सिकिँदैन र फेरि हुन रोक्न पनि सकिँदैन। Skipping "ask the user what changed". It is a step in the method and it is free. Most faults follow a change the user can name. "के बदलियो?" सोध्ने चरण छोड्नु। यो विधिकै एउटा चरण हो र निःशुल्क छ। धेरैजसो खराबी प्रयोगकर्ताले नाम लिन सक्ने परिवर्तनपछि आउँछ। Reinstalling the operating system for a hardware symptom. If the screen is blank before any OS could load, the OS cannot be the cause — and reinstalling destroys the user's data for nothing. हार्डवेयरको लक्षणमा अपरेटिङ सिस्टम फेरि इन्स्टल गर्नु। कुनै OS लोड हुनुअघि नै स्क्रिन खाली छ भने OS कारण हुनै सक्दैन — र फेरि इन्स्टल गर्दा प्रयोगकर्ताको data बेकारमा नष्ट हुन्छ। Cheapest check first, one change at a time. The symptom says how far it got. सस्तो जाँच पहिले, एकपटकमा एउटा परिवर्तन। कहाँसम्म पुग्यो भन्ने लक्षणले नै भन्छ। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit This unit carries 9 marks in the written paper and is most of what the practical exam actually tests. The written questions are predictable: list the steps of troubleshooting (in order — the order is the answer), what would you check if… given a symptom, and state the causes of a slow system or a boot failure. The examiner is looking for a sequence of checks with reasons, not a single guessed cause. Write the order you would work in and say what each check rules out; that is where the marks are. यो युनिटले लिखित परीक्षामा ९ अंक बोक्छ र व्यावहारिक परीक्षाले जाँच्ने कुराको ठूलो हिस्सा यही हो। लिखित प्रश्न अनुमान गर्न सकिने खालका छन्: troubleshooting का चरण सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (क्रमैसँग — क्रम नै उत्तर हो), लक्षण दिएर के जाँच्नुहुन्छ, र ढिलो प्रणाली वा boot असफलताका कारण लेख्नुहोस्। परीक्षकले अनुमान गरिएको एउटा कारण होइन, कारणसहितको जाँच क्रम खोज्छ। तपाईं कुन क्रममा काम गर्नुहुन्छ लेख्नुहोस् र हरेक जाँचले के हटाउँछ भन्नुहोस्; अंक त्यहीँ छ। Q1 3 marks List the steps of troubleshooting in order. Troubleshooting का चरण क्रमैसँग सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस्। Show the answer 1. Identify the problem — state exactly what happens and when. 2. Gather information — ask the user what changed. 3. Establish a theory of probable cause — the most likely cause consistent with the symptom. 4. Test the theory, changing one thing at a time; if it is disproved, return to step 3. 5. Apply the fix and verify the original symptom has gone. 6. Document the symptom, the cause and the solution. १. समस्या पहिचान — के हुन्छ र कहिले हुन्छ ठ्याक्कै भन्ने। २. जानकारी सङ्कलन — प्रयोगकर्तालाई के बदलियो सोध्ने। ३. सम्भावित कारणको अनुमान — लक्षणसँग मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सम्भावित कारण। ४. अनुमानको परीक्षण, एकपटकमा एउटा कुरा बदलेर; गलत साबित भए चरण ३ मा फर्किने। ५. समाधान लागू गरी सुरुको लक्षण हट्यो कि पुष्टि गर्ने। ६. लक्षण, कारण र समाधानको अभिलेख राख्ने। Q2 3 marks A computer powers on with fans running but shows nothing on screen. Describe how you would find the fault. कम्प्युटरमा बिजुली आउँछ, पंखा घुम्छ, तर स्क्रिनमा केही देखिँदैन। खराबी कसरी पत्ता लगाउनुहुन्छ वर्णन गर्नुहोस्। Show the answer Work from the cheapest check outward. First confirm the monitor has power and the video cable is firm at both ends, and try a monitor known to work — this rules out the display path. Then listen at power-on: repeated beeps mean POST found a fault before video was available, which points to memory. Power off, unplug, and reseat the RAM modules one at a time until the clips close. If the beeps continue with a module known to be good, the slot or the board is at fault. Change only one thing at a time, and verify the display returns before closing the case. सबैभन्दा सस्तो जाँचबाट बाहिरतिर बढ्नुहोस्। पहिले monitor मा बिजुली छ र video केबल दुवै छेउमा कसिएको छ पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्, र चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको monitor जोडेर हेर्नुहोस् — यसले display को बाटो हटाउँछ। अनि बिजुली लाग्दा सुन्नुहोस्: बारम्बार बीप भनेको video उपलब्ध हुनुअघि POST ले खराबी भेट्यो, जसले मेमोरीतिर देखाउँछ। बिजुली बन्द गरी प्लग निकाली क्लिप बन्द नहुन्जेल RAM एक–एक गरी फेरि बसाल्नुहोस्। चल्ने मोड्युल राख्दा पनि बीप जारी रहे slot वा बोर्डमा खराबी छ। एकपटकमा एउटा मात्र कुरा बदल्नुहोस्, र केस बन्द गर्नुअघि स्क्रिन फर्कियो कि पुष्टि गर्नुहोस्। Q3 3 marks State four causes of a computer becoming slow, and how you would tell one of them apart from the others. कम्प्युटर ढिलो हुनुका चार कारण लेख्नुहोस्, र तीमध्ये एउटालाई अरूबाट कसरी छुट्याउनुहुन्छ भन्नुहोस्। Show the answer Causes: insufficient RAM; too many programs loading at startup; a nearly full or fragmented hard disk; malware infection; overheating causing the processor to reduce its speed. Overheating is told apart by its timing — the machine is normal when first switched on and only becomes slow after it has been running for a while, and sooner when a demanding program is open. The other causes are slow from the start. कारण: RAM अपुग; startup मा धेरै प्रोग्राम लोड हुनु; hard disk झन्डै भरिनु वा टुक्रिनु; malware सङ्क्रमण; तात्दा प्रोसेसरले गति घटाउनु। तात्ने समस्या समयले छुट्टिन्छ — खोल्दा सामान्य हुन्छ र केही बेर चलेपछि मात्र ढिलो हुन्छ, र भारी प्रोग्राम खोले झन् चाँडो। अरू कारणमा सुरुदेखि नै ढिलो हुन्छ। Key points to revise
