items.ne: बिजुली आउँछ, तर स्क्रिनमा केही देखिँदैन

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: You press the power button. The fans spin and the power light is on. The screen stays completely black — no logo, no text, no error.
items.ne: पावर बटन थिच्नुहुन्छ। पंखा घुम्छ, पावर बत्ती बल्छ। स्क्रिन पूरै कालो रहन्छ — कुनै लोगो छैन, अक्षर छैन, त्रुटि छैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The machine has power. What do you check first?
items.ne: मेसिनमा बिजुली छ। पहिले के जाँच्नुहुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Monitor power and the video cable at both ends
items.ne: Monitor को पावर र दुवै छेउको video केबल

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Right call — cheapest check first. The monitor light is on and the cable is firm at both ends, so the display path is not simply disconnected. Ruled out: monitor off, cable loose.
items.ne: ठीक निर्णय — सबैभन्दा सस्तो जाँच पहिले। Monitor को बत्ती बलेको छ र केबल दुवै छेउमा कसिएको छ, त्यसैले display को बाटो केवल छुटेको होइन। हट्यो: monitor बन्द, केबल खुकुलो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Open the case and reseat the RAM
items.ne: केस खोलेर RAM फेरि बसाल्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: This may well be the fault, and you will come to it — but not yet. You have just opened a case, handled a static-sensitive component and spent fifteen minutes without ruling out a cable that takes five seconds. Do the outside before the inside.
items.ne: खराबी यही हुन सक्छ, र तपाईं यहाँ आइपुग्नुहुनेछ — तर अहिले होइन। तपाईंले केस खोल्नुभयो, static ले बिगार्न सक्ने पार्ट छुनुभयो, र पाँच सेकेन्डमा जाँचिने केबल नहेरी पन्ध्र मिनेट खर्चनुभयो। भित्र भन्दा पहिले बाहिर हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Replace the power supply
items.ne: पावर सप्लाई साट्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Stop. Replacing a part is not a diagnostic step — it is what you do AFTER a diagnosis. The fans are spinning, so the supply is delivering power. You would have spent money and still not known the cause.
items.ne: रोकिनुहोस्। पार्ट साट्नु निदानको चरण होइन — निदान पछि गरिने काम हो। पंखा घुमिरहेको छ, त्यसैले सप्लाईले बिजुली दिइरहेको छ। पैसा खर्च हुन्थ्यो र कारण अझै थाहा हुँदैनथ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The display path is connected. Now what does the machine itself tell you?
items.ne: Display को बाटो जोडिएको छ। अब मेसिन आफैँले के भन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Listen for beep codes at power-on
items.ne: पावर लाग्दा बीप कोड सुन्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The POST is talking to you. You hear a repeating pattern of beeps. That is the BIOS reporting a fault it found before it could use the screen — which is exactly why the screen is blank.
items.ne: POST ले तपाईंसँग कुरा गरिरहेको छ। दोहोरिने बीपको ढाँचा सुनिन्छ। यो BIOS ले स्क्रिन प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुअघि नै भेट्टाएको खराबी सुनाइरहेको हो — स्क्रिन खाली हुनुको कारण यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Try a different monitor you know works
items.ne: चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको अर्को monitor जोडेर हेर्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Good substitution test — swapping in a known-good part is a legitimate way to rule one out. The second monitor is also blank, so the monitor is not the fault. The problem is inside the system unit.
items.ne: राम्रो प्रतिस्थापन परीक्षण — चल्ने भनेर थाहा भएको पार्ट राखेर हेर्नु कुनै एउटा सम्भावना हटाउने वैध तरिका हो। दोस्रो monitor पनि खाली छ, त्यसैले monitor खराबी होइन। समस्या सिस्टम युनिट भित्र छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Reinstall the operating system
items.ne: अपरेटिङ सिस्टम फेरि इन्स्टल गर्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: No. The screen is blank before any operating system would load — you are not even reaching the boot stage. Reinstalling would destroy the user's data to fix something the OS is not responsible for.
items.ne: होइन। कुनै पनि अपरेटिङ सिस्टम लोड हुनुअघि नै स्क्रिन खाली छ — तपाईं boot चरणसम्म पुग्नु पनि भएको छैन। फेरि इन्स्टल गर्दा OS को दोष नभएको कुरा मिलाउन प्रयोगकर्ताको data नष्ट हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The POST beeps before video is available. Which component does that point to?
items.ne: Video उपलब्ध हुनुअघि नै POST ले बीप गर्छ। यसले कुन भागतिर सङ्केत गर्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Reseat the RAM modules, one at a time
items.ne: RAM मोड्युल एक–एक गरी फेरि बसाल्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Now it is the right move, and it is confirmed rather than guessed. Memory is checked so early in the POST that a failure there happens before the BIOS can put anything on screen. One module was not fully seated; the clips were not down.
items.ne: अब यो सही कदम हो, र अनुमान होइन — पुष्टि गरिएको हो। POST मा मेमोरी यति चाँडो जाँचिन्छ कि त्यहाँ असफल भएमा BIOS ले स्क्रिनमा केही देखाउनै पाउँदैन। एउटा मोड्युल पूरै बसेको थिएन; क्लिप तल परेका थिएनन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Check the hard disk cable
items.ne: Hard disk को केबल जाँच्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Reasonable instinct, wrong stage. The hard disk is not read until well after the POST has finished and video is working. A disk fault gives you an error message ON the screen — it cannot give you a blank one.
items.ne: सोचाइ ठीकै, तर चरण गलत। POST सकिएर video चलेपछि मात्र hard disk पढिन्छ। Disk को खराबीले स्क्रिनमा त्रुटि सन्देश देखाउँछ — खाली स्क्रिन दिन सक्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Improperly seated RAM. The POST tests memory before it initialises video, so the machine reports the fault with beeps and never reaches the point where it could display anything.
items.ne: RAM राम्ररी नबसेको। POST ले video सुरु गर्नुअघि मेमोरी जाँच्छ, त्यसैले मेसिनले बीपले खराबी सुनाउँछ र स्क्रिनमा केही देखाउन सक्ने अवस्थासम्म पुग्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Power off and unplug. Press each module down until both clips close by themselves. Boot with one module to confirm, then add the rest. If the beeps continue with a known-good module, the slot itself is faulty.
items.ne: बिजुली बन्द गरी प्लग निकाल्नुहोस्। दुवै क्लिप आफैँ बन्द नहुन्जेल हरेक मोड्युल थिच्नुहोस्। पुष्टिका लागि एउटा मोड्युल राखेर बुट गर्नुहोस्, अनि बाँकी थप्नुहोस्। चल्ने मोड्युल राख्दा पनि बीप जारी रहे slot नै बिग्रिएको हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: It restarts by itself after a while
items.ne: केही बेरपछि आफैँ रिस्टार्ट हुन्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The computer starts normally and works fine. After twenty to thirty minutes — sooner if a heavy program is open — it shuts down or restarts with no warning and no error message.
items.ne: कम्प्युटर सामान्य रूपमा सुरु हुन्छ र राम्रै चल्छ। बीस–तीस मिनेटपछि — भारी प्रोग्राम खोलेको भए अझ चाँडो — कुनै चेतावनी र त्रुटि सन्देशबिनै बन्द वा रिस्टार्ट हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: It works and then stops. What does the TIMING tell you?
items.ne: चल्छ अनि रोकिन्छ। यो समय ले के बताउँछ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Note that it fails only after it has been running a while
items.ne: केही बेर चलेपछि मात्र बिग्रिन्छ भन्ने कुरा टिप्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: That is the whole clue. A fault present from the start is usually a connection or a component; a fault that appears only after the machine warms up is almost always thermal. Heavy programs making it sooner confirms it — they make more heat.
items.ne: सङ्केत यही हो। सुरुदेखि रहेको खराबी प्रायः जडान वा पार्टको हुन्छ; मेसिन तातेपछि मात्र देखिने खराबी झन्डै सधैं तापसम्बन्धी हुन्छ। भारी प्रोग्रामले चाँडो बनाउनुले पुष्टि गर्छ — तिनले बढी ताप निकाल्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Scan for a virus
items.ne: भाइरस स्क्यान गर्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Worth doing eventually, and it comes back clean. But a virus does not usually wait for the machine to warm up, and it does not shut the power off — it is software, and a sudden power-off is not something software normally does.
items.ne: पछि गर्नु लायक छ, र केही भेटिँदैन। तर भाइरसले मेसिन तात्ने कुर्दैन, र बिजुली नै काट्दैन — त्यो सफ्टवेयर हो, र अचानक बिजुली जानु सफ्टवेयरले सामान्यतया गर्ने काम होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: You suspect heat. How do you confirm it before opening anything?
items.ne: ताप हो कि भन्ने शंका छ। केही नखोली कसरी पुष्टि गर्नुहुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Read the temperatures in the BIOS setup screen
items.ne: BIOS सेटअप स्क्रिनमा तापक्रम पढ्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The BIOS reports the processor temperature without loading the operating system, so nothing else is competing for the machine. It reads far above normal and is still climbing while you watch.
items.ne: BIOS ले अपरेटिङ सिस्टम लोड नगरी प्रोसेसरको तापक्रम देखाउँछ, त्यसैले अरू केहीले मेसिन ओगटेको हुँदैन। यो सामान्यभन्दा धेरै माथि छ र हेर्दाहेर्दै बढिरहेको छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Feel whether air is coming out of the exhaust vent
items.ne: निकास प्वालबाट हावा आइरहेको छ कि छैन छाम्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A quick and genuinely useful check. Almost no warm air is leaving, which means either a fan has stopped or the airflow path is blocked. You have narrowed it to cooling without any tools at all.
items.ne: छिटो र साँच्चै काम लाग्ने जाँच। न्यानो हावा झन्डै निस्किरहेको छैन — अर्थात् या त पंखा रोकिएको छ, या हावाको बाटो बन्द छ। कुनै औजारबिनै तपाईंले cooling मा सीमित गर्नुभयो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: It is overheating. What is the actual cause inside?
items.ne: तात्ने पक्का भयो। भित्र वास्तविक कारण के हो?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Open the case and inspect the heatsink, fan and vents
items.ne: केस खोलेर heatsink, पंखा र प्वाल हेर्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Now opening the case is justified — you know what you are looking for. The heatsink fins are packed with dust and the fan is turning slowly against it. The processor is making heat normally; it simply cannot get rid of it.
items.ne: अब केस खोल्नु जायज छ — के खोज्ने हो थाहा छ। Heatsink का पत्रहरू धुलोले भरिएका छन् र पंखा त्यसैको प्रतिरोधमा बिस्तारै घुमिरहेको छ। प्रोसेसरले सामान्य रूपमै ताप निकालिरहेको छ; त्यो बाहिर जान मात्र सकेको छैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Replace the processor
items.ne: प्रोसेसर साट्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Stop. The processor is doing nothing wrong — it is producing the heat it always produces. Replacing the most expensive component on the board would leave the blocked cooling in place, and the new processor would overheat exactly the same way.
items.ne: रोकिनुहोस्। प्रोसेसरले केही गलत गरेको छैन — यसले सधैं निकाल्ने ताप नै निकालिरहेको छ। बोर्डकै सबैभन्दा महँगो पार्ट साट्दा बन्द भएको cooling त्यसै रहन्थ्यो, र नयाँ प्रोसेसर पनि ठ्याक्कै त्यसरी नै तात्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Overheating caused by blocked cooling — dust in the heatsink fins and a fan slowed by it. The automatic thermal shutdown is not the fault; it is the protection working correctly to stop the processor being damaged.
items.ne: Cooling बन्द भएर तात्नु — heatsink का पत्रमा धुलो, र त्यसैले ढिलो भएको पंखा। स्वतः बन्द हुनु खराबी होइन; प्रोसेसर बिग्रिनबाट जोगाउन सुरक्षा ठीकसँग काम गरेको हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Power off and unplug. Clear the dust from the fins and fan with dry compressed air, never a wet cloth. Check the fan spins freely. Reapply thermal paste if the heatsink was removed. Then prevent the repeat: clean vents on a schedule and keep the case clear of the wall.
items.ne: बिजुली बन्द गरी प्लग निकाल्नुहोस्। सुक्खा कम्प्रेस्ड एयरले पत्र र पंखाको धुलो हटाउनुहोस् — भिजेको कपडा कहिल्यै प्रयोग नगर्नुहोस्। पंखा स्वतन्त्र घुम्छ कि हेर्नुहोस्। Heatsink निकालेको भए thermal paste फेरि लगाउनुहोस्। अनि दोहोरिन नदिनुहोस्: तालिका बनाएर प्वाल सफा गर्नुहोस् र केस भित्ताबाट अलग राख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The power disappears entirely. A surge protector handles voltage that is too high and a stabiliser handles voltage that is too low — neither can supply power that is not there. Only a UPS carries a battery, and its purpose is to give enough time to save work and shut down properly.
items.ne: बिजुली पूरै हराउँछ। Surge protector ले धेरै बढी भोल्टेज सम्हाल्छ र stabiliser ले धेरै कम — नभएको बिजुली दुवैले दिन सक्दैनन्। UPS सँग मात्र ब्याट्री हुन्छ, र यसको उद्देश्य काम बचाएर ठीकसँग बन्द गर्न पुग्ने समय दिनु हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The shutdown is the protection working correctly — it is stopping the processor being damaged. The fault is whatever prevents the heat escaping: dust in the heatsink fins, a stopped or slowed fan, dried thermal paste, or blocked vents. The processor is producing its normal amount of heat.
items.ne: बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा ठीकसँग चलेको हो — प्रोसेसर बिग्रिनबाट रोकिरहेको छ। खराबी भनेको ताप बाहिर जान नदिने कुरा हो: heatsink का पत्रमा धुलो, रोकिएको वा ढिलो भएको पंखा, सुकेको thermal paste, वा बन्द प्वाल। प्रोसेसरले सामान्य मात्रामै ताप निकालिरहेको छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: An antivirus recognises threats by comparing against what it knows. New malware appears constantly, so a scanner that is never updated is blind to everything released after installation. This is why "install antivirus" alone is a half answer — "and keep it updated" is the other half of the mark.
items.ne: Antivirus ले आफूलाई थाहा भएकोसँग मिलाएर खतरा चिन्छ। नयाँ malware निरन्तर आइरहन्छ, त्यसैले कहिल्यै अपडेट नगरिएको स्क्यानर इन्स्टलपछि आएका सबैप्रति अन्धो हुन्छ। त्यसैले "antivirus राख्ने" मात्र आधा उत्तर हो — "र अपडेट गरिराख्ने" ले बाँकी आधा अंक दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A flat panel has one native resolution and is sharp only at that setting; anything else is scaled to fit and goes soft, and a wrong aspect ratio also stretches the picture. Low refresh rate causes flicker, not blur. 24-bit colour depth is normal, not a fault.
items.ne: Flat panel को एउटै native resolution हुन्छ र त्यही सेटिङमा मात्र तीक्ष्ण हुन्छ; अरूमा अटाउन तानिन्छ र धमिलो हुन्छ, र गलत aspect ratio ले तस्बिर पनि तान्छ। कम refresh rate ले झिमझिम ल्याउँछ, धमिलोपन होइन। २४-bit colour depth सामान्य हो, खराबी होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Dry compressed air removes dust without moisture and without generating static. A damp cloth or soapy water introduces moisture, which shorts and corrodes; a household vacuum builds a large static charge at its nozzle, which can destroy components outright.
items.ne: सुक्खा कम्प्रेस्ड एयरले चिस्यानबिना र static नबनाई धुलो हटाउँछ। भिजेको कपडा वा साबुनपानीले चिस्यान ल्याउँछ, जसले शर्ट र खिया गराउँछ; घरायसी भ्याकुमको नोजलमा ठूलो static चार्ज बन्छ, जसले पार्ट एकैचोटि नष्ट गर्न सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Calling a thermal shutdown a fault. The shutdown is the protection working. The fault is the blocked airflow, the stopped fan or the dried thermal paste.
items.ne: तापले बन्द हुनुलाई खराबी भन्नु। बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा चलेको हो। खराबी भनेको रोकिएको हावा, नचल्ने पंखा वा सुकेको thermal paste हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which power problem is this?
items.ne: यो कुन बिजुली समस्या हो?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Each case describes what the power actually did. Name the problem — the protective device follows from it, and choosing the wrong one is the expensive mistake this topic exists to prevent.
items.ne: हरेक केसले बिजुलीले साँच्चै के गर्‍यो बताउँछ। समस्याको नाम भन्नुहोस् — सुरक्षा उपकरण त्यसैबाट आउँछ, र गलत छान्नु नै यो विषयले रोक्न खोजेको महँगो गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.ref: powerprotect · option "Surge — needs a surge protector"
items.en: Surge — needs a surge protector
items.ne: Surge — surge protector चाहिन्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Sag — needs a stabiliser
items.ne: Sag — stabiliser चाहिन्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Blackout — needs a UPS
items.ne: Blackout — UPS चाहिन्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which port does this connect to?
items.ne: यो कुन पोर्टमा जोडिन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A device that will not work is very often a device in the wrong socket. Read what is being connected and choose the port — the reasoning matters more than the shape, because several connectors physically fit where they do not belong.
items.ne: नचल्ने उपकरण प्रायः गलत सकेटमा जोडिएको हुन्छ। के जोड्दै हुनुहुन्छ पढेर पोर्ट छान्नुहोस् — आकारभन्दा कारण महत्त्वपूर्ण छ, किनकि धेरै connector नमिल्ने ठाउँमा पनि भौतिक रूपमा अटाउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: 3.5 mm audio
items.ne: ३.५ mm audio

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A brief, very large rise in voltage is a surge or spike. A surge protector diverts the excess energy away from the equipment before it reaches the power supply.
items.ne: छोटो तर धेरै ठूलो भोल्टेज बढाइ नै surge वा spike हो। Surge protector ले बढी ऊर्जा पावर सप्लाईसम्म पुग्नुअघि नै अन्तै पठाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The supply is gone, so nothing that conditions incoming power can help — there is none to condition. Only a UPS carries a battery, which is why it is the only answer to a blackout.
items.ne: सप्लाई नै गयो, त्यसैले आउने बिजुली मिलाउने कुनै उपकरणले काम गर्दैन — मिलाउने बिजुली नै छैन। ब्याट्री UPS मा मात्र हुन्छ, त्यसैले blackout को एक मात्र उत्तर यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Voltage that falls below normal without disappearing is a sag or brownout. A voltage stabiliser holds the output steady while the incoming supply moves around.
items.ne: नहराई सामान्यभन्दा तल झर्ने भोल्टेज नै sag वा brownout हो। Voltage stabiliser ले आउने सप्लाई तलमाथि हुँदा पनि आउटपुट स्थिर राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Switching a large inductive load OFF throws energy back into the supply as a spike. Read the event, not the outcome — the machine dying looks like a blackout, but the cause was a moment of far too much voltage, not too little.
items.ne: ठूलो inductive भार बन्द गर्दा ऊर्जा spike बनेर सप्लाईमै फर्किन्छ। नतिजा होइन, घटना पढ्नुहोस् — मेसिन मर्नु blackout जस्तो देखिन्छ, तर कारण एक क्षणको अत्यधिक भोल्टेज हो, कमी होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A network cable ends in an RJ-45 plug and goes to the Ethernet port. The trap is that an RJ-11 telephone plug is narrower and will slide into an RJ-45 socket without clicking — it fits, and it will never carry a network.
items.ne: नेटवर्क केबलको टुप्पोमा RJ-45 प्लग हुन्छ र त्यो Ethernet पोर्टमा जान्छ। पासो यो हो: RJ-11 टेलिफोन प्लग साँघुरो हुन्छ र क्लिक नगरी RJ-45 सकेटभित्र पस्छ — अटाउँछ, तर कहिल्यै नेटवर्क बोक्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Picture AND sound over one cable means HDMI — VGA is analogue and carries video only. If a user complains there is no sound from the monitor, check which of the two they used before suspecting the speakers.
items.ne: एउटै केबलमा तस्बिर र आवाज भनेको HDMI हो — VGA analogue हो र video मात्र बोक्छ। Monitor बाट आवाज आएन भन्ने गुनासो आए स्पिकरमा शंका गर्नुअघि कुन केबल प्रयोग भयो हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: All four are USB, which is why USB replaced the separate parallel, PS/2 and serial ports it succeeded. One port type, one connector, and the system detects what was plugged in.
items.ne: चारै USB हुन् — त्यसैले USB ले पहिलेका छुट्टाछुट्टै parallel, PS/2 र serial पोर्ट हटायो। एउटै किसिमको पोर्ट, एउटै connector, र के जोडियो प्रणालीले आफैँ पत्ता लगाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Both are 3.5 mm and physically identical, so the plug fits either way and nothing warns you. Go by the colour and the icon: green with a headphone symbol is output, pink with a microphone symbol is input. "It fits" is not evidence.
items.ne: दुवै ३.५ mm र भौतिक रूपमा एउटै हुन्, त्यसैले प्लग जतासुकै अटाउँछ र केही चेतावनी आउँदैन। रङ र चिन्ह हेर्नुहोस्: हेडफोन चिन्हसहितको हरियो output, माइक्रोफोन चिन्हसहितको गुलाबी input। "अटायो" भन्नु प्रमाण होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: One path, front to back. Dust on the fins is an insulator: the processor makes its normal heat and simply cannot get rid of it.
items.ne: एउटै बाटो, अगाडिबाट पछाडि। पत्रमा जमेको धुलो इन्सुलेटर हो: प्रोसेसरले सामान्य ताप निकाल्छ तर त्यो बाहिर पठाउनै सक्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Define a computer virus, list how infection spreads, and state detection and prevention methods.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: निरोधात्मक सम्भारका काम सूचीबद्ध गर्न र हरेकले कुन खराबी रोक्छ भन्न, वायरलेस जडान समस्या मिल्दो क्रममा समाधान गर्न, प्रणालीले भोग्ने बिजुली समस्या र हरेकबाट जोगाउने उपकरण नाम लिन, video card र monitor का लक्षणबाट खराबी पत्ता लगाउन, प्रोसेसर किन चिसो पार्नुपर्छ र cooling बिग्रिँदा के हुन्छ व्याख्या गर्न, र भाइरसको परिभाषा दिन, सर्ने तरिका सूचीबद्ध गर्न तथा पत्ता लगाउने र रोक्ने उपाय भन्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Screen blurry or stretched
items.ne: स्क्रिन धमिलो वा तानिएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Resolution not set to the monitor's native value
items.ne: Monitor को आफ्नै resolution मा सेट नभएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Set the recommended resolution in display settings
items.ne: Display सेटिङमा सिफारिस गरिएको resolution राख्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Wrong or missing colours
items.ne: रङ गलत वा नआएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Loose or damaged video cable — a bent pin
items.ne: Video केबल खुकुलो वा बिग्रेको — पिन बाङ्गिएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Reseat the cable; check the pins; try another cable
items.ne: केबल फेरि कस्ने; पिन हेर्ने; अर्को केबल जोड्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Flickering, tiring to look at
items.ne: झिमझिम, हेर्न थकाइ लाग्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Refresh rate set too low
items.ne: Refresh rate धेरै कम राखिएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Raise it to the highest the monitor supports
items.ne: Monitor ले सक्ने सबैभन्दा माथि बढाउने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Distorted patterns or artefacts on screen
items.ne: स्क्रिनमा बिग्रिएका आकार वा धब्बा

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Video card overheating or failing
items.ne: Video card तात्दै वा बिग्रँदै

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Clean its fan and fins; reseat the card; test in another slot
items.ne: यसको पंखा र पत्र सफा गर्ने; कार्ड फेरि बसाल्ने; अर्को slot मा जाँच्ने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Device not recognised at all
items.ne: उपकरण पत्तै नलागेको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Loose connector, dead port, or a missing driver
items.ne: Connector खुकुलो, पोर्ट मरेको, वा driver नभएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Try another port, then another cable, then install the driver
items.ne: अर्को पोर्ट, अनि अर्को केबल, अनि driver इन्स्टल

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Three problems are listed. Decide how many devices are actually needed before you read on.
items.ne: तीन समस्या लेखिएका छन्। पढ्नुअघि साँच्चै कति उपकरण चाहिन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The examiner is testing whether you match the device to the problem. Recommending a surge protector for a site whose real complaint is power cuts protects against the one thing that site did not report.
items.ne: परीक्षकले तपाईंले उपकरणलाई समस्या सँग मिलाउनुहुन्छ कि हेर्छ। बिजुली जाने गुनासो भएको ठाउँमा surge protector सिफारिस गर्नु भनेको त्यहाँ नभनिएकै कुराबाट जोगाउनु हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: When a user reports several things at once, count the faults before you start. A "fix" that clears two of three symptoms is reported back as "it is still broken".
items.ne: प्रयोगकर्ताले एकैचोटि धेरै कुरा भन्दा सुरु गर्नुअघि खराबी कति छन् गन्नुहोस्। तीनमध्ये दुई लक्षण हटाउने "समाधान" फेरि "अझै बिग्रेकै छ" भनेर फर्किन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying a surge protector protects against power cuts. It handles voltage that is too high. Only a UPS has a battery, so only a UPS helps in a blackout.
items.ne: Surge protector ले बिजुली जानुबाट जोगाउँछ भन्नु। यसले बढी भोल्टेज सम्हाल्छ। ब्याट्री UPS मा मात्र हुन्छ, त्यसैले blackout मा UPS मात्र काम लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Writing "install antivirus" without "and update it". An antivirus that is never updated cannot recognise anything released after it was installed.
items.ne: "अपडेट गर्ने" नलेखी "antivirus राख्ने" मात्र लेख्नु। कहिल्यै अपडेट नगरिएको antivirus ले इन्स्टल भएपछि आएको कुनै पनि कुरा चिन्न सक्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Cleaning inside a machine with a wet cloth or a household vacuum. Use dry compressed air. Moisture and static both destroy components.
items.ne: मेसिनभित्र भिजेको कपडा वा घरायसी भ्याकुमले सफा गर्नु। सुक्खा कम्प्रेस्ड एयर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। चिस्यान र static दुवैले पार्ट नष्ट गर्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit is the widest in the subject — eleven topics for 9 marks — so questions are short and drawn from anywhere in it. The reliable ones are: list preventive maintenance tasks (pair each with the failure it prevents and you answer a 4-mark question with a 3-mark list), differentiate UPS, surge protector and voltage stabiliser, what is a computer virus and how do you prevent infection, and why must a processor be cooled. Expect at least one symptom-to-cause question drawn from the display and connection faults.
items.ne: यो विषयकै सबैभन्दा फराकिलो युनिट हो — ९ अंकका लागि एघार विषय — त्यसैले प्रश्न छोटा र जताबाट पनि आउन सक्ने हुन्छन्। भरपर्दा प्रश्न: निरोधात्मक सम्भारका काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (हरेकसँग रोकिने खराबी जोड्नुभयो भने ३ अंकको सूचीले ४ अंकको प्रश्न उत्तर हुन्छ), UPS, surge protector र voltage stabiliser छुट्याउनुहोस्, कम्प्युटर भाइरस के हो र सङ्क्रमण कसरी रोक्ने, र प्रोसेसर किन चिसो पार्नुपर्छ। Display र जडान खराबीबाट कम्तीमा एउटा लक्षण–कारण प्रश्न आउने अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Preventive maintenance is work carried out on a system that is still functioning, in order to prevent failures and extend equipment life. Cleaning dust from vents, fans and heatsinks prevents overheating and unexpected shutdowns. Checking that cables and cards are firmly seated prevents intermittent faults. Deleting temporary files and defragmenting the disk prevents slowdowns and the disk filling. Updating the operating system and antivirus closes the security holes malware uses. Taking regular backups prevents permanent data loss when hardware eventually fails.
items.ne: Preventive maintenance भनेको अझै चलिरहेको प्रणालीमा खराबी रोक्न र उपकरणको आयु बढाउन गरिने काम हो। प्वाल, पंखा र heatsink को धुलो सफा गर्दा तात्ने र अचानक बन्द हुने समस्या रोकिन्छ। केबल र कार्ड कसिएका छन् कि जाँच्दा रुकिरुकी आउने खराबी रोकिन्छ। अस्थायी फाइल मेटाउँदा र डिस्क defragment गर्दा ढिलो हुने र डिस्क भरिने समस्या रोकिन्छ। OS र antivirus अपडेट गर्दा malware भित्रिने प्वाल बन्द हुन्छ। नियमित ब्याकअपले हार्डवेयर बिग्रिँदा हुने स्थायी data क्षति रोक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A surge protector guards against a surge or spike — a brief, very high rise in voltage — by diverting the excess away from the equipment. A voltage stabiliser guards against a sag or brownout by holding the output steady when the incoming voltage drops below normal. A UPS contains a battery and is the only one of the three that can supply power during a complete blackout, giving enough time to save work and shut down properly; it also filters noise.
items.ne: Surge protector ले surge वा spike — छोटो तर धेरै ठूलो भोल्टेज बढाइ — बाट जोगाउँछ, बढी बिजुली उपकरणबाट अन्तै पठाएर। Voltage stabiliser ले आउने भोल्टेज सामान्यभन्दा तल झर्दा आउटपुट स्थिर राखेर sag वा brownout बाट जोगाउँछ। UPS मा ब्याट्री हुन्छ र पूरै blackout मा बिजुली दिन सक्ने तीनमध्ये एक मात्र यही हो, जसले काम बचाएर ठीकसँग बन्द गर्न पुग्ने समय दिन्छ; यसले noise पनि छान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A computer virus is a malicious program that attaches itself to another program or file and copies itself to other files or computers when the host is run. Prevention: install antivirus software and keep it updated; scan USB drives and other removable media before opening them; do not open email attachments from unknown senders; avoid pirated software; disable autorun; and keep regular backups.
items.ne: Computer virus भनेको अर्को प्रोग्राम वा फाइलमा टाँसिने र त्यो चल्दा आफूलाई अन्य फाइल वा कम्प्युटरमा सार्ने हानिकारक प्रोग्राम हो। रोकथाम: antivirus राख्ने र अपडेट गरिराख्ने; USB र अन्य मिडिया खोल्नुअघि स्क्यान गर्ने; नचिनेकाको इमेल attachment नखोल्ने; चोरी सफ्टवेयर नचलाउने; autorun बन्द गर्ने; र नियमित ब्याकअप राख्ने।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Surge = too high, sag = too low, blackout = none. Only a UPS has a battery.
items.ne: Surge = धेरै बढी, sag = धेरै कम, blackout = बिल्कुलै छैन। ब्याट्री UPS मा मात्र।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A processor needs a heatsink, thermal paste and a fan, and the case needs a clear front-to-back airflow path. Thermal shutdown is protection working correctly.
items.ne: प्रोसेसरलाई heatsink, thermal paste र पंखा चाहिन्छ, र केसमा अगाडिदेखि पछाडिसम्म हावाको खुला बाटो। तापले बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा ठीकसँग चलेको हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Blurry screen → wrong resolution. Flicker → low refresh rate. Artefacts → video card overheating.
items.ne: धमिलो स्क्रिन → गलत resolution। झिमझिम → कम refresh rate। बिग्रिएका आकार → video card तात्दै।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A virus attaches to a host and spreads when it runs. Antivirus only works if it is kept updated, and backups are the last defence.
items.ne: भाइरस कुनै host मा टाँसिन्छ र त्यो चल्दा सर्छ। Antivirus अपडेट गरे मात्र काम लाग्छ, र ब्याकअप अन्तिम रक्षा हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: a fault that appears only after the machine warms up is one of the few whose cause is written in its timing. Students who never learn to read that will replace a processor to fix a dusty heatsink.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: मेसिन तातेपछि मात्र देखिने खराबी ती थोरैमध्ये एक हो जसको कारण समयमै लेखिएको हुन्छ। यो पढ्न नसिकेका विद्यार्थीले धुलो भरिएको heatsink मिलाउन प्रोसेसरै साट्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: Why this matters: two of these four cases are faults a technician meets constantly — an RJ-11 plug sitting loose in an RJ-45 socket, and headphones in the microphone jack. Both "fit", both fail, and neither gives an error message.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: यी चारमध्ये दुई त्यस्ता खराबी हुन् जुन टेक्निसियनले बारम्बार भेट्छ — RJ-45 सकेटमा खुकुलो बसेको RJ-11 प्लग, र माइक्रोफोन ज्याकमा घुसाइएको हेडफोन। दुवै "अटाउँछन्", दुवै चल्दैनन्, र कुनैले त्रुटि सन्देश दिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: choosing the wrong protective device is an expensive mistake in the real world. A surge protector on a site with frequent cuts protects against the one problem that site does not have.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: गलत सुरक्षा उपकरण छान्नु वास्तविक जीवनमा महँगो गल्ती हो। बारम्बार बिजुली जाने ठाउँमा surge protector राख्नु भनेको त्यहाँ नभएकै समस्याबाट जोगिनु हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Preventive maintenance is done while the system still works. Pair each task with the failure it prevents.
items.ne: Preventive maintenance प्रणाली चलिरहेकै बेला गरिन्छ। हरेक कामसँग त्यसले रोक्ने खराबी जोड्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Preventive maintenance is work done on a system that is still working, to stop failures before they happen and to extend the equipment's life. Each task exists because of a specific failure it prevents — that pairing is what the exam wants, not the list on its own: Cleaning dust from vents, fans and heatsinks — prevents overheating and the sudden shutdowns it causes. Checking that all cables and cards are firmly seated — prevents intermittent faults that are very hard to trace. Deleting temporary files and defragmenting the disk — prevents slowdowns and the disk filling up. Updating the operating system and antivirus — closes the security holes malware uses to get in. Taking regular backups — the only preventive measure that works after the hardware has already failed. Using a UPS and keeping the machine in a cool, dry, ventilated place — prevents damage from power problems, heat and humidity.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Preventive maintenance भनेको अझै चलिरहेको प्रणालीमा गरिने काम हो, जसले खराबी हुनुअघि नै रोक्छ र उपकरणको आयु बढाउँछ। हरेक काम कुनै निश्चित खराबी रोक्न छ — परीक्षाले खोज्ने त्यही जोडी हो, एक्लो सूची होइन: प्वाल, पंखा र heatsink को धुलो सफा गर्ने — तात्ने समस्या र त्यसले ल्याउने अचानक बन्द हुने अवस्था रोक्छ। सबै केबल र कार्ड कसिएका छन् कि जाँच्ने — पत्ता लगाउन गाह्रो हुने रुकिरुकी आउने खराबी रोक्छ। अस्थायी फाइल मेटाउने र डिस्क defragment गर्ने — ढिलो हुने र डिस्क भरिने समस्या रोक्छ। अपरेटिङ सिस्टम र antivirus अपडेट गर्ने — malware भित्रिने सुरक्षा प्वाल बन्द गर्छ। नियमित ब्याकअप लिने — हार्डवेयर बिग्रिसकेपछि पनि काम लाग्ने एक मात्र निरोधात्मक उपाय। UPS प्रयोग गर्ने र मेसिन चिसो, सुक्खा, हावा खेल्ने ठाउँमा राख्ने — बिजुली समस्या, ताप र आर्द्रताबाट हुने क्षति रोक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Four things can go wrong with mains power, and a different device protects against each: Surge / spike — a brief, very large rise in voltage, often from lightning or heavy machinery switching off. Protected by a surge protector, which diverts the excess. Sag / brownout — voltage that drops below normal but does not disappear. It can make a system unstable and restart without warning. Protected by a voltage stabiliser. Blackout — power fails completely. Only a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) helps, because it holds a battery that carries the machine long enough to save work and shut down properly. Noise — small unwanted variations riding on the supply. Filtered by a UPS or a conditioner. A UPS is not a generator. It buys minutes, not hours, and its purpose is a clean shutdown.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् मुख्य बिजुलीमा चार किसिमका समस्या आउँछन्, र हरेकबाट फरक उपकरणले जोगाउँछ: Surge / spike — छोटो तर धेरै ठूलो भोल्टेज बढाइ, प्रायः चट्याङ वा ठूलो मेसिन बन्द हुँदा। Surge protector ले जोगाउँछ, जसले बढी बिजुली अन्तै पठाउँछ। Sag / brownout — भोल्टेज सामान्यभन्दा तल झर्नु, तर पूरै नजानु। प्रणाली अस्थिर बनाउँछ र चेतावनीबिनै रिस्टार्ट गराउँछ। Voltage stabiliser ले जोगाउँछ। Blackout — बिजुली पूरै जानु। UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) ले मात्र काम गर्छ, किनकि यसमा ब्याट्री हुन्छ जसले काम बचाएर ठीकसँग बन्द गर्न पुग्ने बेर मेसिन चलाइराख्छ। Noise — सप्लाईमै मिसिएर आउने साना अवाञ्छित उतारचढाव। UPS वा conditioner ले छान्छ। UPS जेनेरेटर होइन। यसले घण्टा होइन, मिनेट दिन्छ, र यसको उद्देश्य सफासँग बन्द गर्नु हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A processor turns electrical power into work and heat. If the heat is not carried away as fast as it is produced, the temperature climbs until the board shuts the machine down to protect the chip. How a processor is cooled: a heatsink of metal fins sits on the chip, with a thin layer of thermal paste filling the microscopic gaps so heat crosses into it. A fan moves air through the fins. The case provides the path: cool air in at the front, warm air out at the back. Processor power and voltage: the board supplies the processor through its own regulator at a low, precisely held voltage. Too low and the system is unstable; too high and the chip is damaged. This is why overclocking without care destroys processors. Thermal shutdown is protection, not a fault. A machine that turns itself off when hot is working correctly — the fault is whatever is stopping the heat leaving.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् प्रोसेसरले विद्युतीय शक्तिलाई काम र ताप मा बदल्छ। उत्पादन भएको गतिमै ताप बाहिर नगए तापक्रम बढ्दै जान्छ र चिप जोगाउन बोर्डले मेसिन बन्द गरिदिन्छ। प्रोसेसर कसरी चिसो पारिन्छ: चिपमाथि धातुका पत्र भएको heatsink राखिन्छ, र सूक्ष्म खाली ठाउँ भर्न पातलो thermal paste लगाइन्छ ताकि ताप त्यसमा सरोस्। पंखा ले पत्रबीच हावा चलाउँछ। केस ले बाटो दिन्छ: अगाडिबाट चिसो हावा भित्र, पछाडिबाट न्यानो हावा बाहिर। प्रोसेसरको बिजुली र भोल्टेज: बोर्डले आफ्नै regulator मार्फत प्रोसेसरलाई कम र ठ्याक्कै स्थिर भोल्टेज दिन्छ। कम भए प्रणाली अस्थिर हुन्छ; बढी भए चिप बिग्रिन्छ। ध्यान नपुर्‍याई overclock गर्दा प्रोसेसर नष्ट हुनुको कारण यही हो। तापका कारण बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा हो, खराबी होइन। तातेपछि आफैँ बन्द हुने मेसिन ठीकसँग चलिरहेको छ — ताप बाहिर जान नदिने जुनसुकै कुरा नै खराबी हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: In this order 1. Is the adapter switched on? Many laptops have a physical switch or a keyboard shortcut, and flight mode disables it entirely. This is the commonest cause and the fastest to check. 2. Is the network visible? If no networks appear at all, the fault is the adapter or its driver. If other networks appear but yours does not, the fault is at the router. 3. Does it connect but not reach the internet? Then the wireless link is fine and the problem is beyond the router — the connection to the provider. 4. Is the signal weak? Distance, thick walls and interference from other equipment all reduce it. Moving closer is a diagnostic step, not just a workaround. 5. Is it the password or the security setting? A wrong key gives a connection that keeps dropping and reconnecting rather than a clean failure.
items.ne: यही क्रममा १. Adapter खुला छ? धेरै ल्यापटपमा भौतिक स्विच वा किबोर्ड सर्टकट हुन्छ, र flight mode ले पूरै बन्द गर्छ। सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण र सबैभन्दा छिटो जाँच यही हो। २. नेटवर्क देखिन्छ? कुनै पनि नेटवर्क नदेखिए खराबी adapter वा यसको driver मा छ। अरू देखिने तर आफ्नो नदेखिने भए खराबी router मा छ। ३. जोडिन्छ तर इन्टरनेट आउँदैन? त्यसो भए वायरलेस जडान ठीक छ र समस्या router भन्दा पर — सेवा प्रदायकसँगको जडानमा छ। ४. सिग्नल कमजोर छ? दूरी, बाक्लो भित्ता र अरू उपकरणको हस्तक्षेपले घटाउँछ। नजिक सर्नु समाधान मात्र होइन, निदानको एउटा चरण पनि हो। ५. पासवर्ड वा security सेटिङ हो? गलत key ले सफासँग असफल हुनुको साटो बारम्बार जोडिने र छुट्ने जडान दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A computer virus is a malicious program that attaches itself to another program or file, and copies itself to other files or computers when that host is run. How infection spreads: infected USB drives and external media; email attachments; downloads from untrusted sites; pirated software; and network shares. Signs of infection: the computer slows down for no clear reason; files disappear, change size or will not open; programs start or crash on their own; unexpected messages appear; free disk space falls quickly; the antivirus has been disabled. Detection and protection: install antivirus software and keep it updated — an out-of-date scanner cannot recognise a new virus. Scan removable media before opening it. Enable a firewall. Keep the operating system patched. Prevention: do not open attachments from unknown senders, do not install pirated software, disable autorun on removable media, and take regular backups — the last defence when everything else has failed.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Computer virus भनेको अर्को प्रोग्राम वा फाइलमा टाँसिने र त्यो चल्दा आफूलाई अन्य फाइल वा कम्प्युटरमा सार्ने हानिकारक प्रोग्राम हो। कसरी सर्छ: सङ्क्रमित USB र बाहिरी मिडिया; इमेल attachment; अविश्वसनीय साइटबाट डाउनलोड; चोरी सफ्टवेयर; र नेटवर्क share। सङ्क्रमणका लक्षण: स्पष्ट कारणबिनै कम्प्युटर ढिलो हुनु; फाइल हराउनु, आकार बदलिनु वा नखुल्नु; प्रोग्राम आफैँ खुल्नु वा बन्द हुनु; अनपेक्षित सन्देश देखिनु; खाली ठाउँ छिट्टै घट्नु; antivirus बन्द भइदिनु। पत्ता लगाउने र जोगाउने: antivirus राख्नुहोस् र अपडेट गरिराख्नुहोस् — पुरानो स्क्यानरले नयाँ भाइरस चिन्न सक्दैन। बाहिरी मिडिया खोल्नुअघि स्क्यान गर्नुहोस्। Firewall खोल्नुहोस्। अपरेटिङ सिस्टम अपडेट राख्नुहोस्। रोकथाम: नचिनेको पठाउनेको attachment नखोल्नुहोस्, चोरी सफ्टवेयर नराख्नुहोस्, हटाउन मिल्ने मिडियाको autorun बन्द गर्नुहोस्, र नियमित ब्याकअप लिनुहोस् — सबै असफल भएपछिको अन्तिम रक्षा यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Shutdown is the protection, not the fault. Only a UPS has a battery.
items.ne: बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा हो, खराबी होइन। ब्याट्री UPS मा मात्र हुन्छ।

items.en: Differentiate between a UPS, a surge protector and a voltage stabiliser.

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: What is a computer virus? State any three ways of preventing infection.
items.ne: Computer virus के हो? सङ्क्रमण रोक्ने कुनै तीन उपाय लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Read what the problem actually is: the power disappears. A surge protector handles voltage that is too high and a stabiliser handles voltage that is too low — neither can supply power that is not there. Only a UPS carries its own battery, and that is why it is the only one of the three that helps in a blackout.
items.ne: समस्या के हो पढ्नुहोस्: बिजुली हराउँछ। Surge protector ले धेरै बढी भोल्टेज सम्हाल्छ र stabiliser ले धेरै कम — नभएको बिजुली दुवैले दिन सक्दैनन्। UPS सँग मात्र आफ्नै ब्याट्री हुन्छ, र तीनमध्ये blackout मा काम लाग्ने एक मात्र यही हुनुको कारण त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Unit 5 is troubleshooting applied to specific parts, so it assumes the method from Unit 4: cheapest check first, one change at a time, and reading the timing of a fault as evidence.
items.ne: युनिट ५ भनेको निश्चित भागमा लगाइएको troubleshooting हो, त्यसैले युनिट ४ को विधि थाहा भएको मान्छ: सस्तो जाँच पहिले, एकपटकमा एउटा परिवर्तन, र खराबीको समयलाई प्रमाणका रूपमा पढ्ने।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A school has frequent power cuts and loses unsaved work every time. Which device solves the problem? एउटा विद्यालयमा बारम्बार बिजुली जान्छ र हरेक पटक नबचाइएको काम हराउँछ। कुन उपकरणले यो समस्या समाधान गर्छ? A surge protector A voltage stabiliser A UPS Read what the problem actually is: the power disappears. A surge protector handles voltage that is too high and a stabiliser handles voltage that is too low — neither can supply power that is not there. Only a UPS carries its own battery, and that is why it is the only one of the three that helps in a blackout. समस्या के हो पढ्नुहोस्: बिजुली हराउँछ। Surge protector ले धेरै बढी भोल्टेज सम्हाल्छ र stabiliser ले धेरै कम — नभएको बिजुली दुवैले दिन सक्दैनन्। UPS सँग मात्र आफ्नै ब्याट्री हुन्छ, र तीनमध्ये blackout मा काम लाग्ने एक मात्र यही हुनुको कारण त्यही हो। 5.3 Cooling, ventilation and processor power Definition — learn this wording A processor turns electrical power into work and heat. If the heat is not carried away as fast as it is produced, the temperature climbs until the board shuts the machine down to protect the chip. How a processor is cooled: a heatsink of metal fins sits on the chip, with a thin layer of thermal paste filling the microscopic gaps so heat crosses into it. A fan moves air through the fins. The case provides the path: cool air in at the front, warm air out at the back. Processor power and voltage: the board supplies the processor through its own regulator at a low, precisely held voltage. Too low and the system is unstable; too high and the chip is damaged. This is why overclocking without care destroys processors. Thermal shutdown is protection, not a fault. A machine that turns itself off when hot is working correctly — the fault is whatever is stopping the heat leaving. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् प्रोसेसरले विद्युतीय शक्तिलाई काम र ताप मा बदल्छ। उत्पादन भएको गतिमै ताप बाहिर नगए तापक्रम बढ्दै जान्छ र चिप जोगाउन बोर्डले मेसिन बन्द गरिदिन्छ। प्रोसेसर कसरी चिसो पारिन्छ: चिपमाथि धातुका पत्र भएको heatsink राखिन्छ, र सूक्ष्म खाली ठाउँ भर्न पातलो thermal paste लगाइन्छ ताकि ताप त्यसमा सरोस्। पंखा ले पत्रबीच हावा चलाउँछ। केस ले बाटो दिन्छ: अगाडिबाट चिसो हावा भित्र, पछाडिबाट न्यानो हावा बाहिर। प्रोसेसरको बिजुली र भोल्टेज: बोर्डले आफ्नै regulator मार्फत प्रोसेसरलाई कम र ठ्याक्कै स्थिर भोल्टेज दिन्छ। कम भए प्रणाली अस्थिर हुन्छ; बढी भए चिप बिग्रिन्छ। ध्यान नपुर्‍याई overclock गर्दा प्रोसेसर नष्ट हुनुको कारण यही हो। तापका कारण बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा हो, खराबी होइन। तातेपछि आफैँ बन्द हुने मेसिन ठीकसँग चलिरहेको छ — ताप बाहिर जान नदिने जुनसुकै कुरा नै खराबी हो। {{dia:hwCooling}} One path, front to back. Dust on the fins is an insulator: the processor makes its normal heat and simply cannot get rid of it. एउटै बाटो, अगाडिबाट पछाडि। पत्रमा जमेको धुलो इन्सुलेटर हो: प्रोसेसरले सामान्य ताप निकाल्छ तर त्यो बाहिर पठाउनै सक्दैन। Diagnose it yourself

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · आफैँ निदान गर्नुहोस् The fault lab — it restarts by itself after a while What you will learn: to use the timing of a fault as evidence. This scenario cannot be solved by naming a part — it is solved by noticing when the failure happens and what that rules out. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: खराबीको समय लाई प्रमाणका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न। यो अवस्था पार्टको नाम भनेर समाधान हुँदैन — कहिले बिग्रिन्छ र त्यसले के हटाउँछ भनी ध्यान दिएर हुन्छ। Why this matters: a fault that appears only after the machine warms up is one of the few whose cause is written in its timing. Students who never learn to read that will replace a processor to fix a dusty heatsink.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: मेसिन तातेपछि मात्र देखिने खराबी ती थोरैमध्ये एक हो जसको कारण समयमै लेखिएको हुन्छ। यो पढ्न नसिकेका विद्यार्थीले धुलो भरिएको heatsink मिलाउन प्रोसेसरै साट्छन्। 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults Symptom Most likely cause What to do Screen blurry or stretchedस्क्रिन धमिलो वा तानिएको Resolution not set to the monitor's native valueMonitor को आफ्नै resolution मा सेट नभएको Set the recommended resolution in display settingsDisplay सेटिङमा सिफारिस गरिएको resolution राख्ने Wrong or missing coloursरङ गलत वा नआएको Loose or damaged video cable — a bent pinVideo केबल खुकुलो वा बिग्रेको — पिन बाङ्गिएको Reseat the cable; check the pins; try another cableकेबल फेरि कस्ने; पिन हेर्ने; अर्को केबल जोड्ने Flickering, tiring to look atझिमझिम, हेर्न थकाइ लाग्ने Refresh rate set too lowRefresh rate धेरै कम राखिएको Raise it to the highest the monitor supportsMonitor ले सक्ने सबैभन्दा माथि बढाउने Distorted patterns or artefacts on screenस्क्रिनमा बिग्रिएका आकार वा धब्बा Video card overheating or failingVideo card तात्दै वा बिग्रँदै Clean its fan and fins; reseat the card; test in another slotयसको पंखा र पत्र सफा गर्ने; कार्ड फेरि बसाल्ने; अर्को slot मा जाँच्ने Device not recognised at allउपकरण पत्तै नलागेको Loose connector, dead port, or a missing driverConnector खुकुलो, पोर्ट मरेको, वा driver नभएको Try another port, then another cable, then install the driverअर्को पोर्ट, अनि अर्को केबल, अनि driver इन्स्टल Practise the judgement
items.ne: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which power problem is this, and what protects against it? What you will learn: to match a described power event to the right protective device — which is exactly how this topic is examined, rather than as four definitions in a row. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णन गरिएको बिजुली घटनालाई ठीक सुरक्षा उपकरणसँग मिलाउन — यो विषय चार परिभाषा लहरै सोधेर होइन, ठ्याक्कै यसै गरी जाँचिन्छ। Why this matters: choosing the wrong protective device is an expensive mistake in the real world. A surge protector on a site with frequent cuts protects against the one problem that site does not have.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: गलत सुरक्षा उपकरण छान्नु वास्तविक जीवनमा महँगो गल्ती हो। बारम्बार बिजुली जाने ठाउँमा surge protector राख्नु भनेको त्यहाँ नभएकै समस्याबाट जोगिनु हो। Example 1 Choosing power protection for a real site Question: a school computer lab has three problems: the voltage drops noticeably at peak hours, the power fails completely two or three times a week, and there are lightning storms in the monsoon. What do you install, and why? Three problems are listed. Decide how many devices are actually needed before you read on.तीन समस्या लेखिएका छन्। पढ्नुअघि साँच्चै कति उपकरण चाहिन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। Step 1 — name each problem. Voltage dropping at peak hours is a sag. Power failing completely is a blackout. Lightning is a surge. Step 2 — match a device to each. Sag needs a stabiliser. Blackout needs a UPS. Surge needs a surge protector. Step 3 — check for overlap before buying three things. A UPS already provides surge protection and filtering, and most units regulate voltage within a range as well. So a UPS with built-in voltage regulation covers all three. Step 4 — state what it does not cover. A UPS gives minutes, not hours. If the cuts last longer than the battery, its job is a clean shutdown, and a generator is a separate decision. Answer A UPS with built-in voltage regulation — it answers all three, and only the blackout genuinely required a battery. The examiner is testing whether you match the device to the problem. Recommending a surge protector for a site whose real complaint is power cuts protects against the one thing that site did not report. परीक्षकले तपाईंले उपकरणलाई समस्या सँग मिलाउनुहुन्छ कि हेर्छ। बिजुली जाने गुनासो भएको ठाउँमा surge protector सिफारिस गर्नु भनेको त्यहाँ नभनिएकै कुराबाट जोगाउनु हो। Example 2 A monitor problem, narrowed in three checks Question: a user reports that their screen "looks wrong". On inspection the picture is blurry, slightly stretched, and there is a faint pink tint on the left side. How do you proceed? Step 1 — separate the complaints. There are two independent symptoms here: geometry (blurry and stretched) and colour (a pink tint). Treating them as one fault is what makes this look hard. Step 2 — deal with the geometry first, because it costs nothing. Blurry and stretched on a flat panel means the resolution is not the monitor's native value. Set the recommended resolution; the picture becomes sharp and the correct shape. Step 3 — the tint remains, so it is a separate fault. A colour cast confined to one area of the screen points at the signal, not the settings. Check the video cable for a bent or pushed-in pin, and reseat it at both ends. Step 4 — confirm. One pin was not making contact. With the cable reseated the tint goes. Verify both symptoms are gone before closing the job. Answer Two faults, not one: wrong resolution (a setting) and a video cable pin (hardware). Fixing either alone would have left the user still complaining. When a user reports several things at once, count the faults before you start. A "fix" that clears two of three symptoms is reported back as "it is still broken". प्रयोगकर्ताले एकैचोटि धेरै कुरा भन्दा सुरु गर्नुअघि खराबी कति छन् गन्नुहोस्। तीनमध्ये दुई लक्षण हटाउने "समाधान" फेरि "अझै बिग्रेकै छ" भनेर फर्किन्छ। Mistakes that cost marks here Calling a thermal shutdown a fault. The shutdown is the protection working. The fault is the blocked airflow, the stopped fan or the dried thermal paste. तापले बन्द हुनुलाई खराबी भन्नु। बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा चलेको हो। खराबी भनेको रोकिएको हावा, नचल्ने पंखा वा सुकेको thermal paste हो। Saying a surge protector protects against power cuts. It handles voltage that is too high. Only a UPS has a battery, so only a UPS helps in a blackout. Surge protector ले बिजुली जानुबाट जोगाउँछ भन्नु। यसले बढी भोल्टेज सम्हाल्छ। ब्याट्री UPS मा मात्र हुन्छ, त्यसैले blackout मा UPS मात्र काम लाग्छ। Writing "install antivirus" without "and update it". An antivirus that is never updated cannot recognise anything released after it was installed. "अपडेट गर्ने" नलेखी "antivirus राख्ने" मात्र लेख्नु। कहिल्यै अपडेट नगरिएको antivirus ले इन्स्टल भएपछि आएको कुनै पनि कुरा चिन्न सक्दैन। Cleaning inside a machine with a wet cloth or a household vacuum. Use dry compressed air. Moisture and static both destroy components. मेसिनभित्र भिजेको कपडा वा घरायसी भ्याकुमले सफा गर्नु। सुक्खा कम्प्रेस्ड एयर प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। चिस्यान र static दुवैले पार्ट नष्ट गर्छन्। Shutdown is the protection, not the fault. Only a UPS has a battery. बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा हो, खराबी होइन। ब्याट्री UPS मा मात्र हुन्छ। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit This unit is the widest in the subject — eleven topics for 9 marks — so questions are short and drawn from anywhere in it. The reliable ones are: list preventive maintenance tasks (pair each with the failure it prevents and you answer a 4-mark question with a 3-mark list), differentiate UPS, surge protector and voltage stabiliser, what is a computer virus and how do you prevent infection, and why must a processor be cooled. Expect at least one symptom-to-cause question drawn from the display and connection faults. यो विषयकै सबैभन्दा फराकिलो युनिट हो — ९ अंकका लागि एघार विषय — त्यसैले प्रश्न छोटा र जताबाट पनि आउन सक्ने हुन्छन्। भरपर्दा प्रश्न: निरोधात्मक सम्भारका काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (हरेकसँग रोकिने खराबी जोड्नुभयो भने ३ अंकको सूचीले ४ अंकको प्रश्न उत्तर हुन्छ), UPS, surge protector र voltage stabiliser छुट्याउनुहोस्, कम्प्युटर भाइरस के हो र सङ्क्रमण कसरी रोक्ने, र प्रोसेसर किन चिसो पार्नुपर्छ। Display र जडान खराबीबाट कम्तीमा एउटा लक्षण–कारण प्रश्न आउने अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस्। Q1 4 marks What is preventive maintenance? List any four tasks and state what each one prevents. Preventive maintenance के हो? कुनै चार काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् र हरेकले के रोक्छ भन्नुहोस्। Show the answer Preventive maintenance is work carried out on a system that is still functioning, in order to prevent failures and extend equipment life. Cleaning dust from vents, fans and heatsinks prevents overheating and unexpected shutdowns. Checking that cables and cards are firmly seated prevents intermittent faults. Deleting temporary files and defragmenting the disk prevents slowdowns and the disk filling. Updating the operating system and antivirus closes the security holes malware uses. Taking regular backups prevents permanent data loss when hardware eventually fails. Preventive maintenance भनेको अझै चलिरहेको प्रणालीमा खराबी रोक्न र उपकरणको आयु बढाउन गरिने काम हो। प्वाल, पंखा र heatsink को धुलो सफा गर्दा तात्ने र अचानक बन्द हुने समस्या रोकिन्छ। केबल र कार्ड कसिएका छन् कि जाँच्दा रुकिरुकी आउने खराबी रोकिन्छ। अस्थायी फाइल मेटाउँदा र डिस्क defragment गर्दा ढिलो हुने र डिस्क भरिने समस्या रोकिन्छ। OS र antivirus अपडेट गर्दा malware भित्रिने प्वाल बन्द हुन्छ। नियमित ब्याकअपले हार्डवेयर बिग्रिँदा हुने स्थायी data क्षति रोक्छ। Q2 3 marks Differentiate between a UPS, a surge protector and a voltage stabiliser. UPS, surge protector र voltage stabiliser बीचको फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्। Show the answer A surge protector guards against a surge or spike — a brief, very high rise in voltage — by diverting the excess away from the equipment. A voltage stabiliser guards against a sag or brownout by holding the output steady when the incoming voltage drops below normal. A UPS contains a battery and is the only one of the three that can supply power during a complete blackout, giving enough time to save work and shut down properly; it also filters noise. Surge protector ले surge वा spike — छोटो तर धेरै ठूलो भोल्टेज बढाइ — बाट जोगाउँछ, बढी बिजुली उपकरणबाट अन्तै पठाएर। Voltage stabiliser ले आउने भोल्टेज सामान्यभन्दा तल झर्दा आउटपुट स्थिर राखेर sag वा brownout बाट जोगाउँछ। UPS मा ब्याट्री हुन्छ र पूरै blackout मा बिजुली दिन सक्ने तीनमध्ये एक मात्र यही हो, जसले काम बचाएर ठीकसँग बन्द गर्न पुग्ने समय दिन्छ; यसले noise पनि छान्छ। Q3 2 marks What is a computer virus? State any three ways of preventing infection. Computer virus के हो? सङ्क्रमण रोक्ने कुनै तीन उपाय लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer A computer virus is a malicious program that attaches itself to another program or file and copies itself to other files or computers when the host is run. Prevention: install antivirus software and keep it updated; scan USB drives and other removable media before opening them; do not open email attachments from unknown senders; avoid pirated software; disable autorun; and keep regular backups. Computer virus भनेको अर्को प्रोग्राम वा फाइलमा टाँसिने र त्यो चल्दा आफूलाई अन्य फाइल वा कम्प्युटरमा सार्ने हानिकारक प्रोग्राम हो। रोकथाम: antivirus राख्ने र अपडेट गरिराख्ने; USB र अन्य मिडिया खोल्नुअघि स्क्यान गर्ने; नचिनेकाको इमेल attachment नखोल्ने; चोरी सफ्टवेयर नचलाउने; autorun बन्द गर्ने; र नियमित ब्याकअप राख्ने। Key points to revise
