items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What you will learn: to use the timing of a fault as evidence. This scenario cannot be solved by naming a part — it is solved by noticing when the failure happens and what that rules out.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: खराबीको समय लाई प्रमाणका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न। यो अवस्था पार्टको नाम भनेर समाधान हुँदैन — कहिले बिग्रिन्छ र त्यसले के हटाउँछ भनी ध्यान दिएर हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 5.4 Display, video card and device connection faults
items.en: What you will learn: to choose a port from what is being connected rather than from the shape of the plug — because several connectors physically fit sockets they do not belong in, and "it fits" is the reasoning that produces a device that never works.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्लगको आकार होइन, के जोड्दै हुनुहुन्छ हेरेर पोर्ट छान्न — किनकि धेरै connector नमिल्ने सकेटमा पनि भौतिक रूपमा अटाउँछन्, र "अटायो" भन्ने तर्कले नै कहिल्यै नचल्ने उपकरण बनाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What you will learn: to match a described power event to the right protective device — which is exactly how this topic is examined, rather than as four definitions in a row.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णन गरिएको बिजुली घटनालाई ठीक सुरक्षा उपकरणसँग मिलाउन — यो विषय चार परिभाषा लहरै सोधेर होइन, ठ्याक्कै यसै गरी जाँचिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Differential = since the last FULL backup, which is why each one grows larger than the last but a restore needs only two sets. Option 1 describes an incremental backup. Swapping these two reverses every answer about restore time, so it is worth learning as a pair.
items.ne: Differential = अन्तिम FULL ब्याकअपपछि — त्यसैले हरेक अघिल्लो भन्दा ठूलो हुँदै जान्छ तर फर्काउन दुई सेट मात्र चाहिन्छ। पहिलो विकल्पले incremental वर्णन गर्छ। यी दुई साट्दा फर्काउने समयसम्बन्धी हरेक उत्तर उल्टिन्छ, त्यसैले जोडी बनाएरै सिक्नु राम्रो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Each incremental holds only what changed since the previous backup, so the chain must be replayed in order: Monday's full set, then Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. That is five. Option 2 would be right for a DIFFERENTIAL scheme — which is exactly the trade differential buys with its larger daily sets.
items.ne: हरेक incremental मा अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको मात्र हुन्छ, त्यसैले शृंखला क्रमैसँग लगाउनुपर्छ: सोमबारको full, अनि मंगल, बुध, बिहीबार र शुक्रबार। जम्मा पाँच। दोस्रो विकल्प DIFFERENTIAL योजनाका लागि सही हुन्थ्यो — differential ले ठूला दैनिक सेटको बदलामा किन्ने कुरा ठ्याक्कै त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: RAID 5 stripes data with parity spread across the disks, and the parity has to live somewhere other than the data it protects — so three is the minimum. RAID 0 and RAID 1 both need two.
items.ne: RAID 5 ले parity सबै डिस्कमा फैलाएर striping गर्छ, र parity ले जोगाउने data भन्दा अन्तै बस्नुपर्छ — त्यसैले न्यूनतम तीन। RAID 0 र RAID 1 दुवैलाई दुई चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Mirroring copies every write to both disks, and a deletion is a write. Both lose the folder in the same instant. RAID protects against a DISK failing — a mechanical event. It gives no protection against deletion, corruption, a virus or ransomware, because to the array those are ordinary valid writes. Only a separate backup recovers this.
items.ne: Mirroring ले हरेक लेखाइ दुवै डिस्कमा सार्छ, र मेटाइ पनि लेखाइ हो। दुवैले एकै क्षणमा फोल्डर गुमाउँछन्। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिनु — यान्त्रिक घटना — बाट जोगाउँछ। मेटाइ, बिग्रिनु, भाइरस वा ransomware बाट जोगाउँदैन, किनकि array का लागि ती साधारण वैध लेखाइ हुन्। छुट्टै ब्याकअपले मात्र यो फर्काउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Son = daily, father = weekly, grandfather = monthly, oldest generation last. Keeping several generations is what protects against damage that is noticed late — if only one daily set existed and it were overwritten each day, every copy you hold would contain the same corruption.
items.ne: Son = दैनिक, father = साप्ताहिक, grandfather = मासिक — सबैभन्दा पुरानो पुस्ता अन्तिम। धेरै पुस्ता राख्नुले ढिलो थाहा हुने क्षतिबाट जोगाउँछ — दैनिक एउटै सेट भई हरेक दिन ओभरराइट भइरहे तपाईंसँग भएका सबै प्रतिलिपिमा उही बिग्रिने कुरा हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A system restore point rolls the operating system's settings and drivers back to an earlier state, which is exactly the problem here. Data recovery software is for deleted files — none are missing. Clean-room recovery is for physical drive damage, and a RAID rebuild is for a failed disk; neither applies.
items.ne: System restore point ले अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सेटिङ र driver अघिल्लो अवस्थामा फर्काउँछ — यहाँको समस्या ठ्याक्कै त्यही हो। Data recovery सफ्टवेयर मेटिएका फाइलका लागि हो — यहाँ केही हराएको छैन। Clean-room रिकभरी भौतिक क्षतिका लागि, र RAID rebuild बिग्रेको डिस्कका लागि; दुवै लागू हुँदैनन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Calling RAID a backup. RAID survives a disk failing. It mirrors deletion, corruption and ransomware faithfully onto every disk in the array.
items.ne: RAID लाई ब्याकअप भन्नु। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिँदा जोगाउँछ। मेटाइ, बिग्रिनु र ransomware लाई array का हरेक डिस्कमा जस्ताको तस्तै सार्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Full, incremental and differential backups across one working week.
items.ne: एउटा कार्य-हप्ताभरि full, incremental र differential backup।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A FULL backup copies everything, every time. Restoring is simple — you need one set — but it takes the longest and uses the most media.
items.ne: FULL backup ले हरेक पटक सबै कुरा कपी गर्छ। पुनर्स्थापना सजिलो — एउटै सेट चाहिन्छ — तर समय सबैभन्दा बढी लाग्छ र मिडिया पनि धेरै खपत हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: INCREMENTAL copies only what changed since the LAST backup of any kind. Each day is small and quick. But to restore Friday you need Monday's full set plus every increment in between — miss one and the chain is broken.
items.ne: INCREMENTAL ले जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो backup पछि बदलिएको मात्र कपी गर्छ। हरेक दिनको सानो र छिटो हुन्छ। तर शुक्रबार फर्काउन सोमबारको full सेट र बीचका सबै increment चाहिन्छन् — एउटा छुट्यो भने शृंखला टुट्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: DIFFERENTIAL copies everything changed since the last FULL backup. Each day is bigger than the one before, but a restore needs exactly two sets: the full one and the most recent differential. That is the trade — more media for a simpler recovery.
items.ne: DIFFERENTIAL ले अन्तिम FULL backup पछि बदलिएको सबै कपी गर्छ। हरेक दिनको अघिल्लो भन्दा ठूलो हुन्छ, तर पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट चाहिन्छ: full र सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो differential। सौदा यही हो — सजिलो रिकभरीका लागि बढी मिडिया।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which method fits this situation?
items.ne: यो अवस्थामा कुन विधि मिल्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Every option here is the right answer to something. The marks go to matching the method to the problem actually described — read what is being protected against.
items.ne: यहाँका हरेक विकल्प कुनै न कुनै कुराको सही उत्तर हुन्। अंक विधिलाई वर्णन गरिएकै समस्यासँग मिलाउनुमा छ — केबाट जोगाउन खोजिएको हो पढ्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Off-site backup
items.ne: अर्को ठाउँको ब्याकअप

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A deletion needs a BACKUP, because RAID would have mirrored the deletion onto every disk instantly. Any backup would do here; differential is chosen because a restore needs only two sets, so recovering one folder is quick.
items.ne: मेटाइका लागि ब्याकअप चाहिन्छ, किनकि RAID ले मेटाइलाई तुरुन्तै हरेक डिस्कमा सारिसक्थ्यो। यहाँ जुनसुकै ब्याकअपले काम गर्थ्यो; differential छानिनुको कारण फर्काउन दुई सेट मात्र चाहिनु हो, त्यसैले एउटा फोल्डर फर्काउन छिटो हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The requirement is CONTINUITY, not recovery — no interruption is allowed, so there is no time to restore anything. Mirroring means the second disk carries on alone the moment the first fails.
items.ne: आवश्यकता निरन्तरता हो, पुनर्स्थापना होइन — रोकिन नपाउने भएकाले केही फर्काउने समयै हुँदैन। Mirroring भएकाले पहिलो बिग्रेकै क्षणदेखि दोस्रो डिस्कले एक्लै चलाइरहन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The constraint is on BACKUP time, not restore time. Incremental copies only what changed since the previous backup of any kind, which makes it the smallest and fastest each night — accepting a slower, more fragile restore in exchange.
items.ne: बाधा ब्याकअप समयमा छ, फर्काउने समयमा होइन। Incremental ले जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको मात्र कपी गर्छ, त्यसैले हरेक रात सबैभन्दा सानो र छिटो — बदलामा ढिलो र कमजोर पुनर्स्थापना स्वीकार गरेर।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: No RAID level and no backup schedule helps when both copies burn together. The property that matters here is not the method but the LOCATION — a copy held somewhere else, or in the cloud.
items.ne: दुवै प्रतिलिपि सँगै जल्दा कुनै RAID स्तर र कुनै ब्याकअप तालिकाले काम गर्दैन। यहाँ महत्त्वपूर्ण कुरा विधि होइन, स्थान हो — अर्को ठाउँमा वा cloud मा राखिएको प्रतिलिपि।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Step through the week. The difference between the three is not what they copy on Monday — it is what they copy on Friday, and how many sets a restore then needs.
items.ne: हप्ताभरि चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस्। तीनबीचको फरक सोमबार के कपी गर्छन् भन्ने होइन — शुक्रबार के कपी गर्छन्, र फर्काउन कति सेट चाहिन्छ भन्ने हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The yellow band is the sentence that separates a full-mark answer from a half one. RAID survives a disk failing; it does not survive a mistake.
items.ne: पहेँलो पट्टी नै पूरा अंक र आधा अंकको उत्तर छुट्याउने वाक्य हो। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिँदा जोगाउँछ; गल्ती भएमा जोगाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: List recovery techniques and say when each applies.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: backup र recovery को परिभाषा दिन र दुवै किन चाहिन्छ भन्न, full–incremental–differential लाई गति र पुनर्स्थापनामा के चाहिन्छ भन्ने आधारमा तुलना गर्न, सामान्य ब्याकअप उपकरण र मिडिया नाम लिन तथा अवस्था अनुसार छान्न, ब्याकअप तालिका र grandfather–father–son जस्ता media rotation कसरी चल्छ बुझाउन, RAID 0–1–5 वर्णन गर्न र RAID किन ब्याकअप होइन भन्न, र recovery का उपाय सूचीबद्ध गरी कहिले कुन लागू हुन्छ भन्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Decide two things before reading on: how many sets, and what Wednesday's failure costs you.
items.ne: पढ्नुअघि दुई कुरा निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: कति सेट चाहिन्छ, र बुधबारको असफलताले के गुमाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Run the same failure against a differential scheme and only Friday's differential matters — Wednesday's loss would cost nothing. That is what "two sets" buys you.
items.ne: यही असफलता differential योजनामा लगाउनुहोस् — शुक्रबारको differential मात्र काम लाग्छ, बुधबार हराए केही बिग्रँदैन। "दुई सेट" ले किन्ने कुरा यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Mirroring copies every change to both disks, and a deletion is a change. Both disks lose the folder at the same instant. RAID protects against a disk failing — a mechanical event affecting one disk. It gives no protection against deletion, overwriting, a virus or ransomware, because those are legitimate write operations as far as the array is concerned. Only a backup, held separately and not written to continuously, recovers this.
items.ne: Mirroring ले हरेक परिवर्तन दुवै डिस्कमा सार्छ, र मेटाइ पनि परिवर्तन हो। दुवै डिस्कले एकै क्षणमा फोल्डर गुमाउँछन्। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिनु — एउटा डिस्कमा हुने यान्त्रिक घटना — बाट जोगाउँछ। मेटाइ, ओभरराइट, भाइरस वा ransomware बाट जोगाउँदैन, किनकि array का लागि ती वैध लेखाइ हुन्। छुट्टै राखिएको र निरन्तर नलेखिने ब्याकअपले मात्र यो फर्काउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Read the pattern rather than memorising three numbers: capacity and safety trade directly against each other, and RAID 5 exists because it buys most of the capacity of RAID 0 with most of the safety of RAID 1.
items.ne: तीन सङ्ख्या घोक्नुभन्दा ढाँचा पढ्नुहोस्: क्षमता र सुरक्षा सीधै एक–अर्काको सट्टामा जान्छन्, र RAID 5 हुनुको कारण यही हो — यसले RAID 0 को धेरैजसो क्षमता र RAID 1 को धेरैजसो सुरक्षा सँगै दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Swapping incremental and differential. Incremental = since the last backup; differential = since the last full backup. Getting these the wrong way round reverses every answer about restore time.
items.ne: Incremental र differential साट्नु। Incremental = अघिल्लो ब्याकअप पछि; differential = अन्तिम full ब्याकअप पछि। उल्टो पारे फर्काउने समयसम्बन्धी हरेक उत्तर उल्टिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying RAID 5 needs two disks. It needs a minimum of three, because parity has to live somewhere other than the data it protects.
items.ne: RAID 5 लाई दुई डिस्क चाहिन्छ भन्नु। न्यूनतम तीन चाहिन्छ, किनकि parity ले जोगाउने data भन्दा अन्तै बस्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Keeping the only backup beside the computer. Fire, flood and theft take both at once. A serious plan keeps a copy off-site.
items.ne: एक मात्र ब्याकअप कम्प्युटरकै छेउमा राख्नु। आगलागी, बाढी र चोरीले दुवै सँगै लैजान्छन्। गम्भीर योजनाले एउटा प्रतिलिपि अर्को ठाउँमा राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The shortest unit — 8 hours, 7 marks — and the most predictable. Three questions cover almost everything ever asked: differentiate full, incremental and differential backup (say what each copies AND what a restore needs, or you get half the marks), explain RAID 0, 1 and 5 with their minimum disks and what happens when one fails, and define backup and recovery / list recovery techniques. If a question gives you a scenario, the answer is almost always the trade-off between backup time and restore time — say which you are choosing and why.
items.ne: सबैभन्दा छोटो युनिट — ८ घण्टा, ७ अंक — र सबैभन्दा अनुमानयोग्य। तीन प्रश्नले सोधिने झन्डै सबै समेट्छन्: full, incremental र differential छुट्याउनुहोस् (हरेकले के कपी गर्छ र फर्काउन के चाहिन्छ दुवै भन्नुहोस्, नत्र आधा अंक), RAID 0, 1 र 5 व्याख्या गर्नुहोस् न्यूनतम डिस्क र एउटा बिग्रिँदा के हुन्छ सहित, र backup–recovery को परिभाषा / recovery का उपाय। प्रश्नले अवस्था दियो भने उत्तर झन्डै सधैं ब्याकअप समय र पुनर्स्थापना समयबीचको सौदा हो — कुन छान्दै हुनुहुन्छ र किन भन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A full backup copies all the data every time; it takes the longest and uses the most media but a restore needs only that one set. An incremental backup copies only what has changed since the last backup of any type; it is the quickest to take and the smallest, but restoring requires the last full backup together with every incremental taken since, and a missing one breaks the chain. A differential backup copies everything changed since the last full backup; each one grows larger than the last, but a restore needs exactly two sets — the full backup and the most recent differential.
items.ne: Full backup ले हरेक पटक सबै data कपी गर्छ; समय सबैभन्दा बढी लाग्छ र मिडिया धेरै खपत हुन्छ तर फर्काउन त्यही एउटै सेट चाहिन्छ। Incremental backup ले जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको मात्र कपी गर्छ; लिन सबैभन्दा छिटो र सानो, तर फर्काउन अन्तिम full ब्याकअप र त्यसपछिका सबै incremental चाहिन्छन्, र एउटा हराए शृंखला टुट्छ। Differential backup ले अन्तिम full ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको सबै कपी गर्छ; हरेक अघिल्लो भन्दा ठूलो हुँदै जान्छ, तर फर्काउन ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट चाहिन्छ — full र सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो differential।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so that the operating system treats them as a single drive, to gain speed, fault tolerance or both. RAID 0 uses striping: data is divided across the disks giving faster access and full capacity, but there is no redundancy and one disk failing loses everything — minimum two disks. RAID 1 uses mirroring: identical data is written to both disks so one can fail without loss, but only half the capacity is usable — minimum two disks. RAID 5 uses striping with parity spread across all disks, so any one disk can fail and be rebuilt from the parity, at the cost of one disk's capacity — minimum three disks.
items.ne: RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्क जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता वा दुवैका लागि। RAID 0 ले striping प्रयोग गर्छ: data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, पहुँच छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता पाइन्छ, तर redundancy नभएकाले एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै जान्छ — न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 ले mirroring प्रयोग गर्छ: दुवै डिस्कमा उही data लेखिन्छ, त्यसैले एउटा बिग्रिए पनि हराउँदैन, तर आधा क्षमता मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य — न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 ले सबै डिस्कमा फैलिएको parity सहित striping गर्छ, त्यसैले कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ, एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमताको मूल्यमा — न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Grandfather–father–son is a media rotation scheme in which daily backups (son) are kept for about a week, weekly backups (father) for about a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for about a year, with the media reused in that planned cycle. It protects against corruption or an unwanted change that is not noticed immediately: if a single daily backup is overwritten each day, then after a few days every copy held contains the same damage, whereas keeping older generations means an undamaged version still exists.
items.ne: Grandfather–father–son एउटा media rotation योजना हो जसमा दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) करिब एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) करिब एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) करिब एक वर्ष राखिन्छ, र मिडिया त्यही योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग हुन्छ। यसले तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाइने बिग्रिनु वा अवाञ्छित परिवर्तनबाट जोगाउँछ: दैनिक एउटै ब्याकअप हरेक दिन ओभरराइट भइरहे केही दिनपछि भएका सबै प्रतिलिपिमा उही क्षति हुन्छ, तर पुराना पुस्ता राखे नबिग्रेको संस्करण अझै रहन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Full = everything, one set to restore. Incremental = since the last backup, full plus every increment to restore. Differential = since the last full, exactly two sets to restore.
items.ne: Full = सबै, फर्काउन एउटै सेट। Incremental = अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि, फर्काउन full र सबै increment। Differential = अन्तिम full पछि, फर्काउन ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Grandfather–father–son keeps daily, weekly and monthly generations, which is what protects against damage noticed late.
items.ne: Grandfather–father–son ले दैनिक, साप्ताहिक र मासिक पुस्ता राख्छ, जसले ढिलो थाहा भएको क्षतिबाट जोगाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: RAID 0 = speed, no redundancy, 2 disks. RAID 1 = mirror, 2 disks. RAID 5 = parity, 3 disks minimum.
items.ne: RAID 0 = गति, redundancy छैन, २ डिस्क। RAID 1 = mirror, २ डिस्क। RAID 5 = parity, न्यूनतम ३ डिस्क।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: RAID is not a backup. It survives a disk failing, not a deletion, a virus or a mistake.
items.ne: RAID ब्याकअप होइन। यसले डिस्क बिग्रिँदा जोगाउँछ — मेटाइ, भाइरस वा गल्तीमा होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Count the sets a restore depends on, and say what a missing one costs
items.ne: पुनर्स्थापनाले भर पर्ने सेट गन्नुहोस्, र एउटा हराए के गुम्छ भन्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A restore needs the last FULL backup plus whatever holds the changes since. Incremental holds changes since the LAST BACKUP OF ANY KIND, so every one since the full backup is needed and they form a chain — break a link and everything after it is lost. Differential holds changes since the last FULL backup, so exactly two sets are ever needed and losing an older differential costs nothing.
items.ne: पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि अन्तिम FULL ब्याकअप र त्यसपछिका परिवर्तन बोक्ने जति चाहिन्छ। Incremental ले जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछिको परिवर्तन बोक्छ, त्यसैले full पछिका सबै चाहिन्छन् र ती शृंखला बन्छन् — एउटा कडी टुट्यो भने त्यसपछिको सबै जान्छ। Differential ले अन्तिम FULL पछिको परिवर्तन बोक्छ, त्यसैले सधैं ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट चाहिन्छ र पुरानो differential हराए केही बिग्रँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Full backup on Monday. Incremental backups on Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. The disk fails on Friday night. How many sets does the restore need?
items.ne: सोमबार full ब्याकअप। मंगल, बुध, बिही र शुक्रबार incremental। शुक्रबार राति डिस्क बिग्रियो। पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि कति सेट चाहिन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Does an incremental hold changes since the last FULL backup, or since the last backup of any kind? Answer full or any
items.ne: Incremental ले अन्तिम FULL पछिको परिवर्तन बोक्छ कि जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछिको? full वा any

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: That is the whole definition. Tuesday holds Monday-to-Tuesday, Wednesday holds Tuesday-to-Wednesday, and so on — each one starts where the previous backup stopped, not where the full one did.
items.ne: परिभाषा नै यही हो। मंगलबारले सोम–मंगलको, बुधबारले मंगल–बुधको बोक्छ — हरेकले अघिल्लो ब्याकअप रोकिएको ठाउँबाट सुरु गर्छ, full रोकिएको ठाउँबाट होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: How many incremental sets were taken between Monday and Friday? Answer a number
items.ne: सोमबारदेखि शुक्रबारसम्म कति incremental सेट लिइए? सङ्ख्यामा उत्तर दिनुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday — four.
items.ne: मंगल, बुध, बिही र शुक्रबार — चार।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: So how many sets in total does the restore need? Answer a number
items.ne: त्यसैले पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि जम्मा कति सेट चाहिन्छ? सङ्ख्यामा उत्तर दिनुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The full set, then all four increments replayed in order. Five.
items.ne: Full सेट, अनि चारै increment क्रमैसँग लगाउने। पाँच।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Sets needed
items.ne: चाहिने सेट

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Five. The chain has to be replayed in order, which is the price incremental pays for being the fastest to take. Notice the count is full + one per day since — not one per day of the week.
items.ne: पाँच। शृंखला क्रमैसँग लगाउनुपर्छ — लिन सबैभन्दा छिटो हुनुको मूल्य incremental ले यही तिर्छ। गन्ती full + त्यसपछिका हरेक दिनको एक हो, हप्ताको हरेक दिनको एक होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The same week, but the Tuesday-to-Friday backups are DIFFERENTIAL instead. The disk fails on Friday night. How many sets does the restore need?
items.ne: उही हप्ता, तर मंगलदेखि शुक्रसम्मका ब्याकअप DIFFERENTIAL छन्। शुक्रबार राति डिस्क बिग्रियो। पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि कति सेट चाहिन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What does Friday's differential contain — changes since Thursday, or since Monday? Answer thursday or monday
items.ne: शुक्रबारको differential मा के हुन्छ — बिहीबारपछिको परिवर्तन कि सोमबारपछिको? thursday वा monday

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A differential always measures from the last FULL backup, so Friday's already contains everything Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday captured.
items.ne: Differential सधैं अन्तिम FULL बाट नाप्छ, त्यसैले शुक्रबारकोमा मंगल, बुध र बिहीबारले टिपेको सबै पहिल्यै समेटिएको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: So how many sets does the restore need? Answer a number
items.ne: त्यसैले पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि कति सेट चाहिन्छ? सङ्ख्यामा उत्तर दिनुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Monday's full set and Friday's differential. The ones in between are redundant the moment a newer differential exists.
items.ne: सोमबारको full र शुक्रबारको differential। नयाँ differential बनेकै क्षणदेखि बीचका सबै बेकामे हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Sets needed
items.ne: चाहिने सेट

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Two — always two, whatever day it fails on. That is what differential buys with its larger daily sets, and it is the comparison the exam asks for.
items.ne: दुई — जुन दिन बिग्रिए पनि सधैं दुई। ठूला दैनिक सेटको बदलामा differential ले किन्ने कुरा यही हो, र परीक्षाले खोज्ने तुलना पनि यही।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Back to the incremental week: full on Monday, incrementals Tuesday to Friday. Wednesday's tape turns out to be unreadable. Up to which day can the data be trusted?
items.ne: फेरि incremental हप्तामा: सोमबार full, मंगलदेखि शुक्रसम्म incremental। बुधबारको टेप पढ्नै नमिल्ने निस्कियो। कुन दिनसम्मको data भरपर्दो छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Does Thursday's increment contain the changes Wednesday's was holding? Answer yes or no
items.ne: बिहीबारको increment मा बुधबारकोले बोकेको परिवर्तन छ? yes वा no

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Thursday only holds what changed after Wednesday's backup ran. Nothing later re-captures what Wednesday was carrying, so the gap cannot be filled from another set.
items.ne: बिहीबारकोमा बुधबारको ब्याकअप चलेपछि बदलिएको मात्र हुन्छ। बुधबारले बोकेको कुरा पछिको कुनैले फेरि टिप्दैन, त्यसैले त्यो खाडल अर्को सेटबाट भरिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: So which day is the last one you can restore to? Answer monday, tuesday, wednesday or friday
items.ne: त्यसैले कुन दिनसम्म फर्काउन सकिन्छ? monday, tuesday, wednesday वा friday

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Monday's full set plus Tuesday's increment replay cleanly. The chain breaks at Wednesday, and everything from there on is unrecoverable.
items.ne: सोमबारको full र मंगलबारको increment सफासँग लाग्छन्। शृंखला बुधबार टुट्छ, र त्यसपछिको सबै फर्काउन सकिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Restorable up to
items.ne: यति दिनसम्म फर्काउन सकिने

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Tuesday. One damaged tape cost three days of work — that fragility is the real argument against incremental, and it is why the same failure under a differential scheme would have cost nothing at all.
items.ne: मंगलबार। एउटा बिग्रेको टेपले तीन दिनको काम लियो — incremental विरुद्धको साँचो तर्क यही कमजोरी हो, र त्यसैले differential योजनामा उही असफलताले केही बिगार्दैनथ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A full backup runs on the 1st of the month. Differential backups run every day after it. The disk fails on the 20th. How many sets does the restore need? Answer a number.
items.ne: महिनाको १ गते full ब्याकअप चल्छ। त्यसपछि हरेक दिन differential। २० गते डिस्क बिग्रियो। पुनर्स्थापनाका लागि कति सेट चाहिन्छ? सङ्ख्यामा उत्तर दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Sets needed
items.ne: चाहिने सेट

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Two, and the twenty days are a distraction. A differential restore never needs more than the full set and the latest differential, however long the month has run. If you answered 20 or 19, you counted the backups taken rather than the ones a restore depends on.
items.ne: दुई — र बीस दिन ध्यान भड्काउन राखिएको हो। महिना जति लामो भए पनि differential पुनर्स्थापनालाई full सेट र सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो differential भन्दा बढी कहिल्यै चाहिँदैन। २० वा १९ भन्नुभयो भने तपाईंले लिइएका ब्याकअप गन्नुभयो, पुनर्स्थापनाले भर पर्नेहरू होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Different technology, same question. A RAID 5 array of four disks loses one disk. To rebuild the missing disk's contents, how many of the surviving disks must be readable? Answer a number.
items.ne: फरक प्रविधि, उही प्रश्न। चार डिस्कको RAID 5 array ले एउटा डिस्क गुमायो। हराएको डिस्कको सामग्री पुनर्निर्माण गर्न बाँकी कतिवटा डिस्क पढ्न मिल्नुपर्छ? सङ्ख्यामा उत्तर दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Disks needed
items.ne: चाहिने डिस्क

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: All three. The rule transferred: a recovery depends on every source that holds part of the answer, and you count those rather than counting what exists. RAID 5 rebuilds the lost disk by combining the data and parity spread across ALL the remaining disks — so a second failure during the rebuild loses the array, which is exactly the chain-breaks-and-everything-after-is-gone problem, wearing different hardware.
items.ne: तीनै वटा। नियम सर्‍यो: पुनर्स्थापनाले उत्तरको अंश बोक्ने हरेक स्रोतमा भर पर्छ, र गन्नुपर्ने कुरा त्यही हो — के छ भन्ने होइन। RAID 5 ले बाँकी सबै डिस्कमा फैलिएको data र parity जोडेर हराएको डिस्क बनाउँछ — त्यसैले पुनर्निर्माणकै बीचमा दोस्रो डिस्क बिग्रिए array जान्छ, जुन ठ्याक्कै "कडी टुट्यो, त्यसपछिको सबै गयो" भन्ने समस्या हो, फरक हार्डवेयर लगाएर।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: every option here is correct for something. Marks are lost by choosing one that solves a different problem from the one described — RAID for accidental deletion is the classic.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: यहाँका हरेक विकल्प कुनै न कुनै अवस्थाका लागि ठीक छन्। वर्णन गरिएको भन्दा फरक समस्या समाधान गर्ने विकल्प छानेर अंक गुम्छ — भुलले मेटिएकोमा RAID भन्नु उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: "how many sets are needed to restore?" is asked directly, and it is the one question in this unit that cannot be answered by recognising a definition — you have to count, and the number depends on which method was used.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "फर्काउन कति सेट चाहिन्छ?" सीधै सोधिन्छ, र यस युनिटमा परिभाषा चिनेर उत्तर दिन नसकिने प्रश्न यही एउटा हो — गन्नै पर्छ, र सङ्ख्या कुन विधि प्रयोग भयो त्यसमा भर पर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A backup is a separate copy; recovery is the process of restoring it. A backup that has never been restored from is untested.
items.ne: Backup छुट्टै प्रतिलिपि हो; recovery त्यो फर्काउने प्रक्रिया। कहिल्यै फर्काएर नहेरिएको ब्याकअप परीक्षण नगरिएको हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A backup is a copy of data kept separately, so that it can be restored if the original is lost, damaged or changed by mistake. Recovery is the process of restoring that data, and returning the system to working order, after a failure. Data is lost in more ways than hardware failure: accidental deletion, overwriting a file, a virus, theft, fire or flood, and a failed update. A backup plan has to survive all of them, which is why keeping the copy in the same building as the original is a weak plan and an off-site copy is part of a serious one. The test of a backup is not whether it ran. It is whether a restore works — a backup that has never been restored from is an assumption, not a safeguard.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Backup भनेको छुट्टै राखिएको data को प्रतिलिपि हो, ताकि मूल हराए, बिग्रिए वा भुलवश बदलिए फर्काउन सकियोस्। Recovery भनेको खराबीपछि त्यो data फर्काउने र प्रणालीलाई चल्ने अवस्थामा ल्याउने प्रक्रिया हो। Data हार्डवेयर बिग्रेर मात्र हराउँदैन: भुलले मेटिनु, फाइल ओभरराइट हुनु, भाइरस, चोरी, आगलागी वा बाढी, र असफल अपडेट। ब्याकअप योजनाले यी सबै झेल्नुपर्छ — त्यसैले प्रतिलिपि मूलकै भवनमा राख्नु कमजोर योजना हो र अर्को ठाउँको प्रतिलिपि गम्भीर योजनाको हिस्सा हो। ब्याकअपको जाँच "चल्यो कि चलेन" होइन। फर्काउन सकिन्छ कि सकिँदैन हो — कहिल्यै फर्काएर नहेरिएको ब्याकअप अनुमान हो, सुरक्षा होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The three methods compared Full backup — copies everything every time. Slowest to take and uses the most media, but a restore needs only one set, so it is the fastest and safest to recover from. Incremental backup — copies only what has changed since the last backup of any kind. Fastest to take and smallest, but a restore needs the last full backup plus every increment since. If one increment in the chain is missing or damaged, everything after it is lost. Differential backup — copies everything changed since the last full backup. Each day is larger than the last, but a restore needs exactly two sets: the full backup and the most recent differential. The trade is always the same: time and media when you back up, against time and risk when you restore.
items.ne: तीन विधिको तुलना Full backup — हरेक पटक सबै कपी गर्छ। लिन सबैभन्दा ढिलो र मिडिया धेरै लाग्छ, तर फर्काउन एउटै सेट चाहिन्छ — त्यसैले recovery सबैभन्दा छिटो र सुरक्षित। Incremental backup — जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअप पछि बदलिएको मात्र कपी गर्छ। लिन सबैभन्दा छिटो र सानो, तर फर्काउन अन्तिम full ब्याकअप र त्यसपछिका सबै increment चाहिन्छन्। शृंखलाको एउटा increment हराए वा बिग्रिए त्यसपछिको सबै जान्छ। Differential backup — अन्तिम full ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको सबै कपी गर्छ। हरेक दिनको अघिल्लो भन्दा ठूलो हुन्छ, तर फर्काउन ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट चाहिन्छ: full र सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो differential। सौदा सधैं उही हो: ब्याकअप लिँदाको समय र मिडिया, बनाम फर्काउँदाको समय र जोखिम।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Backup devices and media: external hard disks (large, fast, cheap per gigabyte); USB flash drives (portable, small capacity); optical discs — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (write once, cheap, slow); magnetic tape (very large capacity, low cost, still used for archives); network attached storage; and cloud storage, which is off-site by nature. Scheduling means deciding when backups run and automating them. Backups that depend on someone remembering do not happen. They are usually scheduled outside working hours, because a backup competes for the disk and the network. Media rotation means reusing a set of media in a planned cycle, so that several generations of backup exist at once. The standard scheme is grandfather–father–son: daily backups (son) are kept for a week, weekly backups (father) for a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for a year. Rotation is what protects you from a problem you did not notice immediately. If a file was corrupted three weeks ago and every backup has been overwritten since, the only copies you hold are all corrupted too.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ब्याकअप उपकरण र मिडिया: बाहिरी hard disk (ठूलो, छिटो, प्रति GB सस्तो); USB flash drive (बोक्न सजिलो, कम क्षमता); optical disc — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (एक पटक लेखिने, सस्तो, ढिलो); चुम्बकीय टेप (धेरै ठूलो क्षमता, कम लागत, अभिलेखका लागि अझै प्रयोगमा); network attached storage; र cloud storage, जुन स्वभावतः अर्को ठाउँमा हुन्छ। Scheduling भनेको ब्याकअप कहिले चल्ने तय गरेर स्वचालित बनाउनु हो। कसैले सम्झनुपर्ने ब्याकअप हुँदैन। प्रायः कार्यालय समयबाहिर राखिन्छ, किनकि ब्याकअपले डिस्क र नेटवर्क ओगट्छ। Media rotation भनेको मिडियाको समूहलाई योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग गर्नु, ताकि एकैचोटि ब्याकअपका धेरै पुस्ता रहून्। मानक योजना grandfather–father–son हो: दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) एक वर्ष राखिन्छ। तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाएको समस्याबाट जोगाउने कुरा rotation नै हो। तीन हप्ताअघि फाइल बिग्रेको थियो र त्यसपछि हरेक ब्याकअप ओभरराइट भइसक्यो भने तपाईंसँग भएका सबै प्रतिलिपि पनि बिग्रिएकै हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so the operating system sees them as one drive, in order to gain speed, fault tolerance, or both. RAID 0 — striping. Data is split across the disks, so reads and writes are faster and the full capacity is usable. There is no redundancy: if any one disk fails, all the data is lost. Minimum two disks. RAID 1 — mirroring. The same data is written to both disks. One disk can fail and the system keeps running. Only half the total capacity is usable. Minimum two disks. RAID 5 — striping with parity. Data and parity information are spread across all the disks. Any one disk can fail and its contents are rebuilt from the parity. The capacity of one disk is given up to parity. Minimum three disks.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्कलाई जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता, वा दुवै पाउन। RAID 0 — striping. Data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, त्यसैले पढ्न–लेख्न छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता प्रयोग हुन्छ। कुनै redundancy छैन: एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै data जान्छ। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 — mirroring. उही data दुवै डिस्कमा लेखिन्छ। एउटा बिग्रिए पनि प्रणाली चलिरहन्छ। कुल क्षमताको आधा मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 — parity सहितको striping. Data र parity सबै डिस्कमा फैलाइन्छ। कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए त्यसको सामग्री parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ। एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमता parity मा जान्छ। न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Match the technique to the failure Restore from backup — the general answer, and the only one that works when data itself has been lost or corrupted. System restore point — rolls the operating system's settings and drivers back to an earlier state. Fixes a bad update or driver; does not recover deleted personal files. Recovery / repair console — repairs a damaged boot sector or system files so the machine can start again. Data recovery software — scans sectors directly to retrieve files whose index entries were deleted. This works precisely because a quick format and a delete do not remove the data itself. Professional recovery from a failed drive — for physical damage such as a head crash, done in a clean room. Expensive, and never guaranteed. Rebuilding a RAID array — replacing a failed disk and letting the array rebuild its contents from the mirror or the parity.
items.ne: खराबी अनुसार उपाय मिलाउनुहोस् ब्याकअपबाट फर्काउने — सामान्य उत्तर, र data नै हराएको वा बिग्रिएको बेला काम लाग्ने एक मात्र उपाय। System restore point — अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सेटिङ र driver लाई अघिल्लो अवस्थामा फर्काउँछ। खराब अपडेट वा driver मिलाउँछ; मेटिएका व्यक्तिगत फाइल फर्काउँदैन। Recovery / repair console — बिग्रिएको boot sector वा सिस्टम फाइल मर्मत गरेर मेसिन फेरि सुरु हुन दिन्छ। Data recovery सफ्टवेयर — सूची मेटिएका फाइल फर्काउन sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। यो चल्नुको कारण नै quick format र delete ले data आफैँ नहटाउनु हो। बिग्रेको ड्राइभबाट व्यावसायिक रिकभरी — head crash जस्तो भौतिक क्षतिका लागि, clean room मा गरिने। महँगो, र कहिल्यै ग्यारेन्टी नहुने। RAID array पुनर्निर्माण — बिग्रेको डिस्क साटेर array लाई mirror वा parity बाट सामग्री फेरि बनाउन दिने।

items.en: Decide two things before reading on: how many sets, and what Wednesday's failure costs you.पढ्नुअघि दुई कुरा निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: कति सेट चाहिन्छ, र बुधबारको असफलताले के गुमाउँछ। Step 1 — what does an incremental hold? Only what changed since the previous backup of any kind — so Tuesday's holds Monday-to-Tuesday changes, Wednesday's holds Tuesday-to- Wednesday, and so on. Step 2 — rebuild the timeline. Start from Monday's full set, then apply Tuesday's, Wednesday's, Thursday's and Friday's increments in order. That is five sets. Step 3 — remove Wednesday. Thursday's increment holds only what changed after Wednesday's backup. Without Wednesday there is a gap in the chain that nothing else fills, so the restore can only be trusted up to Tuesday. Answer Five sets are needed. Losing Wednesday's breaks the chain: everything from Wednesday onwards is unrecoverable. Run the same failure against a differential scheme and only Friday's differential matters — Wednesday's loss would cost nothing. That is what "two sets" buys you. यही असफलता differential योजनामा लगाउनुहोस् — शुक्रबारको differential मात्र काम लाग्छ, बुधबार हराए केही बिग्रँदैन। "दुई सेट" ले किन्ने कुरा यही हो। 6.3 Devices, media, scheduling and rotation Definition — learn this wording Backup devices and media: external hard disks (large, fast, cheap per gigabyte); USB flash drives (portable, small capacity); optical discs — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (write once, cheap, slow); magnetic tape (very large capacity, low cost, still used for archives); network attached storage; and cloud storage, which is off-site by nature. Scheduling means deciding when backups run and automating them. Backups that depend on someone remembering do not happen. They are usually scheduled outside working hours, because a backup competes for the disk and the network. Media rotation means reusing a set of media in a planned cycle, so that several generations of backup exist at once. The standard scheme is grandfather–father–son: daily backups (son) are kept for a week, weekly backups (father) for a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for a year. Rotation is what protects you from a problem you did not notice immediately. If a file was corrupted three weeks ago and every backup has been overwritten since, the only copies you hold are all corrupted too. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ब्याकअप उपकरण र मिडिया: बाहिरी hard disk (ठूलो, छिटो, प्रति GB सस्तो); USB flash drive (बोक्न सजिलो, कम क्षमता); optical disc — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (एक पटक लेखिने, सस्तो, ढिलो); चुम्बकीय टेप (धेरै ठूलो क्षमता, कम लागत, अभिलेखका लागि अझै प्रयोगमा); network attached storage; र cloud storage, जुन स्वभावतः अर्को ठाउँमा हुन्छ। Scheduling भनेको ब्याकअप कहिले चल्ने तय गरेर स्वचालित बनाउनु हो। कसैले सम्झनुपर्ने ब्याकअप हुँदैन। प्रायः कार्यालय समयबाहिर राखिन्छ, किनकि ब्याकअपले डिस्क र नेटवर्क ओगट्छ। Media rotation भनेको मिडियाको समूहलाई योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग गर्नु, ताकि एकैचोटि ब्याकअपका धेरै पुस्ता रहून्। मानक योजना grandfather–father–son हो: दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) एक वर्ष राखिन्छ। तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाएको समस्याबाट जोगाउने कुरा rotation नै हो। तीन हप्ताअघि फाइल बिग्रेको थियो र त्यसपछि हरेक ब्याकअप ओभरराइट भइसक्यो भने तपाईंसँग भएका सबै प्रतिलिपि पनि बिग्रिएकै हुन्छन्। 6.4 RAID Definition — learn this wording RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so the operating system sees them as one drive, in order to gain speed, fault tolerance, or both. RAID 0 — striping. Data is split across the disks, so reads and writes are faster and the full capacity is usable. There is no redundancy: if any one disk fails, all the data is lost. Minimum two disks. RAID 1 — mirroring. The same data is written to both disks. One disk can fail and the system keeps running. Only half the total capacity is usable. Minimum two disks. RAID 5 — striping with parity. Data and parity information are spread across all the disks. Any one disk can fail and its contents are rebuilt from the parity. The capacity of one disk is given up to parity. Minimum three disks. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्कलाई जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता, वा दुवै पाउन। RAID 0 — striping. Data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, त्यसैले पढ्न–लेख्न छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता प्रयोग हुन्छ। कुनै redundancy छैन: एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै data जान्छ। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 — mirroring. उही data दुवै डिस्कमा लेखिन्छ। एउटा बिग्रिए पनि प्रणाली चलिरहन्छ। कुल क्षमताको आधा मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 — parity सहितको striping. Data र parity सबै डिस्कमा फैलाइन्छ। कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए त्यसको सामग्री parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ। एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमता parity मा जान्छ। न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क। {{dia:hwRaid}} The yellow band is the sentence that separates a full-mark answer from a half one. RAID survives a disk failing; it does not survive a mistake. पहेँलो पट्टी नै पूरा अंक र आधा अंकको उत्तर छुट्याउने वाक्य हो। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिँदा जोगाउँछ; गल्ती भएमा जोगाउँदैन। Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A server uses RAID 1. A user deletes an important folder by mistake. Is it recoverable from the RAID? एउटा सर्भरमा RAID 1 छ। प्रयोगकर्ताले भुलवश महत्त्वपूर्ण फोल्डर मेट्छ। के त्यो RAID बाट फर्काउन सकिन्छ? Yes — the second disk still has it No — the deletion was mirrored too Yes, but only within 24 hours Mirroring copies every change to both disks, and a deletion is a change. Both disks lose the folder at the same instant. RAID protects against a disk failing — a mechanical event affecting one disk. It gives no protection against deletion, overwriting, a virus or ransomware, because those are legitimate write operations as far as the array is concerned. Only a backup, held separately and not written to continuously, recovers this. Mirroring ले हरेक परिवर्तन दुवै डिस्कमा सार्छ, र मेटाइ पनि परिवर्तन हो। दुवै डिस्कले एकै क्षणमा फोल्डर गुमाउँछन्। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिनु — एउटा डिस्कमा हुने यान्त्रिक घटना — बाट जोगाउँछ। मेटाइ, ओभरराइट, भाइरस वा ransomware बाट जोगाउँदैन, किनकि array का लागि ती वैध लेखाइ हुन्। छुट्टै राखिएको र निरन्तर नलेखिने ब्याकअपले मात्र यो फर्काउँछ। 6.5 Recovery techniques Match the technique to the failure Restore from backup — the general answer, and the only one that works when data itself has been lost or corrupted. System restore point — rolls the operating system's settings and drivers back to an earlier state. Fixes a bad update or driver; does not recover deleted personal files. Recovery / repair console — repairs a damaged boot sector or system files so the machine can start again. Data recovery software — scans sectors directly to retrieve files whose index entries were deleted. This works precisely because a quick format and a delete do not remove the data itself. Professional recovery from a failed drive — for physical damage such as a head crash, done in a clean room. Expensive, and never guaranteed. Rebuilding a RAID array — replacing a failed disk and letting the array rebuild its contents from the mirror or the parity. खराबी अनुसार उपाय मिलाउनुहोस् ब्याकअपबाट फर्काउने — सामान्य उत्तर, र data नै हराएको वा बिग्रिएको बेला काम लाग्ने एक मात्र उपाय। System restore point — अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सेटिङ र driver लाई अघिल्लो अवस्थामा फर्काउँछ। खराब अपडेट वा driver मिलाउँछ; मेटिएका व्यक्तिगत फाइल फर्काउँदैन। Recovery / repair console — बिग्रिएको boot sector वा सिस्टम फाइल मर्मत गरेर मेसिन फेरि सुरु हुन दिन्छ। Data recovery सफ्टवेयर — सूची मेटिएका फाइल फर्काउन sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। यो चल्नुको कारण नै quick format र delete ले data आफैँ नहटाउनु हो। बिग्रेको ड्राइभबाट व्यावसायिक रिकभरी — head crash जस्तो भौतिक क्षतिका लागि, clean room मा गरिने। महँगो, र कहिल्यै ग्यारेन्टी नहुने। RAID array पुनर्निर्माण — बिग्रेको डिस्क साटेर array लाई mirror वा parity बाट सामग्री फेरि बनाउन दिने। Practise the judgement
items.ne: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which backup or RAID level fits this situation? What you will learn: to choose a method from a described need, which is how this unit is examined — the exam gives you a situation and asks what you would use, not for three definitions. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णन गरिएको आवश्यकताबाट विधि छान्न — यो युनिट यसै गरी जाँचिन्छ। परीक्षाले तीन परिभाषा होइन, अवस्था दिएर के प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ सोध्छ। Why this matters: every option here is correct for something. Marks are lost by choosing one that solves a different problem from the one described — RAID for accidental deletion is the classic.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: यहाँका हरेक विकल्प कुनै न कुनै अवस्थाका लागि ठीक छन्। वर्णन गरिएको भन्दा फरक समस्या समाधान गर्ने विकल्प छानेर अंक गुम्छ — भुलले मेटिएकोमा RAID भन्नु उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण। Example 2 How much space do you actually get? Question: four 2 TB disks are available. What usable capacity does each of RAID 0, RAID 1 and RAID 5 give, and how many disks can fail in each? Step 1 — RAID 0 keeps nothing back. Every disk stores data and none stores a copy or parity, so usable = 4 × 2 = 8 TB. Nothing is protected: 0 disks may fail. Step 2 — RAID 1 stores everything twice. Half the total is a copy, so usable = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 TB. One disk of each mirrored pair may fail. Step 3 — RAID 5 gives up one disk's worth to parity. Usable = (4 − 1) × 2 = 6 TB. Any one disk may fail and be rebuilt from the parity. Answer RAID 0 → 8 TB, no disk may fail · RAID 1 → 4 TB, one per pair · RAID 5 → 6 TB, any one Read the pattern rather than memorising three numbers: capacity and safety trade directly against each other, and RAID 5 exists because it buys most of the capacity of RAID 0 with most of the safety of RAID 1. तीन सङ्ख्या घोक्नुभन्दा ढाँचा पढ्नुहोस्: क्षमता र सुरक्षा सीधै एक–अर्काको सट्टामा जान्छन्, र RAID 5 हुनुको कारण यही हो — यसले RAID 0 को धेरैजसो क्षमता र RAID 1 को धेरैजसो सुरक्षा सँगै दिन्छ। Faded practice
items.ne: · क्रमशः कम सहयोग

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: · क्रमशः कम सहयोग Counting what a restore depends on What you will learn: to work out how many sets a restore needs from the schedule alone. The first problem is worked for you, the next shows fewer steps, and the last two give you nothing — including one that moves the same counting rule to a RAID rebuild. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: तालिका हेरेरै पुनर्स्थापनालाई कति सेट चाहिन्छ निकाल्न। पहिलो समस्या तपाईंका लागि गरिदिइन्छ, अर्कोमा कम चरण देखिन्छन्, र अन्तिम दुईमा केही दिइँदैन — तीमध्ये एउटाले उही गन्ती नियमलाई RAID पुनर्निर्माणमा सार्छ। Why this matters: "how many sets are needed to restore?" is asked directly, and it is the one question in this unit that cannot be answered by recognising a definition — you have to count, and the number depends on which method was used.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "फर्काउन कति सेट चाहिन्छ?" सीधै सोधिन्छ, र यस युनिटमा परिभाषा चिनेर उत्तर दिन नसकिने प्रश्न यही एउटा हो — गन्नै पर्छ, र सङ्ख्या कुन विधि प्रयोग भयो त्यसमा भर पर्छ। Mistakes that cost marks here Calling RAID a backup. RAID survives a disk failing. It mirrors deletion, corruption and ransomware faithfully onto every disk in the array. RAID लाई ब्याकअप भन्नु। RAID ले डिस्क बिग्रिँदा जोगाउँछ। मेटाइ, बिग्रिनु र ransomware लाई array का हरेक डिस्कमा जस्ताको तस्तै सार्छ। Swapping incremental and differential. Incremental = since the last backup; differential = since the last full backup. Getting these the wrong way round reverses every answer about restore time. Incremental र differential साट्नु। Incremental = अघिल्लो ब्याकअप पछि; differential = अन्तिम full ब्याकअप पछि। उल्टो पारे फर्काउने समयसम्बन्धी हरेक उत्तर उल्टिन्छ। Saying RAID 5 needs two disks. It needs a minimum of three, because parity has to live somewhere other than the data it protects. RAID 5 लाई दुई डिस्क चाहिन्छ भन्नु। न्यूनतम तीन चाहिन्छ, किनकि parity ले जोगाउने data भन्दा अन्तै बस्नुपर्छ। Keeping the only backup beside the computer. Fire, flood and theft take both at once. A serious plan keeps a copy off-site. एक मात्र ब्याकअप कम्प्युटरकै छेउमा राख्नु। आगलागी, बाढी र चोरीले दुवै सँगै लैजान्छन्। गम्भीर योजनाले एउटा प्रतिलिपि अर्को ठाउँमा राख्छ। RAID survives a disk; backup survives a mistake. Incremental = since last backup, differential = since last full. RAID ले डिस्क जोगाउँछ; ब्याकअपले गल्ती जोगाउँछ। Incremental = अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि, differential = अन्तिम full पछि। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit The shortest unit — 8 hours, 7 marks — and the most predictable. Three questions cover almost everything ever asked: differentiate full, incremental and differential backup (say what each copies AND what a restore needs, or you get half the marks), explain RAID 0, 1 and 5 with their minimum disks and what happens when one fails, and define backup and recovery / list recovery techniques. If a question gives you a scenario, the answer is almost always the trade-off between backup time and restore time — say which you are choosing and why. सबैभन्दा छोटो युनिट — ८ घण्टा, ७ अंक — र सबैभन्दा अनुमानयोग्य। तीन प्रश्नले सोधिने झन्डै सबै समेट्छन्: full, incremental र differential छुट्याउनुहोस् (हरेकले के कपी गर्छ र फर्काउन के चाहिन्छ दुवै भन्नुहोस्, नत्र आधा अंक), RAID 0, 1 र 5 व्याख्या गर्नुहोस् न्यूनतम डिस्क र एउटा बिग्रिँदा के हुन्छ सहित, र backup–recovery को परिभाषा / recovery का उपाय। प्रश्नले अवस्था दियो भने उत्तर झन्डै सधैं ब्याकअप समय र पुनर्स्थापना समयबीचको सौदा हो — कुन छान्दै हुनुहुन्छ र किन भन्नुहोस्। Q1 3 marks Differentiate between full, incremental and differential backup. Full, incremental र differential backup बीचको फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्। Show the answer A full backup copies all the data every time; it takes the longest and uses the most media but a restore needs only that one set. An incremental backup copies only what has changed since the last backup of any type; it is the quickest to take and the smallest, but restoring requires the last full backup together with every incremental taken since, and a missing one breaks the chain. A differential backup copies everything changed since the last full backup; each one grows larger than the last, but a restore needs exactly two sets — the full backup and the most recent differential. Full backup ले हरेक पटक सबै data कपी गर्छ; समय सबैभन्दा बढी लाग्छ र मिडिया धेरै खपत हुन्छ तर फर्काउन त्यही एउटै सेट चाहिन्छ। Incremental backup ले जुनसुकै किसिमको अघिल्लो ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको मात्र कपी गर्छ; लिन सबैभन्दा छिटो र सानो, तर फर्काउन अन्तिम full ब्याकअप र त्यसपछिका सबै incremental चाहिन्छन्, र एउटा हराए शृंखला टुट्छ। Differential backup ले अन्तिम full ब्याकअपपछि बदलिएको सबै कपी गर्छ; हरेक अघिल्लो भन्दा ठूलो हुँदै जान्छ, तर फर्काउन ठ्याक्कै दुई सेट चाहिन्छ — full र सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो differential। Q2 3 marks What is RAID? Explain RAID 0, RAID 1 and RAID 5, stating the minimum number of disks for each. RAID के हो? RAID 0, RAID 1 र RAID 5 व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्, र हरेकलाई चाहिने न्यूनतम डिस्क सङ्ख्या लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so that the operating system treats them as a single drive, to gain speed, fault tolerance or both. RAID 0 uses striping: data is divided across the disks giving faster access and full capacity, but there is no redundancy and one disk failing loses everything — minimum two disks. RAID 1 uses mirroring: identical data is written to both disks so one can fail without loss, but only half the capacity is usable — minimum two disks. RAID 5 uses striping with parity spread across all disks, so any one disk can fail and be rebuilt from the parity, at the cost of one disk's capacity — minimum three disks. RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्क जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता वा दुवैका लागि। RAID 0 ले striping प्रयोग गर्छ: data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, पहुँच छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता पाइन्छ, तर redundancy नभएकाले एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै जान्छ — न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 ले mirroring प्रयोग गर्छ: दुवै डिस्कमा उही data लेखिन्छ, त्यसैले एउटा बिग्रिए पनि हराउँदैन, तर आधा क्षमता मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य — न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 ले सबै डिस्कमा फैलिएको parity सहित striping गर्छ, त्यसैले कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ, एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमताको मूल्यमा — न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क। Q3 2 marks Explain the grandfather–father–son media rotation scheme, and state one problem it protects against that a single daily backup does not. Grandfather–father–son media rotation योजना बुझाउनुहोस्, र दैनिक एउटै ब्याकअपले नजोगाउने कुन समस्याबाट यसले जोगाउँछ लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer Grandfather–father–son is a media rotation scheme in which daily backups (son) are kept for about a week, weekly backups (father) for about a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for about a year, with the media reused in that planned cycle. It protects against corruption or an unwanted change that is not noticed immediately: if a single daily backup is overwritten each day, then after a few days every copy held contains the same damage, whereas keeping older generations means an undamaged version still exists. Grandfather–father–son एउटा media rotation योजना हो जसमा दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) करिब एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) करिब एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) करिब एक वर्ष राखिन्छ, र मिडिया त्यही योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग हुन्छ। यसले तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाइने बिग्रिनु वा अवाञ्छित परिवर्तनबाट जोगाउँछ: दैनिक एउटै ब्याकअप हरेक दिन ओभरराइट भइरहे केही दिनपछि भएका सबै प्रतिलिपिमा उही क्षति हुन्छ, तर पुराना पुस्ता राखे नबिग्रेको संस्करण अझै रहन्छ। Key points to revise
