items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The program starts. Execution always begins at main().
items.ne: प्रोग्राम सुरु भयो। सधैं main() बाटै चल्न थाल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Object s1 is being created with "Ram" and 15. Creating an object automatically calls the constructor.
items.ne: "Ram" र 15 सहित अब्जेक्ट s1 बन्दैछ। अब्जेक्ट बन्ने बित्तिकै कन्स्ट्रक्टर आफैं बोलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Jump into the constructor. Here n = "Ram" and r = 15.
items.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर भित्र पस्यो। यहाँ n = "Ram" र r = 15 छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The data member name gets the value "Ram".
items.ne: डाटा मेम्बर name ले "Ram" मान पायो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The data member roll gets the value 15.
items.ne: डाटा मेम्बर roll ले 15 मान पायो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: This cout runs, so the first line of output appears now.
items.ne: यो cout चल्यो, त्यसैले पहिलो आउटपुट अहिले देखियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The constructor is finished. Object s1 is now ready in memory. Control returns to main().
items.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर सकियो। अब्जेक्ट s1 मेमोरीमा तयार भयो। नियन्त्रण main() मा फर्कियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Object s2 is being created with "Sita" and 16. The constructor is called again.
items.ne: "Sita" र 16 सहित अब्जेक्ट s2 बन्दैछ। कन्स्ट्रक्टर फेरि बोलियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Inside the constructor again. This time n = "Sita" and r = 16.
items.ne: फेरि कन्स्ट्रक्टर भित्र। यस पटक n = "Sita" र r = 16।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: s2 has its OWN separate copy of name. It becomes "Sita". s1 is not affected.
items.ne: s2 सँग आफ्नै छुट्टै name छ। यो "Sita" भयो। s1 मा कुनै असर पर्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: roll of s2 becomes 16.
items.ne: s2 को roll 16 भयो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The second line of output is printed.
items.ne: दोस्रो आउटपुट लाइन छापियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Constructor finished. Both objects now exist.
items.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर सकियो। अब दुवै अब्जेक्ट अस्तित्वमा छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: s1.display() is called. The dot operator picks the object s1.
items.ne: s1.display() बोलाइयो। डट अपरेटरले s1 अब्जेक्ट छान्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: display() runs using s1 data, so it prints Ram and 15.
items.ne: display() ले s1 कै डाटा प्रयोग गर्‍यो, त्यसैले Ram र 15 छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: display() ends. Back in main().
items.ne: display() सकियो। फेरि main() मा।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: s2.display() is called. The SAME function, but a different object.
items.ne: s2.display() बोलाइयो। उही फङ्सन, तर फरक अब्जेक्ट।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Now display() uses s2 data, so it prints Sita and 16.
items.ne: अब display() ले s2 को डाटा प्रयोग गर्‍यो, त्यसैले Sita र 16 छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: display() ends again.
items.ne: display() फेरि सकियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: return 0; main() is ending, so every local object must now be destroyed.
items.ne: return 0; main() सकिँदैछ, त्यसैले सबै लोकल अब्जेक्ट अब नष्ट हुनुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: IMPORTANT: objects are destroyed in REVERSE order of creation. s2 was made last, so s2 is destroyed FIRST.
items.ne: महत्त्वपूर्ण: अब्जेक्ट बनेको उल्टो क्रममा नष्ट हुन्छन्। s2 पछि बनेको थियो, त्यसैले s2 नै पहिले नष्ट हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The destructor of s2 prints its message.
items.ne: s2 को डिस्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो सन्देश छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Now the destructor of s1 runs — the object created first is destroyed last.
items.ne: अब s1 को डिस्ट्रक्टर चल्यो — पहिले बनेको अब्जेक्ट अन्तिममा नष्ट हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The destructor of s1 prints its message.
items.ne: s1 को डिस्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो सन्देश छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The program ends. Notice: you never called the constructor or destructor yourself — C++ called both automatically.
items.ne: प्रोग्राम सकियो। हेर्नुहोस्: तपाईंले कन्स्ट्रक्टर वा डिस्ट्रक्टर हातले बोलाउनु परेन — C++ ले आफैं बोलायो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The program starts at main().
items.ne: प्रोग्राम main() बाट सुरु भयो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: ONE object p of class Puppy is created. But Puppy is built on top of Dog, and Dog is built on top of Animal.
items.ne: Puppy क्लासको एउटा अब्जेक्ट p बन्यो। तर Puppy, Dog माथि बनेको छ र Dog, Animal माथि बनेको छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: RULE: the constructor of the TOP-MOST base class runs first. So Animal() runs first.
items.ne: नियम: सबैभन्दा माथिको base क्लासको कन्स्ट्रक्टर पहिले चल्छ। त्यसैले Animal() पहिले चल्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Animal constructor prints its line.
items.ne: Animal कन्स्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Next the middle class constructor Dog() runs.
items.ne: त्यसपछि बीचको क्लास Dog() को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Dog constructor prints its line.
items.ne: Dog कन्स्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Last of all, the constructor of the class we actually created — Puppy() — runs.
items.ne: सबैभन्दा अन्त्यमा, हामीले साँच्चै बनाएको क्लास Puppy() को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Puppy constructor prints its line. The object p is now fully built.
items.ne: Puppy कन्स्ट्रक्टरले आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो। अब अब्जेक्ट p पूरै तयार भयो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p.eat() is called. Puppy has no eat() of its own, so C++ looks up to Dog, then up to Animal.
items.ne: p.eat() बोलाइयो। Puppy सँग आफ्नै eat() छैन, त्यसैले C++ माथि Dog मा, अनि Animal मा खोज्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: eat() is found in Animal and runs. This is inheritance working — code reused without rewriting.
items.ne: eat() Animal मा भेटियो र चल्यो। यही इनहेरिटेन्सको काम हो — नलेखीकनै कोड पुनः प्रयोग।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p.bark() is called. It is not in Puppy, so C++ looks up to Dog.
items.ne: p.bark() बोलाइयो। Puppy मा छैन, त्यसैले C++ माथि Dog मा हेर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: bark() is found in Dog and runs.
items.ne: bark() Dog मा भेटियो र चल्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p.weep() is called. This one belongs to Puppy itself.
items.ne: p.weep() बोलाइयो। यो चाहिँ Puppy कै आफ्नो हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: weep() runs from Puppy.
items.ne: Puppy बाट weep() चल्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: return 0; the program is ending. (Destructors, if written, would run in the reverse order: Puppy, then Dog, then Animal.)
items.ne: return 0; प्रोग्राम सकिँदैछ। (डिस्ट्रक्टर लेखिएको भए उल्टो क्रममा चल्थ्यो: Puppy, अनि Dog, अनि Animal।)

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Program ends. One object, three constructors, and three functions coming from three different classes.
items.ne: प्रोग्राम सकियो। एउटा अब्जेक्ट, तीन कन्स्ट्रक्टर, र तीन फरक क्लासबाट आएका तीन फङ्सन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p is declared as a pointer to Shape. It is empty right now — it points to nothing.
items.ne: p लाई Shape को पोइन्टरका रूपमा घोषणा गरियो। अहिले यो खाली छ — कतै देखाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A Circle object c is created in memory.
items.ne: मेमोरीमा Circle अब्जेक्ट c बन्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A Square object s is created in memory.
items.ne: मेमोरीमा Square अब्जेक्ट s बन्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p = &c;  The Shape pointer now stores the ADDRESS of the Circle object. This is allowed because Circle IS-A Shape.
items.ne: p = &c;  अब Shape पोइन्टरसँग Circle अब्जेक्टको ठेगाना छ। Circle पनि एक प्रकारको Shape भएकाले यो मिल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p->draw() is called. The arrow operator is used because p is a pointer.
items.ne: p->draw() बोलाइयो। p पोइन्टर भएकाले एरो अपरेटर प्रयोग गरियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: draw() is marked VIRTUAL in the base class. So C++ does NOT decide now — it waits and checks the real object at run time.
items.ne: base क्लासमा draw() लाई VIRTUAL लेखिएको छ। त्यसैले C++ ले अहिले निर्णय गर्दैन — चल्दै गर्दा वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The real object is a Circle, so the OVERRIDDEN Circle::draw() is chosen — not the base one.
items.ne: वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट Circle हो, त्यसैले override गरिएको Circle::draw() छानियो — base को होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Circle::draw() runs and prints its line.
items.ne: Circle::draw() चल्यो र आफ्नो लाइन छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p = &s;  The SAME pointer p now stores the address of the Square object instead.
items.ne: p = &s;  उही पोइन्टर p सँग अब Square अब्जेक्टको ठेगाना छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: p->draw() is called again — exactly the same line of code as before.
items.ne: p->draw() फेरि बोलाइयो — ठ्याक्कै पहिलेकै लाइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Again C++ checks at run time which object p is really pointing to.
items.ne: फेरि C++ ले चल्दै गर्दा p ले वास्तवमा कुन अब्जेक्ट देखाएको छ भनेर जाँच्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: This time the object is a Square, so Square::draw() is chosen.
items.ne: यस पटक अब्जेक्ट Square हो, त्यसैले Square::draw() छानियो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Square::draw() runs and prints a DIFFERENT line — from the same call.
items.ne: Square::draw() चल्यो र उही कलबाट फरक लाइन छाप्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: return 0; the program is ending.
items.ne: return 0; प्रोग्राम सकिँदैछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: EXAM POINT: if you delete the word "virtual" on this line, BOTH calls would print "Drawing a Shape", because C++ would then decide by the POINTER TYPE at compile time instead.
items.ne: परीक्षा बुँदा: यो लाइनबाट "virtual" शब्द हटाए दुवै कलले "Drawing a Shape" छाप्थ्यो, किनकि तब C++ ले पोइन्टरको प्रकार हेरेर कम्पाइल गर्दै निर्णय गर्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Program ends. One call, two outputs — that is run-time polymorphism.
items.ne: प्रोग्राम सकियो। एउटै कल, दुई आउटपुट — यही run-time polymorphism हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A stack inserts and deletes at only one end called the top, so the last value pushed is the first one popped.
items.ne: स्ट्याकले एउटै छेउ (top) बाट राख्छ र झिक्छ, त्यसैले अन्तिममा हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A tree is non-linear because it is hierarchical — one node can connect to many child nodes.
items.ne: ट्री अरेखीय हो किनकि यो तह–तह मिलेको हुन्छ — एउटा नोड धेरै सन्तानसँग जोडिन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Fields make a record, and many related records together make a file.
items.ne: फिल्डहरू मिलेर रेकर्ड बन्छ, र धेरै रेकर्ड मिलेर फाइल बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A queue follows FIFO: new elements join at the rear and elements leave from the front, like a line at a counter.
items.ne: Queue ले FIFO मान्छ: नयाँ तत्त्व rear मा थपिन्छ र front बाट निस्कन्छ — काउन्टरको लाइन जस्तै।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A linked list is dynamic: nodes are allocated as needed, so it grows and shrinks at run time. An array is fixed once declared. The other three options describe an ARRAY — index access is O(1) in an array and requires walking the list in a linked list, and a linked list uses MORE memory per element because every node also stores a pointer.
items.ne: Linked list गतिशील हुन्छ: आवश्यकता अनुसार node बन्छन्, त्यसैले चल्दाचल्दै बढ्छ–घट्छ। Array घोषणा गरेपछि स्थिर हुन्छ। बाँकी तीन विकल्पले array लाई वर्णन गर्छन् — array मा index बाट पहुँच O(1) हो भने linked list मा हिँड्नुपर्छ, र linked list ले हरेक node मा pointer पनि राख्ने भएकाले प्रति तत्त्व बढी मेमोरी खान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Traversing means visiting each element once, usually to process or display it. Searching looks for one particular element and may stop early; sorting rearranges elements into order. All three are listed in the syllabus as operations on data structures.
items.ne: Traversing भनेको हरेक तत्त्वलाई एक पटक हेर्नु — प्रायः प्रशोधन गर्न वा देखाउन। Searching ले कुनै एउटा तत्त्व खोज्छ र बीचैमा रोकिन सक्छ; sorting ले क्रममा मिलाउँछ। तीनै पाठ्यक्रममा डाटा स्ट्रक्चरका operation का रूपमा सूचीबद्ध छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The syllabus names exactly two non-linear structures: trees and graphs. In a linear structure every element has one predecessor and one successor; in a non-linear one an element may connect to many. Option 4 is the trap — a tree is non-linear but a queue is linear, so the pair fails the word ONLY.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमले ठ्याक्कै दुई non-linear संरचना नाम लिन्छ: tree र graph। Linear संरचनामा हरेक तत्त्वको एक अघिल्लो र एक पछिल्लो हुन्छ; non-linear मा एउटै तत्त्व धेरैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। चौथो विकल्प पासो हो — tree non-linear हो तर queue linear, त्यसैले "मात्र" भन्ने शर्त पूरा हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Work it through: after the three pushes the stack is 10, 20, 30 with 30 on top. A pop removes the TOP, so 30 goes and 20 is on top. Pushing 40 puts it above 20. The top is 40. The common slip is popping 10 — but LIFO removes the last one in, not the first.
items.ne: क्रमैसँग हेर्नुहोस्: तीन push पछि stack मा 10, 20, 30 हुन्छ र टुप्पोमा 30। Pop ले टुप्पोको हटाउँछ, त्यसैले 30 गयो र 20 टुप्पोमा आयो। 40 push गर्दा त्यो 20 माथि बस्छ। टुप्पोमा 40 छ। सामान्य गल्ती 10 हटाउनु हो — तर LIFO ले पहिलो होइन, अन्तिम छिरेको हटाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A data structure is a way of organising data in memory so a program can use it efficiently. The same data stored badly makes a program slow; stored well it makes it fast. Converting source to machine code is the compiler's job, not a data structure's.
items.ne: डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनेको मेमोरीमा data मिलाएर राख्ने तरिका हो, जसले प्रोग्रामलाई छिटो काम गर्न दिन्छ। उही data नमिलाई राखे प्रोग्राम ढिलो हुन्छ; मिलाएर राखे छिटो। Source लाई मेसिन कोडमा बदल्ने काम compiler को हो, डाटा स्ट्रक्चरको होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A field, also called an attribute, is one property of an entity. A record is the whole collection of fields describing one entity (one student). A file is a collection of records. The three sit inside one another: field in record, record in file.
items.ne: Field — जसलाई attribute पनि भनिन्छ — entity को एउटा गुण हो। Record भनेको एउटै entity (एक विद्यार्थी) लाई वर्णन गर्ने सबै field को समूह। File भनेको record हरूको समूह। तीन एक–अर्काभित्र पर्छन्: field record भित्र, record file भित्र।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A print queue is FIFO — the document sent first is printed first, which is exactly what fairness requires. The other three are all LIFO and are modelled by a stack: undo reverses the most recent action, plates come off the top, and a function returns to the most recent caller.
items.ne: Print queue FIFO हो — पहिले पठाइएको कागजात पहिले छापिन्छ, र न्यायसंगत हुन त्यही चाहिन्छ। बाँकी तीनै LIFO हुन् र stack ले देखाउँछ: undo ले सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो काम उल्ट्याउँछ, थाल माथिबाट उठ्छ, र function सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो बोलाउनेकहाँ फर्कन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Choosing the right data structure makes a program faster and tidier; it does nothing about the correctness of your logic. A program with a perfect data structure and a wrong condition is still wrong. The first three are the advantages the syllabus lists.
items.ne: ठीक डाटा स्ट्रक्चर छान्दा प्रोग्राम छिटो र सफा हुन्छ; तपाईंको तर्क सही छ कि छैन भन्नेमा यसले केही गर्दैन। उत्कृष्ट डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भए पनि शर्त गलत भए प्रोग्राम गलत नै हुन्छ। पहिला तीन पाठ्यक्रमले लेखेका फाइदा हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Sorting once lets every later search be a binary search, which halves the remaining list at each step — about 10 comparisons for 1000 names instead of up to 1000. A stack would make it worse, since you can only reach the top. Shorter names and comments change readability, not running speed.
items.ne: एक पटक क्रममा मिलाएपछि हरेक पछिल्लो खोजी binary search हुन सक्छ, जसले हरेक चरणमा बाँकी सूची आधा गर्छ — हजार नामका लागि हजारसम्म होइन, करिब १० तुलना। Stack ले झन् बिगार्छ, किनकि टुप्पो मात्र छुन पाइन्छ। छोटो नाम र टिप्पणीले पढ्न सजिलो बनाउँछ, गति होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Exam tip — remember the ladder Field → Record → File. One field is one value; many fields make one record; many records make one file. The entity is the real thing all of it describes. Students most often mix up entity (the thing) with attribute (a property of the thing).
items.ne: फिल्ड → रेकर्ड → फाइल। इन्टिटी चाहिँ जुन वास्तविक वस्तुको वर्णन गरिँदैछ त्यो हो। विद्यार्थीहरूले प्रायः entity (वस्तु) र attribute (त्यसको गुण) लाई अलमल्याउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: marks[5] is outside the array and gives a garbage value or crashes the program. C++ does not warn you.
items.ne: अन्तिम तत्त्वका लागि marks[5]

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Which data structure does this need?
items.ne: यसलाई कुन डाटा स्ट्रक्चर चाहिन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Two questions settle every case. Is the shape a LINE or does it BRANCH? If it is a line, which end do things leave from — the end they went in at, or the other one? Commit before you check.
items.ne: दुई प्रश्नले हरेक केस मिलाउँछ। आकार रेखा हो कि हाँगा फैलिन्छ? रेखा भए चीज कुन छेउबाट निस्कन्छ — भित्र गएकै छेउबाट कि अर्कोबाट? जाँच्नुअघि छान्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Back returns to B, the page visited most recently — last in, first out. Pages go in and come out at the same end, and a stack is the only structure that behaves that way.
items.ne: Back ले सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो पृष्ठ B मा फर्काउँछ — पछि आएको पहिले जाने। पृष्ठहरू उही छेउबाट भित्र–बाहिर हुन्छन्, र यस्तो व्यवहार stack ले मात्र गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The report arrived first and prints first — first in, first out. Things enter at the rear and leave from the front, which is two different ends, and that is what makes it a queue rather than a stack.
items.ne: report पहिले आयो र पहिले छापिन्छ — पहिले आएको पहिले जाने। चीज पछाडिबाट भित्र र अगाडिबाट बाहिर जान्छ — दुई फरक छेउ, र यही फरकले यसलाई stack होइन queue बनाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Every folder sits inside exactly one parent folder and may hold many children, and no path ever leads back to where it started. One parent, many children, no cycle — that is a tree, and it is non-linear.
items.ne: हरेक फोल्डर ठ्याक्कै एउटै अभिभावक फोल्डरभित्र हुन्छ र धेरै छोरा राख्न सक्छ, र कुनै बाटो सुरुको ठाउँमा फर्किंदैन। एउटै अभिभावक, धेरै छोरा, चक्र छैन — यही tree हो, र यो non-linear हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The three routes close into a loop, so you can leave Kathmandu and arrive back at it. A tree can never do that, and no city is the parent of another — any node may connect to any node, which is a graph.
items.ne: तीन मार्ग मिलेर चक्र बन्छ, त्यसैले काठमाडौंबाट निस्केर काठमाडौं फर्कन सकिन्छ। Tree ले यो कहिल्यै गर्न सक्दैन, र कुनै सहर अर्कोको अभिभावक होइन — कुनै पनि बिन्दु कुनै पनि बिन्दुसँग जोडिन सक्छ, यही graph हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Undo removes the exclamation mark, the most recent change, and a second undo removes "setu". The order is the reverse of the order things were done in, so the structure holding them is a stack.
items.ne: Undo ले सबैभन्दा पछिल्लो परिवर्तन "!" हटाउँछ, र दोस्रो undo ले "setu"। क्रम काम गरेको क्रमको ठ्याक्कै उल्टो हुन्छ, त्यसैले यिनलाई राख्ने संरचना stack हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The new person joins at the back and is served sixth, while the person at the front is served next. Insertion at one end and deletion at the other is the definition of a queue.
items.ne: नयाँ मान्छे पछाडि उभिन्छ र छैटौं पालो पाउँछ, अगाडिकोले भर्खरको पालो पाउँछ। एक छेउबाट राख्ने र अर्को छेउबाट हटाउने — queue को परिभाषा यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: How one value becomes a field, fields become a record, and records become a file.
items.ne: एउटा मान → फिल्ड, फिल्डहरू → रेकर्ड, रेकर्डहरू → फाइल कसरी बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The classification tree. If a structure has levels or branches, it is non-linear.
items.ne: वर्गीकरणको रूख। तह वा हाँगा भएको संरचना non-linear हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Five integers in one continuous block. Index 0 to 4 — never 1 to 5.
items.ne: पाँच पूर्णांक एउटै लगातार ब्लकमा। index ० देखि ४ सम्म — १ देखि ५ होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Three nodes at scattered addresses, held together only by pointers.
items.ne: छरिएका ठेगानामा रहेका तीन नोड, पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडिएका।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Why this difference matters — array vs linked list in action
items.en: Inserting into the middle: the array must shift elements, the linked list only re-points two links. This single picture answers most array-vs-list questions.
items.ne: बीचमा थप्दा: एरेले तत्त्वहरू सार्नुपर्छ, लिंक्ड लिस्टले दुई लिंक मात्र फेर्छ। यही एउटा चित्रले array-vs-list का धेरै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: top moves.
items.ne: push र pop दुवै उही छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्। top

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Two different ends: join at the rear, leave from the front.
items.ne: दुई फरक छेउ: पछाडिबाट लाइनमा बस्ने, अगाडिबाट निस्कने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A is the root. D, E and F are leaves. D and E are siblings.
items.ne: A root हो। D, E, F leaf हुन्। D र E siblings हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The yellow path B → C → D → B is a cycle. A tree can never contain one.
items.ne: पहेँलो बाटो B → C → D → B एउटा चक्र हो। ट्रीमा यस्तो कहिल्यै हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Same books. Same room. Same librarian. Only the arrangement changed — and the speed changed completely. That arrangement is the data structure.
items.ne: व्यवहारिक उदाहरण — पुस्तकालय। ५,००० किताब भएको पुस्तकालय सम्झनुहोस्। किताबहरू नै डाटा हुन्। भुइँमा थुपारेको छ भने एउटा किताब खोज्न घण्टौं लाग्न सक्छ। तर विषय अनुसार नम्बर हालेको र्‍याकमा राखिएको छ भने एक मिनेटमै भेटिन्छ। किताब उही, कोठा उही — तर मिलाउने तरिका फेरियो, र गति पूरै फेरियो। त्यही मिलान नै डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The raw facts and figures that a computer stores or processes. On its own, data carries no meaning until it is organised.
items.ne: कच्चा तथ्य र अंक। मिलाएर नराखेसम्म यसको अर्थ हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A data item that can be divided into smaller sub-items.
items.ne: फेरि साना टुक्रामा भाग गर्न मिल्ने डाटा आइटम।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A data item that cannot be divided any further. Also called an atomic item.
items.ne: अब भाग गर्न नमिल्ने डाटा आइटम।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A collection of related data items (fields) that together describe one thing. One row of a table.
items.ne: एउटै वस्तुलाई जनाउने सम्बन्धित फिल्डहरूको समूह — तालिकाको एउटा हरफ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Any real-world thing, person or object about which we store data.
items.ne: जुन वास्तविक वस्तु/व्यक्तिको बारेमा डाटा राखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One property or characteristic of an entity. One column of a table.
items.ne: इन्टिटीको एउटा गुण वा विशेषता — तालिकाको एउटा स्तम्भ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A collection of related records of the same entity, stored together.
items.ne: एउटै इन्टिटीका धेरै रेकर्डहरूको संग्रह।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: i < 5, so i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — exactly the five valid indexes.
items.ne: लुप i < 5

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Analogy — a pile of plates You wash plates and stack them one on top of another. The plate you put down last sits on top, so it is the plate you pick up first. The very first plate is at the bottom and leaves last. You cannot pull a plate from the middle without lifting the ones above it.
items.ne: उदाहरण — थाकिएका प्लेट। धोएर एक–अर्कामाथि थुपारेका प्लेटमध्ये अन्तिममा राखेको सबैभन्दा माथि हुन्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यही उठाइन्छ। पहिलो प्लेट सबैभन्दा तल हुन्छ र अन्तिममा निस्कन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The bus-route case is the one worth reading the reason for even when you get it right. It is a graph for one reason only — the routes close into a loop — and that single property is what separates every graph question from every tree question.
items.ne: कुनै बटन थिच्नुअघि लिडका दुई प्रश्नको उत्तर दिनुहोस्। आकार हाँगिन्छ? हाँगिए non-linear — हरेक वस्तुको एउटै अभिभावक र कुनै चक्र नभए tree, यीमध्ये एक पनि नमिले graph। नहाँगिए चीज कुन छेउबाट निस्कन्छ सोध्नुहोस्: भित्र गएकै छेउबाट भए stack, पर्तिरको छेउबाट भए queue। 1.6 Operations on Data Structures OperationWhat it does TraversingVisiting each element exactly once in order to read or process it. हरेक तत्त्वलाई ठीक एक पटक भेटेर पढ्ने वा प्रयोग गर्ने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Finding the location of an element that matches a given value.
items.ne: दिइएको मानसँग मिल्ने तत्त्व कहाँ छ भनेर पत्ता लगाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Adding a new element into the structure.
items.ne: संरचनामा नयाँ तत्त्व थप्ने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Removing an existing element from the structure.
items.ne: भइरहेको तत्त्व हटाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Arranging elements in a particular order — ascending or descending.
items.ne: तत्त्वहरूलाई सानोदेखि ठूलो वा ठूलोदेखि सानो क्रममा मिलाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Joining two sorted lists into one single sorted list.
items.ne: दुईवटा मिलेका लिस्टलाई जोडेर एउटै मिलेको लिस्ट बनाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Before you open the output: how many comparisons does this loop make before break stops it? That number, not the printed line, is what a question about searching is really asking for.

items.en: Advantages: (i) efficiency — searching and sorting become faster; (ii) reusability — one structure can be used in many programs; (iii) abstraction — the user need not know the internal working; (iv) better memory utilisation.

items.en: Entity — a real-world thing about which data is stored, e.g. Student. Attribute (field) — one property of that entity, e.g. Name, Roll, Marks. Record — a collection of related fields describing one entity, e.g. Ram | 15 | 78. File — a collection of related records, e.g. the records of all 40 students.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A data structure is a particular way of organising, storing and managing data in a computer's memory so that it can be accessed and modified efficiently. Notice what the definition does not say. A data structure is not the data itself. It is the arrangement of the data, together with the rules for putting data in and taking data out.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनेको कम्प्युटरको मेमोरीमा डाटालाई मिलाएर, राखेर र व्यवस्थापन गर्ने एउटा खास तरिका हो, ताकि त्यो डाटा छिटो र सजिलै प्रयोग र परिवर्तन गर्न सकियोस्। ध्यान दिनुहोस् — डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनेको डाटा आफैं होइन। यो डाटा कसरी मिलाइएको छ भन्ने कुरा र डाटा राख्ने–झिक्ने नियम हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Six advantages Efficiency — the right structure makes searching and sorting far faster. Searching a sorted array by binary search takes about 20 steps for 10,00,000 items; checking one by one takes up to 10,00,000 steps. Reusability — one structure such as a stack can be written once and used in many different programs. Abstraction — the user calls push() without knowing how it works inside. Better memory use — structures like the linked list take memory only when it is actually needed. Easy maintenance — organised data means shorter, clearer code that is easier to correct later. Handles large data — millions of records stay manageable.
items.ne: छ वटा फाइदा Efficiency (दक्षता) — सही स्ट्रक्चरले खोज्ने र क्रम मिलाउने काम धेरै छिटो बनाउँछ। १० लाख डाटामा binary search ले करिब २० चरणमै भेट्छ; एक–एक गरी हेर्दा १० लाख चरणसम्म लाग्न सक्छ। Reusability — एक पटक लेखेको स्ट्याक धेरै प्रोग्राममा प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ। Abstraction — भित्र कसरी चल्छ थाहा नपाई पनि push() प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ। मेमोरीको राम्रो प्रयोग — linked list ले चाहिएको बेला मात्र मेमोरी लिन्छ। सजिलो मर्मत — मिलेको डाटाले कोड छोटो र स्पष्ट बनाउँछ। ठूलो डाटा — लाखौं रेकर्ड पनि व्यवस्थित रहन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Why they are needed Data keeps growing — programs must handle huge amounts of data. Processor speed is limited — a faster CPU cannot rescue a badly arranged pile of data. Search must be fast — searching 1,00,000 unsorted names one by one is far too slow. Many users at once — many requests must reach the data quickly. Memory is limited — data must be stored without waste.
items.ne: किन आवश्यक छ डाटा बढ्दै छ — प्रोग्रामले धेरै ठूलो डाटा सम्हाल्नुपर्छ। प्रोसेसरको गति सीमित छ — छिटो CPU ले पनि बिग्रेको मिलानलाई सुधार्न सक्दैन। खोजी छिटो हुनुपर्छ — नमिलेको १ लाख नाम एक–एक गरी खोज्न धेरै ढिलो हुन्छ। एकैचोटि धेरै प्रयोगकर्ता — डाटा छिटो पुग्नुपर्छ। मेमोरी सीमित छ — खेर नफाली राख्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The two main groups Linear data structure: the elements are arranged in a sequence, one after another. Each element has exactly one element before it and one after it. The whole structure can be traversed completely in a single run. Non-linear data structure: the elements are not in a sequence. One element may be connected to many elements. It cannot be traversed in one straight run. Some books first split data structures into primitive (int, float, char, pointer — supplied by the language) and non-primitive (built by the programmer). Linear and non-linear are the two kinds of non-primitive structures.
items.ne: दुई मुख्य समूह Linear (रेखीय): तत्त्वहरू एउटा पछि अर्को गरी क्रमैसँग राखिन्छन्। प्रत्येकको एउटा अघिल्लो र एउटा पछिल्लो हुन्छ। एकै पटकमा सबै घुम्न सकिन्छ। Non-linear (अरेखीय): तत्त्वहरू क्रममा हुँदैनन्। एउटा तत्त्व धेरैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। सिधा एकै पटकमा सबै घुम्न सकिँदैन। केही किताबले पहिले primitive (int, float, char, pointer — भाषाले नै दिएको) र non-primitive (प्रोग्रामरले बनाएको) भनेर छुट्याउँछन्। Linear र non-linear चाहिँ non-primitive कै दुई प्रकार हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0].
items.ne: एरे एरे भनेको एउटै प्रकारका तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी मा राखिन्छ र सधैं ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। मेमोरी लगातार भएकाले र हरेक तत्त्वको साइज उही भएकाले कम्प्युटरले जुनसुकै तत्त्वको ठेगाना तुरुन्तै गणना गर्न सक्छ: ठेगाना = base + index × size। त्यसैले एरेको पहुँचलाई direct/random access भनिन्छ — a[900] मा पुग्न पनि a[0] जत्तिकै समय लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first).
items.ne: लिंक्ड लिस्ट लिंक्ड लिस्ट भनेको नोड भनिने तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो। हरेक नोडका दुई भाग हुन्छन्: डाटा, र अर्को नोडको ठेगाना राख्ने pointer। नोडहरू लगातार मेमोरीमा हुँदैनन् — जहाँसुकै हुन सक्छन्। लिस्टलाई पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडेर राख्छ। head नामक पोइन्टरले पहिलो नोड देखाउँछ, र अन्तिम नोडको पोइन्टरमा NULL हुन्छ जसले अन्त्य जनाउँछ। एक–एक नोड गरी मेमोरी लिने भएकाले लिस्ट प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा घटबढ हुन सक्छ। यसैलाई dynamic डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनिन्छ। प्रकार: singly (एउटा पोइन्टर), doubly (अघि र पछि दुवैको पोइन्टर), circular (अन्तिम नोडले पहिलो नोड देखाउने)।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix.
items.ne: स्ट्याक स्ट्याक त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ राख्ने र झिक्ने काम एउटै छेउ (top) बाट मात्र हुन्छ। यसले LIFO — Last In, First Out नियम मान्छ। अन्तिममा हालेको तत्त्व सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: push() हाल्ने, pop() झिक्ने, peek() नझिकी हेर्ने, isEmpty() र isFull() अवस्था जाँच्ने। Overflow = भरिएको स्ट्याकमा push। Underflow = खाली स्ट्याकबाट pop। खाली स्ट्याकमा top = -1 हुन्छ। प्रयोग: ब्राउजरको Back बटन, एडिटरको Undo, फङ्सन कलको call stack, स्ट्रिङ उल्टाउने, ब्राकेट मिलेको छ कि छैन जाँच्ने, infix लाई postfix मा बदल्ने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers.
items.ne: क्यु क्यु त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ एउटा छेउ (rear) बाट राखिन्छ र अर्को छेउ (front) बाट झिकिन्छ। यसले FIFO — First In, First Out नियम मान्छ। पहिले हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: enqueue() पछाडि हाल्ने, dequeue() अगाडिबाट झिक्ने, front() पहिलो तत्त्व नझिकी हेर्ने। front > rear हुँदा क्यु खाली हुन्छ। प्रकार: simple queue, circular queue (rear घुमेर सुरुमै फर्कने), priority queue (महत्त्वपूर्ण तत्त्व पहिले निस्कने), deque (दुवै छेउबाट राख्न–झिक्न मिल्ने)। प्रयोग: प्रिन्टरको job queue, CPU scheduling, कल–सेन्टरको लाइन, डाटा बफर।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children.
items.ne: ट्री ट्री त्यस्तो अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जसले डाटालाई नोडहरूको तह (hierarchy) मा मिलाउँछ। माथि एउटा मात्र root हुन्छ, र अरू हरेक नोडको एउटा मात्र parent हुन्छ। ट्रीमा चक्र (cycle) हुँदैन। जान्नैपर्ने शब्दहरू: Root — सबैभन्दा माथिको नोड; parent नभएको एक मात्र नोड। Parent — तल नोड भएको नोड। Child — कुनै नोडको ठीक तलको नोड। Siblings — एउटै parent भएका नोडहरू। Leaf — सन्तान नभएको नोड। Level — root level ०, त्यसका सन्तान level १, यसरी नै। Height — root देखि सबैभन्दा तलको leaf सम्मको तह संख्या। Binary tree भनेको हरेक नोडका बढीमा दुई सन्तान हुने ट्री हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Graph A graph is a non-linear data structure made of a set of vertices (also called nodes) joined by a set of edges (lines). Any vertex may connect to any other vertex. There is no root, no parent–child rule, and cycles are allowed — this is the main difference from a tree. In a directed graph the edges have arrows (one-way). In an undirected graph the edges have no direction (two-way). A weighted graph puts a number on each edge, for example the distance between two cities. Applications: road maps and Google Maps routing, social networks, computer networks.
items.ne: ग्राफ ग्राफ भनेको vertex (बिन्दु) हरूको समूह र तिनलाई जोड्ने edge (रेखा) हरूको समूहबाट बनेको अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो। जुनसुकै vertex जुनसुकैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। root हुँदैन, parent–child नियम हुँदैन, र चक्र (cycle) हुन सक्छ — ट्रीसँगको मुख्य फरक यही हो। Directed graph मा edge मा तीर हुन्छ (एकतर्फी)। Undirected मा दिशा हुँदैन। Weighted graph मा हरेक edge मा संख्या हुन्छ, जस्तै दुई सहरबीचको दूरी। प्रयोग: सडक नक्सा र Google Maps, सामाजिक सञ्जाल, कम्प्युटर नेटवर्क।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Array
items.ne: — एरे

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — एरे Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0]. एरे एरे भनेको एउटै प्रकारका तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी मा राखिन्छ र सधैं ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। मेमोरी लगातार भएकाले र हरेक तत्त्वको साइज उही भएकाले कम्प्युटरले जुनसुकै तत्त्वको ठेगाना तुरुन्तै गणना गर्न सक्छ: ठेगाना = base + index × size। त्यसैले एरेको पहुँचलाई direct/random access भनिन्छ — a[900] मा पुग्न पनि a[0] जत्तिकै समय लाग्छ। {{dia:arrayMemory}} Five integers in one continuous block. Index 0 to 4 — never 1 to 5. पाँच पूर्णांक एउटै लगातार ब्लकमा। index ० देखि ४ सम्म — १ देखि ५ होइन। Example 1 Declaring an array and printing it #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int marks[5] = {75, 82, 60, 91, 48}; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { cout << "marks[" << i << "] = " << marks[i] << endl; } return 0; } Output marks[0] = 75 marks[1] = 82 marks[2] = 60 marks[3] = 91 marks[4] = 48 The loop runs while i < 5, so i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — exactly the five valid indexes. लुप i < 5 सम्म चल्छ, त्यसैले i ले ०,१,२,३,४ मान लिन्छ — यीनै पाँच वटा मान्य index हुन्। Common mistake Writing marks[5] to reach the last element. In an array of size 5 the last index is 4. marks[5] is outside the array and gives a garbage value or crashes the program. C++ does not warn you. अन्तिम तत्त्वका लागि marks[5] लेख्नु गलत हो। साइज ५ को एरेमा अन्तिम index ४ हो। marks[5] एरे बाहिर पर्छ र फोहोर मान दिन्छ वा प्रोग्राम क्र्यास हुन्छ। C++ ले चेतावनी दिँदैन। Size 5 means last index 4. The last valid index is always size − 1. साइज ५ भए अन्तिम index ४। अन्तिम मान्य index सधैं साइज − १ हुन्छ। 1.5.1 (b) Linked List
items.ne: — लिंक्ड लिस्ट

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — लिंक्ड लिस्ट Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first). लिंक्ड लिस्ट लिंक्ड लिस्ट भनेको नोड भनिने तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो। हरेक नोडका दुई भाग हुन्छन्: डाटा, र अर्को नोडको ठेगाना राख्ने pointer। नोडहरू लगातार मेमोरीमा हुँदैनन् — जहाँसुकै हुन सक्छन्। लिस्टलाई पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडेर राख्छ। head नामक पोइन्टरले पहिलो नोड देखाउँछ, र अन्तिम नोडको पोइन्टरमा NULL हुन्छ जसले अन्त्य जनाउँछ। एक–एक नोड गरी मेमोरी लिने भएकाले लिस्ट प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा घटबढ हुन सक्छ। यसैलाई dynamic डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनिन्छ। प्रकार: singly (एउटा पोइन्टर), doubly (अघि र पछि दुवैको पोइन्टर), circular (अन्तिम नोडले पहिलो नोड देखाउने)। {{dia:linkedList}} Three nodes at scattered addresses, held together only by pointers. छरिएका ठेगानामा रहेका तीन नोड, पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडिएका। Example 2 What one node looks like in C++ struct Node { int data; // part 1 — the value Node *next; // part 2 — address of the next node }; int main() { Node *head = new Node; // create the first node head->data = 75; head->next = NULL; // NULL means "the list ends here" return 0; } Notice Node *next; — a Node that stores the address of another Node. That single line is what makes the chain possible. Node *next; हेर्नुहोस् — एउटा Node ले अर्को Node को ठेगाना राख्छ। यही एउटा लाइनले शृंखला सम्भव बनाउँछ। Why this difference matters — array vs linked list in action {{dia:arrayVsList}} Inserting into the middle: the array must shift elements, the linked list only re-points two links. This single picture answers most array-vs-list questions. बीचमा थप्दा: एरेले तत्त्वहरू सार्नुपर्छ, लिंक्ड लिस्टले दुई लिंक मात्र फेर्छ। यही एउटा चित्रले array-vs-list का धेरै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिन्छ। 1.5.1 (c) Stack
items.ne: — स्ट्याक

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — स्ट्याक Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix. स्ट्याक स्ट्याक त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ राख्ने र झिक्ने काम एउटै छेउ (top) बाट मात्र हुन्छ। यसले LIFO — Last In, First Out नियम मान्छ। अन्तिममा हालेको तत्त्व सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: push() हाल्ने, pop() झिक्ने, peek() नझिकी हेर्ने, isEmpty() र isFull() अवस्था जाँच्ने। Overflow = भरिएको स्ट्याकमा push। Underflow = खाली स्ट्याकबाट pop। खाली स्ट्याकमा top = -1 हुन्छ। प्रयोग: ब्राउजरको Back बटन, एडिटरको Undo, फङ्सन कलको call stack, स्ट्रिङ उल्टाउने, ब्राकेट मिलेको छ कि छैन जाँच्ने, infix लाई postfix मा बदल्ने। {{dia:stackOps}} Both push and pop use the same end. Only top moves. push र pop दुवै उही छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्। top मात्र सर्छ। Analogy — a pile of plates You wash plates and stack them one on top of another. The plate you put down last sits on top, so it is the plate you pick up first. The very first plate is at the bottom and leaves last. You cannot pull a plate from the middle without lifting the ones above it. उदाहरण — थाकिएका प्लेट। धोएर एक–अर्कामाथि थुपारेका प्लेटमध्ये अन्तिममा राखेको सबैभन्दा माथि हुन्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यही उठाइन्छ। पहिलो प्लेट सबैभन्दा तल हुन्छ र अन्तिममा निस्कन्छ। 1.5.1 (d) Queue
items.ne: — क्यु

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — क्यु Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers. क्यु क्यु त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ एउटा छेउ (rear) बाट राखिन्छ र अर्को छेउ (front) बाट झिकिन्छ। यसले FIFO — First In, First Out नियम मान्छ। पहिले हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: enqueue() पछाडि हाल्ने, dequeue() अगाडिबाट झिक्ने, front() पहिलो तत्त्व नझिकी हेर्ने। front > rear हुँदा क्यु खाली हुन्छ। प्रकार: simple queue, circular queue (rear घुमेर सुरुमै फर्कने), priority queue (महत्त्वपूर्ण तत्त्व पहिले निस्कने), deque (दुवै छेउबाट राख्न–झिक्न मिल्ने)। प्रयोग: प्रिन्टरको job queue, CPU scheduling, कल–सेन्टरको लाइन, डाटा बफर। {{dia:queueOps}} Two different ends: join at the rear, leave from the front. दुई फरक छेउ: पछाडिबाट लाइनमा बस्ने, अगाडिबाट निस्कने। 1.5.2 (a) Tree
items.ne: — ट्री

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — ट्री Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children. ट्री ट्री त्यस्तो अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जसले डाटालाई नोडहरूको तह (hierarchy) मा मिलाउँछ। माथि एउटा मात्र root हुन्छ, र अरू हरेक नोडको एउटा मात्र parent हुन्छ। ट्रीमा चक्र (cycle) हुँदैन। जान्नैपर्ने शब्दहरू: Root — सबैभन्दा माथिको नोड; parent नभएको एक मात्र नोड। Parent — तल नोड भएको नोड। Child — कुनै नोडको ठीक तलको नोड। Siblings — एउटै parent भएका नोडहरू। Leaf — सन्तान नभएको नोड। Level — root level ०, त्यसका सन्तान level १, यसरी नै। Height — root देखि सबैभन्दा तलको leaf सम्मको तह संख्या। Binary tree भनेको हरेक नोडका बढीमा दुई सन्तान हुने ट्री हो। {{dia:tree}} A is the root. D, E and F are leaves. D and E are siblings. A root हो। D, E, F leaf हुन्। D र E siblings हुन्। 1.5.2 (b) Graph
items.ne: — ग्राफ

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — ग्राफ Graph A graph is a non-linear data structure made of a set of vertices (also called nodes) joined by a set of edges (lines). Any vertex may connect to any other vertex. There is no root, no parent–child rule, and cycles are allowed — this is the main difference from a tree. In a directed graph the edges have arrows (one-way). In an undirected graph the edges have no direction (two-way). A weighted graph puts a number on each edge, for example the distance between two cities. Applications: road maps and Google Maps routing, social networks, computer networks. ग्राफ ग्राफ भनेको vertex (बिन्दु) हरूको समूह र तिनलाई जोड्ने edge (रेखा) हरूको समूहबाट बनेको अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो। जुनसुकै vertex जुनसुकैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। root हुँदैन, parent–child नियम हुँदैन, र चक्र (cycle) हुन सक्छ — ट्रीसँगको मुख्य फरक यही हो। Directed graph मा edge मा तीर हुन्छ (एकतर्फी)। Undirected मा दिशा हुँदैन। Weighted graph मा हरेक edge मा संख्या हुन्छ, जस्तै दुई सहरबीचको दूरी। प्रयोग: सडक नक्सा र Google Maps, सामाजिक सञ्जाल, कम्प्युटर नेटवर्क। {{dia:graph}} The yellow path B → C → D → B is a cycle. A tree can never contain one. पहेँलो बाटो B → C → D → B एउटा चक्र हो। ट्रीमा यस्तो कहिल्यै हुँदैन। Practise the judgement

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which structure does the situation need? What you will learn: to choose a structure from a description instead of reciting the classification. "Which data structure would you use and why" is how this unit's heaviest marks are actually asked. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्गीकरण घोकेर भन्नुको साटो विवरण पढेर संरचना छान्न। "कुन डाटा स्ट्रक्चर प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ र किन" भनी यस युनिटका सबैभन्दा भारी अंक यसै रूपमा सोधिन्छन्। How to use this Answer the two questions in the lead before you press anything. Does the shape branch? If yes it is non-linear — a tree if every item has one parent and no path loops back, a graph if either of those fails. If it does not branch, ask which end things leave from: the same end they entered is a stack, the far end is a queue. The bus-route case is the one worth reading the reason for even when you get it right. It is a graph for one reason only — the routes close into a loop — and that single property is what separates every graph question from every tree question. कुनै बटन थिच्नुअघि लिडका दुई प्रश्नको उत्तर दिनुहोस्। आकार हाँगिन्छ? हाँगिए non-linear — हरेक वस्तुको एउटै अभिभावक र कुनै चक्र नभए tree, यीमध्ये एक पनि नमिले graph। नहाँगिए चीज कुन छेउबाट निस्कन्छ सोध्नुहोस्: भित्र गएकै छेउबाट भए stack, पर्तिरको छेउबाट भए queue। 1.6 Operations on Data Structures OperationWhat it does TraversingVisiting each element exactly once in order to read or process it. हरेक तत्त्वलाई ठीक एक पटक भेटेर पढ्ने वा प्रयोग गर्ने। SearchingFinding the location of an element that matches a given value. दिइएको मानसँग मिल्ने तत्त्व कहाँ छ भनेर पत्ता लगाउने। InsertionAdding a new element into the structure. संरचनामा नयाँ तत्त्व थप्ने। DeletionRemoving an existing element from the structure. भइरहेको तत्त्व हटाउने। SortingArranging elements in a particular order — ascending or descending. तत्त्वहरूलाई सानोदेखि ठूलो वा ठूलोदेखि सानो क्रममा मिलाउने। MergingJoining two sorted lists into one single sorted list. दुईवटा मिलेका लिस्टलाई जोडेर एउटै मिलेको लिस्ट बनाउने। Example 3 Searching — linear search on an array #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int a[6] = {12, 45, 7, 23, 56, 9}; int key = 23, pos = -1; for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) { if (a[i] == key) { // compare one by one pos = i; break; // stop as soon as it is found } } if (pos != -1) cout << "Found " << key << " at index " << pos; else cout << "Not found"; return 0; } Before you open the output: how many comparisons does this loop make before break stops it? That number, not the printed line, is what a question about searching is really asking for. output खोल्नुअघि: break ले रोक्नुअघि यो loop ले कति पटक तुलना गर्छ? छापिने लाइन होइन, त्यही सङ्ख्या नै searching को प्रश्नले साँच्चै सोधेको कुरा हो। Output Found 23 at index 3 Linear search checks elements one by one and works even on unsorted data. Binary search is far faster but the data must be sorted first. Linear search ले एक–एक गरी जाँच्छ र नमिलेको डाटामा पनि चल्छ। Binary search धेरै छिटो हुन्छ तर डाटा मिलेको हुनैपर्छ। ▶ Experiment — Stack (LIFO) vs Queue (FIFO) Commit to an answer first, then run the experiment and see whether you were right. Guessing and being corrected is what makes this stick. Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् You push 10, then 20, then 30 onto an empty stack. You then call pop() once. Which value comes out? 10 20 30 Nothing A stack inserts and removes at one end only — the top. 30 was pushed last, so it is sitting on top and leaves first. Run the experiment below and watch top move. स्ट्याकले एउटै छेउ — top — बाट मात्र राख्छ र झिक्छ। ३० अन्तिममा हालिएकाले सबैभन्दा माथि छ, त्यसैले पहिले निस्कन्छ। तल प्रयोग चलाएर top सरेको हेर्नुहोस्। Interactive experiment
items.ne: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: · अन्तरक्रियात्मक प्रयोग Stack and Queue, side by side What you will learn: which end each structure uses, and why that one difference decides the order values come out. The running code line lights up and the console explains every step in both languages. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुवैले कुन छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्, र त्यही एउटा फरकले मान निस्कने क्रम कसरी निर्धारण गर्छ। Stack — LIFO Try it push() pop() peek() Reset top = -1 (empty) Queue — FIFO Try it enqueue() dequeue() front() Reset front = 0 · rear = -1 (empty) Why did this happen? In the stack, the value pushed last came out first — only top moved. That is LIFO. In the queue, the value inserted first came out first — rear moved on insert, front moved on delete. That is FIFO. Stack मा अन्तिममा हालेको मान पहिले निस्कियो — top मात्र सर्‍यो। यही LIFO हो। Queue मा पहिले हालेको मान पहिले निस्कियो — हाल्दा rear, झिक्दा front सर्‍यो। यही FIFO हो। Exam focus — questions asked from this unit SEE exam connection
items.ne: · परीक्षा जोड

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: · परीक्षा जोड Data structure terms, classification and operations are guaranteed marks — the definitions are asked almost every year. डाटा स्ट्रक्चरका शब्द, वर्गीकरण र अपरेसन पक्का अंक हुन् — परिभाषा लगभग हरेक वर्ष सोधिन्छ। Q1 · Define data structure and list any four advantages. [4 marks] Show the answer Model answer: A data structure is a particular way of organising, storing and managing data in a computer's memory so that it can be accessed and modified efficiently. Advantages: (i) efficiency — searching and sorting become faster; (ii) reusability — one structure can be used in many programs; (iii) abstraction — the user need not know the internal working; (iv) better memory utilisation. परिभाषा र कुनै चार फाइदा लेख्नुहोस्। माथिकै अंग्रेजी वाक्य जस्ताको तस्तै लेख्दा पूरा अंक आउँछ। Q2 · Differentiate between linear and non-linear data structures with examples. [4 marks] Show the answer In a linear data structure the elements are arranged in a sequence, one after another, at a single level, and the whole structure can be traversed in one run. Examples: array, linked list, stack, queue. In a non-linear data structure the elements are not in a sequence; one element may connect to many, the structure has multiple levels, and it cannot be traversed in one straight run. Examples: tree, graph. दुवैको परिभाषा + कम्तीमा दुई–दुई उदाहरण लेख्नुहोस्। तालिकाको रूपमा लेखे झन् राम्रो। Q3 · What is a stack? Explain LIFO with a real-life example and name its operations. [5 marks] Show the answer A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows LIFO — Last In, First Out — meaning the element inserted last is removed first. Real-life example: a pile of plates. The plate placed last sits on top and is taken first. Operations: push() to insert, pop() to remove, peek()/top() to read the top element, isEmpty() and isFull() to check the state. Pushing into a full stack causes overflow; popping from an empty stack causes underflow. परिभाषा + LIFO + प्लेटको उदाहरण + अपरेसनका नाम — चारै कुरा लेखे पूरा अंक। Q4 · Explain the terms entity, attribute, record and file with one example each. [4 marks] Show the answer Entity — a real-world thing about which data is stored, e.g. Student. Attribute (field) — one property of that entity, e.g. Name, Roll, Marks. Record — a collection of related fields describing one entity, e.g. Ram | 15 | 78. File — a collection of related records, e.g. the records of all 40 students. चारै शब्दको एक–एक लाइन परिभाषा र एक–एक उदाहरण दिनुहोस्। Key points to revise

items.en: What you will learn: to choose a structure from a description instead of reciting the classification. "Which data structure would you use and why" is how this unit's heaviest marks are actually asked.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्गीकरण घोकेर भन्नुको साटो विवरण पढेर संरचना छान्न। "कुन डाटा स्ट्रक्चर प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ र किन" भनी यस युनिटका सबैभन्दा भारी अंक यसै रूपमा सोधिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: What you will learn: which end each structure uses, and why that one difference decides the order values come out. The running code line lights up and the console explains every step in both languages.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुवैले कुन छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्, र त्यही एउटा फरकले मान निस्कने क्रम कसरी निर्धारण गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Compilation is how any source program becomes machine code — it happens to C programs too and has nothing to do with objects. The features of OOP are class, object, encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, data hiding and message passing.
items.ne: Compilation भनेको जुनसुकै source प्रोग्राम मेसिन कोड बन्ने तरिका हो — C प्रोग्राममा पनि हुन्छ र object सँग यसको सम्बन्ध छैन। OOP का विशेषता: class, object, encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, data hiding र message passing।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Structured programming divides a problem into functions, and data is passed around between them. OOP divides it into objects, each holding its own data together with the functions allowed to touch that data. That binding is what makes data hiding possible. Both use loops, variables and a compiler.
items.ne: Structured programming ले समस्यालाई function मा बाँड्छ, र data तिनीहरूबीच पठाइन्छ। OOP ले object मा बाँड्छ, र हरेक object ले आफ्नो data सँगै त्यो data छुन पाउने function पनि राख्छ। यही बन्धनले data hiding सम्भव बनाउँछ। दुवैमा loop, variable र compiler चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Keywords are words reserved by the language with a fixed meaning, so they cannot be used as names. An identifier is a name YOU choose, such as a variable or function name. Both are kinds of token, along with constants, strings, operators and punctuators.
items.ne: Keyword भनेका भाषाले आफ्नै लागि सुरक्षित राखेका, निश्चित अर्थ भएका शब्द हुन्, त्यसैले तिनलाई नामका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन। Identifier भनेको तपाईंले छानेको नाम — जस्तै variable वा function को नाम। दुवै token का किसिम हुन्, constant, string, operator र punctuator सँगै।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: An identifier may contain letters, digits and the underscore, and must not START with a digit. _totalMarks is fine. 2ndMarks begins with a digit; total marks contains a space; float is a reserved keyword, so it cannot be used as a name.
items.ne: Identifier मा अक्षर, अंक र underscore हुन सक्छन्, तर अंकबाट सुरु हुनु हुँदैन। _totalMarks ठीक छ। 2ndMarks अंकबाट सुरु भयो; total marks मा खाली ठाउँ छ; float सुरक्षित keyword भएकाले नाम बनाउन मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Read the arrows as the direction the data travels. cin >> n moves data FROM the input stream INTO n. cout << n moves it OUT of n to the screen. Writing cin << n is the most common beginner error in this unit — the arrows point the wrong way.
items.ne: तीरलाई data कता जान्छ भन्ने दिशा ठान्नुहोस्। cin >> n ले input बाट n भित्र data लैजान्छ। cout << n ले n बाट बाहिर स्क्रिनमा। cin << n लेख्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो — तीर उल्टो छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: It is a preprocessor directive that pastes in the iostream header, which declares cin, cout and the stream operators. Without it the compiler does not know what cout is. Execution always begins at main, whatever headers are included.
items.ne: यो preprocessor directive हो, जसले iostream header भित्र्याउँछ — र त्यसैले cin, cout तथा stream operator घोषणा गर्छ। यो नभए compiler लाई cout के हो थाहा हुँदैन। जुनसुकै header राखे पनि प्रोग्राम सधैं main बाट सुरु हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A do…while tests its condition AFTER the body, so the body always runs at least once. 5 is printed, i becomes 6, and only then is 6 < 3 tested — false, so the loop ends. Output is just 5. If this had been a plain while loop, the condition would have been tested first and nothing would have printed.
items.ne: do…while ले शर्त पछि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले body कम्तीमा एक पटक चल्छ। 5 छापिन्छ, i 6 हुन्छ, अनि मात्र 6 < 3 जाँचिन्छ — गलत, त्यसैले loop सकिन्छ। आउटपुट 5 मात्र। यदि साधारण while भएको भए शर्त पहिले जाँचिन्थ्यो र केही छापिँदैनथ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: This is called fall-through: once a case matches, statements keep executing until a break or the end of the switch. It compiles happily, which is what makes it dangerous — the program runs and quietly produces the wrong answer. Fall-through is occasionally useful on purpose, but a missing break is usually a bug.
items.ne: यसलाई fall-through भनिन्छ: एउटा case मिलेपछि break नआएसम्म वा switch नसकिएसम्म कथन चल्दै जान्छन्। यो सजिलै compile हुन्छ — त्यही नै खतरा हो, किनकि प्रोग्राम चल्छ र चुपचाप गलत उत्तर दिन्छ। कहिलेकाहीं जानाजान fall-through राखिन्छ, तर छुटेको break प्रायः बग हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: float stores numbers with a fractional part. Storing 72.45 in an int does not round it — it truncates to 72 and the .45 is gone silently, which is why marks calculations written with int come out slightly wrong. char holds a single character and bool holds only true or false.
items.ne: float ले दशमलव भएको सङ्ख्या राख्छ। 72.45 लाई int मा राख्दा यो गोलो हुँदैन — काटिएर 72 हुन्छ र .45 चुपचाप हराउँछ; त्यसैले int ले लेखिएको अंक गणना अलिअलि गलत आउँछ। char ले एउटै अक्षर र bool ले true वा false मात्र राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: GUI design is a classic OOP application: every window, button and text box is an object with its own data and behaviour. Other areas the syllabus lists include simulation and modelling, real-time systems, office automation and CAD. The other three options are hardware tasks, not programming ones.
items.ne: GUI डिजाइन OOP को उत्कृष्ट प्रयोग हो: हरेक window, button र text box आफ्नै data र व्यवहार भएको object हो। पाठ्यक्रमले simulation र modelling, real-time प्रणाली, कार्यालय स्वचालन र CAD पनि लेख्छ। बाँकी तीन हार्डवेयरका काम हुन्, प्रोग्रामिङका होइनन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: C++ reads a function top to bottom, and a name must be declared before it is used. On the cout line the compiler has not met marks yet, so it reports an undeclared identifier. Moving the declaration above the cout fixes it. Note the error is at COMPILE time — the program never runs at all.
items.ne: C++ ले function लाई माथिबाट तल पढ्छ, र नाम प्रयोग गर्नुअघि घोषणा भइसक्नुपर्छ। cout भएको लाइनमा compiler ले marks भेटेकै छैन, त्यसैले undeclared identifier भन्छ। घोषणालाई cout भन्दा माथि सारे मिल्छ। ध्यान दिनुहोस्, त्रुटि compile कै बेला हुन्छ — प्रोग्राम चल्नै पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The loop runs with i = 1, 2, 3 and prints i × i each time: 1, 4, 9. It stops when i becomes 4 because 4 <= 3 is false, so 16 is never printed. Choosing 1 4 9 16 is the off-by-one slip — count how many times the condition is TRUE, not how many values i takes.
items.ne: Loop i = 1, 2, 3 मा चल्छ र हरेक पटक i × i छाप्छ: 1, 4, 9। i 4 हुँदा 4 <= 3 गलत हुने भएकाले रोकिन्छ, त्यसैले 16 कहिल्यै छापिँदैन। 1 4 9 16 छान्नु एक-ले-चुक्ने गल्ती हो — i कति मान लिन्छ होइन, शर्त कति पटक सही हुन्छ गन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Data hiding means the data is declared private, so only the class's own member functions can reach it. Encapsulation is the binding of data and functions together; data hiding is what that binding lets you enforce. Inheritance passes members to a derived class and polymorphism gives one name several forms.
items.ne: Data hiding भनेको data लाई private घोषणा गर्नु, ताकि class कै member function ले मात्र छुन सकून्। Encapsulation भनेको data र function सँगै बाँध्नु; त्यही बन्धनले data hiding लागू गर्न दिन्छ। Inheritance ले derived class लाई member दिन्छ र polymorphism ले एउटै नामलाई धेरै रूप।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The arrows point the way the data travels. cout << pushes a value OUT to the screen; cin >> pulls a value IN from the keyboard. Written as cin << n the compiler looks for a way to insert into an input stream, finds none, and stops — so this is a compile error, not a wrong answer at run time. An uninitialised int n; is perfectly legal, which is why option 2 is the tempting wrong one.
items.ne: तीरले data कुन दिशामा जान्छ देखाउँछ। cout << ले मान पर्दामा बाहिर पठाउँछ; cin >> ले किबोर्डबाट भित्र तान्छ। cin << n लेख्दा compiler ले input stream भित्र हाल्ने उपाय खोज्छ, पाउँदैन, र रोकिन्छ — त्यसैले यो चल्दाको गलत उत्तर होइन, compile त्रुटि हो। int n; लाई मान नदिई छोड्नु पूर्ण रूपमा वैध छ, त्यसैले दोस्रो विकल्प आकर्षक गलत उत्तर हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A switch JUMPS to the matching label and then keeps running straight down — the later case labels are only labels, not barriers. There is no break anywhere, so after printing B it carries on into case 3 and then default, giving BCD. default is not skipped just because a case already matched. Add break; to each case and the answer becomes B.
items.ne: switch ले मिल्ने label मा हाम फाल्छ र त्यसपछि सिधै तल चलिरहन्छ — पछिका case label मात्र हुन्, बार होइनन्। कतै break छैन, त्यसैले B छापेपछि case 3 र त्यसपछि default मा पनि पस्छ, र BCD आउँछ। कुनै case मिलेकै कारण default छुट्दैन। हरेक case मा break; थपे उत्तर B बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Which feature of OOP is this?
items.ne: यो OOP को कुन विशेषता हो?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Each case describes something a program does. Name the OOP feature responsible. Two of them are the pair students swap most often — read what is being HIDDEN and what is being IGNORED.
items.ne: हरेक केसले प्रोग्रामले गर्ने कुरा वर्णन गर्छ। जिम्मेवार OOP विशेषताको नाम दिनुहोस्। दुईवटा त्यस्ता छन् जुन विद्यार्थीले सबैभन्दा बढी साट्छन् — के लुकाइँदै छ र के बेवास्ता गरिँदै छ, त्यो पढ्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Data and the functions that work on it are wrapped together in one class, and the data is protected from direct access. That wrapping is encapsulation. The private keyword is its usual sign.
items.ne: डाटा र त्यसमा काम गर्ने फङ्सन एउटै क्लासमा बाँधिएका छन्, र डाटा सिधै पहुँचबाट जोगिएको छ। यही बाँधाइ नै encapsulation हो। private शब्द यसको सामान्य सङ्केत हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Only the necessary detail is shown and the internal working is hidden. That is abstraction — it hides COMPLEXITY. Encapsulation hides DATA. This pair is the one students swap.
items.ne: आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ र भित्रको काम लुकाइएको छ। यही abstraction हो — यसले जटिलता लुकाउँछ। Encapsulation ले डाटा लुकाउँछ। विद्यार्थीले साट्ने जोडी यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One class acquires the members of another, so common code is written once and reused. The IS-A test confirms it: a Dog IS-A Animal.
items.ne: एउटा क्लासले अर्कोका मेम्बर प्राप्त गर्छ, त्यसैले साझा कोड एक पटक लेखेर पुनः प्रयोग हुन्छ। IS-A जाँचले पुष्टि गर्छ: Dog एक प्रकारको Animal हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One name behaving in more than one form. This is compile-time polymorphism (function overloading) — the compiler decides which to call from the argument list.
items.ne: एउटै नाम एकभन्दा बढी रूपमा चल्नु। यो compile-time polymorphism (function overloading) हो — कुन चलाउने भन्ने compiler ले आर्गुमेन्ट हेरेर तय गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Also polymorphism, but run-time — function overriding with a virtual function. Same name, form chosen while the program runs rather than while it compiles.
items.ne: यो पनि polymorphism, तर run-time — virtual फङ्सनसहितको function overriding। उही नाम, तर रूप compile गर्दा होइन, चल्दै गर्दा छानिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Two classes acquiring members from one base is hierarchical inheritance. If the question had asked which draw() runs through a Shape pointer, the answer would have been polymorphism instead.
items.ne: दुई क्लासले एउटै base बाट मेम्बर लिनु hierarchical inheritance हो। Shape pointer बाट कुन draw() चल्छ भनी सोधेको भए उत्तर polymorphism हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Why OOP was invented — the problem it solves
items.en: In C, global data can be changed by any function. In C++, each object locks its own data away and offers only public functions.
items.ne: C मा global डाटालाई जुनसुकै फङ्सनले बदल्न सक्छ। C++ मा हरेक अब्जेक्टले आफ्नो डाटा बन्द राख्छ र public फङ्सन मात्र दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Every C++ program has these same parts. Learn to label them.
items.ne: हरेक C++ प्रोग्राममा यीनै भाग हुन्छन्। नाम दिन सिक्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Why OOP was invented — the problem it solves
items.en: That is exactly what an object does — and it is why an object is safer than a global variable that any function can change.
items.ne: उदाहरण — TV को रिमोट। बटन थिच्दा च्यानल फेरिन्छ। भित्रको सर्किट थाहा हुँदैन र छुन पनि पाइँदैन। रिमोटले भित्री भाग (डाटा) लुकाएर बटन (फङ्सन) मात्र दिन्छ। अब्जेक्ट ले पनि ठ्याक्कै यही गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A real-world entity that has data (its state) and functions (its behaviour). An object is an instance of a class and it takes memory.
items.ne: डाटा र व्यवहार भएको वास्तविक वस्तु। क्लासको एउटा instance, जसले मेमोरी लिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A blueprint or template that describes what data and functions its objects will have. A class takes no memory by itself.
items.ne: अब्जेक्ट बनाउने नक्सा वा टेम्प्लेट। यसले आफैंले मेमोरी लिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: private.
items.ne: डाटा र फङ्सनलाई एउटै एकाइमा बाँध्ने र डाटालाई बाहिरबाट लुकाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Showing only the necessary features to the user and hiding the internal details of how the work is actually done.
items.ne: आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाउने र भित्री जटिलता लुकाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One class acquires the properties and functions of another class, so that code can be reused instead of rewritten.
items.ne: एउटा क्लासले अर्को क्लासका गुण र फङ्सन प्राप्त गर्ने — कोड पुनः प्रयोग हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One name, many forms. The same function name or operator behaves differently in different situations.
items.ne: एउटै नाम, धेरै रूप। उही फङ्सनको नामले फरक अवस्थामा फरक काम गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Objects communicate with each other by calling one another's member functions — this is called sending a message.
items.ne: अब्जेक्टहरूले एकअर्काको फङ्सन बोलाएर सञ्चार गर्ने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The code that will run for a function call is decided at run time, not while compiling. This is what makes virtual functions work.
items.ne: कुन कोड चल्ने हो भन्ने कुरा कम्पाइल गर्दा होइन, चल्दै गर्दा निर्णय हुने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Abstraction. Complexity is hidden and only what you need is shown. The test that separates the two: abstraction hides COMPLEXITY, encapsulation hides DATA. A private variable with a getter is encapsulation; a dashboard that shows speed without the mechanism is abstraction. Unit 4 spends a whole section on this pair — it is asked most years.
items.ne: Abstraction। जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र चाहिने कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ। छुट्याउने जाँच: abstraction ले जटिलता लुकाउँछ, encapsulation ले डाटा। Getter सहितको private चल encapsulation हो; संयन्त्र नदेखाई गति देखाउने ड्यासबोर्ड abstraction हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Two cases are both polymorphism — one decided by the compiler, one decided while the program runs. Read the reasons: the exam asks you to name which kind.
items.ne: उत्तर दिनुअघि एउटै प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: के लुकाइँदै छ? फङ्सनपछाडि लुकेको डाटा = encapsulation। सरल अन्तरमुखपछाडि लुकेको जटिलता = abstraction। अर्कोका मेम्बर लिने क्लास = inheritance। एउटै नाम धेरै रूपमा = polymorphism। दुई केस polymorphism कै हुन् — एउटा compiler ले, अर्को चल्दै गर्दा तय हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Reserved words with a fixed meaning. You cannot use them as your own names.
items.ne: पहिल्यै अर्थ तोकिएका शब्द — आफ्नो नामका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Names the programmer creates for variables, functions and classes.
items.ne: प्रोग्रामरले भेरिएबल, फङ्सन र क्लासलाई राखेको नाम।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Fixed values that never change while the program runs.
items.ne: प्रोग्राम चल्दा नबदलिने मान।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Symbols that perform an operation on values.
items.ne: मानमाथि काम गर्ने चिन्ह।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Symbols that separate or group parts of the program.
items.ne: प्रोग्रामका भाग छुट्याउने वा समूह बनाउने चिन्ह।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A sequence of characters written inside double quotes.
items.ne: डबल कोट भित्रका अक्षरहरूको शृंखला।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Count the tokens in that line and write your number down before opening this. Almost everyone who gets it wrong forgets the same one — and it is the character at the very end.
items.ne: त्यो लाइनका token गन्नुहोस् र खोल्नुअघि आफ्नो सङ्ख्या लेख्नुहोस्। बिराउनेहरू प्रायः उही एउटा बिर्सन्छन् — र त्यो सबैभन्दा अन्तिमको अक्षर हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: ; (punctuator). Questions like "identify the tokens in the given statement" are common — count carefully.
items.ne: यो एउटै लाइनमा सात टोकन छन्। "दिइएको कथनमा token पहिचान गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न बारम्बार आउँछ — ध्यान दिएर गन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Whole numbers, no decimal point
items.ne: दशमलव नभएको पूर्ण संख्या

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Decimal numbers, about 6 digits of precision
items.ne: दशमलव भएको संख्या

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Decimal numbers with higher precision
items.ne: अझ शुद्ध दशमलव संख्या

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A single character in single quotes
items.ne: सिंगल कोटमा एउटा अक्षर

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: false (0)
items.ne: true वा false मात्र

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: "No value" — used when a function returns nothing
items.ne: कुनै मान नहुने

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: <string>
items.ne: अक्षरहरूको शृंखला

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: main().
items.ne: यी चार गल्ती सबैभन्दा बढी हुन्छन्: namespace बिर्सने, cin मा तीर उल्टो लेख्ने, सेमीकोलन छुटाउने, र main

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Runs a block only when the condition is true.
items.ne: सर्त सही भएमा मात्र चल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One block if true, another block if false.
items.ne: सही भए एउटा, गलत भए अर्को ब्लक।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Checks many conditions one by one from the top down.
items.ne: माथिबाट धेरै सर्त क्रमशः जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: An if inside another if.
items.ne: एउटा if भित्र अर्को if।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: break.
items.ne: मान मिलाएर धेरैमध्ये एउटा case छान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Repeats a block a known number of times.
items.ne: कति पटक दोहोरिने थाहा हुँदा।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Repeats while a condition is true. The condition is checked first — entry controlled. May run zero times.
items.ne: सर्त पहिले जाँच्छ, त्यसैले ० पटक पनि चल्न सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Runs the block at least once, then checks the condition — exit controlled.
items.ne: कम्तीमा एक पटक चल्छ, अनि मात्र सर्त जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Exits the loop or switch immediately.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Object Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming method that solves a big problem by breaking it into small parts called objects. Each object keeps its own data and the functions that work on that data bound together, so that no other part of the program can access that data directly. The key phrase examiners look for is "binds together data and the functions that operate on that data".
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् OOP भनेको ठूलो समस्यालाई अब्जेक्ट भनिने साना–साना भागमा बाँडेर समाधान गर्ने प्रोग्रामिङ तरिका हो। हरेक अब्जेक्टले आफ्नो डाटा र त्यही डाटामाथि काम गर्ने फङ्सन लाई सँगै बाँधेर राख्छ, ताकि प्रोग्रामको अरू भागले त्यो डाटा सिधै छुन नसकोस्। परीक्षकले खोज्ने मुख्य वाक्यांश: "डाटा र त्यसमाथि काम गर्ने फङ्सनलाई सँगै बाँध्छ"।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Token A token is the smallest individual unit of a C++ program that has meaning to the compiler. When the compiler reads your program it first breaks it into tokens. The character set is every character C++ understands: letters A–Z and a–z, digits 0–9, special symbols such as + - * / = < > ( ) { } ; ,, and white space (space, tab, newline).
items.ne: टोकन टोकन भनेको C++ प्रोग्रामको सबैभन्दा सानो अर्थपूर्ण एकाइ हो, जुन कम्पाइलरले बुझ्छ। कम्पाइलरले प्रोग्राम पढ्दा पहिले यसलाई टोकनमा टुक्र्याउँछ। Character set भनेको C++ ले बुझ्ने सबै अक्षर हो: A–Z, a–z, ०–९, विशेष चिन्ह + - * / = ( ) { } ;, र खाली ठाउँ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: cout and cin cout << sends data out to the screen. << is called the insertion operator. cin >> takes data in from the keyboard. >> is called the extraction operator. Both are objects defined in the header file <iostream> and both live inside the namespace std. endl moves the cursor to a new line. Memory trick: the arrows point in the direction the data travels. cout << x — data flows out of x into cout. cin >> x — data flows from cin into x.
items.ne: cout र cin cout << ले डाटा स्क्रिनमा बाहिर पठाउँछ। << लाई insertion operator भनिन्छ। cin >> ले किबोर्डबाट डाटा भित्र लिन्छ। >> लाई extraction operator भनिन्छ। दुवै <iostream> हेडर फाइलमा भएका अब्जेक्ट हुन् र std नेमस्पेस भित्र बस्छन्। endl ले नयाँ लाइनमा लैजान्छ। सम्झने तरिका: तीर जता फर्किएको छ, डाटा त्यतै जान्छ।

items.ne: cin >> ले भित्र लिन्छ, cout << ले बाहिर पठाउँछ। तीरले डाटा जाने दिशा देखाउँछ।

items.en: …functionData and functions are kept separate.Data and functions are bound together. ReusabilityDifficult — there is no inheritance.Easy — inheritance is supported. OverloadingNot supported.Supported — function and operator overloading. Suitable forSmall, simple programs.Large, complex programs. Example languagesC, Pascal, FORTRAN, BASICC++, Java, Python, C#
items.ne: छोटो सार POP मा फङ्सन मुख्य हुन्छ, डाटा प्रायः global हुने भएकाले कम सुरक्षित हुन्छ, र यसले माथिबाट तल (top-down) सोच्छ। OOP मा अब्जेक्ट मुख्य हुन्छ, डाटा private राखेर लुकाइन्छ, र तलबाट माथि (bottom-up) सोच्छ। ठूलो प्रोग्रामका लागि OOP राम्रो। Predict first · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A driver uses a steering wheel without knowing how the engine works. Which feature of OOP does that describe? चालकले इन्जिन कसरी चल्छ नजानीकनै स्टेयरिङ चलाउँछन्। यसले OOP को कुन विशेषता जनाउँछ? Encapsulation Abstraction Inheritance Abstraction. Complexity is hidden and only what you need is shown. The test that separates the two: abstraction hides COMPLEXITY, encapsulation hides DATA. A private variable with a getter is encapsulation; a dashboard that shows speed without the mechanism is abstraction. Unit 4 spends a whole section on this pair — it is asked most years. Abstraction। जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र चाहिने कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ। छुट्याउने जाँच: abstraction ले जटिलता लुकाउँछ, encapsulation ले डाटा। Getter सहितको private चल encapsulation हो; संयन्त्र नदेखाई गति देखाउने ड्यासबोर्ड abstraction हो।
