items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.7 Operators in C — C का operator
items.en: The lesson is not to memorise a table. It is that a = 10 + ((4 * 2) % 3); says the same thing and cannot be misread, by the compiler or by you in six months.
items.ne: १२। * र % को precedence उस्तै छ, + भन्दा माथि, र बायाँबाट दायाँ जान्छन्। त्यसैले 4 * 2 = 8, अनि 8 % 3 = 2, अनि 10 + 2 = 12। विकल्प (क) ले बायाँबाट दायाँ गणना गरेको नतिजा जनाउँछ, र C ले वाक्य पढेजस्तै expression पढ्दैन। सिकाइ तालिका कण्ठ गर्नु होइन — a = 10 + ((4 * 2) % 3); ले उही कुरा भन्छ र यसलाई compiler ले पनि, छ महिनापछि तपाईंले पनि गलत पढ्नै सक्नुहुन्न।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.7 Operators in C — C का operator
items.en: Decide the data type for the radius before you open this. If you choose int, work out what the program prints for a radius of 2.5.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि radius को data type निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। int छान्नुभयो भने २.५ को radius मा प्रोग्रामले के छाप्छ निकाल्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.7 Operators in C — C का operator
items.en: float, not int: with int r a radius of 2.5 would be stored as 2 and the area would be wrong with no warning. Note also that r is multiplied by itself rather than written r^2 — ^ is the bitwise XOR operator in C, not a power, and r^2 compiles and gives a completely different number.
items.ne: int होइन float: int r भए २.५ को radius २ मा भण्डारण हुन्थ्यो र क्षेत्रफल कुनै चेतावनीविनै गलत हुन्थ्यो। अर्को कुरा — r लाई आफैंले गुणन गरिएको छ, r^2 लेखिएको छैन; C मा ^ घात होइन bitwise XOR हो, र r^2 compile भएर बिलकुलै फरक सङ्ख्या दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.7 Operators in C — C का operator
items.en: Find at least four faults before opening this. Only one of them stops the compiler — and the ones that do not are the expensive ones.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि कम्तीमा चार गल्ती भेट्नुहोस्। त्यसमध्ये एउटैले मात्र compiler रोक्छ — र नरोक्नेहरू नै महँगा हुन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.7 Operators in C — C का operator
items.en: Only one of the five stops the build — the missing semicolon. That one is free, because the compiler tells you where it is. The other four are what this subject is really about, and the compiler's silence about them is the whole point: ask for warnings (gcc -Wall) and it will mention line 8 and line 11; nothing at any warning level mentions line 10. A program that compiles is a program whose grammar is right, and nothing more.

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.1 Introduction to C programming — C प्रोग्रामिङको परिचय
items.en: An old language that nothing has replaced C is a general-purpose high level programming language developed by Dennis Ritchie at Bell Laboratories in 1972, to write the UNIX operating system. It is still in use for the same reason it was written: it is small, fast, and it lets a programmer reach the memory directly. Features worth remembering, because this is a standard question: Simple and small — only 32 keywords to learn, against hundreds of library functions. Fast — compiled straight to machine code with very little added on top. Portable — the same source file compiles on different machines. Structured — a program is built from functions, each doing one job. Rich set of operators — including bitwise operators most high level languages hide. Extensible — a programmer can add their own functions to the library. Middle level — high level readability with low level access to memory. C is case sensitive. Sum, sum and SUM are three different names, and every keyword is lower case. This single rule causes more beginner errors than any other.
items.ne: पुरानो भाषा, जसलाई कसैले विस्थापित गरेन C सामान्य प्रयोजनको high level प्रोग्रामिङ भाषा हो, जसलाई Dennis Ritchie ले Bell Laboratories मा १९७२ मा UNIX operating system लेख्न बनाएका थिए। जुन कारणले बनाइएको थियो, त्यही कारणले अहिले पनि चलिरहेको छ: सानो, छिटो, र प्रोग्रामरलाई मेमोरीसम्म सिधै पुग्न दिन्छ। सम्झनुपर्ने विशेषता, किनभने यो मानक प्रश्न हो: सरल र सानो — सिक्नुपर्ने keyword ३२ मात्र, जबकि library function सयौं। छिटो — सिधै मेसिन कोडमा compile हुन्छ, माथि थपिने कुरा थोरै। Portable — उही source फाइल फरक मेसिनमा compile हुन्छ। Structured — प्रोग्राम function हरूबाट बन्छ, हरेकले एउटा काम गर्ने। धेरै operator — धेरै high level भाषाले लुकाउने bitwise operator सहित। Extensible — प्रोग्रामरले आफ्नै function library मा थप्न सक्छ। Middle level — high level जस्तो पढ्न सजिलो, low level जस्तो मेमोरी पहुँच। C case sensitive छ। Sum, sum र SUM तीन फरक नाम हुन्, र हरेक keyword सानो अक्षरमै लेखिन्छ। सुरुआतीले गर्ने सबैभन्दा धेरै गल्ती यही एउटा नियमले निम्त्याउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.2 Basic program structure — प्रोग्रामको आधारभूत संरचना
items.en: Every C program has the same skeleton Learn this shape once and every program in the subject fits inside it. Preprocessor directive — a line beginning with #. It is handled before compiling. #include is the one you will use most. Header file — the file a directive pulls in. stdio.h holds the declarations of printf and scanf; string.h holds the string functions; math.h holds sqrt and friends. The .h stands for header. main() — execution starts here, always, wherever it is written in the file. A program with no main compiles and then fails to link, because nothing knows where to begin. Tokens — the smallest meaningful pieces the compiler reads. C has six kinds: keywords, identifiers, constants, strings, operators and special symbols. Semicolon — a statement terminator, not a separator. Every statement ends with one; #include, a function heading and a closing brace do not, because none of them is a statement. Comments — /* … */ spans lines; // runs to the end of the line. The compiler removes them, so they cost nothing to run and a great deal to omit. Whitespace — spaces, tabs and blank lines. C ignores them, which is why indentation is for the reader rather than the compiler. Escape sequence — a backslash and a letter that stand for one character that cannot be typed: \n newline, \t tab, \\ a real backslash, \" a quote inside a string, \0 the null character.
items.ne: हरेक C प्रोग्रामको ढाँचा एउटै हुन्छ यो आकार एक पटक सिकेपछि विषयका सबै प्रोग्राम यसैभित्र अट्छन्। Preprocessor directive — # बाट सुरु हुने लाइन। यो compile गर्नुअघि नै चल्छ। सबैभन्दा धेरै चलाइने #include हो। Header file — directive ले भित्र्याउने फाइल। stdio.h मा printf र scanf का घोषणा हुन्छन्; string.h मा string function; math.h मा sqrt आदि। .h को अर्थ header हो। main() — फाइलमा जहाँ लेखिए पनि चल्न सधैं यहीँबाट सुरु हुन्छ। main नभएको प्रोग्राम compile त हुन्छ, तर link हुँदैन — कहाँबाट सुरु गर्ने कसैलाई थाहा हुँदैन। Tokens — compiler ले पढ्ने सबैभन्दा सानो अर्थपूर्ण टुक्रा। C मा छ किसिम छन्: keyword, identifier, constant, string, operator र special symbol। Semicolon — यो statement terminator हो, separator होइन। हरेक statement यसैले सकिन्छ; #include, function को शीर्षक र बन्द गर्ने brace लाई चाहिँदैन, किनभने ती statement होइनन्। Comments — /* … */ धेरै लाइनसम्म; // लाइनको अन्त्यसम्म। Compiler ले हटाइदिन्छ, त्यसैले लेख्दा केही लागत छैन र नलेख्दा धेरै। Whitespace — खाली ठाउँ, tab, खाली लाइन। C ले वास्ता गर्दैन — त्यसैले indentation compiler का लागि होइन, पाठकका लागि हो। Escape sequence — backslash र एउटा अक्षर मिलेर टाइप गर्न नमिल्ने एउटा अक्षर जनाउँछ: \n नयाँ लाइन, \t tab, \\ साँच्चैको backslash, \" string भित्रको उद्धरण, \0 null अक्षर।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.3 Variables and keywords — Variable र keyword
items.en: A name you choose, and 32 you cannot A variable is a named box in memory whose value can change while the program runs. Declaring one reserves the space and fixes the type: int age; gives you a box that holds a whole number and nothing else. The name is an identifier, and the rules for one are examined directly: The first character must be a letter or an underscore, never a digit. After that, letters, digits and underscores only — no spaces and no other symbol. It must not be a keyword. It is case sensitive: total and Total are two variables. A keyword is a word the language has already given a meaning: int, float, if, else, for, while, return, break and 24 more. There are 32 in standard C, all lower case, and you may not use one as a name — not because it is forbidden on principle, but because the compiler would have no way to tell which meaning you intended.
items.ne: तपाईंले छान्ने नाम, र ३२ वटा नछान्न पाइने Variable भनेको मेमोरीमा नाम भएको बाकस हो, जसको मान प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा बदलिन सक्छ। घोषणा गर्दा ठाउँ छुट्टिन्छ र प्रकार तय हुन्छ: int age; ले पूर्ण सङ्ख्या मात्र राख्ने बाकस दिन्छ। नाम भनेको identifier हो, र यसका नियम सिधै सोधिन्छन्: पहिलो अक्षर अक्षर वा underscore हुनुपर्छ, अङ्क कहिल्यै होइन। त्यसपछि अक्षर, अङ्क र underscore मात्र — खाली ठाउँ हुँदैन, अरू चिन्ह पनि हुँदैन। यो keyword हुनु हुँदैन। यो case sensitive हुन्छ: total र Total दुई फरक variable हुन्। Keyword भनेको भाषाले पहिल्यै अर्थ दिइसकेको शब्द हो: int, float, if, else, for, while, return, break र अरू २४। मानक C मा ३२ वटा छन्, सबै सानो अक्षरमा, र तीमध्ये कुनैलाई नाम बनाउन मिल्दैन — सिद्धान्ततः निषेध भएर होइन, तपाईंले कुन अर्थ चाहनुभयो compiler ले छुट्याउनै नसक्ने भएर।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.4 Character set, constants and variables — Character set, constant र variable
items.en: What you may type, and what cannot change The character set is everything C accepts in a source file: the letters A-Z and a-z, the digits 0-9, special characters such as + - * / % = < > ( ) { } [ ] ; , . # & |, and whitespace. A constant is a value that cannot change while the program runs. The kinds you need: Integer constant — 25, -7, 0 Real (floating) constant — 3.14, -0.5 Character constant — one character in single quotes: 'A', '7', '\n' String constant — characters in double quotes: "Nepal", "A" Two ways to make your own: #define PI 3.1416, which the preprocessor substitutes before compiling, and const float pi = 3.1416;, which is a real variable the compiler refuses to let you change. 'A' and "A" are not the same thing. The first is one character and occupies one byte. The second is a string: the letter A and a hidden \0 after it, so two bytes. That difference becomes Unit 5.
items.ne: के टाइप गर्न पाइन्छ, र के बदलिँदैन Character set भनेको C ले source फाइलमा स्वीकार गर्ने सबै कुरा हो: अक्षर A-Z र a-z, अङ्क 0-9, विशेष चिन्ह जस्तै + - * / % = < > ( ) { } [ ] ; , . # & |, र खाली ठाउँ। Constant भनेको प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा नबदलिने मान हो। चाहिने किसिमहरू: Integer constant — 25, -7, 0 Real (floating) constant — 3.14, -0.5 Character constant — एकल उद्धरणभित्र एउटा अक्षर: 'A', '7', '\n' String constant — दोहोरो उद्धरणभित्रका अक्षर: "Nepal", "A" आफ्नै बनाउने दुई तरिका: #define PI 3.1416, जसलाई preprocessor ले compile गर्नुअघि नै साट्छ, र const float pi = 3.1416;, जुन साँच्चैको variable हो तर compiler ले बदल्न दिँदैन। 'A' र "A" एउटै होइनन्। पहिलो एउटा अक्षर हो र एक byte ओगट्छ। दोस्रो string हो: A अक्षर र पछाडि लुकेको \0, जम्मा दुई byte। यही फरक युनिट ५ बन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.5 Data types and format specifiers — Data type र format specifier
items.en: Four basic types and the code that prints each The sizes are not fixed by the language. int is 2 bytes on an old 16-bit Turbo C setup and 4 bytes on everything modern. Write "2 or 4" in an answer, or use sizeof(int) to ask the compiler, which is the only reliable way to know. Modifiers stretch a type: short, long, signed, unsigned. unsigned int gives up negative numbers to double the positive range. The format specifier is a promise you make to printf, and printf believes it without checking. Pass an int and claim %f and the output is nonsense, with no error at all.
items.ne: चार आधारभूत प्रकार, र हरेकलाई छाप्ने सङ्केत आकार भाषाले तय गरेको होइन। पुरानो १६-bit Turbo C मा int २ byte हुन्छ र आजका सबैमा ४। उत्तरमा "२ वा ४" लेख्नुहोस्, वा sizeof(int) ले compiler लाई सोध्नुहोस् — पक्का थाहा पाउने एकमात्र भरपर्दो तरिका त्यही हो। Modifier ले प्रकार तन्काउँछ: short, long, signed, unsigned। unsigned int ले ऋणात्मक छाडेर धनात्मक दायरा दोब्बर बनाउँछ। Format specifier भनेको तपाईंले printf सँग गरेको वाचा हो, र printf ले नजाँची पत्याउँछ। int पठाएर %f भन्नुभयो भने कुनै त्रुटिविनै बेकारको output आउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.6 Input and output statements — Input र output का statement
items.en: Two library functions, and one ampersand printf() sends formatted text to the screen. Everything between the quotes is printed literally except a % specifier, which is replaced by the next argument, and an escape sequence, which becomes its character. scanf() reads formatted input from the keyboard. It uses the same specifiers — and it needs the address of each variable, written with &, because a function that is given a value cannot change the caller's variable. Unit 4 explains why in full; for now, scanf takes & and printf does not. Two more you will see: getchar() reads one character and putchar() writes one. Learning outcome 5.4 also mentions gets() and puts() for whole lines; they are not on the official topic list and gets() has been removed from the C standard because it cannot be used safely. Use fgets() if you need a whole line.
items.ne: दुई library function, र एउटा ampersand printf() ले ढाँचा मिलाएको पाठ पर्दामा पठाउँछ। उद्धरणभित्रको सबै जस्ताको तस्तै छापिन्छ, तर % specifier को ठाउँमा अर्को argument आउँछ र escape sequence आफ्नो अक्षर बन्छ। scanf() ले keyboard बाट ढाँचा मिलाएको input पढ्छ। यसले उही specifier चलाउँछ — र हरेक variable को ठेगाना चाहिन्छ, जुन & ले लेखिन्छ, किनभने मान मात्र पाएको function ले बोलाउनेको variable बदल्न सक्दैन। किन भन्ने पूरा कुरा युनिट ४ मा छ; अहिलेलाई — scanf लाई & चाहिन्छ, printf लाई चाहिँदैन। अरू दुई पनि भेटिन्छन्: getchar() ले एउटा अक्षर पढ्छ र putchar() ले एउटा लेख्छ। सिकाइ उपलब्धि ५.४ ले पूरै लाइनका लागि gets() र puts() पनि भनेको छ; ती आधिकारिक विषयसूचीमा छैनन् र gets() लाई C मानकबाटै हटाइएको छ, किनभने त्यसलाई सुरक्षित तरिकाले चलाउनै मिल्दैन। पूरै लाइन चाहिए fgets() चलाउनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 2.7 Operators in C — C का operator
items.en: Five families the syllabus names Arithmetic — + - * / %. The modulus % gives the remainder and works on integers only. Relational — < > <= >= == !=. Each answers true or false. In C there is no separate true/false type: zero is false and anything else is true. Logical — && and, || or, ! not. They combine conditions that are already true or false. Bitwise — & and, | or, ^ xor, ~ not, << left shift, >> right shift. These work on the individual bits of a number. Assignment — = and its compound forms += -= *= /= %=. x += 5 is exactly x = x + 5. Two more you will use constantly: increment ++ and decrement --. In i++ the old value is used and then i grows; in ++i i grows first. Alone on a line they are identical. Precedence, highest first: (), then * / %, then + -, then relational, then &&, then ||, then = last. When in doubt, use brackets — they cost nothing and they are never wrong.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमले नाम लिएका पाँच परिवार Arithmetic — + - * / %। Modulus % ले शेष दिन्छ र पूर्णाङ्कमा मात्र चल्छ। Relational — < > <= >= == !=। हरेकले सत्य वा असत्य दिन्छ। C मा छुट्टै true/false प्रकार छैन: शून्य असत्य, अरू जे भए पनि सत्य। Logical — && and, || or, ! not। यिनले सत्य–असत्य भइसकेका सर्त जोड्छन्। Bitwise — & and, | or, ^ xor, ~ not, << बायाँ सार्ने, >> दायाँ सार्ने। यिनले सङ्ख्याका छुट्टाछुट्टै bit मा काम गर्छन्। Assignment — = र यसका मिश्रित रूप += -= *= /= %=। x += 5 ठ्याक्कै x = x + 5 हो। अरू दुई सधैं चलाइन्छन्: increment ++ र decrement --। i++ मा पुरानै मान प्रयोग भएर अनि i बढ्छ; ++i मा पहिले i बढ्छ। एक्लै लाइनमा भए दुवै उस्तै। Precedence, माथिल्लोदेखि: (), अनि * / %, अनि + -, अनि relational, अनि &&, अनि ||, अन्त्यमा =। अलमल भए कोष्ठक लगाउनुहोस् — यसको कुनै लागत छैन र यो कहिल्यै गलत हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The preprocessor runs FIRST, before compiling. It copies the contents of stdio.h into this file, which is where printf is declared.
items.ne: Preprocessor compile हुनुअघि नै सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्छ। यसले stdio.h को सामग्री यही फाइलमा सार्छ, र printf त्यहीँ घोषित छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Execution always begins at main, wherever main is written in the file. int in front says main will hand a number back to the operating system.
items.ne: फाइलमा main जहाँ लेखिए पनि चल्न सुरु main बाटै हुन्छ। अगाडिको int ले main ले operating system लाई एउटा सङ्ख्या फर्काउँछ भन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: printf sends the text between the quotes to the screen. There is no newline in it, so the next thing printed would continue on the same line.
items.ne: printf ले उद्धरणभित्रको पाठ पर्दामा पठाउँछ। यसमा newline छैन, त्यसैले अर्को कुरा छापिए उही लाइनमै जोडिन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: return 0 ends main and reports success. Zero means the program finished normally; any other number would mean it did not.
items.ne: return 0 ले main सिध्याउँछ र सफलता जनाउँछ। शून्यको अर्थ प्रोग्राम सामान्य रूपमा सकियो; अरू कुनै सङ्ख्याको अर्थ सकिएन।

items.en: Reading two numbers and adding them

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Three integer variables are created. Declaring them does NOT give them a value — whatever was in that memory is still there, which is why it is shown as garbage.
items.ne: तीन integer variable बन्छन्। घोषणा गर्दैमा मान मिल्दैन — त्यो मेमोरीमा जे थियो त्यही रहन्छ, त्यसैले यहाँ garbage देखाइएको छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A prompt is printed first. Without it the program waits with a blank screen and the user has no idea what is wanted.
items.ne: पहिले सङ्केत छापिन्छ। यो नभए प्रोग्राम खाली पर्दामा पर्खिरहन्छ र प्रयोगकर्तालाई के चाहिएको हो थाहै हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: scanf waits for the user. They type 12 and 8. The ampersands matter: scanf is given the ADDRESS of a and of b, because it has to put the values into them.
items.ne: scanf ले प्रयोगकर्ता कुर्छ। उसले 12 र 8 टाइप गर्छ। Ampersand महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: scanf लाई a र b का ठेगाना दिइन्छ, किनभने मान तिनैभित्र राख्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The right side is worked out first and the result is stored in sum. The equals sign here is assignment, not equality.
items.ne: पहिले दायाँपट्टिको गणना हुन्छ र नतिजा sum मा राखिन्छ। यहाँको बराबर चिन्ह assignment हो, बराबर भन्ने होइन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: %d is replaced by the value of sum. printf does not look at the variable to decide the format — it believes the specifier, which is why a wrong one prints nonsense rather than an error.
items.ne: %d को ठाउँमा sum को मान आउँछ। printf ले ढाँचा तय गर्न variable हेर्दैन — specifier लाई नै पत्याउँछ, त्यसैले गलत specifier ले त्रुटि होइन बेकारको कुरा छाप्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: main returns 0 and the program ends.
items.ne: main ले 0 फर्काउँछ र प्रोग्राम सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Integer division — the trap in / and %
items.ne: Integer division — / र % को पासो

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Two integers are declared and given values on the same line. Initialising at the point of declaration is normal C and avoids the garbage state entirely.
items.ne: दुई integer एउटै लाइनमा घोषणा गरेर मान पनि दिइयो। घोषणा गर्दै मान दिनु सामान्य C हो र garbage अवस्था नै आउँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 7 / 2 between two integers is INTEGER division. The answer is 3 and the remainder is simply thrown away — it is not rounded, so 7/2 is 3 and not 4.
items.ne: दुई integer बीचको 7 / 2 integer division हो। उत्तर 3 आउँछ र शेष फालिन्छ — round हुँदैन, त्यसैले 7/2 को 3 हो, 4 होइन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: This is the line that surprises everybody. share is a float, but the DIVISION happened between two integers before the result reached it, so 3 is what gets stored. Making a float of the answer afterwards cannot bring back a remainder that was already discarded.
items.ne: सबैलाई अचम्म लाग्ने लाइन यही हो। share float हो, तर नतिजा त्यहाँ पुग्नुअघि नै भाग दुई integer बीच भइसक्यो, त्यसैले 3 नै भण्डारण हुन्छ। पछि float बनाएर पहिल्यै फालिएको शेष फिर्ता आउँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The backslash-n inside the quotes is an escape sequence. It is two characters in the source and one newline on the screen.
items.ne: उद्धरणभित्रको backslash-n escape sequence हो। Source मा दुई अक्षर, पर्दामा एउटा नयाँ लाइन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: %.1f asks for one digit after the point. Plain %f would have printed 3.000000, which is the same value shown less tidily.
items.ne: %.1f ले दशमलवपछि एक अङ्क माग्छ। सादा %f ले 3.000000 छाप्थ्यो — उही मान, कम सफा।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The modulus operator gives what division threw away: 7 = 2 x 3 + 1. Together, / and % tell you everything about an integer division.
items.ne: Modulus ले भागले फालेको कुरा दिन्छ: 7 = 2 x 3 + 1। / र % सँगै भए integer division बारे सबै थाहा हुन्छ।

"Garbage" is not a joke — it is the real state of a declared and uninitialised variable in C, and printing one is a genuine bug that produces a different wrong number every run. चरण १ मा रोकिएर तीनै variable हेर्नुहोस्। "Garbage" ठट्टा होइन — C मा घोषणा गरेर मान नदिएको variable को वास्तविक अवस्था त्यही हो, र त्यसलाई छाप्नु साँच्चैको bug हो जसले हरेक पटक फरक गलत सङ्ख्या दिन्छ। 2.7 Operators in C

Almost everybody says 3.5 the first time. share मा मान राख्ने लाइनमा रोकिएर अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। पहिलो पटक झन्डै सबैले ३.५ भन्छन्। Predict first

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which family does this operator belong to? What you will learn: to classify an operator from how it is used, which is what "explain the operators in C with examples" is really asking for. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्रयोग हेरेर operator वर्गीकरण गर्न — "C का operator उदाहरणसहित बुझाउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नले साँच्चै खोज्ने त्यही हो। How to use this The trap is & against &&. One ampersand works on bits; two work on conditions. The same is true of | and ||. पासो & र && बीच छ। एउटा ampersand ले bit मा काम गर्छ; दुईले सर्तमा। | र || को पनि उस्तै। Example 1 A complete program, part by part Question: write a C program that reads the radius of a circle and prints its area, and name each part of the program. Decide the data type for the radius before you open this. If you choose int, work out what the program prints for a radius of 2.5. खोल्नुअघि radius को data type निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। int छान्नुभयो भने २.५ को radius मा प्रोग्रामले के छाप्छ निकाल्नुहोस्। Working #include <stdio.h> /* preprocessor directive + header file */ #define PI 3.1416 /* a symbolic constant */ int main() /* execution starts here */ { float r, area; /* declaration: two float variables */ printf("Enter the radius: "); scanf("%f", &r); /* & gives scanf the ADDRESS of r */ area = PI * r * r; /* assignment; PI is replaced before compiling */ printf("Area = %.2f\n", area); /* %.2f = two decimal places */ return 0; /* 0 means the program succeeded */ } Output (if the user types 7) Enter the radius: 7 Area = 153.94 float, not int: with int r a radius of 2.5 would be stored as 2 and the area would be wrong with no warning. Note also that r is multiplied by itself rather than written r^2 — ^ is the bitwise XOR operator in C, not a power, and r^2 compiles and gives a completely different number. int होइन float: int r भए २.५ को radius २ मा भण्डारण हुन्थ्यो र क्षेत्रफल कुनै चेतावनीविनै गलत हुन्थ्यो। अर्को कुरा — r लाई आफैंले गुणन गरिएको छ, r^2 लेखिएको छैन; C मा ^ घात होइन bitwise XOR हो, र r^2 compile भएर बिलकुलै फरक सङ्ख्या दिन्छ। Example 2 Finding the errors in a short program Question: this program will not compile, and when it is made to compile it still prints the wrong thing. Find every fault. #include <stdio.h>; int main() { int a, b float avg; printf("Enter two numbers: "); scanf("%d %d", a, b); avg = (a + b) / 2; printf("Average = %d", avg); return 0; } Find at least four faults before opening this. Only one of them stops the compiler — and the ones that do not are the expensive ones. खोल्नुअघि कम्तीमा चार गल्ती भेट्नुहोस्। त्यसमध्ये एउटैले मात्र compiler रोक्छ — र नरोक्नेहरू नै महँगा हुन्। Working LINE 1 #include <stdio.h>; A directive is not a statement. The compiler says "extra tokens at end of '#include' directive" and carries on. WARNING LINE 5 int a, b The declaration has no semicolon. The error is reported on the NEXT line. COMPILE ERROR LINE 8 scanf("%d %d", a, b); scanf needs the ADDRESS of each variable: &a and &b. This compiles with no message unless you ask for warnings, and then the program misbehaves unpredictably. RUN-TIME LINE 10 avg = (a + b) / 2; a and b are int, so this is integer division and the .5 is discarded before avg sees it. No warning level mentions it. WRONG ANSWER LINE 11 printf("Average = %d", avg); avg is a float and %d claims an int. printf believes the specifier, so this prints nonsense. It should be %.2f. WRONG OUTPUT Only one of the five stops the build — the missing semicolon. That one is free, because the compiler tells you where it is. The other four are what this subject is really about, and the compiler's silence about them is the whole point: ask for warnings (gcc -Wall) and it will mention line 8 and line 11; nothing at any warning level mentions line 10. A program that compiles is a program whose grammar is right, and nothing more. पाँचमध्ये एउटैले मात्र build रोक्छ — छुटेको semicolon। त्यो सस्तो छ, किनभने compiler ले कहाँ छ भनिदिन्छ। बाँकी चार नै यो विषयको साँचो कुरा हुन्, र त्यसबारे compiler को चुप्पी नै मुख्य पाठ हो: चेतावनी मागे (gcc -Wall) लाइन ८ र लाइन ११ को कुरा आउँछ; लाइन १० को कुरा कुनै पनि स्तरमा आउँदैन। compile भएको प्रोग्राम भनेको व्याकरण ठिक भएको प्रोग्राम हो, त्योभन्दा बढी होइन। Mistakes that cost marks here Forgetting the ampersand in scanf. scanf("%d", n) compiles and then behaves unpredictably. It is &n. Putting a semicolon after #include or after a function heading. Neither is a statement. Expecting 7 / 2 to be 3.5. Two integers give integer division. Write 7.0 / 2 if you want 3.5. Using = where == is meant. if (a = 5) assigns 5 and is always true. It is legal C, so nothing warns you. Mixing up 'A' and "A". Single quotes for one character, double quotes for a string. Claiming int is always 2 bytes. Say "2 or 4, depending on the compiler". scanf मा ampersand बिर्सनु: scanf("%d", n) compile भएर अनिश्चित व्यवहार गर्छ; &n लेख्नुहोस्। #include वा function को शीर्षकपछि semicolon राख्नु: ती statement होइनन्। 7 / 2 लाई ३.५ ठान्नु: दुई पूर्णाङ्कको भाग पूर्णाङ्कमै हुन्छ; ३.५ चाहिए 7.0 / 2 लेख्नुहोस्। == को ठाउँमा = लेख्नु: if (a = 5) ले ५ राख्छ र सधैं सत्य हुन्छ — मान्य C भएकाले चेतावनी पनि आउँदैन। 'A' र "A" मिसाउनु: एउटा अक्षरलाई एकल उद्धरण, string लाई दोहोरो। int सधैं २ byte भन्नु: "compiler अनुसार २ वा ४" लेख्नुहोस्। Memory hook — scanf takes the address, printf takes the value. One ampersand, one whole category of bug. सम्झने तरिका — scanf ले ठेगाना लिन्छ, printf ले मान। एउटा ampersand, एउटा पूरै किसिमको bug। Practical work — this unit's other 3 hours

items.en: A do-while runs the body first and tests the condition afterwards, so the body has already happened by the time the condition is looked at. for and while both test before each turn, so if the condition is false at the start the body runs zero times. This is the single difference between the loops and it is the most asked question from this unit.
items.ne: do-while ले पहिले body चलाउँछ र पछि सर्त जाँच्छ, त्यसैले सर्त हेरिने बेलासम्म body भइसकेको हुन्छ। for र while दुवैले हरेक पटकअघि जाँच्छन्, त्यसैले सुरुमै सर्त असत्य भए body शून्य पटक चल्छ। Loop बीचको एउटै फरक यही हो र यस युनिटबाट सबैभन्दा धेरै सोधिने प्रश्न पनि यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: There is no break anywhere in this switch. Control enters at the matching label, case 2, and then FALLS THROUGH every case below it, including default, running each printf in turn: B, then C, then D. The case labels only decide where execution starts; break is what decides where it stops. Adding break after each case would print B alone.
items.ne: यो switch मा कतै break छैन। नियन्त्रण मिल्ने label — case 2 — मा छिर्छ र त्यसपछि default सहित तलका हरेक case मा FALL THROUGH गर्दै हरेक printf चलाउँछ: B, अनि C, अनि D। Case का label ले चल्न कहाँबाट सुरु हुने मात्र तय गर्छन्; कहाँ रोकिने break ले तय गर्छ। हरेक case पछि break थपे B मात्र छापिन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4 — five turns — and then becomes 5, at which point 5 < 5 is false and the loop ends. Counting from zero with a strictly-less-than condition always gives exactly the number in the condition, which is why array loops are written this way. Changing the condition to i <= 5 would give six turns and, over an array of size 5, would read past the end.
items.ne: i ले 0, 1, 2, 3 र 4 मान लिन्छ — पाँच पटक — अनि 5 हुन्छ, र त्यहाँ 5 < 5 असत्य भएर loop सकिन्छ। शून्यबाट सुरु गरेर "भन्दा सानो" सर्त राख्दा सधैं सर्तमा लेखिएकै सङ्ख्या जति पटक चल्छ — त्यसैले array का loop यसरी लेखिन्छन्। सर्त i <= 5 बनाए छ पटक चल्थ्यो र पाँच आकारको array मा अन्त्यभन्दा पर पढ्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: continue abandons only the rest of the current turn and jumps to i++, so when i is 3 the printf below it is skipped and the loop carries on. The output is therefore 1, 2, 4, 5 with 3 missing. If the statement had been break, the loop itself would have ended at i == 3 and the output would be 12 — which is option A, and telling the two apart is exactly what this question is for.
items.ne: continue ले यस पटकको बाँकी मात्र छाडेर i++ मा हाम फाल्छ, त्यसैले i 3 हुँदा तलको printf छुट्छ र loop चलिरहन्छ। त्यसैले output 1, 2, 4, 5 हुन्छ, 3 छुटेर। Statement break भएको भए i == 3 मै loop सकिन्थ्यो र output 12 हुन्थ्यो — त्यो विकल्प (क) हो, र यी दुई छुट्याउनु नै यो प्रश्नको उद्देश्य हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The semicolon straight after the for brackets is a complete, empty statement, and that empty statement is the loop body. So the loop runs three times doing nothing at all, and the printf is simply the next statement after the loop, which runs once. The program compiles without a single warning, which is what makes this mistake expensive: nothing tells you, and the output is one line where three were expected.
items.ne: For को कोष्ठकपछि सिधै आउने semicolon पूरै खाली statement हो, र त्यही खाली statement loop को body हो। त्यसैले loop तीन पटक केही नगरी चल्छ, र printf loop पछिको अर्को statement मात्र भएकाले एक पटक चल्छ। प्रोग्राम एउटै चेतावनीविना compile हुन्छ — यही गल्ती महँगो हुनुको कारण त्यही हो: कसैले भन्दैन, र तीन लाइनको अपेक्षामा एक लाइन आउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The inner loop completes all of its turns for each single turn of the outer loop, so the counts multiply rather than add: 3 x 4 = 12. Adding them would give 7, which is option A and the usual wrong answer. In a pattern program the outer loop is the rows and the inner loop is the columns, so this is a rectangle of three rows and four columns.
items.ne: बाहिरी loop को हरेक एक पटकका लागि भित्री loop ले आफ्ना सबै पटक पूरा गर्छ, त्यसैले गन्ती जोडिँदैन, गुणन हुन्छ: 3 x 4 = 12। जोडे 7 आउँथ्यो — त्यो विकल्प (क) हो र सामान्य गलत उत्तर पनि। ढाँचाको प्रोग्राममा बाहिरी loop पङ्क्ति र भित्री loop स्तम्भ हो, त्यसैले यो तीन पङ्क्ति र चार स्तम्भको आयात हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An if-else-if ladder tests its conditions in order and stops at the first one that is true. 95 is at least 40, so that branch runs and the else if below it is never even evaluated. The conditions overlap, which is legal and is exactly why order matters: a ladder on ranges must be written from the narrowest or highest condition downwards.
items.ne: if-else-if शृंखलाले सर्तहरू क्रमैसँग जाँच्छ र पहिलो सत्यमा रोकिन्छ। ९५ कम्तीमा ४० छ, त्यसैले त्यही शाखा चल्छ र तलको else if मूल्याङ्कन नै हुँदैन। सर्त बाझिनु मान्य छ, र क्रम महत्त्वपूर्ण हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही: दायराको शृंखला सबैभन्दा साँघुरो वा अग्लो सर्तबाट तलतिर लेख्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The loop ends only when the condition becomes false, and that cannot happen until i has already been increased past 5. The last body turn runs with i = 5, then i++ makes it 6, then 6 <= 5 is false and the loop stops — so i is 6. The counter is an ordinary variable declared outside the loop, so it keeps that value afterwards, and output questions are regularly built on exactly this.
items.ne: Loop सर्त असत्य भएपछि मात्र सकिन्छ, र त्यो i ५ नाघेर नबढेसम्म हुन सक्दैन। अन्तिम पटक body i = 5 मा चल्छ, अनि i++ ले 6 बनाउँछ, अनि 6 <= 5 असत्य भएर loop रोकिन्छ — त्यसैले i 6 हुन्छ। Counter loop बाहिर घोषणा गरिएको सामान्य variable भएकाले पछि पनि त्यही मान राख्छ, र output का प्रश्न ठ्याक्कै यसैमा बनेका हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A while loop tests its condition before every turn, including the first. 10 < 5 is false immediately, so the body never runs and nothing is printed. Note that this is not an infinite loop: it would be one if the condition were true and nothing inside changed n, which is a different mistake. The same code written as a do-while would print Hello once.
items.ne: While loop ले हरेक पटकअघि — पहिलो पटक पनि — सर्त जाँच्छ। 10 < 5 तुरुन्तै असत्य छ, त्यसैले body कहिल्यै चल्दैन र केही छापिँदैन। ध्यान दिनुहोस् — यो अनन्त loop होइन: सर्त सत्य भएर भित्र n नबदलिएको भए त्यो हुन्थ्यो, र त्यो अर्कै गल्ती हो। उही कोड do-while मा लेखे Hello एक पटक छापिन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: goto is written as goto label; with label: marking the destination somewhere in the same function. It is the only one of the four jump statements that names a destination — break ends a loop, continue skips a turn, and return ends a function. It is on the syllabus and examinable, and almost every real program is clearer without it, because a reader can no longer work out what reaches a line by reading downwards.
items.ne: goto लाई goto label; लेखिन्छ र उही function भित्र कतै label: ले गन्तव्य जनाउँछ। चार jump statement मध्ये गन्तव्यको नाम लिने एकमात्र यही हो — break ले loop सिध्याउँछ, continue ले एक पटक छाड्छ, return ले function सिध्याउँछ। यो पाठ्यक्रममा छ र सोधिन्छ, तर झन्डै हरेक वास्तविक प्रोग्राम यसविना स्पष्ट हुन्छ, किनभने कुन लाइनमा के पुग्छ तलतिर पढेर थाहा पाउन सकिँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A switch tests one value against exact constant labels, so the expression must be an integer type — int or char — and each case must be a single constant. A float cannot be used, and a range cannot be written as a case at all. That is why grading from marks needs an if-else-if ladder: the ladder can test ranges and the switch cannot.
items.ne: Switch ले एउटा मानलाई ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant label सँग जाँच्छ, त्यसैले expression पूर्णाङ्क प्रकारको — int वा char — हुनुपर्छ र हरेक case एउटै constant। Float चल्दैन, र दायरा case मा लेख्नै मिल्दैन। अंकबाट grade निकाल्न if-else-if शृंखला चाहिनुको कारण त्यही हो: शृंखलाले दायरा जाँच्न सक्छ, switch ले सक्दैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A do-while ends with while (condition); and that semicolon is compulsory, because the whole do-while is one statement that finishes there. A for or a while heading is followed by the body, so a semicolon after it would end the statement early and leave an empty body — which compiles and silently changes the program.
items.ne: do-while while (condition); ले सकिन्छ र त्यो semicolon अनिवार्य छ, किनभने पूरै do-while एउटै statement हो जो त्यहीँ सकिन्छ। for वा while को शीर्षकपछि body आउँछ, त्यसैले त्यहाँ semicolon राखे statement चाँडै सकिन्छ र body खाली रहन्छ — जुन compile हुन्छ र प्रोग्राम चुपचाप बदल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Every loop needs three things: an initialisation, a condition and an UPDATE. A for loop puts all three on one line so the update is hard to forget; a while loop leaves the update inside the body, and here it is missing. i stays 1, the condition stays true, and the loop runs until the program is killed. Adding i++ inside the braces fixes it.
items.ne: हरेक loop लाई तीन कुरा चाहिन्छ: initialisation, सर्त र UPDATE। For loop ले तीनै एउटै लाइनमा राख्छ त्यसैले update बिर्सन गाह्रो हुन्छ; while ले update body भित्र छाड्छ, र यहाँ त्यही छुटेको छ। i १ मै रहन्छ, सर्त सत्य रहन्छ, र प्रोग्राम नमारेसम्म loop चल्छ। Brace भित्र i++ थपे ठिक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: break leaves the single nearest enclosing loop and nothing more. Control resumes after the inner loop, still inside the outer one, which then carries on with its next turn. Leaving both needs a flag variable tested by the outer condition, or a return if the loops are alone in a function. Expecting one break to escape two loops is one of the standard wrong answers in this unit.
items.ne: break ले आफूलाई घेर्ने सबैभन्दा नजिकको एउटै loop छाड्छ, त्योभन्दा बढी होइन। नियन्त्रण भित्री loop पछि, तर बाहिरी loop भित्रै फर्कन्छ, र बाहिरी loop आफ्नो अर्को पटक सुरु गर्छ। दुवै छाड्न बाहिरी सर्तले जाँच्ने flag variable चाहिन्छ, वा loop हरू function मा एक्लै भए return। एउटा break ले दुई loop उम्कन्छ भन्ने अपेक्षा यस युनिटका मानक गलत उत्तरमध्ये एक हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The heaviest unit in the subject. 16 of the 64 theory hours, 13 of the 50 external marks, and 15 of the 64 practical hours — more than any other unit on all three counts. Three official topics carry all of it, so each one below is taught in several sections. If time is short, this is the unit to spend it on.
items.ne: विषयको सबैभन्दा भारी युनिट। ६४ मध्ये १६ घण्टा, ५० मध्ये १३ अंक, र ६४ मध्ये १५ प्रयोगात्मक घण्टा — तीनै हिसाबले अरू कुनै युनिटभन्दा बढी। आधिकारिक तीन विषयले यो सबै बोक्छन्, त्यसैले तलका हरेकलाई धेरै खण्डमा सिकाइएको छ। समय थोरै छ भने यही युनिटमा खर्चनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Which loop fits this job best?
items.ne: यो कामलाई कुन loop ठिक हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: All three loops can be made to do all three jobs. The question is which one states the intention most clearly, and the deciding fact is whether the number of repetitions is known before the loop starts.
items.ne: तीनै loop ले तीनै काम गर्न सक्छन्। प्रश्न कुनले नियत सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट देखाउँछ भन्ने हो, र निर्णय गर्ने कुरा loop सुरु हुनुअघि नै कति पटक दोहोरिने थाहा छ कि छैन भन्ने हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Which jump statement does this describe?
items.ne: यो वर्णन कुन jump statement को हो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Four statements change the normal order of execution, and the examination asks you to tell them apart by effect. Ask what each one abandons: the rest of this pass, the whole loop, or the whole function.
items.ne: चारवटा statement ले चल्ने सामान्य क्रम बदल्छन्, र परीक्षाले असरका आधारमा छुट्याउन भन्छ। हरेकले के छाड्छ सोध्नुहोस्: यस पटकको बाँकी, पूरै loop, कि पूरै function?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Exactly ten repetitions, known before the loop begins. A for loop puts the start, the stop and the step on one line, so a reader sees the whole count at a glance instead of hunting for it.
items.ne: ठ्याक्कै दस पटक, र त्यो loop सुरु हुनुअघि नै थाहा छ। for loop ले सुरु, अन्त्य र पाइला एउटै लाइनमा राख्छ, त्यसैले पाठकले पूरै गणना एकै नजरमा देख्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Nobody knows how many numbers will be typed, so the count cannot go on a for line. A while loop tests the condition before each pass, which is right here because zero could be the very first entry.
items.ne: कति सङ्ख्या टाइप हुन्छन् कसैलाई थाहा छैन, त्यसैले गणना for लाइनमा राख्न मिल्दैन। while ले हरेक पटकअघि सर्त जाँच्छ, र यहाँ त्यही ठिक छ किनभने पहिलो प्रविष्टि नै शून्य हुन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The menu has to appear at least once before anyone can choose to exit. A do-while runs the body first and tests afterwards, which is exactly the shape of that requirement and the reason the loop exists.
items.ne: कसैले Exit छान्नुअघि menu कम्तीमा एक पटक देखिनै पर्छ। do-while ले पहिले body चलाएर पछि जाँच्छ, र आवश्यकताको आकार ठ्याक्कै त्यही हो — यो loop हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The array has a fixed size, so the number of passes is known and an index is needed anyway. A for loop supplies the index and the count together, which is why array work is almost always written with one.
items.ne: Array को आकार तय छ, त्यसैले कति पटक चल्ने थाहा छ र index पनि चाहिन्छ नै। for loop ले index र गणना सँगै दिन्छ, त्यसैले array को काम झन्डै सधैं यसैले लेखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The password must be asked for once before it can be judged wrong, so the body comes before the test. Written as a while loop this needs the question duplicated above the loop, which is the clue to use do-while.
items.ne: Password गलत हो भन्न पहिले एक पटक सोध्नै पर्छ, त्यसैले body जाँचभन्दा अगाडि आउँछ। while ले लेख्दा प्रश्न loop माथि दोहोर्‍याउनुपर्छ, र त्यही सुराकले do-while रोज्न भन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: break leaves the loop entirely and carries on with the statement after it. Searching is the clearest use of it, because continuing after a successful find costs time and gains nothing at all.
items.ne: break ले पूरै loop छाडेर त्यसपछिको statement बाट अघि बढ्छ। खोजीमा यसको प्रयोग सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट छ, किनभने भेटिसकेपछि पनि चलिरहनुले समय मात्र खान्छ, केही दिँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: continue abandons only the rest of the current pass and starts the next one, so the loop is not left. This is the difference that is asked for again and again: one skips a turn, the other ends the game.
items.ne: continue ले यस पटकको बाँकी मात्र छाड्छ र अर्को पटक सुरु गर्छ, loop छाड्दैन। बारम्बार सोधिने फरक यही हो: एउटाले एक पटक छाड्छ, अर्कोले खेलै सिध्याउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: return ends the function, not just a loop, and hands a value back to the caller. Reaching it inside a loop leaves the loop too, because the whole function has finished at that point.
items.ne: return ले loop मात्र होइन पूरै function सिध्याउँछ र बोलाउनेलाई मान फर्काउँछ। Loop भित्र यो भेटिए loop पनि छुट्छ, किनभने त्यहीँ पूरै function सकिइसकेको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: goto is the only one that names a destination label, and it is the only one of the four that most programmers avoid. It is examinable, and in real programs a loop or a function reads better almost every time.
items.ne: गन्तव्यको label नाम लिने एकमात्र यही हो, र चारमध्ये धेरै प्रोग्रामरले बच्ने पनि यही हो। परीक्षामा सोधिन्छ, तर वास्तविक प्रोग्राममा loop वा function झन्डै सधैं राम्रो पढिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The same keyword does a second job inside a switch, where leaving it out makes every later case run as well. That fall-through is the commonest switch mistake and the reason break is written after every case.
items.ne: उही keyword ले switch भित्र दोस्रो काम गर्छ; नलेखे पछिका सबै case पनि चल्छन्। त्यही fall-through switch को सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो, र हरेक case पछि break लेखिनुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Find the three mistakes that stop a loop ending: no initialisation, no update, and a stray semicolon.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: if, if…else if शृंखला र switch बीच छान्न र किन भन्न, तीनै loop सही लेख्न र कुन समस्यालाई कुन चाहिन्छ भन्न, कागजमै loop ट्रेस गरेर हरेक पटकपछि हरेक variable को मान दिन, break र continue ले के–के छाड्छन् भनेर फरक बुझाउन, nested loop ले ढाँचा छाप्न र कुन loop ले पङ्क्ति अनि कुनले स्तम्भ नियन्त्रण गर्छ भन्न, अनि loop नरोकिने तीन गल्ती — initialise नगर्नु, update नगर्नु र बीचमा semicolon छुट्नु — पत्ता लगाउन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.1 Decision making — if, if…else, switch — निर्णय — if, if…else, switch
items.en: Decide, before opening this, whether switch can test a RANGE of marks. The answer decides the whole question.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: switch ले अंकको दायरा जाँच्न सक्छ कि सक्दैन? त्यही उत्तरले पूरै प्रश्न टुङ्ग्याउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.1 Decision making — if, if…else, switch — निर्णय — if, if…else, switch
items.en: switch compares a value against exact constants, so it cannot test a range. Grading by marks needs the ladder. switch is right when the value is a small set of exact choices — a menu option, a grade letter, a day number. Note also the descending order in the ladder: with 40 first, a student scoring 95 would be told "second division", because the first true test wins.
items.ne: switch ले मानलाई ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant सँग तुलना गर्छ, त्यसैले दायरा जाँच्न सक्दैन। अंकबाट श्रेणी निकाल्न शृंखला नै चाहिन्छ। मान सानो र ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने छनोटको समूह भएमा switch ठिक हुन्छ — menu विकल्प, grade अक्षर, बारको नम्बर। शृंखलाको घट्दो क्रम पनि हेर्नुहोस्: ४० पहिले राखे ९५ ल्याउने विद्यार्थीलाई "second division" भनिन्थ्यो, किनभने पहिलो सत्य जाँच नै जित्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.1 Decision making — if, if…else, switch — निर्णय — if, if…else, switch
items.en: switch has three rules that are all examinable. The expression must be an int or a char — never a float and never a string. Each case label must be a constant, not a variable. And without break, control falls through into the next case and keeps going — which is occasionally useful and usually a bug. default is optional and runs when nothing matched.
items.ne: switch का तीन नियम सबै परीक्षामा सोधिन्छन्। Expression int वा char हुनुपर्छ — float कहिल्यै होइन, string पनि होइन। हरेक case को label constant हुनुपर्छ, variable होइन। अनि break नभए नियन्त्रण अर्को case मा झरेर चलिरहन्छ — कहिलेकाहीं काम लाग्ने, प्रायः गल्ती। default ऐच्छिक हो र केही नमिले चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: The same trap exists on if: if (x > 5); tests x, does nothing, and then runs the next line unconditionally. Be suspicious of a semicolon directly after a closing bracket.
items.ne: एक पटक। for लाइनको अन्त्यको semicolon पूरै खाली statement हो, र त्यही खाली statement loop को body हो। Loop ले इमानदारीपूर्वक पाँच पटक केही गर्दैन। printf loop पछिको अर्को statement मात्र हो, त्यसैले एक पटक चल्छ। प्रोग्राम एउटै चेतावनीविना compile हुन्छ, र यही गल्ती महँगो हुनुको कारण त्यही हो: कसैले भन्दैन, र पाँच लाइनको ठाउँमा एक लाइन आउँछ। if मा पनि उही पासो छ: if (x > 5); ले x जाँच्छ, केही गर्दैन, अनि अर्को लाइन सर्तविनै चलाउँछ। कोष्ठक बन्द भएपछि सिधै आउने semicolon देखे शंका गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Count the stars on each row before opening this. Row 1 has one, row 4 has four — so what must the inner loop's condition depend on?
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि हरेक पङ्क्तिका तारा गन्नुहोस्। पहिलो पङ्क्तिमा एउटा, चौथोमा चार — त्यसो भए भित्री loop को सर्त केमा भर पर्नुपर्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Every row really ends with a space you cannot see here, because printf("* ") prints a space after each star — the first row is "* " and the last is "* * * * ". Nothing in the pattern depends on it, but it is the kind of thing that makes an automatic checker disagree with you.
items.ne: हरेक पङ्क्ति वास्तवमा यहाँ नदेखिने एउटा खाली ठाउँमा सकिन्छ, किनभने printf("* ") ले हरेक तारापछि एक खाली ठाउँ छाप्छ — पहिलो पङ्क्ति "* " र अन्तिम "* * * * "। नमुनाको कुनै कुरा त्यसमा अडिँदैन, तर स्वचालित जाँचकर्ता तपाईंसँग बाझ्ने ठाउँ यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Two details carry the marks. The inner condition is j <= i and not j <= 4: the number of stars has to grow with the row, and i is the row number. And the printf("\n") sits inside the outer loop but outside the inner one — move it inside the inner loop and every star lands on its own line; move it outside both and the whole pattern becomes one long row.
items.ne: अंक दुई कुराले बोक्छन्। भित्री सर्त j <= 4 होइन j <= i हो: ताराको सङ्ख्या पङ्क्तिसँगै बढ्नुपर्छ, र i नै पङ्क्ति नम्बर हो। अनि printf("\n") बाहिरी loop भित्र तर भित्री loop बाहिर छ — भित्री loop भित्र सारे हरेक तारा आफ्नै लाइनमा जान्छ; दुवैभन्दा बाहिर सारे पूरै ढाँचा एउटै लामो पङ्क्ति बन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.3 Jump statements — break, continue, goto, return — Jump statement — break, continue, goto, return
items.en: Omitting braces around two statements. Only the first belongs to the if or the loop.
items.ne: for, while वा if पछि semicolon: खाली body बन्छ, सफा compile हुन्छ, र प्रोग्राम चुपचाप बदलिन्छ। switch मा break बिर्सनु: मिलेको case मुनिका सबै पनि चल्छन्। दायराका लागि switch चलाउनु: यसले ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant मात्र तुलना गर्छ। while भित्र update बिर्सनु: सर्त कहिल्यै असत्य हुँदैन र loop रोकिँदैन। एउटा break ले दुई nested loop छाड्छ भन्ठान्नु: भित्री मात्र छाड्छ। सर्तमा == को ठाउँमा = लेख्नु: if (a = 0) सधैं असत्य, if (a = 5) सधैं सत्य। दुई statement वरिपरि brace नलगाउनु: if वा loop को भाग पहिलो मात्र हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 3. Fifteen hours — the joint largest practical allocation in the subject — because this is where a student stops reading programs and starts writing them. Neither can be done from this site: both need a C compiler on a real computer.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ३ को सूचीबाट। पन्ध्र घण्टा — विषयको सबैभन्दा ठूलो प्रयोगात्मक समयमध्ये एक — किनभने विद्यार्थीले प्रोग्राम पढ्न छाडेर लेख्न सुरु गर्ने ठाउँ यही हो। दुवै यस साइटबाट गर्न मिल्दैन: दुवैलाई साँच्चैको कम्प्युटरमा C compiler चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: Unit 2. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: area and perimeter of a rectangle; simple interest from principal, rate and time; conversion of temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit; swapping two numbers using a third variable. Observe: every one of these runs top to bottom with no decision and no repetition — that is what sequential means, and it is the baseline the next activity departs from.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: युनिट २। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: आयातको क्षेत्रफल र परिमिति; साँवा, दर र समयबाट साधारण ब्याज; सेल्सियसबाट फरेनहाइट; तेस्रो variable प्रयोग गरेर दुई सङ्ख्या साट्ने। ध्यान दिने: यी सबै कुनै निर्णय र दोहोरिनविना माथिबाट तल चल्छन् — sequential भनेको त्यही हो, र अर्को क्रियाकलाप यहींबाट अलग हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 3.1, 3.2 and 3.3. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: largest of three numbers; odd or even; a grade from marks using a ladder; a simple calculator using switch; multiplication table of any number; sum of the first n natural numbers; factorial; prime or not; and the star triangle from Example 2. Observe and record: for each looping program, write down the value of the counter when the loop ends. Being able to say why it is one more than the last value used is worth more than the program itself.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ३.१, ३.२ र ३.३। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: तीन सङ्ख्यामध्ये ठूलो; जोर कि बिजोर; शृंखला प्रयोग गरेर अंकबाट grade; switch ले साधारण calculator; कुनै सङ्ख्याको गुणन तालिका; पहिलो n प्राकृतिक सङ्ख्याको जोड; factorial; prime हो कि होइन; र उदाहरण २ को तारा त्रिभुज। ध्यान दिएर लेख्ने: हरेक loop भएको प्रोग्राममा loop सकिँदा counter को मान लेख्नुहोस्। त्यो अन्तिम प्रयोग भएको मानभन्दा एक बढी किन हुन्छ भन्न सक्नु प्रोग्राम आफैंभन्दा बढी काम लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: This unit carries 13 of the 50 external marks — more than any other — and 16 of the 64 theory hours. Expect a long question asking you to write a program with a loop, a differentiate question on break against continue or while against do-while, and at least one "what is the output" question where the answer turns on a stray semicolon, a missing break, or the counter's value after the loop.
items.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये १३ अंक ओगट्छ — अरू कुनैभन्दा बढी — र ६४ मध्ये १६ घण्टा। Loop भएको प्रोग्राम लेख्न भन्ने लामो प्रश्न, break र continue वा while र do-while को फरक सोध्ने प्रश्न, र कम्तीमा एउटा "output के हुन्छ" प्रश्न अपेक्षा गर्नुहोस् — जसको उत्तर छुट्टै semicolon, छुटेको break, वा loop पछिको counter को मानमा भर पर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: The difference in one line: break ends the loop, continue ends only that pass.
items.ne: break ले loop पूरै सिध्याउँछ; नियन्त्रण loop पछिको पहिलो statement मा जान्छ। उदाहरणको output 12 हुन्छ। continue ले यस पटकका बाँकी statement मात्र छाडेर अर्को पटकमा जान्छ; loop चलिरहन्छ। उदाहरणको output 1245 हुन्छ। एक लाइनमा फरक: break ले loop सिध्याउँछ, continue ले त्यो एक पटक मात्र।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Marks: a for loop is correct here because ten turns are known in advance. Note that i is used inside the printf as well as in the condition — a counter is a variable, not just a tally.
items.ne: अंक: दस पटक पहिल्यै थाहा भएकाले यहाँ for ठिक छ। i सर्तमा मात्र होइन printf भित्र पनि प्रयोग भएको ध्यान दिनुहोस् — counter गन्ती मात्र होइन, variable हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: All three can solve the same problem; the choice states the intention, which is what the marks are for.
items.ne: १. for — नियन्त्रणका तीनै भाग एउटै लाइनमा; दोहोरिने सङ्ख्या पहिल्यै थाहा भएमा। २. while — कोष्ठकमा सर्त मात्र; हरेक पटकअघि जाँचिने भएकाले body शून्य पटक पनि चल्न सक्छ; सङ्ख्या पहिल्यै थाहा नभएमा। ३. do-while — पहिले body, पछि जाँच; त्यसैले कम्तीमा एक पटक सधैं चल्छ; सर्तपछि semicolon चाहिने एकमात्र loop यही; body कम्तीमा एक पटक हुनैपर्ने भएमा। तीनैले उही समस्या समाधान गर्न सक्छन्; छनोटले नियत देखाउँछ, र अंक त्यसैको हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: After for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) ends, i holds 6.
items.ne: if…else if शृंखलाले ठ्याक्कै एउटा शाखा चलाउँछ — पहिलो सत्य भएको। switch ले ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant तुलना गर्छ, int वा char मा चल्छ, र हरेक case पछि break चाहिन्छ। हरेक loop लाई initialisation, सर्त र update चाहिन्छ; for ले तीनै एउटै लाइनमा राख्छ। while शून्य पटक पनि चल्न सक्छ; do-while कम्तीमा एक पटक सधैं चल्छ। Nested loop मा बाहिरीको एक पटकका लागि भित्री पूरै चल्छ; बाहिरी पङ्क्ति, भित्री स्तम्भ। break ले loop छाड्छ, continue ले एक पटक, return ले function, goto ले label मा हाम फाल्छ। for, while वा if पछि सिधै semicolon राखे खाली body बन्छ र चेतावनीविनै compile हुन्छ। for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) सकिएपछि i मा ६ हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Trace a loop on paper and give the value of every variable at every turn
items.ne: कागजमै loop ट्रेस गरेर हरेक पटक हरेक variable को मान भन्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Write one column per variable and one row per turn. Fill a row in this order: test the condition, run the body, then apply the update. The loop ends when the condition is false — and the counter has ALREADY been updated past the last value it was used with.
items.ne: हरेक variable को एउटा स्तम्भ र हरेक पटकको एउटा पङ्क्ति लेख्नुहोस्। पङ्क्ति यही क्रममा भर्नुहोस्: सर्त जाँच्ने, body चलाउने, अनि update लगाउने। सर्त असत्य भएपछि loop सकिन्छ — र counter अन्तिम पटक प्रयोग भएको मानभन्दा पहिल्यै नाघिसकेको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: int i, sum = 0; for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) sum = sum + i;  What is sum at the end, and what is i?
items.ne: int i, sum = 0; for (i = 1; i <= 4; i++) sum = sum + i;  अन्त्यमा sum कति हुन्छ, र i कति?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: After the FIRST turn (i = 1), what is sum?
items.ne: पहिलो पटक (i = 1) पछि sum कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: sum started at 0, and the body adds i, which is 1. So sum = 0 + 1 = 1.
items.ne: sum ० बाट सुरु भयो, र body ले i — अर्थात् १ — जोड्छ। त्यसैले sum = 0 + 1 = 1।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: After the SECOND turn (i = 2), what is sum?
items.ne: दोस्रो पटक (i = 2) पछि sum कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: sum was 1 and i is now 2, so sum = 1 + 2 = 3. Each turn adds the current i to whatever sum already held.
items.ne: sum १ थियो र i अब २ छ, त्यसैले sum = 1 + 2 = 3। हरेक पटक अहिलेको i लाई sum मा पहिल्यै भएको मानमा जोडिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The last turn uses i = 4. What is i when the loop STOPS?
items.ne: अन्तिम पटक i = 4 मा चल्छ। Loop रोकिँदा i कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: After the body runs with i = 4, i++ makes i 5, and only then is the condition tested: 5 <= 4 is false, so the loop ends with i holding 5.
items.ne: i = 4 मा body चलेपछि i++ ले i लाई ५ बनाउँछ, अनि मात्र सर्त जाँचिन्छ: 5 <= 4 असत्य, त्यसैले loop सकिँदा i मा ५ हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So what is the final value of sum?
items.ne: त्यसो भए sum को अन्तिम मान कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10, and i is 5 rather than 4. Those two answers come from the same table and students get the first right and the second wrong, because the update runs after the last useful turn.
items.ne: 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 10, र i ४ नभई ५ हुन्छ। दुवै उत्तर उही तालिकाबाट आउँछन् र विद्यार्थीले पहिलो ठिक अनि दोस्रो गलत पार्छन्, किनभने अन्तिम काम लाग्ने पटकपछि पनि update चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: int i, c = 0; for (i = 2; i <= 10; i = i + 2) c++;  How many times does the body run?
items.ne: int i, c = 0; for (i = 2; i <= 10; i = i + 2) c++;  body कति पटक चल्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: List the values i takes. What is the LAST one the body runs with?
items.ne: i ले लिने मान सोच्नुहोस्। body अन्तिम पटक कुन मानमा चल्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The update adds 2 each time, so i is 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. The condition is i <= 10, so 10 passes and the body runs with it.
items.ne: Update ले हरेक पटक २ जोड्छ, त्यसैले i २, ४, ६, ८, १० हुन्छ। सर्त i <= 10 भएकाले १० पास हुन्छ र body त्यसमै चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is i when the condition first fails?
items.ne: सर्त पहिलो पटक असफल हुँदा i कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: After the turn with i = 10 the update makes i 12, and 12 <= 10 is false. The step is 2, so the counter overshoots by 2 rather than by 1.
items.ne: i = 10 को पटकपछि update ले i लाई १२ बनाउँछ, र 12 <= 10 असत्य हुन्छ। पाइला २ भएकाले counter १ होइन २ ले नाघ्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So how many times did the body run?
items.ne: त्यसो भए body कति पटक चल्यो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Five turns: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Counting is not (10 - 2) = 8 and not 10: with a step of 2 the number of turns is the number of values the counter actually takes.
items.ne: पाँच पटक: २, ४, ६, ८, १०। गन्ती (10 - 2) = 8 पनि होइन, १० पनि होइन: पाइला २ हुँदा पटकको सङ्ख्या counter ले साँच्चै लिने मानको सङ्ख्या हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: int i = 5, total = 0; while (i > 0) { total = total + i; i--; }  What is total?
items.ne: int i = 5, total = 0; while (i > 0) { total = total + i; i--; }  total कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: This loop counts DOWN. What is the first value added to total?
items.ne: यो loop घट्दो छ। total मा पहिलो पटक कुन मान जोडिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i starts at 5 and the condition 5 > 0 is true, so the body runs with i still 5 and adds 5 before i-- reduces it.
items.ne: i ५ बाट सुरु हुन्छ र सर्त 5 > 0 सत्य छ, त्यसैले i अझै ५ हुँदै body चल्छ र i-- ले घटाउनुअघि ५ जोडिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is i when the loop stops?
items.ne: Loop रोकिँदा i कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The last useful turn runs with i = 1, then i-- makes i 0, and 0 > 0 is false. A down-counting loop overshoots below the limit, not above it.
items.ne: अन्तिम काम लाग्ने पटक i = 1 मा चल्छ, अनि i-- ले i लाई ० बनाउँछ, र 0 > 0 असत्य हुन्छ। घट्दो loop सीमाभन्दा माथि होइन, तल नाघ्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is the final value of total?
items.ne: total को अन्तिम मान कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15. The same total as counting up, because addition does not care about order — but the trace table is read in the opposite direction.
items.ne: 5 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 15। बढ्दो गन्तीकै जोड, किनभने जोडलाई क्रमको वास्ता छैन — तर ट्रेस तालिका उल्टो दिशामा पढिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) { if (i == 3) continue; printf("%d", i); }  Write the exact output, with no spaces.
items.ne: for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) { if (i == 3) continue; printf("%d", i); }  ठ्याक्कै output लेख्नुहोस्, खाली ठाउँ नराखी।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is printed?
items.ne: के छापिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: continue abandons the rest of that turn only, so when i is 3 the printf below it is skipped and the loop carries on. 3 is missing from the output and nothing else is. Had the statement been break, the output would have been 12.
items.ne: continue ले त्यस पटकको बाँकी मात्र छाड्छ, त्यसैले i ३ हुँदा तलको printf छुट्छ र loop चलिरहन्छ। Output बाट ३ मात्र छुट्छ, अरू केही छुट्दैन। Statement break भएको भए output 12 हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A menu is shown, a choice is read, and this repeats until the user picks Exit. Written with do-while and a condition that is already false at the start, how many times does the menu appear?
items.ne: Menu देखाइन्छ, छनोट पढिन्छ, र प्रयोगकर्ताले Exit नछानेसम्म दोहोरिन्छ। सुरुमै असत्य भइसकेको सर्तसहित do-while मा लेखिँदा menu कति पटक देखिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: How many times does the menu appear?
items.ne: Menu कति पटक देखिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Once. A do-while runs its body before it tests anything, so a condition that is false from the beginning still lets the body happen exactly one time. Nothing has been traced here: the question moved from counting turns in a table to knowing where the test sits relative to the body, and that single structural fact decides the answer without any arithmetic at all.
items.ne: एक पटक। do-while ले केही जाँच्नुअघि body चलाउँछ, त्यसैले सुरुदेखि असत्य सर्त भए पनि body ठ्याक्कै एक पटक हुन्छ। यहाँ केही ट्रेस गरिएको छैन: प्रश्न तालिकामा पटक गन्नेबाट body र जाँच कुन क्रममा छन् भन्ने तिर सर्‍यो, र त्यही एउटा संरचनागत तथ्यले कुनै गणनाविनै उत्तर तय गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.1 Decision making — if, if…else, switch — निर्णय — if, if…else, switch
items.en: Before stepping, say which line will run and which lines will be skipped. Then check whether the else was tested at all.
items.ne: चरण सुरु गर्नुअघि कुन लाइन चल्छ र कुन छुट्छ भन्नुहोस्। अनि else जाँचियो कि जाँचिएन हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Write the two columns — i and sum — on paper and fill them in before each press. That is exactly what "trace the following program" asks you to do in an examination.
items.ne: कागजमा i र sum का दुई स्तम्भ बनाएर हरेक पटक थिच्नुअघि भर्नुहोस्। परीक्षामा "तलको प्रोग्राम ट्रेस गर्नुहोस्" भन्दा ठ्याक्कै त्यही खोजिएको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Both loops are given n < 5 with n already 10. Predict how many lines the program prints in total before you step. Most people say zero.
items.ne: दुवै loop लाई n पहिल्यै १० हुँदा n < 5 दिइएको छ। चरण सुरु गर्नुअघि प्रोग्रामले जम्मा कति लाइन छाप्छ अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। धेरैले शून्य भन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Ask two questions in order. Do I know the count in advance? If yes, for. If no, must the body happen at least once? If yes, do-while; if no, while.
items.ne: क्रमैसँग दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्। गन्ती पहिल्यै थाहा छ? छ भने for। छैन भने — body कम्तीमा एक पटक हुनैपर्छ? पर्छ भने do-while; पर्दैन भने while।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.3 Jump statements — break, continue, goto, return — Jump statement — break, continue, goto, return
items.en: Predict the complete output before you start. Then check two things: is 3 missing, and does the output stop before 5?
items.ne: सुरु गर्नुअघि पूरै output अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। अनि दुई कुरा जाँच्नुहोस्: ३ छुटेको छ? र output ५ भन्दा अगाडि रोकिएको छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.3 Jump statements — break, continue, goto, return — Jump statement — break, continue, goto, return
items.en: For each case ask what is abandoned: this turn, this loop, or this function. Those three answers separate continue, break and return, and only goto names a destination.
items.ne: हरेक केसमा के छाडिन्छ सोध्नुहोस्: यस पटक, यो loop, कि यो function। यी तीन उत्तरले continue, break र return छुट्याउँछन्, र गन्तव्यको नाम goto ले मात्र लिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.1 Decision making — if, if…else, switch — निर्णय — if, if…else, switch
items.en: Four shapes, in the order you meet them 1. Simple if — do something only when a condition is true. 2. if…else — two paths, exactly one of which runs. 3. if…else if…else (the ladder) — several conditions tested in order. The first true one wins and the rest are never tested. Order matters: if you test marks >= 40 before marks >= 80, nobody ever gets a distinction. 4. switch — one value compared against a list of exact constants. A condition is any expression. In C zero is false and anything that is not zero is true, which is why if (n) means "if n is not zero" and is perfectly legal. Without braces, an if controls exactly one statement. Two indented lines under an if look like a block and are not one — the second runs every time. Use braces always; the compiler does not care and the next reader does.
items.ne: चार आकार, भेटिने क्रममा १. साधारण if — सर्त सत्य भएमा मात्र केही गर्ने। २. if…else — दुई बाटो, जसमध्ये ठ्याक्कै एउटा चल्छ। ३. if…else if…else (शृंखला) — धेरै सर्त क्रमैसँग जाँचिन्छन्। पहिलो सत्य जित्छ र बाँकी कहिल्यै जाँचिँदैनन्। क्रम महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: marks >= 80 भन्दा अघि marks >= 40 जाँच्नुभयो भने कसैले पनि distinction पाउँदैन। ४. switch — एउटा मानलाई ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant को सूचीसँग तुलना गर्ने। सर्त भनेको जुनसुकै expression हो। C मा शून्य असत्य र शून्य नभएको जे पनि सत्य हो — त्यसैले if (n) को अर्थ "n शून्य होइन भने" हुन्छ र यो पूरै मान्य छ। Brace नभए if ले ठ्याक्कै एउटा statement मात्र नियन्त्रण गर्छ। if मुनि indent गरेका दुई लाइन block जस्तो देखिन्छन् तर होइनन् — दोस्रो सधैं चल्छ। सधैं brace लगाउनुहोस्; compiler लाई फरक पर्दैन, पछि पढ्नेलाई पर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: Three loops, one question that chooses between them Every loop needs the same three things, and the difference between the loops is only where those three are written: Initialisation — the counter gets a starting value. Condition — tested each time; the loop continues while it is true. Update — the counter changes, or the condition never becomes false. for puts all three on one line: for (i = 1; i <= 10; i++). Use it when the number of repetitions is known before the loop starts. while puts only the condition in the brackets; the other two are yours to place. Use it when you do not know how many times — "keep reading until the user types 0". do…while runs the body first and tests afterwards, so it always runs at least once. Use it when the body has to happen before anyone can judge the condition — a menu, a password prompt. It is the only loop that ends with a semicolon after the while. Nested loops are a loop inside a loop. The inner one completes all of its turns for each single turn of the outer one. In a pattern, the outer loop is rows and the inner loop is columns.
items.ne: तीन loop, र तिनलाई छुट्याउने एउटै प्रश्न हरेक loop लाई उही तीन कुरा चाहिन्छ, र loop बीचको फरक ती तीन कहाँ लेखिन्छन् भन्ने मात्र हो: Initialisation — counter ले सुरुको मान पाउँछ। Condition — हरेक पटक जाँचिन्छ; सत्य रहेसम्म loop चल्छ। Update — counter बदलिन्छ, नत्र सर्त कहिल्यै असत्य हुँदैन। for ले तीनै कुरा एउटै लाइनमा राख्छ: for (i = 1; i <= 10; i++)। दोहोरिने सङ्ख्या loop सुरु हुनुअघि नै थाहा भएमा यसलाई प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। while ले कोष्ठकमा सर्त मात्र राख्छ; अरू दुई तपाईंले राख्नुपर्छ। कति पटक भन्ने थाहा नभएमा प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् — "प्रयोगकर्ताले ० नटाइपेसम्म पढिरहनुहोस्"। do…while ले पहिले body चलाएर पछि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले यो सधैं कम्तीमा एक पटक चल्छ। सर्त जाँच्नुअघि नै body हुनैपर्ने भए प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् — menu, password। while पछि semicolon चाहिने एकमात्र loop यही हो। Nested loop भनेको loop भित्रको loop हो। बाहिरी loop को एक पटक का लागि भित्री loop ले आफ्ना सबै पटक पूरा गर्छ। ढाँचामा बाहिरी loop पङ्क्ति र भित्री loop स्तम्भ हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.3 Jump statements — break, continue, goto, return — Jump statement — break, continue, goto, return
items.en: Four ways to leave somewhere early break — leaves the whole loop immediately and continues after it. Inside a switch it stops the fall-through into the next case. continue — abandons the rest of this turn only and goes straight to the next one. The loop is not left. goto — jumps to a labelled line elsewhere in the same function: goto end; with end: somewhere below. It is examinable, and almost every real program is clearer without it, because a reader can no longer tell what reaches a line by reading downwards. return — ends the whole function and hands a value back. Inside a loop it leaves the loop too, because the function it belonged to has finished. In a nested loop, break leaves only the inner loop. This is asked often and answered wrongly often: one break does not escape two loops.
items.ne: समयअघि बाहिरिने चार तरिका break — पूरै loop तुरुन्तै छाडेर त्यसपछिबाट अघि बढ्छ। switch भित्र यसले अर्को case मा झर्न रोक्छ। continue — यस पटकको बाँकी मात्र छाडेर सिधै अर्को पटकमा जान्छ। Loop छाडिँदैन। goto — उही function भित्र label लेखिएको लाइनमा हाम फाल्छ: goto end; र तल कतै end:। परीक्षामा सोधिन्छ, तर झन्डै हरेक वास्तविक प्रोग्राम यसविना स्पष्ट हुन्छ — किनभने कुन लाइनमा के पुग्छ भन्ने कुरा तलतिर पढेर थाहा पाउन सकिँदैन। return — पूरै function सिध्याएर मान फर्काउँछ। Loop भित्र भए loop पनि छुट्छ, किनभने त्यो भएको function नै सकियो। Nested loop मा break ले भित्री loop मात्र छाड्छ। यो धेरै सोधिन्छ र धेरै गलत उत्तर आउँछ: एउटा break ले दुई loop उम्कँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.3 Jump statements — break, continue, goto, return — Jump statement — break, continue, goto, return
items.en: Memory hook — continue skips a turn; break ends the game; return leaves the ground.
items.ne: सम्झने तरिका — continue ले एक पटक छाड्छ; break ले खेल सिध्याउँछ; return ले मैदानै छाड्छ।
