items.en: Differentiate between break and continue with an example of each.
items.ne: break र continue को फरक हरेकको उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Write a C program to print the multiplication table of a number entered by the user, from 1 to 10.
items.ne: प्रयोगकर्ताले दिएको सङ्ख्याको १ देखि १० सम्मको गुणन तालिका छाप्ने C प्रोग्राम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Explain the three looping statements of C with syntax and one example each. State clearly when each should be used.
items.ne: C का तीन looping statement लाई syntax र हरेकको एउटा उदाहरणसहित बुझाउनुहोस्। हरेक कहिले प्रयोग गर्ने स्पष्ट लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested
items.en: How many times does the body run? for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++); printf("Hello");
items.ne: body कति पटक चल्छ? माथिको for लाइनको अन्त्यमा semicolon छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Every loop condition is a relational expression and every counter is an assignment, both from 2.7. If i = i + 1 and i == 1 still look like the same kind of line, a loop cannot be traced and the output question cannot be answered.
items.ne: हरेक loop को सर्त relational expression हो र हरेक counter assignment — दुवै २.७ बाट। i = i + 1 र i == 1 अझै उस्तै लाइन देखिन्छन् भने loop ट्रेस गर्न सकिँदैन र output को प्रश्नको उत्तर आउँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A flowchart diamond is an if and a loop is an arrow going back. Drawing the control flow before writing it is what makes a nested loop tractable.
items.ne: Flowchart को diamond नै if हो र पछाडि फर्कने तीर नै loop। लेख्नुअघि नियन्त्रण प्रवाह कोर्नुले nested loop सम्हाल्न सकिने बनाउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: if, else if, else — only one branch runs
items.ne: if, else if, else — एउटै शाखा मात्र चल्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: marks is set to 72. Changing this one value is how you test every branch of the chain, which is what a practical exercise on this unit asks you to do.
items.ne: marks लाई 72 राखियो। यही एउटा मान बदलेर शृंखलाका सबै शाखा जाँच्न सकिन्छ, र यस युनिटको प्रयोगात्मक अभ्यासले त्यही गर्न भन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The first condition is tested: is 72 greater than or equal to 80? It is false, so the printf under it is skipped completely.
items.ne: पहिलो सर्त जाँचियो: 72 ले 80 भन्दा ठूलो वा बराबर हो? होइन, त्यसैले तलको printf पूरै छाडिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Because the first was false, the else if is tested next: is 72 at least 60? Yes. Note that the chain is only reached because the earlier test failed.
items.ne: पहिलो असत्य भएकाले अब else if जाँचिन्छ: 72 कम्तीमा 60 छ? छ। ध्यान दिनुहोस् — अघिल्लो जाँच असफल भएकैले यहाँसम्म आइपुगेको हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: This branch runs and prints. The important part is what happens next: not the else, and not any further test.
items.ne: यो शाखा चल्छ र छाप्छ। मुख्य कुरा त्यसपछि के हुन्छ भन्ने हो: else होइन, र अरू कुनै जाँच पनि होइन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Control jumps straight past the else to the statement after the whole chain. Exactly ONE branch of an if-else chain ever runs, which is why a student who writes three separate ifs gets a different program.
items.ne: नियन्त्रण else नाघेर सिधै पूरै शृंखलापछिको statement मा पुग्छ। if-else शृंखलामा सधैं ठ्याक्कै एउटै शाखा चल्छ — त्यसैले तीन छुट्टाछुट्टै if लेख्ने विद्यार्थीको प्रोग्राम फरक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A for loop, one turn at a time
items.ne: For loop, एक–एक पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: sum starts at 0. This is not decoration: if sum is left uninitialised, every addition below is adding to a value nobody knows.
items.ne: sum 0 बाट सुरु हुन्छ। यो सजावट होइन: sum लाई मान नदिए तलका हरेक जोडले कसैलाई थाहा नभएको मानमा जोडिरहेको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The for line has three parts separated by semicolons. The FIRST part runs once only, right now: i becomes 1.
items.ne: For लाइनका तीन भाग semicolon ले छुट्याइएका छन्। पहिलो भाग एक पटक मात्र, अहिले चल्छ: i 1 हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The SECOND part is the condition and it is tested before every turn: is 1 less than or equal to 5? True, so the body runs.
items.ne: दोस्रो भाग सर्त हो र हरेक पटकअघि जाँचिन्छ: 1 ले 5 भन्दा सानो वा बराबर हो? सत्य, त्यसैले body चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Turn 1: sum = 0 + 1 = 1. Read the line right to left — work out the right side, then store it on the left.
items.ne: पहिलो पटक: sum = 0 + 1 = 1। लाइन दायाँबाट बायाँ पढ्नुहोस् — पहिले दायाँको गणना, अनि बायाँमा भण्डारण।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The THIRD part runs at the end of every turn: i++ makes i 2. Then the condition is tested again — 2 is still at most 5.
items.ne: तेस्रो भाग हरेक पटकको अन्त्यमा चल्छ: i++ ले i लाई 2 बनाउँछ। अनि सर्त फेरि जाँचिन्छ — 2 अझै 5 भित्रै छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Turn 2: sum = 1 + 2 = 3. Notice that sum is holding the running total, and i is holding the position. Two different jobs, two different variables.
items.ne: दोस्रो पटक: sum = 1 + 2 = 3। ध्यान दिनुहोस् — sum ले चल्दै गरेको जोड राख्छ, i ले स्थान। दुई फरक काम, दुई फरक variable।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 3. The condition is tested again and 3 is still at most 5, so the body runs once more.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 3 बनाउँछ। सर्त फेरि जाँचिन्छ र 3 अझै 5 भित्रै छ, त्यसैले body फेरि चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Turn 3: sum = 3 + 3 = 6.
items.ne: तेस्रो पटक: sum = 3 + 3 = 6।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 4, and 4 is at most 5.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 4 बनाउँछ, र 4 पनि 5 भित्रै छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Turn 4: sum = 6 + 4 = 10.
items.ne: चौथो पटक: sum = 6 + 4 = 10।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 5. The condition still holds, and this will turn out to be the last time it does.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 5 बनाउँछ। सर्त अझै सत्य छ, र यो नै अन्तिम पटक हुने देखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Turn 5: sum = 10 + 5 = 15. This is the last turn, and nothing on screen says so yet.
items.ne: पाँचौं पटक: sum = 10 + 5 = 15। यो अन्तिम पटक हो, र पर्दामा अहिलेसम्म त्यसो भनिएको छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 6, the condition 6 <= 5 is FALSE, and the loop ends. i is 6 when the loop finishes, not 5 — that is the detail output-prediction questions are built on.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 6 बनाउँछ, सर्त 6 <= 5 असत्य हुन्छ, र loop सकिन्छ। Loop सकिँदा i 6 हुन्छ, 5 होइन — output अनुमान गर्ने प्रश्न त्यही कुरामा बनेका हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The printf is OUTSIDE the loop, so it runs once. Move it inside the braces and the program would print five lines instead of one.
items.ne: printf loop भन्दा बाहिर छ, त्यसैले एक पटक चल्छ। यसलाई brace भित्र सारे प्रोग्रामले एक होइन पाँच लाइन छाप्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: do-while runs its body before it tests
items.ne: do-while ले जाँच्नुअघि body चलाउँछ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: n is 10, so the condition n < 5 is false from the very beginning. Both loops below are given the same false condition on purpose.
items.ne: n 10 छ, त्यसैले n < 5 सुरुदेखि नै असत्य छ। तलका दुवै loop लाई जानीजानी उही असत्य सर्त दिइएको छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The while loop tests FIRST. 10 < 5 is false, so the body never runs even once and nothing is printed.
items.ne: while ले पहिले जाँच्छ। 10 < 5 असत्य छ, त्यसैले body एक पटक पनि चल्दैन र केही छापिँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The do-while begins by running the body. There is no test here at all — the word do is a promise that the body will happen.
items.ne: do-while ले body चलाएरै सुरु गर्छ। यहाँ जाँच नै छैन — do शब्द नै body हुन्छ भन्ने वाचा हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So this prints, even though the condition was already false. A do-while always runs at least once; that is the entire difference between the two loops.
items.ne: त्यसैले सर्त पहिल्यै असत्य भए पनि यो छापिन्छ। do-while कम्तीमा एक पटक सधैं चल्छ; दुई loop बीचको पूरै फरक त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Only NOW is the condition tested. It is false, so the loop ends after exactly one pass. Note the semicolon after the closing bracket — a do-while needs it and a while does not.
items.ne: सर्त अब मात्र जाँचिन्छ। असत्य छ, त्यसैले ठ्याक्कै एक पटकपछि loop सकिन्छ। कोष्ठकपछिको semicolon हेर्नुहोस् — do-while लाई चाहिन्छ, while लाई चाहिँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The program ends having printed one line. An examination question that gives both loops and asks for the output is asking exactly this.
items.ne: प्रोग्राम एउटा लाइन छापेर सकिन्छ। दुवै loop दिएर output सोध्ने परीक्षाको प्रश्नले ठ्याक्कै यही सोधेको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: break leaves the loop, continue skips a turn
items.ne: break ले loop छाड्छ, continue ले एक पटक छाड्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i starts at 1 and the condition 1 <= 6 is true, so the body runs.
items.ne: i 1 बाट सुरु हुन्छ र सर्त 1 <= 6 सत्य छ, त्यसैले body चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Neither if matches, so the printf at the bottom runs and 1 is printed. The space inside the quotes is what keeps the numbers apart.
items.ne: कुनै पनि if मिलेन, त्यसैले तलको printf चल्छ र 1 छापिन्छ। उद्धरणभित्रको खाली ठाउँले सङ्ख्याहरू छुट्याउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 2 and the condition still holds, so the body runs again.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 2 बनाउँछ र सर्त अझै सत्य छ, त्यसैले body फेरि चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Both tests fail again, so 2 is printed.
items.ne: दुवै जाँच फेरि असफल भए, त्यसैले 2 छापिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 3.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 3 बनाउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The first if matches, so continue runs. It jumps straight to i++ and skips everything below it — including the printf.
items.ne: पहिलो if मिल्यो, त्यसैले continue चल्छ। यो सिधै i++ मा हाम फाल्छ र तलको सबै — printf सहित — छाड्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: continue landed here: i++ makes i 4. Note that the loop was never left — only the rest of that one turn.
items.ne: continue यहीँ आइपुग्यो: i++ ले i लाई 4 बनाउँछ। ध्यान दिनुहोस् — loop छाडिएकै थिएन, त्यो एक पटकको बाँकी मात्र।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 3 was never printed, which is why the output jumps from 2 to 4.
items.ne: 3 कहिल्यै छापिएन, त्यसैले output 2 बाट सिधै 4 मा जान्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: i++ makes i 5 and the condition still holds, so the body runs once more.
items.ne: i++ ले i लाई 5 बनाउँछ र सर्त अझै सत्य छ, त्यसैले body फेरि एक पटक चल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The second if matches, so break runs. This leaves the loop entirely — i will never reach 6.
items.ne: दोस्रो if मिल्यो, त्यसैले break चल्छ। यसले पूरै loop छाड्छ — i कहिल्यै 6 सम्म पुग्दैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Control is now after the loop. Output was 1 2 4: 3 was skipped by continue, and 5 and 6 never happened because of break. One statement skipped a turn, the other ended the loop.
items.ne: नियन्त्रण अब loop पछाडि छ। Output 1 2 4 भयो: 3 लाई continue ले छाड्यो, र 5 अनि 6 break का कारण भएनन्। एउटाले एक पटक छाड्यो, अर्कोले loop नै सिध्यायो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: All three do
items.ne: तीनै ले

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 4 times
items.ne: ४ पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 5 times
items.ne: ५ पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 6 times
items.ne: ६ पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Forever
items.ne: सधैं

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Three times
items.ne: तीन पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Once
items.ne: एक पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Never — it is a compile error
items.ne: कहिल्यै होइन — यो compile त्रुटि हो

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Four times
items.ne: चार पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Distinction, because 95 is at least 80
items.ne: Distinction, किनभने ९५ कम्तीमा ८० छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The grade for 40 and above, because the first true test wins and the rest are never reached
items.ne: ४० माथिको grade, किनभने पहिलो सत्य जाँच जित्छ र बाँकीसम्म पुगिँदैन

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Both branches run
items.ne: दुवै शाखा चल्छन्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Nothing — the conditions overlap so the program is invalid
items.ne: केही पनि होइन — सर्त बाझिएकाले प्रोग्राम अमान्य हुन्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: It is undefined after the loop
items.ne: Loop पछि यो अनिश्चित हुन्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Hello, once
items.ne: Hello, एक पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Nothing at all
items.ne: केही पनि होइन

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Hello forever
items.ne: Hello सधैं

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Hello five times
items.ne: Hello पाँच पटक

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: It ends the loop it is inside
items.ne: यो भएको loop सिध्याउँछ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: It transfers control to a labelled statement elsewhere in the same function
items.ne: यसले नियन्त्रण उही function भित्र label लेखिएको statement मा सार्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: It calls another function
items.ne: यसले अर्को function बोलाउँछ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: It skips the current turn of a loop
items.ne: यसले loop को यस पटकको काम छाड्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A float variable, or a range such as case 40 to 59
items.ne: float variable, वा case 40 देखि 59 जस्तो दायरा

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: None of them
items.ne: कुनैलाई पनि होइन

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Because while loops cannot be stopped
items.ne: किनभने while loop रोक्नै मिल्दैन

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Because nothing inside the loop changes i, so the condition stays true forever
items.ne: किनभने loop भित्र i लाई केहीले बदल्दैन, त्यसैले सर्त सधैं सत्य रहन्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Because i was initialised outside the loop
items.ne: किनभने i loop बाहिर initialise गरिएको थियो

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Because printf resets i to 1 each time
items.ne: किनभने printf ले हरेक पटक i लाई १ बनाउँछ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Both loops
items.ne: दुवै loop

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Only the inner loop; the outer loop continues with its next turn
items.ne: भित्री loop मात्र; बाहिरी loop आफ्नो अर्को पटकबाट चलिरहन्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Only the outer loop
items.ne: बाहिरी loop मात्र

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The whole function
items.ne: पूरै function

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Which loop always executes its body at least once?
items.ne: कुन loop ले आफ्नो body कम्तीमा एक पटक सधैं चलाउँछ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: int n = 2; switch (n) { case 1: printf("A"); case 2: printf("B"); case 3: printf("C"); default: printf("D"); } What is printed?
items.ne: int n = 2; switch (n) { case 1: printf("A"); case 2: printf("B"); case 3: printf("C"); default: printf("D"); } के छापिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: How many times does the body run in: for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) ?
items.ne: for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) मा body कति पटक चल्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) { if (i == 3) continue; printf("%d", i); } What is printed?
items.ne: for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++) { if (i == 3) continue; printf("%d", i); } के छापिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: for (i = 1; i <= 3; i++); printf("Hi"); How many times is Hi printed?
items.ne: for (i = 1; i <= 3; i++); printf("Hi"); Hi कति पटक छापिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: for (i = 1; i <= 3; i++) for (j = 1; j <= 4; j++) printf("*"); How many stars are printed?
items.ne: for (i = 1; i <= 3; i++) for (j = 1; j <= 4; j++) printf("*"); कति तारा छापिन्छन्?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Decide, before opening this, whether switch can test a RANGE of marks. The answer decides the whole question. खोल्नुअघि निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: switch ले अंकको दायरा जाँच्न सक्छ कि सक्दैन? त्यही उत्तरले पूरै प्रश्न टुङ्ग्याउँछ। Working /* (a) the ladder — the right tool here */ if (marks >= 80) printf("Distinction"); else if (marks >= 60) printf("First division"); else if (marks >= 40) printf("Second division"); else printf("Fail"); /* (b) switch — the wrong tool here */ switch (marks) { case 80: printf("Distinction"); break; case 79: printf("First division"); break; /* ...and 99 more cases. This cannot work. */ default: printf("Fail"); } switch compares a value against exact constants, so it cannot test a range. Grading by marks needs the ladder. switch is right when the value is a small set of exact choices — a menu option, a grade letter, a day number. Note also the descending order in the ladder: with 40 first, a student scoring 95 would be told "second division", because the first true test wins. switch ले मानलाई ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant सँग तुलना गर्छ, त्यसैले दायरा जाँच्न सक्दैन। अंकबाट श्रेणी निकाल्न शृंखला नै चाहिन्छ। मान सानो र ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने छनोटको समूह भएमा switch ठिक हुन्छ — menu विकल्प, grade अक्षर, बारको नम्बर। शृंखलाको घट्दो क्रम पनि हेर्नुहोस्: ४० पहिले राखे ९५ ल्याउने विद्यार्थीलाई "second division" भनिन्थ्यो, किनभने पहिलो सत्य जाँच नै जित्छ। Step through it
items.ne: · चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस् Why do-while always runs at least once What you will learn: the single difference between while and do-while, shown by giving both the same false condition. One prints nothing and the other prints a line, from the same starting state. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: while र do-while बीचको एउटै फरक — दुवैलाई उही असत्य सर्त दिएर देखाइएको। उही सुरुवातबाट एउटाले केही छाप्दैन, अर्कोले एक लाइन छाप्छ। How to use this Both loops are given n < 5 with n already 10. Predict how many lines the program prints in total before you step. Most people say zero. दुवै loop लाई n पहिल्यै १० हुँदा n < 5 दिइएको छ। चरण सुरु गर्नुअघि प्रोग्रामले जम्मा कति लाइन छाप्छ अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। धेरैले शून्य भन्छन्। Practise the judgement
items.ne: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which loop fits this job best? What you will learn: to choose a loop from the problem rather than from habit. The deciding fact is always whether the number of repetitions is known before the loop starts. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: बानीले होइन, समस्या हेरेर loop छान्न। निर्णय गर्ने कुरा सधैं loop सुरु हुनुअघि दोहोरिने सङ्ख्या थाहा छ कि छैन भन्ने हो। How to use this Ask two questions in order. Do I know the count in advance? If yes, for. If no, must the body happen at least once? If yes, do-while; if no, while. क्रमैसँग दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्। गन्ती पहिल्यै थाहा छ? छ भने for। छैन भने — body कम्तीमा एक पटक हुनैपर्छ? पर्छ भने do-while; पर्दैन भने while। Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which jump statement does this describe? What you will learn: to tell the four apart by effect rather than by definition, which is how the examination asks about them. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: परिभाषाले होइन असरले चारैलाई छुट्याउन — परीक्षाले सोध्ने तरिका त्यही हो। How to use this For each case ask what is abandoned: this turn, this loop, or this function. Those three answers separate continue, break and return, and only goto names a destination. हरेक केसमा के छाडिन्छ सोध्नुहोस्: यस पटक, यो loop, कि यो function। यी तीन उत्तरले continue, break र return छुट्याउँछन्, र गन्तव्यको नाम goto ले मात्र लिन्छ। Practise it — the help comes away
items.ne: · अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ Mistakes that cost marks here A semicolon after for, while or if. It makes an empty body, compiles cleanly, and silently changes the program. Forgetting break in a switch. Every case below the matching one runs as well. Using switch for a range of values. It compares exact constants only. Forgetting the update inside a while. The condition never becomes false and the loop never ends. Thinking one break leaves two nested loops. It leaves the inner one only. Writing = instead of == in a condition. if (a = 0) is always false and if (a = 5) is always true. Omitting braces around two statements. Only the first belongs to the if or the loop. for, while वा if पछि semicolon: खाली body बन्छ, सफा compile हुन्छ, र प्रोग्राम चुपचाप बदलिन्छ। switch मा break बिर्सनु: मिलेको case मुनिका सबै पनि चल्छन्। दायराका लागि switch चलाउनु: यसले ठ्याक्कै मिल्ने constant मात्र तुलना गर्छ। while भित्र update बिर्सनु: सर्त कहिल्यै असत्य हुँदैन र loop रोकिँदैन। एउटा break ले दुई nested loop छाड्छ भन्ठान्नु: भित्री मात्र छाड्छ। सर्तमा == को ठाउँमा = लेख्नु: if (a = 0) सधैं असत्य, if (a = 5) सधैं सत्य। दुई statement वरिपरि brace नलगाउनु: if वा loop को भाग पहिलो मात्र हुन्छ। Memory hook — continue skips a turn; break ends the game; return leaves the ground. सम्झने तरिका — continue ले एक पटक छाड्छ; break ले खेल सिध्याउँछ; return ले मैदानै छाड्छ। Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours

items.topic: 3.1 Decision making — if, if…else, switch — निर्णय — if, if…else, switch
items.en: What you will learn: where control actually goes after a branch succeeds. It does not fall into the else, and it does not test anything further — watch the line marker jump past both.

items.topic: 3.2 Loop statements — for, while, do-while, nested — Loop — for, while, do-while, nested

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A prototype gives the return type, the name and the parameter types, and ends with a semicolon. It promises the compiler that the function exists somewhere so a call can be checked before the body is read. Option A is the definition, with the body in braces and no semicolon after the closing brace. Option C is a call, with real values inside the brackets.
items.ne: Prototype ले return प्रकार, नाम र parameter का प्रकार दिन्छ र semicolon ले सकिन्छ। यसले compiler लाई function कतै छ भन्ने वाचा दिन्छ, ताकि body पढ्नुअघि call जाँच्न सकियोस्। विकल्प (क) definition हो — brace भित्र body र बन्द brace पछि semicolon छैन। विकल्प (ग) call हो, कोष्ठकभित्र वास्तविक मान सहित।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: change is called by value, so a copy of n is made and handed over as x. The function sets the copy to 100 and then ends, taking the copy with it. n in main was never touched and still holds 5. To change n the function would need its address: void change(int *x) with *x = 100; called as change(&n).
items.ne: change call by value बाट बोलाइएको छ, त्यसैले n को प्रतिलिपि बनेर x का रूपमा जान्छ। Function ले प्रतिलिपिलाई 100 बनाएर सकिन्छ, र प्रतिलिपि पनि सँगै जान्छ। main को n छोइएकै थिएन र अझै 5 छ। n बदल्न function लाई ठेगाना चाहिन्थ्यो: void change(int *x) र भित्र *x = 100;, change(&n) ले बोलाएर।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The ampersands send the addresses of a and b, and the stars inside the function reach back to those addresses. t keeps the value at x, which is 5; then *x = *y writes 9 into a; then *y = t writes 5 into b. Nothing is returned and nothing needs to be, because the function wrote directly into main's memory. Remove the two ampersands and the two stars and the same program would print 5 9.
items.ne: Ampersand ले a र b का ठेगाना पठाउँछन्, र function भित्रका star ले ती ठेगानासम्म पुग्छन्। t ले x को ठेगानाको मान — 5 — राख्छ; अनि *x = *y ले a मा 9 लेख्छ; अनि *y = t ले b मा 5 लेख्छ। केही फर्काइँदैन र चाहिँदैन पनि, किनभने function ले सिधै main को मेमोरीमा लेख्यो। दुई ampersand र दुई star हटाए उही प्रोग्रामले 5 9 छाप्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A library function comes with the compiler already written and already compiled; you include its header and call it. strlen lives in string.h, as strcpy, strcat and strcmp do. printf and scanf need stdio.h, and sqrt and pow need math.h. larger and swap are names a programmer chooses, which makes them user-defined, and main is the function the program starts from rather than a library one.
items.ne: Library function compiler सँगै पहिल्यै लेखिएर compile भइसकेको आउँछ; तपाईंले header include गरेर बोलाउनुहुन्छ। strlen string.h मा छ, strcpy, strcat र strcmp जस्तै। printf र scanf लाई stdio.h, sqrt र pow लाई math.h चाहिन्छ। larger र swap प्रोग्रामरले छानेका नाम हुन् — त्यसैले ती user-defined हुन् — र main प्रोग्राम सुरु हुने function हो, library को होइन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The base case is the condition under which the function returns an answer WITHOUT calling itself, and it is the only thing that ends the recursion. Without it every call makes another call. Each unfinished call occupies memory on the stack, so this is not a quiet infinite loop — the stack runs out and the program stops with a stack overflow. That is a different failure from an endless while loop, and knowing which one you get is the point of the question.
items.ne: Base case भनेको function ले आफैंलाई नबोलाई उत्तर फर्काउने सर्त हो, र recursion सिध्याउने एकमात्र कुरा त्यही हो। त्यो नभए हरेक call ले अर्को call गर्छ। हरेक अधुरो call ले stack मा मेमोरी ओगट्छ, त्यसैले यो चुपचापको अनन्त loop होइन — stack सकिन्छ र प्रोग्राम stack overflow भएर रोकिन्छ। अनन्त while loop भन्दा यो फरक असफलता हो, र कुन आउँछ थाहा पाउनु नै प्रश्नको उद्देश्य हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: This is factorial. f(4) calls f(3), which calls f(2), which calls f(1); f(1) hits the base case and returns 1 without calling again. That is four calls in all. The multiplications then happen on the way back: 2 x 1 = 2, 3 x 2 = 6, 4 x 6 = 24. Every multiplication waits until the innermost call has returned, which is why four unfinished calls exist on the stack at the same moment.
items.ne: यो factorial हो। f(4) ले f(3) बोलाउँछ, त्यसले f(2), त्यसले f(1); f(1) base case मा पुगेर फेरि नबोलाई 1 फर्काउँछ। जम्मा चार call भए। गुणन फर्कंदा हुन्छ: 2 x 1 = 2, 3 x 2 = 6, 4 x 6 = 24। हरेक गुणन सबैभन्दा भित्रको call नफर्कंदासम्म पर्खन्छ — त्यसैले एकै क्षणमा stack मा चार अधुरा call हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: void means "nothing here". In front of the name it is the return type, saying no value comes back — so the call cannot be used on the right of an assignment. Inside the brackets it is the parameter list, saying nothing goes in. A function that prints a line of stars is the usual example: it needs no input and produces no value, only an effect on the screen.
items.ne: void को अर्थ "यहाँ केही छैन" हो। नाम अगाडि यो return प्रकार हो — कुनै मान फर्कंदैन भन्छ, त्यसैले call लाई assignment को दायाँपट्टि राख्न मिल्दैन। कोष्ठकभित्र यो parameter सूची हो — केही भित्र जाँदैन भन्छ। ताराको लाइन छाप्ने function सामान्य उदाहरण हो: यसलाई input चाहिँदैन र मान दिँदैन, पर्दामा असर मात्र पार्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A function takes any number of arguments and returns at most one value. That asymmetry is not a detail of syntax — it is the whole reason call by reference exists. A function that must give back two answers, such as a swap, sends them out through pointers instead, by writing into the caller's memory rather than returning anything at all.
items.ne: Function ले जति पनि argument लिन्छ र बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ। यो असमानता syntax को सानो कुरा होइन — call by reference हुनुको पूरै कारण त्यही हो। swap जस्तो दुई उत्तर फर्काउनुपर्ने function ले केही नफर्काई बोलाउनेको मेमोरीमै लेखेर pointer मार्फत ती बाहिर पठाउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The argument is what you send at the call, so a and b are the arguments. The parameter is the variable in the function heading that receives it, so x and y are the parameters. The names do not have to match and usually do not — the connection is made by position, first argument into first parameter, which is also why passing them in the wrong order is a bug no compiler will catch.
items.ne: Argument भनेको call मा पठाइने कुरा हो, त्यसैले a र b argument हुन्। Parameter भनेको function को शीर्षकमा त्यो पाउने variable हो, त्यसैले x र y parameter हुन्। नाम मिल्नै पर्दैन र प्रायः मिल्दैन पनि — जोडाइ स्थानले हुन्छ, पहिलो argument पहिलो parameter मा। त्यसैले क्रम उल्टो पठाउनु compiler ले नसमात्ने गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Reusability is the first advantage of functions, and the cost of not having it is maintenance rather than speed. Four copies means four places to change, and the one that gets missed is a bug that appears only in that part of the program. A function also makes the code shorter and easier to read and test, and its name documents what the ten lines were for — which a copy does not.
items.ne: Function को पहिलो फाइदा पुनःप्रयोग हो, र त्यो नहुँदाको लागत गति होइन, मर्मत हो। चार प्रतिलिपि भनेको सच्याउने चार ठाउँ, र छुट्ने त्यो एउटा प्रोग्रामको त्यही भागमा मात्र देखिने bug बन्छ। Function ले कोड छोटो, पढ्न र जाँच्न सजिलो पनि बनाउँछ, र यसको नामले ती दस लाइन केका लागि थिए भन्छ — प्रतिलिपिले भन्दैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An array name used on its own is the address of its first element, so passing marks passes an address and the function works on the caller's array. No ampersand is written because none is needed — the array is already what & would have produced. This is the exception students find surprising, and it is the reason a sorting function changes the list in main without returning anything.
items.ne: Array को नाम एक्लै प्रयोग गर्दा त्यो पहिलो element को ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले marks पठाउनु ठेगाना पठाउनु हो र function ले बोलाउनेकै array मा काम गर्छ। Ampersand नलेखिनुको कारण चाहिँदैन भन्ने हो — & ले बनाउने कुरा array आफैं भइसक्यो। विद्यार्थीलाई अचम्म लाग्ने अपवाद यही हो, र क्रम मिलाउने function ले केही नफर्काई main को सूची बदल्नुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Declaration, definition or call?
items.ne: Declaration, definition कि call?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A function appears three times in a well-written C program and each appearance has its own name and its own job. The punctuation at the end is the quickest clue: a semicolon, a brace, or a result being used.
items.ne: राम्ररी लेखिएको C प्रोग्राममा function तीन पटक देखिन्छ र हरेक पटकको आफ्नै नाम र आफ्नै काम हुन्छ। अन्त्यको चिन्ह सबैभन्दा छिटो सुराक हो: semicolon, brace, कि नतिजा प्रयोग भएको।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Call by value or call by reference?
items.ne: Call by value कि call by reference?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The question is never what the function prints — it is whether the ORIGINAL variable in main has changed after the call returns. Look for the ampersand at the call and the star in the parameter list.
items.ne: प्रश्न function ले के छाप्यो भन्ने होइन — call फर्केपछि main को मूल variable बदलियो कि बदलिएन भन्ने हो। Call मा ampersand र parameter सूचीमा star खोज्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A line that names the return type and the parameters and then ends in a semicolon is a prototype. It promises the compiler that this function exists somewhere, so a call can be checked before the body is read.
items.ne: Return type र parameter को नाम लिएर semicolon मा सकिने लाइन prototype हो। यसले compiler लाई यो function कतै छ भन्ने वाचा दिन्छ, त्यसैले body पढ्नुअघि नै call जाँच्न मिल्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The same heading with a body in braces is the definition, and it is where the work actually happens. There is no semicolon after the closing brace, which is the detail most often got wrong in a written answer.
items.ne: उही शीर्षकसँग brace भित्र body भए definition हो, र काम वास्तवमा यहीँ हुन्छ। बन्द गर्ने brace पछि semicolon हुँदैन, र लिखित उत्तरमा प्रायः यही कुरा बिग्रन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Arguments with real values inside the brackets, and a result being stored, means the function is being used rather than described. This is the only one of the three that actually makes the body run.
items.ne: कोष्ठकभित्र वास्तविक मान र नतिजा कतै भण्डारण भएको देखिए function वर्णन होइन प्रयोग भइरहेको छ। तीनमध्ये body साँच्चै चलाउने एकमात्र यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A library function is used exactly as your own is, so this is a call. Its declaration is in stdio.h and its definition is already compiled inside the library, which is why neither one appears in your file.
items.ne: Library function आफ्नै जस्तै प्रयोग हुन्छ, त्यसैले यो call हो। यसको declaration stdio.h मा छ र definition पहिल्यै library भित्र compile भइसकेको छ — त्यसैले दुवै तपाईंको फाइलमा देखिँदैनन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Braces with statements inside make it a definition even though it takes nothing and returns nothing. void in front says no value comes back, and void inside the brackets says no argument goes in.
items.ne: केही नलिने र केही नफर्काउने भए पनि brace भित्र statement भएकाले यो definition हो। अगाडिको void ले मान फर्किँदैन भन्छ, कोष्ठकभित्रको void ले कुनै argument जाँदैन भन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A copy of n is made and the function changes the copy, so n in main still holds whatever it held before. This is the default in C and the reason a swap function written this way does nothing at all.
items.ne: n को प्रतिलिपि बन्छ र function ले प्रतिलिपि मात्र बदल्छ, त्यसैले main को n जस्ताको तस्तै रहन्छ। C मा पूर्वनिर्धारित यही हो, र यसरी लेखिएको swap function ले केही नगर्नुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The ampersand sends the address of n and the star inside reaches back to that address, so the original really changes. Both halves are needed: an address passed in, and a dereference used on it.
items.ne: Ampersand ले n को ठेगाना पठाउँछ र भित्रको star ले त्यही ठेगानासम्म पुग्छ, त्यसैले मूल variable साँच्चै बदलिन्छ। दुवै भाग चाहिन्छ: ठेगाना पठाउनु, र त्यसमाथि dereference गर्नु।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A value goes in, a value comes back through return, and nothing in main is modified in place. Returning a result is the ordinary way to get an answer out, and it does not make the call by reference.
items.ne: मान भित्र जान्छ, return मार्फत मान फर्कन्छ, र main मा कुनै variable ठाउँमै बदलिँदैन। नतिजा return गर्नु उत्तर बाहिर ल्याउने सामान्य तरिका हो, र यसले call लाई by reference बनाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An array name is already an address, so no ampersand is written and the function still changes the caller array. This is the exception students find surprising, and it is why arrays are never copied into a function.
items.ne: Array को नाम आफैंमा ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले ampersand नलेखे पनि function ले बोलाउनेको array बदल्छ। विद्यार्थीलाई अचम्म लाग्ने अपवाद यही हो, र array कहिल्यै function भित्र प्रतिलिपि नहुनुको कारण पनि यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.1 What a function is — Function भनेको के हो
items.en: Where the program is while a function runs. main stops at the call and waits; the returned value arrives back at the same line it left from.
items.ne: Function चल्दै गर्दा प्रोग्राम कहाँ हुन्छ। main call मा रोकिएर पर्खन्छ; फर्केको मान जहाँबाट गएको थियो त्यही लाइनमै आइपुग्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: The same swap twice. On the left the function owns two copies at different addresses; on the right it owns two addresses that point back into main.
items.ne: उही swap, दुई पटक। बायाँपट्टि function सँग फरक ठेगानाका दुई प्रतिलिपि छन्; दायाँपट्टि main तिरै देखाउने दुई ठेगाना छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: List the advantages of using functions, with a reason for each.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: function भनेको के हो र प्रोग्रामलाई किन यिनमा बाँडिन्छ भन्न, declaration, definition र call लेख्न अनि चिन्ह हेरेर कुन हो भन्न, library र user-defined function छुट्याउन र हरेक library function लाई कुन header चाहिन्छ भन्न, call by value र call by reference बुझाउन र बोलाउनेको variable बदलिन्छ कि बदलिँदैन अनुमान गर्न, recursive function ट्रेस गरेर यसको base case नाम लिन, र function प्रयोग गर्नुका फाइदा कारणसहित भन्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.2 Declaration, definition and calling — घोषणा, परिभाषा र call
items.en: Decide what the function should RETURN before you open this — the larger number, or nothing at all with the printing done inside? Both work; only one of them can be reused.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि function ले के RETURN गर्नुपर्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस् — ठूलो सङ्ख्या, कि भित्रै छापेर केही पनि होइन? दुवै चल्छन्; फेरि प्रयोग गर्न मिल्ने चाहिँ एउटै हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.2 Declaration, definition and calling — घोषणा, परिभाषा र call
items.en: Returning the value rather than printing inside the function is what makes larger reusable: the caller decides whether to print it, store it or compare it again. Note also that the second return needs no else — if the first one runs, the function has already ended.
items.ne: Function भित्रै नछापी मान return गर्नुले larger लाई पुनःप्रयोगयोग्य बनाउँछ: छाप्ने, राख्ने कि फेरि तुलना गर्ने भन्ने बोलाउनेले निर्णय गर्छ। अर्को कुरा — दोस्रो return लाई else चाहिँदैन; पहिलो चल्यो भने function त्यहीँ सकिइसक्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: This is why call by reference exists. "A function returns at most one value" is not a limitation you work around — it is the fact that makes pointers necessary.
items.ne: एउटा return ले फर्कन्छ; अर्को pointer मार्फत लेखिन्छ। int divide(int a, int b, int *rem) { *rem = a % b; return a / b; } लाई q = divide(17, 5, &r); ले बोलाउँदा q ३ र r २ हुन्छ। विकल्प (क) C होइन। return q, r; compile त हुन्छ — comma operator ले q मूल्याङ्कन गरेर फाल्छ र r फर्काउँछ — त्यसैले function ले चुपचाप शेष मात्र फर्काउँछ। Compile हुने गलत उत्तर नहुने भन्दा नराम्रो हो। विकल्प (ख) चल्छ तर भाग दुई पटक गर्छ; यति सानो कुरामा लागत छैन, तर (ग) रोज्नुको कारण दुवै उत्तर एउटै गणनाबाट आउँछन् र सँगै निस्कनुपर्छ भन्ने हो। Call by reference हुनुको कारण यही हो। "Function ले बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ" भन्ने कुरा पन्छाउने बाधा होइन — pointer लाई अनिवार्य बनाउने तथ्य त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: Write the three output lines in the order they appear. The question is not what square does — it is where main is while square is running.
items.ne: तीन output लाइन देखिने क्रममा लेख्नुहोस्। प्रश्न square ले के गर्छ भन्ने होइन — square चल्दै गर्दा main कहाँ हुन्छ भन्ने हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: main is suspended exactly once, and the line r = square(4); is not finished until the return arrives — the assignment happens after the function has ended, not before it starts. That ordering is what "a call is a round trip" means, and it is why "after" cannot be printed in the middle.
items.ne: main ठ्याक्कै एक पटक रोकिन्छ, र r = square(4); लाइन return नआएसम्म सकिँदैन — assignment function सकिएपछि हुन्छ, सुरु हुनुअघि होइन। "Call भनेको आउने–जाने यात्रा हो" भन्नुको अर्थ त्यही क्रम हो, र "after" बीचमा छापिन नसक्नुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: Calling a library function without its header. sqrt without math.h is an error, not a warning you can ignore.
items.ne: Definition को बन्द brace पछि semicolon: prototype लाई चाहिन्छ, definition लाई चाहिँदैन। Call by value ले बोलाउनेको variable बदल्छ भन्ठान्नु: सक्दैन; & र * खोज्नुहोस्। Base case नभएको recursive function: यो अनन्त loop होइन, crash हो। Argument र parameter मिसाउनु: argument call मा, parameter definition मा। दुई मान return गर्न खोज्नु: बढीमा एउटा; दोस्रोका लागि pointer। Header नराखी library function बोलाउनु: math.h विनाको sqrt बेवास्ता गर्न मिल्ने चेतावनी होइन, त्रुटि हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 4. Neither can be done from this site — both need a C compiler on a real computer. The steppers above show what happens inside a call; they compile nothing.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ४ को सूचीबाट। दुवै यस साइटबाट गर्न मिल्दैन — दुवैलाई साँच्चैको कम्प्युटरमा C compiler चाहिन्छ। माथिका stepper ले call भित्र के हुन्छ देखाउँछन्; केही compile गर्दैनन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 4.2, 4.3 and 4.4. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: a function returning the larger of two numbers; a void function that prints a line of stars; a function returning the area of a circle; and a swap written twice — once by value and once by reference. Observe and record: print a and b in main after each version of the swap and write down both outputs. Having the two results side by side in your own record book is worth more than any explanation of them.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ४.२, ४.३ र ४.४। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: दुई सङ्ख्यामध्ये ठूलो फर्काउने function; ताराको लाइन छाप्ने void function; वृत्तको क्षेत्रफल फर्काउने function; अनि swap दुई पटक — एक पटक value बाट, एक पटक reference बाट। ध्यान दिएर लेख्ने: हरेक swap पछि main मा a र b छापेर दुवै output लेख्नुहोस्। आफ्नै अभिलेख पुस्तिकामा दुई नतिजा छेउछाउ हुनु तिनको जुनसुकै व्याख्याभन्दा बढी काम लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 4.5. Hand in: the source file and your practical record. Suggested set: factorial of a number; sum of the first n natural numbers; the n-th Fibonacci number. Then do this on purpose: delete the base case from your factorial program, run it, and record what happens. It will not hang quietly — it will stop with a crash, and knowing which failure a missing base case produces is the point of the activity.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ४.५। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: सङ्ख्याको factorial; पहिलो n प्राकृतिक सङ्ख्याको जोड; n-औं Fibonacci सङ्ख्या। अनि जानीजानी यो गर्नुहोस्: आफ्नो factorial प्रोग्रामबाट base case हटाएर चलाउनुहोस् र के हुन्छ लेख्नुहोस्। यो चुपचाप अड्किँदैन — crash भएर रोकिन्छ, र base case छुट्दा कुन किसिमको असफलता आउँछ थाहा पाउनु नै क्रियाकलापको उद्देश्य हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: This unit carries 10 of the 50 external marks and 12 of the 64 theory hours. The long question is almost always call by value against call by reference, with a swap program to write or trace. Shorter questions ask for the advantages of functions, the difference between a library and a user-defined function, the parts of a function, or what recursion is and what its base case is for.
items.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये १० अंक र ६४ मध्ये १२ घण्टा ओगट्छ। लामो प्रश्न झन्डै सधैं call by value र call by reference कै हुन्छ, र swap प्रोग्राम लेख्न वा ट्रेस गर्न भनिन्छ। छोटा प्रश्नले function का फाइदा, library र user-defined function को फरक, function का भाग, वा recursion भनेको के र base case किन चाहिन्छ सोध्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Advantages (any two): reusability — written once and called many times; readability — a long program becomes a short list of named steps; easier debugging — a fault is isolated to one function; division of work — several people can write different functions at once.
items.ne: Function भनेको नाम भएको, आफैंमा पूरा statement को खण्ड हो, जसले निश्चित काम गर्छ र प्रोग्रामको जहाँबाट पनि बोलाउन सकिन्छ। यसले argument लिन सक्छ र बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ। फाइदा (कुनै दुई): पुनःप्रयोग, पढ्न सजिलो, सच्याउन सजिलो, कामको बाँडफाँट।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Marks: the base case, the recursive call with n - 1 moving towards it, and a correct prototype. Including n == 0 is worth a mark of its own, because 0! is defined as 1 and a base case of n == 1 alone would recurse forever on an input of 0.
items.ne: अंक: base case, base case तिर सर्ने n - 1 सहितको recursive call, र सही prototype। n == 0 समेट्नुको आफ्नै अंक छ, किनभने 0! लाई १ मानिन्छ र n == 1 मात्रको base case भए input ० मा सधैं recurse भइरहन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: The differences, in a line each. What is passed: a copy, against an address. What the function can change: nothing outside itself, against the caller's variables. Memory: two extra variables, against two pointers. Safety: cannot damage the caller, against can. Use it when: the function only needs to read, against the function must change the caller's data or return more than one answer.
items.ne: Call by value: हरेक argument को प्रतिलिपि जान्छ; function प्रतिलिपिमै काम गर्छ, त्यसैले बोलाउनेका variable नबदलिने। C मा पूर्वनिर्धारित र सुरक्षित। Call by reference: ठेगाना जान्छ — call मा &, parameter मा *; function ले बोलाउनेको मेमोरीसम्म पुगेर मूल variable बदल्छ। फरक: के पठाइन्छ — प्रतिलिपि कि ठेगाना। Function ले के बदल्न सक्छ — आफूबाहिर केही होइन, कि बोलाउनेका variable। सुरक्षा — बिगार्न नसक्ने कि सक्ने। कहिले चलाउने — function ले पढ्ने मात्र भए पहिलो, बोलाउनेको data बदल्नुपर्ने वा एकभन्दा बढी उत्तर चाहिने भए दोस्रो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: A function returns at most one value; pointers are how a second answer gets out.
items.ne: Function एउटा काम गर्ने, नाम भएको खण्ड हो; main पनि, printf पनि। Declaration semicolon ले सकिन्छ, definition सँग body हुन्छ र semicolon हुँदैन, call मा वास्तविक मान हुन्छन्। Argument call मा, parameter definition मा। Library function compiler सँगै आउँछ र header चाहिन्छ; user-defined तपाईंले लेख्नुहुन्छ। Call by value ले प्रतिलिपि बनाउँछ — बोलाउनेको बदलिँदैन। Call by reference ले & र * सहित ठेगाना पठाउँछ — बोलाउनेको बदलिन्छ। Array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले function लाई सधैं साँच्चैको array पुग्छ। Recursive function लाई base case चाहिन्छ, नत्र stack overflow हुन्छ। Function ले बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ; दोस्रो उत्तर pointer ले बाहिर निस्कन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Decide whether a function changed the CALLER's variable, not what it printed
items.ne: Function ले के छाप्यो होइन, बोलाउनेको variable बदल्यो कि बदलेन निर्णय गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Look for TWO things together: an & at the call, and a * in the parameter list. Both present means the function holds the caller's address and can write there. Either one missing means a copy was passed and the original is safe. An array is the exception: its name is already an address, so no & is written and the real array still goes in.
items.ne: दुई कुरा सँगै खोज्नुहोस्: call मा &, र parameter सूचीमा *। दुवै भए function सँग बोलाउनेको ठेगाना छ र त्यहाँ लेख्न सक्छ। एउटा छुटे प्रतिलिपि गएको हो र मूल variable सुरक्षित छ। Array अपवाद हो: यसको नाम आफैं ठेगाना भएकाले & नलेखे पनि साँच्चैको array नै भित्र जान्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: void swap(int x, int y) { int t = x; x = y; y = t; }  int a = 5, b = 9; swap(a, b);  What is a afterwards?
items.ne: void swap(int x, int y) { int t = x; x = y; y = t; }  int a = 5, b = 9; swap(a, b);  पछि a कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Is there an & at the call? Answer yes or no
items.ne: Call मा & छ? yes वा no

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: swap(a, b) sends the values 5 and 9, not addresses. So C makes copies and the function is given the copies.
items.ne: swap(a, b) ले ठेगाना होइन, ५ र ९ मान पठाउँछ। त्यसैले C ले प्रतिलिपि बनाएर function लाई ती दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Inside the function, what is x after the three lines run?
items.ne: Function भित्र तीन लाइन चलेपछि x कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The swap works perfectly — on the copies. t holds 5, x takes y which is 9, y takes t. Everything inside the function is correct.
items.ne: Swap ठिकै चल्छ — प्रतिलिपिमा। t सँग ५, x ले y अर्थात् ९ लिन्छ, y ले t। Function भित्रको सबै कुरा सही छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So what is a in main after the call?
items.ne: त्यसो भए call पछि main को a कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: a is still 5. The copies were swapped and then destroyed when the function ended. Nothing was returned and nothing in main was ever reached.
items.ne: a अझै ५ छ। प्रतिलिपि साटिए र function सकिँदा नष्ट भए। केही फर्काइएन र main को केहीसम्म पुगिएन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: void swap(int *x, int *y) { int t = *x; *x = *y; *y = t; }  int a = 5, b = 9; swap(&a, &b);  What is a afterwards?
items.ne: void swap(int *x, int *y) { int t = *x; *x = *y; *y = t; }  int a = 5, b = 9; swap(&a, &b);  पछि a कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What does &a send into the function — a value or an address?
items.ne: &a ले function भित्र के पठाउँछ — मान कि ठेगाना?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The ampersand is the address-of operator, so what is copied into x is a's address rather than a's value. A copy of an address still points at the original.
items.ne: & address-of operator हो, त्यसैले x मा a को मान होइन, a को ठेगाना सर्छ। ठेगानाको प्रतिलिपिले पनि मूल ठाउँ नै देखाउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The line *x = *y writes into which variable in main?
items.ne: *x = *y लाइनले main को कुन variable मा लेख्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: x holds a's address, so *x means "the value at a's address", which is a itself. The function is writing into main's memory.
items.ne: x सँग a को ठेगाना छ, त्यसैले *x को अर्थ "a को ठेगानाको मान" — अर्थात् a आफैं। Function ले main कै मेमोरीमा लेखिरहेको छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So what is a in main after the call?
items.ne: त्यसो भए call पछि main को a कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: a is 9 and b is 5. Two ampersands at the call and two stars in the function are the whole difference from the previous program, which changed nothing.
items.ne: a ९ र b ५ हुन्छ। call का दुई ampersand र function का दुई star — केही नबदल्ने अघिल्लो प्रोग्रामसँगको पूरै फरक यति नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: void twice(int *x) { *x = *x * 2; }  int n = 6; twice(&n);  What is n afterwards?
items.ne: void twice(int *x) { *x = *x * 2; }  int n = 6; twice(&n);  पछि n कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What does *x stand for on the right-hand side? Answer 6 or 12
items.ne: दायाँपट्टि *x ले केलाई जनाउँछ? ६ कि १२?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The right side is worked out first, using the value n holds at that moment, which is 6. Only then is the result stored back.
items.ne: पहिले दायाँको गणना हुन्छ, र त्यति बेला n मा भएको मान — ६ — प्रयोग हुन्छ। नतिजा त्यसपछि मात्र फर्केर भण्डारण हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is n after the call?
items.ne: Call पछि n कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: *x = *x * 2 is n = n * 2 written through a pointer, so n becomes 12. No value was returned and none was needed.
items.ne: *x = *x * 2 भनेको pointer मार्फत लेखिएको n = n * 2 हो, त्यसैले n १२ हुन्छ। कुनै मान फर्काइएन र चाहिएन पनि।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: void add(int x) { x = x + 1; }  int n = 7; add(n); printf("%d", n);  What is printed?
items.ne: void add(int x) { x = x + 1; }  int n = 7; add(n); printf("%d", n);  के छापिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is printed?
items.ne: के छापिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: No ampersand at the call and no star in the parameter list, so a copy was passed. The copy became 8 and was then destroyed; n never changed and 7 is printed.
items.ne: Call मा ampersand छैन र parameter सूचीमा star छैन, त्यसैले प्रतिलिपि पठाइयो। प्रतिलिपि ८ भएर नष्ट भयो; n कहिल्यै बदलिएन र ७ छापिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A sorting function receives a list of marks written as fill(marks, 5), with no ampersand anywhere. Back in main, is the list now in order? Answer yes or no.
items.ne: क्रम मिलाउने function लाई अंकको सूची fill(marks, 5) ले पठाइएको छ, कतै ampersand छैन। main मा फर्कंदा सूची मिलेको हुन्छ? yes वा no।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Is the caller's list sorted? yes or no
items.ne: बोलाउनेको सूची मिलेको हुन्छ? yes कि no

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Yes, and the rule about looking for an ampersand is what has moved. An array name used on its own already IS the address of its first element, so no ampersand is written because none is needed, and the function receives the real array rather than a copy of it. This is the one exception to everything above, and it is why a sorting function changes the caller's list without returning anything at all.
items.ne: हुन्छ, र ampersand खोज्ने नियम नै यहाँ सरेको छ। Array को नाम एक्लै प्रयोग गर्दा त्यो पहिलो element को ठेगाना नै हो, त्यसैले ampersand नचाहिने भएर नलेखिएको हो, र function लाई प्रतिलिपि होइन साँच्चैको array पुग्छ। माथिका सबै कुराको एकमात्र अपवाद यही हो, र क्रम मिलाउने function ले केही नफर्काई बोलाउनेको सूची बदल्नुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.2 Declaration, definition and calling — घोषणा, परिभाषा र call
items.en: Read the end of the line first. Semicolon after the brackets means a prototype; an opening brace means the definition; real values inside the brackets mean a call.
items.ne: पहिले लाइनको अन्त्य पढ्नुहोस्। कोष्ठकपछि semicolon भए prototype; खुल्ने brace भए definition; कोष्ठकभित्र वास्तविक मान भए call।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: Before the last step, predict what the printf will show. The surprise is that everything inside the function was correct.
items.ne: अन्तिम चरणअघि printf ले के देखाउँछ अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। अचम्म यही हो — function भित्रको सबै कुरा ठिकै थियो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: Watch the row for a in main. It changes on a line written inside swap, which is the whole idea, and it is the moment worth pausing on.
items.ne: main को a को पङ्क्ति हेर्नुहोस्। swap भित्र लेखिएको लाइनले त्यो बदल्छ — पूरै विचार त्यही हो, र रोकिएर हेर्नुपर्ने क्षण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: Look for two things together: an & at the call and a * in the parameter list. One without the other is not call by reference. Arrays are the one exception — the name is already an address.
items.ne: दुई कुरा सँगै खोज्नुहोस्: call मा & र parameter सूचीमा *। एउटा मात्र भए त्यो call by reference होइन। Array एक मात्र अपवाद हो — नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Watch the call stack grow to four and then empty. Ask at each step: has any multiplication happened yet? The answer is no until the base case returns.
items.ne: Call stack चारसम्म बढेर अनि खाली भएको हेर्नुहोस्। हरेक चरणमा सोध्नुहोस्: कुनै गुणन भयो? Base case नफर्कंदासम्म जवाफ होइन हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.1 What a function is — Function भनेको के हो
items.en: A named block of code that does one job A function is a named, self-contained block of statements that performs a particular task and can be called from anywhere in the program. You have been using one since Unit 2 without naming it: main() is a function, and so are printf and scanf. A C program is nothing but functions — which is why C is called a structured language. Three words the examination separates carefully: an argument is the value you send at the call — larger(a, b); a parameter is the variable that receives it — int x, int y; the return value is the single answer sent back. A function takes any number of arguments and returns at most one value. That asymmetry is not an accident of syntax — it is the reason 4.4 exists.
items.ne: एउटा काम गर्ने, नाम भएको कोडको खण्ड Function भनेको नाम भएको, आफैंमा पूरा statement को खण्ड हो, जसले कुनै निश्चित काम गर्छ र प्रोग्रामको जहाँबाट पनि बोलाउन सकिन्छ। युनिट २ देखि नै तपाईंले नाम नलिई यो चलाइरहनुभएको छ: main() function हो, र printf अनि scanf पनि। C प्रोग्राम function बाहेक केही होइन — त्यसैले C लाई structured भाषा भनिन्छ। परीक्षाले ध्यान दिएर छुट्याउने तीन शब्द: argument भनेको call मा पठाइने मान — larger(a, b); parameter भनेको त्यो पाउने variable — int x, int y; return value भनेको फर्काइने एउटै उत्तर। Function ले जति पनि argument लिन्छ र बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ। यो असमानता syntax को संयोग होइन — ४.४ हुनुको कारण त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.2 Declaration, definition and calling — घोषणा, परिभाषा र call
items.en: One function, three appearances Declaration (prototype) — tells the compiler the function's name, what it returns and what it takes, so a call can be checked before the body is read. It ends with a semicolon and is written above main. Definition — the same heading with the body in braces. This is where the work is. There is no semicolon after the closing brace. Call — the name with real values in the brackets, inside another function. This is the only one of the three that makes anything happen. If the definition is written above main, the declaration may be left out — the definition has already told the compiler everything. Writing the prototype anyway is the habit to form, because real programs put definitions in a different file.
items.ne: एउटै function, तीन पटक देखिने Declaration (prototype) — compiler लाई function को नाम, के फर्काउँछ र के लिन्छ भन्छ, ताकि body पढ्नुअघि नै call जाँच्न सकियोस्। यो semicolon ले सकिन्छ र main माथि लेखिन्छ। Definition — उही शीर्षक र brace भित्र body। काम यहीँ हुन्छ। बन्द गर्ने brace पछि semicolon हुँदैन। Call — अर्को function भित्र, कोष्ठकमा वास्तविक मान राखेर नाम लेख्नु। तीनमध्ये केही गराउने एकमात्र यही हो। Definition main माथि लेखिएको छ भने declaration छाड्न मिल्छ — definition ले compiler लाई सबै भनिसक्यो। तैपनि prototype लेख्ने बानी बसाल्नुहोस्, किनभने वास्तविक प्रोग्राममा definition अर्कै फाइलमा हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.3 Types of function — library and user-defined — Function का प्रकार — library र user-defined
items.en: Written for you, or written by you A library function comes with the compiler, already written and already compiled. You do not define it; you include its header and call it. printf and scanf need stdio.h; strlen and strcpy need string.h; sqrt and pow need math.h. A user-defined function is one you write yourself, because no library function does your particular job — larger above, or a function that computes a student's division from their marks. By what crosses the boundary, a user-defined function is one of four shapes, and the examination sometimes asks for all four: no arguments, no return value — void greet(void) arguments, no return value — void show(int n) no arguments, a return value — int readNumber(void) arguments and a return value — int larger(int x, int y) void means "nothing here". In front of the name it says no value comes back; inside the brackets it says no argument goes in.
items.ne: तपाईंका लागि लेखिएको, कि तपाईंले लेखेको Library function compiler सँगै आउँछ — पहिल्यै लेखिएको र compile भइसकेको। तपाईंले define गर्नुहुन्न; यसको header include गरेर बोलाउनुहुन्छ। printf र scanf लाई stdio.h; strlen र strcpy लाई string.h; sqrt र pow लाई math.h चाहिन्छ। User-defined function भनेको तपाईं आफैंले लेख्ने हो, किनभने तपाईंको त्यो विशेष काम कुनै library function ले गर्दैन — माथिको larger, वा अंकबाट विद्यार्थीको श्रेणी निकाल्ने function। सिमाना के–के नाघ्छ भन्ने आधारमा user-defined function चार आकारमध्ये एक हुन्छ, र परीक्षाले कहिलेकाहीं चारै सोध्छ: argument छैन, return पनि छैन — void greet(void) argument छ, return छैन — void show(int n) argument छैन, return छ — int readNumber(void) argument पनि छ, return पनि — int larger(int x, int y) void को अर्थ "यहाँ केही छैन" हो। नाम अगाडि भए कुनै मान फर्कंदैन भन्छ; कोष्ठकभित्र भए कुनै argument जाँदैन भन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: The most-asked question in this unit In call by value, a copy of each argument is made and handed to the function. The function works on the copies, so the caller's variables cannot change. This is what C does by default, and it is safe: a function cannot damage something it was only shown. In call by reference, the address of each argument is sent instead, using & at the call and * in the parameter list. The function can then reach back into the caller's memory, so the originals do change. Strictly, C has only call by value — what is copied in the second case is the address, not the variable. The effect is call by reference and that is the name the syllabus and the examination use, so use it; but knowing that a pointer is itself passed by value is what makes the mechanism make sense rather than being a rule. Why bother? A function returns at most one value. A function that must change two variables — a swap — has no other way.
items.ne: यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा धेरै सोधिने प्रश्न Call by value मा हरेक argument को प्रतिलिपि बनाएर function लाई दिइन्छ। Function ले प्रतिलिपिमै काम गर्छ, त्यसैले बोलाउनेका variable बदलिन सक्दैनन्। C ले पूर्वनिर्धारित रूपमा यही गर्छ, र यो सुरक्षित छ: देखाइएको मात्र कुरालाई function ले बिगार्न सक्दैन। Call by reference मा हरेक argument को ठेगाना पठाइन्छ — call मा & र parameter सूचीमा * लेखेर। अनि function ले बोलाउनेको मेमोरीसम्म पुग्न सक्छ, त्यसैले मूल variable बदलिन्छन्। कडा अर्थमा C सँग call by value मात्र छ — दोस्रो अवस्थामा प्रतिलिपि बन्ने कुरा ठेगाना हो, variable होइन। असर चाहिँ call by reference कै हो र पाठ्यक्रम अनि परीक्षाले त्यही नाम चलाउँछन्, त्यसैले तपाईं पनि त्यही लेख्नुहोस्; तर pointer आफैं value बाट पठाइन्छ भन्ने थाहा पाउनुले यो नियम होइन, व्यवस्था हो भन्ने बुझाउँछ। किन चाहियो? Function ले बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ। दुई variable बदल्नुपर्ने function — swap — सँग अर्को उपाय छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A function that calls itself, and the line that stops it A recursive function is one that calls itself, directly or through another function. It is used where a problem is naturally defined in terms of a smaller version of itself: 4! is 4 × 3!, and 3! is 3 × 2!, and so on. Every recursive function needs two parts, and leaving out the first is the classic error: a base case — a condition under which it returns an answer without calling itself. For factorial that is if (n == 1) return 1; a recursive case — the call to itself, with an argument moving towards the base case. Without a base case the calls never stop. The program does not loop forever quietly: each call takes memory on the stack, the stack fills, and the program crashes with a stack overflow. Recursion versus a loop. Anything recursion can do, a loop can do. Recursion is often shorter and closer to the mathematical definition; a loop uses less memory, because it does not stack up unfinished calls. For factorial a loop is the better program and recursion is the better illustration, which is why the curriculum asks for it.
items.ne: आफैंलाई बोलाउने function, र त्यसलाई रोक्ने लाइन Recursive function भनेको सिधै वा अर्को function मार्फत आफैंलाई बोलाउने function हो। समस्या आफैंको सानो रूपमा परिभाषित हुने ठाउँमा यो चलाइन्छ: 4! भनेको 4 × 3! हो, र 3! भनेको 3 × 2!, यसरी नै। हरेक recursive function लाई दुई भाग चाहिन्छ, र पहिलो छुटाउनु नै उत्कृष्ट गल्ती हो: base case — जुन सर्तमा आफैंलाई नबोलाई उत्तर फर्काउँछ। Factorial मा if (n == 1) return 1; recursive case — आफैंलाई बोलाउने, र argument base case तिर सर्दै जाने। Base case नभए call कहिल्यै रोकिँदैनन्। प्रोग्राम चुपचाप सधैं चलिरहने होइन: हरेक call ले stack मा मेमोरी लिन्छ, stack भरिन्छ, र प्रोग्राम stack overflow भएर crash हुन्छ। Recursion कि loop। Recursion ले गर्न सक्ने सबै loop ले पनि गर्छ। Recursion प्रायः छोटो र गणितीय परिभाषासँग नजिक हुन्छ; loop ले कम मेमोरी खान्छ, किनभने अधुरा call थुपार्दैन। Factorial का लागि loop राम्रो प्रोग्राम हो र recursion राम्रो उदाहरण — त्यसैले पाठ्यक्रमले यो माग्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: Five reasons, each with the problem it solves Reusability — written once, called many times from anywhere in the program. Copying the same ten lines to four places means fixing a mistake in four places. Smaller, readable programs — a long main becomes a short list of named steps, and the name is documentation that cannot go out of date. Easier testing and debugging — a fault is located in one function instead of searched for across the whole file. Division of work — different people can write different functions at the same time, agreeing only on the prototypes. Abstraction — the caller needs to know what a function does, not how. You use printf daily and have never read it. The one cost worth naming: a call has a small overhead in time and stack memory. For Grade 9 programs it is far too small to matter, and clarity wins every time.
items.ne: पाँच कारण, हरेकसँग त्यसले समाधान गर्ने समस्या पुनःप्रयोग — एक पटक लेखेर प्रोग्रामको जहाँबाट पनि धेरै पटक बोलाउन मिल्छ। उही दस लाइन चार ठाउँमा सार्नु भनेको गल्ती चार ठाउँमा सच्याउनु हो। सानो, पढ्न सजिलो प्रोग्राम — लामो main नाम भएका चरणको छोटो सूची बन्छ, र नाम आफैं कहिल्यै पुरानो नहुने documentation हो। जाँच्न र सच्याउन सजिलो — त्रुटि पूरै फाइलमा खोज्नुभन्दा एउटै function मा भेटिन्छ। कामको बाँडफाँट — prototype मा मात्र सहमत भएर फरक मान्छेले फरक function एकैचोटि लेख्न सक्छन्। Abstraction — बोलाउनेलाई function ले के गर्छ थाहा हुनुपर्छ, कसरी गर्छ होइन। तपाईं दिनहुँ printf चलाउनुहुन्छ र कहिल्यै पढ्नुभएको छैन। नाम लिनै पर्ने एउटा लागत: हरेक call ले समय र stack मेमोरीमा सानो भार थप्छ। कक्षा ९ का प्रोग्रामका लागि त्यो नगण्य छ, र स्पष्टता सधैं जित्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: Memory hook — Value sends a photocopy; reference sends the address. No ampersand, no change.
items.ne: सम्झने तरिका — Value ले फोटोकपी पठाउँछ; reference ले ठेगाना। Ampersand छैन भने बदलाव पनि छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: What is a function? Write any two advantages of using functions.
items.ne: Function भनेको के हो? Function प्रयोग गर्नुका कुनै दुई फाइदा लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Write a C program to find the factorial of a number using a recursive function.
items.ne: Recursive function प्रयोग गरेर सङ्ख्याको factorial निकाल्ने C प्रोग्राम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Differentiate between call by value and call by reference with a suitable program for each.
items.ne: Call by value र call by reference को फरक, हरेकको उपयुक्त प्रोग्रामसहित लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.6 Advantages of functions — Function का फाइदा
items.en: A function must give back BOTH the quotient and the remainder of a division. How can it?
items.ne: कुनै function ले भागफल र शेष दुवै फर्काउनुपर्छ। कसरी सक्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A parameter is a variable with a type and a scope, and an argument is an expression evaluated at the call. Both are Unit 2 ideas wearing new names, and the names are what the examination asks you to tell apart.
items.ne: Parameter भनेको प्रकार र क्षेत्र भएको variable हो, र argument भनेको call मा मूल्याङ्कन हुने expression। दुवै युनिट २ कै विचार नयाँ नाममा छन्, र परीक्षाले छुट्याउन भन्ने ती नाम नै हुन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: return inside a function behaves like break inside a loop — it leaves early and nothing below it runs. A recursive function is also a repetition, and its base case is doing the job a loop condition does.
items.ne: Function भित्रको return loop भित्रको break जस्तै हो — चाँडै बाहिरिन्छ र तलको केही चल्दैन। Recursive function पनि दोहोरिने नै हो, र यसको base case ले loop को सर्तकै काम गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Call by value — the swap that does nothing
items.ne: Call by value — केही नगर्ने swap

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: main starts with a = 5 and b = 9. Keep your eye on these two rows: the whole question is whether they change.
items.ne: main सुरु हुँदा a = 5 र b = 9 छ। यी दुई पङ्क्तिमा नजर राख्नुहोस्: पूरै प्रश्न यी बदलिन्छन् कि बदलिँदैनन् भन्ने हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: swap is called. C makes COPIES of a and b and hands the copies over. The originals are not sent anywhere.
items.ne: swap बोलाइयो। C ले a र b का प्रतिलिपि बनाएर ती पठाउँछ। मूल variable कतै पठाइँदैनन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: x and y are brand new variables inside swap. They happen to hold the same values, and they live at different memory addresses from a and b.
items.ne: x र y swap भित्रका बिलकुल नयाँ variable हुन्। संयोगले मान उही छन्, तर तिनको मेमोरी ठेगाना a र b भन्दा फरक छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: t keeps a copy of x, because the next line is about to overwrite x and the value would otherwise be lost.
items.ne: t ले x को प्रतिलिपि राख्छ, किनभने अर्को लाइनले x मेट्न लागेको छ र नत्र त्यो मान हराउँथ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: x takes y. Inside this function the swap is working perfectly.
items.ne: x ले y को मान लिन्छ। यस function भित्र swap ठिकै चलिरहेको छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: y takes the saved value from t. x and y are now swapped — and a and b have not moved at all.
items.ne: y ले t मा राखिएको मान लिन्छ। x र y अब साटिए — र a अनि b टसमस भएका छैनन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: swap ends. x, y and t are destroyed, taking the swapped values with them. Nothing was returned and nothing in main was touched.
items.ne: swap सकियो। x, y र t नष्ट हुन्छन् र साटिएका मान पनि सँगै जान्छन्। केही फर्काइएन र main को केही छोइएन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The output proves it: a is still 5 and b is still 9. This is the single most common surprise in Unit 4, and the reason the next program exists.
items.ne: Output ले प्रमाणित गर्‍यो: a अझै 5 र b अझै 9 छ। युनिट ४ को सबैभन्दा ठूलो अचम्म यही हो, र अर्को प्रोग्राम हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Call by reference — the swap that works
items.ne: Call by reference — काम गर्ने swap

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The same starting point as before: a = 5, b = 9. Only two characters in this program are different from the one that failed.
items.ne: अघिकै सुरुवात: a = 5, b = 9। असफल भएको प्रोग्रामसँग यसको फरक दुई अक्षरको मात्र छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The ampersand means "the address of". What is handed over is not the value 5 but the place where 5 lives.
items.ne: Ampersand को अर्थ "को ठेगाना" हो। पठाइएको 5 भन्ने मान होइन, 5 बसेको ठाउँ हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: x and y are pointers. They are still copies — but they are copies of ADDRESSES, and a copy of an address still points at the original.
items.ne: x र y pointer हुन्। यी अझै प्रतिलिपि नै हुन् — तर ठेगानाका प्रतिलिपि, र ठेगानाको प्रतिलिपिले पनि मूल ठाउँ नै देखाउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: *x means "the value at the address in x", which is a in main. So t gets 5 — read out of main, not out of a local copy.
items.ne: *x को अर्थ "x मा भएको ठेगानाको मान" हो, र त्यो main को a हो। त्यसैले t ले 5 पाउँछ — स्थानीय प्रतिलिपिबाट होइन, main बाटै।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Watch the a row. *x = *y writes into main's a, from inside swap. This is the moment the program does what the previous one could not.
items.ne: a को पङ्क्ति हेर्नुहोस्। *x = *y ले swap भित्रबाटै main को a मा लेख्छ। अघिल्लो प्रोग्रामले गर्न नसकेको काम यहीँ भयो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: *y = t writes 5 into main's b. Both originals have now changed, and nothing has been returned.
items.ne: *y = t ले main को b मा 5 लेख्छ। दुवै मूल variable बदलिए, र केही फर्काइएको छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: swap ends and its own variables disappear, exactly as before. The difference is that the work was done somewhere that outlives the function.
items.ne: swap सकिन्छ र यसका आफ्नै variable अघिझैं हराउँछन्। फरक यति हो — काम function भन्दा लामो बाँच्ने ठाउँमा भएको थियो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Swapped. Two ampersands at the call and two stars in the function are the whole difference between this program and the last one.
items.ne: साटियो। Call मा दुई ampersand र function मा दुई star — अघिल्लो प्रोग्रामसँगको पूरै फरक यति नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Recursion — a function that calls itself
items.ne: Recursion — आफैंलाई बोलाउने function

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: main calls fact(4). Nothing can be printed until that call finishes, and it is about to take a while.
items.ne: main ले fact(4) बोलाउँछ। त्यो call नसकिएसम्म केही छाप्न सकिँदैन, र त्यसलाई केही समय लाग्नेछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: n is 4. The base case asks: is n equal to 1? No, so the function must call itself.

DECLARATION — note the semicolon */ int main() { int a, b, big; printf("Enter two numbers: "); scanf("%d %d", &a, &b); big = larger(a, b); /* 3. CALL — a and b are the ARGUMENTS */ printf("Larger = %d", big); return 0; } int larger(int x, int y) /* 2. DEFINITION — no semicolon here */ { if (x > y) return x; return y; /* reached only when x is not larger */ } Output (if the user types 12 and 8) Enter two numbers: 12 8 Larger = 12 Returning the value rather than printing inside the function is what makes larger reusable: the caller decides whether to print it, store it or compare it again. Note also that the second return needs no else — if the first one runs, the function has already ended. Function भित्रै नछापी मान return गर्नुले larger लाई पुनःप्रयोगयोग्य बनाउँछ: छाप्ने, राख्ने कि फेरि तुलना गर्ने भन्ने बोलाउनेले निर्णय गर्छ। अर्को कुरा — दोस्रो return लाई else चाहिँदैन; पहिलो चल्यो भने function त्यहीँ सकिइसक्यो। Practise the judgement

items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Declaration, definition or call? What you will learn: to name the three appearances of a function from the line alone. The punctuation at the end decides it — a semicolon, a brace, or a result being used. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: लाइन मात्र हेरेर function का तीन रूप नाम लिन। अन्त्यको चिन्हले निर्णय गर्छ — semicolon, brace, कि नतिजा प्रयोग भएको। How to use this Read the end of the line first. Semicolon after the brackets means a prototype; an opening brace means the definition; real values inside the brackets mean a call. पहिले लाइनको अन्त्य पढ्नुहोस्। कोष्ठकपछि semicolon भए prototype; खुल्ने brace भए definition; कोष्ठकभित्र वास्तविक मान भए call। 4.3 Types of function — library and user-defined

Ask at each step: has any multiplication happened yet? The answer is no until the base case returns. Call stack चारसम्म बढेर अनि खाली भएको हेर्नुहोस्। हरेक चरणमा सोध्नुहोस्: कुनै गुणन भयो?
