items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en:
· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A function must give back BOTH the quotient and the remainder of a division. How can it? कुनै function ले भागफल र शेष दुवै फर्काउनुपर्छ। कसरी सक्छ? Write return q, r; — C returns both values Call the function twice, once for each answer Return one and send the other out through a pointer parameter One comes back through return; the other is written through a pointer. int divide(int a, int b, int *rem) { *rem = a % b; return a / b; } called as q = divide(17, 5, &r); leaves q as 3 and r as 2. Option A is not C. return q, r; compiles — the comma operator evaluates q, throws it away, and returns r — so the function silently returns only the remainder. A wrong answer that compiles is worse than one that does not. Option B works and does the division twice. On this scale that costs nothing; the reason to prefer option C is that the two answers come from one calculation and should leave together. This is why call by reference exists. "A function returns at most one value" is not a limitation you work around — it is the fact that makes pointers necessary. एउटा return ले फर्कन्छ; अर्को pointer मार्फत लेखिन्छ। int divide(int a, int b, int *rem) { *rem = a % b; return a / b; } लाई q = divide(17, 5, &r); ले बोलाउँदा q ३ र r २ हुन्छ। विकल्प (क) C होइन। return q, r; compile त हुन्छ — comma operator ले q मूल्याङ्कन गरेर फाल्छ र r फर्काउँछ — त्यसैले function ले चुपचाप शेष मात्र फर्काउँछ। Compile हुने गलत उत्तर नहुने भन्दा नराम्रो हो। विकल्प (ख) चल्छ तर भाग दुई पटक गर्छ; यति सानो कुरामा लागत छैन, तर (ग) रोज्नुको कारण दुवै उत्तर एउटै गणनाबाट आउँछन् र सँगै निस्कनुपर्छ भन्ने हो। Call by reference हुनुको कारण यही हो। "Function ले बढीमा एउटा मान फर्काउँछ" भन्ने कुरा पन्छाउने बाधा होइन — pointer लाई अनिवार्य बनाउने तथ्य त्यही हो। Example 2 One call, traced through both files of the program Question: state the output, and say how many times main is suspended. #include <stdio.h> int square(int n) { printf("in square, n = %d
", n); return n * n; } int main() { int r; printf("before
"); r = square(4); printf("after, r = %d
", r); return 0; } Write the three output lines in the order they appear. The question is not what square does — it is where main is while square is running. तीन output लाइन देखिने क्रममा लेख्नुहोस्। प्रश्न square ले के गर्छ भन्ने होइन — square चल्दै गर्दा main कहाँ हुन्छ भन्ने हो। Working main starts prints before reaches r = square(4) SUSPENDS here, and waits square starts, n is a new variable holding 4 prints in square, n = 4 returns 16 main RESUMES at the same line stores 16 into r prints after, r = 16 returns 0 Output before in square, n = 4 after, r = 16 main is suspended exactly once, and the line r = square(4); is not finished until the return arrives — the assignment happens after the function has ended, not before it starts. That ordering is what "a call is a round trip" means, and it is why "after" cannot be printed in the middle. main ठ्याक्कै एक पटक रोकिन्छ, र r = square(4); लाइन return नआएसम्म सकिँदैन — assignment function सकिएपछि हुन्छ, सुरु हुनुअघि होइन। "Call भनेको आउने–जाने यात्रा हो" भन्नुको अर्थ त्यही क्रम हो, र "after" बीचमा छापिन नसक्नुको कारण पनि त्यही। Practise it — the help comes away

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ Mistakes that cost marks here A semicolon after the definition's closing brace. A prototype takes one; a definition does not. Expecting a call-by-value function to change the caller's variable. It cannot. Look for & and *. Writing a recursive function with no base case. It is not an infinite loop, it is a crash. Confusing argument with parameter. Argument is at the call; parameter is in the definition. Returning two values. A function returns at most one; use pointers for the second. Calling a library function without its header. sqrt without math.h is an error, not a warning you can ignore. Definition को बन्द brace पछि semicolon: prototype लाई चाहिन्छ, definition लाई चाहिँदैन। Call by value ले बोलाउनेको variable बदल्छ भन्ठान्नु: सक्दैन; & र * खोज्नुहोस्। Base case नभएको recursive function: यो अनन्त loop होइन, crash हो। Argument र parameter मिसाउनु: argument call मा, parameter definition मा। दुई मान return गर्न खोज्नु: बढीमा एउटा; दोस्रोका लागि pointer। Header नराखी library function बोलाउनु: math.h विनाको sqrt बेवास्ता गर्न मिल्ने चेतावनी होइन, त्रुटि हो। Memory hook — Value sends a photocopy; reference sends the address. No ampersand, no change. सम्झने तरिका — Value ले फोटोकपी पठाउँछ; reference ले ठेगाना। Ampersand छैन भने बदलाव पनि छैन। Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours
items.ne: — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.ne: — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Functions
items.ne: फङ्सन

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.2 Declaration, definition and calling — घोषणा, परिभाषा र call
items.en: What you will learn: to name the three appearances of a function from the line alone. The punctuation at the end decides it — a semicolon, a brace, or a result being used.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: लाइन मात्र हेरेर function का तीन रूप नाम लिन। अन्त्यको चिन्हले निर्णय गर्छ — semicolon, brace, कि नतिजा प्रयोग भएको।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: What you will learn: that a correct-looking swap can run perfectly and change nothing outside itself. Keep your eye on the two main rows while the two swap rows do their work.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: ठिकै देखिने swap पूरै सफलतापूर्वक चलेर पनि आफूबाहिर केही नबदल्न सक्छ। swap का दुई पङ्क्तिले काम गर्दा main का दुई पङ्क्तिमा नजर राख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: What you will learn: exactly which step changes main's variable, and that nothing is returned at all. Compare it against the program above — only two characters differ.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: कुन चरणले ठ्याक्कै main को variable बदल्छ, र केही पनि return हुँदैन भन्ने कुरा। माथिको प्रोग्रामसँग तुलना गर्नुहोस् — फरक दुई अक्षरको मात्र छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 4.4 Call by value and call by reference — Call by value र call by reference
items.en: What you will learn: to answer the real question, which is never what the function prints but whether the caller's variable survived unchanged.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: साँचो प्रश्नको उत्तर दिन — function ले के छाप्यो भन्ने होइन, बोलाउनेको variable जस्ताको तस्तै रह्यो कि रहेन भन्ने।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What you will learn: that every multiplication happens on the way back up, not on the way down, and that four unfinished calls exist at once. The call stack panel is the point of this one.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक गुणन तल जाँदा होइन फर्कंदा हुन्छ, र एकैचोटि चार अधुरा call हुन्छन्। यसको मुख्य कुरा call stack को प्यानल नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Indexing starts at 0, so an array of size 10 has indices 0 to 9 and the last index is size minus one. There is no marks[10]: that is the eleventh box and it is not part of the array. C performs no bounds checking, so writing to it compiles and quietly damages whatever happens to be in that memory.
items.ne: Index ० बाट सुरु हुन्छ, त्यसैले १० आकारको array का index ० देखि ९ सम्म हुन्छन् र अन्तिम index आकार घटाउ एक हो। marks[10] भन्ने छैन: त्यो एघारौं बाकस हो र array को भाग होइन। C ले bound जाँच्दैन, त्यसैले त्यहाँ लेख्दा compile हुन्छ र त्यो मेमोरीमा जे छ त्यो चुपचाप बिग्रन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: When an array is given an initialiser list that is shorter than its size, the remaining elements are set to zero rather than left as garbage. That is a rule about initialisation, not about declaration: int a[5]; with no list at all leaves all five holding garbage. It is also why int a[100] = {0}; is the usual way of writing "an array of a hundred zeros".
items.ne: Array लाई आकारभन्दा छोटो initialiser सूची दिइँदा बाँकी element garbage नभई शून्य हुन्छन्। यो initialisation को नियम हो, घोषणाको होइन: सूची नै नभएको int a[5]; मा पाँचै मा garbage रहन्छ। "सय शून्यको array" लेख्ने चलनचल्तीको तरिका int a[100] = {0}; हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: KATHMANDU is nine letters, and every string in C ends with the null character, which needs a box of its own. So ten is the smallest safe size. Declaring char city[9] leaves no room for the terminator, so nothing marks the end of the string and printf carries on into whatever follows in memory. The rule is always: length plus one.
items.ne: KATHMANDU नौ अक्षरको हो, र C मा हरेक string null अक्षरले सकिन्छ जसलाई आफ्नै बाकस चाहिन्छ। त्यसैले सुरक्षित सबैभन्दा सानो आकार दस हो। char city[9] घोषणा गरे terminator का लागि ठाउँ रहँदैन, string को अन्त्य केहीले जनाउँदैन र printf मेमोरीमा पछि जे छ त्यतै बढ्छ। नियम सधैं यही हो: लम्बाइ जोड एक।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: strlen counts the characters up to the null terminator and does not count the null itself, so it returns 5. Three different numbers describe this one variable and all three are right: the length is 5, the characters stored are 6 including the null, and the array size is 20. Confusing the length with the size is the usual error, and sizeof(s) would give 20.
items.ne: strlen ले null terminator सम्मका अक्षर गन्छ र null आफैंलाई गन्दैन, त्यसैले ५ फर्काउँछ। यही एउटै variable लाई तीन फरक सङ्ख्याले वर्णन गर्छन् र तीनै ठिक छन्: लम्बाइ ५, null सहित भण्डारण भएका अक्षर ६, र array को आकार २०। लम्बाइ र आकार मिसाउनु सामान्य गल्ती हो, र sizeof(s) ले २० दिन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: strcmp returns 0 when the strings match, a negative number when the first comes earlier alphabetically, and a positive number when it comes later. Zero meaning "equal" is the opposite of what most people expect, so the condition for "the passwords are the same" reads if (strcmp(a, b) == 0), which looks backwards and is correct. Writing if (strcmp(a, b)) tests for DIFFERENT, because any non-zero value is true in C.
items.ne: String मिल्दा strcmp ले ० फर्काउँछ, पहिलो वर्णक्रममा अघि भए ऋणात्मक, पछि भए धनात्मक। ० को अर्थ "बराबर" हुनु धेरैको अपेक्षाविपरीत छ, त्यसैले "password मिल्यो" भन्ने सर्त if (strcmp(a, b) == 0) हुन्छ — उल्टो देखिन्छ र ठिक छ। if (strcmp(a, b)) लेखे फरक छ कि भनेर जाँचिन्छ, किनभने C मा शून्य नभएको जुनसुकै मान सत्य हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An array name is the address of its first element, so s1 == s2 compares two addresses. Two separate arrays are always at different addresses, so the test is false even when both hold exactly the same word. It compiles and runs, which is what makes it dangerous. strcmp walks both strings character by character and is the only correct way — and it returns 0 for a match.
items.ne: Array को नाम पहिलो element को ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले s1 == s2 ले दुई ठेगाना तुलना गर्छ। छुट्टाछुट्टै दुई array सधैं फरक ठेगानामा हुन्छन्, त्यसैले दुवैमा ठ्याक्कै उही शब्द भए पनि जाँच असत्य हुन्छ। यो compile हुन्छ र चल्छ पनि — त्यसैले खतरनाक छ। strcmp ले दुवै string अक्षर–अक्षर हिँड्छ र सही तरिका त्यही हो — र मिल्दा ० फर्काउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An array name is already an address, so %s takes no ampersand — this is the one scanf in the subject that does not need one. And %s stops reading at the first whitespace, so "Ram Bahadur" leaves "Ram" in name and "Bahadur" waiting in the input. Reading a whole line needs fgets, not scanf, and gets() is not an option because it was removed from the C standard.
items.ne: Array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो, त्यसैले %s लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन — विषयभरिमा ampersand नचाहिने scanf यही एक हो। अनि %s पहिलो खाली ठाउँमै पढ्न छाड्छ, त्यसैले "Ram Bahadur" मा name भित्र "Ram" रहन्छ र "Bahadur" input मै पर्खिरहन्छ। पूरै लाइन पढ्न scanf होइन fgets चाहिन्छ, र gets() विकल्प होइन किनभने त्यो C मानकबाट हटाइएको छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The loop runs six times, with i taking 0 to 5, and a[5] is one box past the end of an array whose last valid index is 4. C does no bounds checking at compile time or at run time, so this builds cleanly. What is at that address is whatever came next in memory, so the program may print a strange number, may corrupt another variable, or may crash — possibly a different one of those on each run.
items.ne: Loop छ पटक चल्छ, i ले ० देखि ५ लिन्छ, र अन्तिम मान्य index ४ भएको array मा a[5] अन्त्यभन्दा एक बाकस पर हो। C ले compile गर्दा पनि, चल्दा पनि bound जाँच्दैन, त्यसैले यो सफा build हुन्छ। त्यो ठेगानामा मेमोरीमा पछि जे आयो त्यही हुन्छ, त्यसैले प्रोग्रामले अनौठो सङ्ख्या छाप्न सक्छ, अर्को variable बिगार्न सक्छ, वा crash हुन सक्छ — हरेक पटक फरक पनि हुन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: 70 + 85 + 60 + 90 + 45 = 350. Two details make this work and both are examined. t is set to 0 before the loop, so the first addition has something known to add to; if t were left uninitialised the answer would be a different wrong number on every run. And the index runs 0 to 4, covering all five elements — option B is the total without the first element, which is what starting the loop at 1 would give.
items.ne: 70 + 85 + 60 + 90 + 45 = 350। दुई कुराले यो चल्छ र दुवै सोधिन्छन्। Loop अघि t लाई ० राखिएको छ, त्यसैले पहिलो जोडसँग जोड्न थाहा भएको कुरा हुन्छ; t लाई मान नदिए हरेक पटक फरक गलत उत्तर आउँथ्यो। अनि index ० देखि ४ सम्म चल्छ र पाँचै element समेट्छ — विकल्प (ख) पहिलो element नगनेको जोड हो, जुन loop १ बाट सुरु गर्दा आउँथ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The syllabus names seven string functions and only four of them — strlen, strcpy, strcat and strcmp — are in the C standard. strrev, strlwr and strupr are compiler extensions, present in Turbo C and some Microsoft tools and absent from glibc, so the header declares nothing for them on Linux and the linker cannot find the code. They are examinable, so write them in an answer; but a program that must run anywhere should reverse a string with a loop instead.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमले सात string function नाम लिन्छ र तीमध्ये चार — strlen, strcpy, strcat र strcmp — मात्र C मानकमा छन्। strrev, strlwr र strupr compiler का थप हुन्, Turbo C र केही Microsoft साधनमा छन् र glibc मा छैनन् — त्यसैले Linux मा header ले तिनका लागि केही घोषणा गर्दैन र linker ले कोड भेट्दैन। यी सोधिन्छन्, त्यसैले उत्तरमा लेख्नुहोस्; तर जहाँ पनि चल्नुपर्ने प्रोग्रामले string loop ले नै उल्टाउनुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Which string function does this job?
items.ne: यो काम कुन string function ले गर्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Five of the seven in the syllabus do jobs that are easy to confuse, and three of them are not standard C at all. Choose by what comes back: a number, a changed string, or a comparison result.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमका सातमध्ये पाँचका काम मिल्दाजुल्दा छन्, र तीनवटा त मानक C मै छैनन्। के फर्कन्छ हेरेर छान्नुहोस्: सङ्ख्या, बदलिएको string, कि तुलनाको नतिजा?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: strlen counts the characters up to the null terminator and returns that number, so it gives 5 for Nepal. It does not count the null itself, which is why the array still needs one more byte than the length.
items.ne: strlen ले null सम्मका अक्षर गन्छ र त्यो सङ्ख्या फर्काउँछ, त्यसैले Nepal को ५ आउँछ। यसले null आफैंलाई गन्दैन, र त्यसैले array मा लम्बाइभन्दा एक byte बढी चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Copying one string into another needs strcpy, because the assignment operator cannot be used on arrays in C. Writing a = b would not compile, and that failed attempt is the usual route to this function.
items.ne: एउटा string अर्कोमा सार्न strcpy चाहिन्छ, किनभने C मा array मा assignment operator चल्दैन। a = b लेखे compile नै हुँदैन, र त्यही असफल प्रयासले यो function सम्म पुर्‍याउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: strcat joins the second string onto the end of the first, so the first array must be big enough to hold both. Declaring a as 30 and not 10 is what makes this safe, and the exam often tests that detail.
items.ne: strcat ले दोस्रो string लाई पहिलोको अन्त्यमा जोड्छ, त्यसैले पहिलो array दुवै अट्ने ठूलो हुनुपर्छ। a लाई 10 होइन 30 राख्नुले यसलाई सुरक्षित बनाउँछ, र परीक्षाले प्रायः त्यही कुरा जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Two strings cannot be compared with the double equals sign, so strcmp is used and it returns zero when they match. Zero meaning equal is the opposite of what students expect, and it costs marks every year.
items.ne: दुई string लाई दोहोरो बराबर चिन्हले तुलना गर्न मिल्दैन, त्यसैले strcmp प्रयोग हुन्छ र मिले शून्य फर्काउँछ। शून्यको अर्थ बराबर हुनु विद्यार्थीको अपेक्षाविपरीत छ, र हरेक वर्ष अंक खान्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Making one string equal to another is a copy and nothing else, so strcpy is the answer even when the task is described in words. strcat would join the two instead and leave the original text in place.
items.ne: एउटा string अर्कोसरह बनाउनु प्रतिलिपि नै हो, त्यसैले शब्दमा वर्णन गरिए पनि उत्तर strcpy हो। strcat ले त दुवैलाई जोडिदिन्थ्यो र पहिलेको पाठ त्यहीँ रहन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.2 Declaration and initialisation of an array — Array को घोषणा र initialisation
items.en: Five integers in one block. The addresses go up by four because an int is four bytes here; the index goes up by one. Those are two different counts, and the compiler does the conversion.
items.ne: एउटै block मा पाँच integer। यहाँ int चार byte भएकाले ठेगाना चार–चारले बढ्छ; index एक–एकले। यी दुई फरक गन्ती हुन्, र बदल्ने काम compiler ले गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.4 Declaration of a string — String को घोषणा
items.en: Six boxes used for a five-letter word. The red box is the one you never typed and the one every string function is looking for.
items.ne: पाँच अक्षरको शब्दका लागि छ बाकस। रातो बाकस तपाईंले कहिल्यै नटाइपेको हो, र हरेक string function ले खोज्ने पनि त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Say which of the seven string functions in the syllabus are not standard C, and what that means for a program you write.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: array भनेको के हो र पचास छुट्टाछुट्टै variable किन उत्तर होइन भन्न, एक-आयामिक array घोषणा र initialise गरेर पहिलो अनि अन्तिम index नाम लिन, loop ले array का element पढ्न, छाप्न र जोड्न, C मा string भनेको के हो र null अक्षरले के गर्छ बुझाउन, strlen, strcpy, strcat र strcmp चलाउन अनि कुन header चाहिन्छ भन्न, र पाठ्यक्रमका सात string function मध्ये कुन मानक C मा छैनन् र त्यसको तपाईंको प्रोग्राममा के अर्थ हुन्छ भन्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.3 One-dimensional arrays in use — एक-आयामिक array को प्रयोग
items.en: This is the price C pays for speed: no check means no cost, and the responsibility moves to you. It is also why i < size rather than i <= size is worth checking every single time you write a loop over an array.
items.ne: Compile हुन्छ। C ले bound जाँच्दैन — न compile गर्दा, न चल्दा। a[5] भनेको "a को सुरुदेखि पाँच बाकस पर भएको मेमोरी" मात्र हो, र compiler ले त्यही ठेगाना निकालेर चलाउँछ। त्यहाँ के छ भन्ने मेमोरीमा पछि जे आयो त्यही हो: अर्को variable, function को आफ्नै हिसाब, वा केही पनि होइन। प्रोग्रामले अनौठो सङ्ख्या छाप्न सक्छ, अर्कै variable चुपचाप बिगार्न सक्छ, वा crash हुन सक्छ — र हरेक पटक फरक नतिजा दिन सक्छ। गतिका लागि C ले तिरेको मूल्य यही हो: जाँच छैन भने लागत पनि छैन, र जिम्मेवारी तपाईंमा सर्छ। Array मा loop लेख्दा हरेक पटक i <= size होइन i < size हो कि भनेर जाँच्नुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: strrev, strlwr and strupr are not standard C. They exist in Turbo C and in some Microsoft compilers and are absent from the C standard library, so a program using them compiles on DEV C++ on a Windows machine and fails on a Linux one with "undefined reference". They are on the syllabus and they are examinable, so write them in an examination answer; but if you are writing a program that has to run anywhere, reverse a string with a loop and swap case with a loop. Knowing which of the seven your program can rely on is worth more than knowing all seven.
items.ne: strrev, strlwr र strupr मानक C मा छैनन्। यी Turbo C र केही Microsoft compiler मा छन् तर C मानक library मा छैनन्, त्यसैले यी चलाएको प्रोग्राम Windows को DEV C++ मा compile भएर Linux मा "undefined reference" भन्दै असफल हुन्छ। यी पाठ्यक्रममा छन् र सोधिन्छन्, त्यसैले परीक्षाको उत्तरमा लेख्नुहोस्; तर जहाँ पनि चल्नुपर्ने प्रोग्राम लेख्दै हुनुहुन्छ भने string loop ले उल्टाउनुहोस् र अक्षरको case loop ले बदल्नुहोस्। सातै जान्नुभन्दा आफ्नो प्रोग्रामले कुनमा भर पर्न सक्छ भन्ने जान्नु बढी काम लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Decide what the "largest so far" variable should start at. Zero is the obvious choice and it is wrong for one kind of input — work out which.
items.ne: "अहिलेसम्मको ठूलो" variable कहाँबाट सुरु गर्ने निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। शून्य स्वाभाविक लाग्छ तर एक किसिमको input मा गलत हुन्छ — कुनमा, पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Starting max at marks[0] rather than at 0 is the detail worth the mark. If every value entered were negative — a temperature program, a profit-and-loss program — then max = 0 would report 0, a number that was never entered. Starting from a real element cannot be wrong whatever the data is. Note too that the second loop starts at 1, because element 0 is already the answer so far.
items.ne: अंक बोक्ने कुरा max लाई ० होइन marks[0] बाट सुरु गर्नु हो। सबै मान ऋणात्मक भए — तापक्रमको वा नाफा–नोक्सानको प्रोग्राममा — max = 0 ले कहिल्यै नहालिएको ० लाई उत्तर भन्थ्यो। साँच्चैको element बाट सुरु गरे data जस्तोसुकै भए पनि गलत हुँदैन। अर्को कुरा — दोस्रो loop १ बाट सुरु हुन्छ, किनभने element ० अहिलेसम्मको उत्तर भइसक्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Work out how many comparisons are needed for five numbers before opening this. If your answer is five, trace the first pass on paper instead.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि पाँच सङ्ख्याका लागि कति तुलना चाहिन्छ निकाल्नुहोस्। उत्तर पाँच आयो भने बरु कागजमा पहिलो पटक ट्रेस गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The outer loop counts passes, not elements: five numbers need four passes, because once four are in place the fifth has nowhere else to be. The inner condition is j < 4 - i rather than j < 4 because the end of the list is already sorted after each pass and comparing it again wastes time. And a[j + 1] is why the inner loop must stop at 4 - i and not 5 - i: at j = 4 it would reach a[5], which is outside the array.
items.ne: बाहिरी loop ले element होइन पटक गन्छ: पाँच सङ्ख्यालाई चार पटक चाहिन्छ, किनभने चार ठाउँमा पुगेपछि पाँचौंको अर्को ठाउँ नै हुँदैन। भित्री सर्त j < 4 होइन j < 4 - i हुनुको कारण हरेक पटकपछि सूचीको अन्त्य मिलिसकेको हुन्छ र फेरि तुलना गर्नु समय खेर फाल्नु हो। अनि a[j + 1] नै भित्री loop 5 - i होइन 4 - i मा रोकिनुपर्ने कारण हो: j = 4 मा यो a[5] सम्म पुग्थ्यो, जुन array बाहिर छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Calling strrev and expecting it everywhere. It is not standard C.
items.ne: Index १ बाट सुरु गर्नु: पहिलो element a[0], अन्तिम a[size - 1]। Loop मा i <= size लेख्नु: अन्त्यभन्दा एक बाकस पर पढिन्छ र चेतावनी आउँदैन। पाँच अक्षरका लागि char name[5]: null लाई छैटौं बाकस चाहिन्छ। दुई string तुलना गर्न ==: यसले ठेगाना तुलना गर्छ, पाठ होइन; strcmp चलाउनुहोस् र बराबर भए ० फर्काउँछ सम्झनुहोस्। String सार्न =: array मा assignment चल्दैन; strcpy चलाउनुहोस्। scanf("%s", name) मा &name लेख्नु: array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो। strrev जताततै चल्छ भन्ठान्नु: यो मानक C मा छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 5. Neither can be done from this site — both need a C compiler on a real computer.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ५ को सूचीबाट। दुवै यस साइटबाट गर्न मिल्दैन — दुवैलाई साँच्चैको कम्प्युटरमा C compiler चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 5.2, 5.3 and Unit 3's nested loops. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: read ten numbers and print them backwards; find the largest and the smallest; find the average; then sort the list into ascending order using two nested loops that compare neighbouring elements and swap them. Observe and record: print the whole array after each pass of the outer loop, and write the passes down. Watching the largest value travel to the end one pass at a time is the clearest thing in this unit and it only happens if you print it.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ५.२, ५.३ र युनिट ३ का nested loop। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: दस सङ्ख्या पढेर उल्टो छाप्ने; ठूलो र सानो पत्ता लगाउने; औसत निकाल्ने; अनि छेउछाउका element तुलना गरेर साट्ने दुई nested loop ले सूचीलाई बढ्दो क्रममा मिलाउने। ध्यान दिएर लेख्ने: बाहिरी loop को हरेक पटकपछि पूरै array छापेर ती चरण लेख्नुहोस्। सबैभन्दा ठूलो मान एक–एक पटक गर्दै अन्त्यतिर सर्दै गएको हेर्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट कुरा हो, र छापे मात्र देखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with a C compiler. This cannot be simulated on this site. Builds on: 5.4 and 5.5. Hand in: the source files and your practical record. Suggested set: read a name and print it; find its length with strlen and again with a loop of your own, and check the two agree; copy one string to another; join two strings; compare two strings and report whether they match. Then record one result that matters: try strrev on your compiler and write down whether it worked. If your school later uses a different compiler, that note in your record book will explain why a program that worked stopped working.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: C compiler भएको कम्प्युटर। यो यहाँ simulate गर्न मिल्दैन। आधार: ५.४ र ५.५। बुझाउने: source फाइल र प्रयोगात्मक अभिलेख। सुझाव: नाम पढेर छाप्ने; strlen ले अनि आफ्नै loop ले लम्बाइ निकालेर दुवै मिल्यो कि मिलेन जाँच्ने; एउटा string अर्कोमा सार्ने; दुई string जोड्ने; दुई string तुलना गरेर मिल्यो कि मिलेन भन्ने। अनि एउटा महत्त्वपूर्ण नतिजा लेख्नुहोस्: आफ्नो compiler मा strrev चलाएर चल्यो कि चलेन लेख्नुहोस्। पछि विद्यालयले अर्को compiler चलायो भने अभिलेखको त्यही टिपोटले चलिरहेको प्रोग्राम किन रोकियो बुझाउनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: This unit carries 8 of the 50 external marks and 10 of the 64 theory hours. The program to write is nearly always "read n numbers into an array and do something with them" — sum, average, largest, smallest, or reverse. Short questions ask what an array is, how it is declared and initialised, what the null character does, and what a named string function returns. One-mark questions love the index: what is the last index of int a[10]?
items.ne: यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ८ अंक र ६४ मध्ये १० घण्टा ओगट्छ। लेख्नुपर्ने प्रोग्राम झन्डै सधैं "n सङ्ख्या array मा पढेर केही गर्ने" हुन्छ — जोड, औसत, ठूलो, सानो, वा उल्टो। छोटा प्रश्नले array भनेको के हो, कसरी घोषणा र initialise गरिन्छ, null अक्षरले के गर्छ, र नाम तोकिएको string function ले के फर्काउँछ सोध्छन्। एक अंकका प्रश्नलाई index मन पर्छ: int a[10] को अन्तिम index कति?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Example: int marks[5]; declares an array of five integers with indices marks[0] to marks[4].
items.ne: Array भनेको एउटै data type का element लाई एउटै नाममुनि लगातार मेमोरी स्थानमा राखेको समूह हो, जहाँ हरेक element ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। Syntax: data_type array_name[size]; उदाहरण: int marks[5]; ले पाँच integer को array घोषणा गर्छ, जसका index marks[0] देखि marks[4] सम्म हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: char name[5] = "NEPAL"; is a mistake because NEPAL is five characters and needs a sixth position for the null. With only five boxes there is no terminator, so nothing marks the end of the string, and functions such as printf and strlen read past the array into whatever memory follows. Compiled and run to check this: sizeof(name) gave 5 as it must, and strlen(name) gave 10 — it had walked five characters past the end of the array before it happened to meet a zero byte.
items.ne: Null अक्षर \0 शून्य मान भएको अक्षर हो, जुन C मा हरेक string को अन्त्यमा आफैं राखिन्छ। यसले string कहाँ सकिन्छ जनाउँछ; लम्बाइ अन्त कतै लेखिँदैन, त्यसैले हरेक string function यही अक्षर नभेटेसम्म अगाडि बढ्छ। char name[5] = "NEPAL"; गल्ती हो किनभने NEPAL पाँच अक्षर हो र null का लागि छैटौं ठाउँ चाहिन्छ। पाँच बाकस मात्र भए terminator नै हुँदैन, string को अन्त्य केहीले जनाउँदैन, र printf अनि strlen जस्ता function array नाघेर पछाडिको मेमोरी पढ्छन्। यो जाँच्न compile गरेर चलाइयो: sizeof(name) ले हुनुपर्ने ५ दियो, र strlen(name) ले १० — array को अन्त्यभन्दा पाँच अक्षर पर पुगेपछि संयोगले शून्य byte भेटेको थियो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Two details carry marks beyond the loop itself. sum is set to 0 before any addition. And the average is divided by 10.0 and not 10: two integers would give integer division and an average of 85.7 would print as 85.00, which is the Unit 2 trap arriving in a Unit 5 program.
items.ne: Loop बाहेक दुई कुराले अंक बोक्छन्। कुनै जोड हुनुअघि sum लाई ० राखिएको छ। अनि औसत 10 होइन 10.0 ले भाग गरिएको छ: दुई integer भए integer division हुन्थ्यो र ८५.७ को औसत ८५.०० छापिन्थ्यो — युनिट २ को पासो युनिट ५ को प्रोग्राममा आइपुगेको।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: strrev, strlwr and strupr are on the syllabus and are not standard C.
items.ne: Array ले एउटै प्रकारका element लाई एउटै नाममुनि लगातार मेमोरीमा राख्छ र index ले पुगिन्छ। Index ० बाट सुरु; अन्तिम index आकार − १; C ले bound जाँच्दै जाँच्दैन। int a[5] = {70, 85}; ले बाँकी तीनलाई शून्य बनाउँछ। String भनेको \0 ले सकिने char array हो, त्यसैले अक्षरभन्दा एक बाकस बढी चाहिन्छ। scanf("%s", name) लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन र पहिलो खाली ठाउँमा रोकिन्छ। strlen ले null अघिका गन्छ; strcpy सार्छ; strcat जोड्छ; strcmp बराबर भए ० फर्काउँछ। सबै string function लाई string.h चाहिन्छ। strrev, strlwr र strupr पाठ्यक्रममा छन् तर मानक C मा छैनन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Work out which box an index names, and where an array or a string actually ends
items.ne: कुन index ले कुन बाकस जनाउँछ, र array वा string साँच्चै कहाँ सकिन्छ पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Indexing starts at 0, so for a size of n the valid indices are 0 to n - 1 and the last index is n - 1. A string stores one extra character, the null, after its letters — so strlen counts the letters and sizeof counts the whole array, and the two numbers are different on purpose.
items.ne: Index ० बाट सुरु हुन्छ, त्यसैले n आकारमा मान्य index ० देखि n − 1 सम्म हुन्छन् र अन्तिम index n − 1 हो। String ले अक्षरपछि null भन्ने एउटा थप अक्षर राख्छ — त्यसैले strlen ले अक्षर गन्छ र sizeof ले पूरै array, र दुई सङ्ख्या जानीजानी फरक हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: int a[5] = {10, 20, 30, 40, 50};  Which box does a[0] name, and what is the last valid index?
items.ne: int a[5] = {10, 20, 30, 40, 50};  a[0] ले कुन बाकस जनाउँछ, र अन्तिम मान्य index कति हो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is the value of a[0]?
items.ne: a[0] को मान कति हो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Index 0 is the FIRST element, not the zeroth of six. The five values sit at indices 0, 1, 2, 3 and 4.
items.ne: Index ० पहिलो element हो, छ मध्येको शून्यौं होइन। पाँच मान index ०, १, २, ३ र ४ मा बस्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is the value of a[4]?
items.ne: a[4] को मान कति हो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: a[4] is the fifth and last element. Counting from zero, the fifth element carries index 4 — one less than you would say out loud.
items.ne: a[4] पाँचौं र अन्तिम element हो। शून्यबाट गन्दा पाँचौं element को index ४ हुन्छ — बोल्दा भनिनेभन्दा एक कम।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So what is the last valid index?
items.ne: त्यसो भए अन्तिम मान्य index कति हो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Size 5, indices 0 to 4, last index 4. There is no a[5], and C will not stop you writing one — it has no bounds checking at all.
items.ne: आकार ५, index ० देखि ४, अन्तिम index ४। a[5] भन्ने छैन, र C ले त्यो लेख्नबाट रोक्दैन — यसमा bound जाँच्ने व्यवस्थै छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: int b[4] = {7, 3};  What is b[2]?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: How many values were given in the list?
items.ne: सूचीमा कति मान दिइएका छन्?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Only 7 and 3 were written, so indices 0 and 1 are filled and 2 and 3 were not given anything.
items.ne: केवल ७ र ३ लेखिएका छन्, त्यसैले index ० र १ भरिए र २ अनि ३ लाई केही दिइएन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: So what is b[2]?
items.ne: त्यसो भए b[2] कति हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An initialiser list shorter than the array sets the remaining elements to zero, not to garbage. That is a rule about initialisation: int b[4]; with no list at all would leave all four holding garbage.
items.ne: Array भन्दा छोटो initialiser सूचीले बाँकी element लाई garbage नभई शून्य बनाउँछ। यो initialisation को नियम हो: सूची नै नभएको int b[4]; मा चारै मा garbage रहन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: char s[10] = "NEPAL";  What does strlen(s) return, and at which index does the null character sit?
items.ne: char s[10] = "NEPAL";  strlen(s) ले के फर्काउँछ, र null अक्षर कुन index मा बस्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: How many boxes does the compiler actually fill?
items.ne: Compiler ले साँच्चै कति बाकस भर्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Five letters and the null character after them. The null is written automatically; nobody types it.
items.ne: पाँच अक्षर र तिनपछि null अक्षर। Null आफैं लेखिन्छ; कसैले टाइप गर्दैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: At which index does the null character sit?
items.ne: Null अक्षर कुन index मा बस्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The letters occupy 0 to 4, so the null is at index 5 — the sixth box, and the first one you never wrote to.
items.ne: अक्षरले ० देखि ४ ओगट्छन्, त्यसैले null index ५ मा — छैटौं बाकस, र तपाईंले कहिल्यै नलेखेको पहिलो बाकस।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What does strlen(s) return?
items.ne: strlen(s) ले के फर्काउँछ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: strlen gives 5 because it counts up to the null and does not count it. Three numbers describe this one variable and all three are right: length 5, characters stored 6, array size 10.
items.ne: strlen ले ५ दिन्छ, किनभने यसले null सम्म गन्छ र त्यसलाई गन्दैन। यही एउटै variable लाई तीन सङ्ख्याले वर्णन गर्छन् र तीनै ठिक छन्: लम्बाइ ५, भण्डारण भएका अक्षर ६, array को आकार १०।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What is a[1] + a[3]?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: a[1] is 20, the second element, and a[3] is 40, the fourth. 20 + 40 = 60. Reading a[1] as the first element and a[3] as the third would give 10 + 30 = 40.

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Somebody writes the condition as i <= 5 instead of i < 5 while adding up the same five marks. Give the one index their loop reaches that does not belong to the array.
items.ne: उही पाँच अंक जोड्दा कसैले सर्त i < 5 को साटो i <= 5 लेख्छ। तिनको loop ले पुग्ने तर array को नभएको एउटा index भन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Which index is outside the array?
items.ne: कुन index array बाहिर छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Index 5. The loop now runs six times and the sixth reaches a box one past the end of an array whose last valid index is 4. Nothing moved in the data and nothing moved in the array — only the comparison operator — and that single character turns a correct total into a number that may be wrong, may corrupt another variable, or may crash the program, differently on each run.
items.ne: Index ५। अब loop छ पटक चल्छ र छैटौंले अन्तिम मान्य index ४ भएको array को अन्त्यभन्दा एक बाकस पर पुग्छ। Data मा केही सरेन, array मा पनि केही सरेन — तुलना गर्ने operator मात्र सर्‍यो — र त्यही एउटा अक्षरले सही जोडलाई गलत हुन सक्ने, अर्को variable बिगार्न सक्ने, वा प्रोग्राम crash गराउन सक्ने सङ्ख्यामा बदल्छ, र हरेक पटक फरक नतिजा दिन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.3 One-dimensional arrays in use — एक-आयामिक array को प्रयोग
items.en: Keep asking "which box is this?" rather than "what number is this?". The index row and the element row are deliberately separate, because confusing them is the error.
items.ne: "यो कुन बाकस हो?" सोध्नुहोस्, "यो कुन सङ्ख्या हो?" होइन। Index को पङ्क्ति र element को पङ्क्ति जानीजानी छुट्याइएका छन्, किनभने तिनलाई मिसाउनु नै गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.4 Declaration of a string — String को घोषणा
items.en: Before the strlen step, predict the number. Then ask why it is not six, and why the array was declared as ten.
items.ne: strlen को चरणअघि सङ्ख्या अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। अनि सोध्नुहोस् — यो छ किन भएन, र array दस किन घोषणा गरियो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Watch for the strcmp case. It returns 0 for a match, so the condition that means "the passwords are the same" is == 0, which reads backwards and is right.
items.ne: strcmp को केस ध्यान दिनुहोस्। मिल्दा ० फर्काउने भएकाले "password मिल्यो" भन्ने सर्त == 0 हुन्छ — उल्टो पढिन्छ, र ठिक छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.1 What arrays and strings are — Array र string भनेको के हुन्
items.en: One name, many boxes An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous memory locations, under one name, reached by an index. Each of those four parts earns its place. Same type, so the compiler knows how far apart the boxes are. Continuous, so the address of element i can be worked out by arithmetic rather than looked up. One name, so fifty marks need one declaration. An index, so a loop can reach every element — which is the whole reason arrays exist. Without an array, storing fifty students' marks needs fifty variables, fifty scanf lines, and no way to write "add them all up" in fewer than fifty additions. With one, it is a loop of three lines. A string in C is not a separate type. It is an array of char that ends with the null character \0. Everything true of arrays is true of strings, plus that one extra rule.
items.ne: एउटै नाम, धेरै बाकस Array भनेको एउटै data type का element को समूह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी स्थान मा, एउटै नाम मुनि राखिन्छ र index ले पुगिन्छ। यी चारै भागको आफ्नै काम छ। एउटै प्रकार, ताकि बाकसहरू कति टाढा छन् compiler लाई थाहा होस्। लगातार, ताकि i औं element को ठेगाना खोज्नु नपरी गणनाले निस्कियोस्। एउटै नाम, ताकि पचास अंकलाई एउटै घोषणा पुगोस्। Index, ताकि loop ले हरेक element मा पुग्न सकोस् — array हुनुको पूरै कारण त्यही हो। Array नभए पचास विद्यार्थीको अंक राख्न पचास variable, पचास scanf लाइन, र "सबै जोड्नुहोस्" भन्ने कुरा पचास जोडभन्दा कममा लेख्ने उपाय नै हुँदैन। Array भए तीन लाइनको loop पुग्छ। C मा string छुट्टै प्रकार होइन। यो char को array हो, जुन null अक्षर \0 ले सकिन्छ। Array का सबै कुरा string मा पनि लागू हुन्छन्, माथि यो एउटा थप नियम।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.2 Declaration and initialisation of an array — Array को घोषणा र initialisation
items.en: Four ways to start one Declaration — int marks[5]; reserves five integer boxes. The number in the brackets is the size, and in standard C before C99 it has to be a constant: int a[n]; with a variable n is not something to rely on in an examination answer. Initialisation — four forms, all legal: int marks[5] = {70, 85, 60, 90, 45}; — size and values both given. int marks[] = {70, 85, 60, 90, 45}; — the compiler counts five for you. int marks[5] = {70, 85}; — the rest become zero, not garbage. int marks[5] = {0}; — a common idiom for "all zero". Indexing starts at 0. An array of size 5 has indices 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, so the last index is size − 1. There is no marks[5], and C will not stop you from writing one — it has no bounds checking at all. Reading past the end gives whatever happens to be in that memory; writing past the end damages something else.
items.ne: सुरु गर्ने चार तरिका घोषणा — int marks[5]; ले पाँच integer बाकस छुट्याउँछ। कोष्ठकभित्रको सङ्ख्या आकार हो, र C99 भन्दा अघिको मानक C मा यो constant नै हुनुपर्छ: variable n सहितको int a[n]; परीक्षाको उत्तरमा भर पर्ने कुरा होइन। Initialisation — चार रूप, सबै मान्य: int marks[5] = {70, 85, 60, 90, 45}; — आकार र मान दुवै दिइएको। int marks[] = {70, 85, 60, 90, 45}; — compiler ले आफैं पाँच गन्छ। int marks[5] = {70, 85}; — बाँकी शून्य हुन्छन्, garbage होइन। int marks[5] = {0}; — "सबै शून्य" भन्ने चलनचल्तीको तरिका। Index ० बाट सुरु हुन्छ। पाँच आकारको array का index ०, १, २, ३, ४ हुन्छन्, त्यसैले अन्तिम index आकार − १ हो। marks[5] भन्ने छैन, र C ले तपाईंलाई त्यो लेख्नबाट रोक्दैन — यसमा bound जाँच्ने व्यवस्थै छैन। अन्त्यभन्दा पर पढ्दा त्यो मेमोरीमा जे छ त्यही आउँछ; पर लेख्दा अरू केही बिग्रन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.3 One-dimensional arrays in use — एक-आयामिक array को प्रयोग
items.en: An array and a loop are one idea The index in marks[i] is a variable, and that is the hinge of the whole unit: one line of code inside a loop reaches a different element each turn. The three things always written together: Reading — for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) scanf("%d", &marks[i]); Note &marks[i]: one element is an ordinary int, so scanf still needs its address. Printing — the same loop with printf("%d ", marks[i]); Totalling — total = total + marks[i]; with total set to 0 before the loop. The condition is i < 5 and not i <= 5. Both compile. One of them reads a box that is not part of the array, and nothing warns you — this is the off-by-one error, and it is the most common bug in this unit by a wide margin.
items.ne: Array र loop एउटै विचार हुन् marks[i] को index variable हो, र पूरै युनिटको कब्जा त्यही हो: loop भित्रको एउटै लाइनले हरेक पटक फरक element मा पुग्छ। सधैं सँगै लेखिने तीन कुरा: पढ्ने — for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) scanf("%d", &marks[i]); &marks[i] हेर्नुहोस्: एउटा element सामान्य int हो, त्यसैले scanf लाई यसको ठेगाना चाहिन्छ। छाप्ने — उही loop, printf("%d ", marks[i]); सहित। जोड्ने — loop अघि total लाई ० राखेर total = total + marks[i]; सर्त i <= 5 होइन i < 5 हो। दुवै compile हुन्छन्। एउटाले array को भाग नभएको बाकस पढ्छ, र कसैले चेतावनी दिँदैन — यही off-by-one त्रुटि हो, र यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने गल्ती निकै फरकसहित यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.4 Declaration of a string — String को घोषणा
items.en: A char array with one hidden rule Three ways to declare one, and they are not all the same: char name[10] = "NEPAL"; — the compiler stores N, E, P, A, L and then \0, and leaves four boxes unused. char name[] = "NEPAL"; — the compiler counts six, not five, because it has to make room for the null. char name[6] = {'N','E','P','A','L','\0'}; — the long way, and the one that shows what the other two are doing. The null character is the string's end marker. Nothing in C records a string's length anywhere; every function that handles one walks forward until it meets \0. That is why char name[5] = "NEPAL"; is a real bug: there is no room for the terminator, so nothing marks the end, and printf carries on printing whatever is next in memory until it happens to meet a zero byte. Reading one with scanf("%s", name) takes no ampersand, because an array name is already an address. It also stops at the first space, so "Ram Bahadur" arrives as "Ram".
items.ne: एउटा लुकेको नियम भएको char array घोषणा गर्ने तीन तरिका, र तीनै उस्तै होइनन्: char name[10] = "NEPAL"; — compiler ले N, E, P, A, L अनि \0 राख्छ, र चार बाकस खाली छाड्छ। char name[] = "NEPAL"; — compiler ले पाँच होइन छ गन्छ, किनभने null का लागि ठाउँ चाहिन्छ। char name[6] = {'N','E','P','A','L','\0'}; — लामो तरिका, र अरू दुईले के गरिरहेका छन् देखाउने तरिका पनि। Null अक्षर नै string को अन्त्यको चिन्ह हो। C मा string को लम्बाइ कतै लेखिँदैन; string चलाउने हरेक function \0 नभेटेसम्म अगाडि बढ्छ। त्यसैले char name[5] = "NEPAL"; साँच्चैको bug हो: terminator का लागि ठाउँ छैन, अन्त्य केहीले जनाउँदैन, र printf ले मेमोरीमा पछि जे छ त्यही छाप्दै जान्छ — कतै शून्य byte नभेटेसम्म। scanf("%s", name) ले पढ्दा ampersand चाहिँदैन, किनभने array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो। यसले पहिलो खाली ठाउँमै रोकिन्छ, त्यसैले "Ram Bahadur" लेख्दा "Ram" मात्र आउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Seven in the syllabus, four of them standard All of them need #include <string.h>. strlen(s) — returns the number of characters before the null. strlen("NEPAL") is 5. strcpy(dest, src) — copies src into dest, null included. Needed because dest = src does not work on arrays. strcat(dest, src) — joins src onto the end of dest. dest must be large enough for both. strcmp(s1, s2) — compares them and returns 0 when they are equal, a negative number if s1 comes first alphabetically, a positive number if it comes after. Zero meaning equal is the opposite of what everyone expects. The other three — strrev, strlwr, strupr — reverse a string, lower-case it and upper-case it. Learn them: they are on the syllabus and they are examined.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रममा सात, तीमध्ये चार मानक सबैलाई #include <string.h> चाहिन्छ। strlen(s) — null भन्दा अघिका अक्षरको सङ्ख्या फर्काउँछ। strlen("NEPAL") को ५। strcpy(dest, src) — src लाई null सहित dest मा सार्छ। चाहिनुको कारण — array मा dest = src चल्दैन। strcat(dest, src) — src लाई dest को अन्त्यमा जोड्छ। dest दुवै अट्ने ठूलो हुनुपर्छ। strcmp(s1, s2) — तुलना गरेर बराबर भए ० फर्काउँछ, s1 वर्णक्रममा पहिले भए ऋणात्मक, पछि भए धनात्मक। शून्यको अर्थ बराबर हुनु सबैको अपेक्षाविपरीत छ। अरू तीन — strrev, strlwr, strupr — ले string उल्टाउँछ, सानो अक्षर बनाउँछ र ठूलो अक्षर बनाउँछ। सिक्नुहोस्: यी पाठ्यक्रममा छन् र सोधिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Memory hook — Index from zero, last is size minus one; a string is one box longer than it looks.
items.ne: सम्झने तरिका — Index शून्यबाट, अन्तिम आकार घटाउ एक; string देखिनेभन्दा एक बाकस लामो।

items.en: What is an array? Write the syntax for declaring a one-dimensional array with an example.
items.ne: Array भनेको के हो? एक-आयामिक array घोषणा गर्ने syntax उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: What is the null character? Why is char name[5] = "NEPAL"; a mistake?
items.ne: Null अक्षर भनेको के हो? char name[5] = "NEPAL"; किन गल्ती हो?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Write a C program to read ten numbers into an array and print their sum and average.
items.ne: दस सङ्ख्या array मा पढेर तिनको जोड र औसत छाप्ने C प्रोग्राम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.3 One-dimensional arrays in use — एक-आयामिक array को प्रयोग
items.en: A program declares int a[5]; and then writes to a[5]. What does the compiler do?
items.ne: प्रोग्रामले int a[5]; घोषणा गरेर a[5] मा लेख्छ। Compiler ले के गर्छ?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An array without a loop is fifty variables with brackets. Every array operation in this unit — read, print, total, find the largest, sort — is a for loop whose counter is the index, so a shaky loop makes every one of them shaky.
items.ne: Loop नभएको array भनेको कोष्ठकसहितका पचास variable मात्र हो। यस युनिटका हरेक काम — पढ्ने, छाप्ने, जोड्ने, ठूलो खोज्ने, क्रम मिलाउने — for loop हुन् जसको counter नै index हो; त्यसैले loop कमजोर भए सबै कमजोर हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A string is a char array and %s, %c and the escape sequence \0 all come from 2.2 and 2.5. The null character is a char constant, not a new idea.
items.ne: String भनेको char array हो, र %s, %c अनि escape sequence \0 सबै २.२ र २.५ बाट आउँछन्। Null अक्षर नयाँ विचार होइन, char constant हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: An array, an index, and a running total
items.ne: Array, index, र चल्दै गरेको जोड

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Five integers are stored side by side in memory. The positions are numbered 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — not 1 to 5. The size in the brackets is 5; the last valid index is 4.

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस् An array, an index, and a running total What you will learn: which element marks[i] is on each turn, and what happens at the end when i reaches 5. The last two steps are the ones worth the attention — they are the off-by-one error, shown rather than described. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक पटक marks[i] कुन element हो, र अन्त्यमा i ५ पुग्दा के हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई चरण नै ध्यान दिनुपर्ने ठाउँ हुन् — off-by-one त्रुटि वर्णन होइन, देखाइएको छ। How to use this Keep asking "which box is this?" rather than "what number is this?". The index row and the element row are deliberately separate, because confusing them is the error. "यो कुन बाकस हो?" सोध्नुहोस्, "यो कुन सङ्ख्या हो?" होइन। Index को पङ्क्ति र element को पङ्क्ति जानीजानी छुट्याइएका छन्, किनभने तिनलाई मिसाउनु नै गल्ती हो। Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A program declares int a[5]; and then writes to a[5]. What does the compiler do? प्रोग्रामले int a[5]; घोषणा गरेर a[5] मा लेख्छ। Compiler ले के गर्छ? Refuses to compile and reports an index error Compiles it without complaint, and the program may do anything at run time Compiles it and silently grows the array to six elements It compiles. C performs no bounds checking — not at compile time and not at run time. a[5] is simply "the memory five boxes past the start of a", and the compiler works out that address and uses it. What is at that address is whatever came next in memory: another variable, part of the function's bookkeeping, or nothing in particular. The program may print a strange number, may quietly corrupt a different variable, or may crash — and it may do a different one of those on each run. This is the price C pays for speed: no check means no cost, and the responsibility moves to you. It is also why i < size rather than i <= size is worth checking every single time you write a loop over an array. Compile हुन्छ। C ले bound जाँच्दैन — न compile गर्दा, न चल्दा। a[5] भनेको "a को सुरुदेखि पाँच बाकस पर भएको मेमोरी" मात्र हो, र compiler ले त्यही ठेगाना निकालेर चलाउँछ। त्यहाँ के छ भन्ने मेमोरीमा पछि जे आयो त्यही हो: अर्को variable, function को आफ्नै हिसाब, वा केही पनि होइन। प्रोग्रामले अनौठो सङ्ख्या छाप्न सक्छ, अर्कै variable चुपचाप बिगार्न सक्छ, वा crash हुन सक्छ — र हरेक पटक फरक नतिजा दिन सक्छ। गतिका लागि C ले तिरेको मूल्य यही हो: जाँच छैन भने लागत पनि छैन, र जिम्मेवारी तपाईंमा सर्छ। Array मा loop लेख्दा हरेक पटक i <= size होइन i < size हो कि भनेर जाँच्नुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही। 5.4 Declaration of a string

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which string function does this job? What you will learn: to pick the function from what has to come back — a number, a changed string, or a comparison result. That is how the one-mark questions on this topic are framed. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: के फर्कनुपर्छ हेरेर function छान्न — सङ्ख्या, बदलिएको string, कि तुलनाको नतिजा। यस विषयका एक अंकका प्रश्न यसरी नै सोधिन्छन्। How to use this Watch for the strcmp case. It returns 0 for a match, so the condition that means "the passwords are the same" is == 0, which reads backwards and is right. strcmp को केस ध्यान दिनुहोस्। मिल्दा ० फर्काउने भएकाले "password मिल्यो" भन्ने सर्त == 0 हुन्छ — उल्टो पढिन्छ, र ठिक छ। Example 1 Reading five marks and finding the largest Question: write a program that reads five marks into an array and prints the largest one. Decide what the "largest so far" variable should start at. Zero is the obvious choice and it is wrong for one kind of input — work out which. "अहिलेसम्मको ठूलो" variable कहाँबाट सुरु गर्ने निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। शून्य स्वाभाविक लाग्छ तर एक किसिमको input मा गलत हुन्छ — कुनमा, पत्ता लगाउनुहोस्। Working #include <stdio.h> int main() { int marks[5], i, max; printf("Enter five marks: "); for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) scanf("%d", &marks[i]); /* & needed: one element is an int */ max = marks[0]; /* start from a REAL element */ for (i = 1; i < 5; i++) /* start at 1: 0 is already in max */ { if (marks[i] > max) max = marks[i]; } printf("Largest = %d", max); return 0; } Output (if the user types 70 85 60 90 45) Enter five marks: 70 85 60 90 45 Largest = 90 Starting max at marks[0] rather than at 0 is the detail worth the mark. If every value entered were negative — a temperature program, a profit-and-loss program — then max = 0 would report 0, a number that was never entered. Starting from a real element cannot be wrong whatever the data is. Note too that the second loop starts at 1, because element 0 is already the answer so far. अंक बोक्ने कुरा max लाई ० होइन marks[0] बाट सुरु गर्नु हो। सबै मान ऋणात्मक भए — तापक्रमको वा नाफा–नोक्सानको प्रोग्राममा — max = 0 ले कहिल्यै नहालिएको ० लाई उत्तर भन्थ्यो। साँच्चैको element बाट सुरु गरे data जस्तोसुकै भए पनि गलत हुँदैन। अर्को कुरा — दोस्रो loop १ बाट सुरु हुन्छ, किनभने element ० अहिलेसम्मको उत्तर भइसक्यो। Example 2 Sorting a list into ascending order Question: sort five numbers using two nested loops, and say what the outer loop is counting. Work out how many comparisons are needed for five numbers before opening this. If your answer is five, trace the first pass on paper instead. खोल्नुअघि पाँच सङ्ख्याका लागि कति तुलना चाहिन्छ निकाल्नुहोस्। उत्तर पाँच आयो भने बरु कागजमा पहिलो पटक ट्रेस गर्नुहोस्। Working #include <stdio.h> int main() { int a[5] = {40, 10, 50, 20, 30}; int i, j, t; for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) /* 4 passes over the list */ { for (j = 0; j < 4 - i; j++) /* each pass is one shorter */ { if (a[j] > a[j + 1]) /* neighbours out of order? */ { t = a[j]; /* the three-line swap */ a[j] = a[j + 1]; a[j + 1] = t; } } } for (i = 0; i < 5; i++) printf("%d ", a[i]); return 0; } The list after each pass of the outer loop start 40 10 50 20 30 pass 1 10 40 20 30 50 50 has travelled to the end pass 2 10 20 30 40 50 40 is now in place pass 3 10 20 30 40 50 nothing left to move pass 4 10 20 30 40 50 Output 10 20 30 40 50 The outer loop counts passes, not elements: five numbers need four passes, because once four are in place the fifth has nowhere else to be. The inner condition is j < 4 - i rather than j < 4 because the end of the list is already sorted after each pass and comparing it again wastes time. And a[j + 1] is why the inner loop must stop at 4 - i and not 5 - i: at j = 4 it would reach a[5], which is outside the array. बाहिरी loop ले element होइन पटक गन्छ: पाँच सङ्ख्यालाई चार पटक चाहिन्छ, किनभने चार ठाउँमा पुगेपछि पाँचौंको अर्को ठाउँ नै हुँदैन। भित्री सर्त j < 4 होइन j < 4 - i हुनुको कारण हरेक पटकपछि सूचीको अन्त्य मिलिसकेको हुन्छ र फेरि तुलना गर्नु समय खेर फाल्नु हो। अनि a[j + 1] नै भित्री loop 5 - i होइन 4 - i मा रोकिनुपर्ने कारण हो: j = 4 मा यो a[5] सम्म पुग्थ्यो, जुन array बाहिर छ। Practise it — the help comes away
items.ne: · अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: · अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् — सहयोग घट्दै जान्छ Mistakes that cost marks here Starting the index at 1. The first element is a[0] and the last is a[size - 1]. Writing i <= size in the loop. It reads one box past the end, and nothing warns you. Declaring char name[5] for a five-letter word. The null needs a sixth box. Using == to compare two strings. It compares addresses, not text. Use strcmp, and remember it returns 0 for equal. Using = to copy a string. Arrays cannot be assigned; use strcpy. Writing &name in scanf("%s", name). The array name is already an address. Calling strrev and expecting it everywhere. It is not standard C. Index १ बाट सुरु गर्नु: पहिलो element a[0], अन्तिम a[size - 1]। Loop मा i <= size लेख्नु: अन्त्यभन्दा एक बाकस पर पढिन्छ र चेतावनी आउँदैन। पाँच अक्षरका लागि char name[5]: null लाई छैटौं बाकस चाहिन्छ। दुई string तुलना गर्न ==: यसले ठेगाना तुलना गर्छ, पाठ होइन; strcmp चलाउनुहोस् र बराबर भए ० फर्काउँछ सम्झनुहोस्। String सार्न =: array मा assignment चल्दैन; strcpy चलाउनुहोस्। scanf("%s", name) मा &name लेख्नु: array को नाम आफैं ठेगाना हो। strrev जताततै चल्छ भन्ठान्नु: यो मानक C मा छैन। Memory hook — Index from zero, last is size minus one; a string is one box longer than it looks. सम्झने तरिका — Index शून्यबाट, अन्तिम आकार घटाउ एक; string देखिनेभन्दा एक बाकस लामो। Practical work — this unit's other 15 hours
items.ne: — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १५ घण्टा

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.ne: — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Arrays & Strings
items.ne: एरे र स्ट्रिङ

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.3 One-dimensional arrays in use — एक-आयामिक array को प्रयोग
items.en: What you will learn: which element marks[i] is on each turn, and what happens at the end when i reaches 5. The last two steps are the ones worth the attention — they are the off-by-one error, shown rather than described.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक पटक marks[i] कुन element हो, र अन्त्यमा i ५ पुग्दा के हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई चरण नै ध्यान दिनुपर्ने ठाउँ हुन् — off-by-one त्रुटि वर्णन होइन, देखाइएको छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 5.4 Declaration of a string — String को घोषणा
items.en: What you will learn: that storing a five-letter word writes six characters, that strlen reports five, and that the two numbers are both right. Watch the name[5] row appear without any line having put something there.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पाँच अक्षरको शब्द राख्दा छ अक्षर लेखिन्छ, strlen ले पाँच भन्छ, र दुवै सङ्ख्या ठिक छन्। कुनै लाइनले केही नराखी name[5] को पङ्क्ति देखिएको हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: What you will learn: to pick the function from what has to come back — a number, a changed string, or a comparison result. That is how the one-mark questions on this topic are framed.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: के फर्कनुपर्छ हेरेर function छान्न — सङ्ख्या, बदलिएको string, कि तुलनाको नतिजा। यस विषयका एक अंकका प्रश्न यसरी नै सोधिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Option A describes an array, which holds many values of ONE type. A structure is the opposite shape: several values of DIFFERENT types about one thing — a student with a name, a roll number and a percentage. Each variable inside it is called a member and each member has its own memory, which is what separates a structure from a union.
items.ne: विकल्प (क) ले array को वर्णन गर्छ, जसले एउटै प्रकारका धेरै मान राख्छ। Structure उल्टो आकारको हो: एउटै कुराबारे फरक प्रकारका धेरै मान — नाम, roll नम्बर र प्रतिशत भएको विद्यार्थी। भित्रका हरेक variable लाई member भनिन्छ र हरेकको आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ — structure लाई union बाट छुट्याउने कुरा त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A union gives every member the same block of memory, so the block only has to be big enough for the largest member — 4 bytes here. A structure with the same two members would need space for both, so its size would be 5 plus any padding the compiler adds. Size is the clearest single difference between the two and it is the standard way the comparison question is marked.
items.ne: Union ले हरेक member लाई उही मेमोरी block दिन्छ, त्यसैले block सबैभन्दा ठूलो member अट्ने मात्र हुनुपर्छ — यहाँ ४ byte। उही दुई member भएको structure लाई दुवैका लागि ठाउँ चाहिन्थ्यो, त्यसैले आकार ५ र compiler ले थप्ने padding हुन्थ्यो। दुईबीचको सबैभन्दा स्पष्ट फरक आकार नै हो र तुलनात्मक प्रश्नको अंक पनि प्रायः यसैमा दिइन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: There is only one block of memory and both members read it. Writing 88 into b.c put 88 into the first byte of the shared block, so reading b.n afterwards reads the changed bytes and gives 88. A line that named only c has changed what n reads — and that is a union's whole behaviour. In a STRUCTURE both members would keep their own values and the answer would be 65.
items.ne: मेमोरीको एउटै block छ र दुवै member ले त्यही पढ्छन्। b.c मा ८८ लेख्दा साझा block को पहिलो byte मा ८८ पुग्यो, त्यसैले पछि b.n पढ्दा बदलिएका byte पढिन्छन् र ८८ आउँछ। c को मात्र नाम लिने लाइनले n ले पढ्ने कुरा बदल्यो — union को पूरै व्यवहार त्यही हो। STRUCTURE मा दुवै member ले आफ्नो मान राख्थे र उत्तर ६५ हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The dot operator joins a structure VARIABLE to one of its members, so it is s1.roll. Student is the type, and a type reserves no memory, so Student.roll names nothing that exists. The arrow -> is used when you hold a POINTER to a structure rather than the structure itself, which is Grade 10 work; for a plain variable the dot is the operator.
items.ne: Dot operator ले structure को VARIABLE लाई यसको member सँग जोड्छ, त्यसैले s1.roll हुन्छ। Student प्रकार हो, र प्रकारले मेमोरी छुट्याउँदैन — त्यसैले Student.roll ले अस्तित्वमा भएको केही जनाउँदैन। Arrow -> त्यतिबेला चलाइन्छ जब structure आफैं होइन, त्यसको POINTER हुन्छ — त्यो कक्षा १० को कुरा हो; सामान्य variable का लागि dot नै operator हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A structure declaration is a statement, so it ends with a semicolon after the closing brace: struct Student { ... }; A function definition is not a statement and takes no semicolon there; #include is a preprocessor directive and takes none; and a semicolon after int main() would make an empty function and then leave the braces as a stray block. Leaving out the structure semicolon produces an error message pointing at the NEXT line, which is why it is hard to find.
items.ne: Structure को घोषणा statement हो, त्यसैले बन्द brace पछि semicolon ले सकिन्छ: struct Student { ... }; Function definition statement होइन र त्यहाँ semicolon लिँदैन; #include preprocessor directive हो र लिँदैन; अनि int main() पछि semicolon राखे खाली function बन्थ्यो र brace छुट्टै block बन्थ्यो। Structure को semicolon छुटाउँदा त्रुटि सन्देशले पछिल्लो लाइन देखाउँछ — त्यसैले भेट्न गाह्रो हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: In C the keyword struct is part of the type name, so the declaration is struct Student s1;. Writing Student s1; alone does not compile unless a typedef has given the type a shorter name. The other two options are C++ and Java syntax: C has no new operator, and a structure variable is created by declaring it, exactly like an int.
items.ne: C मा struct keyword प्रकारकै नामको भाग हो, त्यसैले घोषणा struct Student s1; हुन्छ। typedef ले छोटो नाम नदिएसम्म Student s1; मात्रले compile हुँदैन। अरू दुई विकल्प C++ र Java का syntax हुन्: C मा new operator छैन, र structure को variable int जस्तै घोषणा गरेरै बन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: The two conditions in the question are exactly the two a union needs: only one member is in use at any moment, and memory is scarce. Sharing one block then costs nothing, because the unused member had no value worth keeping. A structure would be safe but would reserve space for both members, which is the memory the device does not have. Saving memory is the only reason a union exists, and it is the reason to give in an answer.
items.ne: प्रश्नका दुई सर्त union लाई चाहिने ठ्याक्कै दुई सर्त हुन्: कुनै पनि क्षणमा एउटै member प्रयोगमा हुनु, र मेमोरी थोरै हुनु। तब एउटै block बाँड्दा केही लागत छैन, किनभने प्रयोगमा नभएको member सँग राख्नुपर्ने मान नै थिएन। Structure सुरक्षित त हुन्थ्यो तर दुवै member का लागि ठाउँ छुट्याउँथ्यो — र त्यही मेमोरी यन्त्रसँग छैन। Union हुनुको एकमात्र कारण मेमोरी बचत हो, र उत्तरमा दिनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Structure or union?
items.ne: Structure कि union?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: They are declared almost identically and they behave completely differently, because a structure gives every member its own memory and a union makes them share one space. Decide from what the program needs.
items.ne: घोषणा झन्डै उस्तै र व्यवहार पूरै फरक — structure ले हरेक member लाई आफ्नै मेमोरी दिन्छ, union ले सबैलाई एउटै ठाउँ बाँड्न लगाउँछ। प्रोग्रामलाई के चाहिन्छ हेरेर निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Every member has to hold its own value at the same time, which is precisely what a structure gives and a union cannot. A record of several facts about one thing is the standard use of a structure.
items.ne: हरेक member ले एकैचोटि आफ्नै मान राख्नुपर्छ, र त्यही structure ले दिन्छ, union ले दिँदैन। एउटै कुराबारे धेरै तथ्यको record राख्नु structure को मानक प्रयोग हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Only one member is in use at any moment, so sharing one block of memory wastes nothing and saves the rest. Saving memory is the only reason a union exists, and it is the reason to give in an answer.
items.ne: कुनै पनि क्षणमा एउटा member मात्र प्रयोगमा हुन्छ, त्यसैले एउटै मेमोरी बाँड्दा केही खेर जाँदैन। Union हुनुको एकमात्र कारण मेमोरी बचाउनु हो, र उत्तरमा दिनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Writing one member overwrites the shared space and the others become meaningless, which only happens in a union. In a structure each member keeps its own bytes and reading another is perfectly safe.
items.ne: एउटा member लेख्दा साझा ठाउँ मेटिन्छ र अरूको अर्थ रहँदैन — यो union मा मात्र हुन्छ। Structure मा हरेक member का आफ्नै byte हुन्छन् र अर्को पढ्नु पूरै सुरक्षित हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: One shared space has to be big enough for the biggest member and no bigger, so the size is the largest and not the total. A structure adds its members up, which is the standard comparison question.
items.ne: एउटै साझा ठाउँ सबैभन्दा ठूलो member अट्ने हुनुपर्छ, अरू होइन — त्यसैले आकार सबैभन्दा ठूलोको हुन्छ, जोड होइन। Structure ले सबै जोड्छ, र मानक तुलनात्मक प्रश्न त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.4 Introduction to union — Union को परिचय
items.en: The same two members twice. The left layout is why a structure's size is the total; the right layout is why a union's is the largest member, and why writing one member changes the other.
items.ne: उही दुई member, दुई पटक। बायाँको बनोटले structure को आकार किन जोड हुन्छ देखाउँछ; दायाँकोले union को आकार किन सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर हुन्छ, र एउटा member लेख्दा अर्को किन बदलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Choose between the two for a given problem and justify the choice.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: structure भनेको के हो र array ले यसको काम किन गर्न सक्दैन भन्न, structure घोषणा गरेर त्यसको variable बनाउन र dot operator ले member मा पुग्न, union घोषणा गरेर यसका member मा पुग्न, union को एउटा member लेख्दा अरू किन बदलिन्छन् बुझाउन, उही member भएका structure र union को आकार दिएर किन फरक हुन्छ भन्न, र दिइएको समस्यामा दुईमध्ये एउटा छानेर कारण दिन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.3 Accessing a member — the dot operator — Member मा पुग्ने — dot operator
items.en: Write the scanf lines before opening this. One of the three members takes no ampersand — decide which, and why.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि scanf का लाइन लेख्नुहोस्। तीनमध्ये एउटा member लाई ampersand चाहिँदैन — कुन र किन, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.3 Accessing a member — the dot operator — Member मा पुग्ने — dot operator
items.en: Three things are being marked. The semicolon after the closing brace. The word struct in front of Student s1. And the dot operator: s1.roll means "the roll member of the variable s1", and the dot joins a variable to a member — never a type to a member, because Student.roll names no memory. Note also %% at the end: a single % would be read as the start of a specifier.
items.ne: तीन कुराको अंक छ। बन्द brace पछिको semicolon। Student s1 अगाडिको struct शब्द। अनि dot operator: s1.roll को अर्थ "s1 variable को roll member" हो, र dot ले variable लाई member सँग जोड्छ — प्रकारलाई कहिल्यै होइन, किनभने Student.roll ले कुनै मेमोरी जनाउँदैन। अन्त्यको %% पनि हेर्नुहोस्: एउटै % लाई specifier को सुरु पढिन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.4 Introduction to union — Union को परिचय
items.en: Option A is the two answers swapped, which is the usual way this is got wrong.
items.ne: Structure कम्तीमा ९, union ४। Structure ले हरेक member लाई आफ्नै मेमोरी दिन्छ, त्यसैले आकार जोड हुन्छ: 4 + 1 + 4 = 9। Union ले एउटै साझा block दिन्छ, त्यसैले आकार सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर — ४। ठ्याक्कै ९ नभई "कम्तीमा" ९ भनिनुको कारण पनि जान्नु राम्रो: हरेक member लाई उसको प्रकारले मन पराउने ठेगानाबाट सुरु गराउन compiler ले padding भनिने प्रयोगविहीन byte थप्छ, त्यसैले वास्तविक मेसिनले प्रायः ९ होइन १२ भन्छ। नियम जोड हो; नाप ठूलो हुन सक्छ। परीक्षाले खोज्ने उत्तर "member को जोड" हो, र padding सँग भेट प्रयोगात्मक कक्षामा sizeof आफैं नापेर हुन्छ। विकल्प (क) मा दुई उत्तर साटिएका छन्, र यो प्रायः त्यसरी नै बिग्रन्छ।

items.en: s[i].roll reads left to right: take element i of the array, then take its roll member. The index comes first because the array is of structures, not a structure of arrays. Note the two scanf arguments: s[i].name is a char array and takes no ampersand, &s[i].roll is an int and does — the same rule as always, applied inside a structure. Without the structure, five students would need two separate arrays kept in step with each other by hand.
items.ne: s[i].roll बायाँबाट दायाँ पढिन्छ: array को i औं element लिने, अनि त्यसको roll member। Index पहिले आउँछ, किनभने यो structure हरूको array हो, array हरूको structure होइन। scanf का दुई argument हेर्नुहोस्: s[i].name char array हो र ampersand लिँदैन, &s[i].roll int हो र लिन्छ — उही पुरानो नियम, structure भित्र लागू भएको। Structure नभए पाँच विद्यार्थीका लागि दुई छुट्टाछुट्टै array हातैले मिलाएर राख्नुपर्थ्यो।

Keyword: struct र union; dot operator सहित बाँकी syntax उस्तै। ५. प्रयोग: एउटै कुराबारे धेरै तथ्यको record लाई structure; एउटै member मात्र प्रयोगमा हुँदा मेमोरी बचाउन union। उदाहरण: { int n; char c; } मा structure लाई ५ byte चाहिन्छ र दुवै मान रहन्छन्, union लाई ४ चाहिन्छ र अन्तिम लेखिएको मात्र रहन्छ।

items.ne: Structure ले फरक प्रकारका variable लाई एउटै नाममुनि राख्छ; हरेक member को आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ। Structure घोषणा गर्दा केही छुट्टिँदैन; त्यसको variable घोषणा गर्दा छुट्टिन्छ। बन्द brace पछिको semicolon अनिवार्य छ, र C मा struct प्रकारकै नामको भाग हो। Dot operator ले variable लाई member सँग जोड्छ: s1.roll। Union उही तरिकाले घोषणा हुन्छ र हरेक member लाई उही मेमोरी दिन्छ। Structure को आकार जोड; union को सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर। Union मा अन्तिम लेखिएको member सँग मात्र अर्थपूर्ण मान हुन्छ। Record का लागि structure, मेमोरी बचाउन union।

items.ne: अन्तिम चरणअघि b.n ले के छाप्छ अनुमान गर्नुहोस्। झन्डै सबैले ६५ भन्छन्, किनभने त्यहाँ राखिएको त्यही थियो — र त्यसपछि कुनै लाइनले n को नाम लिएकै छैन।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.4 Introduction to union — Union को परिचय
items.en: Two clues give a union away every time: a size equal to the largest member rather than the total, and a member going strange after a different member was written.
items.ne: दुई सुराकले union सधैं चिनाउँछन्: आकार जोड नभई सबैभन्दा ठूलो member बराबर हुनु, र अर्को member लेखेपछि एउटा member अनौठो हुनु।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.1 Introduction to structure — Structure को परिचय
items.en: When one thing has several different facts about it An array holds many values of the same type. A student record is several values of different types about one person: a name (text), a roll number (an integer), a percentage (a float). No array can hold that. A structure is a user-defined data type that groups variables of different types under one name. Each variable inside it is a member, and every member has its own memory. Why it matters beyond tidiness: once struct Student exists, you can make an array of structures — struct Student s[50]; — and one declaration holds fifty complete records. That is what every real program storing people, products or marks actually does.
items.ne: एउटै कुराबारे धेरै फरक तथ्य हुँदा Array ले एउटै प्रकारका धेरै मान राख्छ। विद्यार्थीको record भनेको एउटै व्यक्तिबारे फरक प्रकारका धेरै मान हो: नाम (पाठ), roll नम्बर (integer), प्रतिशत (float)। त्यो कुनै array ले राख्न सक्दैन। Structure भनेको प्रयोगकर्ता-परिभाषित data type हो, जसले फरक प्रकारका variable लाई एउटै नाममुनि समूहबद्ध गर्छ। भित्रका हरेक variable लाई member भनिन्छ, र हरेक member को आफ्नै मेमोरी हुन्छ। सफा देखिनुभन्दा बढी किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: struct Student बनेपछि तपाईंले structure को array बनाउन सक्नुहुन्छ — struct Student s[50]; — र एउटै घोषणाले पचास पूरा record राख्छ। मान्छे, सामान वा अंक राख्ने हरेक वास्तविक प्रोग्रामले गर्ने काम त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.2 Declaring a structure and a structure variable — Structure र त्यसको variable घोषणा
items.en: The declaration is a blueprint, not a box Declaring a structure creates a new data type and reserves no memory at all. It is a description of what such a variable would look like — the worked example below shows one in full. Memory is reserved when you declare a variable of that type: struct Student s1;. The keyword struct is part of the type name in C and cannot be left out — Student s1; alone will not compile. The semicolon after the closing brace is compulsory. A structure declaration is a statement, unlike a function definition, and leaving the semicolon out produces an error message that points at the next line and reads as if something else were wrong.
items.ne: घोषणा नक्सा हो, बाकस होइन Structure घोषणा गर्दा नयाँ data type बन्छ र मेमोरी बिलकुलै छुट्टिँदैन। यो त्यस्तो variable कस्तो हुन्छ भन्ने वर्णन मात्र हो — तलको worked example मा पूरै देखाइएको छ। त्यो प्रकारको variable घोषणा गर्दा मात्र मेमोरी छुट्टिन्छ: struct Student s1;। C मा struct keyword प्रकारको नाम कै भाग हो र छाड्न मिल्दैन — Student s1; मात्रले compile हुँदैन। बन्द गर्ने brace पछि semicolon अनिवार्य छ। Function definition भन्दा फरक, structure को घोषणा statement हो, र semicolon छुटे आउने त्रुटि सन्देशले अर्कै लाइन देखाउँछ र अरू केही बिग्रेजस्तो पढिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.4 Introduction to union — Union को परिचय
items.en: The same declaration, one shared box A union is declared exactly like a structure, with the keyword union instead. It groups members of different types under one name — and it gives all of them the same memory. So a union's size is the size of its largest member, not the total. And only one member holds a meaningful value at a time: writing to one overwrites whatever the others were showing, because there is only one block of bytes and they are all reading it. Why would anyone want that? To save memory, when a value is sometimes one type and sometimes another but never both at once — a reading that is either a whole count or a decimal measurement, on a device with very little memory. Saving memory is the only reason a union exists, and it is the reason to give in an answer.
items.ne: उही घोषणा, एउटै साझा बाकस Union लाई structure कै जस्तो घोषणा गरिन्छ, keyword मात्र union हुन्छ। यसले फरक प्रकारका member लाई एउटै नाममुनि राख्छ — र सबैलाई उही मेमोरी दिन्छ। त्यसैले union को आकार जोड होइन, सबैभन्दा ठूलो member को आकार हुन्छ। अनि एक पटकमा एउटै member सँग अर्थपूर्ण मान हुन्छ: एउटामा लेख्दा अरूले देखाइरहेको कुरा मेटिन्छ, किनभने byte को एउटै block छ र सबैले त्यही पढिरहेका छन्। कसैले किन त्यो चाहन्छ? मेमोरी बचाउन — जब कुनै मान कहिले एक प्रकारको र कहिले अर्को हुन्छ तर एकैचोटि दुवै कहिल्यै हुँदैन; जस्तै थोरै मेमोरी भएको यन्त्रमा कि पूर्ण गन्ती कि दशमलव नाप। Union हुनुको एकमात्र कारण मेमोरी बचत हो, र उत्तरमा दिनुपर्ने कारण पनि त्यही।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.4 Introduction to union — Union को परिचय
items.en: 6.5 and 6.6 — declaring and accessing Both work exactly as they do for a structure, and that is the point worth stating plainly: union Box b; declares the variable, and b.n reaches a member with the same dot operator. Nothing in the syntax distinguishes a union from a structure anywhere in a program — not the declaration, not the variable, not the access. The only difference is what the memory does, which is why the diagram above is the whole topic. One practical rule follows from it: read back the member you wrote last. Writing b.n and then reading b.c is not an error the compiler will stop, and the value you get is the same bytes interpreted as a different type.
items.ne: ६.५ र ६.६ — घोषणा र पहुँच दुवै structure मा जस्तै ठ्याक्कै उसरी नै चल्छन्, र स्पष्ट भन्नुपर्ने कुरा त्यही हो: union Box b; ले variable घोषणा गर्छ, र b.n ले उही dot operator ले member मा पुग्छ। प्रोग्रामको कुनै ठाउँमा syntax ले union लाई structure बाट छुट्याउँदैन — न घोषणाले, न variable ले, न पहुँचले। फरक मेमोरीले के गर्छ भन्नेमा मात्र छ, र त्यसैले माथिको चित्र नै पूरै विषय हो। यसबाट एउटा व्यावहारिक नियम निस्कन्छ: अन्तिम पटक लेखेकै member पढ्नुहोस्। b.n लेखेर b.c पढ्नु compiler ले रोक्ने त्रुटि होइन, र आउने मान उही byte लाई फरक प्रकारका रूपमा पढेको नतिजा हो।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.topic: 6.4 Introduction to union — Union को परिचय
items.en: Memory hook — Structure: everyone gets a room. Union: everyone shares one room. Size is the total, or the largest.
items.ne: सम्झने तरिका — Structure: सबैलाई आ–आफ्नो कोठा। Union: सबैले एउटै कोठा बाँड्ने। आकार जोड, कि सबैभन्दा ठूलो।

items.en: For { int n; char c; float f; } with int 4 bytes, char 1 and float 4, what is sizeof for the structure and for the union?

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: A structure is the answer to the question an array leaves open: an array holds many values of ONE type, and a record needs several values of DIFFERENT types. The comparison only lands if the array half is solid.
items.ne: Array ले खुला छाडेको प्रश्नको उत्तर नै structure हो: array ले एउटै प्रकारका धेरै मान राख्छ, record लाई फरक प्रकारका धेरै मान चाहिन्छ। Array को भाग पक्का भए मात्र यो तुलना बुझिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/c-programming
items.en: Why a union saves memory is a question about SIZE, and size is 2.5 — how many bytes an int takes against a char. Without that, "the largest member" is a phrase rather than a number.
items.ne: Union ले किन मेमोरी बचाउँछ भन्ने प्रश्न आकारको हो, र आकार २.५ हो — int ले कति byte लिन्छ, char ले कति। त्यो नभए "सबैभन्दा ठूलो member" सङ्ख्या नभई वाक्यांश मात्र हुन्छ।

items.en: A union gives its members one space to share
