items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A pocket calculator takes numbers in, adds them, and shows a result. By the definition above, is it a computer? पकेट क्यालकुलेटरले संख्या लिन्छ, जोड्छ र नतिजा देखाउँछ। माथिको परिभाषाअनुसार के यो कम्प्युटर हो? Yes — it takes input and gives output No — it has no stored program Yes — it is electronic No. It is electronic and it does process input into output, so it passes two parts of the test. What it cannot do is hold a list of instructions and follow them on its own — you press every key yourself. That is the line the definition draws, and it is why "stored instructions" is in it. A programmable scientific calculator sits much closer to the line, which is a fair thing to notice. होइन। यो इलेक्ट्रोनिक छ र इनपुटलाई आउटपुटमा बदल्छ पनि, त्यसैले जाँचका दुई भाग पास गर्छ। तर निर्देशनको सूची राखेर आफैं पछ्याउन सक्दैन — हरेक बटन तपाईं आफैं थिच्नुहुन्छ। परिभाषाले कोर्ने रेखा यही हो, र "भण्डारण गरिएका निर्देशन" त्यसैले राखिएको हो। 1.2 Characteristics of a computer What a computer is good at Speed — it works in millionths and billionths of a second. A task that would take a clerk a week can finish while you wait. Accuracy — it does not make mistakes in its own arithmetic. Diligence — it does not get bored or tired. The ten-thousandth calculation is done exactly as carefully as the first. Versatility — the same machine prints a bill, plays a song and checks spelling, because changing the program changes the job. Storage — it keeps very large amounts of data and finds any part of it again. Automation — once started, it carries out a whole job without a person at each step. Reliability — it gives the same answer to the same question every time. कम्प्युटर केमा राम्रो छ गति — ऊ सेकेन्डको दशलाख र अर्बौं भागमा काम गर्छ। कर्मचारीलाई हप्ता लाग्ने काम तपाईं पर्खिरहँदै सकिन्छ। शुद्धता — आफ्नै गणनामा ऊ गल्ती गर्दैन। लगनशीलता — ऊ दिक्क हुँदैन, थाक्दैन। दश हजारौं गणना पनि पहिलोजत्तिकै ध्यान दिएर हुन्छ। बहुउपयोगिता — उही मेसिनले बिल छाप्छ, गीत बजाउँछ र हिज्जे जाँच्छ, किनभने प्रोग्राम फेर्दा काम फेरिन्छ। भण्डारण — ऊ धेरै ठूलो मात्रामा data राख्छ र त्यसको जुनसुकै भाग फेरि भेट्टाउँछ। स्वचालन — एकपटक सुरु गरेपछि हरेक चरणमा मान्छे नचाहिने गरी पूरै काम सिध्याउँछ। भरपर्दोपन — उही प्रश्नको उत्तर उसले हरेक पटक उही दिन्छ। GIGO — the one that costs marks. "Accuracy" means the machine does not make arithmetic mistakes. It does not mean the answer is right. If you type a student's marks as 850 instead of 85, the computer will average 850 perfectly and hand you a wrong result. Garbage In, Garbage Out. Accuracy is a property of the machine; correctness is a property of the data you gave it. GIGO — यहीँ अंक जान्छ। "शुद्धता" भनेको मेसिनले गणनामा गल्ती गर्दैन भन्ने हो। उत्तर नै सही हुन्छ भनेको होइन। विद्यार्थीको अंक ८५ का साटो ८५० टाइप गर्नुभयो भने कम्प्युटरले ८५० लाई ठ्याक्कै सही औसत निकालिदिन्छ, र गलत नतिजा दिन्छ। Garbage In, Garbage Out. शुद्धता मेसिनको गुण हो; सहीपन तपाईंले दिएको data को गुण हो। Example 1 Which characteristic is the answer? Question: a school enters 1,200 students' marks. The computer calculates every average in two seconds, and every one of them is wrong because the marks were entered from the wrong register. Which characteristic does this show, and which does it NOT disprove? Two characteristics are in play and the question separates them. Decide which one the two seconds demonstrates, and which one the wrong answers do not touch, before you open this. दुई विशेषता खेलमा छन् र प्रश्नले तिनलाई छुट्याउँछ। दुई सेकेन्डले कुन देखाउँछ, र गलत उत्तरले कुनलाई छुँदैन — खोल्नुअघि निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। Working Two seconds for 1,200 averages -> SPEED Every average arithmetically correct -> ACCURACY is intact The answers are useless -> the DATA was wrong, not the machine The marks lost here are usually lost by writing "this shows the computer is not accurate". It is accurate — it averaged exactly what it was given. The example is GIGO, and naming GIGO is what earns the mark. यहाँ अंक प्रायः "यसले कम्प्युटर शुद्ध छैन भन्ने देखाउँछ" लेखेर जान्छ। ऊ शुद्ध छ — उसलाई दिइएकै कुराको ठ्याक्कै औसत निकाल्यो। यो उदाहरण GIGO हो, र GIGO नाम लिनुले नै अंक दिलाउँछ। 1.3 Modern applications of the computer Where computers are actually used in Nepal Education — school records and results, online classes, and the material you are reading now. Banking and money — accounts, ATMs, mobile banking, and the remittance that reaches a village from abroad in minutes rather than weeks. Government — citizenship and land records, the national ID, online passport applications, and tax filing. Health — patient records at a hospital or health post, laboratory machines, and telemedicine that lets a doctor in Kathmandu advise a health worker in a hill district. Communication — email, messaging and video calls. Transport and tourism — online bus and flight booking, and hotel systems. Weather and disaster warning — forecasting the monsoon and giving flood warning downstream, which in Nepal is a use that saves lives. Agriculture — market prices, weather advice and soil records reaching farmers by phone. नेपालमा कम्प्युटर साँच्चै कहाँ प्रयोग हुन्छ शिक्षा — विद्यालयको अभिलेख र नतिजा, अनलाइन कक्षा, र तपाईंले अहिले पढिरहेको यो सामग्री। बैंकिङ र पैसा — खाता, ATM, मोबाइल बैंकिङ, र विदेशबाट गाउँसम्म हप्तौंमा होइन मिनेटमै पुग्ने रेमिट्यान्स। सरकारी काम — नागरिकता र जग्गाको अभिलेख, राष्ट्रिय परिचयपत्र, अनलाइन राहदानी आवेदन, र कर दाखिला। स्वास्थ्य — अस्पताल र स्वास्थ्य चौकीमा बिरामीको अभिलेख, प्रयोगशालाका मेसिन, र काठमाडौंको डाक्टरले पहाडी जिल्लाको स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई सल्लाह दिन मिल्ने टेलिमेडिसिन। सञ्चार — इमेल, म्यासेज र भिडियो कल। यातायात र पर्यटन — अनलाइन बस र हवाई टिकट, होटेलका प्रणाली। मौसम र विपद् सूचना — मनसुनको पूर्वानुमान र तल्लो तटमा बाढीको चेतावनी — नेपालमा यो ज्यान बचाउने प्रयोग हो। कृषि — बजार भाउ, मौसमको सल्लाह र माटोको अभिलेख फोनबाटै किसानसम्म। 1.4 Classification of computers Five questions, not one list Computers are classified on five different bases, and this is where the unit's marks usually are. The mistake to avoid is treating them as one long list. They are five separate questions, and every computer has an answer to all five at once. By size — supercomputer, mainframe, minicomputer, microcomputer. This asks how much work the machine can do at once. By data handling — analog, digital, hybrid. This asks what kind of signal it works with. Analog measures something that changes smoothly, like a voltage. Digital counts in 0s and 1s. Hybrid does both: a fuel pump measures flowing petrol and prints a digital bill. By purpose — general purpose (you can load new programs onto it) or special purpose (built for one job, like the computer in a washing machine). By model — the physical form: desktop, laptop, palmtop and similar. By brand — IBM PC, IBM compatible, Apple. पाँच प्रश्न, एउटै सूची होइन कम्प्युटरको वर्गीकरण पाँच फरक आधार मा हुन्छ, र यस युनिटका अंक प्रायः यहीँ हुन्छन्। बच्नुपर्ने गल्ती — यिनलाई एउटै लामो सूची ठान्नु। यी पाँच छुट्टाछुट्टै प्रश्न हुन्, र हरेक कम्प्युटरसँग पाँचैको उत्तर एकैचोटि हुन्छ। आकार अनुसार — supercomputer, mainframe, minicomputer, microcomputer। यसले मेसिनले एकैपटक कति काम गर्न सक्छ सोध्छ। डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ अनुसार — analog, digital, hybrid। यसले कस्तो सङ्केतसँग काम गर्छ सोध्छ। Analog ले बिस्तारै बदलिने कुरा नाप्छ, जस्तै भोल्टेज। Digital ले ० र १ मा गन्छ। Hybrid ले दुवै गर्छ: पेट्रोल पम्पले बग्ने पेट्रोल नाप्छ र digital बिल छाप्छ। प्रयोजन अनुसार — general purpose (नयाँ प्रोग्राम हाल्न मिल्ने) वा special purpose (एउटै कामका लागि बनेको, जस्तै वासिङ मेसिनभित्रको कम्प्युटर)। मोडेल अनुसार — भौतिक आकार: desktop, laptop, palmtop र यस्तै। ब्रान्ड अनुसार — IBM PC, IBM compatible, Apple। Where these categories come from The curriculum names the five bases and stops there. Its exact words for topic 1.4 are "on the basis of size, on the data handling, on the purpose, on the model, on the brand" — and it lists no categories at all under any of them. So the lists above are the standard textbook treatment, not quoted curriculum text. For size, data handling and purpose that distinction barely matters: every book and every paper uses the same categories. Model and brand are different. Books disagree about them, and IBM PC / IBM compatible / Apple is a convention from an older generation of computing that some teachers no longer use. Check these two against your own textbook and what your teacher writes on the board, and follow those if they differ from this page. पाठ्यक्रमले पाँच आधार मात्र नाम लिन्छ, त्यहीँ रोकिन्छ। विषय १.४ मा यसका ठ्याक्कै शब्द — "on the basis of size, on the data handling, on the purpose, on the model, on the brand" — र कुनै पनि आधारमुनि कुनै वर्ग लेखिएको छैन। त्यसैले माथिका सूची मानक पाठ्यपुस्तकको प्रचलन हुन्, पाठ्यक्रमकै उद्धरण होइनन्। आकार, डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ र प्रयोजनमा यो फरकले खासै अर्थ राख्दैन — सबै पुस्तक र सबै प्रश्नपत्रले उही वर्ग चलाउँछन्। मोडेल र ब्रान्ड भने फरक हुन्। पुस्तकहरूबीच मत बाझिन्छ, र IBM PC / IBM compatible / Apple पुरानो पुस्ताको प्रचलन हो, जुन कतिपय शिक्षकले अहिले चलाउनुहुन्न। यी दुईलाई आफ्नै पाठ्यपुस्तक र शिक्षकले बोर्डमा लेख्नुभएकोसँग मिलाएर हेर्नुहोस्, र फरक परे त्यही मान्नुहोस्। {{dia:cfClassify}} Read the left column first. The exam names a basis and asks for its categories, or names a category and asks which basis it belongs to. The five bases are the curriculum's; the categories beside them are the usual textbook ones. पहिले बायाँ स्तम्भ पढ्नुहोस्। परीक्षाले कि आधार दिएर त्यसका वर्ग सोध्छ, कि वर्ग दिएर कुन आधारको हो सोध्छ। पाँच आधार पाठ्यक्रमका हुन्; छेउका वर्ग सामान्य पाठ्यपुस्तकका। Practise the judgement

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which basis of classification is being used? What you will learn: to tell the five bases apart on a real case rather than by reciting the list. Six cases, and two of them answer the same basis for different reasons. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: सूची घोकेर होइन, वास्तविक केसमा पाँच आधार छुट्याउन। छ केस छन्, र तीमध्ये दुईले फरक कारणले उही आधारको उत्तर दिन्छन्। How to use this Before pressing anything, say out loud what question the case is answering. How much work? size. What kind of signal? data handling. How many different jobs? purpose. What shape? model. Who made it? brand. Case 3 is the one worth reading the reason for even if you get it right. The washing machine is also micro and also digital — more than one answer is true of the machine, and only one answers the question asked. केही थिच्नुअघि यो केसले कुन प्रश्नको उत्तर दिँदै छ भन्नुहोस्। कति काम? आकार। कस्तो सङ्केत? डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ। कति फरक काम? प्रयोजन। कस्तो आकार? मोडेल। कसले बनायो? ब्रान्ड। केस ३ को कारण सही भए पनि पढ्नुहोस्: वासिङ मेसिन micro पनि हो, digital पनि — मेसिनका लागि एकभन्दा बढी उत्तर सही हुन्छन्, तर सोधिएको प्रश्नको उत्तर एउटै हुन्छ। Example 2 Classify one machine five ways Question: a student's laptop, made by Apple, used for homework, browsing and music. Place it in all five classifications. Work down the five bases in order and answer each one separately. Write your five answers before opening this. पाँच आधार क्रमैसँग लिनुहोस् र हरेकको छुट्टै उत्तर दिनुहोस्। खोल्नुअघि आफ्ना पाँच उत्तर लेख्नुहोस्। Working by size MICROCOMPUTER one person uses it at a time by data handling DIGITAL it works in 0s and 1s by purpose GENERAL PURPOSE homework, browsing and music are different jobs by model LAPTOP that is its physical form by brand APPLE who made it One machine, five answers, none of them competing. A question that gives you a machine and asks for "the classification" is asking for all five unless it names a basis. एउटै मेसिन, पाँच उत्तर, कुनै पनि एकअर्कासँग बाझिँदैनन्। मेसिन दिएर "वर्गीकरण" सोध्ने प्रश्नले आधार नतोकेसम्म पाँचै खोजेको हुन्छ। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying a computer is "not accurate" when the output is wrong. If the input was wrong, that is GIGO. Accuracy describes the machine's arithmetic, not your typing. आउटपुट गलत हुँदा कम्प्युटर "शुद्ध छैन" भन्नु। इनपुट गलत थियो भने त्यो GIGO हो। शुद्धताले मेसिनको गणना जनाउँछ, तपाईंको टाइपिङ होइन। Mixing the five bases into one list. "Supercomputer, digital, laptop" is not a classification — it is one answer from each of three different questions. पाँच आधारलाई एउटै सूचीमा मिसाउनु। "Supercomputer, digital, laptop" वर्गीकरण होइन — यी तीन फरक प्रश्नका एक–एक उत्तर हुन्। Calling a calculator a computer. It has no stored program; you press every key. क्यालकुलेटरलाई कम्प्युटर भन्नु। त्यसमा भण्डारण गरिएको प्रोग्राम छैन; हरेक बटन तपाईं थिच्नुहुन्छ। Using "data" and "information" as the same word. Data goes in, information comes out; the processing in between is the difference. "Data" र "information" लाई उही शब्द ठान्नु। Data भित्र जान्छ, information बाहिर आउँछ; बीचको प्रशोधन नै फरक हो। Data in, information out. Accuracy is the machine's; correctness is yours. Data भित्र, information बाहिर। शुद्धता मेसिनको, सहीपन तपाईंको। Practical work — this unit's other 10 hours Why this section exists This unit is 18 hours, not 8. The 8 hours above are theory; the curriculum gives this unit 10 more hours of practical work, and lists six activities for them. Those activities are worth real marks. Of the 50 internal marks for this subject, 18 are practical work (15 for doing it, 3 for keeping records) and 12 are project work (10 for doing it, 2 for records). A further 5 are a viva in which you explain your own practical and project work. This website cannot do any of them for you. They are chart paper, presentations and a speech to your class. What it can do is tell you exactly what is required, what you need, and what to keep so that the marks are there when they are counted. यो खण्ड किन छ यो युनिट ८ होइन, १८ घण्टाको हो। माथिका ८ घण्टा सैद्धान्तिक हुन्; पाठ्यक्रमले यस युनिटलाई १० घण्टा प्रयोगात्मक काम दिएको छ, र त्यसका लागि छ वटा क्रियाकलाप तोकेको छ। ती क्रियाकलापका साँच्चिकै अंक छन्। यस विषयका ५० आन्तरिक अंकमध्ये १८ अंक प्रयोगात्मक काम (गर्नेको १५, अभिलेखको ३) र १२ अंक प्रोजेक्ट काम (गर्नेको १०, अभिलेखको २) हुन्। थप ५ अंक भाइभाका, जहाँ तपाईंले आफ्नै प्रयोगात्मक र प्रोजेक्ट काम बुझाउनुपर्छ। यी काम यो वेबसाइटले तपाईंका लागि गरिदिन सक्दैन। यी चार्ट पेपर, प्रस्तुतीकरण र कक्षामा बोल्ने काम हुन्। यसले गर्न सक्ने कुरा — के चाहिन्छ, के गर्नुपर्छ र के राख्नुपर्छ ठ्याक्कै बताउने, ताकि अंक गणना हुँदा ती तपाईंसँग होऊन्। Guided practicalThe six activities the curriculum suggests These are the curriculum's own six for Unit 1, quoted from its practical list. The document calls them samples and says a teacher may set other work instead, as the student's need or the school's context requires — so treat this as what is expected of you unless your teacher says otherwise. The 10 hours are not a sample. They are the unit's practical allocation. यी युनिट १ का लागि पाठ्यक्रमकै छ वटा क्रियाकलाप हुन्, त्यसकै प्रयोगात्मक सूचीबाट लिइएका। पाठ्यक्रमले यिनलाई नमुना भनेको छ र विद्यार्थीको आवश्यकता वा विद्यालयको सन्दर्भअनुसार शिक्षकले अरू काम दिन सक्ने लेखेको छ — त्यसैले शिक्षकले अर्कै नभनेसम्म यही नै अपेक्षा हो भनी लिनुहोस्। १० घण्टा चाहिँ नमुना होइन — त्यो युनिटकै प्रयोगात्मक समय हो। 1.1 Draw "Computer and its parts" on chart paper and demonstrate it. You need: chart paper, markers, a ruler. Builds on: 1.1, the block diagram. Hand in: the chart, plus a photograph of it in your record file. Label input, process, output and storage — a chart that names the parts without naming the four stages is a picture, not a block diagram. चाहिन्छ: चार्ट पेपर, मार्कर, रुलर। आधार: १.१ को ब्लक चित्र। बुझाउने: चार्ट र त्यसको फोटो अभिलेख फाइलमा। input, process, output र storage नाम लेख्नुहोस् — चार चरण नलेखेको चार्ट ब्लक चित्र होइन, तस्बिर मात्र हो। 1.2 Make a presentation on (a) features of computer and (b) modern application areas of computer. You need: presentation software, or paper slides if no computer is free. Builds on: 1.2 and 1.3. Hand in: the file or the slides, and your speaking notes. For (b), use examples from Nepal — the ones in 1.3 are a starting list, not a limit. चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर, वा कम्प्युटर खाली नभए कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: १.२ र १.३। बुझाउने: फाइल वा स्लाइड, र बोल्ने नोट। (ख) का लागि नेपालकै उदाहरण लिनुहोस् — १.३ को सूची सुरुवात हो, सीमा होइन। 1.3 Take part in a speech competition on "Role of computer in education". You need: a prepared speech and a class audience — this one is organised by your teacher. Builds on: 1.3. Hand in: your written speech in your record file. Your own school is the strongest example you have. चाहिन्छ: तयार गरेको भाषण र कक्षाका श्रोता — यो शिक्षकले मिलाउनुहुन्छ। आधार: १.३। बुझाउने: लेखेको भाषण अभिलेख फाइलमा। सबैभन्दा बलियो उदाहरण तपाईंकै विद्यालय हो। 1.4 Draw "Types of computer on the basis of working principle" on chart paper and display it in your classroom. You need: chart paper and markers. Builds on: 1.4 — working principle is the data handling basis: analog, digital, hybrid. Hand in: the chart. Give each type one real example; the fuel pump in the drill above is a hybrid one. चाहिन्छ: चार्ट पेपर, मार्कर। आधार: १.४ — working principle भनेको डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ को आधार हो: analog, digital, hybrid। बुझाउने: चार्ट। हरेक किसिमको एउटा वास्तविक उदाहरण दिनुहोस्। 1.5 Prepare a presentation on the use and purpose of hybrid and super computers in different sectors, and demonstrate it. You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 1.4. Hand in: the file and your notes. Weather forecasting at a Nepali met office is a supercomputer use worth naming; hospital and fuel-pump equipment are hybrid ones. चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: १.४। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। नेपालको मौसम विभागको पूर्वानुमान supercomputer को उल्लेखनीय प्रयोग हो; अस्पताल र पेट्रोल पम्पका उपकरण hybrid। 1.6 Present on (a) types by purpose, (b) types by size and data handling, and (c) types by mode and brand. You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 1.4 — this covers all five bases between its three parts. Hand in: the file and your notes. Keep the three parts separate: merging the bases is the mistake the lesson warns about. The practical list writes mode in part (c) where the topic list for 1.4 writes model — the same basis, spelled two ways in the one document. Use model, and ask your teacher if an answer sheet says otherwise. चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: १.४ — तीन भागले पाँचै आधार समेट्छन्। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। तीन भाग छुट्टै राख्नुहोस्; आधार मिसाउनु नै पाठले चेतावनी दिएको गल्ती हो। प्रयोगात्मक सूचीमा (ग) मा mode लेखिएको छ, तर १.४ को विषयसूचीमा model — एउटै आधार, एउटै कागजमा दुई हिज्जे। model नै प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्। Record keepingThe 3 marks most often thrown away Three of the 18 practical marks are for records, not for the work. A record is kept per activity and should contain: the activity number and title, the date, what you did, what you used, what you produced (with a photograph if it is a chart), and one or two sentences on what you learned or what went wrong. Keep them in one file, in order. The curriculum adds two things worth knowing in advance. The practical examination is conducted in the presence of internal and external supervisors, and it assesses both the product and your skill in using equipment — so being able to explain your chart matters as much as the chart. And project work is assessed on the report and the presentation of it; when a project is presented by a group, every member submits their own short reflection on the report, so a group project is still individual work at the end. १८ प्रयोगात्मक अंकमध्ये ३ अंक अभिलेख का हुन्, काम गरेकै होइन। हरेक क्रियाकलापको अभिलेखमा हुनुपर्छ: क्रियाकलापको नम्बर र शीर्षक, मिति, के गर्नुभयो, के प्रयोग गर्नुभयो, के बनाउनुभयो (चार्ट भए फोटोसहित), र के सिक्नुभयो वा के बिग्रियो भन्ने एक–दुई वाक्य। सबै एउटै फाइलमा क्रम मिलाएर राख्नुहोस्। पाठ्यक्रमले थप्छ: प्रयोगात्मक परीक्षा आन्तरिक र बाह्य दुवै सुपरिवेक्षकको उपस्थितिमा हुन्छ, र त्यसले उत्पादनसँगै उपकरण चलाउने सीप पनि जाँच्छ — त्यसैले चार्ट बुझाउन सक्नु चार्ट बनाउनुजत्तिकै महत्त्वको छ। प्रोजेक्ट कामको मूल्याङ्कन रिपोर्ट र त्यसको प्रस्तुतीकरण मा हुन्छ; समूहमा प्रस्तुत गरेमा हरेक सदस्यले आफ्नै छोटो मनन् बुझाउनुपर्छ, त्यसैले समूहको प्रोजेक्ट पनि अन्ततः व्यक्तिगत काम हो। Independent practiceTwo you can do on your own, today Not from the curriculum's list — these are short exercises to test whether the theory above actually holds in your hands. No marks, no teacher needed. One. Pick any five machines you can see from where you are sitting — a phone, a calculator, a TV, a fridge with a display, a laptop. For each, decide whether it contains a computer by the definition in 1.1, and if it does, place it on all five bases from 1.4. Write the five answers down. Where you hesitate is where to re-read. Two. Find one wrong output you have actually seen — a bill, a result sheet, a mistyped name on a document. Decide whether the machine or the data was at fault, and write one sentence saying which and why. If it was the data, you have found a real GIGO example, and it will serve you better in the exam than the one in this lesson. पाठ्यक्रमको सूचीबाट होइन — माथिको सिद्धान्त हातमा टिक्छ कि टिक्दैन जाँच्ने छोटा अभ्यास। अंक छैन, शिक्षक चाहिँदैन। एक। बसेकै ठाउँबाट देखिने पाँच यन्त्र छान्नुहोस् — फोन, क्यालकुलेटर, टिभी, डिस्प्ले भएको फ्रिज, ल्यापटप। हरेकका लागि १.१ को परिभाषाअनुसार त्यसमा कम्प्युटर छ कि छैन भन्नुहोस्, र भए १.४ का पाँचै आधारमा राख्नुहोस्। जहाँ अलमल हुन्छ, त्यही फेरि पढ्ने ठाउँ हो। दुई। आफूले देखेको एउटा गलत आउटपुट सम्झनुहोस् — बिल, नतिजा, कागजमा बिग्रेको नाम। मेसिनको गल्ती थियो कि data को, एक वाक्यमा कारणसहित लेख्नुहोस्। Data को भए तपाईंले साँचो GIGO उदाहरण भेट्नुभयो। Exam focus — what is asked from this unit This unit carries 6 of the 50 external marks and 8 of the 64 theory hours. It is almost always asked as short definition questions and one classification question. The practical half of the unit — 10 hours of chart work and presentations — is assessed inside your school's internal 50 marks, not in the written paper. यो युनिटले बाह्य ५० मध्ये ६ अंक र ६४ सैद्धान्तिक घण्टामध्ये ८ घण्टा ओगट्छ। प्रायः छोटो परिभाषा प्रश्न र एउटा वर्गीकरण प्रश्नका रूपमा सोधिन्छ। युनिटको प्रयोगात्मक आधा भाग — चार्ट र प्रस्तुतीकरणका १० घण्टा — लिखित परीक्षामा होइन, विद्यालयभित्रको आन्तरिक ५० अंकमा मूल्याङ्कन हुन्छ। 2 marks Practice question Define a computer. कम्प्युटरको परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। Show the answer A computer is an electronic device that accepts data, processes it according to a set of stored instructions, gives information as output, and stores data and instructions for later use. Name all four stages — input, process, output, storage — and the stored program. An answer that says only "a machine that calculates" does not reach full marks. चारै चरण — input, process, output, storage — र भण्डारण गरिएको प्रोग्रामको नाम लिनुहोस्। "गणना गर्ने मेसिन" मात्र लेखेको उत्तरले पूरा अंक पाउँदैन। 2 marks Practice question Differentiate between data and information with one example of each. Data र information बीचको फरक, हरेकको एक–एक उदाहरणसहित लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer Data is raw, unprocessed facts that mean little on their own — for example the marks 72, 65, 88. Information is data that has been processed into a usable form — for example "the class average is 75". The difference is the processing in between, which is what the computer does. Data कच्चा तथ्य, जस्तै अंक ७२, ६५, ८८। Information प्रशोधन भएर काम लाग्ने रूपमा आएको, जस्तै "कक्षाको औसत ७५ छ"। बीचको प्रशोधन नै फरक हो। 4 marks Practice question On what five bases are computers classified? Give the categories under any two of them. कम्प्युटरको वर्गीकरण कुन पाँच आधारमा हुन्छ? तीमध्ये कुनै दुईका वर्ग लेख्नुहोस्। Show the answer size supercomputer, mainframe, mini, micro data handling analog, digital, hybrid purpose general purpose, special purpose model desktop, laptop, palmtop brand IBM PC, IBM compatible, Apple Name all five bases for the first marks; then give the categories under the two you know best. Do not merge the lists. पहिले पाँचै आधारको नाम लिनुहोस्; अनि राम्ररी थाहा भएका दुईका वर्ग लेख्नुहोस्। सूचीहरू मिसाउनुहोस् नहोस्। 4 marks Practice question A computer produced a wrong salary report. The company says the computer is unreliable. Explain whether you agree, using a characteristic of computers. कम्प्युटरले गलत तलब प्रतिवेदन निकाल्यो। कम्पनी भन्छ कम्प्युटर भरपर्दो छैन। कम्प्युटरको एउटा विशेषता प्रयोग गरी तपाईं सहमत हुनुहुन्छ कि छैन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्। Show the answer Usually disagree. A computer is accurate and reliable: it processes exactly what it is given, and gives the same answer every time. A wrong report almost always means wrong input or a wrong program — Garbage In, Garbage Out. Say which it is: wrong data entered, or a mistake in the instructions. Both are human errors, not machine ones. प्रायः असहमत। कम्प्युटर शुद्ध र भरपर्दो हुन्छ: दिइएकै कुरा ठ्याक्कै प्रशोधन गर्छ र हरेक पटक उही उत्तर दिन्छ। गलत प्रतिवेदन भनेको प्रायः गलत इनपुट वा गलत प्रोग्राम — Garbage In, Garbage Out। कुन हो भन्नुहोस्: गलत data भरियो, कि निर्देशनमै गल्ती। दुवै मानवीय गल्ती हुन्, मेसिनको होइन। Key points to revise
items.ne: — दोहोर्‍याउनुपर्ने मुख्य बुँदा

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Introduction to Computer
items.ne: कम्प्युटरको परिचय

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: What you will learn: to tell the five bases apart on a real case rather than by reciting the list. Six cases, and two of them answer the same basis for different reasons.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: सूची घोकेर होइन, वास्तविक केसमा पाँच आधार छुट्याउन। छ केस छन्, र तीमध्ये दुईले फरक कारणले उही आधारको उत्तर दिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The ALU is the Arithmetic and LOGIC Unit, and comparison is a logical operation. The control unit decides what happens next and in what order, but it does not do the comparing itself. This pair is asked almost every year.
items.ne: ALU भनेको Arithmetic and LOGIC Unit हो, र तुलना तार्किक काम हो। Control unit ले अब के हुने र कुन क्रममा हुने तय गर्छ, तर तुलना आफैं गर्दैन। यो जोडी झन्डै हरेक वर्ष सोधिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: OMR is the Optical MARK Reader. It only needs to detect which box is filled — the position of the mark carries the meaning, so no letter has to be recognised. OCR would be the answer if the machine had to read what was written inside the boxes.
items.ne: OMR भनेको Optical MARK Reader हो। कुन बाकस भरिएको छ भेट्टाए पुग्छ — अर्थ चिन्हको ठाउँले बोक्छ, अक्षर चिन्नु पर्दैन। बाकसभित्र लेखिएको पढ्नुपर्ने भए OCR उत्तर हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: MICR senses magnetism, not shape. A photocopy reproduces the appearance of the characters perfectly and none of the magnetism, so the reader rejects it. Security is the reason the technology survives even though it is old and expensive.
items.ne: MICR ले आकार होइन, चुम्बकत्व पहिचान गर्छ। फोटोकपीले अक्षरको रूप पूरै उतार्छ तर चुम्बकत्व पटक्कै उतार्दैन, त्यसैले reader ले अस्वीकार गर्छ। पुरानो र महँगो भए पनि यो प्रविधि टिकिरहनुको कारण सुरक्षा नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A scanner captures an image of the page. To a computer that image is just coloured dots — you cannot place a cursor in it. OCR examines the shapes in the image, recognises them as characters, and produces text that can be edited. Scanner and OCR are often sold together, which is why students think they are one thing.
items.ne: Scanner ले पानाको तस्बिर खिच्छ। कम्प्युटरका लागि त्यो तस्बिर रङका थोप्ला मात्र हो — त्यसमा कर्सर राख्नै मिल्दैन। OCR ले तस्बिरभित्रका आकार केलाएर अक्षर चिन्छ र सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने पाठ बनाउँछ। Scanner र OCR प्रायः सँगै बेचिने भएकाले विद्यार्थीले एउटै ठान्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A plotter draws on paper, and paper output you can carry away is hardcopy. Monitor, speaker and projector all produce output that exists only while the device is running, which is softcopy. The plotter is the one students most often put on the wrong side.
items.ne: Plotter ले कागजमा कोर्छ, र बोकेर लैजान मिल्ने कागजको आउटपुट hardcopy हो। Monitor, speaker र projector को आउटपुट उपकरण चलेसम्म मात्र रहन्छ — त्यो softcopy। गलत पक्षमा सबैभन्दा धेरै राखिने यही plotter हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: This is the one job where the old noisy technology is the right answer. An IMPACT printer physically strikes the paper, and that pressure presses through carbon sheets underneath. Laser and inkjet are non-impact — nothing touches the page, so sheets two and three stay blank no matter how fast the printer is.
items.ne: हल्ला गर्ने पुरानो प्रविधि नै ठिक उत्तर हुने काम यही हो। IMPACT प्रिन्टरले कागजमा भौतिक रूपमै ठोक्छ, र त्यो दबाब तलका कार्बन पानासम्म पुग्छ। Laser र inkjet non-impact हुन् — कागज छुँदै छुँदैनन्, त्यसैले प्रिन्टर जतिसुकै छिटो भए पनि दोस्रो र तेस्रो पाना खाली रहन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: 1 KB = 1024 bytes, because memory addresses are binary and 1024 is 2 to the power 10 — the nearest round number in a system that counts in twos. Writing 1000 is the single most common slip in this unit, and the marker is checking whether you know why it is not 1000.
items.ne: 1 KB = 1024 byte, किनभने मेमोरीका ठेगाना binary मा हुन्छन् र १०२४ भनेको २ को घात १० हो — दुईमा गन्ने प्रणालीको नजिकको पूरा संख्या। यस युनिटमा सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने गल्ती १००० लेख्नु हो, र परीक्षकले १००० किन होइन भन्ने थाहा छ कि छैन जाँचिरहेका हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Word length is how much data moves per cycle; clock speed is how many cycles per second. A 64-bit word is 8 bytes, so A finishes in one cycle. B handles one byte per cycle and needs eight. B does more cycles per second, but it needs eight times as many of them — which is exactly why both numbers are quoted and neither alone tells you how fast a processor is.
items.ne: Word length भनेको प्रति चक्र कति data सर्छ; clock speed भनेको प्रति सेकेन्ड कति चक्र। ६४-bit word = ८ byte, त्यसैले A एक चक्रमै सक्छ। B ले प्रति चक्र एक byte चलाउँछ, आठ चक्र चाहिन्छ। B ले सेकेन्डमा बढी चक्र चलाउँछ तर उसलाई आठ गुणा बढी चक्र चाहिन्छ — दुवै संख्या किन भनिन्छ र एक्लैले गति नबताउने कारण यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Which input device does this job need?
items.ne: यो कामलाई कुन input device चाहिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Each case describes what has to be read or captured. Decide which device the job needs. Ask what is physically there — a filled box, a letter shape, a stripe pattern, magnetic ink, a sound, or a movement.
items.ne: हरेक केसमा के पढ्नु वा कैद गर्नुपर्ने हो लेखिएको छ। कामलाई कुन उपकरण चाहिन्छ छान्नुहोस्। त्यहाँ भौतिक रूपमा के छ सोध्नुहोस् — भरिएको बाकस, अक्षरको आकार, धर्काको बान्की, चुम्बकीय मसी, आवाज, कि चाल।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The machine only has to find out WHICH BOX IS FILLED. It does not read a letter or a number — the position of the mark carries the meaning. That is Optical Mark Reader.
items.ne: मेसिनले कुन बाकस भरिएको छ मात्र पत्ता लगाउनुपर्छ। अक्षर वा अंक पढ्नुपर्दैन — चिन्हको ठाउँले नै अर्थ बोक्छ। त्यही Optical Mark Reader हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Editable text means the SHAPES OF THE LETTERS have to be recognised, not photographed. A scanner alone gives a picture; OCR is what reads characters out of it. Optical Character Reader.
items.ne: सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने पाठ भनेको अक्षरको आकार चिन्नुपर्छ, फोटो खिचे पुग्दैन। Scanner ले तस्बिर मात्र दिन्छ; त्यसबाट अक्षर पढ्ने काम OCR को हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The stripes are a number in disguise. The reader turns the pattern back into that number, and the shop computer looks the price up. The price is not on the label — only the code is.
items.ne: धर्का भनेको लुकेको संख्या हो। Reader ले बान्कीलाई संख्यामा फर्काउँछ र पसलको कम्प्युटरले मूल्य खोज्छ। लेबलमा मूल्य हुँदैन — कोड मात्र हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Cheques are printed in magnetic ink precisely so that a photocopy cannot be read by the machine. The reader senses MAGNETISM, not shape — which is why a photocopied cheque is rejected.
items.ne: चेक चुम्बकीय मसीमा छापिनुको कारण नै यही हो — फोटोकपी मेसिनले पढ्न सक्दैन। Reader ले आकार होइन, चुम्बकत्व पहिचान गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Sound is a wave in the air, and nothing on this list except the microphone converts a wave into binary. The other four all read something printed on paper.
items.ne: आवाज हावामा चल्ने तरंग हो, र यो सूचीमा microphone बाहेक कसैले तरंगलाई binary मा बदल्दैन। अरू चारैले कागजमा छापिएको कुरा पढ्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Handwritten still means CHARACTERS, so it is OCR again — modern OCR reads handwriting as well as print. OMR is the tempting wrong answer: a register has boxes, but here the names inside them have to be read, not just counted as filled.
items.ne: हस्तलिखित भए पनि अक्षर नै हो, त्यसैले फेरि OCR — आजको OCR ले छापा र हस्तलेखन दुवै पढ्छ। OMR लोभ्याउने गलत उत्तर हो: रजिस्टरमा बाकस त छन्, तर यहाँ भित्रका नाम पढ्नुपर्छ, भरिएको गन्नु मात्र होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Explain clock speed and word length, and what each one does to speed.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: कम्प्युटर प्रणालीका एकाइ नाम लिन र तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्न, कामअनुसार ठिक input device छान्न र अरू किन मिल्दैनन् भन्न, OMR, OCR, BCR र MICR लाई कसले के पढ्छ भन्ने आधारमा छुट्याउन, softcopy र hardcopy अनि impact र non-impact प्रिन्टर छुट्याउन, memory unit ले input unit ले नराख्ने के राख्छ भन्न, र clock speed तथा word length ले गतिमा के गर्छन् बुझाउन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.2 The input unit and its devices — Input एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
items.en: MICR — Magnetic Ink Character Reader. Reads characters printed in magnetic ink, used on bank cheques, because magnetic ink cannot be photocopied.
items.ne: चारैले कागज स्क्यान गर्छन्। फरक कागजमा के छ भन्नेमा हो, र प्रश्नको पूरा उत्तर त्यही हो। OMR — Optical Mark Reader: बाकसमा लगाएको पेन्सिलको चिन्ह पढ्छ; चिन्हको अर्थ होइन, बाकस भरिएको छ कि छैन मात्र। प्रवेश परीक्षाको उत्तरपुस्तिका। OCR — Optical Character Reader: छापिएका वा लेखिएका अक्षर पढेर सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने पाठ बनाउँछ। BCR — Bar Code Reader: सामानको धर्के कोड पढ्छ; धर्का भनेको संख्या हो, र त्यही संख्याबाट मूल्य खोजिन्छ। MICR — Magnetic Ink Character Reader: चुम्बकीय मसी मा छापिएका अक्षर पढ्छ; बैंक चेकमा चल्छ, किनभने चुम्बकीय मसी फोटोकपी हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.3 The output unit and its devices — Output एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
items.en: Decide before opening this: which printer type can produce more than one copy at a time, and what physical fact makes that possible?
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: कुन किसिमको प्रिन्टरले एकैपटक एकभन्दा बढी प्रति निकाल्न सक्छ, र कुन भौतिक कुराले त्यो सम्भव बनाउँछ?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.3 The output unit and its devices — Output एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
items.en: This is the one job where the noisy old technology is the correct answer. "Impact printers are obsolete" is wrong in a question about carbon copies.
items.ne: हल्ला गर्ने पुरानो प्रविधि नै ठिक उत्तर हुने काम यही हो। कार्बन कपीको प्रश्नमा "impact printer पुरानो भइसक्यो" भन्नु गलत हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.5 The processing unit — the microprocessor — प्रशोधन एकाइ — microprocessor
items.en: Chip A's word length is 64 bits, which is 8 bytes, so all eight arrive in one cycle. Chip B handles 8 bits — one byte — per cycle, so it needs eight cycles. Clock speed was not the question: B does more cycles per second, but it needs eight times as many of them. This is exactly why both numbers are quoted and neither alone tells you how fast a chip is.
items.ne: चिप A को word length ६४ bit = ८ byte, त्यसैले आठै byte एक चक्रमा पुग्छन्। चिप B ले प्रति चक्र ८ bit — एक byte — चलाउँछ, त्यसैले आठ चक्र चाहिन्छ। प्रश्न clock speed को थिएन: B ले सेकेन्डमा बढी चक्र चलाउँछ, तर उसलाई आठ गुणा बढी चक्र चाहिन्छ। दुवै संख्या किन भनिन्छ र एक्लैले गति बताउँदैन भन्ने कारण यही हो।

items.en: The two combine: a processor is fast when it performs many cycles per second and moves a lot of data in each one.
items.ne: Clock speed — प्रोसेसरले एक सेकेन्डमा पूरा गर्ने चक्रको संख्या (MHz, GHz)। बढी clock speed = प्रति सेकेन्ड बढी निर्देशन। Word length — प्रोसेसरले एकै कार्यमा चलाउन सक्ने bit संख्या (८/१६/३२/६४)। लामो word length = प्रति चक्र बढी data। दुवै मिलेर गति बन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: Clock speed = how often. Word length = how much per cycle. Both are needed to judge speed.
items.ne: पाँच एकाइ: input, memory, ALU, control, output; ALU + control = CPU। Input device ले वास्तविक सङ्केतलाई binary मा बदल्छ। OMR — चिन्ह, OCR — अक्षर, BCR — बार कोड, MICR — चुम्बकीय मसी। Output: softcopy र hardcopy; प्रिन्टरमा मात्र impact र non-impact। Memory ले काम हुँदासम्म data र प्रोग्राम दुवै राख्छ; 1 KB = 1024 byte। Clock speed — कति पटक; word length — पटकै कति।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.1 The components of a computer system — कम्प्युटर प्रणालीका भागहरू
items.en: Why this matters: "differentiate between the ALU and the control unit" is a standard question, and the marks go to students who attach the right job to each word. Seeing them in the flow is what makes that stick.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "ALU र control unit छुट्याउनुहोस्" मानक प्रश्न हो, र अंक ती विद्यार्थीले पाउँछन् जसले ठिक काम ठिक शब्दसँग जोड्छन्। प्रवाहमा देखेपछि यो पक्का हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.2 The input unit and its devices — Input एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
items.en: Before answering, say what is physically being read: a filled box, a letter shape, a stripe pattern, or magnetic ink. The device follows from that.
items.ne: उत्तर दिनुअघि के पढिँदै छ भन्नुहोस्: भरिएको बाकस, अक्षरको आकार, धर्काको बान्की, कि चुम्बकीय मसी। उपकरण त्यसैबाट निस्कन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.1 The components of a computer system — कम्प्युटर प्रणालीका भागहरू
items.en: One machine, five jobs Unit 1 said a computer accepts data, processes it, gives information and stores both. Those are not four descriptions of one box — they are four different parts, and a fifth part tells the others what to do. The input unit brings data in. The memory unit holds it. The ALU — Arithmetic and Logic Unit — does every calculation and every comparison. The control unit decides what happens next and in what order. The output unit sends the result out to you. The ALU and the control unit together are called the CPU, the Central Processing Unit. That is why the CPU is called the brain: not because it stores things, but because it is where deciding and calculating both happen.
items.ne: एउटै मेसिन, पाँच काम युनिट १ मा भनियो — कम्प्युटरले data लिन्छ, प्रशोधन गर्छ, information दिन्छ र दुवै राख्छ। यी एउटै बाकसका चार वर्णन होइनन् — यी चार फरक भाग हुन्, र पाँचौं भागले अरूलाई के गर्ने भन्छ। Input unit ले data भित्र ल्याउँछ। Memory unit ले राख्छ। ALU — Arithmetic and Logic Unit — ले हरेक गणना र हरेक तुलना गर्छ। Control unit ले अब के हुने र कुन क्रममा हुने तय गर्छ। Output unit ले नतिजा तपाईंसम्म पठाउँछ। ALU र control unit मिलेर CPU — Central Processing Unit — बन्छ। CPU लाई मस्तिष्क भनिनुको कारण यही हो: यसले राख्छ भनेर होइन, निर्णय र गणना दुवै यहीँ हुन्छन् भनेर।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.2 The input unit and its devices — Input एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
items.en: What an input device really does An input device takes something that exists in the world — a key press, a shape on paper, a sound, a picture — and turns it into the 0s and 1s the computer can work with. Conversion is the job. A device that does not convert is not an input device. The curriculum names twelve: keyboard, mouse, joystick, OMR, OCR, BCR, MICR, scanner, touch screen, touchpad, microphone and digital camera. Learn them in groups rather than as a list of twelve. Typing and pointing: keyboard, mouse, joystick, touchpad, touch screen. Capturing: scanner, digital camera, microphone. Reading marks and codes: OMR, OCR, BCR, MICR — the four that are confused in every examination.
items.ne: Input device ले साँच्चै के गर्छ Input device ले संसारमा भएको कुरा — कुञ्जी थिचाइ, कागजको चिन्ह, आवाज, तस्बिर — लिएर कम्प्युटरले चलाउन सक्ने ० र १ मा बदल्छ। बदल्नु नै यसको काम हो। नबदल्ने उपकरण input device होइन। पाठ्यक्रमले बाह्र वटा नाम लिन्छ: keyboard, mouse, joystick, OMR, OCR, BCR, MICR, scanner, touch screen, touchpad, microphone र digital camera। बाह्रको सूची घोक्नुभन्दा समूहमा सिक्नुहोस्। टाइप र देखाउने: keyboard, mouse, joystick, touchpad, touch screen। कैद गर्ने: scanner, digital camera, microphone। चिन्ह र कोड पढ्ने: OMR, OCR, BCR, MICR — हरेक परीक्षामा अलमल पार्ने चार।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.3 The output unit and its devices — Output एकाइ र यसका उपकरण
items.en: Two cuts, made in order Output devices are classified by two different questions, and answering them in order keeps them straight. First: can you carry the output away? Softcopy output is temporary and on a screen or in sound — monitor, speaker, projector, headphone. Hardcopy output is permanent and on paper or material — printers and the graphic plotter. Second, for printers only: does it strike the paper? An impact printer presses an inked ribbon against the paper, so it is noisy and can print carbon copies — the dot-matrix printer. A non-impact printer never touches the paper: inkjet sprays, laser fuses powder. Quiet, faster, no carbon copy. A 3D printer is different again. It builds an object layer by layer out of plastic or resin, so its output is a thing, not a page.
items.ne: दुई प्रश्न, क्रम मिलाएर Output device लाई दुई फरक प्रश्न ले वर्गीकरण गरिन्छ, र क्रम मिलाएर सोधे अलमल हुँदैन। पहिलो: आउटपुट बोकेर लैजान सकिन्छ? Softcopy अस्थायी हुन्छ — पर्दामा वा आवाजमा: monitor, speaker, projector, headphone. Hardcopy स्थायी हुन्छ — कागज वा वस्तुमा: printer र graphic plotter। दोस्रो, प्रिन्टरका लागि मात्र: कागजमा ठोक्किन्छ? Impact प्रिन्टरले मसी भएको रिबनलाई कागजमा थिच्छ — हल्ला गर्छ र कार्बन कपी निकाल्न सक्छ: dot-matrix। Non-impact प्रिन्टरले कागज छुँदै छुँदैन: inkjet ले छर्छ, laser ले धुलो टाँस्छ। शान्त, छिटो, कार्बन कपी हुँदैन। 3D printer अझ फरक हो। यसले प्लास्टिक वा रेजिनबाट तह–तह गरी वस्तु बनाउँछ, त्यसैले यसको आउटपुट कागज होइन, वस्तु हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The part that holds, while the work happens The memory unit is where data and instructions sit while the computer is working on them. Input brings data in and then it is finished; the memory unit is what keeps it available for the ALU to use, again and again, until the job is done. Two facts matter here, and Unit 4 does the rest. One: the program itself lives in memory, not just the data — that is the stored-program idea from Unit 1, and this is where it is stored. Two: memory is measured in bytes. One byte is 8 bits and holds roughly one character; 1024 bytes is a kilobyte, 1024 KB a megabyte, 1024 MB a gigabyte. Why 1024 and not 1000? Because memory is addressed in binary, and 1024 is 210 — the nearest round number in a system that counts in twos.
items.ne: काम हुँदासम्म राख्ने भाग Memory unit त्यो ठाउँ हो जहाँ कम्प्युटरले काम गरिरहँदा data र निर्देशन बस्छन्। Input ले data भित्र ल्याएपछि उसको काम सकियो; ALU ले बारम्बार प्रयोग गर्न सक्ने गरी राख्ने काम memory unit को हो। यहाँ दुई कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण छन्, बाँकी युनिट ४ ले हेर्छ। एक: data मात्र होइन, प्रोग्राम आफैं पनि memory मै बस्छ — युनिट १ को stored-program विचार, र भण्डारण हुने ठाउँ यही हो। दुई: memory byte मा नापिन्छ। एक byte = ८ bit, लगभग एक अक्षर; १०२४ byte = kilobyte, १०२४ KB = megabyte, १०२४ MB = gigabyte। १००० होइन १०२४ किन? किनभने memory को ठेगाना binary मा हुन्छ, र १०२४ भनेको २१० हो — दुईमा गन्ने प्रणालीको नजिकको पूरा संख्या।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 2.5 The processing unit — the microprocessor — प्रशोधन एकाइ — microprocessor
items.en: One chip, and the two numbers printed on it A microprocessor is the whole CPU built onto a single silicon chip: the ALU, the control unit, and a small set of fast holding places called registers. When an advertisement says "Intel Core i5, 3.2 GHz, 64-bit", it is naming the chip and then the two numbers that describe how it works. Clock speed is how many cycles the chip performs each second, measured in hertz. 3.2 GHz is 3.2 billion cycles per second. More cycles per second means more instructions per second — the chip works faster. Word length is how many bits the chip can handle in one cycle — 8, 16, 32 or 64. A 64-bit chip moves eight bytes where an 8-bit chip moves one. More bits per cycle means more work per cycle. So the two numbers answer different questions: clock speed is how often, word length is how much each time. A student who says "word length makes it faster" without saying per cycle has not answered the question.
items.ne: एउटै चिप, र त्यसमा लेखिएका दुई संख्या Microprocessor भनेको पूरै CPU एउटै सिलिकन चिपमा बनेको हो: ALU, control unit, र register भनिने केही छिटो राख्ने ठाउँ। विज्ञापनले "Intel Core i5, 3.2 GHz, 64-bit" भन्दा चिपको नाम र त्यो कसरी चल्छ भन्ने दुई संख्या भनिरहेको हुन्छ। Clock speed भनेको चिपले सेकेन्डमा कति चक्र चलाउँछ — hertz मा नापिन्छ। 3.2 GHz भनेको सेकेन्डमा ३.२ अर्ब चक्र। बढी चक्र भनेको बढी निर्देशन — चिप छिटो चल्छ। Word length भनेको चिपले एक चक्रमा कति bit चलाउन सक्छ — ८, १६, ३२ वा ६४। 64-bit चिपले आठ byte सार्छ, 8-bit ले एक। बढी bit भनेको प्रति चक्र बढी काम। त्यसैले दुई संख्याले फरक प्रश्नको उत्तर दिन्छन्: clock speed — कति पटक, word length — पटकै कति। "word length ले छिटो बनाउँछ" भन्ने तर प्रति चक्र नभन्ने उत्तरले प्रश्नको जवाफ दिएको हुँदैन।

What you will learn: where each unit sits in the flow and exactly what it is responsible for — so that when a question asks which unit does the comparing, you can see the answer rather than try to recall a sentence. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक एकाइ प्रवाहमा कहाँ पर्छ र कसको के जिम्मेवारी हो — ताकि तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्ने प्रश्नमा वाक्य सम्झनुभन्दा उत्तर देख्न सकियोस्। {{dia:hwSystemUnits}} Why this matters: "differentiate between the ALU and the control unit" is a standard question, and the marks go to students who attach the right job to each word. Seeing them in the flow is what makes that stick.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "ALU र control unit छुट्याउनुहोस्" मानक प्रश्न हो, र अंक ती विद्यार्थीले पाउँछन् जसले ठिक काम ठिक शब्दसँग जोड्छन्। प्रवाहमा देखेपछि यो पक्का हुन्छ। 2.2 The input unit and its devices

Working Needed three copies in one pass Impact? YES — the print head strikes the ribbon against the paper Why it works the strike presses through to carbon paper underneath Answer dot-matrix printer (impact) Why not laser laser fuses powder onto the top sheet only; nothing presses through, so sheets two and three stay blank This is the one job where the noisy old technology is the correct answer. "Impact printers are obsolete" is wrong in a question about carbon copies. हल्ला गर्ने पुरानो प्रविधि नै ठिक उत्तर हुने काम यही हो। कार्बन कपीको प्रश्नमा "impact printer पुरानो भइसक्यो" भन्नु गलत हो। 2.4 The memory unit
