items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which memory is being described? What you will learn: to identify a memory from a property rather than from its name — which is how the examination asks it. Two cases are separated only by whether the thing survives a power cut. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: नामबाट होइन, गुणबाट मेमोरी चिन्न — परीक्षाले सोध्ने तरिका यही हो। दुई केसको फरक बत्ती गएपछि बाँच्छ कि बाँच्दैन भन्नेमा मात्र छ। How to use this For each case ask two questions in order: does it survive a power cut, and can the CPU reach it directly? Those two answers place almost every memory in the subject. हरेक केसमा क्रमैसँग दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: बत्ती गएपछि बाँच्छ? CPU ले सिधै पुग्छ? यी दुई उत्तरले यस विषयका झन्डै सबै मेमोरी ठाउँमा राख्छन्। Example 1 Why opening a large file takes a moment Question: a student double-clicks a 200 MB video on the hard disk. Trace what has to happen before the first frame appears, and explain the pause. Before opening: which of the memories above can the CPU read from directly, and where is the video right now? खोल्नुअघि: माथिका मेमोरीमध्ये CPU ले कुनबाट सिधै पढ्न सक्छ, र भिडियो अहिले कहाँ छ? Working 1 the video is on the HARD DISK — secondary storage 2 the CPU cannot read secondary storage directly 3 so the OS copies part of the file from disk into RAM 4 the disk is mechanical and slow; RAM is electronic and fast 5 the CPU reads the copy in RAM and decodes the first frame 6 the frame is sent to the output unit and appears The pause is step 3 — the slowest link in the chain. It is the disk being read, not the CPU being slow. This is why installing an SSD makes an old computer feel new while a faster processor often does not: the wait was never the CPU. पुरानो कम्प्युटरमा SSD हाल्दा नयाँ जस्तो हुनुको र छिटो प्रोसेसरले प्रायः फरक नपर्नुको कारण यही हो: पर्खाइ CPU को कहिल्यै थिएन। Example 2 How much is 2 GB, in characters? Question: a pen drive holds 2 GB. Roughly how many characters of plain text is that, and why is the answer not simply 2,000,000,000? Two facts are needed: how many bytes are in a gigabyte, and how many bytes one character takes. Work it out before opening this. दुई तथ्य चाहिन्छ: एक gigabyte मा कति byte, र एक अक्षरले कति byte लिन्छ। खोल्नुअघि निकाल्नुहोस्। Working 1 character = 1 byte (8 bits) 1 KB = 1024 bytes 1 MB = 1024 × 1024 = 1,048,576 bytes 1 GB = 1024 × 1,048,576 = 1,073,741,824 bytes 2 GB = 2,147,483,648 bytes So about 2.1 BILLION characters, not 2.0 billion. The difference is over 147 million characters — more than a hundred full-length books. Why not 2,000,000,000: memory is addressed in binary, so each step up is 2^10 = 1024, not 1000. This is why a "2 GB" pen drive and a "2 GB" advertisement can disagree: some manufacturers count in thousands and the computer counts in 1024s. "2 GB" को पेन ड्राइभ र "2 GB" को विज्ञापन किन मिल्दैनन् भन्ने कारण यही हो: कतिपय उत्पादकले हजारमा गन्छन्, कम्प्युटरले १०२४ मा। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying RAM is "Random Access Memory, which is temporary" and stopping. The mark is for volatile and for read and write. Temporary alone is vague. Calling ROM "memory you cannot write to". PROM, EPROM and EEPROM can all be written — once, with UV light, or electrically. ROM is read-only in normal use. Putting cache below RAM. Cache is faster than RAM and sits between RAM and the CPU. Saying the CPU reads a file from the hard disk. It cannot. The file is copied into RAM first, every time. Confusing SRAM and DRAM by speed alone. The real difference is refreshing: DRAM leaks and must be refreshed, SRAM does not. RAM लाई "अस्थायी" मात्र भन्नु: अंक volatile र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने भन्नुमा छ। ROM लाई "लेख्नै नमिल्ने" भन्नु: PROM, EPROM, EEPROM मा लेख्न मिल्छ — एक पटक, UV ले, वा विद्युतीय रूपमा। Cache लाई RAM भन्दा तल राख्नु: cache RAM भन्दा छिटो छ र CPU सँग नजिक। CPU ले hard disk बाट फाइल पढ्छ भन्नु: सक्दैन — हरेक पटक RAM मा सारिन्छ। SRAM/DRAM लाई गतिले मात्र छुट्याउनु: साँचो फरक refresh मा छ। Memory hook — RAM forgets, ROM remembers. Cache is close, disk is far. सम्झने तरिका — RAM बिर्सन्छ, ROM सम्झन्छ। Cache नजिक, disk टाढा। Practical work — this unit's other 6 hours

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: What you will learn: to identify a memory from a property rather than from its name — which is how the examination asks it. Two cases are separated only by whether the thing survives a power cut.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: नामबाट होइन, गुणबाट मेमोरी चिन्न — परीक्षाले सोध्ने तरिका यही हो। दुई केसको फरक बत्ती गएपछि बाँच्छ कि बाँच्दैन भन्नेमा मात्र छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The Internet is the connection itself — cables, routers and the agreement on how a message is addressed. The Web is pages joined by links and read with a browser, and it is only one of the services the Internet carries; e-mail and file transfer are others. Defining the Internet as "a collection of websites" describes one service and calls it the whole network.
items.ne: इन्टरनेट भनेको जडान आफैं हो — तार, राउटर र सन्देशको ठेगाना कसरी लेख्ने भन्ने सहमति। वेब भनेको लिंकले जोडिएका र browser ले पढिने पृष्ठ, र यो इन्टरनेटले बोक्ने धेरै सेवामध्ये एउटा मात्र हो; इमेल र file transfer अरू हुन्। "वेबसाइटहरूको संग्रह" भन्नु एउटा सेवालाई पूरै नेटवर्क भन्नु हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The name is the answer. Modulating turns the computer’s digital output into something the line can carry; demodulating turns the arriving signal back into digital. It is a translator and it must work in both directions. Note that amplifying is a different job done by a different device.
items.ne: नाम नै उत्तर हो। Modulate गर्नु भनेको कम्प्युटरको digital आउटपुटलाई लाइनले बोक्न सक्ने रूपमा बदल्नु; demodulate भनेको आउने सङ्केतलाई फेरि digital बनाउनु। यो अनुवादक हो र दुवै दिशामा काम गर्नैपर्छ। सङ्केत बढाउने काम फरक हो र त्यो अर्कै उपकरणले गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A printer is an output device and has nothing to do with connecting. The requirements group into hardware (device, modem or router, line), software (TCP/IP and a browser) and a service (the ISP account) — and every one of those is required, which is why the ISP is the item most often forgotten.
items.ne: Printer output device हो, जडानसँग कुनै सम्बन्ध छैन। आवश्यकता हार्डवेयर (उपकरण, modem/router, लाइन), सफ्टवेयर (TCP/IP र browser) र सेवा (ISP खाता) मा बाँडिन्छ — र हरेक अनिवार्य छ। सबैभन्दा धेरै छुट्ने ISP नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A government service delivered online is e-governance. Money changing hands makes e-commerce tempting, but e-commerce is buying and selling between a customer and a business — not paying the state what you owe it. Nepali examples of e-governance: online PAN registration, passport applications, result publication.
items.ne: सरकारी सेवा अनलाइन दिनु e-governance हो। पैसा सर्ने भएकाले e-commerce लोभ्याउँछ, तर e-commerce भनेको ग्राहक र व्यवसायबीचको किनबेच हो — राज्यलाई तिर्नुपर्ने तिर्नु होइन। नेपालका उदाहरण: अनलाइन PAN दर्ता, राहदानी आवेदन, नतिजा प्रकाशन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Both let you use a distant machine, and that is why they are confused. The difference is what you get: Telnet gives a text command line on the far computer, remote control gives its whole graphical desktop. Telnet is also old and insecure, because it sends passwords without encryption.
items.ne: दुवैले टाढाको मेसिन चलाउन दिन्छन्, त्यसैले अलमल हुन्छ। फरक के पाइन्छ भन्नेमा छ: Telnet ले पारिको कम्प्युटरमा पाठको command line दिन्छ, remote control ले पूरै ग्राफिकल डेस्कटप। Telnet पुरानो र असुरक्षित पनि छ, किनभने पासवर्ड नलुकाई पठाउँछ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The other three are advantages. Real disadvantages include false information, fraud and theft of money or identity, viruses, loss of privacy, wasted time and content unsuitable for children. A four-mark answer that lists only advantages has answered half the question, and this is one of the commonest ways marks are lost in this unit.
items.ne: बाँकी तीन फाइदा हुन्। साँचो बेफाइदामा पर्छन्: झूटो सूचना, ठगी र पैसा/परिचयको चोरी, भाइरस, गोपनीयताको क्षति, समय खेर जानु, र बालबालिकालाई नसुहाउने सामग्री। फाइदा मात्र लेख्ने ४ अंकको उत्तरले आधा प्रश्नको जवाफ दिएको हुन्छ, र यस युनिटमा अंक गुम्ने सबैभन्दा सामान्य तरिका यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: E-mail is store-and-forward: the message waits at an address until the recipient looks. IRC is live typed conversation needing both people present at once; a newsgroup posts to everybody rather than to one named person. The giveaway here is "one person" plus "even if they are offline".
items.ne: E-mail store-and-forward हो: सन्देश ठेगानामा पर्खिरहन्छ, प्रापकले हेरेपछि पढिन्छ। IRC मा दुवै एकैपटक चाहिन्छ; newsgroup ले एक जनालाई होइन सबैलाई पठाउँछ। सुराक "एक जना" र "अफलाइन भए पनि" मा छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A search engine indexes pages and finds the ones matching your words. Without one you would have to know a page’s address before you could reach it, which makes a network of billions of pages useless to anybody who does not already know what is on it.
items.ne: Search engine ले पृष्ठको सूची बनाएर तपाईंका शब्दसँग मिल्ने खोज्छ। यो नभए पृष्ठको ठेगाना पहिल्यै थाहा हुनुपर्थ्यो, र अर्बौं पृष्ठको नेटवर्क त्यहाँ के छ थाहा नभएकाका लागि बेकामको हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Which Internet service does this need?
items.ne: यसलाई कुन इन्टरनेट सेवा चाहिन्छ?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Each case is a real task. Pick the service built for it. Ask who the message is for: one named person, everybody, a machine you are operating, or a shop you are paying.
items.ne: हरेक केस वास्तविक काम हो। त्यसैका लागि बनेको सेवा छान्नुहोस्। सन्देश कसका लागि हो सोध्नुहोस्: एक जना तोकिएको व्यक्ति, सबै, तपाईंले चलाइरहेको मेसिन, कि तिर्न लागेको पसल।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: One named recipient, and it waits until they look — that is store-and-forward, which is what e-mail is. The teacher does not have to be online when you send it.
items.ne: एक जना तोकिएको प्रापक, र उहाँले हेरेपछि मात्र पढिने — यही store-and-forward हो, र इमेल भनेकै त्यही। पठाउँदा शिक्षक अनलाइन हुनै पर्दैन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A GOVERNMENT service delivered online is e-governance. Money changes hands, which makes e-commerce tempting — but e-commerce is buying and selling between a customer and a business, not paying the state what you owe it.
items.ne: सरकारी सेवा अनलाइन दिनु भनेको e-governance हो। पैसा सर्ने भएकाले e-commerce लोभ्याउँछ — तर e-commerce भनेको ग्राहक र व्यवसायबीचको किनबेच हो, राज्यलाई तिर्नुपर्ने तिर्नु होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Taking over the SCREEN — the whole desktop as a picture — is remote control. Telnet is the near-miss: it would give the technician a text command line on that machine, not its desktop.
items.ne: पर्दा नै — पूरै डेस्कटप तस्बिरका रूपमा — नियन्त्रणमा लिनु remote control हो। Telnet नजिकैको गलत उत्तर: त्यसले त्यो मेसिनमा पाठको command line दिन्थ्यो, डेस्कटप होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Buying goods from a business over the Internet, payment included. That is e-commerce by definition, and Daraz plus eSewa is the Nepali example an examiner is looking for.
items.ne: व्यवसायबाट इन्टरनेटमार्फत सामान किन्नु, भुक्तानीसहित — परिभाषाअनुसारै e-commerce। Daraz र eSewa नै परीक्षकले खोज्ने नेपाली उदाहरण हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Pages joined by links and read in a browser is the World Wide Web — one service on the Internet, not the Internet itself.
items.ne: लिंकले जोडिएका पृष्ठ browser मा पढ्नु भनेको World Wide Web हो — इन्टरनेटमाथिको एउटा सेवा, इन्टरनेट आफैं होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A TEXT PROMPT on a distant machine is Telnet. The task is almost the same as the technician case, and the word that separates them is what you get: a command line here, a desktop there.
items.ne: टाढाको मेसिनमा पाठको prompt पाउनु Telnet हो। काम प्राविधिकको केससँग झन्डै उस्तै छ; छुट्याउने शब्द के पाइन्छ भन्ने हो — यहाँ command line, त्यहाँ डेस्कटप।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 5.2 What you need to connect — जोड्न के–के चाहिन्छ
items.en: Each box is one item on the requirements list, standing where it is needed. Remove any one and there is no connection.
items.ne: हरेक बाकस आवश्यकताको सूचीको एउटा वस्तु हो, चाहिने ठाउँमै उभिएको। कुनै एउटा हटाए जडान हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Give a Nepali example of e-commerce and of e-governance.

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 5.1 What the Internet is, and what it gives you — इन्टरनेट के हो, र यसले के दिन्छ
items.en: A network of networks The Internet is a global network of computer networks, connected by agreed rules called protocols, that lets any connected computer exchange information with any other. The word to be careful with is Web. The Internet is the connection — the cables, the routers, the agreement on how to address a message. The World Wide Web is one service that runs on it, the one made of pages and links. E-mail is another service; so is file transfer. Saying "the Internet is a collection of websites" loses the mark, because it describes one service and calls it the whole network. Advantages: information on almost any subject within seconds; communication by e-mail, message and video call at the price of the connection rather than the distance; online learning; e-commerce; e-governance; entertainment; and work that can be done from anywhere. Disadvantages, which a four-mark answer should include: false information presented as fact; fraud and theft of money or identity; viruses; loss of privacy; wasted time; and content that is not suitable for children. A student who writes only advantages has answered half the question.
items.ne: नेटवर्कहरूको नेटवर्क इन्टरनेट भनेको कम्प्युटर नेटवर्कहरूको विश्वव्यापी नेटवर्क हो, जुन प्रोटोकल भनिने सहमत नियमले जोडिएको हुन्छ र जोडिएको जुनसुकै कम्प्युटरले अर्कोसँग सूचना साट्न सक्छ। ध्यान दिनुपर्ने शब्द वेब हो। इन्टरनेट भनेको जडान हो — तार, राउटर, सन्देशको ठेगाना कसरी लेख्ने भन्ने सहमति। World Wide Web त्यसमाथि चल्ने एउटा सेवा हो, पृष्ठ र लिंकले बनेको। E-mail अर्को सेवा; file transfer अर्को। "इन्टरनेट भनेको वेबसाइटहरूको संग्रह" भन्दा अंक जान्छ, किनभने त्यसले एउटा सेवालाई पूरै नेटवर्क भनेको हुन्छ। फाइदा: झन्डै जुनसुकै विषयको सूचना सेकेन्डमै; इमेल, सन्देश र भिडियो कलबाट दूरीको होइन, जडानको मूल्यमा सञ्चार; अनलाइन सिकाइ; e-commerce; e-governance; मनोरञ्जन; र जहाँबाट पनि गर्न मिल्ने काम। बेफाइदा, जुन ४ अंकको उत्तरमा हुनुपर्छ: तथ्य जस्तो देखाइएको झूटो सूचना; ठगी र पैसा वा परिचयको चोरी; भाइरस; गोपनीयताको क्षति; समय खेर जानु; र बालबालिकालाई नसुहाउने सामग्री। फाइदा मात्र लेख्ने विद्यार्थीले आधा प्रश्नको उत्तर दिएको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 5.2 What you need to connect — जोड्न के–के चाहिन्छ
items.en: A chain, and every link is required The requirements group into hardware, software and a service you pay for. Hardware: a computer or phone; a modem or router; and a line — telephone wire, fibre-optic cable, coaxial cable, or a wireless or mobile-data link. A network interface card or Wi-Fi adapter sits inside the device. Software: an operating system with TCP/IP — the protocols that say how a message is addressed and delivered — and a browser or other application to use the service you want. Service: an account with an Internet Service Provider (ISP) — in Nepal, Nepal Telecom, WorldLink, Subisu, Vianet and others. The ISP already has a connection to the wider Internet; you are renting a share of it. The modem is the part worth understanding rather than memorising. Its name is MOdulator-DEModulator. A computer produces digital signals; a telephone line carries a different kind of signal. Modulating turns the computer's digital output into something the line can carry; demodulating turns the arriving signal back into digital. It is a translator, and it has to work in both directions.
items.ne: एउटा शृंखला, हरेक कडी अनिवार्य आवश्यकता हार्डवेयर, सफ्टवेयर र तिर्नुपर्ने सेवा मा बाँडिन्छ। हार्डवेयर: कम्प्युटर वा फोन; modem वा router; र एउटा लाइन — टेलिफोन तार, अप्टिकल फाइबर, कोएक्सियल केबल, वा वायरलेस/मोबाइल डाटा। उपकरणभित्र network interface card वा Wi-Fi adapter हुन्छ। सफ्टवेयर: TCP/IP भएको operating system — सन्देशको ठेगाना कसरी लेख्ने र पुर्‍याउने भन्ने प्रोटोकल — र चाहिएको सेवा चलाउन browser वा अर्को app। सेवा: Internet Service Provider (ISP) को खाता — नेपालमा Nepal Telecom, WorldLink, Subisu, Vianet आदि। ISP सँग विश्व इन्टरनेटको जडान छँदै छ; तपाईं त्यसैको एक अंश भाडामा लिनुहुन्छ। घोक्नुभन्दा बुझ्नुपर्ने भाग modem हो। नाम नै MOdulator-DEModulator। कम्प्युटरले digital सङ्केत निकाल्छ; टेलिफोन लाइनले अर्कै किसिमको सङ्केत बोक्छ। Modulate गर्नु भनेको कम्प्युटरको digital आउटपुटलाई लाइनले बोक्न सक्ने रूपमा बदल्नु; demodulate भनेको आउने सङ्केतलाई फेरि digital बनाउनु। यो अनुवादक हो, र दुवै दिशामा काम गर्नैपर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 5.3 Applications of the Internet — इन्टरनेटका प्रयोग
items.en: Nine services, each solving a different problem The syllabus names nine. They are easiest to hold if you learn the problem each one solved. WWW (World Wide Web) — pages of text, pictures and video, joined by links and read with a browser. The service most people mean when they say "the Internet". E-mail — sending a written message to an address that is waiting for it, whether or not the other person is online. Store and forward. Newsgroup — a public discussion area on a topic, where messages are posted for everybody rather than sent to one person. The ancestor of today's online forums. Telnet — logging in to a distant computer and using it as though you were sitting at it. Old, and insecure because it sends passwords unencrypted. IRC (Internet Relay Chat) — live typed conversation in channels, in real time. The ancestor of messaging apps. E-commerce — buying and selling over the Internet: Daraz, SastoDeal, airline booking, eSewa and Khalti payments. Search engine — a service that indexes pages and finds the ones matching your words. Google, Bing. Without one the Web would be unusable. E-governance — government services delivered online: the Nepal PAN registration portal, online passport applications, result publication, land-revenue payment. Remote control — taking over another computer's screen and keyboard across the network to fix it or to use software on it. Telnet and remote control sound the same and are not. Telnet gives you a text command line on the far machine; remote control gives you its whole desktop as a picture.
items.ne: नौ सेवा, हरेकले फरक समस्या हल गर्ने पाठ्यक्रमले नौ वटा नाम लिन्छ। हरेकले कुन समस्या हल गर्‍यो सिक्यो भने सम्झन सजिलो हुन्छ। WWW — पाठ, तस्बिर र भिडियोका पृष्ठ, लिंकले जोडिएका, browser ले पढिने। "इन्टरनेट" भन्दा धेरैले बुझ्ने सेवा यही हो। E-mail — पर्खिरहेको ठेगानामा लिखित सन्देश पठाउने, अर्को व्यक्ति अनलाइन होस् या नहोस्। Store and forward। Newsgroup — कुनै विषयमा सार्वजनिक छलफलको ठाउँ, जहाँ सन्देश एक जनालाई होइन सबैका लागि राखिन्छ। आजका अनलाइन फोरमका पुर्खा। Telnet — टाढाको कम्प्युटरमा लगइन गरी त्यहीँ बसेजस्तै चलाउने। पुरानो, र पासवर्ड नलुकाई पठाउने भएकाले असुरक्षित। IRC — च्यानलमा वास्तविक समयमै टाइप गरेर गरिने कुराकानी। Messaging app का पुर्खा। E-commerce — इन्टरनेटबाट किनबेच: Daraz, SastoDeal, हवाई टिकट, eSewa र Khalti भुक्तानी। Search engine — पृष्ठको सूची बनाएर तपाईंका शब्दसँग मिल्ने खोज्ने सेवा। Google, Bing। यो नभए वेब चलाउनै गाह्रो हुन्थ्यो। E-governance — सरकारी सेवा अनलाइन: PAN दर्ता पोर्टल, अनलाइन राहदानी आवेदन, नतिजा प्रकाशन, मालपोत भुक्तानी। Remote control — नेटवर्कबाटै अर्को कम्प्युटरको पर्दा र किबोर्ड चलाएर मर्मत गर्ने वा त्यहाँको सफ्टवेयर प्रयोग गर्ने। Telnet र remote control उस्तै सुनिन्छन्, उस्तै होइनन्। Telnet ले पारिको मेसिनमा पाठको command line दिन्छ; remote control ले पूरै डेस्कटप तस्बिरका रूपमा।

Two of the cases are the pair students most often swap. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक काम र त्यसैका लागि बनेको सेवा मिलाउन। दुई केस विद्यार्थीले सबैभन्दा धेरै साटिने जोडी हुन्। How to use this Ask who the message is for. The service follows from the answer. सन्देश कसका लागि हो सोध्नुहोस्। एक जना तोकिएको व्यक्ति, सबै, तपाईंले चलाइरहेको मेसिन, कि तिर्न लागेको पसल? उत्तरबाटै सेवा निस्कन्छ। Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A household has a computer, a router, a fibre line to the house and a browser installed — but no account with any ISP. Can it reach the Internet? एउटा घरमा कम्प्युटर, router, घरसम्म फाइबर लाइन र browser सबै छन् — तर कुनै ISP को खाता छैन। के इन्टरनेट चल्छ? Yes — all the hardware and software are present No — the ISP is a requirement, not an optional extra Only for browsing, not for e-mail No. The fibre runs to the house and stops there. An ISP is the company that already has a connection to the wider Internet; what you buy is a share of theirs. Without an account the line reaches a door that will not open. This is why the ISP belongs in the requirements list and why leaving it out is the commonest way to lose a mark on that question. The hardware alone connects you to nothing — which is also, in plainer terms, why the connection stops when the bill is unpaid. चल्दैन। फाइबर घरसम्म आएर त्यहीँ टुङ्गिन्छ। ISP त्यो कम्पनी हो जोसँग विश्व इन्टरनेटको जडान पहिल्यै छ; तपाईंले किन्ने भनेको त्यसकै एक अंश हो। खाता नभए लाइन नखुल्ने ढोकासम्म पुग्छ। त्यसैले आवश्यकताको सूचीमा ISP पर्छ र यही छुटाउनु अंक गुमाउने सबैभन्दा सामान्य तरिका हो। सीधा भाषामा भन्दा — बिल नतिरे जडान किन रोकिन्छ भन्ने कारण पनि यही हो। Example 1 Choosing the service for four tasks Question: match each task to the Internet service it needs — (a) send your homework to one teacher, (b) pay the municipality, (c) find pages about the Himalayas, (d) a technician in Pokhara repairs a computer in Butwal. For each one ask who the message is for: one named person, everybody, the state, or a machine you are operating. Write your four answers first. हरेकमा सन्देश कसका लागि हो सोध्नुहोस्: एक जना तोकिएको व्यक्ति, सबै, राज्य, कि तपाईंले चलाइरहेको मेसिन। पहिले चार उत्तर लेख्नुहोस्। Working (a) homework to one teacher E-MAIL one named recipient, and it waits until they look (b) pay the municipality E-GOVERNANCE a government service online. Money moves, which makes e-commerce tempting — but e-commerce is customer and business, not paying the state what you owe (c) find pages SEARCH ENGINE the Web holds the pages; the search engine is what makes finding one among billions possible (d) repair a distant computer REMOTE CONTROL the whole desktop. Telnet would give only a text command line Two of these — (b) and (d) — are the ones most often answered wrongly, and both are wrong for the same reason: the obvious word is chosen before the question is read to the end. यीमध्ये (ख) र (घ) सबैभन्दा धेरै गलत हुन्छन्, र दुवै एउटै कारणले: प्रश्न अन्त्यसम्म नपढी स्पष्ट देखिने शब्द छानिन्छ। Example 2 Why a village school chooses mobile data Question: a school is twelve kilometres from the nearest fibre line. Explain which requirement is the obstacle, and what it can use instead. Go through the requirements one at a time and find the one that fails. Which items are unaffected by distance? आवश्यकता एक–एक गरी हेर्नुहोस् र कुन पूरा हुँदैन भेट्टाउनुहोस्। दूरीले कुन–कुनलाई असर गर्दैन? Working device available not the obstacle browser, TCP/IP available not the obstacle ISP account can be bought not the obstacle THE LINE fibre is 12 km away — THIS is the obstacle Alternative lines that do not need a cable to the building: · mobile data (4G) through a router with a SIM · a wireless link to a tower within sight The modem/router is still required. A mobile router does the same modulating job for a radio signal that a fibre modem does for light. The requirements list is not a formality. Working through it names the single thing that is missing, which is what an engineer — or an examiner — is asking for. आवश्यकताको सूची औपचारिकता होइन। एक–एक गरी हेर्दा छुटेको ठ्याक्कै एउटा कुरा थाहा हुन्छ — इन्जिनियर वा परीक्षकले खोजेकै त्यही हो। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying the Internet and the WWW are the same. The Internet is the network; the Web is one service running on it. Listing only advantages of the Internet. A question worth four marks almost always wants disadvantages too. Forgetting the ISP in the requirements list. The hardware alone connects you to nothing. Saying a modem is only for telephone lines. Any line that does not carry raw digital signals needs conversion — fibre included. Mixing up Telnet and remote control. Telnet gives a command line; remote control gives a desktop. इन्टरनेट र WWW उस्तै भन्नु: इन्टरनेट नेटवर्क हो, वेब त्यसमाथिको एउटा सेवा। फाइदा मात्र लेख्नु: ४ अंकको प्रश्नले प्रायः बेफाइदा पनि खोज्छ। ISP छुटाउनु: हार्डवेयरले मात्र कसैसँग जोड्दैन। Modem टेलिफोन लाइनका लागि मात्र भन्नु: कच्चा digital नबोक्ने हरेक लाइनलाई रूपान्तरण चाहिन्छ। Telnet र remote control मिसाउनु: Telnet ले command line, remote control ले डेस्कटप। Memory hook — The Internet is the road. The Web is one kind of vehicle on it. सम्झने तरिका — इन्टरनेट सडक हो। वेब त्यसमा गुड्ने एक किसिमको सवारी। Practical work — this unit's other 12 hours
items.ne: — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू १२ घण्टा

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.ne: — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Internet and its Application
items.ne: इन्टरनेट र यसको प्रयोग

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 5.3 Applications of the Internet — इन्टरनेटका प्रयोग
items.en: What you will learn: to match a real task to the service designed for it. Two of the cases are the pair students most often swap.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक काम र त्यसैका लागि बनेको सेवा मिलाउन। दुई केस विद्यार्थीले सबैभन्दा धेरै साटिने जोडी हुन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Multi means more than one. A single medium — text alone, one photograph, one song — is not multimedia however good it is. Option C combines four media and adds interactivity through replay, which most definitions also require.
items.ne: Multi भनेको एकभन्दा बढी। एउटै माध्यम — केवल पाठ, एउटा फोटो, एउटा गीत — जतिसुकै राम्रो भए पनि मल्टिमिडिया होइन। विकल्प (ग) ले चार माध्यम मिलाउँछ र फेरि बजाउन दिएर अन्तरक्रिया पनि थप्छ, जुन धेरै परिभाषाले खोज्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A static chart would be an image, but this one changes over time, and the frames are generated rather than filmed. Movement plus created equals animation. It is not video because nothing was recorded by a camera. This is the case most often answered "image".
items.ne: स्थिर चार्ट भए image हुन्थ्यो, तर यो समयसँगै बदलिन्छ र फ्रेम खिचिएका होइनन्, बनाइएका हुन्। चाल + बनाइएको = animation। क्यामेराले केही रेकर्ड नगरेकाले video होइन। "image" भनेर सबैभन्दा धेरै गलत हुने केस यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The difference is the source of the frames: recorded versus created. A cartoon is animation even though it moves convincingly; a film of a cartoonist at work is video. Colour and sound are not the test — both can have either.
items.ne: फरक फ्रेम कहाँबाट आयो भन्नेमा छ: रेकर्ड गरिएको कि बनाइएको। कार्टुन विश्वसनीय रूपमा चले पनि animation हो; कार्टुनिस्टले काम गरेको फिल्म video। रङ र आवाज जाँच होइनन् — दुवैमा दुवै हुन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: .mp3 is audio and .mp4 is video — the digits are not decoration, and swapping them is a common slip. .jpg is an image and .txt is text.
items.ne: .mp3 audio र .mp4 video हो — अंक सजावट होइनन्, र यी साट्नु सामान्य गल्ती हो। .jpg image, .txt text।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Video runs at around 25 to 30 frames per second. Text stores one byte per character; an image stores colour values for every pixel, which is already hundreds of times more. Option A is wrong in an interesting way: file size measures data, not meaning — a page of text can carry an idea an hour of video does not. This is also why multimedia needs compression, and why a school on a slow connection downloads notes easily and video with difficulty.
items.ne: भिडियो प्रति सेकेन्ड करिब २५–३० फ्रेममा चल्छ। पाठले प्रति अक्षर एक byte राख्छ; तस्बिरले हरेक pixel को रङ मान राख्छ, जुन पहिल्यै सयौं गुणा बढी हो। विकल्प (क) रोचक किसिमले गलत छ: फाइलको आकारले data नाप्छ, अर्थ होइन। त्यसैले मल्टिमिडियालाई compression चाहिन्छ, र ढिलो जडान भएको विद्यालयले नोट सजिलै तर भिडियो गाह्रोसँग डाउनलोड गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Text. It is the oldest component and the least exciting, so it is the one dropped — and the question asks for all five: text, audio, video, image and animation. Text is also the only component that carries an exact figure, such as a mountain’s height, without ambiguity.
items.ne: Text। सबैभन्दा पुरानो र कम आकर्षक भएकाले यही छुट्छ — तर प्रश्नले पाँचै खोज्छ: text, audio, video, image, animation। ठ्याक्कै संख्या, जस्तै हिमालको उचाइ, अन्योलबिना बोक्ने एक मात्र भाग पनि text नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Medicine — scan images, animated anatomy and surgical simulators are all standard multimedia applications in that field. The argument for multimedia here is the same as everywhere: a description alone would leave out the shape and the movement, which are exactly what the surgeon needs to rehearse.
items.ne: चिकित्सा — स्क्यानका तस्बिर, चल्ने शरीर रचना र शल्यक्रिया सिमुलेटर सबै त्यस क्षेत्रका मानक प्रयोग हुन्। यहाँ मल्टिमिडियाको तर्क अन्यत्रकै जस्तै हो: वर्णनले आकार र चाल छुटाउँछ, र शल्यचिकित्सकलाई अभ्यास चाहिने तिनै हुन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Which component of multimedia?
items.ne: मल्टिमिडियाको कुन भाग?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Each case describes something in a presentation. Name the component. Ask two questions: does it move, and was it recorded from something real or created frame by frame?
items.ne: हरेक केसमा प्रस्तुतीकरणको कुनै वस्तुको वर्णन छ। भागको नाम भन्नुहोस्। दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: यो चल्छ? र वास्तविक कुराबाट रेकर्ड गरिएको हो कि फ्रेम–फ्रेम बनाइएको?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: It moves, and the frames were DRAWN — nobody filmed these raindrops. Created frame by frame is animation, however realistic it looks.
items.ne: चल्छ, र फ्रेम कोरिएका हुन् — यी थोपा कसैले खिचेको होइन। फ्रेम–फ्रेम बनाइएको भए जतिसुकै वास्तविक देखिए पनि animation।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: It moves and it was RECORDED from something that really happened. Filmed on a phone is the giveaway — a camera was pointed at reality.
items.ne: चल्छ र साँच्चै भएको कुराबाट रेकर्ड गरिएको। फोनमा खिचिएको भन्ने सुराक हो — क्यामेरा वास्तविकतातिर तेर्सिएको थियो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A single still picture is an image, whether it is a photograph, a drawing, a chart or a diagram. The test is that nothing changes over time.
items.ne: एउटै स्थिर तस्बिर image हो — फोटो, चित्र, चार्ट वा रेखाचित्र जे भए पनि। जाँच यही हो: समयसँगै केही बदलिँदैन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Sound is audio whether it is speech, music or an effect. Note that a video usually CONTAINS audio — here there is no picture track at all, only the voice.
items.ne: आवाज भनेपछि audio — बोली, सङ्गीत वा प्रभाव जे भए पनि। भिडियोभित्र पनि audio हुन्छ, तर यहाँ तस्बिरको भाग नै छैन, स्वर मात्र छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The component students forget to list. Letters, numbers and symbols are text, and text is the only component that carries an exact figure like 6,993 metres without ambiguity.
items.ne: विद्यार्थीले सूचीमा छुटाउने भाग यही हो। अक्षर, अंक र चिन्ह text हुन्, र ६,९९३ मिटर जस्तो ठ्याक्कै संख्या अन्योलबिना बोक्ने एक मात्र भाग text नै हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A chart alone would be an image — but this one CHANGES OVER TIME, and the frames are generated by the computer rather than filmed. Movement plus created equals animation. This is the case most often answered "image".
items.ne: एक्लो चार्ट भए image हुन्थ्यो — तर यो समयसँगै बदलिन्छ, र फ्रेम कम्प्युटरले आफैं बनाउँछ, खिचिएको होइन। चाल + बनाइएको = animation। "image" भनेर सबैभन्दा धेरै गलत हुने केस यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Say why a video file is so much larger than a text file about the same subject.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: मल्टिमिडियाको परिभाषा र यो शब्द लाग्न कतिवटा भाग चाहिन्छ भन्न, पाँचै भाग नाम लिई हरेकको एउटा फाइल ढाँचा दिन, image र animation अनि animation र video को फरक बुझाउन, कम्तीमा पाँच क्षेत्रमा मल्टिमिडियाको वास्तविक प्रयोग देखाउन, र उही विषयको पाठ फाइलभन्दा भिडियो फाइल किन यति ठूलो हुन्छ भन्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 6.2 The components of multimedia — मल्टिमिडियाका भागहरू
items.en: This is why multimedia needs compression, and why a school with a slow connection can download notes easily and video with difficulty.
items.ne: हजारौं तस्बिर भएकाले। भिडियो प्रति सेकेन्ड करिब २५–३० फ्रेममा चल्छ, त्यसैले एक मिनेट भनेको झन्डै १,५०० छुट्टाछुट्टै तस्बिर, माथि आवाज। एउटै फोटो नै पानाभरिको पाठभन्दा सयौं गुणा ठूलो हुन्छ, किनभने पाठले प्रति अक्षर एक byte राख्छ भने तस्बिरले हरेक pixel को रङको मान। विकल्प (ग) रोचक किसिमले गलत छ: भिडियो बढी जानकारीमूलक लाग्न सक्छ, तर फाइलको आकारले data नाप्छ, अर्थ होइन। त्यसैले मल्टिमिडियालाई compression चाहिन्छ, र ढिलो जडान भएको विद्यालयले नोट सजिलै तर भिडियो गाह्रोसँग डाउनलोड गर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Name each item before opening this. One of the four is not the component it first appears to be.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि हरेक वस्तुको नाम भन्नुहोस्। चारमध्ये एउटा पहिलो नजरमा देखिएको भाग होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The chart is the one that moves. A static chart would be an image; this one changes over time and was generated rather than recorded, which is animation.
items.ne: सर्ने वस्तु चार्ट नै हो। स्थिर चार्ट image हुन्थ्यो; यो समयसँगै बदलिन्छ र रेकर्ड होइन, बनाइएको हो — त्यही animation।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: One component requires a skill the audience may not have. Decide which, and what replaces it.
items.ne: एउटा भागलाई श्रोतासँग नहुन सक्ने सीप चाहिन्छ। कुन हो र त्यसको ठाउँमा के आउँछ, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: This is the real argument for multimedia, and it is not that pictures are nicer. One medium alone would have left part of the audience out.
items.ne: मल्टिमिडियाको साँचो तर्क यही हो, र त्यो "तस्बिर राम्रो देखिन्छ" भन्नु होइन। एउटै माध्यमले श्रोताको एक हिस्सा छुटाउँथ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Giving a file format for the wrong component. .mp3 is audio, .mp4 is video. The digits are not decoration.
items.ne: एउटै फोटोलाई मल्टिमिडिया भन्नु: एउटा माध्यम धेरै होइन। Animation र video उस्तै भन्नु: video वास्तविकताबाट रेकर्ड, animation फ्रेम–फ्रेम बनाइएको। चार भाग मात्र लेख्नु: पाँच हुन् — प्रायः छुट्ने text, जुन सबैभन्दा पुरानो पनि हो। विशेषतामा अन्तरक्रियात्मकता छुटाउनु: चलचित्रभन्दा मल्टिमिडिया app लाई छुट्याउने त्यही हो। गलत भागको ढाँचा दिनु: .mp3 audio, .mp4 video।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू ८ घण्टा
items.en: From the curriculum's own list for Unit 6, which calls these samples. This is the one unit where the medium is the assessment: 6.3 asks you to use multimedia, not to describe it.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रमकै युनिट ६ को सूचीबाट; यसले यिनलाई नमुना भनेको छ। माध्यम आफैं मूल्याङ्कन हुने एक मात्र युनिट यही हो: ६.३ ले मल्टिमिडिया वर्णन गर्न होइन, प्रयोग गर्न भन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू ८ घण्टा
items.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 6.3. Hand in: the file and your notes. For each field, say what one medium alone would have left out — that is the argument, not the list.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: ६.३। बुझाउने: फाइल र नोट। हरेक क्षेत्रमा एउटै माध्यमले के छुटाउँथ्यो भन्नुहोस् — तर्क त्यही हो, सूची होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू ८ घण्टा
items.en: You need: presentation software or paper slides. Builds on: 6.2. Hand in: the file. Five elements, each with a format and an example you can point at in the room.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर वा कागजकै स्लाइड। आधार: ६.२। बुझाउने: फाइल। पाँच भाग, हरेकको ढाँचा र कोठामै देखाउन मिल्ने उदाहरणसहित।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours — प्रयोगात्मक काम — यस युनिटका अरू ८ घण्टा
items.en: You need: a computer with presentation software, and whatever you choose to include. This one is different from every other activity in the subject: here the multimedia is the work itself, not a description of it. Hand in: the file. Use at least three of the five components and be ready to say why each is there. A topic with a process in it — load shedding, monsoon flooding, how a vaccine works — gives animation something to do.
items.ne: चाहिन्छ: प्रस्तुतीकरण सफ्टवेयर भएको कम्प्युटर र तपाईंले छान्ने सामग्री। यो क्रियाकलाप विषयका अरू सबैभन्दा फरक छ: यहाँ मल्टिमिडिया नै काम हो, त्यसको वर्णन होइन। बुझाउने: फाइल। पाँचमध्ये कम्तीमा तीन भाग प्रयोग गर्नुहोस् र हरेक किन राखियो भन्न तयार रहनुहोस्। प्रक्रिया भएको विषय — लोडसेडिङ, वर्षायामको बाढी, खोपले कसरी काम गर्छ — ले एनिमेसनलाई काम दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: This unit carries 6 of the 50 external marks and 8 of the 64 theory hours. It is a small unit with predictable questions: define multimedia; list its components; differentiate two of them; and give applications. The differentiate question is almost always animation against video.

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 6.2 The components of multimedia — मल्टिमिडियाका भागहरू
items.en: Ask two questions: does it move, and was it recorded or created? Those two sort all five.

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 6.1 What multimedia is — मल्टिमिडिया भनेको के हो
items.en: The word means "many media", and the number matters Multimedia is the use of more than one medium — text, audio, video, image and animation — together in one presentation, usually with some interactivity for the user. "More than one" is the part worth marks. A page of plain text is not multimedia. A photograph on its own is not multimedia. A page with text and a photograph is, and a lesson with text, a diagram, a narration and a clip you can replay is a strong example. Many definitions add interactivity — the user can choose what happens next rather than only watching. A film is many media and no interactivity; a learning app is many media and plenty. If an examination question asks for the features of multimedia, interactivity belongs in the answer.
items.ne: शब्दकै अर्थ "धेरै माध्यम", र संख्या महत्त्वपूर्ण छ मल्टिमिडिया भनेको पाठ, अडियो, भिडियो, तस्बिर र एनिमेसनमध्ये एकभन्दा बढी माध्यम एउटै प्रस्तुतीकरणमा सँगै प्रयोग गर्नु हो, प्रायः प्रयोगकर्ताका लागि केही अन्तरक्रियात्मकता सहित। अंक बोक्ने भाग "एकभन्दा बढी" हो। सादा पाठको पाना मल्टिमिडिया होइन। एक्लो फोटो पनि होइन। पाठ र फोटो भएको पाना हो, र पाठ, चित्र, स्वर अनि फेरि बजाउन मिल्ने क्लिप भएको पाठ बलियो उदाहरण हो। धेरै परिभाषाले अन्तरक्रियात्मकता थप्छन् — प्रयोगकर्ताले हेर्ने मात्र होइन, अब के हुने छान्न पाउने। चलचित्रमा धेरै माध्यम छन् तर अन्तरक्रिया छैन; सिकाइ app मा दुवै प्रशस्त छन्। मल्टिमिडियाका विशेषता सोधिए अन्तरक्रियात्मकता उत्तरमा पर्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 6.2 The components of multimedia — मल्टिमिडियाका भागहरू
items.en: Five, and each is a different kind of data The syllabus names five. Learn each with a format, because "give an example of a file format" is a standard follow-up. Text — letters, numbers and symbols. The oldest component and still the one that carries exact meaning. Formats: .txt, .doc, .pdf. Smallest of the five by far. Audio — recorded or generated sound: speech, music, effects. Formats: .mp3, .wav. A microphone is the input device. Video — moving pictures of real events, captured by a camera, almost always with sound. Formats: .mp4, .avi. Largest of the five. Image — a single still picture: photograph, drawing, diagram, chart. Formats: .jpg, .png, .gif. Animation — a sequence of drawn or computer-generated images shown fast enough to look like movement. Formats: .gif, .swf. Animation and video are the pair that is confused. Both move. Video is recorded from something real; animation is created, frame by frame, from something that never happened. A cartoon is animation even though it moves; a film of a cartoonist drawing is video.
items.ne: पाँच, र हरेक फरक किसिमको data पाठ्यक्रमले पाँच वटा नाम लिन्छ। हरेकलाई ढाँचासहित सिक्नुहोस्, किनभने "फाइल ढाँचाको उदाहरण दिनुहोस्" मानक थप प्रश्न हो। Text — अक्षर, अंक र चिन्ह। सबैभन्दा पुरानो, र ठ्याक्कै अर्थ बोक्ने अझै यही। ढाँचा: .txt, .doc, .pdf। पाँचैमध्ये सबैभन्दा सानो। Audio — रेकर्ड गरिएको वा बनाइएको आवाज: बोली, सङ्गीत, प्रभाव। ढाँचा: .mp3, .wav। Input device — microphone। Video — वास्तविक घटनाको चल्ने तस्बिर, क्यामेराले खिचेको, झन्डै सधैं आवाजसहित। ढाँचा: .mp4, .avi। पाँचैमध्ये सबैभन्दा ठूलो। Image — एउटा स्थिर तस्बिर: फोटो, चित्र, रेखाचित्र, चार्ट। ढाँचा: .jpg, .png, .gif। Animation — कोरिएका वा कम्प्युटरले बनाएका तस्बिरको शृंखला, चल्दै गरेजस्तो देखिने गरी छिटो देखाइने। ढाँचा: .gif, .swf। अलमल पार्ने जोडी animation र video हो। दुवै चल्छन्। Video वास्तविक कुराबाट रेकर्ड गरिन्छ; animation कहिल्यै नभएको कुराबाट फ्रेम–फ्रेम बनाइन्छ। कार्टुन चल्छ तर animation हो; कार्टुनिस्टले कोरेको फिल्म चाहिँ video।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Where more than one medium does better than one Education — lessons with diagrams, narration and animation. A process that changes over time, like a heartbeat or a sorting algorithm, is far clearer animated than described. Entertainment — films, games, music and streaming. Games are the purest case, because they are many media and fully interactive. Business and advertising — product demonstrations, presentations, advertisements, websites. Medicine — scan images, animated anatomy, surgical simulators on which a surgeon practises before operating on a person. Engineering and architecture — 3D models walked through before a building exists. Public information — in Nepal, earthquake and monsoon safety messages that reach people who do not read easily, because sound and pictures do not require literacy. The thread through all of these: multimedia is used where one medium alone would leave something out — a shape, a sound, a movement or a choice.
items.ne: जहाँ एउटा माध्यमभन्दा धेरै माध्यम राम्रो हुन्छ शिक्षा — चित्र, स्वर र एनिमेसन भएका पाठ। मुटुको धड्कन वा sorting जस्तो समयसँगै बदलिने प्रक्रिया वर्णन गर्नुभन्दा चलाएर देखाउँदा धेरै स्पष्ट हुन्छ। मनोरञ्जन — चलचित्र, खेल, सङ्गीत, स्ट्रिमिङ। खेल सबैभन्दा शुद्ध उदाहरण हो — धेरै माध्यम र पूरै अन्तरक्रियात्मक। व्यवसाय र विज्ञापन — उत्पादन देखाउने, प्रस्तुतीकरण, विज्ञापन, वेबसाइट। चिकित्सा — स्क्यानका तस्बिर, चल्ने शरीर रचना, र मानिसमा शल्यक्रिया गर्नुअघि अभ्यास गर्ने सिमुलेटर। इन्जिनियरिङ र वास्तुकला — भवन बन्नुअघि नै घुमेर हेर्न मिल्ने ३डी मोडेल। सार्वजनिक सूचना — नेपालमा भूकम्प र वर्षायामका सुरक्षा सन्देश, जुन पढ्न नसक्नेसम्म पनि पुग्छन्, किनभने आवाज र तस्बिरलाई साक्षरता चाहिँदैन। सबैमा साझा कुरा: एउटै माध्यमले केही छुटाउने ठाउँमा मल्टिमिडिया चल्छ — आकार, आवाज, चाल वा छनोट।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which component of multimedia is this? What you will learn: to tell the five components apart from a description. Two cases both move, and the difference is where the pictures came from. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णनबाटै पाँच भाग छुट्याउन। दुई केसमा दुवै चल्छन्, र फरक तस्बिर कहाँबाट आयो भन्नेमा छ। How to use this Ask two questions: does it move, and was it recorded or created? Those two sort all five. दुई प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: चल्छ? र रेकर्ड गरिएको हो कि बनाइएको? यी दुईले पाँचै छुट्याउँछन्। Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A one-page essay about Mount Everest is about 4 KB. A one-minute video about Mount Everest is about 50,000 KB — more than ten thousand times larger. Why? सगरमाथाबारे एक पानाको निबन्ध करिब ४ KB हुन्छ। सगरमाथाकै एक मिनेटको भिडियो करिब ५०,००० KB — दस हजार गुणाभन्दा ठूलो। किन? Video files are stored less efficiently than text A video is thousands of images plus sound, and each image is already far bigger than the essay The video contains more information about Everest It is thousands of images. Video runs at around 25 to 30 frames per second, so one minute is roughly 1,500 separate images, and sound on top. A single photograph is already hundreds of times larger than a page of text, because text stores one byte per character while an image stores colour values for every pixel. Note that option C is wrong in an interesting way: the video may well feel more informative, but file size measures data, not meaning. A page of text can carry an idea that an hour of video does not. This is why multimedia needs compression, and why a school with a slow connection can download notes easily and video with difficulty. हजारौं तस्बिर भएकाले। भिडियो प्रति सेकेन्ड करिब २५–३० फ्रेममा चल्छ, त्यसैले एक मिनेट भनेको झन्डै १,५०० छुट्टाछुट्टै तस्बिर, माथि आवाज। एउटै फोटो नै पानाभरिको पाठभन्दा सयौं गुणा ठूलो हुन्छ, किनभने पाठले प्रति अक्षर एक byte राख्छ भने तस्बिरले हरेक pixel को रङको मान। विकल्प (ग) रोचक किसिमले गलत छ: भिडियो बढी जानकारीमूलक लाग्न सक्छ, तर फाइलको आकारले data नाप्छ, अर्थ होइन। त्यसैले मल्टिमिडियालाई compression चाहिन्छ, र ढिलो जडान भएको विद्यालयले नोट सजिलै तर भिडियो गाह्रोसँग डाउनलोड गर्छ। 6.3 Applications of multimedia
items.ne: — मल्टिमिडियाका प्रयोग

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Name each item before opening this. One of the four is not the component it first appears to be. खोल्नुअघि हरेक वस्तुको नाम भन्नुहोस्। चारमध्ये एउटा पहिलो नजरमा देखिएको भाग होइन। Working photograph IMAGE a single still picture caption with height TEXT letters and numbers recorded narration AUDIO sound growing bar chart ANIMATION not image — it CHANGES over time, and the frames are generated, not filmed Components present: 4 of the 5 (video is missing) Is it multimedia? YES — more than one medium is the test, and four is comfortably more than one The chart is the one that moves. A static chart would be an image; this one changes over time and was generated rather than recorded, which is animation. सर्ने वस्तु चार्ट नै हो। स्थिर चार्ट image हुन्थ्यो; यो समयसँगै बदलिन्छ र रेकर्ड होइन, बनाइएको हो — त्यही animation। Example 2 Which medium is doing the work? Question: a health message must reach villagers, some of whom cannot read. Which components of multimedia should carry the message, and which one cannot be relied on? One component requires a skill the audience may not have. Decide which, and what replaces it. एउटा भागलाई श्रोतासँग नहुन सक्ने सीप चाहिन्छ। कुन हो र त्यसको ठाउँमा के आउँछ, निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। Working TEXT cannot be relied on — it needs literacy AUDIO works — spoken Nepali needs no reading IMAGE works — a picture of the right action ANIMATION works, and is better than an image where the message is a SEQUENCE: wash, then cover, then store VIDEO works, but the file is large and a village connection may not carry it Answer: audio + image, with animation where a process must be shown. Keep text as a caption for those who can read it, not as the carrier of the message. This is the real argument for multimedia, and it is not that pictures are nicer. One medium alone would have left part of the audience out. मल्टिमिडियाको साँचो तर्क यही हो, र त्यो "तस्बिर राम्रो देखिन्छ" भन्नु होइन। एउटै माध्यमले श्रोताको एक हिस्सा छुटाउँथ्यो। Mistakes that cost marks here Calling a single photograph multimedia. One medium is not many. The word needs at least two. Saying animation and video are the same. Video is recorded from reality; animation is created frame by frame. Listing only four components. Text, audio, video, image, animation — five. The one usually dropped is text, which is also the oldest. Leaving interactivity out of the features. It is what separates a multimedia application from a film. Giving a file format for the wrong component. .mp3 is audio, .mp4 is video. The digits are not decoration. एउटै फोटोलाई मल्टिमिडिया भन्नु: एउटा माध्यम धेरै होइन। Animation र video उस्तै भन्नु: video वास्तविकताबाट रेकर्ड, animation फ्रेम–फ्रेम बनाइएको। चार भाग मात्र लेख्नु: पाँच हुन् — प्रायः छुट्ने text, जुन सबैभन्दा पुरानो पनि हो। विशेषतामा अन्तरक्रियात्मकता छुटाउनु: चलचित्रभन्दा मल्टिमिडिया app लाई छुट्याउने त्यही हो। गलत भागको ढाँचा दिनु: .mp3 audio, .mp4 video। Memory hook — TAVIA: Text, Audio, Video, Image, Animation. Recorded moves is video; drawn moves is animation. सम्झने तरिका — TAVIA। रेकर्ड गरेको चल्छ भने video, कोरेको चल्छ भने animation। Practical work — this unit's other 8 hours

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 6.2 The components of multimedia — मल्टिमिडियाका भागहरू
items.en: What you will learn: to tell the five components apart from a description. Two cases both move, and the difference is where the pictures came from.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णनबाटै पाँच भाग छुट्याउन। दुई केसमा दुवै चल्छन्, र फरक तस्बिर कहाँबाट आयो भन्नेमा छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Cloud computing is about WHOSE computer — renting someone else’s over the Internet. Distributed computing is about HOW MANY computers share one task. Here all forty belong to the weather office itself, so ownership is not the point; sharing the work is. They are not opposites, and a cloud service may well be distributed underneath.
items.ne: Cloud computing कम्प्युटर कसको भन्ने कुरा हो — इन्टरनेटमार्फत अर्कैको भाडामा लिनु। Distributed computing एउटै काम कतिवटा कम्प्युटरले बाँड्छन् भन्ने। यहाँ चालीसै मेसिन मौसम विभागकै हुन्, त्यसैले स्वामित्व होइन, काम बाँड्नु मुख्य कुरा हो। यी उल्टा होइनन्, र cloud सेवा भित्री रूपमा distributed हुन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The test has two parts: it must be a thing that is NOT a computer, and it must be on the network. A water tank is not a computer, so adding a sensor and a connection makes it IoT. A laptop on Wi-Fi fails the first part — it was already a computer.
items.ne: जाँचका दुई भाग छन्: त्यो कम्प्युटर नभएको वस्तु हुनुपर्छ, र नेटवर्कमा हुनुपर्छ। पानीको ट्यांकी कम्प्युटर होइन, त्यसैले सेन्सर र जडान थपेपछि IoT बन्छ। Wi-Fi मा जोडिएको ल्यापटप पहिलो भागमै असफल हुन्छ — त्यो त पहिल्यै कम्प्युटर थियो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The call records are big data — the material. Examining them to discover a pattern nobody asked for is the activity, and that activity is data mining. Big data is a noun you have; data mining is a verb you do to it. Writing "big data is mining large data" merges the two and loses the mark.
items.ne: कल रेकर्ड big data हुन् — सामग्री। कसैले नखोजेको बान्की भेट्न केलाउनु काम हो, र त्यो काम data mining। Big data तपाईंसँग भएको नाम हो; data mining त्यसमाथि गरिने क्रिया। "Big data भनेको ठूलो data को mining हो" लेख्नु दुईलाई मिसाउनु हो र अंक गुम्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The real engine is still visible and information has been ADDED on top — that is AR. VR would replace the surroundings entirely with a computer-generated world, and would need a headset that blocks the room out. The ordinary phone is the clue.
items.ne: वास्तविक इन्जिन देखिँदै छ र माथि सूचना थपिएको छ — यही AR। VR ले वरिपरिको संसार पूरै कम्प्युटरले बनाएको संसारले बदल्थ्यो र कोठा छेक्ने हेडसेट चाहिन्थ्यो। साधारण फोन नै सुराक हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Security that depends on hiding the method collapses as soon as somebody works the method out, and it cannot be repaired. Security that depends on a key survives: the algorithm can be published and studied, and if a key is exposed you change the key. This is why the same public algorithm protects millions of different conversations.
items.ne: तरिका लुकाएर पाइने सुरक्षा कसैले तरिका पत्ता लगाउने बित्तिकै ढल्छ, र त्यसलाई मर्मत गर्न मिल्दैन। Key मा अडेको सुरक्षा टिक्छ: एल्गोरिदम छापेर अध्ययन गर्न दिन सकिन्छ, र key चुहियो भने key फेरे पुग्छ। एउटै सार्वजनिक एल्गोरिदमले लाखौं फरक कुराकानी जोगाउनुको कारण यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Learning from experience is the phrase that carries the mark. An ordinary program does exactly what it was told; an AI system is given examples and works out the rule itself, which is why it can improve without a programmer rewriting it. Speed, Internet and language are not part of the definition.
items.ne: अंक बोक्ने वाक्यांश "अनुभवबाट सिक्ने" हो। साधारण प्रोग्रामले भनेकै गर्छ; AI प्रणालीलाई उदाहरण दिइन्छ र नियम आफैं निकाल्छ, त्यसैले प्रोग्रामरले फेरि नलेखिकनै सुध्रन सक्छ। गति, इन्टरनेट र भाषा परिभाषाका भाग होइनन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Option A is backwards — not buying servers is cloud computing’s main advantage, and options C and D describe the opposite of what it offers. The real disadvantages are dependence on a working connection, data held by someone else, and a cost that never stops. All three matter in Nepal, where connections fail and electricity is not guaranteed.
items.ne: विकल्प (क) उल्टो छ — सर्भर नकिन्नु नै cloud को मुख्य फाइदा हो, र (ग) तथा (घ) ले यसले दिने कुराको ठिक उल्टो भन्छन्। साँचो बेफाइदा: चल्ने जडानमा निर्भरता, data अर्कैसँग रहनु, र कहिल्यै नसकिने खर्च। नेपालमा तीनै महत्त्वपूर्ण छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: New is not the test — a new model of phone is new and changes nothing. A technology is emerging when it is moving out of the laboratory into use fast enough that the rules and the jobs around it have not settled. That also means the list changes over time, which is what the word predicts.
items.ne: जाँच "नयाँ" होइन — फोनको नयाँ मोडेल नयाँ त हो, तर केही बदल्दैन। कुनै प्रविधि प्रयोगशालाबाट प्रयोगमा यति छिटो सर्दै छ कि वरिपरिका नियम र पेसा नै थामिइसकेका छैनन् भने त्यो उदीयमान हो। यसैले सूची समयसँगै बदलिन्छ — शब्दले भनेकै त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Which emerging technology is this?
items.ne: यो कुन उदीयमान प्रविधि हो?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Each case is a real situation. Name the technology. Three questions settle most of them: whose computer is it, can the user still see the room, and is this the data or the digging?
items.ne: हरेक केस वास्तविक परिस्थिति हो। प्रविधिको नाम भन्नुहोस्। तीन प्रश्नले धेरैजसो टुङ्ग्याउँछन्: कम्प्युटर कसको हो, प्रयोगकर्ताले कोठा अझै देख्छ कि देख्दैन, र यो data हो कि खोतल्ने काम?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The question is WHOSE COMPUTER. The school is renting storage on somebody else’s machine over the Internet — that is cloud computing. Distributed is the near-miss, and it would be about how many computers share one task, which is not what is happening here.
items.ne: प्रश्न कम्प्युटर कसको हो भन्ने हो। विद्यालयले अर्कैको मेसिनमा इन्टरनेटमार्फत भण्डारण भाडामा लिएको छ — यही cloud computing। Distributed नजिकैको गलत उत्तर हो; त्यो एउटै काम कतिवटा कम्प्युटरले बाँड्छन् भन्ने कुरा हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: ONE task, MANY computers, working together to finish sooner — that is distributed computing. All forty may belong to the weather office itself, which is why this is not about ownership and not cloud.
items.ne: एउटै काम, धेरै कम्प्युटर, छिटो सक्न सँगै — यही distributed computing। चालीसै मेसिन मौसम विभागकै हुन सक्छन्, त्यसैले यो स्वामित्वको कुरा होइन र cloud होइन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: A water tank is NOT a computer, and it is on the network — which is exactly the test for IoT. A laptop doing the same thing would not be IoT, because a laptop is already a computer.
items.ne: पानीको ट्यांकी कम्प्युटर होइन, र नेटवर्कमा छ — IoT को जाँच ठ्याक्कै यही हो। उही काम ल्यापटपले गरे IoT हुँदैन, किनभने ल्यापटप त कम्प्युटरै हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The records are big data — the material. EXAMINING them to discover a pattern nobody asked for is the activity, and the activity is data mining. "Discovers" is the word that decides it.
items.ne: रेकर्ड भनेको big data — सामग्री। कसैले नखोजेको बान्की भेट्न केलाउनु चाहिँ काम हो, र त्यो काम data mining। निर्णय गर्ने शब्द "भेट्छ" हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Entirely computer-generated and a headset over the eyes: the real room is gone, so this is VR. If the trainee could still see the real operating theatre with labels drawn on it, it would be AR.
items.ne: पूरै कम्प्युटरले बनाएको र आँखामा हेडसेट: वास्तविक कोठा हराउँछ, त्यसैले VR। वास्तविक अपरेसन कक्ष देख्दै माथि नाम कोरिएको भए AR हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The real engine is still visible and information has been ADDED on top. That is AR, and the ordinary phone is the clue — VR needs a headset that blocks the world out.
items.ne: वास्तविक इन्जिन देखिँदै छ र माथि सूचना थपिएको छ — यही AR, र साधारण फोन नै सुराक हो; VR लाई संसार छेक्ने हेडसेट चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Give a Nepali example for at least four of these technologies.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: कुनै प्रविधि नयाँ मात्र नभई "उदीयमान" किन भनिन्छ भन्न, AI, cloud computing, distributed computing, IoT, big data र data mining परिभाषित गर्न, cloud र distributed अनि big data र data mining छुट्याउन, सन्देश encrypt–decrypt गरेर key किन चाहिन्छ भन्न, VR र AR लाई प्रयोगकर्ताले के देख्न सक्छ भन्ने आधारमा छुट्याउन, र कम्तीमा चारवटा प्रविधिको नेपाली उदाहरण दिन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 7.7 Cryptography — encryption and decryption — Cryptography — encryption र decryption
items.en: 1. Set the key to 3 and read the ciphertext — this exact cipher is about 2000 years old. 2. Set it to 0 and see why a key of zero is no key at all. 3. Notice that the spaces do not move: the shape of the message leaks even when the letters do not. A real weakness, and one reason this cipher is not used for anything that matters — a computer breaks it by trying all 25 keys in well under a second.
items.ne: १. Key ३ राखेर ciphertext पढ्नुहोस् — यही cipher करिब दुई हजार वर्ष पुरानो हो। २. ० राखेर हेर्नुहोस्, शून्य key किन key नै होइन। ३. खाली ठाउँ नसरेको ध्यान दिनुहोस्: अक्षर नसरे पनि सन्देशको आकार चुहिन्छ। यो साँचो कमजोरी हो, र यस cipher लाई महत्त्वपूर्ण काममा नचलाइनुको एउटा कारण — कम्प्युटरले २५ वटै key एक सेकेन्डभित्रै प्रयास गरेर फोड्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: That is why the same published algorithm can protect millions of different conversations at once. Each pair of people uses a different key, and knowing the method tells you nothing about any of them.
items.ne: हुँदैनन्, र पूरै विषयको केन्द्रीय विचार यही हो। तरिका लुकाएर पाइने सुरक्षा कसैले तरिका पत्ता लगाउने बित्तिकै ढल्छ, र मर्मत गर्न मिल्दैन — नयाँ cipher नै बनाउनुपर्छ। Key मा अडेको सुरक्षा छापिए पनि टिक्छ: एल्गोरिदम छापेर विज्ञहरूले अध्ययन र आक्रमण गर्न दिन सकिन्छ, र key चुहिए key फेरे पुग्छ। एउटै छापिएको एल्गोरिदमले एकैपटक लाखौं फरक कुराकानी जोगाउन सक्नुको कारण यही हो। हरेक जोडीले फरक key चलाउँछ, र तरिका थाहा हुँदैमा कुनैको key थाहा हुँदैन।

items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit — परीक्षा केन्द्र — यस युनिटबाट के सोधिन्छ
items.en: The key is the secret value used by the algorithm to perform the conversion. The algorithm is usually publicly known; the security depends on keeping the key secret, and a different key produces a different ciphertext from the same message.
items.ne: Encryption भनेको plaintext (पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश) लाई ciphertext (पढ्न नमिल्ने रूप) मा बदल्ने प्रक्रिया हो, ताकि अधिकार पाएकोले मात्र पढोस्। Decryption उल्टो प्रक्रिया। Key भनेको एल्गोरिदमले रूपान्तरण गर्न प्रयोग गर्ने गोप्य मान हो। एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ; सुरक्षा key गोप्य राख्नुमा भर पर्छ, र फरक key ले उही सन्देशबाट फरक ciphertext बनाउँछ।

items.en: VR replaces the real world; AR adds to it.
items.ne: उदीयमान = नियम नै थामिनसक्दै प्रयोगमा छिर्दै गरेको, नयाँ मात्र होइन। AI: मानवीय बुद्धि चाहिने काम गर्ने र अनुभवबाट सिक्ने। Cloud = कम्प्युटर कसको; distributed = कतिवटा। IoT: कम्प्युटर नभएका वस्तु नेटवर्कमा। Big data सामग्री (volume, velocity, variety), data mining काम। Encryption लाई एल्गोरिदम र key चाहिन्छ; एल्गोरिदम सार्वजनिक, key गोप्य। VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ।

items.en: Three questions settle most of them: whose computer is it, is the user still able to see the room, and is this the data or the digging?

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 7.1 What "emerging technology" means — "उदीयमान प्रविधि" भनेको के हो
items.en: Not new — becoming important Emerging technologies are technologies that are still developing, are not yet in ordinary everyday use, and are expected to change how people live and work within the next several years. "New" is not the test. A new model of phone is new and changes nothing. A technology is emerging when it is moving out of the laboratory and into use, fast enough that the rules and the jobs around it have not settled yet. That also means the list changes. Everything in this unit is emerging as this curriculum is written; some of it will be ordinary by the time you are working, and that is what the word predicts.
items.ne: नयाँ होइन — महत्त्वपूर्ण बन्दै गरेको उदीयमान प्रविधि भनेका ती प्रविधि हुन् जो अझै विकसित हुँदै छन्, दैनिक सामान्य प्रयोगमा आइसकेका छैनन्, र आउँदा केही वर्षभित्रै मानिसको जीवन र कामको तरिका बदल्ने अपेक्षा गरिन्छ। जाँच "नयाँ" भन्नु होइन। फोनको नयाँ मोडेल नयाँ त हो, तर केही बदल्दैन। कुनै प्रविधि प्रयोगशालाबाट निस्केर प्रयोगमा यति छिटो सर्दै छ कि वरिपरिका नियम र पेसा नै थामिइसकेका छैनन् भने त्यो उदीयमान हो। यसको अर्थ सूची बदलिन्छ पनि। यो पाठ्यक्रम लेखिँदा यस युनिटका सबै उदीयमान छन्; तपाईं काम गर्ने बेलासम्म केही सामान्य भइसक्नेछन् — शब्दले भनेकै त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Machines doing what used to need a person Artificial Intelligence is the branch of computer science concerned with making machines perform tasks that normally require human intelligence — understanding language, recognising images and speech, making decisions, and learning from experience. The phrase that carries the mark is learning from experience. An ordinary program does exactly what it was told. An AI system is given examples and works out the rule itself, which is why it can improve without being rewritten. Examples you already meet: voice assistants, face unlock on a phone, the suggestions in a search box, machine translation between Nepali and English, and the fraud checks a bank runs on your transactions.
items.ne: पहिले मान्छे चाहिने काम मेसिनले गर्नु Artificial Intelligence कम्प्युटर विज्ञानको त्यो शाखा हो जसले मेसिनलाई सामान्यतया मानवीय बुद्धि चाहिने काम गर्न लगाउँछ — भाषा बुझ्ने, तस्बिर र बोली चिन्ने, निर्णय गर्ने, र अनुभवबाट सिक्ने। अंक बोक्ने वाक्यांश अनुभवबाट सिक्ने हो। साधारण प्रोग्रामले भनेकै गर्छ। AI प्रणालीलाई उदाहरण दिइन्छ र नियम आफैं निकाल्छ — त्यसैले फेरि नलेखिकनै सुध्रन सक्छ। तपाईंले भेटिसकेका उदाहरण: भ्वाइस असिस्टेन्ट, फोनको face unlock, खोज बाकसका सुझाव, नेपाली–अंग्रेजी मेसिन अनुवाद, र बैंकले तपाईंको कारोबारमा गर्ने ठगी जाँच।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 7.3 Cloud computing and distributed computing — Cloud computing र distributed computing
items.en: Two ideas that share a picture and answer different questions Cloud computing is using computing resources — storage, processing, software — that are owned and run by somebody else and reached over the Internet, paying for what you use instead of buying the machines. Google Drive, Gmail and online backup are cloud services. Distributed computing is splitting one large task across many computers that work on it together, so that it finishes faster than any one of them could manage. Weather forecasting and large scientific calculations are done this way. The examination asks you to separate them, and the clean separation is this: cloud computing is about WHO OWNS the computer; distributed computing is about HOW MANY computers share the work. A cloud service may be distributed underneath, and a distributed system may sit entirely inside one organisation's own building. They are not opposites and they are not the same. Cloud computing's advantages: no hardware to buy, reachable from anywhere, grows when you need more. Its disadvantages: it needs a working Internet connection, your data sits on someone else's computer, and the monthly cost never stops — all three matter in Nepal, where connections fail and electricity is not guaranteed.
items.ne: एउटै चित्र बाँड्ने, फरक प्रश्नको उत्तर दिने दुई विचार Cloud computing भनेको अर्कैले किनेर चलाएका कम्प्युटिङ स्रोत — भण्डारण, प्रशोधन, सफ्टवेयर — इन्टरनेटमार्फत प्रयोग गर्नु हो, मेसिन किन्नुको साटो जति चलायो त्यति तिरेर। Google Drive, Gmail र अनलाइन ब्याकअप cloud सेवा हुन्। Distributed computing भनेको एउटै ठूलो काम धेरै कम्प्युटरमा बाँडेर सँगै गराउनु हो, ताकि एउटैले सक्ने भन्दा छिटो सकियोस्। मौसम पूर्वानुमान र ठूला वैज्ञानिक गणना यसरी गरिन्छन्। परीक्षाले यी छुट्याउन भन्छ, र सफा फरक यही हो: cloud computing कम्प्युटर कसको हो भन्ने कुरा हो; distributed computing काम कति कम्प्युटरले बाँड्छन् भन्ने। Cloud सेवा भित्री रूपमा distributed हुन सक्छ, र distributed प्रणाली एउटै संस्थाकै भवनभित्र हुन सक्छ। यी उल्टा पनि होइनन्, उही पनि होइनन्। Cloud का फाइदा: हार्डवेयर किन्नु नपर्ने, जहाँबाट पनि पुग्न सकिने, चाहिएअनुसार बढ्ने। बेफाइदा: चल्ने इन्टरनेट चाहिने, तपाईंको data अर्कैको कम्प्युटरमा रहने, र मासिक खर्च कहिल्यै नसकिने — नेपालमा तीनै कुरा महत्त्वपूर्ण छन्, जहाँ जडान बिग्रन्छ र बिजुलीको ग्यारेन्टी छैन।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 7.4 Internet of Things (IoT) — इन्टरनेट अफ थिङ्स (IoT)
items.en: Ordinary objects that can report and be told The Internet of Things is the connection of everyday physical objects — fitted with sensors and software — to the Internet, so that they can collect data, send it, and be controlled remotely. The test for an IoT device is simple: it is a thing that is not a computer, and it is on the network. A laptop on Wi-Fi is not IoT, because a laptop is a computer. A water tank with a level sensor that messages you when it is low is IoT, because a water tank is not a computer. Examples: smart meters that report electricity use without a reader visiting; soil sensors that tell a farmer when to irrigate; health bands; vehicle trackers; street lights that switch themselves on. The risk is the same in every case — a thing on the network can be reached by people you did not intend.
items.ne: जानकारी दिन र आदेश लिन सक्ने सामान्य वस्तु Internet of Things भनेको दैनिक प्रयोगका भौतिक वस्तुहरूलाई — सेन्सर र सफ्टवेयर राखेर — इन्टरनेटमा जोड्नु हो, ताकि तिनले data जम्मा गरून्, पठाऊन् र टाढैबाट नियन्त्रण गर्न सकियोस्। IoT हो कि होइन भन्ने जाँच सरल छ: त्यो कम्प्युटर नभएको वस्तु हो, र नेटवर्कमा छ। Wi-Fi मा जोडिएको ल्यापटप IoT होइन, किनभने ल्यापटप कम्प्युटर हो। पानीको ट्यांकीमा लेभल सेन्सर राखेर कम भएपछि सन्देश पठाउने प्रणाली IoT हो, किनभने ट्यांकी कम्प्युटर होइन। उदाहरण: मिटर पढ्न कोही नआई बिजुली खपत पठाउने स्मार्ट मिटर; कहिले सिँचाइ गर्ने भन्ने किसानलाई बताउने माटोको सेन्सर; स्वास्थ्य ब्यान्ड; सवारी ट्र्याकर; आफैं बल्ने सडक बत्ती। जोखिम हरेक ठाउँमा उही हो — नेटवर्कमा भएको वस्तुमा तपाईंले नचाहेका मानिस पनि पुग्न सक्छन्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Too big, too fast, too mixed for ordinary tools Big data means collections of data so large, so fast-arriving and so varied that ordinary database software cannot store or process them usefully. It is usually described by three Vs: Volume — terabytes and beyond; Velocity — arriving continuously rather than in batches; Variety — text, images, video, sensor readings and records all mixed together. Size alone is not the point. A single enormous video file is large and is not big data. Big data is large and messy and continuous — which is why it needs different tools, not just a bigger disk. Examples: every transaction of a mobile wallet; every post on a social network; the readings of thousands of weather sensors; a telecom company's call records.
items.ne: साधारण उपकरणका लागि निकै ठूलो, छिटो र मिश्रित Big data भनेको यति ठूलो, यति छिटो आउने र यति विविध data को संग्रह हो कि साधारण डाटाबेस सफ्टवेयरले काम लाग्ने गरी राख्न वा प्रशोधन गर्नै सक्दैन। यसलाई प्रायः तीन V ले वर्णन गरिन्छ: Volume — टेराबाइट र त्योभन्दा माथि; Velocity — पोकामा होइन, निरन्तर आउने; Variety — पाठ, तस्बिर, भिडियो, सेन्सरका मान र अभिलेख सबै मिसिएका। ठूलो हुनु मात्र मुख्य कुरा होइन। एउटै विशाल भिडियो फाइल ठूलो त हो, big data होइन। Big data ठूलो र अव्यवस्थित र निरन्तर हुन्छ — त्यसैले ठूलो डिस्क होइन, फरक उपकरण चाहिन्छ। उदाहरण: मोबाइल वालेटका हरेक कारोबार; सामाजिक सञ्जालका हरेक पोस्ट; हजारौं मौसम सेन्सरका मान; टेलिकम कम्पनीका कल रेकर्ड।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Digging patterns out of data you already have Data mining is the process of examining large amounts of stored data to discover patterns and relationships that were not obvious, and using them to predict or to decide. Big data and data mining are a pair and are not the same. Big data is the material; data mining is the activity. One is a noun you have; the other is a verb you do to it. An examination answer that says "big data is mining large data" has merged the two and loses the mark. The classic example: a shop analyses thousands of receipts and finds that customers who buy bread often buy eggs on the same visit — so the two are placed near each other. Nobody told the computer to look for bread and eggs; it found the pattern. In Nepal the same technique finds which crops fail together in a district, or which transactions look like fraud.
items.ne: भएकै data बाट बान्की खोतल्नु Data mining भनेको भण्डारण गरिएको ठूलो मात्राको data केलाएर स्पष्ट नदेखिएका बान्की र सम्बन्ध पत्ता लगाउने र त्यसैबाट अनुमान वा निर्णय गर्ने प्रक्रिया हो। Big data र data mining जोडी हुन्, उही होइनन्। Big data सामग्री हो; data mining काम। एउटा तपाईंसँग भएको नाम हो, अर्को त्यसमाथि गरिने क्रिया। "Big data भनेको ठूलो data को mining हो" लेख्ने उत्तरले दुईलाई मिसाएको हुन्छ र अंक गुमाउँछ। उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण: पसलले हजारौं बिल केलाउँदा पाउरोटी किन्नेले प्रायः उही पटक अन्डा पनि किन्छन् भन्ने भेट्छ — त्यसैले दुवै नजिक राखिन्छ। पाउरोटी र अन्डा खोज् भनेर कसैले भनेको थिएन; बान्की कम्प्युटरले भेट्यो। नेपालमा यही तरिकाले कुन जिल्लामा कुन बाली सँगै बिग्रन्छ वा कुन कारोबार ठगी जस्तो देखिन्छ पत्ता लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.topic: 7.7 Cryptography — encryption and decryption — Cryptography — encryption र decryption
items.en: Making a message unreadable on purpose Cryptography is the practice of protecting information by converting it into a form that cannot be read by anyone who is not meant to read it. Encryption converts plaintext — the readable message — into ciphertext, using an algorithm and a key. Decryption is the reverse: ciphertext back to plaintext, using the key. The key is the part worth understanding. The algorithm is usually public — everyone knows how the method works. What the sender and receiver keep secret is the key. Security that depends on hiding the method fails as soon as somebody works the method out; security that depends on a key survives, because the method can be published and the key changed. Where you already rely on it: the padlock in a browser when you pay online, the encryption on a messaging app, and the password stored by a website — stored encrypted, so that stealing the file does not hand over the passwords.
items.ne: जानीजानी सन्देश नपढिने बनाउनु Cryptography भनेको सूचनालाई पढ्न नहुनेले पढ्नै नसक्ने रूपमा बदलेर जोगाउने अभ्यास हो। Encryption ले plaintext — पढ्न मिल्ने सन्देश — लाई एल्गोरिदम र key प्रयोग गरी ciphertext मा बदल्छ। Decryption उल्टो हो: key कै प्रयोगले ciphertext बाट फेरि plaintext। बुझ्नुपर्ने भाग key हो। एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ — तरिका सबैलाई थाहा हुन्छ। पठाउने र पाउनेले गोप्य राख्ने भनेको key हो। तरिका लुकाएर पाइने सुरक्षा कसैले तरिका पत्ता लगाउने बित्तिकै सकिन्छ; key मा अडेको सुरक्षा टिक्छ, किनभने तरिका छापे पनि key फेर्न सकिन्छ। तपाईं अहिल्यै भर परिरहेका ठाउँ: अनलाइन तिर्दा browser मा देखिने ताल्चा, messaging app को encryption, र वेबसाइटले राख्ने पासवर्ड — encrypt गरेर राखिन्छ, ताकि फाइल चोरिए पनि पासवर्ड नपाइयोस्।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The real world replaced Virtual Reality is a computer-generated environment that replaces the user's surroundings entirely. Wearing a headset, you see and hear only what the computer produces; the room you are standing in is gone. Uses: pilot and surgical training where a mistake must not cost anything real; walking through a building before it is built; games; and visiting a place — a museum, a mountain — that you cannot travel to.
items.ne: वास्तविक संसार नै प्रतिस्थापित Virtual Reality भनेको कम्प्युटरले बनाएको त्यस्तो वातावरण हो जसले प्रयोगकर्ताको वरिपरिको संसार पूरै प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ। हेडसेट लगाएपछि तपाईंले कम्प्युटरले देखाएको र सुनाएको मात्र पाउनुहुन्छ; उभिएको कोठा हराउँछ। प्रयोग: गल्तीले वास्तविक क्षति नहुनुपर्ने पाइलट र शल्यक्रिया तालिम; नबनेकै भवनभित्र हिँड्ने; खेल; र पुग्नै नसकिने ठाउँ — संग्रहालय, हिमाल — घुम्ने।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: The real world added to Augmented Reality adds computer-generated information to the real world instead of replacing it. Through a phone camera or clear glasses you still see the room, with extra things drawn on top of it. Uses: a phone showing how furniture would look in your own room; navigation arrows drawn on the street ahead; a repair manual that labels the parts of the engine you are actually looking at; and classroom apps that place a 3D heart on your desk. The whole difference is what you can still see. VR: the real world is gone. AR: the real world is there with something added. If an examination question describes a headset that blocks everything out, it is VR; if the user can still see the road, it is AR.
items.ne: वास्तविक संसारमा थपिएको Augmented Reality ले वास्तविक संसार हटाउने होइन, त्यसमाथि कम्प्युटरले बनाएको सूचना थप्छ। फोनको क्यामेरा वा पारदर्शी चस्माबाट तपाईंले कोठा देख्दै गर्नुहुन्छ, माथि थप कुरा कोरिएको हुन्छ। प्रयोग: आफ्नै कोठामा फर्निचर कस्तो देखिन्छ देखाउने फोन; अगाडिको सडकमै कोरिएका बाटो देखाउने तीर; हेरिरहेकै इन्जिनका भाग नाम लेखिदिने मर्मत निर्देशिका; र डेस्कमै ३डी मुटु राख्ने कक्षा app। पूरै फरक तपाईंले अझै के देख्न सक्नुहुन्छ भन्नेमा छ। VR: वास्तविक संसार हराउँछ। AR: वास्तविक संसार छँदै छ, केही थपिएको। प्रश्नमा सबै छेक्ने हेडसेटको कुरा छ भने VR; प्रयोगकर्ताले सडक अझै देख्छ भने AR।

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: Memory hook — VR replaces, AR adds. Big data is the pile; data mining is the digging.
items.ne: सम्झने तरिका — VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ। Big data थुप्रो, data mining खन्ने काम।

items.en: · आफैं गरेर हेर्नुहोस् Encrypt a message, then decrypt it What you will learn: what the key actually does. Move it and the ciphertext changes; the algorithm never changes. That is why secrecy lives in the key, and why decryption is the same operation run backwards. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: key ले साँच्चै के गर्छ। सार्नुहोस्, ciphertext बदलिन्छ; एल्गोरिदम कहिल्यै बदलिँदैन। गोपनीयता key मै बस्नुको र decryption उही कामको उल्टो हुनुको कारण यही हो। Three things to try 1. Set the key to 3 and read the ciphertext — this exact cipher is about 2000 years old. 2. Set it to 0 and see why a key of zero is no key at all. 3. Notice that the spaces do not move: the shape of the message leaks even when the letters do not. A real weakness, and one reason this cipher is not used for anything that matters — a computer breaks it by trying all 25 keys in well under a second. १. Key ३ राखेर ciphertext पढ्नुहोस् — यही cipher करिब दुई हजार वर्ष पुरानो हो। २. ० राखेर हेर्नुहोस्, शून्य key किन key नै होइन। ३. खाली ठाउँ नसरेको ध्यान दिनुहोस्: अक्षर नसरे पनि सन्देशको आकार चुहिन्छ। यो साँचो कमजोरी हो, र यस cipher लाई महत्त्वपूर्ण काममा नचलाइनुको एउटा कारण — कम्प्युटरले २५ वटै key एक सेकेन्डभित्रै प्रयास गरेर फोड्छ। 7.8 Virtual Reality (VR)
