The pairs that get confused — cloud against distributed, big data against data mining, VR against AR — are all here. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: परिस्थितिबाटै प्रविधि चिन्न — यो युनिट यसरी नै जाँचिन्छ। अलमल पार्ने जोडी — cloud र distributed, big data र data mining, VR र AR — सबै यहीँ छन्। How to use this Three questions settle most of them: whose computer is it, is the user still able to see the room, and is this the data or the digging? तीन प्रश्नले धेरैजसो टुङ्ग्याउँछन्: कम्प्युटर कसको हो, प्रयोगकर्ताले कोठा अझै देख्छ कि देख्दैन, र यो data हो कि खोतल्ने काम? Predict first
items.ne: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade9/computer-fundamentals
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A cipher's algorithm is published in a textbook that anyone can buy. Does publishing it make messages encrypted with that algorithm insecure? कुनै cipher को एल्गोरिदम जोसुकैले किन्न सक्ने पाठ्यपुस्तकमा छापिएको छ। छापिएकै कारण त्यस एल्गोरिदमले encrypt गरिएका सन्देश असुरक्षित हुन्छन्? Yes — anyone who knows the method can read the message Yes, but only if they also own a fast computer No — the method being known is fine; it is the key that must stay secret No, and this is the central idea of the whole topic. Security that depends on hiding the method collapses the moment somebody works the method out, and it cannot be repaired — you would have to invent a new cipher. Security that depends on a key survives publication: the algorithm can be printed, studied and attacked by experts, and if a key is ever exposed you simply change the key. That is why the same published algorithm can protect millions of different conversations at once. Each pair of people uses a different key, and knowing the method tells you nothing about any of them. हुँदैनन्, र पूरै विषयको केन्द्रीय विचार यही हो। तरिका लुकाएर पाइने सुरक्षा कसैले तरिका पत्ता लगाउने बित्तिकै ढल्छ, र मर्मत गर्न मिल्दैन — नयाँ cipher नै बनाउनुपर्छ। Key मा अडेको सुरक्षा छापिए पनि टिक्छ: एल्गोरिदम छापेर विज्ञहरूले अध्ययन र आक्रमण गर्न दिन सकिन्छ, र key चुहिए key फेरे पुग्छ। एउटै छापिएको एल्गोरिदमले एकैपटक लाखौं फरक कुराकानी जोगाउन सक्नुको कारण यही हो। हरेक जोडीले फरक key चलाउँछ, र तरिका थाहा हुँदैमा कुनैको key थाहा हुँदैन। Example 1 Encrypt and decrypt by hand Question: encrypt the word NEPAL with a shift of 4, then decrypt XSVOH with the same key. Do both on paper before opening this. Remember that the alphabet wraps: after Z comes A again. खोल्नुअघि दुवै कागजमै गर्नुहोस्। वर्णमाला घुम्छ भन्ने नबिर्सनुहोस्: Z पछि फेरि A आउँछ। Working ENCRYPT shift each letter FORWARD 4 N -> R E -> I P -> T A -> E L -> P NEPAL -> RITEP DECRYPT shift each letter BACK 4 X -> T S -> O V -> R O -> K H -> D XSVOH -> TORKD Check the wrap: with a shift of 4, W -> A, X -> B, Y -> C, Z -> D. Nothing falls off the end of the alphabet. Notice that decryption used no new method — the same operation, run in the other direction with the same key. That is the point the bench above is making, and it is what makes the key, not the algorithm, the thing worth keeping secret. Decryption मा नयाँ तरिका लागेन — उही काम, उही key, उल्टो दिशामा। माथिको बेन्चले भन्न खोजेको कुरा यही हो, र एल्गोरिदम होइन key नै गोप्य राख्नुपर्ने कारण पनि। Example 2 Naming the technology in one paragraph Question: "A municipality fits sensors to 500 water taps. The readings go to a server rented from a company in Singapore. Software examines two years of those readings and finds which wards lose the most water at night." Name the three technologies, in order. Three different things are happening in three sentences. Name each before opening this. तीन वाक्यमा तीन फरक कुरा भइरहेका छन्। खोल्नुअघि हरेकको नाम भन्नुहोस्। Working 1 sensors on 500 taps IoT a tap is not a computer, and now it is on the network 2 a server rented in Singapore CLOUD COMPUTING whose computer? somebody else's, reached over the Internet. NOT distributed — nothing says the work is split across many machines 3 examining two years of DATA MINING readings to FIND a pattern the readings themselves are big data; the examining is the mining Questions in this unit often hide three technologies in one short paragraph, exactly like this. Read it sentence by sentence rather than looking for one answer. यस युनिटका प्रश्नले प्रायः छोटो अनुच्छेदमै तीन प्रविधि लुकाउँछन्, ठ्याक्कै यसरी। एउटा उत्तर खोज्नुभन्दा वाक्य–वाक्य गरी पढ्नुहोस्। Mistakes that cost marks here Saying cloud computing and distributed computing are the same. Cloud is about whose computer; distributed is about how many. Defining big data as "mining big data". Big data is the material, data mining is the activity. Calling a laptop on Wi-Fi an IoT device. IoT is for things that are not computers. Swapping VR and AR. VR replaces the world, AR adds to it. Saying encryption hides the method. The algorithm is usually public — the key is what is secret. Cloud र distributed उस्तै भन्नु: cloud — कम्प्युटर कसको; distributed — कतिवटा। Big data लाई "ठूलो data को mining" भन्नु: big data सामग्री, data mining काम। Wi-Fi मा जोडिएको ल्यापटपलाई IoT भन्नु: IoT कम्प्युटर नभएका वस्तुका लागि हो। VR र AR साट्नु: VR ले संसार हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ। Encryption ले तरिका लुकाउँछ भन्नु: एल्गोरिदम प्रायः सार्वजनिक हुन्छ — गोप्य त key हो। Memory hook — VR replaces, AR adds. Big data is the pile; data mining is the digging. सम्झने तरिका — VR ले हटाउँछ, AR ले थप्छ। Big data थुप्रो, data mining खन्ने काम। Practical work — this unit's other 10 hours
